review_text: It’s amazing makes your skin feel so soft and super moisturized will be the best purchase you ever made

If you love Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Glow Sleeping mask you’ll love their new moisturizer. I love its light texture that just soaks right into my skin. It keeps my skin soft throughout the day and goes on great under make up. Even my hubby loves it!
It’s light-gel texture is amazing. Non greasy at all my drink drinks this stuff up. Doesn’t leave me oily at all either. Love the sleeping mask to. Price point is great to product ratio

Calling all oily (even very oily)/combo skin!! This is so amazing! Super hydrating but not sticky and smell amazing. I use this as serum at night and moisturizer in the morning and I have never had a moisturizer that held the hydration but did not produce the skin even with make up on. I also feel like I use to use the murad cushion blotter but with this baby I have not needed it. My husband starting using it too and he loves it! I highly recommend everyone to try this product!
This better never ever get discontinued!  It does not feel heavy or overly wet at all! Amazing and it smells good!

i haven’t purchased a product by glow recipe that’s disappointed me yet!! it smells amazing but it also FEELS great on my skin. i have extremely sensitive skin but this feels like a smoothie for my face. it’s very fresh and because of the unique texture i can actually moisturize my face with just one pump!! my skin looks healthy and dewy, so much that i sometimes regret putting on foundation because it doesn’t glow as much as my skin did!!
review_title: glow recipe has done it again~!

review_text: I’ve been using super thick moisturizers trying to get my dry/combo skin under control. I noticed a difference with one use of this product and love how light it feels! Not greasy or thick at all, smells amazing, and has made a big difference in my skin in just 2 days. My skin feels balanced and nourished. This is going to become a staple in my skincare routine!

I love this stuff. I have sensitive skin and it didn’t irritate my skin at all. I love the smell of the mask but it didn’t do too much for me. So I promised myself if they made a moisturizer that smelled the same, I would use it. And I love it so much. Only takes about one pump to cover my face and it is incredibly hydrating and goes on well under my make up!

can’t get enough of the watermelon smell! smells like a watermelon jolly rancher!!!!bottle is small but a little pump goes a long way! felt super hydrated and provided a nice glowing base for my makeup!

I’m a big fan of the Glow Recipe watermelon sleeping mask.  It’s a bouncy boost of overnight hydration that doesn’t break me out and smells like actual watermelon. What’s not to love?  But I think this moisturizer is my new holy grail.  I’m 45 with acne prone sensitive skin.  I have hyperpigmentation and a tendency towards dry, dehydrated skin.  You’d never know since I started using this moisturizer 3 weeks ago.  It really plumps and firms, making my fine lines and dark spots appear lessened!  Don’t know if it’s particles in the formula or just magic, but it’s fantastic!  Smells like juicy natural watermelon while applying, but the scent dissipates.  Great base for makeup.  Highly recommend!!

I love this moisturiser!! It is the perfect blend of hydration and balance for my combo skin. The smell is define, like summer in a bottle. My skin feels plump and refreshed after just a few uses. You only need a pump for your entire face, meaning the beautiful bottle will last. I have used it at night as a serum before my moisturiser and really enjoyed the results.
review_title: Perfect Daytime Moisturiser For Combo Skin

review_text: I was already in love with the mask. This has the same delicious watermelon smell. Lightweight gel moisturizer. My new favorite.

This stuff is miracle juice. Super lightweight and long-lasting without the greasy residue left behind by other moisturizers on the market. It left my skin soft and even looking. Some have complained about the fragrance, but I found it to be light, especially in comparison to other high-end products on the market (Dior and Chanel, I’m talking to you). Give it a try!
This left my skin feeling sticky. Not great in general, even worse if you have a pet that sheds.

I NEVER write reviews but I love this product too much to not say so. My skin has been feeling so dry lately and no matter what moisturizers or masks I used nothing really worked until I got this. It feels amazing and smells terrific without being perfumey or sugary. I’m so obsessed with this moisturizer. It’s worth every penny.
Smells just like it’s sister. Super juicy & super moisturizing. I love the way it feels & smells. Makes me have super duper glowy & dewy skin & I am so down for the glow!

Not so perfect for the winter months unless you’re layering, but who wants to cover up that DELICIOUS smell?! I keep it in the fridge for a pick me up in the morning after my jade roller. But I’m definitely going to stock up for summer before it’s sold out. This moisturizer is going to be a life saver in my Texas heat!

I adore glow recipe but I have the same problem with this moisturizer that I do with the sleeping mask. When they dry, they do tend to pill up if I rub my face at all and it sort of peels off. It makes my skin feel nice until I start to rub it off-- it just doesn’t sink in the way I need a moisturizer to do. That said, it smells amazing and the packaging looks like it belongs to a princess, and if you use it right before bed it’s totally fine.

This product is my favorite new moisturizer. It’s incredibly lightweight, but still hydrating and doesn’t leave me greasy or break me out. It leaves a slightly sticky residue right upon application, but it fully sinks in after 30-60 seconds. Fragrance is the last ingredient (sigh), but the scent isn’t gross or perfumey. It smells like watermelon candy. I layer this with my Herbivore Lapis Oil and it’s the best combination for oily/acne-prone skin.

I was so excited to try this because I love everything watermelon. And I have oily acne prone skin so I thought this would be perfect for me considering it’s light weight with a gel texture. I’m not sure if it hydrated me or not. I didn’t see or feel any difference/improvement in my skin. The scent is sweet. The packaging is simple but cute. Not quite a moisturizer like it says. I will be returning this.

For me this worked but everyone’s skin is different. My skin was instantly baby soft, I’ve never experienced anything like this. The scent is sweet but not in a sickening way. I think only one pump is needed but I’ve also applied two or three and it still melted into my skin. Will repurchase. I have combination acne prone skin.

Lightweight yet insane moisture. It doesn’t make me break out and it Smells delicious! A little goes a long way. Such a Beautiful bottle. I have the mask and this is equally as incredible! My favorite moisturizer.

Smells amazing, perfect light moisturizer for the morning, results are immediate soft/plump skin!In the morning before makeup I hate using a thick moisturizer and having to wait until it soaks in! The hyaluronic acid gives immediate results and preps your skin for makeup. This gives me a natural glow and baby soft skin. The smell is not overwhelming by any means but is a beautiful touch. I use the Peter Thomas Roth Water Drench Cloud Serum first and then follow up with this for the perfect morning routine! The beautiful bottle is also a huge plus!! Love having this out on my counter.
review_title: Can't wait for more Glow Recipe!

review_text: I LOVE THIS!!! I have been using Sunday Riley Tidal moisturizer and Ive been noticing bumps all over my skin. When I stop using that, the bumps go away. I loved the glow it gave me but hated that it was in a jar. When I tried this out I believe it will be the perfect replacement. I love the packaging!!! I love the pump!!!! I put this on as my last step before sunscreen (josie maran spf 47) and at night I put it on before the glow recipe mask. Its a very tacky cool feeling. If you don’t like that then this isn’t for you! It does absorb into my skin and leaves it incredibly soft and velvety and an insane glow! Like my face looks like slick glass, kind of wet, but not oily wet!!! I can’t believe the glow. I will continue to use this to make sure I don’t get bumps. The ONLY thing I hate is the added fragrance. Just remove that. I rather this smell like a rotten watermelon then a jolly rancher. Added fragrance (unless natural) has no place in skincare!
review_title: The glow is real but Please remove added fragrance

review_text: I really wanted to love this one especially since it smells so good but honestly it did nothing to hydrate my skin whatsoever

Ugh! I am obsessed with this product! I love their watermelon sleep face mask and I couldn’t wait to try out this new moisturizer! It is perfect for oily/combo skin and smells delicious! I feel that my skin has been brighter and looks healthier than normal. This product is staying in rotation! Highly recommend!!!

I love this moisturizer! It’s lightweight and silky to the touch and a little bit goes a long way, I feel as though my skin drinks it right up and I notice a big difference! I normally have very oily skin and this seems to help with keeping it away.

I really like this moisturizer. It’s lightweight but packs a punch of hydration. Also keeps my oily t zone in check. Love the watermelon scent, it’s not too heavy. And I love how Glow Recipe is all natural and doesn’t use water but fruit and other natural juices for their products that are great for your skin. I trust this brand.

This is a lovely moisturizer. I have been using it morning and night for two weeks, and it’s a great addition to my routine. It’s very light but still effective, and I’ve had no problems with irritation or redness. My skin is very sensitive and I have rosacea, so that’s a win. The scent is nice, too, and doesn’t linger.
I am so disappointed. This product did nothing for me at all. I was so excited to try it, but if anything it left my skin feeling dry.
review_title: I Don't Understand All The Hype

review_text: This is a good lightweight moisturizer.  I do notice my skin seems a bit more glowy and not as parched in the usual spots.  I wouldn’t say it’s a miracle worker but I would definitely purchase it again.
review_title: Might be my new day moisturizer.

review_text: I’ve been trying to find a daytime moisturizer and this may be the one! I feel like it balances my combo skin really well and it works well under makeup. It also smells like a watermelon jolly rancher! My only complaint is that I don’t think it can handle my more extreme dry patches, so I make sure to use something a little heavier at night.

Love this stuff! It gives the skin a nice glow and smells amazing! The smell reminds me of the watermelon jolly ranchers. To cover my full face it only takes one pump, so a little goes a long way. I would definitely recommend!

I usually wait longer than a day before writing a review, but I’ve really fallen in love with this! I put this on in between my regular serums and my sunscreen. It plays well with the other things I use on my face, and my skin feels nicely moisturized. Although my skin normal toward dry, especially in winter, I don’t like using thick, heavy moisturizers, instead preferring to layer products on my skin. This works into my routine quite well. It has a light texture and absorbs well, yet leaves my skin feeling moisturized.I was lucky; I was able to snag the last bottle available in the store. Sweet!

This is an excellent, almost essence like moisturizer. The texture is very thin and light, almost drippy. I find it really quenches my skin and is a nice additional to both my daytime and nighttime routines. I can see how some would find the scent a bit overwhelming but I think it is pleasant and dissipates rapidly.

This stuff is AMAZING! I love watermelon smell but understand it can very easily be too sweet smelling and you end up smelling like candy... not this stuff! It smells like fresh watermelon almost with a hint of cucumber. It’s light wait but makes your skin feel so soft and moisturized instantly!

After searching far and wide, I believe I have at last found my moisturizer holy grail! Smells delicious, mattifies my face without making it sticky or dry, and keeps it like that for longer than anything else I’ve tried. I love this so much.
Smells delicious and works wonderfully for my oily and sensitive skin!  This is a lightweight and effective day time moisturizer.  It doesn’t sit heavy on my skin or bother my makeup.

Definitely not the most hydrating moisturizer in my collection but I do not regret this purchase. Works best for me on the days I want to give my skin a break from makeup. Makes my skin glow without looking sweaty or greasy. The watermelon candy smell makes my heart sing.
review_title: The smell will sucker you in

review_text: Love this moisturizer!! First off all, it smells so amazing! Also, it really seeps into the skin to really hydrate it rather than just sitting on top of the skin. I am in love!

I am pleasantly surprised by this product. I just turned 42 and my skin is dry/combination so I generally need heavy moisturizers. This moisture though is not heavy. It’s liquid and light however it keeps my skin well moisturized and hydrated for hours and hours! It also improves the quality of my skin. At night I apply it on top of my resurfacing treatments and it’s perfect. So far I love it and will order again.
It never really sunk into my skin and made my face taught. Left a sticky residue that wouldn’t go away. Made my face itch like crazy. Could be too much fragrance. Not for me...

I have to say I believe my days of hunting for that one perfect ingredient has ended. My skin is mature and I really have to watch what I use . Since I’ve been using this my skin is at its best. Soft and glowing. Fine lines are gone and those awful laugh lines. I’m not saying this is strictly for aging but the key is a good moisturizer. At first it was sticky but I learned quick that I was using to much just a little bit goes along way and I mean less than a dime . It absorbs in the skin and leaves you hydrated and pores are almost gone . I give credit where credit is due . This moisturizer has been a life saver. Sephora is great for helping you if it doesn’t work for you so if you’re debating about it I’d go for it.

So glad I bought this despite my disappointment in the added fragrance! This works great on my skin and I am seeing the results expected from this product. I have normal skin and I can see the glow from this product. I love it! Will be repurchasing!
Smells divine and some of the most hydrating moisturizer I’ve ever used. I use it with the watermelon sleeping masked and my skin looks fabulous!
I have acne prone skin it’s very light weight n makes my skin look very hydrated and no break outs ever since I started using this

Excellent! Since the their watermelon sleeping mask is a nightly staple in my life, I was ecstatic to find they had this moisturizer! After using the sleeping mask I apply this awesome moisturizer in the morning after the I wash my face and it keeps my skin smooth, bright and hydrated the ENTIRE day! As a Sephora employee I have access to every single product in the stores but I only use four items and Glow’s Watermelon Sleeping Mask and Moisturizer are two of them!

I’ve heard so many great things about the watermelon sleeping mask, I had to try out the moisturizer. I absolutely love this product! It’s not sticky, and it doesn’t make me more oily or trigger a breakout (I’m VERY acne prone).My new holy grail!

Let me start by saying I have combination skin, leaning more toward oily. While this product is pretty and smells excellent it just...did nothing for me in terms of hydrating my skin. If you have very oily skin this may work for you, but it was not enough for me even in my oily areas. I’ve never had sensitive skin but it actually made my skin splotchy and red- maybe the fragrance? I wanted to like this because it was fun to use, but ultimately I ended up returning it.
review_title: May be great for extremely oily skin...

review_text: I have only had this moisturizer for about a week now. I really like it so far. I would actually use it in the Spring and Summer rather than the colder months as it is a little thinner and might not give enough coverage and protection for my face in the Winter. However, this is a delicious and delicate potion. I love the smell, the texture, how it feels on my face and did I mention the smell?As for the results, I will have to come back and report on that. I have not had this long enough to see results on my fine wrinkles. It is pure bliss to put on my face though...Grab a sample, if possible, and try it for yourself.

I ordered this right after it became available at Sephora and have been testing it since. First off, I LOVE that this is a moisturizer geared towards combo/oily skin, I always feel like there just aren’t enough of those around. I fall under both. I have horribly oily skin during the summer, and in the winter my t-zone is an oil slick and my cheeks and sides of my nose are always dry. I like the ingredients in this product, nothing comedogenic for acne-prone skin. It’s a pretty watery, thick serum-like consistency, and I only need one pump for my entire face. It smells very faintly of watermelon, but not overpowering and once you put it on your face the smell quickly dissipates. I’ve found it does a pretty incredible job at moisturizing my dry patches while keeping the rest of my face from getting to crazy shiny, and use it in the AM before my SPF. It’s not a matte finish, but a more dewy look that I think looks wonderful. It doesn’t keep oil at bay all day long, but nothing does for me so it’s not a downfall. Also works well under makeup and with a primer as it sinks into the skin and doesn’t pill or leave any residue on the surface. Great purchase and a really nice product. I’m looking forward to seeing how it handles in warmer months with my skin.
review_title: Finally, a Combo/Oily Moisturizer that Works

review_text: I’m an adult woman constantly suffering from acne. My skin is sensitive and I have rosacea which makes it hard to use any product. I’d also like to slow the process of aging but everything always ends up being too harsh. I have severe oily skin too but this product combats that. It’s  lightweight, it makes my skin feel soft not thick, heavy, or greasy. I feel like I have the worst skin but this product gives me a nice glow which makes me feel pretty for a change. Everyone’s skin is different but I highly recommend trying this product. I can’t imagine it not working for someone when it works for me- Ms. ultra sensitive skin.

The PERFECT lightweight moisturizer!  With my combo/oily skin, this works amazing underneath my makeup.  At night, however, I need a little more hydration and instead layer it as a serum.  Smells amazing - like watermelon jolly ranchers!  The smell disappears a few seconds after application and does not linger.  It’s important to wait 30-60 seconds after applying this before putting on makeup in order to let it set.
I was really intrigued by this product when it launched. I actually really like it. It feels super nice on the skin, not drying or oily. It really sinks into my skin, it looks and feels hydrated!

I was thrilled to pick this up, especially since I needed a new moisturizer and LOVE the sleeping mask. However, this left my face feeling day and sticky with a sticky residue on my fingers. It kept its gel consistency post application and left me feeling like I needed another moisturizer to put on over it. Returned this one.

Okay, let me start by saying that the first day I used this I wanted to return it immediately. My face looked patchy and red within minutes of putting it on-- reminiscent of when I had rosacea back in high school (I haven’t flared up since I was a teen, and I was NOT about to deal with that again). I’m not allergic to any of the ingredients to my knowledge, and I really liked the consistency, so I decided to brave through it and keep using for a few more days before I made a decision. Fast forward a week: This is my new favorite moisturizer. The after-application-redness got less extreme with each use, and at this point it has almost ceased entirely. It gives me just as much moisture as some heavier creams do, except this feels so light on the skin and doesn’t take forever to absorb like those products. It’s like you’re getting the intense benefits of a serum with the added protection of moisturizer. It’s going to be my holy grail when the summer comes and I don’t feel like putting anything even near my face. If your first impression of it is as bad as mine was, I really suggest giving it a few more days before tossing it. The ingredients seem to make the skin better over time and it takes a few applications to get a realistic idea of how your skin is reacting.
I felt no difference in my skin and it left a sticky coating. didn’t feel like my skin was absorbing it. Cute packaging but not worth it.

The best things about this product:  You will reach for it over other moisturizers on your shelf because 1) it is lightweight 2) non-sticky 3) refreshing 4) beautiful bottle holds pretty pale pink fluid 5) it smells amazing fresh, light not sweet watermelon scent 6) it works as an effective moisturizer for combination skin.
review_title: Six Things That Equal Five Star Moisturizer

review_text: This moisturizer is amazing! I have combo skin and it hydrates and yet doesn’t leave my skin oily! Smells like fresh cut watermelon. After only three days my skin feels fantastic! Highly recommend.

It’s like a dose of refreshing “everything” for the skin. Skin feels soothed, smooth and refreshed. Love that my skin drinks it up and has a glow! I use it as a serum under a heavy moisturizer for the cold season.

it’s a really good moisturizer. I was skeptical since this is geared towards oily skin types and I have severely dry skin. boy was I surprised. it plumps and hydrates like no other. it’s a really nice gel like texture and a little bit goes a long way. smells amazing and keeps me hydrates ALL day long. only problem is that it feels tacky after application but only for a few minutes. love it.
Perfect daytime moisturizer for combo skin especially in humid climates!

This moisturizer is hydrating without being heavy. Great for combination skin. The packaging is especially good (glass bottle with a pump!). The light watermelon scent is refreshing and does not irritate my skin like other fragrances.

This moisturizer smells good and it sinks in to the skin nicely and quickly. I have not yet noticed any major changes on the tone/eveness of my skin after using it for a couple of weeks now, or it controling my very oily skin any better, but I do like that it doesn’t just sit on top of my skin like other moisturizers. I am over 40 and have very oily, acne prone skin.
Nice lightweight moisturizer that doesn’t grease-up my bangs. Bonus: it smells like the 80s!
Absolutely love everything that I’ve tried from this brand!

This is my new go-to moisturizer. I thought I would only use it when I needed a light refresh, but it happens to be a perfect blend for my skin. I have VERY sensitive, acne prone skin and this leaves my skin soft for the whole day and when I put it on at night it retains that moisture through the night. This isn’t some “ fix-it-all” or “anti aging miracle” but it’s daily moisture and makes me skin feel really good.

First off, this smells delicious! I usually prefer unscented beauty products, but this is an exception. It’s a gentle and natural smelling watermelon. It goes on smoothly (pat it in) and makes my skin look dewy and feel that way as well.
review_title: Wonderful dewy finish and delightful scent

review_text: I love this moisturizer! I normally use gel moisturizers because I have combo skin and this is one of my favorites! It keeps my oily t-zone under control and hydrates the drier parts of my face, even in the colder parts of the year.

I decided to give this moisturizer a try and was disappointed. Yes, it smells fantastic and the packaging is super cute but I’m not a fan. The formula is very lightweight and I prefer something thicker that I can really feel sink in. It did make my skin feel soft but I didn’t notice a glow or radiance after applying.

This, unfortunately,​ made me break out pretty severely. I am lucky enough to only have one breakout every few weeks and my whole face was covered. The consistency is also not as smooth as I expected and the scent is very artificial smelling. I expected more from this but it just didn’t perform to my standards!
I have oily acne prone skin and this moisturizer, although it smells beautiful, gave me a bunch of whiteheads and left a very sticky residue. Bummer.

This is my FAVORITE moisturizer!!! Not only has it helped with my dry skin but the redness on my face has improved dramatically. Honestly I bought it because of the smell but I’m so happy I did because my skin has a glow to it that I have never had. I really hope they put more products like this out on the market because I think watermelon is amazing as a skin care product.

The o my moisturizer I’ve tried that doesn’t break me out or irritate my sensitive skin. I have combo/oily skin and this works miracles for it; it keeps my skin soft and supple without clogging my pores, or making my oilier.
A little goes a long way and my skin feels so smooth and refreshed once it’s applied. I also love the smell of it!

I had to buy this because I already love the watermelon glow sleeping mask. I loved it even more!!! This does exactly what it says, leaves my skin plump, hydrated, and glowing! I have dry skin, so I definitely recommend if you do too, putting a thicker moisturizer overtop of this. But even if it’s just left alone, it does the trick for sure! Not to mention, it smells like heaven!!
review_title: IF YOU ❤️ THE SLEEPING MASK YOU’LL ❤️ THIS

review_text: really love this moisturizer.! it has a very cooling and soothing effect on the skin.. makes the skin very plump, thankfully my skin didn’t react to this.. smells beautiful and is a light moisturizer for spring and summer.. i have been using it for a week and have definitely noticed a nice glow on the skin.. consistency is a bit tacky but not too much that it actually would be bothersome. totally recommend it!

Ok, here’s the true tea on this product. When I first got it, I HATED it. It felt like it was just sitting on top of my skin, not soaking in, and made my oily skin even more greasy/oily. It honestly felt like I needed to blot my face after doing my morning skincare routine and I looked so wet it was like I was sweaty. Then I realized that I was using wayyyy too much product. This is so light and spreads so easily you really don’t need that much product. The other problem was I was putting it over my Sunday Riley CEO Serum, which is very thick for a serum, it’s much more like a lotion/emulsion, and I know generally you are supposed to go from thinnest to thickest consistency, but since this is a moisturizer I wanted to use it over my CEO. But since the CEO was heavier than the Glow Recipe moisturizer, the moisturizer could never sink into my skin so it just sat on top all greasy and shiny and gross. Knocking off a point for that reason, but I felt like the CEO wasn’t doing anything anyways so ever since I cut that out of my routine I’ve been LOVING this moisturizer. Really light, so definitely better for oily skin like mine.

I have very dry skin and reddish cheeks. After a week of using this product my skin is SILKY smooth and less red. This is the very first moisturizer that has ever worked for me and help to make my skin flawless and beautiful!!!

Just like the glow recipe sleeping mask, I love this! I am very picky when it comes to skincare but I absolutely LOVE Asian skincare. This product again is a thick oil like consistency but doesn’t leave your face greasy or oily. Soaks into the skin fast and leaves it smooth. It smells exactly like watermelon but it’s not too strong. Love the packaging and the light pink color.

Other than it smelling good I did not like it. I have the mask which I use a few times a week. I like the mask but this moisturizer I feel like is identical to the mask. Everything is the same minus the packaging. I didn’t like the way it looked paired with my foundation. I used it for 2 weeks and 5 different foundations and it made me more oily. Returned the moisturizer and was disappointed it wasn’t a score for me.

This is amazing! I’ve always had really dry skin near my nose and forehead, but oily under my eyes and on my lids. I could never find a moisturizer that helped with both. This one does! It saved my skin. I use it with the watermelon overnight mask and it’s worked wonders!! My skin has never felt so good! Another nice thing is that one pump of this gives you the perfect amount to cover your face so you don’t have to worry about putting in too much. 10/10 would recommend!

I REALLY wish this product didn’t have added fragrance. It has a nice texture, absorbs quickly, and keeps me hydrated in combination with an oil or hydrating toner. BUT it started breaking me out horribly, no doubt because of the fragrance. I’m very glad I only got a sample so that I didn’t feel guilty about not giving it another chance. It’s taking my face weeks to heal :(

Just purchased this a few days ago and so far, I am extremely happy. This lightweight moisturizer smells amazing. Goes on easy and dries quickly. My skin is a bit oily and you never know if you’ll look so overly oily at the end of the day. Didn’t make my skin look oily at all. You only need a small amount and the bottle is a good size. Should last for awhile. Plus I think the bottle is pretty.
review_title: Oily skin moisturizer that is lightweight

review_text: Wowzers do I love this moisturizer! I’m a licensed esthetician and skin care junkie, and this is one of my new faves. My skin has recently become oilier, so I bought this with the hopes of having a gel like hydration that doesn’t leave me sticky, and this ticks the boxes! It smells absolutely amazing, and leaves my face plump and smooth.

This is a great lightweight moisturizer that packs a heavy punch! It feels super light and fresh when it goes on but super hydrates my skin quickly. It leaves a slightly tacky feel to my skin but could also be the combo of products I use before it. The tackiness also doesn’t bother me because I usually put on makeup right after and like to have my skin a little tacky

The best moisturizer from Sephora so far. And this is the only place we can find this product. It’s a little slimy and i like it. The scent should be a lil less than i think it’ll be perfect. It leaves a long lasting softness and moist over night. I have super sensitive and prone acne skin but it works really well on me.
review_title: pleasant scent with long lasting softness

review_text: I’ve tried everything from drugstore to high end, and this is the first time I’ve found something that both feels hydrating and keeps my combination/oily/sensitive skin from looking freakishly oily, like I rubbed vaseline all over my t-zone.  I took one star off because the bottle is tiny and gets used up very quickly. Although this has no effect on the moisturizer’s efficacy, the packaging is BEAUTIFUL. It’s the most aesthetically pleasing skincare product I’ve ever bought, and it seriously looks like an art piece sitting on my vanity. Many of the other reviews say that one pump is enough to fully moisturize your face, but I find that it takes at least a pump and a half to make my skin feel moisturized. It absorbs almost instantly, though, which is nice. It’s both extremely functional and effective, and has the most adorable packaging I’ve ever seen, so you can’t really go wrong with it. If only they would double the size, though, because two ounces is literally only 2 little medicine cups full of product, and you’re paying $40 for it.
review_title: A bit small, but still nice and effective

review_text: This product is amazing. Granted after the first time I used it i was about to return it because it felt like it made my face oily. I was using way too much.  A drop goes a very long way and after just a week of using it my skin is the clearest it has ever been. This is a must have and I won’t be going a single day without it!

Based on my skin type this product is not intended that be a moisturizer. Even though I have dry skin I use a thin gel moisturizer powder in the morning under my primer and makeup (typically the clinique yellow gel moisturizer). I had read really good tins about this product and combined with FOMO I purchased as soon as it was on the Sephora ap. I think this is and ok moisturizer. I only use it in the morning because I need a much more heavy duty one at night. I hope honestly don’t think it’s any more hydrating than the clinique yellow gel moisturizer and it’s was cheaper. I use 2 pumps per cheek and 1 on my forehead. It does soak in right away and work well under primer and foundation. You also get 2 ounces which is more than the typical 1 or 1.7 ounces. I recommend this to anyone looking for a light moisturizer. (On a side note I hate watermelon and the smell is strong at first but quickly disappears.)

I NEVER write reviews, but I HAD to for this moisturizer. It’s absolutely amazing. The smell and texture are everything! Finally an amazing moisturizer that doesn’t smell like chemical concoctions or SPF. SUPER moisturizing (even more so than heavy creams, in my opinions). It really does make my face feel like a baby’s bottom. My new fave!

I wanted to love this.  It smells like a watermelon jolly rancher.  The bottle looked lovely on my dresser.But I hated how it never sunk into my skin.  Then it became a medium to collect every dust particle I ran into during the day.  I could feel the grime on my skin.I tried this for a couple of weeks and returned it.
Love this moisturizer! I have aging skin and this provides a nourishing feeling with dewy results. Lovely, light watermelon scent. A little goes a long way.
review_title: Dewy results from a super moisturizer!

review_text: Tried a sample and wanted to love it. It has a strong watermelon scent but faded within minutes after applying. However, it left my skin feeling very dry. Quite the opposite of what I need for my already dry skin. Would not recommend to anyone with dry skin as it doesn’t live up to the hype

I have loved the Watermelon Glow Sleeping mask so much I’m on my second jar. When I saw this daily serum I knew I had to try it. It’s perfect to start the day before moisturizer. Loving this K Beauty line!!! I dab this on during the day around my eyes and in wrinkle trouble spots. Fresh and hydrating! Really love this line!
I have dry skin but tend to get really oily during the day. This is GREAT for a daily moisturizer. so hydrating but the oiliness is so much better!

I LOVE the Glow Recipe mask so I thought I’d give this a shot too. I love it as well. Works amazingly in the morning as a moisturizer or as a serum before my moisturizer if my skin is feeling dehydrated.

I was a little disappointed in this. The claim is that this is good for people with acne prone and oily skin. My skin is very oily and I have blackheads. I get occasional jawline hormonal acne but it’s usually one or two blemishes a month. No big deal. I have been doing a 7 step regimine for 4 months now and wanted to try this. I was using the Benton Aloe Propolis Gel as a moisturizer. Now, the watermelon moisturizer feels wonderful and gives a very nice dewy look. The ingredients list is wonderful...or so I think. But a week after using it, I have small pimples and closed comodones all over my forehead. I haven’t had a pimple on my forehead in over a decade, since my teenage acne began. I’ve read about your skin purging, but i have never had something like this happen before. I exfoliate physically twice a week and once I do a gentle enzyme exfoliation. I have no idea why else this could be happening other than this moisturizer as nothing else in my routine has changed.
review_title: Made me breakout where I haven't since a teen

review_text: The packaging is pretty and expensive - glass bottle with the pump to keep it the hygiene. The moisturizer has a light texture and runny consistency - like the serum. It smells like a fresh watermelon on your face. I have super oily skin, and it surely has done a great job in keeping my skin moist and reduce my oiliness. It’s great for daytime routine! I guess I need to try the sleeping mask from Glow Recipe too since I prefer a bit more of hydrating/moisture during the nightIf you have dry skin, I don’t think the product is for you, since the moisturizer is very light in texture, consistency, and how it feels on the sk​in. The product works great for oily and combination skin.
review_title: Best moisturizer for my OILLLLLLYYYY FACE!!!

review_text: Great for oily skin!!!!!  I have super oily skin and dread putting moisture on in the morning for fear all of my makeup will slide off my face.  Not only is this moisturizer my favorite color,  but it sinks into the skin quickly and leaves my skin feeling refreshed without stickiness or oiliness.  Bonus it smells amazing.
review_title: Millennial Pink dreams for oily skin

review_text: Watermelooonnn! So delicious smelling! This product is great. I have dry skin and it has been so moisturizing.

I use this in the mornings and it makes a great base for makeup. I only use one squirt for my whole face. I have oily skin so it might be different from person to person but it helps reduce shine. I stopped using it for about a week and my skin broke out. It truly helped me keep my face hydrated and clear. This was an amazing purchase and would recommend to everyone!

This product really does work, it’s simple ingredients but effective. I have very sensitive oily/combo skin, and this is enough moisture to balance my oils and keep the redness at bay. It works well under my primer and foundation as a nice tacky base. It’s cooling when settling into my skin, so very refreshing. This is a gel-like texture. I use this in conjunction with their mask at night. My skin texture and tone has improved.  I would not rely on this ALONE though, for texture issues, their mask with AHA does great on dry patches. I would highly recommend getting both products and using them in conjection together.
The smell is really nice. It’s not thick at all, but it moistures really well and my skin became really soft and smooth like a baby. I love it

I normally have red and bumpy skin. I have been using this product for a month now, and my friends and family have mentioned to me that my skin is more healthy than before. Redness has calmed down tremendously and my skin is so smoothe! I you have these issues you HAVE to use this!

Only been using this for a week but I love it already! I have combination skin and this doesn’t leave me oily during the day at all. I love how light weight it is but isn’t too light weight where it feels like it disappeared on you. Also you can’t love the smell?? So happy with this product!

I use this for my morning moisturizer with a treatment serum. It is a great lightweight lotion with a divine scent. With my drier skin, I use something heavier at night, but this is perfect for under make up. Soaks right up and leaves my skin soft.

I was really excited to buy this, but I don’t think it’s for everyone. I bought it because i have combination skin and figured it would be a good fit since I live in humid south Florida. When I put it on, it doesn’t feel like it completely dries. It leaves my skin a little tacky, almost like there’s a film on my skin. I had to wash it off. The smell is amazing. It has a nice texture and easy to spread.

This product has always left my face feeling hydrated and soft. It absorbs pretty good on my face. My face is not shiny once it is all absorbed. I did not see any difference in my skin though. So for me it was a basic moisturizer. The only -1 star I gave it was due to the smell. It is not strong but the scent of artificial watermelon is just not my thing. If you are not a big fan of artificial fruit smells, I suggest trying a sample in store first before you get it.

Amazing! I haven’t been able to use a moisturizer for a couple of years without a breakout until I tried this. I had very dry sensitive skin a few years ago, and then all of a sudden I had oily, acne prone skin. I started using this because my skin was suffering without moisturizer and I was hopeful. It has not caused one breakout! It has helped heal the breakouts I had when I started using the product. This sits well under makeup, and causes no excess oil throughout the day.
review_title: Perfect for makeup and irritated skin!

review_text: I love this moisturizer. It is lightweight and goes on easily. Soaks into the skin quickly leaving you feel moisturized, not sticky or heavy. And it smells terrific. I don’t quite understand why some people have said it dries out their skin - I find quite the opposite.

Smells good, but I wouldn’t really call it a moisturizer. I have normal/dry skin. This is more like a serum, it is light and dries down fairly quickly.Could probably use this in the summer on top of my skincare regimen and follow up with another moisturizer. It smells GREAT. Like a jolly rancher. :) Once i run out, probably wont repurchase.

I LOVE this moisturizer!! It smells SO YUMMY and is an awesome hydrator if you have dry or combo skin. It is not very heavy so I do use a thicker moisturizer on top but it is a great buy and one bottle goes a long way!
Loveeeee this moisturizer! You only need a pea size amount for entire face so be mindful. Plus the smell is just a great added bonus.
It’s OK. Smells great.  Kind of expensive tho for a moisturizer. I’ve been using it for a month and it’s nothing life altering. Will not spend the $ again. But not returning it either.
It worked to keep most of the oil at bay, but I had white heads EVERYWHERE after a few days of use. Will not continue to use this product.
I am very pleased with this product.  My skin looks amazing, even after they took my hour away.  Try it, smells like heaven and not sticky at all.  Wonderful product.  My skin looks amazing.

Normal skin. The product has a nice fragrance and is really lightweight. But the moisture doesn’t last very long. By the end of the day I have a few dry patches on my face, even on no makeup days. Recommend it for maybe oilier skin types.
Best moisturizer I ever used! I absolutely love the smell and texture of this product.

I’ve heard a lot of hype about this so I was excited to purchase it. The bottle is dreamy, like glacial ice. It has a fruity watermelon smell (like some type of gum or candy?). The lotion is very lightweight, almost like water. Felt slightly tacky, didn’t feel like it dried all the way or absorbed all the way. If you can get past that, I did feel like my skin was nicer. Probably a good summer lotion, for now I’m going back to my thicker lotion, or just use this in the evenings when my skin needs a little more moisture.
The best part about this moisturizer is the smell. There’s really nothing special about it aside from that.
Aside from the yummy smell, my skin is softer and smoother and no breakouts so far.
I seriously don’t get the hype of this lotion what so ever. My skin  is normal/combo and this did nothing. It didn’t feel soft or moisturized.
Smells lovely and provides adequate moisture without any greasy or heavy feeling! Size of bottle is great for travel although the glass is a bit heavy. Recommended for oily skin!

Pros: Pleasant watermelon scent that fades relatively quickly. Absorbs quickly and doesn’t leave my skin greasy.Cons: I think something in Glow Recipe’s products just don’t react well with my skin. Normally a light moisturizer like this would be perfect for my combo skin, but both this and their watermelon sleeping mask broke me out. Final Verdict: Unfortunately I’ll be returning this, but I think this is just a case of my skin being incompatible with the product. Otherwise a good moisturizer for oily or combo skin if it works out for you. Also, irrelevant to product performance but the packaging is super cute and sturdy. I love that it has a pump.
Light-weight, great-smelling, very moisturizing.  This moisturizer has proven to be ideal for my combination skin, even in winter.  And it did not cause me to break out.

This is great! I’m currently using this as my daytime moisturizer, it’s light but still hydrating and the watermelon smell is so refreshing.  The only reason I held back a star is because I’m not sure it’s worth the price, I was using a more inexpensive moisturizer before this and it worked just as well.  Bottom line is that I haven’t quite decided if the refreshing scent is worth the extra cost.

I really like this moisturizer.  It goes on like water, but moisturizes all day.  I don’t know that this would work well for super dry skin, but for my normal, borderline dry skin, it is perfect.  No heavy feeling at all.
I have combination skin and this moisturizer works great for me. I use it twice a day after I wash my face and my skin has stopped peeling and feels much softer after using. And it smells great!

I love the packaging, smell, and appearance of this product. If I had oily skin, I’m sure I’d love the function. Unfortunately, this didn’t provide enough moisture for my normal to dry skin, but I still think it’s a wonderful product— it just wasn’t made for my skin type.

This is wonderful. I have pretty oily skin so it’s hard for me to find a moisturizer that works for me. I LOVE this!!! Not oily/greasy, smooth, light weight, does it’s job, and did I mention smells AMAZING! 10/10, would recommend!
I love this product! So light and absorbs into the skin very quickly
It didn’t feel nice. I’m not a snob but this just isn’t all it’s hyped up to be. But it does smell fantastic

This is pretty good! It smells amazing and soaks right into my skin. For me I have found that it works best as a light moisturizer/ serum before I apply my azure blue tansy oil at night. By itself this is probably not best for dry skin without the aid of another moisturizer. I have normal oily-ish skin and layering with an oil makes for a nice glow when I wake up. The packaging is so cute but the bottle itself is smaller than what I was expecting for the price. Overall may repurchase after a while but probably not right away.
Love!  This stuff smells heavenly, goes on smooth and makes my face feel all hydrated and nourished.  I love it.
I love this moisturizer! The scent is amazing! Love the feel!
Love the smell and hydrates my skin so good. Love this Moisturizer!
This moisturizer smells sooo amazing. It left my skin feeling super soft and hydrated.

I love the smell of this product but I understand not everyone may like it. I love when my products have a fruity smell. I use their sleeping mask as well and I find it does wonders on my skin. It’s lightweight and nongreasy while packing a nice hydration punch. It has worked well on my friends that have acne prone skin, oily and dry skin. I love how with a pump, max two, it goes a long way. If you don’t like heavy, thick moisturizers, this is a product you must try! I recommend this to anyone who’s a beginner in skincare. I look forward to trying out any products Glow Recipe comes out with. As of now, I love every single product they have.
Love love love! Very oily and this moisturizer is the perfect thing for me ! I also love the sleeping mask! I

The packaging is beautiful and it’s pink (what’s not to love?). It smells like watermelon candy (which I love) and the scent doesn’t linger when you put it on your face. I used one pump and I thought that was enough to cover my entire face. It felt sticky at first but it sunk into the skin nicely. My issue with it was it made me SUPER oily throughout the day, with and without makeup on my face. It also claims to help with redness and I didn’t feel like I did that at all. If you have dry skin or combination skin (that’s more  on the dry side), I think this would work great for you.
Pretty good, like the smell

Quick Notes:1) Not heavy on my oily skin2) Does not clog my pores3) Works perfectly with my retinol4) Putting it over a primer helps foundation blend seamlessly5) Light, fresh fragrance  I loved the Watermelon Glow Sleeping Mask, so when this came out, I decided to give it a try. I’m using an acne regime with a retinol product at night and it can cause some drying of the skin. I use the moisturizer as my last step in my nightly routine after my cleanser, toner, and retinol: it works wonders! It has not made my skin oily and has not added additional breakouts. I’ve been incorporating it with my makeup routine as well. After primer is applied, I put a pump and a half of the moisturizer over the still damp primer. While everything is still damp, I apply my foundation with a beauty blender and it makes me have mannequin skin. My foundation blends flawlessly with it and my primer of choice, literally making it look like natural skin. I adore this product. As someone who does not like watermelon, I actually enjoy the fragrance of this product as well; very light and summery.
review_title: Oily, Acne-Prone Skin and I Love!

review_text: I have oily combo skin, i tried this for a few weeks and felt like it didn’t really make a change for my skin. smells good and feels really nice and also makes you glowy looking but i felt it wasn’t doing much for me.

This moisturizer is so amazing for acne-prone, sensitive, combination skin. I’ve struggled with acne for years and this moisturizer has really helped keep my skin hydrated and healthy. It has such a pleasant sent. My skin always drinks this stuff right up and I’m left with a beautiful, natural glow. This CRUELTY-FREE moisturizer is a holy grail and I recommend it to all of my friends.

I don’t know what it is about this moisturizer, but I was scraping my sample tub trying to get every last bit. It smells incredible, but it also feels incredible and has made my skin look naturally glowy

I’m so in love with this product! I have oily, sensitive skin that is prone to acne. I’m currently using dermatologist prescribed topical acne treatment that limits what I can and can’t use on my face. Decided to give it a go, and I’m so pleased. Not only is it gentle, it’s super moisturizing and doesn’t leave an oily sheen. It absorbs quickly and smells delicious too. Worth every penny.
Amazing! Makes my skin feel good and it’s not to thick. Definitely five stars

I really wanted to love this because it smells sooo good and feels so nice while you are applying it however it was not very hydrating. Once it soaked into my skin my face felt dry and almost as if I needed moisturizer. It is light weight and soaks right it but did nothing to hydrate my skin so I had to return it.

Like it, don’t love it.  I have super dry skin.  This is hydrating, but in the New York winter not enough on its own. I always apply a moisturizer over it.  Has a light watermelon scent, which I love. Sinks into skin nicely, more like a serum.  I haven’t  notice a major glow or difference in the quality of my skin over the past three weeks, which is something I look for in a moisturizer.  All in all, still on the fence.  Won’t write this off because it works great as a primer before makeup and I think it will be great during the hotter humid weather.
Amazing. Use it every night and I cannot believe the difference. Hydration is so important when battling acne prone skin. Love this!
Nothing special only smells delicious, made me break out and I never do i always had clear skin, will return.

I love the smell and packaging of this moisturizer and think it would be great to use during the humid summer season. However, even with my oily acne prone skin, this moisturizer is not enough for the dry winter season. I get dry spots around the nose and areas where I use salicylic acid (for my acne) and this does not help moisturize those areas at all. I would use this as a serum or during the summer when I want something ultra light weight. This moisturizer did look good under my foundation which is the reason why I am keeping it. Overall, I wouldn’t purchase again.

Just wow! I have VERY oily skin. Like, super oily. I’m so exhausted from trying out products to see if this one works or that one works. Before I found this I was using Origins Ginzing moisturizer and it was ok. I read the reviews for this and had to try it. And DANG!!! I love this stuff! Nothing will ever help me 100%, but this is the closest to helping me stay matte I’ve ever experienced! It smells amazing, and the packaging is fantastic. I’m in love.

As a person from the dehydrated dry skin community, I say this is a hard pass. The packaging is cute so trust me I wanted to like it, but this doesn’t even sink into my skin idk I was very disappointed if you’re looking for a nice hydrating moisturizer go for the Clinique Thirst Relief Moisturizer (it’s also pink) ;)

Going to have to order another bottle in the near future!  Love the scent! Not an overwhelming/strong odor, but is just enough to make it pleasant. I get dry areas, yet I also break out badly at times. Since using this, my skin isn’t nearly as dry anymore,  and my breakouts have decreased by 75 to 80 percent at least!  I would suggest this for people with combination skin for sure.
It smells and feels amazing on my skin, but it doesn’t moisturize at all. It left my skin even more dry than before I started using this product.

I adored the sleeping mask but it was a little too oily for me so I always did the 10 minute sit and then washed it off. This is a wonderful light weight moisturizer and my go to. If my skin is really parched I will go with something much more thicker, but for every day moisturizing this is my new holy grail. And it smells great too!!
I honestly don’t know if it’s doing anything to improve my skin but it smells amazing and it’s a pretty great morning moisturizer for oily skin.

The smell is lovely and it’s texture is great because it’s cooling (almost like a gel) but I will not be re-purchasing this product. I really wanted to love this but it’s not for dry skin. I ended up using a moisturizer on top of this because it feels tightening (more like a serum) rather than hydrating. I’ve been using it for a little over a month and have not noticed any significant changes to my skin.
This stuff is even better than the sleeping mask.  It smells amazing, it’s super light and absorbs super fast. No residue either! A must for a morning moisturizer
Not as good as the mask. I love the smell and it does make your skin feel soft but my face still felt very dry. Looking for something that gives my face a nice hydration boost and this wasn’t it.
review_title: skip this and get the mask

review_text: I love, love, love this moisturizer! My favorite part being that it dries impressively fast and therefore doesn’t add any time to my morning makeup routine. It smells great and it really does add glow to the skin. I consider my skin to be very sensitive and I haven’t had any issues after two weeks of using. Definitely recommend!

I mean, I just love this!! Was so skeptical, but I took the chance and I can’t say enough! Sinks in, plush, and light! I have dehydrated skin so I usually top it off at night with my goat milk moisturizer. I have reactive skin and have not had any adverse reactions!
Does the bare minimum and if your face isn’t super squeaky clean or pillowcase isn’t just washed it tends to break you out over night. The mask is wayyy better!
review_title: Nothing more than a plain moisturizer

review_text: I bought this because the bottle and the color of the gel is super cute. smells really good too and it does moisturize my skin well.

While I do think this is overpriced, I’ll probably keep buying it... its smells absolutely AMAZING and it worked well on my skin.  I was using Origins energizing gel moisturizer but my i was finding that my nose and in between my eyebrows would still be dry.  Not with this, it absorbed well and keep my t-zone from drying out.
Perfect summer moisturizer! Super light, absorbs quickly, moisturizes well and smells divine! This didn’t irritate my sensitive skin and goes really well under my tinted moisturizer!

I really wanted to love this! It smells amazing and went on so nice. But after trying it off and on for a few weeks it just broke out my face every time. In places I don’t even break out too. I think it has some heavy fragrances in it and that’s probably why. It’s a bummer!
I love this moisturizer both during the day under makeup and at night under the Sleeping Mask. Going to be perfect for summer, and it smells PERFECT!
While I think this is good. I have not noticed changes in my skin. It looks pretty though. It gives good hydration but I don’t think its different than any other moisturizer.

Loveeee this stuff! Smells amazing, gives your skin a healthy glow, and sinks in almost immediately. I have super sensitive skin and most moisturizers break me out - luckily this watermelon magic juice has kept my skin clear and moisturized. Also doesn’t seem to cause excess oil on my tzone which is a miracle in and of itself. Not sure that it is improving my skin texture/lines after a month of use, but it is a great AM moisturizer. Works very well with primers (tried with several) and foundations.

Packaging is a 10. Scent a 8. But the real tea for my combo skin is this. It felt like it did not soak / sink into my skin. It made my nose / tzone feel oily and heavy. On top of that it made my skin feel like there was product just sitting on it. Almost greasy. I have cheaper moisturizers that do way better.

I have NEVER found a moisturizer that works like this. I had actually given up on finding “my moisturizer” because I didn’t think it existed. Until now. This has a water-based, thin gel texture that immediately soaks into my skin and keeps me hydrated all daaaaaay. I use it daily and nightly and I really do like how this doesn’t leave an oil film like literally every other oily skin moisturizer does for me. To me- this is really worth the investment.
review_title: FELLOW SHINY-FACED FRIENDS, THIS IS A HOLY. GRAIL.

review_text: started using this moisturizer about a week ago after a Sephora employee recommended it too me and boy did it make such a difference in my skin in just one week! I love this stuff!! I wanted to love it but I just can’t.  While it smells amazing! It breaks me out terribly.  I gave it a fair try on 3 separate occasions thinking maybe other things were effecting my skin that week but it happened every time I used it.

i recomen this product it soo good

This stuff is SO great for oily/combo skin. Smells like a watermelon jolly rancher (if you’re sensitive to scents you mightttt wanna be careful, but I’m not bothered by it). I feel soft w/o feeling oily all day, so ya know, this stuff? Perfection. I pair it w/ the other glow recipe products.

I never use moisturizers because they make me breakout. This is very light weight and a little bit goes a long way. Doesn’t break me out or make me too oily. Soaks in very quick and leaves skin texture every soft but not shiny.
I love this moisturizer! So light yet does the job and i notice my face stays moisturize throughout the entire day.

I love this product! I struggle with acne and marks left behind and I’ve tried everything. Nothing has ever worked for me until I’ve tried this! It smells nice and absorbed quickly. I have very oily skin and this is perfect for me. My acne is just about non existent and my marks are fading fast. Love it!

I have extremely sensitive, acne prone, combo skin and this works great for me. love the light smell its gooey goes on smoothly but leaves me face tacky that’s the only thing I dislike I have oily skin but do not see any difference I have used it for almost 2weeks

Really nice lightweight moisturizer. I use it in place of the Drunk Elephant Hydra Gel in my routine, Great to layer (I use it just after DE’s Vit C and before Dr. Jart Ceramidin Cream). The formula is nice, and I’d buy this again.
It’s okay . It drys really quick and I need to keep putting on more !
I have been going through an oily phase recently, and this worked great fro me. I needed moisture but nothing heavy, and it smells fantastic too.
Broke me out and left my face very shiny.

I love this! I have combo skin and it helps keep my skin hydrated but not get oily around my t-zone. It absorbs quickly and smells amazing! My skin tone looks even in the morning and my pores are less noticeable around my nose.

This smells delicious but it broke me out. Basically it stays a little bit sticky and unless you’re putting on makeup over that, all the dirt sticks to that stickiness. I have combination skin, the moisturizer didn’t sink well on my skin and left a sticky feeling throughout my face. It didn’t really do anything as far as controlling my oil. I think the best part of the moisturizer is the packing
It’s very lightweight moisturizer with a fresh scent of watermelons.  That’s it. High price for a lotion that doesn’t really moisturize much.

I absolutely LOVE the smell. It smells heavenly, the best moisturizer I’ve ever smelled. It feels really great on the skin and sinks in nicely.
