I loved it at first, it made my skin really soft but slowly it made me break out and I’ve never had a single pimple in my life. Not even in high school. :( really wanted to like it

This is the best moisturizer for oily/dry combo skin. I have very oily cheeks, forehead, chin and nose while have dry patches around my nose and jaw. It has helped considerably with both issues. I really recommend it! I love it!!
Bought this for the smell alone! Super light consistency and goes on super smooth. Will be fantastic for summer.
I love this product because it’s super lightweight and your skin soaks it up instantly, leaving you with a ​natural glow.
At first I wasn’t impressed but the more I use this product it has become an obsessive staple. I love how the smell isn’t very strong and it’s very gentle on my sensitive skin. Highly recommend!

For my oily skin and breakout prone, this is a great gel formula. I put it on in the morning after i clean my face and then at night going to bed. Since it is such a light airy texture, my skin absorbs it so I don’t look greasy. Highly recommended this along with their “watermelon sleeping mask” because they do not irritate my skin! You also get a lot of product for the price so I do agree in paying more here versus the drugstore if that means better quality.
I was really excited about this product, smelled nice felt great etc.  However it made my skin extremely sensitive and irritated with lots of flaky skin..

I have been using this brands’ mask (also on my husband! Lol!) the first week it came out on Sephora.com.  This seems to me to be the Watermelon Mask watered down--5 stars for the formula being in a pump-now if they could just put their mask in the same packaging!
Why add fragrance?! Dear all companies stop adding fragrance to your face and body products. Majority of people have allergies.
review_title: FRAGRANCE should NOT be in skincare!!!

review_text: I already love majority of Glow Recipe’s products and the other masks and skincare lines they carry on their site. I was so excited to try this and I’m enjoying it as my daily moisturizer currently. The smell is great and my skin drinks it up every morning and night!

I have very picky skin, acne prone, oily throughout the day, but it feels dry and unbalanced without any moisture...this is my new holy grail. I picked this up after falling in love with the sleeping mask, and this did not disappoint! A tiny dot is plenty for my entire face, it completely disappears into my skin leaving no trace on the surface. It does not increase my greasiness with or without makeup.  Can’t recommend enough, my 2 year search has finally ended.

I got this back in February and have used it once a day since then (using a little more than less than 1 pump). It’s pretty tacky and it’s light weight. I don’t see too much of a difference using it and I think it’s an okay summer lotion, but for $40 it just doesn’t seem worth it. However the sleeping mask is my favorite.
It left my skin feeling really soft Kinda like I had a veil on it The more you use it the better results you get.I got my sister hooked on it she loves it

I got a sample of this and really wanted to like it. The bottle is so cute and I love that it has a pump head... I also LOOOVE watermelon and the scent is just slightly sweet enough without being overpowering. However, it feels sooo sticky on my face like it’s just sitting there and not absorbing. My skin immediately felt kind of tight and unpleasant. I used it for 3 days and started seeing small dots appearing on my face. :-( Super bummed that it didn’t work out for me.
The smell is a bit too strong for me. It is a kind of sweet and fruity smell, so if you like that smell it might not be a problem for you. It seems to moisturize pretty well.

i just bought the full size after using the trial size. i love how my face feels after i use it. i has pretty oily skin with the occasional break out, but this really smoothed my skin and evened the color. i’ve been looking for a good moisturizer and this really impressed me

I have acne prone combination skin. I have been using a combination of cetaphil and coconut oil in the past just to not irritate my skin. I bought his moisturizer recently because of the scent, it smells like a watermelon jolly rancher ! This soaks right into my skin giving it a dewy and plumped look. I use this in conjunction with Sunday Riley power couple duo and my face has never felt softer/ more moisturizer / brighter. I recommend this product to anyone who needs a good summer moisturizer.

Like most of the reviews here mention, this moisturizer has pros and cons. Pros: I think it’s deceptively lightweight and actually moisturizes well - not enough for winter, but good for warmer weather. And while I usually prefer my products to be fragrance-free, there’s no denying that this smells delicious! I haven’t had any issues with acne or redness. Cons: The main issue is that this dries super sticky. I guess that makes sense, since it contains fruit juice. It does give your face kind of a glossy, glassy look which some people might like, but I can’t imagine wearing it during the day.  I can see why other reviewers felt like they were picking up dirt/pet hair/etc.! Even at night, the stickiness is kind of unpleasant.Overall, I like this but probably won’t be making it an everyday product.
My skin is literally glowing. This moisturizer is so lightweight and non-sticky and smells divine!

After seeing all the raved reviews, I thought it was a perfect gift to give since my friend always talked about wanting to give a try with glow recipe brands. she was definitely surprised and loved it! And now I wanted to try it! LOL :)
I absolutely love this product. The smell is amazing, its really light and makes my skin look good and helps with the oiliness.

Great product! I use this a serum after my toner and before I use the Rose Hydration Cream from Fresh. Since my skin is now very dry, this works as a serum for me, but still provides a ton of moisture. I would highly recommend - love the scent - very mild but fresh and fruity. Awesome product!
review_title: Love! Perfect as serum for dry skin

review_text: So far, so good! It smells delicious, is lightweight

I bought this after reading the reviews, and had high hopes for it. I liked it at first, the scent is fruity, the packaging is cute (ofcourse they got me at packing). Unfortunately, it didn’t do anything for my skin. The dry areas in my face still remained dry and patchy. It was too watery/runny for my liking. It did break me out, which I rarely breakout.

Got this product as a sample and used it until I finished the bottle. It left my skin feeling so hydrated and soft, I decided to buy the regular size! This product leaves my face feeling moisturized all day long!
Not impressed. Smells so good. But is way too sticky and did not absorb into my skin. Had to return.

I’m so glad I got a sample before I bought it! I have oily, aging skin, and I’ve read so many reviews how this leaves a matte finish. Not for my skin. It felt like it just sits on top of the skin, and it peels really badly under primer and makeup. I have the Glow mask and love it, but it peels too, which is fine because I use it at night. I would recommend this to someone that maybe does not use an SPF or makeup, that would prevent the peeling. Or use at night before your Glow mask. I would give it 2 stars, but I love the smell!

I tried to love it. But it made my combo skin oilier in places and sticky in others. It has caused my skin to break out as well. It does smell delicious and if you don’t have sensitive skin(like me...) you should give it a try!!
I’m trying to like this, but my normal/combination skin just gets oily later on in the day. More so then when I don’t use this product. I’m better off with the Drunk Elephant B Hydra Gel.

I love this moisturizer. It is a little on the pricey side but the packaging is super nice and the product is very nice as well. It really does have a strong watermelon scent but it never irritated my skin and I personally love the scent of it.
Made my face feel really sticky and itchy. Broke me out and usually nothing breaks me out! Very disappointing
Love this stuff! Some days i do feel like i need to add a heavier moisturizer, but i’ve been using for about 3 weeks now and I’m still in love with it!
THE ONLY moisturizer that doesn’t irritate my skin. And I tried DOZENS. You only need a teeny bit. It smells heavenly, and sinks in great. Ah! So glad I got this.

This is a great, lightweight moisturizer. It has a smooth, gel-like consistency that can be easily worn under makeup or on its own. I use it daily as part of my morning routine. Despite being lightweight, it is very hydrating and will keep your skin moisturized throughout the day. I think this moisturizer would work best for someone with combination or oily skin. It’s also a nice moisturizer to use for the warm weather.

This is definitely one of the better moisturizers I have ever used. I have sensitive but average levels of oil and dryness in my skin. That being said I usually have to switch to a lighter cream in the summer - and this one is perfect. Smells AMAZING and is light a feathery. The watermelon mask is awesome too. Together they make the perfect summer combo skin routine.
review_title: Great Light Moisturizer and Perfect for Summer

review_text: I love the watermelon smell of this moisturizing gel! It really does give you great moisture and your skin just drinks it up! It doesn’t leave a greasy feeling on your face either! Totally worth the purchase!!

Really loving this moisturizer! Packaging is beautiful and not cheap looking. The smell is obviously so refreshing but light. I appreciate a nice scent so long as it’s not overwhelming. The actual moisturizer itself is lightweight and you really don’t need to pump a lot out. I use about a pump and a half and it’s good for my face and neck. It also works great with my foundations (I used It Cosmetics CC cream & La Mer foundation). I believe this one is a keeper and I will probably repurchase!

I like this pink juice but it doesn’t quite blow me away like the mask does! The smell is extraordinary and I like the product but don’t feel like it’s giving me a TON of moisturizing unfortunately. I’d say this product is good but not great. I’ll keep using though and maybe it will grow on me.

LOVE LOVE LOVE!!If you have dry/sensitive acne prone skin look no further!! My skin has improved soooo much since I started using this product!Brightness, hydration, and improvement in skin texture! All things that this lovely gem gave me!

I got this as a gift, I have been wanting to try it since I have heard good stuff about it, but within the second day of trying it my face was extremely itchy, irritated, and made me break out everywhere!! I have oily, acne prone skin for the past two years and have been constantly finding products that can adjust to my face. Very disappointed, my face had started to get a lot better and this product in a matter of two days took me to square one.

I bought this product a few weeks ago after reading all of the glowing (ha) recommendations, and I’m not that impressed with it honestly. It is very lightweight which I like, and smells delicious, but I don’t think it’s really doing much for my skin. I don’t really like how sticky it is when it dries, and I don’t think it’s moisturizing enough for me. I have pretty normal skin, not overly dry and definitely not oily, but it doesn’t seem to add anything to my skincare routine. Will be returning.

I only am giving this moisturizer two stars because it did break me out and I got more blackheads on my nose. However, this lotion was so beautiful and luxurious it felt like gel and I’m sad it didn’t work for me.

I received a good sized sample of this and wanted to love it but just didn’t. I find the very fruity, sweet scent is not to my liking. It’s also kinda sticky and I like my skin care products to absorb well without any sticky residue.

I have incredibly sensitive combination skin. Quite a few common moisturizer ingredients give me cystic acne and i’ve been struggling to keep my skin hydrated without breaking out. ENTER THIS MAGIC POTION. It smells divine, it lightweight and immediately dries down and plumps my skin. And even though it is a light gel moisturizer, this little gem made a huge difference in the moisture of my skin after only 2 days of using it. i’m in awe. It’s pricey but worth every penny to me.

I think that this is a perfect, light weight moisturizer for spring/summer. Smells really good and when I use in combination with the watermelon mask my face stays really hydrated and glowing! Definitely worth a try!
The smell of this is AMAZING! I bought after trying the sleeping mask. Very light weight and refreshing - I have very dry skin so sometimes this on its own is not enough.

Favorite moisturizer I have ever tried for my combination mostly dry skin type. My dry spots are moisturized but it doesn’t leave my more oily spots feeling even more oily. It is just the perfect moisturizer for me.

At first I was skeptical about trying this moisturizer because the price and who it caters to. I am an 18 year old girl with what seems like combo skin bit leans more towards the oily side of the spectrum. Seeing the bottle reeled me in at first because it has a pump and I love the color pink so I looked at it and when I smelt it I fell in love with the smell. So I asked for a sample of it to test out before fully committing to the purchase. It is super light and leaves your face feeling baby soft. However at first I didn’t like it due to the tackiness of it when it does down but after really taking the time to know what works best for me,  I was able to find a way to make the tackiness not so bad and unbearable. Now I can say I love this  moisturizer. Everything from the packing, to the smell,  to the actual performance of the product. I would definitely recommend trying this out but I would recommend getting a sample first and trying it out with your skin routine to make sure that you actually like the product and that it works well with your current products you use.

Lightweight and not sticky, but I don’t see any difference in my level of oiliness. I will likely keep this because it is a nice product at night, but I continue my quest to find something that helps with my oiliness.

I love the way this smells, like watermelon candy. It’s light and absorbs quickly. It’s not at all greasy, though I’ve noticed it takes a little while for it to absorb into my skin.I had tried a sample of this moisturizer and I had tohave the full size. Now I’m really interested in other Glow Recipe products.
I’m in LOVE with this! It smells amazing and is the perfect summer moisturizer. It’s light weight and not oily! I wake up feeling dewy every morning! Will be repurchasing soon!

I really like this moisturizer. It’s fairly lightweight, which makes it a good nighttime choice for me since my skin tends to be a bit oilier in the evening. It smells just like fresh watermelon, and makes my skin feel baby soft. It’s a bit pricey, but hopefully it’ll last a long time since I’m only using it once a day.

I’ve had this product for a little over 10 days and I must say WOW. I LOVE it I can’t stop raving about it to everyone!! It’s one of those things that give results instantly, at least in my case. This moisturizer/serum is AMAZING. I’ve noticed my skin is way softer and more plump than before and my favorite part is that it STAYS that way. Love it. I’ve also noticed a HUGE difference in skin tone, it’s more even now and a lot of my redness went away. Acne cars have also been fading everyone has been complimenting me on my skin since I started using it. I do apply a drugstore moisturizer after though so I use it as a serum. The only thing I’ve changed from my skin care routine has been adding this Miracle juice and I don’t plan on changing it again!

i put this on before school, as i was putting it on it was almost sticky. It was also very light weight and went into my skin almost immediately. by the end of the day( didn’t have gym) i was broken out everywhere even my neck where i usually don’t breakout. I really don’t even have acne prone skin. I’m so disappointed.

For well over a year Drunk Elephants B-Hydra has been my holy grail, but lately it just hasn’t been moisturizing enough and anything heavier was breaking me out.  After trying a sample of this for a few days I think I’ll be switching to this once my bottle of B-Hydra runs out to see how it works long term.  Feels great, doesn’t break me out so far.  Only downside is my skin does feel ever so slightly tacky afterwards but nothing I can’t deal with. I’d rather feel like that than a big greaseball.
This stuff is really good! It moisturizers and hydrates very well!! Love it.

I loved the watermelon mask so much I bought the cleanser and moisturizer. Moisturizes without being greasy or oily! Also doesn’t leave a residue once applied which is great for following up with makeup.
Great light moisturizer

I have very oily skin. thus my skin has become constantly texturized and dried out, because most moisturizers are oil based and the cleansers I have to use are super drying. I started using this product a couple weeks ago, after being frustrated about not finding a good moisturizer that isn’t oil based. My skin feels super hydrated. It’s firmer, because my skin cells aren’t all dried and most of my skin texture is now gone. I have used this all over my face and have not experienced any sensitivity, even near the eyes. This product also smells exactly like a super ripe watermelon. I would definitely recommend this.

I like this moisturizer a lot. I think it’s important to note that I have dry not oily skin. I think this moisturizer is great for use during the day, under makeup. It absorbs quickly into my skin, which I really like. I will buy this again!
Honestly the best moisurizer I’ve used. Lots of things irritate my skin and clog my pores and I have combo skin, but this made my skin sing! Not to mention a little glow that looks so natural.
I actually like this stuff but .. it sadly broke me out . It felt amazing and smells amazing as well but it broke me out and it dried down with no sticky feeling .

My combo skin loves this moisturizer. I was skeptical at first about its lightness but it sinks in and leaves me moisturized without looking oily. The container is glass so be careful I almost drop it daily. The yummy scent is a bonus and disappears after awhile.
Best moisturizer for oily skin!

cannot praise this enough, I have been using it for a month now and haven’t had a single breakout, my skin looks even, I am obsessed. My skin tone is looking even, and my skin is hydrated. Will continue to buy.

I was terrified that this moisturizer would irritate my skin or cause bumps, but it hasn’t! I use it every morning and before bed and I’ve noticed and improvement in my skin’s texture. I knew I would love the smell because I have the mask as well. I have very sensitive skin so I am impressed!

Super lightweight and smells wonderful. I was worried it would be a strong watermelon smell but it isn’t, a lil goes along way I use like one pump and pat it on. I really like it!! Gonna try the sleep mask next.
GREAT! At first it feels like an oil. As an oily skinned person, I was a Little nervous. But it blended out super nicely and made my skin so soft. Plus it smells amazing!

I purchased this since it was recommended for oily skin types. First things first, if you aren’t a fan of scented skin care then you will not love this! But for those that do it smells just like starburst. I haven’t noticed any breakouts or sensitivity from the added fragrance. Now I will say that the claim of tackiness is true, but only if you use too much product. I use about less than 1 full pump & after 10 minutes it’s absorbed into my skin. When I use too much I definitely can feel the stickiness, but it doesn’t affect my makeup or nighttime routine. I really don’t feel anything extraordinary with using this. I think I like it mainly because of the aesthetic with the color & bottle (love that it’s a pump btw), but I feel like it gives the same results as any other moisturizer. But I will say is it wears nicely under makeup, gives nice hydration for oily skin, does not add to any oiliness, and smells delicious.
Smells amazing, does nothing else.....

Git this as a sample from a company rep. There was a severely disappointing amount for the sample. The product left my face sticky & didn’t feel well hydrated. I ordered the sleeping mask, I hope that is better.

I am really picky with my moisturizers so I tend to try a lot of samples. I received this as one and it wasn’t too bad, but definitely not for me. I really dislike the consistency. It’s more gel than cream. Seems to moisturize ok, but what really turned me off was at the end of the day, if I touched my face I could feel pilling. Being the only new product in my rotation, pretty this moisturizer was the reason. While it’s great for a lot of other people according to the reviews, definitely not for me.
My dry skin loves this light and quick-absorbing moisturizer. I also love that it’s cruelty free

I found out about this when I took a Flawless foundation with color IQ class at Sephora and I love it. During the class we briefly touched on skincare and the wonderful ladies at sephora asked me about my skin and one had skin similar to mine which is really oily especially t zone area and she  recommended this to me! My skin feels so soft and supple after using this. It is not greasy at all and it just smells amazing! It doesn’t take a bunch of pumps to moisturize.

First off, this product does deliver a glow that doesn’t clog pores, look oily, or break me out. Secondly, I have dry skin, and I pretty much ignored that this was marketed for Oily. I thought I might be the exception, but I wasn’t. I have combo, mostly dry skin, and I have one really dry patch. This did NOTHING to my dry patch, but in my combo/mildly dry areas it was really great. I’d say if you’re looking for a moisturizer that’s gonna quench dry skin, definitely skip this one. If you’re pretty dry, but not overly dry I would say give it a go, because the glow factor and smell of this (not to mention the cooling effect!) is really great, and that’s why I probably won’t be returning it. I think it would be great for people in the summer that are really dry in winter but their skin gets slightly oilier in the heat of summer. Alternatively, if you have VERY oily skin, this probably wouldn’t be the moisturizer for you. This is a product that is great for combo/normal skin. Not really dry, not really oily.
review_title: Stay away if you are very dry!!

review_text: Nothing special. I have oily/combo skin and this didn’t really do anything extraordinary. It’s lightweight and sometimes I feel like my chin area gets flakey because this doesn’t moisturize it enough.

Used this moisturizer every night and I woke up with absolutely beautiful, dewy skin. This drastically changed the actual texture of my skin but didn’t do much for my pores. Love the smell but can be a bit sticky on your hands!

Honestly, when you put it on it doesn’t feel like it’s doing much. But over a couple weeks most of the texture on my skin is gone, the tone is more even, and my skin is just looking great. The results I’ve had with this convinced my boyfriend he should be using it too! The smell is very nice too and doesn’t stick around long.

Cute product - smells great, lovely packaging, but it takes FOREVER to absorb into my face. It’s been two hours and I still feel some tackiness on the skin. Would not recommend as there are much better, cheaper options out there!
This is amazing for oily skin. I use it in the morning because it’s not super heavy but it still feels nice on the skin. LOVE the smell.
I bought this days after I purchased the Glow Recipe Sleep Mask.  I lobe both products and will continue purchasing them!

First thing’s first, if you don’t like scented skin care items, you will probably not like this. It has an almost artificial watermelon scent, but in my opinion it goes away pretty quickly after applying it. I was really skeptical about this product after the first use because it left my face feeling a little sticky. But after it soaks in for a few minutes, your skin will feel SO smooth and the sticky feeling completely goes away(that’s with using 1 pump which is all you should need). Not only is my skin super smooth now, but I have this natural looking glow that I’ve never had until I started using this. I would definitely try a sample of this before spending the 39 dollars though! Because I’ve seen a lot of mixed reviews.
review_title: The glow is strong with this one

review_text: Felt sticky at first, but honestly AMAZING moisturizer - I have  slightly dry skin, but this lightweight moisturizer works just fine. It healed the dry patch on my cheek and makes my skin feel super soft!

Not a thick lotion...light and hydrating. Smells really good. I have oily/combo skin. I put this on my skin over the Whal Myung skin elixir at night and in the morning my skin feels good and does not look oily. Will probably purchase this again.
I love this moisturizer. It’s smell good and face feels so fresh after use .

I got a sample size of this as part of a sun lover’s kit through Sephora. The smell is what first appeals to you, but the hydration is what keeps you coming back! I can honestly say I look forward to applying this to my face every morning. I just love the watermelon scent in summer. I’ll switch to a heavier moisturizer in the winter, but this is great for a dewy summer look.
This moisturizer is nice and lightweight, it smells amazing and I think it’s even helping with my breakouts
This is really light weight and absorbs fast and the smell is fruity. Honestly, I’m sad the scent doesn’t last longer!
This stuff is great! Cleared up my breakouts in a month (used the cleanser as well). Smells great and soaks right in the skin!

This earned 2 stars because it smells good.  It loses the rest because I don’t understand why this is called a moisturizer.  It goes on lightweight, and has a more watery texture than anything.  It dries to a sticky film that I can’t wait to get off my fingers.  Did not moisturize the normal-dry areas of my combo skin.  Did not really notice anything, and there are far less expensive moisturizers available with helpful ingredients for one’s skin.
so nice! great hydration but it absorbs completely and isnt heavy at all. it is a little tacky for about a minute but it subsides. I will definitely buy this again. and the smell is incredible

Pros: light moisturizer, smell nice Cons: IT ENHANCES YOUR PORES (my pores beome more visible after 2weeks using this product), face feels oily and greasy after 1 hr of applicationDO NOT WASTE YOUR MONEY ON THIS! I highly recommend Kiehl’s ultra facial cream even though I have combination skin
Broke me out. I thought this whole line was geared toward dry and sensitive :( dissapointed

I’m really picky about facial moisturizers so I wasn’t sure how I would feel about this stuff.  I have oily to combination skin with random dry patches. This product feels really watery and gel-like. It goes surprisingly far on the face. It smells AMAZING - exactly like a watermelon jolly rancher. I’ve been using it for about a week now and the glow is real. My skin feels so healthy. The only way I can describe it is bouncy?? Anyway, this stuff is awesome. I’ve been using the corresponding  overnight mask as well.

AMAZING!!! I have combination skin (dry cheeks and oily forehead/chin) and this stuff is wonderful! My skin looks fantastic, feels so soft, and smells great. 10/10, the only moisturizer I’ll ever use.

I have very acne prone skin so I use a lot of AHAs and other products to combat flareups and this tends to dry out my skin a lot. I get really flaky and red around my mouth. I have tried a lot of top shelf moisturizers that just haven’t worked. This stuff is amazing. It smells great, looks so pretty, and makes my skin feel wonderful. It hydrates so well and doesn’t cause any breakouts! My dry patches are gone and I haven’t had any acne either so best of both!
review_title: Finally a good moisturizer for severely combo skin

review_text: I love this moisturizer.  I live in a very windy dry climate and never needed moisturizer until I moved here.  I have tried many different brands, but this one is totally different.  It’s lightweight and feels wonderful.  I use it at night and in the morning under my makeup.
Amazing moisturizer. Leaves my skin looking so radiant and makes it feel so hydrated. It doesnt have a strong watermelon smell like people say it does but it has a slight watermelon scent.

Overall love this product! Was looking for a product to work with my oily skin and so far so good. It moisturizes without being too heavy, and my skin has a glow after using it, and works well underneath primer

had to get rid of this after only a month of using. i was initially attracted to the “glow“ portion of this, packaging, and wanted to try a new product. literally does nothing and its SO sticky. just a pretty packaging thats all. only positive is that it didnt make my skin breakout

The product feels very light and smells great. I’m prone to breaking out with just about anything that goes on my face but this hasn’t caused any breakouts...yet. Hopefully, it stays that way. It also makes my skin feel very soft. I would recommend this product.
love love it feels great on the skin, dries nicely and smells really good

First moisturizer I’ve found that works for my oily/acne prone skin that makes it feel hydrated and isn’t heavy at all. 10/10 would recommend. I use this with the frothy face wash from Origins and my skin has been way better since!!

Wanted to love this for two reasons; 1) I have very oily skin and 2) it does not contain any silicones (!) but I haven’t been wowed in the 3 weeks I’ve been using it. I’m very oily all over my face by the end of the day; this is that “juicy radiance“ they must be talking about but it just looks like an oil slick - not exaggerating either! I adore the smell but for those who are scent adverse it goes away as soon as you pat it in. I love that it has NOT broken me out and I haven’t had any adverse reactions to the ingredients as I have VERY sensitive skin. Have not noticed any improvement in dullness, uneven texture and skin tone. I would consider repurchasing this based on the fact that it doesn’t have any silicones which causes cystic acne in me but I’m on the fence..  It’s not a bad product, just wish it would do something more than make me look oily. You might like this if you have more combination to dry skin as this does hydrate very well.

This stuff feels amazing and smells great, but like other people have said it also made me break out. I don’t know why because it’s geared towards oiler and breakout prone skin types, but as soon as I stopped using it the breakouts calmed down.

Really like this moisturizer. It’s lightweight, smells SO GOOD, and you only really need 1 full pump for your whole face. Also, it makes you have a nice healthy glow (like you will realllly glow!) ✨✨✨

This is my holy grail moisturizer for oily skin/combination type. It’s so hard to find a good moisturizer when you have naturally oily skin but this did not let me down. It applies smoothly and spreads a lot on the face even with just a little. My face is soft without oily residue the next day.
review_title: A Must Have For Oily Skin

review_text: Love this product really hydrates without leaving your skin greasyDefinitely for combo sensitive skin
Bought this product, Love it, it’s super light and smells great
I love this!! I love the packaging, the color, the scent, and how lovely it makes my skin. I have dry skin but am prone to breakouts. It’s really great under makeup too.

I have combination to oily skin and it’s really hard to find a moisturizer that isn’t so heavy that it will clog my pores but moisturizing enough for my dry patches. This one is the perfect combo and it smells AMAZING!
I like the smell but its not that moisturizing on me. I have slightly dry middle aged dullish skin that needs a bit more.

This product smells great, just like a candy I had as a kid. It’s not really for normal or even dry skin like it claims. It does not hydrate enough for my nighttime routine and doesn’t mix well with my primer/foundation for daytime use.

I bought this moisturizer because it is tailored towards oily/combo skin. I love the packaging and smell! unfortunately I put this on in the morning and noticed halfway through the day that I started to get bumps all over my skin and was breaking out. this was not the case for the sleeping mask though.
review_title: love it but not for my skin

review_text: I have a mix skin with an oily T zone and could never find a good moisturizer that wouldnt cause a break out. This moisturizer is amazing, smells amazing, isnt sticky on my skin and has made my skin look so much better!! I use it after cleansing my skin twice a day.

A great moisturizer for the summer!! Left my face feeling hydrated without being heavy. For comments saying this product left their face feeling sticky, I found that you have to treat this moisturizer like a serum, and massage it in. <3

I’ve been using this moisturizer for several weeks now, and it’s been working wonders! Yes, it smells amazing, but more importantly it’s super gentle on my sensitive, acne-prone skin. A little goes a long way, which is great because of the price. I use this day and night. I have crazy oily skin and this product gives me enough moisture so my skin doesn’t get thirsty halfway through the day and decide to turn on the faucet. It’s also been evening out my skin tone and gives me a smooth surface to apply makeup. Plus, the bottle is gorgeous... which may or may not have had anything to do with my purchasing it in the first place.
review_title: Worth the hype and the price

review_text: I love this moisturizer. I’ve been on the hunt FORVER for a moisturizer that doesn’t make my face feel greasy or heavy (I left oily in my T-Zone) and this is perfect!! It absorbs into my skin quickly, gives me an amazing glow and leaves my skin so soft and smooth. Totally recommend this.
Underwhelming. Smells great but very watery. Leaves my skin tight and shiny.
Love this moisturizer, very light and refreshing
When I first put the moisturizer on it makes my skin tacky/sticky... which makes it good under makeup. But after 20 minutes my skin is oily and greasy more than when I use other moisturizers.
I absolutely love this product I have dry skin but the moisturizer really does work

Let’s start off with the smell - Amazing. It was very lightweight which I also liked, but I couldn’t get passed the sticky residue it left on my face. It almost made my skin feel more dry than hydrated. I went through one bottle of this already and honestly can say that I say no difference in my skins moisture level. Probably won’t repurchase

I have extremely acne prone skin. For the past 2 years my skincare routine was just washing my face and using a prescribed acne medication, as I was extremely paranoid to put anything on my skin that could even potentially clog my pores and cause more acne. After reading reviews and wanting to upgrade my skincare routine, I bit the bullet and tried this moisturizer. I’m glad to say that it hasn’t clogged my pores at all! It sinks in really quickly and leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. It does leave a slight stickiness but I don’t mind that at all. I would definitely repurchase this again and recommend it to anybody with skin like mine! The only thing I’m a little worried about is that I seem to be going through the bottle a little more quickly than I was hoping given the price. Currently I use two pumps twice a day after cleansing. I may have to cut down a pump to make the product last longer, but I am extremely happy overall! I feel very refreshed and relaxed after using this, too as it has a pleasant scent (reminds me of watermelon Jolly Ranchers. )

I bought this because my winter moisturizer was too heavy for the summer. This is the perfect amount of moisture for summer days, I don’t think it will be enough for the winter days though as I live in a very dry, cold climate in the winter and need a heavy duty moisturizer then. But I was pleasantly surprised. It almost has the texture of if you were to purée watermelon down, which I enjoy, and it smells so refreshing. I really enjoy this. I do think it’s a bit pricey for what it is though, a lightweight moisturizer

I finally found a moisturizer that does the job but is so lightweight! I love the scent and the packaging is gorgeous.  I will definitely repurchase when this runs out (which will take a while since a little goes a long way).

I was really attracted to this because of the smell, and that’s about where it ends of me. Horrible moisturizer, like does almost nothing. I have oily skin and was hoping this would be a good summer moisturizer, but sadly no. I returned it and got the Caudalie Vinosource Moisturizing Sorbet, and I’m so glad I did. I give this 2 stars because of the smell.       I think this is a good moisturizer for a teenager though lol

I think I found my new favorite skincare item. This moisturizer is amazing!! First off, yes, it smells amazing just like watermelon. After using it for a week and I already saw my skin looking better and right now as I write this it’s week two and I’m so happy. My skin is glowing and isn’t dull anymore. It also looks supple and hydrated. I’ve only been using concealer for makeup no foundation needed. This product is lightweight and doesn’t leave any sticky/greasy feeling. I really like it.

Caused acne-like breakouts. I had to go to my fern. She prescribed clundamicin antibiotic, salicilico and sulphur products. As soon as O got it under control, I tried using the watermelon serum again and I broke out again like crazy. I’m 49, not a teen. My dermatologist recommended to ditch it and that the strong fragrance is probably what caused the breakouts.

This is supposed to be a moisturizer.   It sits on top of my skin.  It’s sticky and makes me look oily.   Keep your receipt.  If you have oily, combo, sensitive or acne prone skin stay away.  I am returning this and I have no idea how they are charging this much for a product like this......horrible!I do have a glow but at the expense of have a sticky layer of gross rancid watermelon juice diluted with tubing alcohol and glycerin.   That’s what it feels like.   Doesn’t moisturize or absorb at all.  Just like the mask.....
review_title: NO! Unless you like sticky rancid watermelon glow

review_text: I bought this product after reading through the reviews and I can’t say that I’m 100% in love with it BUT I do like it. I have extremely combo skin, if that makes sense, and this just makes my face a little too oily for my liking. It does a great job at keeping my face moisturized for me, because although my skin is very oily, it’s also very dry and flakey. A little bit of this goes a long way, a whole pump is honestly too much! It also smells amazing! I don’t think I’ll buy it again but if you have dry skin, you won’t be disappointed!

I never thought I could have glowing skin but I do with this moisturizer. I struggled with oily skin and would be shiny by mid-morning. I ran out of the Tatcha Water Cream and even though I liked how it felt and the packing was beautiful, my skin was still very oily. I’ve used this for about three weeks, and my skin is significantly less oily. I have a natural glow and don’t get too shiny by the end of the work day. I use Coola Sun Silk Drops over this moisturizer, and sometimes set with a light powder and have a great natural glow all day.

I honestly love this product so much! It’s very difficult for me to find good, non oily moisturizers and this was just the thing I was looking for! Even the supposed “oil-free” stuff would make my face oily and gross. This stuff is so goo, and a little goes a long way too! I was skeptical about the price at first, but as someone with sensitive skin, this product is perfect. (And it comes in a really cool bottle)

THIS MOISTURIZER IS A BLESSING IN DISGUISE. It has literally changed my skin within a few days of use. It makes my face baby soft. My skin glows so nicely and feels so smooth. I can’t even put into words how much I’m obsessed with this! It’s my new holy grail and I’ll forever use it
review_title: Literally changed my skin in less than a week

review_text: leaves a sticky residue on my face even if I let it sit and absorb overnight. the fragrance is a bit much also.

I have very oily skin, the type where my skin will get shiny after 2 hours of doing my skin care routine alone or after I’ve applied any makeup. At this point, I think nothing will stop my t-zone from getting shiny and oily. I had high hopes for this moisturizer after falling in love with the sleeping mask. But every single time I use this, it doesn’t control my oil whatsoever and I get shiny and oily way faster. I wouldn’t call it a nice or amazing “glow” I hate when my skin feels and looks so oily. My skin appears more “glowy” and healthy looking when I use the sleeping mask, this is just the oil on the surface of my skin not being controlled. However it is very lightweight and smells amazing like everyone else says, but this just didn’t do it for me with controlling my oily pores... the only reason I won’t return it is because I’m hopeful it will be a better winter time moisturizer when my skin needs extra hydration like this.

I have oily skin and this moisturizer is perfect for day and night.  I use 1-2 pumps in the morning and 2-3 pumps at night.  My skin skin is showing so much improvement in acne, oil production, pore size and my makeup looks fantastic over it.  It smells like candy and the packaging is beautiful!
This stuff smells amazing, but it di not work for me as it sat on top of my skin without sinking in - it made me look so juicy and wet, which would be a good look for my lips, but not for my face.
Not for dry or sensitive skin.  Sticky on the skin. I never felt a difference and got itchiness and broke out. Only two things I liked is the bottle and the smell.  Not worth the cost.
review_title: Try a sample before buying this product.

review_text: I have tried many moisturizers over the years that claim to help oily skin.  I am extremely oily, all year round.  This is a new holy grail product for me.  It’s very light but leaves my skin feeling moisturized and not greasy at all.  I can even tell a difference in my oil throughout the day.  Love this stuff!
I have combo oily skin and this product doesn’t work for me. It was not hydrating at all. It barely smells like watermelon and the scent disappears after a few seconds.
Broke me out in a day! It’s very sticky and I broke out all over my face within a day. From the reviews I can see that it happens to a lot of other people. Stay away if you have sensitive skin.

I am so obsessed with the moisturizer! My skin can get really dehydrated, and it has been such a challenge to find a moisturizer that hydrated enough but doesn’t feel heavy on my face. This one is a winner! It is lightweight, and soaks in quickly (no heavy feeling!) but wow does it leave your skin feeling hydrated!

At first glance this product is beautiful. The packaging is heavy, it comes in a nice pump, and smells incredible. I’m not sure if it’s the fragrance or something else, but this product gave me the worst acne breakout ive had all year. These breakouts wouldn’t even go away with sulfur treatments,  which usually clears it up.  I’ve stopped using this product for two days, and my skin is already clearing up. I don’t normally have sensitive skin, this product must contain something that  irritated my skin. It’s really too bad, because I really love the smell and feel of this product.

Wasn’t a terrible moisturizer, just wasn’t what my skin needed. It had a very sticky/tacky finish and I wasn’t a fan. Some people might like that for maybe before they put on foundation but I didn’t feel as if it moisturized the way I wanted it to. The smell was nice and I loved the packaging and bottle!
Nice light scent, love the gel texture.  Throughout the day however made my face really oily.

This lotion does sooo amazing. I’ve tried everything from Chanel to drugstore and this is the best by far for my oily skin. It has a watery consistency that sinks into your skin and keeps you looking hydrated, but not too shiny. Truly a glow!HOWEVER! I give this a tentative five stars just due to usage. I’m around a third of the way through this product after a month of use. THERE IS AN ADJUSTMENT PERIOD WHERE YOU’LL NEED A GOOD AMOUNT! I used one pump in the morning, two at night until my skin adjusted, now I’m only using two pumps total a day and still totally hydrated.

I got it as a sample, but unfortunately, for me it didn’t work at all. The smell is absolutely divine, but it leaves a sticky residue and it’s also a bit itchy. I had to wash it off after 30 min or so because I couldn’t stand the feel of it on my face anymore.
review_title: Sticky and unpleasant. Had to wash it off.

review_text: I love this stuff!!! It is very moisturizing. I feel this moisturizer is very concentrated and a little goes a long way! I moisten my face with water first and then I had no problems with stickiness. I have extremely oily skin like within 1hr oily with or without makeup and I feel this does not contain oils and doesn’t create extra oil. Leave my face slightly dewy. It’s very light and smells great. I even put it on my lips and it doesn’t taste nasty. It doesn’t feel powdery like most mattifying lotions just simply moisturizing.
review_title: Amazing! Use a little on a moist face!!!

review_text: First of all, I love this product! It smells amazing and leaves your skin feeling soft and plump throughout the day, even under foundation and concealer. I will note that when I first began to use the product my skin appeared more red than usual and I was worried about the lasting impact of continued use. This no longer occurs and my skin actually appears more even-toned when not wearing make-up. Definitely recommend.
I LOVE this stuff. Works amazing, my skin looks and feels good. I’m almost ready to buy a new bottle!

Smells aaaaamazing, and is a great lightweight moisturizer for oily skin, BUT is not for acne prone skin- every time I use it my face breaks out in random spots that I never ever break out in, and makes existing acne worse. Really disappointed because everything else about this moisturizing is amazing, but breaking me out is a total deal breaker.

This really smells like watermelon juice, like you blended up watermelon and slathered it all over your face. It doesn’t smell chemically, it’s not too strong, it’s perfect consistency and it’s very moisturizing. I had been using the overnight mask for a good 6 months then I saw that this product came out and had to have it. I think I’ve been using it for a solid 4 months now (mostly in the AM only, I have another night cream) and I have about 1/4 of the bottle left. I anticipate purchasing again, also I love the bottle design looks like ice!

I wanted to love this since it says it’s made for oily skin but it  barely moisturizes. Not bad just to use as a light moisturizer in the morning, but if you’re looking for hydration, this is not the product. I use it more for the wonderful smell than anything.

I have acne prone combination skin,  and as unfair as it can be, am also now worrying about wrinkles.  Just a few days after using my skin was mostly clear,  and a crease I had been worrying about faded away.  While you can glow a bit too much by the end of the day,  a quick blot is worth how happy my skin is!
Have enjoyed using it as a daily moisturizer under makeup. Delicious watermelon jolly rancher smell

If you’re on the fence about this product, BUY IT! I was a bit hesitant to try this after seeing some reviews saying they broke out because of the fragrance or that it was sticky, but I decided to buy it anyways, and I’m so glad I did! I added it to my night and morning routine. I have to say that when I woke up in the morning, my skin looked so plump and glowy and even some of my dark spots that were taking forever to go away, were gone. I feel like I finally have the skin I’ve wanted to achieve for years. I think I’ve found my new holy grail moisturizer, and the smell is a plus because while it’s yummy, it’s not overpowering. I would say it’s amazing for all skin types because it worked for the parts of my face that were dry and the parts that were very oily. I’m excited to see what magic the mask will do!

I use this primarily as a daytime moisturizer, and it is fantastic. Absorbs quickly, and for real keeps my skin moisturized *all* day long and sits under makeup like a dream. I would prefer it didn’t have an overwhelming watermelon candy scent, but it dissipates quickly.

Light, quick to absorb and fragrant moisturizer however it does not provide lasting moisture even though the gel is light and feels good on the skin. This works well on oily skin however a good amount of product is needed to get a full moisturizing effect. Considering how expensive it is it’s hard to say if this is totally worth it when there are other products that moisturize for less just without watermelon. I will say that I do like how it feels and had no major problems. I just don’t believe it is a $40 product. If you are willing to pay for it than it’s worth it
review_title: Light and refreshing but not super moisturizing

review_text: Smells wonderful and is a nice consistency. Did not add anything to my skin, though. Did not feel any more moisturized but it is a fun product.

I have combo and sensitive skin. Many moisturizers do not work on my because they are too heavy and cause me to break out. This moisturizer is the first moisturizer that I have tried so far that doesn’t seem to cause breakouts or leave my face feeling greasy. If you have combo skin and are prone to breakouts, I would recommend the Watermelon Pink Juice Moisturizer. I can’t want to try the mask next.

I have unbelievably sensitive and acne Prone skin. My skin is also usually sensitive to scented products but I decided to try since many acne Prone people were recommending it. It’s a great lightweight moisturizer (great for people with very oily skin). I kept it in my refrigerator so I could get a nice cool feeling when putting it on. But after about 2 weeks my skin started breaking out and I’m sure it’s because it is scented. I don’t recommend this for people who have skin that doesn’t respond well to scented products. But if your skin isn’t like that then I highly recommend this for you! Especially if you have oily skin. I really wished this product worked for me :(

This was a hyrdrating, oil free gel moisturizer. It didn’t make me oily, but it did leave my skin kind of waxy. The main reason that I gave this 2 stars is because this broke me out so much. At the time, my skin was already breaking out from a different product, so I wanted a moisturizer that would calm everything down without making my face too oily. I’ve tried this for a month and my skin was not improving. So I knew something was up. I looked up the reviews for this again and so many people had issues with this moisturizer breaking their face out. So I stopped immediately and went back to my old moisturizer. And within a week, my break outs were going away and my skin was smoother. Don’t know what it is about the moisturizer that broke me out, but it’s a shame that this didn’t work for me.
very moisturizing  nice and fresh actually smells like watermelon ! Light for daytime a bit tacky preps face for primer and foundation

I purchased the set with this moisturizer and the watermelon glow sleeping mask, super excited to try both. However, I was slightly disappointed with this product. I expected more hydration and glow. It smells nice though and is pretty. I will be returning this in exchange for the dr. jart water fuse, which I adore. The sleeping mask is awesome though.

This lotion made my face get really hot, and then I looked over in the mirror and it literally looked like I had thee worst sunburn ever! It was awful. I have pretty sensitive skin so I  would not recommend it for those like me. I will say it smells amazing!
Light and gel like to see right into skin without clogging pores. The smell is amazing and I love the pump
The smell is incredible, brings me great joy! It’s very light and it’s great for my oily, acne prone skin.

I love this moisturizer! You only need a very small amount for your entire face and neck, so one bottle will last a looong time. It smells amazing, the packaging is adorable and the glass bottle is very heavy. As long as you don’t forget to wear sunscreen, your face will be baby soft.

I would say I have combo - leaning more towards oily skin. This moisturizer has been great for me. I tend to get oily in my t-zone and dry around my mouth and this moisturizer is lightweight and keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day without making it feel greasy. Only downside is the applicator is really weird - it would be better if this had a pump.

Omg this is the best moisturizer out there. My skin is so bright and glowy after using this product for over a month. I have extremely oily skin and this really helped cut back on some of the oil production throughout the day. I absolutely love the watermelon scent and don’t think it’s over powering at all.
review_title: Made my skin so bright and healthy looking

review_text: Okay... this product is BOMB! It hydrates so well, it smells incredible, is not greasy at all, is so good for dry/combo skin. I honestly can’t believe it works so well and smells so good at the same time! I have nothing negative to say about it. I have been using it for about a month not and the bottle is still filled to the top. You do not have to use much of it. Even though the price is a bit high, it is worth every penny! LOVE IT!
review_title: Are you kidding me, great job Glow Recipe!!

review_text: This was just okay. I didn’t feel like it was moisturizing any better than anything else I’ve ever tried and it of course broke out my extremely reactive skin. My real problem with this was that it was impossible to layer. I use other serums and any time I would put this on top, it wouldn’t sink it and it would stay sticky on my face. If I only used this, it wasn’t a problem, but if it was layer, it would stay sticky. Considering I enjoy my serums, I did not like that.
Smells wonderful! Moisturizes very well but doesn’t feel heavy. I’ve noticed a slight glow as I continue to use it. I’m waiting on the night cream now. Can’t wait to try it!!
This stuff smells so good and has my skin so soft! It hasn’t triggered any acne breakouts on me as of yet. I’m oily but this is perfect for my skin! I absolutely love it!
An excellent, light but effective moisturizer for the hot months. Works well used in conjunction with SPF cream over it. Has a nice, fresh scent, too.

I had to wait for this one to come back in stock, but it was worth it.  I already use the Watermelon Glow Sleep Mask which is divine so how could anyone g wrong with this one.  One pump and your freshly cleansed face now has a get moisturizer for the day!!  My face is well hydrated, plump, and glows all day long!  [Would love to have a vat where I could walk in after a shower and have every inch of my body covered with this! lol]  This is not a heavy moisturizer which makes it perfect for the day  It absorbs quickly and at night - top your face with the Sleep Mask to wake up with a gorgeous complexion!
review_title: Watermelon Pink Juice Moisturizer is the BOMB!!!!

review_text: Wonderful product! It might seem strange at first, it goes from watery to sticky but upon being absorbed your skin will just feel smooth and hydrated. I have combination skin and I’ve tried argan oil and different things to moisterize my face, this has been the best thing for me so far to keep my skin hydrated without causing breakouts.

I would definitely recommend this! I have oily skin and I would say that I’ve seen an improvement of the amount of oil produced when using this, I definitely don’t feel as oily as normal. This leaves the skins glowy and beautiful. The smell is light and sweet and is not over powering plus when after 5-10 mins it doesn’t smell anymore. I will be buying this again!!

I bought this a few weeks ago after falling in love with the watermelon mask and I have NOT been disappointed. It has that sweet watermelon smell and glides onto the skin and soaks in quickly. I’ve been using it at night before I sleep and in the morning before I put on my makeup. My face doesn’t feel oily or sticky when I wake up (which is refreshing since I have combination skin) and has been the perfect primer for my makeup. I highly highly recommend and will be buying again.

Great moisturizer especially if you are looking for something lightweight in the summer. Also gives a great looking glow to skin. It is not sticky and smells good. My favorite part of the day is putting it on!

I so wanted to love this moisturizer but unfortunately this turned out to be the worst one I’ve ever used. I have combination skin and it dried out my cheeks and chin so bad that I was left with horrible patches and it’s been a week that I’ve stopped using it and my skin still hasn’t gone back to normal.
Pros: Smells nice, pretty bottle, a little goes a long way Cons: Made my skin breakout after 1 use Will be returning
It’s so cooling and smooth under make up! I know the price is steep and it made me kinda ehhhh at first, but it’s a must have now. I’m on my second bottle and I love it. Did I mention I love it? Haha

I got this moisturizer for my combination skin and the only thing I really enjoy about the product is the scent. It dries down too sticky for my liking and I only use one pump for my entire face and the stickiness doesn’t really go away with time. I won’t be purchasing this again :(
I have combination skin that can be very oily. especially in the summer. This is the best moisturizer I have found and I have great makeup days everytime I use it. Bonus pretzel: it smells great!

This product is amazing if you just want that little boost of glowyness added into your skin. I feel like after the first use my skin was so glowy and beautiful, and I got tons of compliments on my skin.

When I bought this moisturizer, I had a “slight“ sunburn on my face and that night I put this on my face after cleansing and toning and it was absorbed right away. My face no longer felt dry. I have used it most mornings and evenings since and not only did my face not peel (yes, even subsequent added time in the sun). Though it does sometime feel sticky, I think that it is also due to over use of toner because some days it has a slight sticky feeling but some days not. I would recommend this product and oh, it also smells great if you like watermelon.
Smells great and is light. but I’m not sure it adds much moisture

Love this product!  It is very lightweight, and smells fantastic!  I have normal skin, borderline dry in winter. I just purchased a month ago, and I like to use this as a wake me up for my skin after the shower. It is a little sticky, but putting on sparingly helps to avoid it being out of control.
It didn’t work for me; I have very oily skin and this moisturizer makes it worse, specially in summertime.
love this moisturizer!! It is very light but hydrating, and it gives me a really nice glow! and did I mention it smells so yummy and refreshing!
Love this moisturizer. If you have dry skin though this definitely is not for you. Combination and oily skin friendly only.
I love the way that this moisturizes the face, you can seriously see your skin glow without makeup.

I wouldn’t classify this as a moisturizer. I have dry skin and I need something to leave my skin plump and moisturized. Maybe because it’s for “combination to oily” skin and I’m not supposed to be using it but it’s not “moisturizing” enough. It leaves my skin feeling tight. But throughout the day, especially in warm temps it does leave a glow. Also, I need to use like 4 pumps to spread onto my face evenly. This product is a little pricey to be using 4 pumps everyday.
Love this as a serum for my dry skin!!!

STICKY!  I don’t know so many people can say it doesn’t dry sticky but I’ve tried it a few times and each time it dries the same.  It’s lightweight and smells nice but it just feels gross.  I love the mask but this stuff is a no from me.

I expected more and would give this product a 3.5 if possible. Proceeding with 4 stars only because the price is reasonable. Smells delicious as stated. Product does soak into skin so I used two coats on my semi dry skin. Just wish it had a little more moisturizing finesse since it is listed as a moisturizer and NOT a serum even though description of product differentiated between the two. Which seems too sly to me. If you have dry skin this will NOT meet your moisturizing needs.

Let me start with this stuff smells AMAZING and the packaging is beautiful but the product it self is not my favorite. I have combination skin. I’m usually very oily right now (summer time) and every time I use this it dries my skin out. My skin feels awful and is flaky around my nose. I am very disappointed because I was very excited about this product but it just doesn’t get it done for me. Maybe someone with more oil will get better results!
review_title: Smells good but that’s about it.

review_text: LOVE this moisturizer! I am extra oily in the summer and use this in the mornings under makeup for my 12-14 hour shifts at work. It keeps my hydrated and smells amazing, all while keeping excess oil out of the picture.

This is the best thing I’ve put on my skin in ages. I am over 60, but my skin is still rather oily, especially in the summer. I have always been very moisturizer averse, since I get an acne outbreak occasionally. In addition, I often have reactions to products, so i am very cautious about trying new things. This past winter, for the first time ever, my face looked and felt quite dry. I came across Glow Recipe in my research and decided to try it based on the excellent reviews. This is the first new skin care product I’ve tried in years that I totally love. It is very lightweight, smells lovely,  and sinks right into my skin. It really does make my skin glow, and I have not had a hint of a breakout after using it for several months. I thought I would not continue using it in the summer, but in fact i am, and I think it has actually improved the oiliness situation.Highly recommend!
I have really dry skin and didn’t do much of anything for it. My skin was left still feeling very dry but the smell is great and has beautiful packaging but doesn’t replenish any of my dryness.

Perfect for the summer!! It’s super light and it smells like fresh watermelon. I love it!! I have combination skin, so I was nervous about trying it, but I love it!! I don’t apply it daily, but I always apply it when i need some extra glow!!

I wanted to love this, I really really did, but it fell flat for me. Pros: Smells amazingAbsorbs quickly A little goes a long wayPhenomenal packagingCons:Leaves my skin feeling stickyDidn’t do much for my skin Did I spend this much for it to just look good on my counter???Conclusion:Will look amazing on your dressing table and looks great in the background of your Instagram photos... but that’s pretty much it. Returning.

Love the smell.  Love the ingredients. Best packaging on the market. BUT not moisturizing enough for me. I use Tretinoin, and therefore hydration is critical to keeping skin balanced. IF you have oily skin, this would be a great day moisturizer. It seems to be a great blend of a moisturizer and an essence in one. I won’t repurchase again, but that’s really because of my personal needs.
review_title: Great if u want a very very light moisturizer

review_text: At first when I bought this product I was super excited to use it as a moisturizer. But since I have really dry skin it was not going to work. Which is why I am grateful for that I looked at the back to find you can use it as a serum if you have dry skin. This not only smells like heaven but makes my skin feel hydrated and soft before I put on my moisturizer. I would definitely recommend this to any skin types because it can be used as multiple skin solutions.

It will get trapped in your pores and may clog them. Cetyl Alcohol can be drying, comedogenic, cause a lot of irritation, dehydration, and IRONICALLY cause free radical damage.Fragrance: the last ingredient. I bought this moisturizer to try and I am not disappointed at all. I am in my 40’s and it is not too heavy or too light of a moisturizer. It is frankly just right as far as hydration. I have very sensitive skin and this moisturizer does amazingly well. I put it on in the morning before my makeup application and it helps to even out the application. I do not feel any residue at all once the moisturizer dries. So comments are that it is sticky once applied, that is only while it is drying. There is no residual stickiness and greasiness once done. This is a very light moisturizer and I use another step in my routine at night and as well as an essence to ensure that this maximizes this step’s effectiveness. I really like smell of fresh watermelon, yet the fragrance is very light. It dissipates once you are done using it. The packaging is simple, yet pretty. I feel like my skin is not stripped after cleansing and this little number ensures that.

I love this... I don’t know if it works so much as a real moisturizer for me since it’s more of a gel like formula and I prefer creamy moisturizers but the smell is what mainly has me hooked. I pray it’s working also because to spend this much money just because it smells amazing and because I love the packaging isn’t a reason to buy a face care product but I have made wayyyyyyyy worse decisions in my life then this so I am going to keep buying it anyway lol. It also though now that I think about it gives a nice cooling feeling when you put it on so that’s a nice touch also.
This is okay, it smells ok, nothing amazing.  I’ve tried cheaper gel moisturizers that have done a better job.  Don’t waste your money on this.....

I never write reviews but this is amazing! I’m not a dry person but when I got sunburn after the beach, I decided not to wear makeup since my face was already so dry because of the sun. I used this everyday for 2 weeks and it worked like a dream. It kept me moisturized and glowing! I definitely recommend :)
Watery and runny. Gross formula with a childish scent.

I Also have combo skin, and am prone to acne and late afternoon shine. I still get a little shine in the late afternoon but I didn’t experience any breakouts. It doesn’t really work very well with my Primer but that’s my only issue. Smells great and can’t use too much or too little.Using it for 2 weeks now daily and no breakouts. But my skin also doesn’t break out the same way the pictures here do. I don’t get the little pink rash-like breakouts. My advice to those getting rash like breakouts - I’d see if you have an allergy to one of the ingredients.
I love this moisturizer, the smell is amazing and the its so lightweight and moisturizing at the same time.

Is not worth the hype! I was very excited and it definitely does not work as a moisturizer (I even had friends with normal to oily skin try it out) - it is a fun strum to use and I do love the smell. This is only a good purchase if you want something pretty that smells good and is just kinda fun and games.

This is just a great, simple moisturizer. It’s hard not to love. It’s definitely a product thats’s better for people with normal, oily, or combination skin (I don’t think it would be worth the purchase for drier skin types, tbh.) Works the way a moisturizer should. I was scared at first because it smells like watermelon jolly ranchers and my face is super sensitive to scented things but this did a good job moisturizing my skin without making it oily or break out! Good base for makeup too! A little goes a long way.
I love this moisturizer! It feels so light and non-greasy and really moisturizes my skin without making it oily throughout the day (which is hard for me to find).
Super light but hydrating. Feels so fresh on the skin. Had a VERY strong scent, but it’s really really luscious. Feels like a big sip of juice for your skin.

review_title: a little goes... a little way.

review_text: If you have oily skin, or even summer time oily combo skin like me, you need this. I use this as a primer in the Winter and Fall time, and as a moisturizer in the Spring and Summer. I checked the ingredients and it’s non comedogenic which is great for my acne prone skin. I really do like enjoy this product and I do recommend it.
Love this! Super light weight and absorbs into skin really well. The smell and color are a bonus. Works well under my makeup as well.
I really wanted to love this moisturizer! It smelled really good (think watermelon jolly rancher). But it feels a little tacky and sticky when applied and it only moisturizes so-so.

I apply this in the morning, before putting on my makeup. The scent is absolutely wonderful, like a jolly rancher. It goes on every easily, dries quickly, doesn’t leave sin feeling greasy like some do, which is great for my oily skin. My only gripe would be that I feel like it isn’t a deep moisture

review_text: I was hesitant to try this, because it is on the pricier side, but I am so happy I did! I have combination skin and this is perfect! It leaves my skin refreshed, moisturized, and glowing while feeling light as air and not making me more oily than I already am. Plus, the watermelon scent is absolutely to die for!!!!!!!!
Probably my favorite moisturizer I’ve ever used, it’s great for my oily skin and it smells so good and feels so great on my skin!

Packaging is gorgeous and it smells delicious but in terms of performance this “moisturizer“ is so underwhelming. I have toners that do a better job at hydrating than this product and it does not moisturize. It also leaves u with a tacky feeling on your skin.

I LOVE Glow Recipe and their entire watermelon line. This is no exception. It’s amazing. The formula is amazing. The packaging is on point. The whole thing is just perfect (it comes with a pump). Really I am not complaining about this at all. But I will not be re-purchasing. I have very dry skin and this just did not cut it. I loved using it as a serum in the morning for some added moisture, but seeing as I don’t normally use serums, this would just be an added expense. Also since I do have dry skin and I used this every day, I used about three to four pumps each time and I ran out of it very quickly. If you do not have super dry skin and you love watermelon, PLEASE try this! It deserves love because it is SO good! It just doesn’t work for me. Perhaps when I’m rich and famous, I’ll splurge on serums (but not today).
I love that this doesn’t leave my skin oily. I’ve noticed that if you don’t pat it mostly dry, it can be mildly sticky. BUT THAT SMELL IS HEAVEN.
Face feels plump and soft all day! No oily feeling residue. Love how affordable it is and perfect size to throw in your bag to use anytime.

I was in surch for a moisturizer that would fit me since I have combo skin. Im sooooo glad I purchase the Glow Recipe. It doesn’t leave my face greasy nor is it sticky and it smells AMAZING (exactly like watermelon)!!!! A little goes along the way.

As far as I’m concerned, I won’t ever be using another moisturizer again -- and this definitely makes me want to try more of their products.
My skin feels hydrated and new. So beyond thrilled!

I ended up using the Supergoop SPF stick (which I love anyway) and it was better - that also helped with the tackiness. Overall, this was okay. Not worth the price, and seemed for younger skin (I’m 37). Maybe my daughter will like.

It made me so sad and I couldn’t salvage any product because of glass shards, so much amazing product wasted :(. Really wish they’d come out with a plastic component in conjunction with the glass so that people can have one safe for travel and safe from the clumsiness that comes with everyday life.

I did want to keep using it, though, so I actually AM using it as a serum - at night time, to give myself extra hydration overnight. Sometimes my heavy night creams have a lot of oils and are good at sealing in moisture but not good at actually hydrating in and of themselves, so I use this to hydrate my skin and get that glow and then use a heavier night cream to seal it in. TO THE PEOPLE COMPLAINING ABOUT THE TACKINESS - please understand that this “tackiness’ is responsible for the luscious, rich and comforting hydration,  elasticity, and cushiony feeling that you really experience on your skin all day LONG! The cult gloss of “glass” skin is not actually the skin itself, its achieved by a liquid that manages to stay moist/reflective on the surface of skin all day long….and boy does this do that! It gives you the dewiest barrier that STAYS on your skin and feels so comfortable, repairing, and moist to the touch. As a dry skin person, this is exactly what I want to feel when I touch my skin! Supple, comforting moisture that lets my face move freely, elasticity enhanced. … As an added bonus,  if you wear powder foundation (or mineral foundation) having a moist “tacky“ finish is an absolute must! This makes any powder look glowy, luminous, fresh and feel absolutely comfortable!!! It will transform your powder foundation! You cannot achieve a natural looking powder foundation without a dewy moist finish such as this. It could almost be called both a primer and moisturizer in one! It really facilitates the even, smooth adhering of powder makeup, while also providing rich nutrition and hydration to the skin! Just look at the ingredient list! If you’re anything like me you’ve noticed that so many skincare products have about the same first ten ingredients. All common fillers and cheap silicones, ingredients that really do nothing special in terms of nutrition for the skin. This is the first product I noticed that had a RADICALLY different ingredient list when compared to so many products on Sephora shelfs. I love that it doesn’t rely on cheap fillers or silicones (which break me out). Just nutrients in the forms of fruit extracts and botanicals. Absolutely rich and nutritious.I will say.. It was a mistake to market for “Oily skins. If you have oily skin, you may mind thick “moistness“ and dew... but dry skins however, you will love it!
