My skin looks great when I wake up. so fresh and glowy! Hence why I don’t usually wash in a m. ;)

I bought this because I was in need of a face moisturizer and oh my gosh this is amazing! Usually when I put moisturizer right after washing my face it still feels dry. While at Sephora I was removing some foundation I had tried on and decided to try the glow recipe moisturizer. I liked how it was like a gel consistency and I can feel my skin absorbing it in instead of sitting at the top of my skin. I didn’t get that dry feeling after applying it and it also didn’t leave a greasy feeling after a couple of minutes in. I’ve been using this moisturizer twice a day and I think my skin feels great! I also have noticed that it I’m not as oily as I used to be, but it might be because I’m also using the watermelon mist and pineapple vitamin c serum along with it. I’m not complaining about being a little less oily than normal, but I’m very satisfied with it!

So happy I tried this moisturizer! I have congested, blemish prone, sensitive skin. I needed a moisturizer that would be light in texture and that would not increase the sebum production in my skin. I was recommended this oil free moisturizer and I have been using it for about 2-3 weeks now, I am very impressed with the results. Not only has my skin received the moisture it needed, but my skin was not as oily anymore. It’s so gentle and I LOVE the texture. If you have oily/combination skin, I would definitely give this a try. Keep in mind your skin naturally takes about 2-3 months to adjust to new skincare products.

I bought this hoping it would be a good lightweight moisturizer for summer, when I don’t feel like having anything heavy on my face. I have a combo skin with a reverse t-zone (oily chin and nose, dry forehead and cheeks). My experience the first few days of using this was that it just wasn’t moisturizing enough for my drier areas - my forehead in particular was dehydrated to the point of greatly exaggerating my fine lines. Nonetheless, I took this with me on a beach vacation, reasoning that with the humidity I didn’t need much extra moisture. It did work for me in that limited capacity - my skin was soft but not oily. Which is why I was so surprised when I started breaking out EVERYWHERE. I’m 30 and still get hormonal acne, but that’s limited to my chin. I was getting enormous zits on my forehead and nose, two places I haven’t gotten acne in 10  years. I know it was the Glow Recipe because when I switched back to my regular day moisturizer (CeraVe AM), I stopped breaking out.I’m giving this two stars despite the break-out because I like the fact that it doesn’t have dimethicone and because it sinks into the skin very quickly. However, it also left my skin feeling sticky, and didn’t layer very well under my SPF. Overall, this was a big miss for me.
Love the light watermelon scent. Very lightweight and good for hot days. Feels fresh

I bought this moisturizer hoping it would really quench my skin and bring it back to life. It did well as a light moisturizer, good for summer. It didn’t provide the full moisture that I needed. It smells great and really makes my skin glow. I probably use it 2-3 times a week.
I really loved the smell of this product and the way it made my face feel. I do think it helped with my oily complexion as well

Absorbs quickly and feels hydrating but not overly. I have to remove a star because it has added fragrance (obviously) which isn’t great for skin. I think I broke out because of the scent. I also wish it was just a touch more hydrating. The smell is great. I would buy this again maybe if I had no other option but I will always prefer something with no fragrance.If your skin isn’t super sensitive you will probably do well with this.

I personally am not sure why this is rated so highly. I purchased this product because of the hype, and I was very disappointed. The best thing about it is the smell, it smells really good! It is a very watery consistency and I did not find it to be very moisturizing. I even tried using it before using my foundation and it made my face very oily. I wanted to love it, I really did but unfortunately this product was not for me :( It is also a little pricey for the quality of this product.

in terms of moisturization, this product doesn’t really do a whole lot for me because I have dry skin and need extra boost. this product does say that if you need a lot of hydration you should just use this as a serum supplement to your moisturizer so I’m not mad about it. it really is just so cute and smells so nice, I mostly just wanted it for the aesthetics and this product serveddd. not going to buy the full size, but fun to try once.
review_title: honestly it's just really cute and smells nice

review_text: I use only this and their pineapple brightening serum nightly and it has made my skin look better than it’s ever been. I’m 34, with some sun damage and acne. Well, I HAD sun damage and acne. These products completely changed my skin and I’ll be buying it forever.

Love the product, however my first bottle now has a very dingy scent. Hoping with my second bottle that doesn’t happen again! (I had purchased the set with the overnight sleeping mask because I absolutely LOVE that product and it has not had the same smell issue.)

I love the watermelon sleeping mask, and I was hoping this would provide the same skin smoothing, redness reducing results. It doesn’t. It’s fine I guess, but it goes on so tacky and sticky and takes forever to absorb. It was adding unnecessary time to my morning routine, because I had to wait to put on my makeup. And for all that stickiness, it isn’t very moisturizing. I’d have to use another product around my nose and mouth because those areas would feel dry and tight within an hour. Glad I bought the small bottle.
review_title: There are better products out there

review_text: This is my 2nd time purchasing this. I love this moisturizer for the summer- it’s light enough but still very hydrating! It doesn’t make me break out and is perfect for my combo skin. The smell is SO GOOD, not overpowering at all and dissipates quickly. Plus the packaging is functional and adorable, it looks great sitting on my vanity!

Really love this product! I have sensitive, acne-prone skin (yes, even at 27yrs old sadly) and this moisturizer makes my skin SO SOFT and glowy. I put it on morning and night knowing my skin will be soothed. Works super great with the sleeping mask, too. I save the sleeping mask for once a week when I want to look extra good ;)

I won a years worth of Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Glow line and this was one of the products included. I have combo skin and this moisturizer is perfect for me during the summer. And if I need a thicker moisturizer during the summer I can still use this as a hydrating serum. As It’s very hydrating and my skin just soaks it right up! It smells amazing and leaves my face so soft and glowy. I have a few bottles to last me a while but when I run out I will definitely repurchase!

I have super oily (hormonal) acne prone skin and this gel moisturizer works!! I love it’s lightweight gel texture. It absorbs into my skin within minutes and gives my skin a hydrated plump look and doesn’t break me out! I also use the Watermelon Sleeping Mask at night and I love that product too. Highly recommend for oily acne prone skin as a daily morning moisturizer.
review_title: Perfect Gel Moisturizer For Oily Skin!

review_text: I like the watermelon smell. It’s more like a serum than a moisturizer and you can get many uses out of the mini size. However, it leaves my face kinda sticky afterwards so I don’t like it much.
Smells nice, but I did not notice any difference on my skin.

I love this product! As someone with oily/breakout prone skin, especially in the summer, a lot of moisturizers break me out. This one is thin, almost water like, but keeps my skin hydrated! Plus it smells amazing! My only problem is that I seem to run out of it very quickly - but that could be because I’m using too much. I had two travel size products and had to get the full size - I can’t live without this!

It’s a fresh and light product. Perfect for summer and humidity, the hydration amount is not a lot but enough for my skin during summer. I need less heavy moisture on summertime so this makes me feel good.If you have dry skin I wouldn’t recommend using this alone as a source of moisture, layering with other products is ideal.It’s great under make up and doesn’t “peel off” or makes make up cakey.
review_title: Great product during summer, specially on humidity

review_text: I’ll start by saying Glow Recipe is one of the best brands out there right now and this moisturizer, which sort of started the trend, is gorgeous. Lightweight and non-greasy, it’s prefect for summer when I need something but I don’t want to weight down my skin with heavy creams. And the smell. I want to eat this stuff, it smells so good. Plus it works. My skin feels bouncy and hydrated all day.
review_title: I want to eat this stuff

review_text: I purchased a sample size of this based on the intriguing list of ingredients. This is the third time recently that I’ve bought skin care based on “ingredient list” only to be sadly disappointed. I agree with other reviewers that the formula is sticky and not hydrating. My sensitive skin felt tight and more prone to whiteheads. So not for me....maybe best for younger women with oily skin?
I love the packaging and smell great but im pretty sure it made me break out. not repurchasing.

I have been searching for something that gives visible hydration to my skin for years, and this is it. It smells amazing, is super thin but spreads SO well. A pea size drop covers your whole face and made my skin incredibly soft. I am so impressed.
Love!!! Absorbs relatively quickly, reduces my redness and doesn’t break me out. Leaves the skin feeling plump and refreshed

I have combination skin but i get dry patches so I thought something more lightweight would work perfectly. it didn’t break me out or irritate my skin, which is a concern I have with skincare--especially ones with such heavy amounts of fragrance like this product. However, it’s not hydrating by any means. It definitely needs to be used as a serum like the packaging recommends which I find pointless.
review_title: stay away if you need serious hydration

review_text: I LOVE this. I’ve had such a hard time finding something that works with my sensitive combo skin, and this is the holy grail for me. It has a great smell, goes on easily and dries quick without leaving a sticky residue. It gives you a cute glow and didn’t aggravate my acne.

I love this stuff. I have an oily T zone and this keeps my t zone from becoming oily, it has also helped with clearing up any discoloration I’ve had for years. I also have the sleep mask that goes with this amazing product......so in love
I have an oily to normal skin type, and this lightweight moisturizer has been a miracle for my skin.

Smells amazing, feels great on the skin, at first. As the days progressed, my skin became dry, itchy, and flaky. Do not recommend for sensitive skin. I had to put on my Murad oil to compensate for the dryness.
This product is amazing. A light weight moisturizer that doesn’t break me out. Smells amazing too!

I still don’t know how I feel about it... bought the trail size on impulse at the checkout line - the packaging was so cute! Nice light moisturizer, great for summer. The initial smell is nice, but when it starts drying/as your rubbing it into your skin it starts to smell sooooooo gross. That really keeps me from using it more, otherwise it’s ok.
review_title: After smell??? Am I the only one???

review_text: Hmm I’ve been using this product every morning for over a month and I can honestly say I don’t know any difference in my skin really. It’s light weight which I like and it does make your skin a little glowy for a couple hours but nothing great..it doesn’t make your skin sticky and goes well with makeup application. Luckily it doesn’t make me breakout either.
review_title: Light weight and good for makeup users

review_text: This moisturizer is AMAZING! It leaves me that dewy glow without being oily! I received a sample and omg this stuff is so good. I only gave it a 4 because it is really expensive. I get it, you get what you pay for and this product is great but the price pulls me back a bit. Other than that I love this product and it smells soooo good!

I love this product! Although I don’t think it will be quite moisturizing enough come winter time (I live in Buffalo AKA a 7 month snow globe). I love using this during the warm summer months though! It smells amazing and my skin feels so soft the next day! I have relatively sensitive, combo skin but I haven’t encountered any issues while using this!

This made me breakout, tiny little red bumps all over my face. My skin also stung a little bit directly after applying this. My skin isn’t even that sensitive so this was surprising. I really wanted this product to work for me :/

I wanted to try this since I love gel moisturizers but I find this feels super sticky for a long time after applying. That might be great for some people or before applying lotion but I am not a big fan. My skin DOES feel soft and hydrated but is sticky to the touch to the point that it just feels like I am sweaty which I am not into.
This is my Holy grail!! I use it all year round and already on my 3rd bottle! It doesn’t leave my skin sticky and it works great on my skin. If you’re looking for a light moisturizer this is a must.
I though I would like this cause I like the sleeping mask. It’s just not heavy enough to use as a moisturizer
This is my favorite glow recipe product ever. It smells amazing and leaves my skin so soft. Can’t wait for it to arrive.
I’ve grown to love this moisturizer. At first I got a small rash using it but it went away and it makes my skin feel great and glowy

I got this as a sample and I have used it a couple times as a serum.  It does say you can use it as a serum.  It definately doesn’t feel hyrating enough to be a stand alone moisturizer.  Smells great, though.  I have combo skin though, seems like from other reviews people with oily skin love it as a moisturizer, but anything less than oily skin this isn’t going to cut it for you except as a serum with something else used for true hydration.
review_title: Decent product, not much of a moisturizer.

review_text: Leaves my skin feeling super dewy and fresh. The only con is that it dries fairly quickly and leaves some spots feeling dryer than others making me have to moisturize those parts again. Overall a good and I’ll be purchasing again.
I tried a sample that I received in a purchase and loved this product. I feel like it has great hydration and smells amazing.
Smells ahhh-mazing! It is definitely oil free which is great for my oily, acne prone skin.
The smell is nice but it smells very unnatural. The moisturizer is very sticky on my face. I wish I can return it but I can’t find the original packaging.

I received this as a sample but will definitely be purchasing a full-sized product.  This moisturizer is lightweight, smells amazing, and actually helps keep oil under control. I love how soft it makes my skin!
I like this moisturizer, I’m on my second bottle now. It’s very light
I loved the smell. Smells amazing and just like watermelon, unfortunately it irritated the apples of my cheeks. I made sure to wash my face before trying this product and was super disappointed.
Lightweight yet hydrating, just perfect for my skin. Did not break me out, wich is really rare in my case.
My favorite moisturizer! Lightweight enough for everyday use and perfect for underneath makeup! A little goes a long way!
review_title: a perfect foundation for combination skin

review_text: This moisturizer always leaves my skin so soft. I have dry skin especially my cheeks. I apply this product after I wash my face before I go to bed, and wake up with super soft skin ready for makeup application. It smells amazing too!!!

Love the texture and the packaging! But did not work for me.. it’s soooo lightweight that it barely works as a moisturizer. I used it as a primer or after heavier moisturizer cream during my pm beauty routine.

I was very excited to buy this because I love oil-free moisturizers and Glow Recipe has pretty good reviews. This product is light-weight and doesn’t feel sticky. It’s great to use before and after bed. I wouldn’t say it affected my skin long-term but it helped keep my face moisturized immediatly after I applied it.
review_title: Smells amazing and feels great too!

review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE this product. I have had my eyes on it for months before purchasing and I wish I would of bought it sooner. It smells AMAZING, but is not overwhelming. Great for summer humidity

Trying this for the third time now. I like the way the product smells and doesn’t dry sticky on my skin. It’s lightweight and seems to control the amount of oil on my face throughout the day. The only thing I don’t like is the redness that has come with it, yet somehow my face is soft..
This stuff is amazing. doesnt clog pores, doesnt break me out, doesnt irritate. i switched over from Kiehl’s water cream to this and im in love!
This product is drying and breaks me out. The overnight mask is amazing though.
Lightweight moisturizer. Good for summer but winter you will need something more hydrating (for dry skin). Too tacky for my liking.

Second time ordering this product! Hands down the best lightweight moisturizer for summer. I have very sensitive/combination skin so it’s like picking a needle in a haystack when it comes to skincare. I always have to test everything out first before I purchase it. This moisturizer smells so good and the texture is really light so you only need a little. I put on my SPF right after and I’m ready to go! Packaging is super cute♡ I don’t recommend this when the weather’s cold but it’s perfect for summer especially because I tend to sweat a lot on my face!

The scent alone is reason to buy this moisturizer!  It would be ideal for summer because it is so night and non-greasy.  However, I am going to wear it into the colder months since it is so quick to slather on under my sunscreen when I am in a hurry.

I recently got super interested in a more K-beauty inspired skincare routine and the sample size of this way a great jumping off point into it. Usually if a moisturizer is too heavy it’ll break me out or make me super shiny (in a greasy--not dewey--way. However, this is a very light feeling moisturizer that packs the perfect amount of moisture for my combo skin. Even during the summer heat, I’ve loved this. I love the fresh smell of it, it’s not too scented as well. One dollop is enough for my entire face so it does seem to last a good while even though I’m almost out of mine! This was my first Glow Recipe item and I’m loving it. Looking into their blueberry cleanser next and maybe the full size of this.
review_title: Light feel and packs a fresh faced punch

review_text: Got this as a sample and so glad I did.  I really love it. Love the smell but who cares really. It really adds plump without clogging your pores. I have been using it esp after PMD machine. My skin is looking and feeling great.  I will be interested to see how it does in winter.
review_title: Great to use for am and pm

review_text: Smells great its so cute  I was excited when I bought it , I used it for 7 days  along with the vit c and then I noitced my skin breaking out . I think the product does not let your skin breathe

I have oily to normal skin, I’ve been breaking out for the first time in several years. That being said, less is more when it comes to a moisturizer. This moisturizer is perfect! It’s light yet gives exactly enough hydration to use a serum (pineapple bright serum) if I desire and also helps my makeup look better too! Love it!

A decent moisturizer. Nothing to write home about. It’s got a gel texture, which is my preference for moisturizers, and it feels nice on the skin. Surprisingly, I thought I was going to love the watermelon scent, but that’s the main thing I don’t like. While it starts off smelling ok, the final note of the scent is funky and reminds me of what my hands smell like when they’re dirty. I don’t see myself rushing out to repurchase this, especially since it’s quite expensive.

I AM IN LOVE WITH THIS PRODUCT! Okay so boom, I needed a light moisturizer with just enough dewiness to make me glow. And boy did it ever! I love this product! I foolishly got the Drunk Elephant Protini in it’s place and learned my lesson quick when I broke out in two huge, blotchy rashes (stay away from soy ladies...). I’ll never do that again! Glow Recipe, I’m coming back for another bottle soon!
review_title: I’m drowning in hydration... don’t save me.

review_text: This is the best moisturizer I’ve used under makeup, not only because primer/foundation sit well on top, but it provides a slightly initially tacky base for makeup to cling to, making it apply so smoothly. I’m surprised it’s not specifically marketed as wearing beautifully with makeup. Worn alone, it gives the skin radiance and is the perfect lightweight moisturizer all around. I’m also acne prone and haven’t noticed breakouts.

This is my holy grail that actually works for my combo-leaning-oily skin. The watermelon smell is subtle and wonderful! On the days I exfoliate, I use it as serum and layer it under a thicker moisturizer.

I’ve generally liked every product I have tried from Glow Recipe, so I was thrilled to get a sample of this to try. I have normal skin that tends toward dry, especially in the colder months. I believe this product is aimed toward “oily to combination skin“, so I was delightfully surprised to find that this moisturizer packs quite the punch. If you’ve ever used the Glow Recipe Watermelon Sleeping Mask, I think you’ll agree this looks, feels, and smells nearly identical. It glides on beautifully, and a little goes a long way. One thing to note is that this formula remains a bit tacky until it fully absorbs, and for me that takes about 20 minutes. This is not necessarily something I’d use by itself during the winter when my skin is at it’s driest, but I think this would be a great summertime night moisturizer. If you love the smell of watermelon, I highly recommend giving this a try, along with anything else from this collection.
i reallly wanted to like this product, but it didn’t really provide me moisture or hydration. it made me very oily.
I have cystic acne, severely oily skin, and textured skin and this moisturizer helped with my oil, made my skin smoother and brighter. It calms any inflammation, absorbs well and smells amazing.
review_title: Great for oily and acne prone skin

review_text: I wish that I  could give this zero stars. NOT for oily skinned people. This made me MORE oily as the day went on. I’ll never repurchase this. Waste of money. However, would be great for people with dry skin. Would hydrate ya. This did nothing for me except made me more oily. Hate it.
review_title: Pass if you have oily skin

review_text: I really wanted to like this. I was really hoping that it would help with my oily tea zone but it didn’t. I thought it would be like a gel moisturizer but it’s more of just a consistently of tacky. It doesn’t sink into your skin it just kind of stays on top. The smell is amazing, so there’s that.

I had acne before using this, and although I don’t attribute the entirety of clearing my skin to this product this absolutely helped. I have tried other moisturizers and this is the only one that did not over moisturize my face but gave enough that my face would not over produce oils. Would 100% recommend to anyone with oily or combo skin that has acne. I tried this and then tried another product that was recommended for me, and saw immediate differences after I went off of this product, i started to break out more.
Pro: very nice texture and finish, smells great and didn’t irritate my rosacea allergic skinCon: expensive

This moisturizer is amazing under makeup! I have combo-oily skin, and since switching to this lotion, I no longer have to blot my face during the day. I’ve also noticed that my foundation doesn’t settle in to my smile lines anymore. Doesn’t matter what foundation or powder I use! Plus it smells amazing!! I definitely recommend it to anyone with oily skin

I dont think it’s for me, it did not feel hydrating enough for me. It smells good, soaks in rather quickly but other than that I wont be repurchasing again. I’m going to stick with the belif aqua bomb or drunk elephant protini moisturizer.

Meh. I really wanted to worship this, but unfortunately it wasn’t meant to be.  It’s SUPER light so even as a serum it wasn’t enough for me. Might be great for a tween starting out with skincare, or even a more mature user who has super oily skin and just needs the slightest bit of moisture.
The formula is light weight not feeling oily but does nothing. I use it in summer time and still feel dry right after apply it although my skin is oily not dry skin.
love this moisturizer . it has been in my skin care routine now for a few months and it leaves my skin so hydrated and soft.

Moisturizing and refreshing without making my skin oily and greasy!
Perfect moisturizer !!! Instant glow to your skin!
I have oily skin and live in a super humid climate, this stuff is light and doesn’t add unwanted oil to my skin. When it says to only use a little bit, use just a little.
I’ve been using this moisturizer for over a year now and I can’t get ready without it. Just bought my second bottle recently
Simply amazing! I love products in glass bottle. The mosturizer refresh my skin for hours.
This is my go to moisturizer for the summer months and it never disappoints. Lightweight and absorbs quick. My face stays hydrated all day. And it smells great!!

Otherwise, this is an easy decision.

I’ve been using this for about 3 weeks now. And I’m happy with it. It smells great, feels weightless, I even feel like it makes the skin instantly plump and hydrated without any residue. I have had many issues with moisturizers and oils in the past due to sensitive skin. I absolutely love this moisturizer. Highly recommend anyone with acne prone and oily skin!

I received a sample of this in one of my beauty subscription boxes and fell in love. It seriously smells amazing!! It’s lightweight and doesn’t cause me to breakout.  I wish the regular size ones weren’t so expensive lol

Bought this moisturizer due to the packaging and then fell in love with the smell. It does make my skin slightly more glowy. I have dry and oily skin and this cream works really well for me. Light but hydrating, lovely smell.

This is worth the price, a little goes a long way. Great as a final moisturizer in the morning or bedtime. It smells really nice but if you don’t like strong smells, it might be better to give a sniff in store first before buying! Personally I like the effect the scent gives in my routine.

I really like this moisturizer for summer time,’ it gives a nice glow to the skin. I couldn’t use it for winter because I don’t find it particularly hydrating but I love the effect that leaves in the skin
love the scent of watermelon and such a good price. really does wonders of my dry skin. a staple in my skin care routine!

It smells nice, really hydrates my oily/combination skin, and makes my skin feel smooth. It’s a LITTLE irritating in the sense where it makes my skin itch a bit.
Tacky texture; more like a serum than a moisturizer. Not hydrating for dry, sensitive skin.
It smells nice, but did nothing for my skin. It was dewy right after applied, but didn’t hydrate or moisturize my skin. I would recommend the mask over this product.

I’ve purchased it twice already and genuinely love this product. It is very lightweight and refreshing and gives your skin a burst of hydration. You do need more than the recommended amount on the bottle to fully hydrate your face, and if this is your only moisturizer that you’re using twice a day, it wont last you longer than 4-6months (which, once again, is not worth the price point). 2) It gives just the right amount of hydration if you’re always indoors or if it’s summer and not so dry. I do think this is a geographical issue, as this will be a very good moisturizer for warmer, more humid areas as its very light and doesnt make your skin oily at all.

Literally glowing without the oil. I have oily skin, and this is perfect. People compliment me daily about my skin. It’s bright and glowing. I’m excited to try the other products, so I’m buying them now. I only use the face wash and this, and my face looks amazing.

Still love it though and I definitely recommend it.Also works well to prime skin for foundation.

My skin gets so dry from being in central air all day that it literally flakes off when you rub it. This stuff solved that with one use. It is very sticky when you apply it so I would recommend it for a bedtime use only. When I woke up, my skin was so supple, soft, and smooth in ways that it hasn’t been in ages. I know they use real watermelon, but it smelled very fake. It was just an average product because I didn’t notice any results like brightening from using it.

From the majority good reviews I’m assuming my experience is an anomaly, but I still want to warn others as I also see I’m not the only one it’s happened to. I have struggled with adult break outs, flakiness, dry patches, combo skin, rosacea- nothing has been consistent. Even Shea butter is a “no go.” Tried almost everything. Some things work, some don’t. As I got older, the many years of dry cabin air & UV rays at 39,000 feet caught up. In my college days I was also a die hard sun worshiper/ lifeguard which caused permanent sun damage to my body. I still have marks after all these years! (Advice to young people- use a good strong sunscreen, self tan & wear UV blocking sunglasses!!!! You WILL get cataracts!) Ok, I love watermelon.  It’s mostly water but contains lycopene which is very good for the skin & has very slight sun protection benefits. This not only contains brightening & refreshing watermelon extract but hyaluronic acid which is one of the best, most lightweight moisturizers. The licorice reduces redness. This is a lightly naturally fragranced moisturizer that because of the hyaluronic acid, has an almost soft serum feel. On off days I don’t wear ANY make up but always wear moisturizer! I use it under foundation, or even at night.  The smaller size of this “Glow” product is TSA compliant in size, however, I would put it in a tiny, leakproof container for travel as pumps do not travel well.  Both “Glow” & MILK are cruelty-free.

I was interested in buying this product after seeing it in a magazine. I have oily skin during the summer and dry skin in the winter so I thought this would be perfect to pair with my makeup. It does have a liquid consistency and feels more like a gel than a moisturizer to be honest. I found that it still left my skin feeling dry. Although I didn’t hate the product, I don’t think it is something that I will be buying again. The search continues....
If you’re looking for something soft on the skin and clean this is definitely the route to go!
Wanted to love it ‘cause of the smell. It’s alright. Doesn’t work well if u have dry or combo skin. I live in a humid climate. Works better at night. Much better moisturizers out there and cheaper.
In summer I like to switch to dewy, gel-type moisturizers. This one fits the bill nicely, and I love the delicate scent.

I have sensitive acne prone skin and I am always leery about trying new products, but this stuff is amazing! It did not break me out. I’m not crazy about the smell of watermelon, but this has a nice “summer time“ fragrance to it. My skin is now so soft. I will be buying the bigger size from now on.

This product is an absolute joy to use. It smells fresh and clean, and applies quite cool and light, while still providing adequate moisture for my skin. I have very oily skin but don’t mind a bit of a dewier look, which this does provide. Nothing crazy, just a little glow, and it does not interfere in any way with makeup application. In fact, it’s decent as a primer for a natural finish. I didn’t give it five stars because, although I love using it, and it didn’t do anything bad to my skin, I don’t see any improvements. I’ll probably buy it again because I like it quite a lot, but it doesn’t do anything for me except provide moisture. As a side note, I wouldn’t recommend that anyone use this during winter or in a cold climate, I don’t think it’s substantial enough. Overall very pleasant though.
Too light for my type of skin, which is oily. I also don’t like the way it feels on my skin, a bit sticky.

I have dry but super sensitive skin so I usually need gel moisturizers. I liked the scent and I didn’t have any trouble with breakouts or a reaction, but it wasn’t great either. It only moisturizes for the time you have it on and doesn’t do much for skin.

Best product ever!!! Keeps my skins moisture level consistent throughout the day. I have combination skin so this was a good pick for me. I’ve been using it for the past month and a half and I would never use anything else!

Not a bad moisturizer, however for oily skin types, it does do the job. My face feels sticky after applying it and after an hour or so my face is drenched in oil. The watermelon smell is not over powering at all, and a little does go a long way.

Love this as I had bought the toner and loved the smell, so I thought I’d give this a try and I love it too as it made my skin so soft, less redness and didn’t make my skin dry out or oily and it feels so light as some moisturizers can feel thick when putting on. so I recommend this one.
I would give this 0 stars if I could. This is worse than putting on nothing. It somehow makes my skin dryer than before I put it on .

This lightweight moisturizer, more like serum to me. Only need small amount for whole face and neck. Has slightly fragrant. I use this before sunscreen during day time and during night time, I use it before night cream or watermelon sleeping mask. One star down for price (expensive for the amount of moisturizer you get) and this moisturizer definitely cannot use by it self without additional products

Consistency is nice, thin without being watery, and it smells pleasantly candy-like. Other than that, it’s not very cosmetically elegant. Whether I pat or gently rub it in, my oily skin is left pretty sticky. It’s not the worst texture and I finished the mini size in about a month with no major complaints, but there are more enjoyable products out there that hydrate and reduce free radical damage. Cute product to try but would not repurchase.
This product leaves my skin feeling refreshed and moisturized. However, the fragrance is strong but disappears quickly. Personally I like it.
Love how my skin stay hydrated during the day, even with makeup! (Using CC cream from IT! With it). Love the texture, super soft

Great for summer use! The watermelon extract and aloe keeps your skin feel cool and refreshed. Would recommend this for part of your morning routine. I wouldn’t use for someone who needs deep hydration or has dry skin as it is so lightweight. Works great for people who have oily to combination skin.
My main moisturizer, feels great on my skin, not greasy at all, makes my skin feel good for hours.

The description says it works any time of day but I would argue this may be best as a daytime moisturizer. I like something much more moisturizing at night, but this is something I would use in the summer especially when I want a base moisturizer before my spf. I’m not really a “patting“ type of person but perhaps I’d have a different opinion if I had patted it on instead of rubbing/wiping? Not sure. The consistency is rather thin witch surprised me after using the night mask. I half expected it to be closer to a gel consistency but it is more watery. I had to use more than one pump but I’m also using a tester so the pump could be very different. Overall I like it I just wasn’t super impressed with its moisturizing effect.
First think I do after I shower everyday! It’s a must!!

Love this product. I have combination skin with my dry patches being usually on my cheeks and forehead. I use this product with water (because of the hyaluronic acid) as more of a thicker serum and apply a heavier moisturizer on my dry areas. Really great for oily skin, stays kinda sticky for a little while but absorbs right into the skin. Beautiful semi glowy finish

It’s alright. I have sensitive and super dry skin - I didn’t notice it did anything for me. It stayed sticky on my skin for hourss, I honestly just wanted to wash it off. I got it in a set with the sleep mask (which I much prefer to this moisturizer). I’ll use it up only because Is quite pricy, but I won’t re-purchase. Still on the hunt for a good day-cream!
Not moisturizing at all. I love the mist spray so this was a letdown.

I got this as a gift and it is amazing. The trick is to put it on immediately after you wash your face, while your face is still wet - it absorbs ten times more than on dry skin. After a few days of applying this moisturizer to my skin, I felt a difference. My skin is smooth and soft. It feels and look hydrated. Remember the key is to put it on wet/moist skin for maximum absorption. Definitely worth trying and re-buying!
This moisturizer is so runny! Yes it does smell like a watermelon but doesn’t feel like doing a thing!

The moisturizer feels more like a serum in weight, but is pretty hydrating. My skin looked very glowy after using it. I have dry/combo skin so this isn’t hydrating enough for me, but it felt nice and smelled really good.
I really wanted to love this product. It’s light and not greasy at all, and it smells great. Unfortunately though it totally broke me out. Just didn’t agree with my skin!
I have oily skin and this moisturizer is hydrating enough. I enjoy the smell and it leaves my skin feeling plump and glowy  not oily. I use it during the day under makeup and it works great.

It smells good, but sadly it doesn’t sink in. It sits on the surface of my face and makes it feel so greasy. I have combo skin, now it just sits on my counter and wanna return it. I’d say maybe this would be good for very dry skin but I’m not sure. I just can’t handle a all day greasy feel.. but the smell is very nice.
Love this moisturizer. It smells great and makes my skin feel fresh and hydrated. I keep it in my mini fridge and it makes it better!

A little goes a long way, the formula is more on the liquid side than on the creamy or thick. It makes my skin feel hydrate and refresh, smells wonderful. But to be honest, sometimes, depending on my skin mood and the weather it makes my T zone get more oily that normal.
review_title: Love the smell, is it enough?

review_text: I was very excited to try this moisturizer when reading the description on how it works. Being ridiculously oily, I will say I would probably never use this under make up or any time going out in public since my skin started to get pretty oily within a couple of hours of using this. This is probably due to the hyaluronic acid. I do love how it feels on my skin though and am using it during the evening / overnight. I would still recommend this product depending on your skin type and what you intend to use it for.

favourite moisturizer ever!! I have very dry skin and typically need a thick moisturizer to keep my skin moisturized throughout the day (especially in the winter). I picked up this product because of the cute packaging and was so surprised at how it kept my skin moisturized all day long. it is very lightweight and a little goes a long way so it lasts a long time. have been using for over a year now and would highly recommend.

Love this moisturizer.. i have oily acne prone skin.. I used it in the morning and leave my skin matte and glowy without feeling dehydrated.. Also it makes my pores smaller and didn’t make my skin breakout.
I wanted to love this because the texture and smell is amazing but it left my skin feeling quite oily which is not something I even struggle with.

I have combination skin that’s oilier during the summertime but still needs a moisturizer. The Pink Juice Oil-Free Moisturizer has worked nicely as a lightweight formula for summer. It feels refreshing and plumping without stickiness or making my face an oil slick.
I love this moisturizer! I bought it to see how it would work for my combination to oily skin and I’m in love with the results of it on my skin

I don’t do well with things that are heavily scented and this product is heavily scented.  the moisturizer was very thin consistency. once I applied it it immediately sinked into my skin. my skin didn’t feel hydrated at all. if anything my skin felt even drier after applying it. not a good moisturizer if you’re looking for moisture.

ive gone through 3 bottles of this stuff. its great for oily skin and acne-prone skin. however i stopped using this because it aint worth the price. I am now using the Neutrogena oil free gel cream and its half this price. this moisturizer is grrat but even for oily skin it can be a bit drying. get the Neutrogena stuff cause its more hydrating and better for ur wallet
Love this for my sensible skin! Gives me a glow that I love!

This is so disappointing because this moisturizer worked pretty good and my skin loved it at first. I went through a bottle of the mini size then ended up buying the full size later. And I don’t know why my skin just doesn’t like it anymore? I keep breaking out with whiteheads and more acne. I put it to the test a couple times and everytime I stopped using it, My acne cleared up a lot more. And when I started using it again.. I broke out.. No sadly this is a not a good product for me): I’m not saying don’t try this.. Just beware it could happen? Because I know this works for a lot of people.
Can’t live without it. Moisturizes just enough so that my face is not cracking, and it’s not sticky or anything.

I love most of the glow recipe products but I must say as someone with dry skin this isn’t really moisturizing but rather better as a serum. I use the banana soufflé moisturizer by glow recipe and I’m so in love with it. I decided to give this a try and tbh I don’t think I’ll be purchasing it again after I run out of this bottle. I’ll most likely just continue using it as a serum. It smells amazing and is really light weight which is a bonus! If you’re someone with dry skin and want to try a glow recipe moisturizer, give the banana soufflé one a try. I’ll guarantee you’ll love it a lot more than this one
review_title: Not moisturizing enough for dry skin

review_text: I started using this product about a month ago and thought it was a good moisturizer! It has really wonderful watermelon scent that’s refreshing. I only use it before bed and when I wake up in the morning, my skin feels hydrated and smooth. It spreads really easily and doesn’t require a lot of product (1 pump). The only reason I didn’t give this 5/5 stars is because when I initially put it on my face, it felt sticky and a little heavy compared to other moisturizers I’ve used, which is why I only use it at night so it doesn’t bother me throughout the day.
I have very sensitive skin so I wanted to try this since it was all natural but once it dries down it’s Extremely sticky, so much so you can’t touch your face to your neck. Sent it back for a refund.
If you’re okay with fragance and you have oily skin you’re gonna love this one!!! Skins absorbs it and glows super cool :) I’ll buy full size next time!

I would say I have combination skin, and I wanted a light weight moisturizer for summer. Ive used it all summer and I’m pretty satisfied with it! I don’t think it will be enough for my drier skin in the winter, but my skin doesn’t feel tight when I use this, which is a sign that it’s doing what I want it to! I use it with a face oil for a little extra plumping. This doesn’t sting my sensitive skin, and it hasn’t broken me out. I think this is best for oily skin, but it does work for combo skin if you want something really light weight. Also, the watermelon smell is so summery!
This exceeds my expectations. I have normal to dry skin so I use it as a serum. It’s not sticky or goopy. It’s just thick enough and makes my skin feel so refreshed! Love this line!

I love this moisturizer for my oily acneic skin. That being said, this is probably not enough of a standard moisturizer for someone with dry skin. It’s super super light which makes it ideal when I need to layer on serums or treatments for my acne. Also, because their aren’t any actives, I can use this for both my morning and evening routines (making sure to add an spf in the morning because this doesn’t have any). I’m also pretty sensitive and this doesn’t irritate my skin at all so that’s a plus.

I used this in my night routine as a serum while using a heavier cream afterwards. Made my skin feel fresh, smells amazing, and hydrated my skin. However, I gradually stopped using it when I realized it wasn’t doing much for my skin anymore.
review_title: Did me well for the first few weeks

review_text: Tried to love it because I loved the smell. I went through a bottle and a half and just couldn’t make any combination of skin care or makeup products work to prevent the oiliness. I normally don’t get oily until noon-ish after putting makeup on at around 6 or 7 am. After using this I was super greasy and my makeup had shifted on my forehead by 9 am. Then I combined this and the Banana Souffle Moisture Cream, my oily spots began to break out, and I got new flaky and super irritated dry spots around my mouth and between my eyebrows. I was so disappointed I couldn’t make this work for my oily skin, and 2 months later, I’m still trying to get the irritation to calm down.
review_title: Made my oily skin more oily

review_text: What I like most about this moisturizer is that it’s very light weight, almost like a serum, but still very moisturizing for my oily skin. I think that this product could easily be applied under a heavier moisturizer for people with drier skin as well, because of how light weight it is. The product worked well with the other skin care products I use and didn’t pill. Besides being a good moisturizer, I also enjoyed the scent. The product has a light watermelon scent that quickly fades after application.

Beautiful packaging, beautiful product. Doesn’t make my makeup “roll“ if I use it before applying. And when I use it at night fresh out of a shower, it moisturizes my skin perfectly without over doing it. At times I’m having extra rough dry times, I use first aid beauty moisturizer along side it.The smell is SO refreshing but fades quickly so it really doesn’t give you time to get sick of it. I have super super sensitive skin and I’ve never had any breakouts/over drying/ irritation using this ’juice’ which is a total win in my book.

This product is very thin and absorbs as it should, but it makes my oily skin face oily much faster than it usually is. Even under another moisturizer it still makes me oily. The banana souffle moisturizer from glow recipe controlled my oil much more than this moisturizer. I really love the smell, but wish this product was thicker. This product is probably best for extra hydration in winter time used as a serum.
wow! this is my holy grail moisturizer! it smells amazing and does not break me out. it keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day and leaves my skin so soft. 100% recommend!

I absolutely love this moisturizer.  My friend told me to try it, and I did and the formula is kind of watery but also still really hydrating.  I have really sensitive dry skin that’s somehow acne prone (when it comes to new products) but this hasn’t broken my skin out, and keeps it hydrated for most of the day.  I highly recommend this, even though it is kind of on the pricier side for a moisturizer (compared to drugstore).

Amazing moisturizer. It is non sticky and keeps my skin hydrated for a long time. I apply it twice a day. my skin has started glowing. also the smell is very mild and subtle.. plus the bottle has pump so no need to touch the cream.. love this product. I shall definitely keep using this!!!!
Not that great of a moisturizer. The sleeping mask is much better.

Great lightweight moisturizer for oily/combo skin. I wake up with smooth skin each morning after using this. It works well on its own during the summer time, but I would use something heavier on top of it during the winter. Every Glow Recipe item I’ve tried is amazing. I really love this brand and can’t wait to try more of their products.
I have dry/combo skin and this didn’t keep my skin hydrated throughout the day. I love the sleeping mask tho!
review_title: Not hydrating enough for my dry skin

review_text: At first this product seemed good and lightweight for my sensitive and dry skin but overtime it got worse. The fragrance is too much for me and my skin type but my skin is very sensitive. This product is great for people with oily skin and don’t want a heavy moisturizer, however if you have dry skin this one can be skipped. It makes your skin feel tight (if you have dry skin) and evaporates in only a couple seconds.

perfect for spring/summer usage, not too heavy but still deeply moisturizing. feels and smells really nice, and I appreciate the natural origins of the ingredients. my only complaint is that it is easy to overapply, I was putting too much on at first because it felt so light, which broke my chin out. I started using less and the acne issue resolved!

This is amazing! I use it with the watermelon toner and it really gives the skin a beautiful glow. Not too thick in texture. I have dry skin and it is amazing!! Must use with the toner though, the toner is a life changer!!

I really like this moisturizer! I’m 28 years old and  I’m a victim of laugh lines and a bit of forehead wrinkles. I’ve paired this moisturizer with the Watermelon Glow PHA toner (as if the toner was the serum) with no other serums and I feel like pairing them both has given me a nice glow. Two weeks in and my laugh/mouth lines were visibly reduced. Its really lightweight (a pump of the cream is good for covering the entire face) and moisturizes so well! Even if I don’t pair it with the toner, it leaves me with a nice refreshed look (perfect for summer). It aborbs super quickly (like the toner) and I layer it with the Farmacy sunscreen and its just the best day time routine. I will say it left me oily and I broke out a bit during the first week as my skin was getting used to the formula, but now on my third week my skin looks really fresh and so clear so it was worth the few small pimples I got. It was my fault anyways bombarding my skin with two new products at once (the moisturizer and toner).This is a product to be patient with as your skin becomes accustomed to the formula, but the results are definitely worth it (hence the 5 stars). I’m interested to see how it will hold up for winter time!
This is a great serum but I wouldn’t call it a moisturizer.

This stuff is very hydrating and I’m surprised to see that a lot of people don’t like it! Putting this on after putting on the plum serum is just about the best combo on earth. It smells so good and consistency is nice

This is my absolute favorite moisturizer I’ve been using this for 8 months and I’ve seen so much improvement in my skin. I’d like to note that I use a full skin care routine with an SPF from Murad. If you have dry/ sensitive skin that is not very oily this is the product for you. I also use their/Toner, pineapple serum, face mist, over night mask. I want to try their newer products too. But honestly Glow Recipe has saved my skin.
I have fairly dry skin so I found that this moisturizer didn’t do anything for my skin

I have used many different moisturizers from different brands and this is by far one of the best moisturizers that I would use for summer. it’s very light but still hydrating. I really like the nice and subtle watermelon scent. This product is perfect for summer.

I liked this product a lot. It was very light, not too sticky, and had an amazing scent. I even received complaints on the texture of my skin and how good it smelled. I wouldn’t say that I noticed a big difference in my skin but overall it was okay.
Love this for oily skin. Smells amazing too(if you like watermelon). Instantly melts into the skin. Wouldn’t recommend for dry skin though

This moisturizer smells great and is aesthetically pleasing, but did not change my skin dramatically. It did not give me any wow factor, and I have other products that are much better for hydration and the moisturization of my skin. Just felt sticky putting it on, and it did not feel like it sunk into my skin. It felt like it stayed on the surface of my skin rather than penetrating into it.

Love how light and fresh it feels!  And the watermelon scent is amazing.  As someone prone to breakouts, I am always cautious when trying new skincare products, but I can say that this never breaks me out!  It provides the perfect amount of moisture and keeps the skin looking glowy!!
This doesn’t work well for me. I prefer the banana soufflé instead.

I thought I would love this as I love the AHA Watermelon sleeping mask. But unfortunately this fell through. When putting it on it takes forever to absorb and leaves a tacky feeling. But if I don’t put makeup on top it’ll be an oil-slick within an hour, with makeup I might last a few hours. But although it’ll leave me an oil-slick, I still feel dry and needing moisture. Sad to see this slip through the line.
review_title: Oil-slick but yet not moisturizing enough

review_text: sooooo hydrating and smells so good, like a faint watermelon smell so nice expecially when chilled in the refrigerator.... my favorite moisturizer

So happy to have to found my holy grail moisturizer. I have been using this for about a year and it’s made such a difference in my skin. I use this + the ordinary hyaluronic acid 2% and my skin has never been better. I use 2 pumps am and pm. It’s so mosturizing my skin feels amazing after applying it. Plus the packaging is so cute!
I like the smell of this, and it’s definitely lightweight, but I think it’s a little bit too lightweight for my skin.
Absolutely love, love and love this product!! It si totally worth the money!!!

i tried this originally with a sample. it seemed to be ok and so I substituted my Tatchta for it. but it does not moisturize well. my skin is so dry, and now I’m breaking out! back to the expensive stuff
review_title: shell out for better if you have combination skin!

review_text: I really like this moisturizer! I use a vitamin C serum and then put this over the top. I feel like my skin looks so much younger ( I am 36) and it really helps with the fine lines. I have noticed my developing crows feet are more difficult for me to pick out in the mirror even on days I don’t drink enough water... which seems like every day. I really like this and will be purchasing again.

Love this product!!!! It’s extremely absorbing and really feels like it’s moisturizing and not just sitting on the surface of my skin. It’s partly like a serum in that it’s thin and watery enough to penetrate, but can also be enough of a moisturizer to not need another layer. At night I use it as a serum & apply a thick cream over it, but in the am, I can go all day with this only. I’’m 50 and have dry, aging skin. This product is good for me.
I have combination skin and I only used this product for a week and this broke me out on my cheeks....
It didnt work for me and make my face breaking !  Has a nice smell and i would not recommend this .
The smell was nice, but, it this product left my face dull.

It’s a nice moisturizer leaves your skin glowy pretty good gel moisturizer however, it does take a while to absorb into the skin and leaves it tacky but after it’s fully absorbed it leaves skin feeling soft, smells like a watermelon jolly rancher so be aware it does contain fragrance
Love the smell, but maybe to strong for a moisturizer!

I absolutely love this moisturizer. My fav!! Great for oily skin. When you first put it on, it feels sticky but once it dries (about a minute or so) it makes your skin feel sooo smooth and soft. A little of the expensive side, but i love how lightweight it is. Will definitely purchase again!!

Really sad that this moisturizer didn’t work out for me! Having oily skin, I LOVE gel moisturizers as they usually help hydrate and moisturize and don’t tend to feel too heavy. For whatever reason, this moisturizer felt amazing on my skin but pilled like crazy! I already have a steady skincare routine, so it didn’t make sense to play around with my serums/other products to see if they were the culprit to the pilling when I could just try another moisturizer. Also, it smells great but if you’re sensitive to fragrance be mindful of that!
This moisturizer is super light wet and just sinks into your skin. It’s non oily and leaves you feeling refreshed!If you have dry skin, it’s best to go with a heavier facial cream.
Works great for me! Makes my skin feel lightly moisturized & non greasy. Works well under make up too! The scent is awesome & energizing too
Very disappointed, did not work for my dry skin. I have been using this product for months and have not seen any improvements. Would not recommend!
Stunning. I love this moisturizer, it’s light but still effective. The smell is absolutely to die for. I’ve had only good luck with this product and I highly recommend!

Really lovely moisturizer. I find that it works best in fall/winter. Sinks in quick doesn’t pill and has a nice smell. I usually only need one small pump from my usual moisturizer but for this one I need a pump and a half. I would repurchase it, however I go through this p quick and it is p expensive so I don’t plan to anytime soon. The only negative side to this I find is that it makes me a bit oilier in the summer (that could’ve just been stress too), but overall it’s a nice product that does as marketed. Plus it’s in a really nice packaging and I love pink lol.

I didnt expect to love this,but I do. I have dry combination skin that is very sensitive, and this hasn’t made my skin angry and the moisture soaks in quick without sitting on the skin. I’ll be buying this again as well as trying the other items in this line.

Did nothing good: did not moisturize in any way, was sticky and probably just irritated my skin considering the potent fragrance. Way too light a moisturizer, even for a gel.  Save your money.2* because packaging is cute.
review_title: A fiery pit into which you can throw your money

review_text: Wasn’t a fan of the glass container it comes in - practicality wise.  And the actual product felt sticky on my skin the entire time. It didn’t absorb well and still left my forehead oily/shiny.

#giftedbyglowrecipe I am a huge fan of this moisturizer! I received it as a gift and I have been using it ever since it came out a couple years ago! I’m so glad to be restocked. I love using this as my daytime moisturizer for glowy and dewy skin! It keeps my skin so hydrated and I love it!
Smells nice, and feels nice and lightweight on the skin. I just needed more moisture for my dry skin.

#giftedbyglowrecipe Glow Recipe products are such a treat for the skin. I love the pink juice moisturizer . It’s very lightweight , hydrating and good for all skin types. Can be used as a lightweight moisturizer for the daytime.

I received this product gifted by glow recipe. I wanted to share that is one of my favorite moisturizers! I’ve been a longtime fan of Glow Recipe for the quality of their products. First off this moisturizer makes your skin glow and feels so much more hydrated. I pretty much use it as a primer before light makeup and it lasts so well. I have a combination skin type and I don’t have any issue with the moisturizer drying my skin or making it oily. Also, I don’t know about you all but the subtle watermelons scent is my absolute favorite. I actually use this on my neck and arms too!

I love this moisurizer that Glow Recipe gifted me! The glass packaging is so much better! This moisturizer provides instant hydration and glow to my skin. I love the pink gel-like, clear texture. It smells as incredible as the watermelon mask which I love. I think it’s great for my combo skin and can’t wait to try more products from Glow Recipe!

I was gifted by Glow Recipe Watermelon Moisturizer and I was already a longtime fan of this wonderful moisturizer! I love how good it smells and how it keeps my skin so so hydrated plus plumped as well! Overall I will keep buying this once I run out and can we just admire the gorgeous pink packaging as well!

it’s the best and most perfect moisturizer ! it’s nice and lightweight yet still so moisturizing ! glow recipe has the best products ever! the formula allows it to sink in evenly and nicely while giving you such a great hydrating and glowing canvas for the rest of your day and night ! :)

#glowrecipegiftedme this watermelon juice moisturizer, This is such a great lightweight gel moisturizer. I think this sits well under makeup as a primer because it has a sticky light gel consistency to it,  but it’s very hydrating and doesn’t leave the skin looking greasy at all. This is a great day time moisturizer.

Note that I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe in exchange for an honest review. This is a great gel moisturizer that packs hydration! My skin looks and feels hydrated after using it. It sits well under other skincare and makeup products as a primer. The texture is really soothing/lightweight and comfortable to wear. I found the scent to be pleasant but not too overpowering. Overall my dry skin was very happy with this moisturizer!

I received this moisturizer complimentary from Glow Recipe. Ok this moisturizer has seriously impressed me! I have very oily skin, and finding a good lightweight moisturizer is always a challenge. This moisturizer is not only lightweight, but actually leaves my skin feeling super soft and hydrated! It has a gel-like texture and doesn’t feel sticky at all. I also love how well it works under my makeup!
This moisturizer is very nice and lightweight! This is the perfect moisturizer if you have oily skin!

Glow Recipe gifted me this moisturizer but this is my honest review:) This is a very lightweight (gel textured) moisturizer and honestly I didn’t have much expectations of it until I tried it! I’m in love!!! I used this by itself (with no makeup) and with makeup and both times it suited my combination skin well!
