I loved this moisturizer because of the light sweet scent and the texture was different from most moisturizers. I like that it is gentle and easy for your skin to absorb. It doesn’t clash with the other skin care products that I’m using and has a very thin consistency which is really good for my skin to absorb product easier and faster. I haven’t tried anything from the recipe that I haven’t liked yet and I do love the ingredients that are in this moisturizer. This was gifted to me by glow recipe and I was so happy to try it.

I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe.I saw an immediate difference in my skin after the first use.  It left my skin glowing, smooth, and soft.Perfect to apply before makeup! The gel consistency absorbs so quickly without leaving my skin oily.It has a beautiful watermelon scent.The packaging is beautiful. I would definitely recommend.

I’ve been trying out the Watermelon Moisturizer that I received complimentary from Glow Recipe. It is intended as a lightweight moisturizer for oily/combo skin; but it definitely still works for my dry skin! I love to use it after toner and before my thicker moisturizer as a moisturizing serum and it definitely increases the hydration and glow to my skin. I also love that it’s really lightweight and has a very subtle tackiness that helps to grip makeup when used as a primer. The scent is a light, watermelon scent that I enjoy that isn’t overpowering or lingering so it doesn’t bother even the most sensitive to smells like myself.  I also love that you can use it with other skincare and it doesn’t leave any weird texture or pilling or anything that other skincare combos can. It works great in combination with the other Glow Recipe products too! The other day I used the watermelon toner, this moisturizer, the banana moisturizer and the avocado eye cream and loved the way my skin looked and felt! This is definitely not my first Glow Recipe product and will definitely nit be my last!

I was super excited to have moisturizer gifted by Glow Recipe to try! I’ve seen so many people use this moisturizer and love it, so I knew I had to get my hands on it. I’ve used this moisturizer a couple of times and was pleasantly surprised. First, if you love how watermelon smells, you’ll totally love this moisturizer. Like most people have said,  it smells exactly like a Watermelon Jolly Rancher (which is my favorite flavor) so I love it! I have used it in the morning after my vitamin C serum and I have found that it sinks into my skin extremely fast and is hydrating for my skin. It’s not heavy and more of a “liquid” moisturizer which I tend to veer towards for my AM routine as I feel like if I layer my makeup, it won’t be cakey.I haven’t tried it as a makeup primer yet, but I can see why people love to do that because of the consistency and how it feels on the skin. It’s light enough to layer and it doesn’t leave your face too oily.

This product was Gifted by Glow Recipe.The product really made my skin feel hydrated and plump. Also it really works as a good primer, i.The texture of the product is super light and the scent is not powerful.Its a lovely product for my oily skin,love it

This was my first time trying a Glow Recipe and I was beyond excited!! I love the watery, gel-like texture as it just sinks into my combination skin and left my skin feeling more hydrated without feeling oily. I used it under my makeup and I can say that this works nicely as a makeup primer since it is lightweight but a bit tacky. Be aware that this does have a strong watermelon scent (that smells lovely btw), but thankfully it has not caused any reactions to my skin so far. Complimentary from glow recipe.
review_title: Love this as a makeup primer!

review_text: Say hello to my new fave ! Hands down one of the best moisturizers I’ve ever used . It works perfectly for my combination skin . Right away my skin feels instantly cool, nourished and alive ! I’ve also heard this moisturizer works perfect as a primer. I honestly do believe it works great because it has a sticky finish . It’s not to tacky but just the right amount . I have yet to try that but stay tuned for an update . This product was gifted by glow recipe .

I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe. I love the texture of this moisturizer! It’s so thin, almost like a serum. Smells like a hint of watermelon & leaves my skin feeling so soft after applied. I think this is perfect as a moisturizer for those with oily/combination skin or as a hydrating serum for those with dry/normal skin types. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and lasts all day! I really enjoyed this moisturizer as an AM moisturizer instead of at night, as I tend to use a thicker formula for my PM. Overall great product worth the price point as the bottle is quite large! I love that it’s a pump also!!

The best way to describe this moisturizer Glow Recipe gifted me is “juicy”. It has a siliconey, gel feel that has a nice slip to it. Because of the slightly tacky finish, it also would be a nice prep for makeup. It hydrated deeply for my oily skin but I suspect it wouldn’t be enough for drier folks. I’ve been using it consistently for a few weeks and haven’t noticed strong difference in my skin as a whole, but it is a moisturizer- so all I really want is lightweight hydration. This gives me that and more, since it layers so well under sunscreen and makeup. The scent is strong but I like it and it doesn’t irritate my skin or eyes.

*This was Gifted by Glow Recipe but the opinion is completely my own.* My skin looked so hydrated and dewy after the 1st use, it gave me instant healthy-looking skin. I love that it doubles as a primer, it works amazingly helping my skin look even and smoother, I can see it helping blur out my large pores the instant I put it on. I’m a big fan of the liquidy texture and it smells gorgeous!! (I literally was to drink this!) the only thing I’m not a big fan of is it leaves my skin feeling a little sticky afterward, I have mixed feelings about this because my skin absorbs it super fast but I still have to wait a while for the stickiness to go away, so if you don’t mind waiting for a little extra, to me this is perfect! I have combination skin and it can be a nightmare sometimes, my dry areas are scaly dry but my T zone is a disco ball, so its really hard for me to find a moisturizer that can not only hydrate my dry areas but that is also not going to make me shiny throughout the day, and this does exactly that! So far I’m loving it but I will say I am in South Texas and we hardly get cold days, I suspect this won’t be as hydrating for those winter days but we shall see.

I got a mini size of this in a Sephora Favorites set and I liked it a lot. It’s a nice moisturizer for Summertime if you prefer using something lighter in the summer. It’s very light, but still moisturizing. And it smells amazing.

So I’ve been using @glowrecipe watermelon moisturizer for 2 weeks now and am actually obsessed. I have combination skin depending on the season for reference. It absorbs right into my skin and gives me such a good natural glow. It also helped the texture of my skin more than I expected. It’s the perfect primer for under your make up & helps keep makeup out of your fine lines. The scent is so light and fresh, not overwhelming at all. Gifted by Glow Recipe.

This product is only ok. I wish I had bought the mini size. It’s fine enough that I won’t be returning but I will get something else when it runs out. I have oily skin so I was looking for something like and oil free, but this is too watery. I feel like it sits on my skin and feels wet and slippery, but then when it dries my skin is still kind of tight, like the moisturizer didn’t actually soak in.

Happy Saturday my gorgeous babe’s have you tried @glowrecipe Watermelon Pink Juice Moisturizer? Cuz let me tell you its amazing im obsessed with the fresh smell its not over powerful and its great under makeup as a primer. It’s also very light weight and soaks right into the skin. I have combination skin so this works amazing on hotter days as my skin can sometimes get a little oily. It’s made with great combination of antioxidants, hyaluronic acid and 90% watermelon extract and what i love is that it works great mixed with my other skin care routine. If you have dry skin I would recommend that you use it with your goto moisturizer just to give that extra moisture and glow.

I got this as a free sample and used it for about 2 weeks. It glides on smoothly and noticed it leaves somewhat of a sticky finish but smells really good. Into the 2nd week, however, I started breaking out. Not wanting to blame it right away as the reason for my breakout, I continued to use it but ultimately stopped after a few more days with no let up on the breakouts. I got tired of the sticky finish as well. I didn’t feel refreshed after my skin care routine like I usually do.

To be honest, I never felt all that compelled to check out this brand, as I wasn’t sure if it was gimmicky, but frig how could I resist something called Watermelon Pink Glow Juice??? And then I looked at the ingredients and daaaaymn I’m impressed. The first two ingredients are Watermelon Fruit Extracts, so of course smells like watermelon and feels silky on the skin.I think the bulk of the appeal with this product is the sensorial experience you get, which is valid. There’s something to be said about skincare that you ENJOY using. All in all, this is a nice product that I think works best as an emulsion, or as a summertime moisturizer for those with oily skin. I enjoy its versatility and how it can be used as a moisturizer, serum, emulsion, makeup primer, or even added to your foundation. So in one way or another, it could work for almost any skin type.
The component is nice, I did not like the product.  I felt that it immediately clogged my pores.  I have oily skin and it made me shinier than other moisturizers.
This is a great lightweight moisturizer for oilier skin or perhaps the summer months for combo. Smells amazing, but doesn’t pack enough of a hydrating punch for my combo skin with redness.

I don’t understand all the hype with this skincare line. I’ve been using this moisturizer now for more than a month and have not gained any positive results from it. First off, it smells awful! I tried hard to like it and get past the smell, but I can’t. Second, the texture is so lightweight that it doesn’t even feel like you’ve moisturized your face at all. After using it for a while, it dried out my face and made it itchy. It was even worse when I added the pineapple serum. There’s just no benefit to adding this into your skincare regimen. There are so many other great brands out there that are way more effective, better quality, and price range. What a waste!

This serum-like gel moisturizer is super lightweight, but still quite hydrating. I think this would better suit me in the summer as I prefer a cream that’s extra hydrating in the colder months. Lately, I’ve been layering this under my moisturizer for an added layer of hydration, and my acne-prone skin hasn’t had any complaints. I enjoy the watermelon scent, but appreciate that it dissipates quickly. This definitely delivers glowing skin, but almost a little too much extra shine for my oily complexion. It sinks into the skin quickly, leaving a slightly tacky finish; it doesn’t feel sticky, nor does it pill under SPF or makeup.Product gifted by Glow Recipe for review
My skin changes during the seasons , but the is the perfect summer moisturizer because it’s light weight and absorbs into the skin fast . Won’t keep your face greasy during summer .

I love everything about this moisturizer. It’s a non-sticky gel like formula that smells amazing and soaks into the skin very quickly. I have normal to oily skin, with light breakouts around certain times of the month - certain moisturizers overdue it, but this one is the perfect end to my skincare routine. I’ve been using it daily for 2 weeks - I will be repurchasing! My ONLY complaint is that I seem to be going through it quick, even at 1 pump a day - I want mooore!
love this! it’s one of my favorite moisturizers, and the scent is absolutely divine, it leaves me so nice and glowy

I did like the glow recipe oil free moisturizer, the smell was lovely, and the formula wad nice and light and worked well on my skin. However for the price and the amount you receive I am going to be moving on to find a new product.
I wanted to like this. In theory, it’s great. It’s oil-free, has a light, pleasant scent, and feels good going on. Sadly, every time I use it, I’m a greasy mess by noon.
Wonderful facial moisturizer, absolutely love it! Lightweight and absorbs easily, subtle scent and beautiful packaging.

Love this one but definitely not for my skin, I wanted a moisturizer and this worked as a serum for me since I have dry skin and needed to hydrate it with something more. My husband on the other hand tried it and he’s a fan! He has very oily skin so this makes him feel dry and clean
review_title: Amazing product but not for my type of skin

review_text: Made my skin even dry out more . Once you put it on feels nice but then 10 min later it’s like it did nothing for your face

works for me! has been helping with my maskne! as a nurse I have to continuously wear a mask 12 hours so have been trying a lot of different products and this seems to give me a good barrier for my skin under the mask!

Love this product !! One pump is enough so this product really goes a long way. I have sensitive skin and this was perfect for me. Scent is nice and not overpowering. I saw some people commenting about this product making face sticky but if you exfoliate regularly this should not be an issue and your skin should absorb it well.

The novelty of Glow Recipe’s Watermelon line fades quickly.. Similar to the Watermelon Sleeping Mask this has the same texture and smell and the same lack of effect. It left my skin very sticky and then very dry. I have to layer this under an actual emollient cream moisturizer which defeats the purpose. This may work better for people with like skin or those who don’t need a good deal of moisture.
Nice packaging, I do wanted to love this, but now my skin even more dry then before.
One of my favorite moisturizers hands down besides the Lancer face cream. This one is light and perfect for summer, leaving your skin with a dewy sheen. Plus the scent is to die for. Love.

Best day moisturizer I have ever used. Never leaves me looking too oily. Absorbs really well on clean skin. Also does make my skin more hydrated. I always had trouble finding the right day moisturizer because my skin concern is quick clogging pores and blackheads — and this has not made my pores worse as far as I can tell!
Had such high hopes as I love their toner but it left my face super dry! As soon as I put on my powder every dry spot was super visible! Sadly I say this is a no go.

Bought this because I always hear great stuff and I have combo skin so in the am I get oily and I needed something lightweight. I liked it at first but it did peel under my sunscreen if I put too must moisturizer on which is annoying, the smell is very fragrant so I hope you like it, it last a long time which is good. Overall I wouldn’t repurchase it but if it was a free sample I would use it
Not impressed. it gives you a glow when you apply and that’s it. it does moisturize but i have better moisturizers. not going to purchase again.

Really meh..  I got this as a reward because I needed a new moisturizer and didn’t want to spend money but honestly the fragrance feels like it sits on/irritates the skin (and fragrance has never bothered me before).  The actual moisturizing aspect is also pretty meh.  Honestly at this point I’m just forcing myself to finish it because the bottle is pretty and I want to use it to hold some dried flowers.  Otherwise it would’ve gone in the trash by now.

I have acne-prone combination skin. I thought this would be great for the summer as it would be lightweight. Well, the smell is great for the summer, but I feel like it didn’t really moisturize my skin and didn’t keep it from being oily the way my other moisturizer did. I used it up, but I won’t be repurchasing, unfortunately. I love the brand and wanted to love this.
It has some moisture but when I get a moisturizer I’m aiming at my dry spots on my forehead and this just tinted them... lol

Okay so I really enjoy this product. The consistency is amazing & it’s just like so cooling. It’s like a cool watery gel & I’m sure it’d be amazing to put in one of those skincare fridges & then apply. However, I’m on tretinoin & it peels your skin but I need something with a little more hydration if I’m on this. So just a little caution if you’re using something prescribed by a dermatologist. But definitely would recommend, it’s really such a nice product to have. The packaging is amazing but it is glass & I’m pretty clumsy

I’ve been wanting to try this since there is such a hype for it.  I’ve tried different formulas (creams and gels) from low and medium brands and I would say that Glow Recipe is similar to Garnier Ultra-lift Miracle Anti-fatigue, iUNIK Centella Calming Gel Cream and O Hui in terms of absorption rate, texture, how long the moisturizer lasts before feeling the need to reapply and ability to elevate redness.  Really enjoyed using this formula which works great and smells wonderful (sweet but not over sugary candy smell) but one things that will be the decider to repurchasing when I run out is size for value.
great product and smells amazing!! I do have sensitive skin so it does leave my face a little bit red but not too bad! also helped with my acne!

I have a love hate relationship with this moisturizer! i love how my skin feels when it’s on and it hydrates really well, and smells really good, but my skin doesn’t really like fragrance and tends to cause me more breakouts than i’d like. but if ur skin isn’t super sensitive it should be fine!
So so soothing to my face! I love how bright and smooth my face looks after using this!

It’s okay. It’s not one of the most revolutionary moisturizers out there but slightly better than some I’ve seen. It did give my skin some hydration, but that’s about it. Sometimes it just sat on top of my oily skin. And I have acne and oily skin. It’s not bad per se, but there are much better drugstore moisturizers for us oily skin folk out there.

This is a lightweight moisturizer that smells like jolly ranchers. Glow Recipe gifted me this fun gel-like moisturizer. I am a fan of the way it dries down - the consistency has a surprising thickness to it that I didn’t expect. I also really love the glass packaging and didn’t find that the scent irritated my skin in the slightest.

i LOVE this moisturizer! i usually have issues with moisturizers making my skin breakout since i have combination skin. in the dry spots it took away the dryness, and in the oily spots it moisturized but didn’t give my skin acne or the appearance of excess oil. this bottle lasted me about 10 months, using AM and PM, and using about 1 pump each use.
I’m never compatible with any type of gel products but I tried using this one as a serum before my cream moisturizer and it moisturizes well and gives me that glowy  skin look

i have heard about this moisturizer and brand for so long and i’ve always wanted to try it. i decided to start with a mini product to see how it is with my skin, and it was amazing! the best moisturizer i’ve ever used and i purchases more things from glow recipe that i’m very excited to try! would recommend!
Love this moisturizer. Be careful with the applicator on the mini - mine is sort of sharp at the end and I scratched my face.
review_title: Love it! Reminds me of our past beach vacations!

review_text: I love this product, and I change the way I use it depending on the season. In the summer it makes a great lightweight moisturizer for normal skin, followed by a sunscreen. In the winter, and at night, it makes a great serum to use under a heavier cream or the watermelon glow sleeping mask. It reduces redness and makes my skin feel great, although with normal skin I still need more intense moisture than this in the nights and the winter. If you had combo/oily skin this would probably be a great choice year round. I think it does just what it says and I will order it again.
This is a very lightweight moisturizer that I highly recommend! I actually use this as a serum because of how lightweight it is but it works both ways!
Lightweight, liquidy moisturizer perfect for the summer. Actually smells like watermelon!

Alright not to be gross but in the winter I get some CRUSTY skin, I’m taking Sahara desert on my face. No moisturizer could help at all. As a last resort I asked my friend who works at Sephora to pick something out for me that would help and she came back with this bad boy. I’ve been using it for about 4 days now, my face is soft as a baby’s bottom. I cannot stop touching it (that’s bad I know) but I am in LOVE. I also tend to be sensitive to some skin products but no issues with this one.  If you’re struggling with dry skin I HIGHLY recommend. I’ve never written a review for a product before but this works so well I had to. Leave crusty flaky skin in 2020!!!

This is a really nice light moisturizer that’s somehow still very hydrating. It absorbs into the skin easier than the banana moisturizer and feels really lightweight. Perfect for my normal/combo skin, especially in the summer. very little amount of fragrance, I really love it. Plus the bottle is recyclable.

I love the watery gel like consistency and sweet watermelon scent of this moisturizer. I love watermelon so I may be biased, but I think it’s not overpowering. It is very easy to apply and feels like a hydrating cooling layer of amazingness. It dries down and leaves my skin feeling ever so slightly sticky, but with an hour it completely sinks in my skin feels so soft and smooth and dewy looking. I use it under makeup and have had no problems.I have oily acne prone skin and I feel like this type of moisturizer works super well for my skin.

I added it to my skincare and it didn’t make my face burn which often happens because I have sensitive skin and after only using it a few times my skin looks healthier and cleaner. Would recommend it to anyone who has sensitive skin to use since it just cools my face down and relaxes me with the slightly fruity scent.
Honestly an amazing moisturizer! It made my skin super glowy and smooth! I could not be more happy with it!

This is a very light moisturizer. Too light for my mature skin. It has more of a watery consistency. The scent is definitely watermelon, which I don’t mind. Nicer for summer perhaps, or depending what type of climate you live in.

This product felt nice in my skin and smells just like watermelon. The problem I had was the bottle was almost 1/3 empty when I received it. With a mini costing $28 and is only 25 ml, I expected the bottle to at least be filled. I am now hesitant to buy online in the future.
review_title: Felt nice but was missing 1/3 of the product

review_text: I absolutly love this product. It doesn’t feel sticky and it makes my skin look so glowy! Although, there isn’t a lot of product in it (i purchased the smallest size). $21 for less than 1 oz is kind of crazy. Love the product! But i’m spending too much money for too little product :(
review_title: Too much money, not enough product

review_text: Very lightweight moisturizer that gave my skin a great glow. Unfortunately, my t zone was very oily after using it. I will say it did not break me out.

This is hands down my most favorite moisturizer. I struggle with hormonal acne and unfortunately have to deal with monthly breakouts for weeks on end. This moisturizer is light on my face and doesn’t cause new acne to pop up out of nowhere. Despite it being a scented moisturizer, the scent is light and it fades away a few seconds after applying it my face. It doesn’t make my face feel sticky and gross. I have been using this moisturizer for forever but haven’t seen any good results with clearing up my acne until I decided to implement the Ordinary’s niacinamide 10% + zinc 1% serum into my skincare routine. It has been 3 days since I made this change and yes, I see an improvement in my skin. This moisturizer does a good job at moisturizing but to see a result, definitely seek other products to target your skin concerns.

I didn’t love this product, although I did want to because I’m obsessed with the smell and packaging.I felt it was sort of drying, didn’t really like the way it made my skin feel. Maybe id use it in the summer but definitely won’t do for Canadian winters

This product is amazing! I use it as a moisturizer at night and it makes my skin look fully hydrated and glow. You’ll even wake up with skin still glowing. I only use this moisturizer at night simply because I have combination skin and I will look oily throughout the day. I definitely recommend this to anyone with dry skin.

I love this moisturizer! Its gelly consistency spreads easily, so I only use one pump to cover my full face and neck. The smell is not in your face at all, and it does a great job of smoothening out my face and brightening it up. My sensitive skin loves this product as well, as it hasn’t broken out since I’ve started using it. I use this in combination with their watermelon toner and I have seen such great results, giving me a natural glow that lasts all day. I will say that when you first apply it, it almost seems to sit above the surface of your skin before it sinks in. My hands always feel a bit sticky afterwards, alongside my face, but it only takes a minute or so before my skin absorbs it. I feel hydrated, refreshed, and ready to apply makeup!

It wasn’t a hit or a miss for me, just alright. It does moisturize but the formula doesn’t feel special or life-changing. It feels a bit sticky when applied and under makeup it feels heavy and slimey, does not dry down quick.

Glow recipe has done it again Glow Recipe is my favourite brand and this is another great product. I see a lot of people say it is sticky however I did not come across this problem I love mixing this with the rare beauty foundation for a lighter coverage. The smell of this product is fantastic. Some people have said that this one isn’t special but I think differently I have tried many including the Farmacy daily greens one and I like this one way more it’s lighter weight has more product is the same price has a pump applicator and it does make me greasy and the farmacy smell can be overwhelming I can smell it on my face all day. This is one of my favourite products. I hope you enjoy it too.

It smells great and it feels like it’s actually moisturizing as soon as you put it on but it doesn’t leave my skin feeling moisturize throughout the day. My skin type is normal. Also, if this is your favorite moisturizer I highly recommend getting the largest size available because the 2 ounce seems to get used fairly quickly and I use my product sparingly.

Pros: lightweight, smells nice, medium moistureCons: very sticky texture (even on my hands after I apply), made some of the pores across my nose even more visible which usually happens when I’m not moisturized enough. I have skin that leans oily but this might work better for someone who has extremely oily skin, or maybe paired with a heavier night cream.

This is my absolute favorite moisturizer!! I can see why so many people love this.  From the light gel consistency to the sweet scent it’s an A+ in my book. The bottle is one of the most glam of any face product I’ve owned.  I do wish it had spf for daytime though.  This is the perfect product to use before foundation or on makeup free days as well.

I love the smell and consistency of the moisturizer. It feels cooling on my skin, but does take some time to absorb and dry. I’m not acne prone but do suffer from oily skin. I hated that it made me look oily after applying.

Decided to buy the mini size to try out the product and I love it. I’ve been using it as a serum before moisturizing because I have dry skin and I love it. I wouldn’t use it as a moisturizer for dry skin, but for oily skin it’s perfect on its own. It gives me that extra water based hydration that I didn’t know I needed before my Bobbi Brown Face Base Moisturizer. My skin feels bouncy and incredibly soft. I’ll definitely buy the bigger size once I’m done with this one.

I just love this fresh, juicy, watermelon scent!!! The smell makes me feel youthful and lifts up my mood. It feels great on skin too-so lightweight. I initially got this as a sample but I’ve had to buy the full size product because I loved it!

So, I’d like to start by saying I think this cream is pretty good. It doesn’t cause breakouts. I used the entire thing lasted about 2 months which is great. Most others only last me 1 month. I believe it does what it claims to do for the most part. However, My problem with this product is that it claims to be for dry skin, and it’s not. So many brands do this they just check-off every box. It can’t be for dry and oily skin they are 2 different concerns at opposite ends. It doesn’t dry out my skin or cause itching but that does not mean it is designed for dry skin. It leaves a lot to be desired in terms of moisture and provides zero hydration for dry skin. I bet this is great for oily skin and maybe even combo. I really wish brands would stop claiming their products are for every skin type and just be honest. I am going to try their banana moisturizer next. It claims to be more hydrating but I couldn’t help but notice it also claims to be for all skin types and if that is the case why make two products that both do the same thing for the same people.. kinda odd.
I buy this every few months! My favorite, and helps balance out my T zone!

I got this as a christmas gift and now its my holy grail! Perfect for combination and oily skin types since It’s moisturizing without feeling greasy. It’s also very light which allows for multiple products to be layered under or on top of it. Best of all, the smell makes my mouth water.

Love it! My combination skin loves it, even in winter. It’s light-weight and gives a good amount of hydration and glow to the skin and does not leave the skin greasy even during summer. Just 2 pumps of it is more than enough in winters for the face and neck.
I really like the way this moisturizer feels. I’m not sure it does everything it claims but I am happy that it doesn’t break me out.
Does nothing to your skin.literally.cant return it now i guess, i threw the box.waste of money!

I had been lusting for this particular moisturizer just because it was so cute and EVERYONE with oily skin seemed to be loving it, so as soon as I finished ny old moisturizer, I ordered this one. I wish I knew I was making a HUGE mistake. Slowly, over time, my acne was getting worse and worse as I continued using it. I typically only have acne on the side of my face but I started getting it on my cheeks, TONS of my neck and even on my forehead, which for many years had been almost completely devoid of almost any acne! That’s when I knew something was going wrong. As SOON as I stopped using this moisturizer, my face cleared very quickly and I have not developed any new acne. This product is EXTREMELY comedogenic and does not allow the skin to breathe. So don’t fall for the hype the way I did, save yourself some money and pick up some CeraVe. That’ll do you wonders over this.

I purchased the little sample box wanted to see what the hype was all about. Ok so the toner I liked, gave a glow but the moisturizer I washed it off after 5 mins. It felt tacky and almost like a film was on my face. Couldn’t wait to get it off. I’ll return the sample box but will purchase the full size toner.
review_title: Will only repurchase the toner not moisturizer

review_text: i love the smell and the texture it gives my skin, feels smooth. BUT i got the larger size and it’s extremely small and was not filled to the top

I use a full Glow Recipe routine and this is the only product that I might not repurchase. My combo skin loves lightweight moisturizers but this one just doesn’t feel that special. I would suggest getting a nice water cream from a different brand but this moisturizer didn’t have a negative effect for me.

I just finished my first bottle of this and I will probably not repurchase. The pros are that it smells wonderful and that it does leave your face very hydrated. The cons are that it takes a while to settle into your skin, and the product is not a good value. I went through a 60mL bottle in a month 1/2 with daily use (occasional twice daily) on my face and neck.  Cost aside, I think this is a decent moisturizer. I don’t love it, and I don’t hate it.

This moisturizer is just ok in my opinion. The packaging is so cute and it smells delicious, but other than that, it performed just as well as some of my drugstore gel moisturizers. My skin felt moisturized and hydrated. The product does what it says, but you can get the same effect from a cheaper moisturizer.

Love it so far. Only had it a bit but no breakouts, soothes my skin, has a great smell and nice texture. It feels gentle and soothing to my drier areas. I’ll update this after I’ve had it a few weeks.

i think this is breaking me out on my cheeks. the texture is just so gooey and gross. i have oily skin but this makes me oilier throughout the day and yet it’s not moisturizing enough. total waste of money :(

Since this is a lightweight moisturizer, I love to use this during the daytime. I’ve found that it’s helped control my acne and my skin isn’t sensitive to it at all. My skin looks smoother and hydrated after use. I also like that the packaging uses a pump since it makes it easier to apply the product. The only cons are that the scent is a bit too strong for my liking, although I do like the watermelon candy-like scent in general and this product does take longer to absorb than some of my other products. However, these are minor cons for me.

This is a really nice experience, it’s nice and cooling, but like the product description says, you shouldn’t really use this as a moisturizer if you have dry skin. It’s not enough. I wish it didn’t have added fragrance.
Amazing product. Definitely a customer for life. Mh skin is glowing!!!!!

Not my thing - definitely more of a serum than a moisturizer but does advertise “light.“ Stickiness is one of my pet peeves and this smells like watermelon and it feels like sugar syrup after application. Ick.

This is my holy grail daytime moisturizer. I’ve tried several gel/juice/water creams because they work best for my oily skin -- and this one is my fav. Better than Tatcha, which is also great, but pricier! This one feels cooling and hydrating on the skin, and my skin is so soft after use. It doesn’t break me out, soothes redness and doesn’t pill under makeup. I was momentarily swayed into buying the new Summer Friday Cloud Dew because it got so much hype (too sticky, bit irritating and less hydrating for me). I ended up just missing my Glow Recipe and coming back! I use it during the day in the winter with Protini at night, and both morning/night in summer months for reference.
AMAZING DONT LISTEN TO THE NEGATIVE! THIS IS A SERUM TYPE MOISTURIZER AND IT IS GREAT FOR ALL SKIN TYPES! ITS SO SILKY AND IM IN LOVE! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
This product is just okay. The smell is very over powering and leaves a stickiness to the skin.

Normally I don’t like fragrance in skincare (and definitely not in makeup products), but this scent is so delicious and it doesn’t linger too long nor does it cause irritation. I mainly bought this product for the ingredients and because it’s oil-free, plus I wanted to try out a gel type moisturizer for day time use. It’s definitely not hydrating enough for night time use, but for day time it’s perfect; it’s light and absorbs really well. To me, it’s more of a hydrating/moisturizing serum, so that’s how I use it and I absolutely love it. I’ll definitely be repurchasing and keeping it in my morning skincare routine.

I was really excited to try this product but I realized that this is for people with oily-combination skin. If you have SUPER dry skin, this is probably not the moisturizer for you. Left my skin wanting more and more and more.

I received several samples from a friend who shops frequently from Sephora. This one was not her favorite and I can see from the reviews it didn’t work for some people. I have combination skin. My nose and around can get greasy but my chin and cheeks are insanely dry and flakey. This product worked amazing on my skin. It stays hydrated from morning to night and is a great way to prep my skin for foundation. I went ahead and bought the largest bottle. It smells great too. I’ve never been into buying pricy skincare but I may have to think twice now. I did not break out either. I’m not prone to acne though. That was more of a high school thing and I’m now in my early 30’s.

It’s so lightweight and smells so nice. It’s one of those smells that if you’re trying to smell it you can smell it but if you’re not trying to smell it you won’t. The only thing is that the bottle wasn’t filled all the way for me and I saw another review that said the same thing. I absolutely love this brand and the fact that they use fruit to make skin care. All of their packaging is really cute.
Not really moisturizing, face still feels dry after use. If you have a “normal” face, not super dry, this would be a good, VERY light moisturizer.

Depuis que j’utilise ce produit, ma peau est parfaitement balancée: hydratée et matifiée à la fois.  J’utilise ce produit depuis plus de 2 mois et je n’ai eu aucune poussée d’acnée ce qui en soi est un miracle! Je trouve par contre que ma peau reste un peu collante après application. L’utilisation d’une base à maquillage est requise si l’on veut une application de maquillage douce après le soin hydratant. Gros coup de coeur Glow recipe. J’ai donc acheté d’autres produits et je ne suis pas déçue!
review_title: Parfait pour la peau mixte à tendance acnéique.

review_text: When I started my retinoic acid routine, I bought this despite I am Combo to dry because I knew my skin will get dry. So I used this as a light weight moisturizer in the afternoon o evening at work instead of cream. And my skin never peeled. I increased my prescription strength and nothing. Only when I stopped using it (I did not reapply creams either in that time)  is when I experienced some dryness combined with winter here! So I will restock soon!I was worried the fragrance of watermelon could trigger acne but it did not for me
review_title: For Combo to dry, use as a supplement

review_text: Yes Yes my new fav !! Super light , smell so bomb and good for oily skin !

Lightweight and hydrating. Only lost a star because this product doesn’t last for very long.

Very light weight and hydrating! I love to use this in the morning. It also smells amazing! I will say I feel like the pump doesn’t get all the product but otherwise I love it.

I have been using this moisturizer for almost 3 years now and I love it. It hydrates my dry cheeks and smells amazing. The only down side is the packaging. When it almost runs out, I can’t use every last drop in the bottle. I always ended up washing it out and recycling the glass bottle. I love the glass material but I wish it comes in a glass jar, a big big jar so that I don’t have to keep buying these little glass bottles twice a year. Other than that, it works wonder to my combo skin both in winter and summer (dry cheeks and chin, oily T-zone).
review_title: Love this but wish it comes in a bigger size jar

review_text: Love love this moisturizer I want to give it 10 stars.

This moisturizer is amazing! I do have combo to oily skin, and all I use in the mornings are the watermelon dew drops, the ultra fine watermelon mist and ONE PUMP of this moisturizer! It lasts forever and the packaging for this whole brand is perfect.

If you’re sensitive to fragrance or just don’t like it avoid this product if you don’t care about fragrance go for it!

After trying every moisturizer Sephora has to offer for combo skin, I thought I would just have to deal with unsatisfying products that either hydrated my skin but broke me out, or did not break me out but left my skin dry.  This moisturizer is the best of both worlds.  I cannot believe my PCOS hormonal acne (my experience) loves this so much.   It is not too heavy in the summer when I am oily, so I use it day and night.  In the winter however, I only use it during the day as I need something more richer for night time dryness.  I cannot recommend it enough, try the mini to test it out!
My favorite! It is super light and leaves my skin with a natural beautiful glow

This is a fantastic moisturizer for oily skin! It’s super lightweight, but it’s moisturizing enough to use both day and night. It also goes really nicely under makeup, but for people with oily skin I’d still recommend using a matte primer/serum under your makeup as the product itself is not mattifying.AND MOST IMPORTANTLY it doesn’t cause breakout for my acne probe skin.
review_title: great moisturizer for oily / acne prone skin!

review_text: This really falls short of a “moisturizer”. I was so excited to try this and I will say the texture and the smell are amazing. review_title: hardly any real moisturizing going on here

The texture was that of a gel and when put on skin it did not soak in like I was expecting. It sat on the surface and felt almost greasy. I ended up getting pretty bad acne on my forehead and temple region from this. It almost has a silica feel to it.
BAD. I wanted to like it because of all the hype and positive reviews but it did not moisturize my skin, It just sat on top of it and did not absorb.

I don’t like to return stuff but this time i was so disappointed that not think twice to return it. It did not moisturize my face and it felt dry.not worth it.

I’d recommend it for people with the same skin concerns as me who can’t use products with a lot of strong  components. Besides smelling wonderful, this product did relatively little for my skin. While I don’t think it caused any more blemishes than I had, it didn’t help with them at all or leave my skin feeling that moisturized.

When you have combination/oily skin to start with, it’s hard to find products that give you dewy skin without turning you into a greaseball. I prepped my skin with the Glow Recipe fine mist, put on the Kate Sommerville barrier serum, waited a few minutes and then applied one pump for my whole face and patted the product on. Then I waited a few minutes before proceeding with sunscreen. Really liked the results. My skin is moisturized but not shiny. I have temperamental skin during this time of year and glad I found a product with good ingredients.

The moisturizing effect is there but not stellar but it leaves a sticky feeling on the face. The pump isn’t secure and it comes loose easily each time I use it. It is okay for no makeup but is very tacky if you are trying to layer products on top.
review_title: Didn't Live Up to the Hype

review_text: Love love loveee. This makes my face look so dewy and feel so nice. I do have dry skin so it really balances me out, never look oily, just glowing !! I put this on instead of foundation or CC cream. I feel like I’m using this stuff up so fast !!

If you’re someone who enjoys fragrances..you’ll love the smell of this!

I have gone through several bottles of these and the effects are amazing. I use it as a serum during the winter but a light weight moisturizer in the summer. The fragrance is sweet and fresh without being overpowering. The texture is dewey and gives a cooling effect. I had redness on my cheeks and after using this product consistently I can say that the redness has faded and my complexion is more even. In the mornings I will use this before my makeup and it helps even out dry patches and make it so my makeup goes on smoothly.

I blow up like the elephant man when I use things that are too heavy on fragrance, but the watermelon extract in this must be natural because it smells amazing but doesn’t irritate at all. Echoing what others have said about it leaving your face a bit sticky, if you’re having a good skin day this is actually a benefit because it improves the skin tone and stays looking oil free. If you want to wear foundation I found that using a bit of tinted moisturizer after this product sinks in works as an effective primer. Or if you use powder, the tackiness might actually be helpful.
review_title: Like Dumping a Daiquiri on Face- In Good a Way

review_text: Not a deep moisturizer on my combination skin, feels more like a lightweight serum and I used quite a bit to feel hydration. However, it does brighten my skin and I love the smell and texture. The major downside is how quickly I went through it, especially for the price point.
i wanted to like this so badly bc i love the glow recipe banana moisturizer but this leaves my face SO sticky and doesn’t absorb at all. i’m confused by all these positive review about this product

review_text: I LOVE this moisturizer. It was very lightweight and at the same time very moisturizing and also it made my skin look very dewy and healthy. My sunscreen goes really well on top and my foundation or any other cream products that I use don’t move around either.

So, first of all, I have to admit that this feels more like a serum than it does a moisturizer - it’s very liquid and lightweight, and has a light, candied scent that might be off-putting to some, but I revel in it. That said, I do find this moisturizer delightful - it absorbs beautifully into my skin, and keeps it looking healthy and glowing all day. It’s a great light moisturizer on days you don’t want something heavy - fantastic if you’re in warm California weather (like me) or warm spring/summer days anywhere else.

I know I know this is expensive but it’s WORTH IT! I have combination to oily skin and this settles into my skin sooo nicely. Leave me feeling glowy and fresh but not oily. Plus the scent is delightful. It lasts me about 3 months using 1-2X a day so I feel the price is fair for that in comparison to others on the market.
I really like it. Just one pump covers my face, it smells amazing and I’m soft. I do spray a bit of toner after I’m done with it.

Just as the title says, this product was highly recommended. I was surprised how amazing my skin felt after the fragrance threw me off as I’ve been fragrance-free for at least 2 years. But I’m glad I kept up with it. My skin is super soft and there isn’t any sting like some serum-like moisturizers give me.
review_title: Tik Tok Made me buy it

review_text: I have combo skin and I need a moisturizer that won’t over clog or suffocate my skin in the mornings when I am prepping for the day. This moisturizer is good for that and my skin feels moisturized. It’s super lightweight and I like the ingredients it has. It gives you a bit of a glow, gives you a plump look, and honestly I am not mad about the fragrance. It smells like juicy watermelon and I am here for it. The fragrance goes away after a while, for those who are scared about that feature. I wouldn’t use this in my night time routine, though. You may need something with extra moisturization.

I never write reviews, but i just had to for this product. I struggled with acne for a large period of time and honesty i got the small pack that had this moisturizer and the sleeping mask. I used them everyday with the moisturizer being in the morning and the sleeping mask at night. And in a few days i could see my acne calming down. I didn’t use anything else. Just my cleanser and both the glow recipe moisturizer and sleeping mask.

I preferred the banana soufflé moisturizer. I have normal to oily skin, but I found this not hydrating enough for my skin and ended using my Neutrogena hydro boost moisturizer on top at night. Smells amazing!
I wanted to love it because of the clean ingredients and the nice smell, but it didn’t hydrate my dry areas enough and it made the pores on my t-zone look bigger.

At first I didn’t break out, and then suddenly pimples and a cluster of them in different areas started popping up.I loved that the company is pretty clean besides the fragrance. The packaging is cute, and the smell was not bad. It reminded me of watermelon scented hairspray lol. The consistency on my face was easy to spread, but felt a little sticky. Once it dried, my face was soft, and it actually reduced the redness I had on my face. Other than the pimples, this product wasn’t a bad buy. A little pricey, but I was willing to pay that if it worked.
review_title: good product, just not for my skin.

review_text: So I have been using only clean products (through a app called think dirty) and this product came up with a good grade so I purchased it to test it out. I think oily skin would love this product and if you are dry you can still use it, but you might have to buy other hydrating products maybe or just test it out for a month. I’m pretty dry right now and I am using Vaseline as my extra hydration and raw organic Shea butter and it really helps (maybe even hydraulic acid or an oil cleanser) . Also I would say I haven’t gotten acne with it but that could be because of me using retinol (drunk elephant) at a high percentage. But if you want something more creamy and clean for the skin I would recommend farmacy honey halo for my dry skin people(and it last longer). Hope this helps :)
not the biggest fan of the scent but it fades quickly. other than that this is like giving my skin a glass of water. it’s so hydrating but lightweight.

LOVE & ITS SMELLS SO GOOD!! Makes my skin super hydrated. Leaves with glass skin finish heals my acne when I use the Glow kit

I’m glad to have received a sample with an order. It is lightweight & oil free. I switched to this moisturizer because wearing a mask for nine hours a day was taking a toll on my skin. This product has been a great solution.
I have combination skin and using this product for two weeks made the dry areas drier and the oily areas oilier. The scent isn’t anything special. I was excited to try but this did not work for me.

It’s a nice, lightweight, almost serum like moisturizer. I loved this product. Super lightweight moisturizer that didn’t make me break out.

As someone who tries a lot of skin care and believes expensive skin care is mostly false advertising, I was proven wrong by this product. I have noticed a difference after using it just a couple of times. My skin feels more hydrated, soft, bright and plump. Even heavy night-time moisturizers feel like they are gone by the morning but my skin is still dewy in the morning when I use this. So dewy and pretty, perfect on it’s own or under makeup

review_title: More a Serum Than a Moisturizer for Dry Skin

review_title: More of a Serum; Still Nice!

review_text: Good quality...my skin is extra dry so I needed more hydration, but for I think this moisturizer would be great for all skin types.  The scent is very refreshing and I love glow recipe’s glass bottles.  So cute!

Loooove this moisturizer! Makes my skin feel great without being too greasy.
feels a little thick on my skin, almost oily. nonetheless, it is hydrating!

review_title: 1 month of use. Skin texture worsened.

I am anxious to see the results over time and look forward to trying other products in the line.

This moisturizer has my skin glowing! I’ve been dealing with acne-prone, normal, dull skin for so long, and when I bought this to try, the results were instant! My face has been so smooth and soft, I feel like a different person!

this is my holy grail moisturizer and i’m on my third bottle now, its so lightweight for my oily skin and its got amazing packaging and a sweet fragrance that goes away once you apply it. it keeps your skin looking dewy and soft even after it settles into your skin, my skin really likes it too.

The perfect lightweight moisturiser! I live in a very humid climate, and most face moisturisers are far too heavy or greasy and feel gross on my face. This is the perfect amount of moisture for my normal skin in a humid climate. It also smells good, which is nice :)

review_title: Is it worth the $$?? Yes it IS.

When my skin is dryer, I stick to the Banana Soufflé moisturizer, also by Glow Recipe!

Absolutely love this product. I have really oily skin so the face wash that I use strips everything off my face and just one squirt of this moisturizer gives me everything I need for the whole day! Even in the winter!!

lightweight but doesn’t really feel super hydrating - there are other better lightweight oil-free moisturizers that deliver much more of an impact.  every time i’ve worn this i’ve felt like i need another layer over top of a different product to Actually hydrate my skin.

LOVE THIS MOISTURIZER. have never had such glowing skin before. Just got back from vaca and usually very dry after being in the sun, but my skin has never looked better!

I have pretty sensitive skin and I have been normally using the Belif creams for moisturizer but was getting a bit bored of my skin care ritual & wanted to shake things up. I really do love Glow Recipes packaging- it’s always good quality and sturdy, lotions come with pumps that don’t quit on you so that’s a bonus! The scent is beautiful, it’s a very light watermelon whiff- perfect to wake yourself up on a summer morning. The lotion is very light and a little goes a long way. It doesn’t leave an oily feeling and it’s not a thick lotion so it doesn’t feel heavy. However, after you first apply it, it does seem to stay a bit “tacky” on the skin, almost sticky. That does go away as it absorbs into the skin & I personally only use it at nighttime, but if you were using it in the morning you’d want to wait about 10 minutes before applying primer or makeup on top of this. As far as keeping my face hydrated it has done a wonderful job throughout the summer. I have zero dry patches and my skin looks even. I also love that it doesn’t get slimy or gross feeling as you sweat throughout a hot day. My one fear is that it might be a bit too light for a winter moisturizer, at least for myself personally, and I have combination skin, more so on the dryer side. I definitely recommend trying this product!
