Love the scent too. It somehow doesn’t irritate my skin . Iris not my everyday moisturizer but I love to add it for a moisture boost.

I love this stuff. Its light, not irritating, smells good. I honestly wish they sold it a bigger bottle because its annoying to me how quickly it runs out. That’s the only reason why I won’t commit to using it daily, it doesn’t last a month and I know there are products that do.

This is a decent moisturizer for dry skin if you’re planning to put makeup on top of it. It hydrates well and doesn’t leave residue behind, so your makeup won’t slide around after application. It has a lovely, light sent as well.For long-term or non-makeup hydration, I’d recommend using another cream-based moisturizer on top of this one. It’s a good lightweight moisturizer but if your skin is anywhere near as dry as mine gets, you’ll need multiple applications of this one just to keep from looking like jerky at the end of the day lol.

I have been trying it for a month now and I really felt the difference in my skin. It is really glowing and the dull skin is going away. I have ordered the big one now. Looking forward to try other products from Glow Recipe

influenced to buy it but big mistake this moisturizer hardly does anything. It does smell good but that’s probably all it has going for it. If you like glow recipe i’d probably recommend the plum moisturizer over this one

I had ordered this directly from glow recipe because of a deal, but I absolutely hated it.  I don’t really know how anyone could possibly feel moisturized from this unless they live in a very humid area! this also gave contributed to my perioral dermatitis so it’s an absolute no from me.  Cute bottle and name but it made my skin look like crap.

i was mostly influenced to purchase this because i have oily and combination skin so this oil free alternative to a moisturizer might work because most creams are too heavy on my skin. however after using it on my whole face, my skin started flaking from dehydration in some areas of my skin. although it feels moisturizing during appliance, it really doesn’t hydrate really well.
after a good amount of time this moisturizer really did work for me and the smell is amazing!
review_title: This was totally a win for me!

review_text: I was already a fan of the original Blueberry Bounce Cleanser from Glow Recipe, but this new formula is even more amazing!! The new pump and bottle design is so user friendly and dispenses the exact amount of cleanser needed with one pump!  This is the most hydrating deep cleanser I have ever used, and my crazy combination skin just loves it!

I want to soak my whole body in itIt smells sooo good. But that’s not important, it helps but most importantly, it leaves my face so clean and tight without stripping it. I love how my pores are visibly clean and open so that it absorbs the next parts of my skincare routine. Also, it literally melts the makeup off without feeling oily or thick. It’s quite viscous but still gel enough to remove all that dirt, oil, makeup and grime. LOVE IT.

Excellent 3 in 1 product. Great cleanser in the morning. Great cleanser in the evening because it removes all residue from whatever you apply to your face for the day. Using it as a mask is easy and a lovely experience. Nice fragrance and leaves the skin soft and hydrated.  If you travel this is a great product because you get multiple benefits without having to pack multiple products.

I have tried the original Blueberry cleanser and would like to write about the main differences between the two.- The new bottle - definitely a huge improvement for me personally. I prefer pump bottles, it just makes it easier to dispense the right amount rather than dealing with a tube. And.... it easily locks!!! Which is a huge plus again.Having kids they are always in my stuff, by locking the bottle it gives me a peace of mind.- Scent - the scent change is very subtle. It became more fruity and flowery. I liked the original scent, and like the new one as well.- Texture - Oh man, I feel like the new cleanser is much-much bouncier in texture and thicker a little bit. It makes it easier to mask since the texture is a little firmer and stays on your face easier. If you are washing your face a little goes a long way. It doesn’t foam up too much, gives little bubbles. The original cleanser did an excellent job removing makeup and eye makeup, so does the new one as well. I usually apply the cleanser on my hands, lather it up, close my eyes and cover the whole face in bubbles. I massage face and eye area and let the cleanser soak in a little bit into my makeup, mascara and liner. I go in circles around my eyes, cheeks and face a few times to loosen up the makeup before washing it off. Usually does the trick and all the makeup gets removed from the first wash.I honestly liked the original formula, but the new formula with all of the improvements are a great plus! Do recommend to try

The new Blueberry Bounce Cleanser is an instant HG item. Smells good, cleans good, feels good. I love the pump bottle, as I can see the product and dispense it easily. I would call this cleanser a gel cleanser, but its thicker and more viscous then other gel cleansers I’ve used before. It leaves my skin feeling cleansed and soft and bouncy. My favorite way to use is to lather on my face in the shower, and then leave the super fine and soft bubbles on for a minute or so before rinsing.

Better than the original! Thicker, viscous consistency makes it great to use as a mask as well as a cleanser, and it smells sooo good it makes you WANT to wash your face for at least a minute (the amount of time you’re supposed to wash your face for in order to properly cleanse your face yet that I always found too much of a hassle to do before this cleanser came along). It’s so good I had to buy a bottle for my mom too!
I absolutely love this cleanser - it’s so light and gentle, does a great job and leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. I also love the light scent. Highly recommend this cleanser and this brand!

I have enjoyed the original version, but as always Glow Recipe succeeds with an improvement on a known winner.  This version seems to be more full-bodied and somewhat tackier consistency.  This allow me to use less product with the same results.  My 1-minute warm water massage produces a very smooth facial feel.  I do then splash my face with cold water to set the process.  My pores seem well-cleansed thus appearing smaller.  Without all that daily grime, my moisturizer can soak into my skin deeper.  i love the new pump.  The pump tube goes all the way to the bottom to maximize every drop.  The fragrance doesn’t scream of blueberries, but rather a fresh fruit/subtle floral blend that you can’t quite identify.  Its a pleasant merge of scents.  All-in-all if you have enjoyed the original blueberry cleanser, you will love the improved one.

This cleanser is great for acne-prone skin. I like that it also works as a mask. I have sensitive skin and this has a calming effect for my skin. I also like the packaging better than the tube it was previously in.

Love the new packaging! The dispenser gives you precisely the amount you need, and I love the locking design. Super cute, cleans extremely well and is super gentle on my face. The only reason I’m not giving it the full five stars is because of the new fragrance (which is a bit much for me and lingers on my face), but otherwise it’s great!
Blueberry bounce is a wonderfully refreshing cleanser, washing away the stress of the day with it’s texture and smell. It leaves the skin clean but not dry. Love it!

Loving this new bottle and formulation. Although I do miss the blueberry bits in the old formula. This pump bottle is much easier to use, especially in the shower. Subtle and clean scent, foams up nicely and leaves a soft fresh feeling afterwards.

This has always been a gentle and effective cleanser (I go minimal so I can’t say how good it is as a remover with waterproof/longwearing makeup) and its reformulation has made it even better - better bottle and more product too! With just one pump it cleanses the skin without leaving squeaky tight. I wish they kept the old scent though. I like it better than this new floralish one but it’s not too strong.

First and foremost, my favorite cleanser has been the original Blueberry Bounce ever since it was released, so I was excited to try this new formula. Comparisons and review below: Packaging: Obviously the packaging has changed. It is now in a bigger bottle, holds more product, and has a pump with a straw rather than a soft tube bottle with a cap. The pump is easy to close up - you can switch it off if you need to pack it for traveling. -->Verdict: I prefer the original packaging, but I know that can be personal preference. I find the soft tube bottle with a top cap closure much more secure for traveling, and easier for every day use. I also feel like getting the last bits out of the bottle will be harder with the straw pump structure. All that being said, it is nice that the new bottle has more product in it. Consistency: The new formula is much more ’bouncy’ than the original. It has a firmer texture than the original foams up more while washing your face. There isn’t much of the blueberry bits in the new formula though. -->Verdict: I really enjoy both versions. I kept going back and forth with the cleansers to compare and I have to say they are both . great - I still love the original, but the new texture feels great as well. I do miss the larger pieces of blueberry though. Scent: The new cleanser smells more fruity (not necessarily like blueberries, just fruity/floral in general), and has a stronger fragrance. The original smells lighter and strictly more like blueberries. -->Verdict: I prefer the original, but both smell good. I prefer to use lighter fragranced products on my face in general. However, after layering on toner, moisturizers, etc, I can’t smell the cleansers after use anyway. Ingredients: The ingredients are the same, but the new cleanser is claimed to be more gentle, and better at removing makeup (among other things). -->Verdict: I am for anything that is better and safer for my skin, so the new clean

My first impression of this cleanser was that it is remarkably hydrating.  After cleansing and drying I wasn’t desperate for toner or mist.  My skin also felt much smoother than it usually does after cleansing.  I typically use an oil cleanser and a foam cleanser, but the directions for the Blueberry Bounce state that it works as a makeup remover if you massage in into to your face for a minute, so I tried that method without the oil cleanser and it literally made my skin squeaky clean.  I’m impressed by how gentle yet effective it is.  The fragrance is subtle and pleasant.  The foam is lighter than what I’m used to but easier to rinse off.  I appreciate the locking mechanism on the bottle pump too.  A !

I’ve enjoyed both the original and this new Blueberry Bounce cleanser from Glow Recipe. I’m in my early 40s so I look for cleansers that don’t over strip my skin. The new formula is incredibly powerful, yet still gentle. I only require a pump about the size of 2 peas to get an incredible lather. The first few times I tried it I did notice that the scent was strong, but not offensive. I’ve grown used to the scent so I barely notice it now. I typically use my foam cleanser after an oil cleanser, but decided to try this alone since it promises to also remove makeup. It did well, although there was still some residual eye makeup after cleansing. I love the pump design and the locking mechanism is easy and built in. I’ve only been using this formula for about 10 days, but I’m pretty sure it will become a staple like many other Glow Recipe products. I highly recommend it.

I love glow recipe products and the new blueberry bounce cleaner is another must have product for me. I have very sensitive skin and like to use this as a quick mask on hot summer days. What I like most about this product is how soft it leaves my skin. I also love the new packaging and the gel texture.

I’ve used the original Blueberry Bounce Cleanser and there are some really great things about this new version.  As other reviewers have noted, the bottle is really nice.  I like the pump design as well as the increased quantity!  The new fragrance is floral but very subtle.  I started using this as my second step in my two-step cleanse but where it really shines is as a makeup removed.  I had a really late night and didn’t wash my face (!) so the next morning I tried using this as a makeup remover by massaging it into my face for a minute and rinsing.  It worked great!  Even though my skin wasn’t in great condition it felt soft and there wasn’t any makeup residue!

My skin was combination/oily but now it’s combination/dry after using the wrong products. My skin is kinda damaged but K-beauty has brought it back to normal. The first version dried me out but this one is much better.  Good cleanser and good makeup remover. I didn’t use it as a mask because I feared it would dry me out. It helps control my acne and my large pores. I just felt the products I used afterwards didn’t absorb beyond the surface of my skin. My skin felt moisturized on the surface but it didn’t go deeper than that. It exceeded my expectations but my skin didn’t love it as much. Creamy foaming cleansers work better for my skin. This one wasn’t meant for me. However, since my skin is damaged I encourage you to try it and see if it works for you.
review_title: Good cleanser just wasn't meant for me

review_text: This new formulation of the Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser is amazing. I thought I liked the old one, but this formula really outshines it. It really cleans your skin without striping it, leaving it feeling hydrated and supple. At night, I use it as a second cleanse and removes the last remnants of my very stubborn waterproof mascara with very little effort. The pump delivers just the right amount of product-with the old tube packing I was always squeezing too little or too much product, or dropping it in the sink and watching product ooze out while scrambling to pick it up with soap in my eyes. All in all, this cleanser has earned a permanent place in my ever changing skincare routine.

Really liked the packaging of this new Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser. I feel like Glow Recipe has made this product more worth it by giving a little more product than the old tube, and taking it to the next level by adding better and more ingredients to it. I really like the scent of this cleanser and how it removes all of my makeup and dirt off my face, leaving it clean and soft. One thing that I didnt really like was the fact that it did break me out a little and made my face a tad bit red. The old Blueberry Cleanser tube was better for me. Maybe its because I have extra sensitive skin, but i’ll give this cleanser a couple more weeks and see if it gets better !
Love the new formulation! It removes all traces of makeup, even eyes, without stripping my skin. Suds up with tiny bubbles and a gentle hint of blueberry. The pump dispenser is a nice plus!

Packaging: The bottle retains the clean simple look of the original but the pump makes it easier to use on a daily basis. I do think the tube packaging was easier for travel though. Maybe they can come out with a travel tube version of this.Smell: The blueberry scent is lighter with the new formulation but just as pleasant. I can see super fine blueberry bits on my bottle.Texture: It transforms from a watery-gel texture to foam as you rub it onto wet palms, then to a tacky texture as you rub it on your face.Effectiveness: I wear light makeup and it removed everything except for my mascara. My face felt really clean and soft afterwards.Conclusion: I love how nice my skin feels after and like using this in the mornings. With makeup, I would still need to double cleanse but it’s not a dealbreaker for me. The bonus is my skin feeling touchably soft after.
Great cleansing product, leaves skin super soft and hydrated. There is no feeling of moisture loss after drying, we as many other products have left my skin crying for moisture.
I like the new formula and packing. This cleanser left my skin feeling clean and hydrated.  I use this at night and love that the double cleanse has been condensed to one step!

Finally saw this at my local Sephora yesterday! The upgraded packaging is everything! I absolutely adore pumps and this bottle is worthy of a shelfie! Cleanser has the same bouncy gel texture, foams up nicely, and removed all my makeup! My skin feels clean, smooth, and refreshed!

I have acne-prone skin that is also extremely sensitive; and this cleanser is wonderful to use.  It’s both gentle, yet powerful in it’s cleansing strength.  It feels luxurious to use and smells amazing (I personally love the fruity-floral scent).  I still have not used it as a mask, but imagine that it will yield nice results because of the ingredients and consistency. I highly recommend!

I lucked into a small sample size of this and the sleeping mask in a kit. I like to use this with my facial brush because it’s gentle and works great after a makeup removing oil. I will consider buying a full size when my current cleaner is done! I’m

Love the new version. First, new package. The pump is thin plastic. It’s pretty but not substantial. But that said, it opens and locks easily, pumps smoothly and creates plenty of pressure to dispense a nice amount of cleanser. I find it easier and cleaner to use than the tube but can’t put it in my drawer any more. Luckily, it isn’t ugly on my counter. Next, the cleanser. Same great performance as before. I was grateful to test it after I put some seriously nasty serum on my face that stank, got sticky and made my face feel tight. After an hour, I couldn’t wait to get it off. This cleanser saved me. The scent of blueberries is fairly noticeable but pleasant and disappears completely when rinsed. The texture is smooth and easily gets to a medium lather. It leaves my skin very clean but smooth and not parched or stripped. It got all that nasty serum out in just a few seconds. Whew and yay. I find this cleanser to be one of my favorites and it performs way better than most gentle cleansers.

I’ve been loving the original formula but I’m glad glow recipe reformulated it for better!! It’s so gentle and more hydrating and perfect to use as the second cleanser after removing makeup! Smells amazing too!!
its super hydrating and smells amazing... Also the packaging is so cute!

I can not say enough good things about this cleanser. A little goes a long way, I love the way it fizzes or foams up (whatever you want to call it) when you are washing your face and it removes your makeup really well. I use it as a cleanser and makeup remover, including water proof mascara. I PROMISE you won’t be disappointed but if you are, I apologize. There is less than a handful of products that I swear by and continue to buy over and over and this is one of them. Give it a try you won’t regret it. There are also small bits of blueberries in the cleanser which is nice because you are actually seeing the natural ingredients in your product.
review_title: THE BEST. Stop here. This is your new cleanser

review_text: I was hestitant to use this on my eyes because of the AHA but it was gentle enough that my eyes felt no irritation and all of my waterproof makeup came off. The more i massaged it into my skin, the foamier it got and by the end I had a rich lather on my face that left my skin feeling clean but not tight. The smell is more of a clean and light blueberry scent and not the artificial blueberry candy or jello scent that one would normally associate with blueberry skincare products. I never tried the OG blueberry bounce cleanser but I love the new one so much that I’m looking for excuses to wash my face.
Effectively removes makeup, doesn’t dry skin out. Love this cleanser!
This is my favorite cleanser! Smells amazing and not only makes my skin feel great, my face looks great and hydrated. So happy I found this! Loving this glow recipe brand!
Love this cleanser! My skin feels soooo clean after using it and it looks brighter as well. Worth the price because a little goes a long way.

Great cleanser for removing face makeup, only! It does make my very sensitive eyes sting when i use it on my eyes and while i’m not expecting it to take off my waterproof mascara, which it doesnt, i’d recommend other products for that purpose.Doesn’t leave any feelings of residue nor does it make my face feel dried out. It smells more like fruity candy.

This cleanser is very different from anything I have ever tried. It actually is like jelly and it is rather sticky and can be messy. It definitely hydrates the skin, but I am not sure that it actually does anything for the pores like it claims. I will continue to use because I like how it leaves my skin feeling.

This has become my new favorite cleanser! It works great on my sensitive skin and leave it feeling amazing! Not only clean but soft and subtle, not dry, tight or striped! The packaging is really cute and modern and the smell of the cleanser itself it nice also! I will definitely buy again! Glow Recipe has become my favorite skin care! the watermelon products are amazing also!
review_title: Great all around!(Even for sensitive gals like me)

review_text: Better the second time as I know what to expect! This is nice cleanser and mask. Completely cleans off all traces of my makeup including the crazy long wearing mascara! I truly like the whole line and others from their website!

I’m obsessed with this cleanser! I have combination skin and my skin did not feel stripped at all. It’s the only cleanser that I have ever used that is gentle and removes all my make up without double cleansing.
Literally the best cleanser I have tried to date. Completely removes every trace of make up - even my toughest waterproof liner. Love this so much!
Love! Cleans so well but doesn’t strip my face and smells nice.

I am a fitness instructor and I use this once a day.  Naturally, my skin is combo, but with my teaching schedule it tends to lean toward oily.  I originally received it as a sample, and really liked it.  I’ve been using it for about three weeks now, and my skin seems brighter, also no breakouts.  Washing my face with Blueberry bounce is really great.  It gently foams, leaving my skin feeling soft, clean, and supple.  It also smells really great, but if scent isn’t your thing, that’s something to note.  I don’t use it as a makeup remover, but it is great as a daily cleanser.   I’m very pleased with my purchase, and will be buying again.

Wow! Total game changer! For the last 3+ years my HG facial cleanser has been the Total Truth Cleanser. I saw this pretty purple bottle during the VIB sale & after reading all the rave reviews, I decided to try it. I am so glad I did. I’ve got normal skin but I’ve been experience a little dryness on my nose & forehead, especially after washing my face in the shower. I’ve used this TWICE and my skin is noticeably smoother! I washed my face in the shower tonight and my skin does not feel right and dry like it normally does and there are no dry patches! My skin is smooth, soft and hydrated! Amazing!
review_title: Softer, smoother skin after just 2 uses!

review_text: I was hesitant to try this cleanser because I’ve been using the La Mer Gel Cleanser for a while and am generally gravitated towards more popular or luxury brands. A Sephora consultant recommended it for me because I have normal to dry skin and I know AHA’s and Hyaluronic Acid are great for hydration. I’ve been using it for only a couple day now but I love it! It removes makeup well but still feels gentle on the face and eyes. It’s also really slick so it washes off effortlessly. I was wary that it would feel stripping but my skin felt great afterwards with no tightness or dryness. The only thing I’m kind of ambivalent about is the smell; it is a light, fruity blueberry scent but personally I think it smells a little too shampoo-like. It’s not bothersome but if you’re not into fragranced cleansers, you may not like this. Other than that, definitely recommend!
review_title: Gentle cleanser, great for dry skin!

review_text: I really wanted to love this cleanser, but it stripped my skin. I had to skip my toner and moisturize immediately to stop my dry skin from itching. Positives include: very little is needed to wash your face, it lathers easily, and washes make-up off well. The scent is subtle, I wanted a delicious blueberry smell but it didn’t smell like it to me.

After finishing my bottle of Fresh’s Soy cleanser I decided to pick this up instead of repurchasing because I’d heard so many wonderful things about this cleanser and the Fresh cleanser left my face feeling so dry and tight after using it. I’ve only used this cleanser a handful of times and I can already feel the difference! My skin doesn’t feel tight after cleansing, and it feels so moisturized. The small amount of AHAs in the cleanser is just enough to leave me skin feeling soft and smooth, and doesn’t irritate my sensitive, combo skin. I’m excited to keep using this, and try using this as a mask, as well. Definitely recommend picking this up and giving it a try.
I’m in love with this cleanser, after using it for a week my skin is clearing up and looks so healthy I haven’t needed to wear foundation.
I like this a lot. Doesn’t dry out my skin. I love the packaging which squirts out just enough product. I love the light blueberry scent. No complaints.

I have tried too many cleansers to count but this one is by far superior. A few people compared Blueberry Bounce to the Fresh Soy Cleanser which just didn’t get along well with my skin. This cleaner works very well with both Foreo & Clarisonic devices and leaves skin feeling clean and moisturized (10/10 would recommend following up with the Watermelon Glow Sleeping Mask!!!!) however please don’t use around your eyes since this product does have glycolic and lactic acid and it will not be pleasant. Seriously though, best cleanser ever.
review_title: Will never use a different cleanser, ever again.

review_text: I have the older version of this cleanser and already loved it! Now that it is beautifully and conveniently packaged with a pump - it’s perfection! It removes makeup with ease and does not make my skin feel tight (stripping my face of oil) afterwords. Great job, Glow Recipe!!

My face feels so clean after washing with this! Leaves my skin feeling firm and glowing. I don’t use this to remove makeup because I want my skin to get all the AHAs in this. I use Purity Made Simple to remove any makeup then I go in with this. I only use at night and I can feel a difference even in the morning since incorporating into my night time routine. The bottle being adorable and minimalistic is just cherry on top. Begs to be displayed next to the sink.

Great produt, but not with people with sensitive skin.  I noticed red blotches on my cheeks and chin and after stip using the product they disappeared.  I would recommend to people with normal type of skin

This cleanser is amazing. I bought it to be my evening cleanser to help with taking off my makeup, and it does that and more. I’ve only used it a few times so far but I woke up this morning and my skin was noticeably better, my pores were smaller and not clogged looking like they usually are, and my skin felt baby smooth. I have oily to dry combo skin, and this cleanser does the trick for me without feeling stripped or tight but definitely still clean!
So sad, it was too aggressive for my skin. A single use of it as a cleanser caused massive aggressive breakouts like I’ve never had before.

I got this because I love trying new skin care.... but believe me when I tell you this cleanser will change your life. I normally use a three step system to take of my makeup (balm, makeup wipes then cleanser) this is literally a three in one! When I am traveling I don’t even bring a balm! Worth the money! Only problem I’m experiencing is the pump but I can definitely overlook that!

Had to leave a review because I saw the nonsense posted by someone who does not understand chemistry or photography. The old formula had bigger blueberry pieces, this one just has more fine pieces. I contacted the company and they told me the finer pieces won’t show up on camera and that they tried! So I did my own experiment. With flash on and after a high contrast edit, they’re right, the blueberry pieces totally disappear in a photo. Same amazing cleanser I’ve loved for over a year now :)
review_title: Still has Real pieces of blueberry!

review_text: This is a fantastically effective cleanser with a unique  jelly-to-foaming texture. It works really well at removing makeup. However, for me I found it very difficult on the eyes (whether using more of it to remove eye makeup or very little in the morning), particularly since I wear contacts. It makes them uncomfortably dry and stings. Since I already have other effective cleansers that are fine near my eyes I found myself never reaching for this one and decided not to keep, especially with the price.

Wowza! Ok so I’ve been using this for all of 4 days. Not usually a long enough time frame for a proper review except my skin is FLAWLESS! The issues I was having 5 days ago and for the past 4 months are: dullness, large pores, the worst texture issue and discoloration around my nose. I tried two peels from Sephora. One smoothed the texture, for 2 days. And the other brighten my skin but made my pores huge.I purchased this with the Saturday morning? peel and used them both the same day I received them, while I the peel has played its role well, this cleanser has taken my skin to the next level. It’s not dewy or overly glowing just healthier more youthful skin. My skin looks and feels hydrated, even, soft and smooth. In the morning I use the cleanser then follow up with my coola cucumber scented sunscreen and at night the cleanser with the glow recipe moisturizer.This review isn’t a full 5 because I could do without the scent. It’s not necessarily bad, just hate blueberries, but with these results it’s tolerable for the entire 35 seconds it’s on my face. GET IT!

Been using this for 3 weeks now and it has changed my skincare life! It’s so gentle while at the same time being deeply cleansing. The pump is great because it regulates the amount you use. Tried using it as a mask, I like it however I have normal to dry skin and it is deeply cleansing and I don’t really need that deep of a cleansing mask in my life right now. All in all, love this cleanser and will be repurchasing once I use this bottle up.

I’ve been looking forward for Glow Recipe to arrive in Canada for a long time.  Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser has a thick gel consistency so a little does go a long way. One little pump is enough to take off any leftover dirt that my oil cleaner couldn’t get.  My 56 year old face and neck are so smooth and moisturized after this step.  Definitely happy.
review_title: So worth the hype...must try product

review_text: Love this product!! Not only is the smell fantastic, but its ability to remove ALL my makeup in ONE wash WITHOUT any rubbing, scrubbing, OR discomfort makes it my favorite cleanser by far!
I really wanted to like this cleanser. Every time after I used this though, my skin was red and had bumps. This is the only product that has ever broken me out. :/
Amazing cleanser, actually works! Although it foams so great, does not dry out skin, smells so good. A little goes a long way! love it!

I started using this cleanser last week. It left my face feeling stripped of any moisture it had and I have combo skin. I noticed the other day that I have dry patches all over my forehead and nose now from this cleanser. I think this might be more suited for very oily skin. Gave it 2 stars because the scent is good and the packaging is functional.
Bought based on reviews and will repurchase.  Skin is very smooth after cleansing without stripping it of oil.  Smells amazing.  Will repurchase.
Love this product, I have been using it mostly as a facial wash and it has really done wonders with my skin.

Amazing cleanser at taking off light-semi full makeup but it does sting your eyes if the soap gets in them! I had on many coats of mascara and although it all came off my eyes were super red afterwards. Easy to use and the packaging is great. Hasn’t bothered my sensitive acne prone skin.
review_title: Good 2 in 1 makeup remover and cleanser

review_text: Was pricey.  Smells nice.  Works ok. Not too drying on the skin. It’s a weird consistency until it lathers.  I might buy this again if on sale.  I will try more from this brand.
good for winter time, soft and gentle as it says.
I love it! Love the smell and how it makes my skin look! It’s really soft and goes well with my sensitive skin. Will definitely buy again.

This cleanser gave me terrible break outs!I usually NEVER break out from cleansers, but this one stripped my skin and gave me the worst break outs I’ve ever had in my life. Avoid if you have sensitive skin!

I’m not sure what to think yet. I’ve been using for 2 weeks but it hasn’t impressed me. I would say it’s a decent cleanser, but compared to their glow sleeping mask this was a little disappointing. I didn’t notice much of a difference in my skin. I’ll try and give it some more time.

I love this face wash. It smells wonderful and makes my skin feel super clean. I use this face wash with the Clarisonic and I love it. I only have 4 stars because it’s good, but not my favorite of all time. My holy grail is the Tatcha Deep Cleanse. This is a very close second!
I don’t tend to write reviews but this is yet the best cleanser ever that I’ve used..
Great cleanser. Beautiful packaging. A light blueberry smell not to over powering.
I have been using this for a few weeks. Love the packaging - super easy to lock it when you need to travel. Also love the texture of the cleanser and the fragrance.

Really wanted to love this but my skin is so dry right now & it has patches, it actually hurts. After using this my skin felt like it was on fire. Gave it 2 stars bc I loved the packaging $ smell wasn’t unpleasant. It did remove my mascara very well (I use about 3 coats). My skin is dry but not sensitive. I’ve used harsh cleansers & I’ve never felt my face in “pain” with anything I’ve used.
Even when I wash two times, this face wash doesn’t do a good job of cleaning my skin. Smells great but look elsewhere if you want a good cleaning product.
Beyond amazing product!! truly takes off every bit of mascara and makeup. Super hydrating and the gel feels very bouncy.
I LOVE this cleanser! It doesn’t take much

Truly the best cleanser I’ve ever used. Seriously after using it one time my skin felt so freaking smooth. I’ve never had a cleanser have that effect on my face. It’s really good for taking off your makeup and as a toner too. The texture is amazing too, like a gel/serum. The scent is so nice and not offensive at all. I reccomend this product to anyone who wants clean and soft skin.
review_title: I love this MULTI PURPOSE facial cleanser!

review_text: Really liking the results so far. My face looks and feels so much I better. The last few months I have started getting heavy breakouts on my forehead with clogged pores galore! I swear I can feel the gunk coming out my pores and even after one day my skin looked noticeably better. It also smells like real life blueberries and not artificial.
I love this stuff! It smells great and is good with my combination skin type.

It’s smells amazing!! This cleaner does remover every bit of makeup even to your mascara. I recommend wiping your face than using this in case your makeup wipe doesn’t get everything. I love this cleanser. A little goes a long way. You’ll only need one pump for your whole face.
I love this cleaner. I use it morning and night and my skin feels clean and refreshed without being dry. I follow with the glow moisturizer and sleeping mask and my skin has never looked better.

Smells good, left my face clean but very drying. I have dry to normal skin with no other skin issues so this was not the best option for me. I tried a heavier moisturizer to balance out the dry feeling after but it didn’t help.
review_title: Not the best for dry or sensitive skin

review_text: I haven’t tried it with makeup on. It’s a good cleanser. It foams, but, doesn’t dry out my skin and leaves it clean, hydrated and fresh. And oh, a little goes a long way with this one! Believe me, 2 or 3 drops are enough to cleanse the face. The sample I got at the store in their teeny tiny container- lasted me 5 times.The reason I gave it four stars because I haven’t tried it with makeup on.

Every time I try to buy this in a store, it seems to always be sold out because everyone else loves it too! Does a great job of getting my makeup off and leaving my skin soft and clean. Smells nice too!
This actually gets off my makeup including the impossible eye makeup. It gets off about 95% which is better than I can say for other cleansers.
review_title: My eye makeup met its match

review_text: An amazing, gentle cleanser that removers makeup and dirt without stripping your skin. The scent is minimal and not overpowering.

This cleanser is amazingggg! It cleared my skin up in a week!!! It didn’t leave me feeling tight/dry after use like i thought it would ...my skin looks soooo smooth and glowy now I’m impressed!!!! :D the only thing is it did  irritate my eyes a bit so i try not to go around that area but i am going to continue to use it !!!

The packaging is super cute and sleek. I was getting bored of my fresh cleanser and wanted to try something new. I use this as a second step after I’ve taken off a majority of my makeup with the clinque take the day off. The consistency is a thick gel. I usually use about 2 pumps. The scent kind of reminds me of shampoo. It feels great on my skin and does a great job on removing left over makeup on my skin. Be careful though this stuff gets in eyes pretty easily and stings like crazy. It’s only happened to me once. The price point is a liiiiiittle steep though. Still life be it though.

This cleanser is amazing if you’ve got sensitive/acne-prone skin. My skin loves to breakout immediately if something isn’t working. I’ve tested this cleanser out for 2 months, and my skin has calmed down, and the breaks I do get are hormonal and unavoidable. It does a great job at disinfecting them that’s for sure, and reduces the redness and inflammation. The only thing to be advised about when it comes to this cleanser is that it can be drying, so please use a nice rich moisturizer afterwards to add some moisture back into your skin.

I have very sensitive acne-prone skin and have never had a cleanser make my face look this good. this is the clearest my acne has ever been. I use it as a morning cleanser and i have definitely seen a change in the definition of my pores and my makeup application.

I wasn’t impressed. I’ll admit I’m a bit hard to please in the cleaner department. It didn’t make my skin feel soft after use, which is big for me. I didn’t really care for the consistency either, when the water hit it, it disappeared. I tried it bc it had ok reviews and I liked the packaging:)

I like the new packaging vs the old. As someone who has sensitive skin, this works well for me. Super easy one-step cleansing process as it removes my eye makeup without smearing or smudging  it across my face.
I like to use it in the morning. It cleans skin very well and light. It does not leave skin super dry afterwards but very soft.

I have extremely sensitive, oily, breakout-prone skin and I have to be very careful about what I put on my face. This stuff is AMAZING. If I could give it 10 stars I would. Perfect cleanser. Cleans my face without making it feel tight and dry and doesn’t break me out.
Love this cleanser - perfect balance. And gentle and smells so nice!

I have super sensitive skin and find most cleansers too harsh.  This is hands down the best cleanser I’ve ever used!  It smells amazing and is super gentle but makes my skin feel extremely clean.  Absolutely love it.

I have only been using this cleanser for a few days, but have already noticed a huge difference. It is clearing up my MASSIVE breakout on my chin and also soothing the rest of my skin. I was a bit skeptical because of the price, but I feel that this is worth it. The smell is lovely and not strong which is really nice. It lathers up very nicely with warm water and makes skin feel nice and clean without being drying.
Really like this cleanser. Feel like it really works to take makeup off and also with leaving my skin feeling soft and glowing. Love the smell too!
This product is amazing. Makes your skin feel great and even removes waterproof makeup! You don’t need a full pump because it lathers up on your face.
gentle and cleansing on my sensitive, not oily nor dry, skin!

This cleanser is amazing. I wear makeup every day and I have always used an oil cleanser as the first step in removing my makeup but this has replaced that. This works so well as removing all traces of makeup. I don’t even need to double cleanse. It also makes my skin feel incredibly smooth and does not strip the oils. Highly recommend.

I was really excited to try this product based of the reviews and the Glow Recipe mask that I love, however I was extremely disappointed. This dried out my skin instantly, made me break out and caused red patches. I don’t usually have sensitive skin, but after this product I do. I believe this would be best for people with extreme acne or oily skin.
I feel like this would be a great face wash if I wasn’t on Retin-A for fine lines. This face wash is causing further irritation. I do however, like the scent and the way it makes my face feel clean.

Best wash for my combination sensitive skin! I had gone to the dermatologist and received a wash through a prescription- i has horrible reactions to it- got this and my face cleared up within two days!!! Plus I’m experiencing consistent improvement - even my pores (which are very big) appear so much smaller and tighter. I’m hooked !

Not usually one to write a review, but this product is amazing! I have been using this product for over a month, and I can confidently say my skin is more elastic (bouncy). I was having trouble with breakouts for few months but using this as the first step in my double cleanse has helped a lot with the hyper-pigmentation. Of course I can’t give this product all the credit...but it has succeeded where others have failed in my breakout journey! The packaging is so pretty and clean, and the pump delivers the perfect amount of cleanser. Great product for the price. Also love the model in the video :)

First off, this smells delightful. It smells just like blueberries! It cleaned my skin but didn’t leave it feeling tight or dry. The consistency was a jelly-like goo. For context I have oily skin and I’m concerned with my pores and blackheads. I like that this has AHAs to really deep clean my skin. I highly recommend trying it if you have blemish prone, or oily skin.
The cleanser make my skin feel smooth. It has a soothing effect on my skin.

it dries out my skin & leaves it feeling very tight and rubber like. I use (used) it every day (~one pump). at first it made my skin feel soft, but after using about half I’m over it.I have sensitive acne prone skin. dry and oily t zone combo.

Nothing special. Smell great. I would recommend this product for normal skin type. It is very gentle to the skin..there’s better product out there. It don’t wash out all of my makeup. I do use a cleansing balm before..

I read such amazing reviews on this and wanted to love it but I just don’t feel that it cleanses my skin enough. It’s more of a light cleanser that’s good in the morning but not for night time. I find this to make my skin feel super soft after using it but I’ve never felt that it truly cleansed my skin well enough after a long day of wearing a full face of makeup. I find myself getting more breakouts due to this cleanser as well because it’s just not enough for my skin. If you aren’t looking for something that’ll give you a deep cleanse, this will be great for you but it wasn’t enough for me and my acne prone skin.

It smells wonderful, but I found it very drying. The sides of my face and neck actually started to peel. I passed in on to a friend who has oily skin and she said she skin was very tight after washing. It would be good for someone with very oily skin
review_title: Too drying for normal or combo skin

review_text: This cleanser is A-mazingggg! It brightens your skin, leaves your skin radiant, smooth and supple and controls breakouts. Literally since I’ve been using it I’ve noticed I don’t break out as often! Definitely a must have!

As far as face wash goes, as long as it actually soaps up and doesn’t leave a weird film or make me break out then I’m sold. This one definitely hit all the check boxes the only downside is it’s more on the basic side so if you’re looking for a face wash to help with radiance or aging it’s not up to par with some of the others I have.

I have tried a few of the big hype cleansers like Deep Cleanse from Tatcha and the Superfood cleanser from Youth to the People (both are good), but this one really takes the cake! It is great not just for a thorough cleanse but it also leave your skin feeling very soft and radiant which I find is not typical of the more deep cleansing ones!
review_title: Everything you want in a cleanser

review_text: Miss the old formula. This one has way too much perfume that lingers on your face. I was super sad because the tube lasted me so long and was awesome (i love their whole line and cant wait for sephora to carry their avocado mask). I do not suggest this product if you or someone in your family is sensitive to smell.
The smell was incredible but it broke me out so bad, I would NOT recommend for people with acne prone skin.

I was so happy to buy this product because I love the Watermelon Sleeping Mask + Moisturizer by Glow Recipe. Unfortunately, on my first use I noticed it was super drying. I waited for that bounce that I saw in the display videos, but felt my face tightening more and more. This product did do a nice job at removing my eye makeup, but was just too harsh on my combination skin. I was also expecting it to smell more like blueberries, but it did have a nice clean scent.
Love the feel of my skin after using this. The only thing that keeps me from buying more is the price I guess.
Amazing cleanser, my skin was starting to feel dry and breaking out from the winter weather. Used this once and the next day my skin was so soft and my pimples were less noticeable.

My favorite new cleanser, hands down! For those that are curious, the consistency is gel-like and considerably thicker than it appears to be just from looking at the bottle. Leaves behind zero grimy residue yet still remains hydrating to the skin. Only a single pump is required to remove a full face of make up and is able to be worked into a rich lather. The easy-to-use locking mechanism on the dispenser is a godsend (considering how many cosmetic products are lacking in such a feature) and keep the bottle from accidentally dispensing when you’re travelling with it. It also has a light, clean scent and lovely packaging. Will buy again and again!

I was super hopeful for this face wash because of all the great reviews but my gosh, this cleanser dried my skin out so bad( i usually have oily skin everywhere) and gave me bright red patches everywhere. If you Have sensitive skin i wouldn’t recommend.

I’ve tried at least a hundred cleansers and nothing seemed to make any difference for my stubborn skin. I struggle with redness on my cheeks and dull uneven skin tone and this stuff is the only cleanser that I can see and feel a difference. It leaves my skin soft and smooth. I quite enjoy the scent, and it doesn’t create a huge lather which I actually appreciate. My skin can be sensitive and it did not react at all to the fragrance, which is very light and pleasant.

I have oily skin & bought this cleanser about two weeks ago and I can now say that I’ve definitely noticed a difference in my skin texture & hydration level. I went from using the Biore charcoal gel face wash to the Glow Recipe Blueberry Bounce Gentle Cleanser, by doing so this has revitalized my skin to become more SUPPLE & HEALTHY. You don’t need to use a lot either; one pump w/ some warm water & you’re onto lathering your face. I highly suggest if you have dry skin or if you oily skin! It has helped keep my natural oils at a healthy level and it serves a nostalgic essence, from the antioxidants packed in this baby! Needless to say, I love it.
review_title: It’s a bubble bath for ya face!

review_text: Really good cleanser! I normally would use it while I’m in the shower to scrub off all my make-up and it works well!!! I had on a matte lipstick (can’t remember if it was Kat Von D or Kylie) but I just rubbed a bit of this on it with no water or anything and left it for a few seconds and it wiped right off! Good stuff

I usually do not buy from glow recipe because their products do not always cater to dry skin, but this does for sure. This cleanser clears my skin. My skin looked better within a couple of weeks. I did not know right away what caused my skin to look clearer, and I figured out it was this! It does not make my face feel tight, burn, or irritate my skin. It is a very comfortable feeling and I will definitely purchase again. It smells great as well.

I was hesitant about buying this pricey cleanser but I’m glad i did! I have super oily, gunky acne prone skin. My pores are always clogging. I’ve tried a variety of cleansers, from your typical 10% benzoyl peroxide wash to more gentle, cleansers like Glossier’s milk jelly. I’ve also tried cleansing balms/oils then using another gentle cleanser. I read the ingredients and reviews, then tested this out at my local Sephora (loved the smell) and bought it. My friend looked at me like I was crazy... $30 for a cleanser?! (She has perfect skin, washes her face with bar soap what can i say?!)Anyways, I went home and cleansed my face with this product.... and it’s really really good. It suds up like shampoo. Heck, it even smells like shampoo. It’s expensive, but since it suds up so well you only need a half a pump, even if you have makeup on. This was an amazing value compared to the glossier milk jelly cleanser, where I found myself using 2-3 pumps to really feel “clean.” For maximum efficiency, slightly wet your face, put on the cleanser and scrub, then wet your hands and continue to wash, working in any areas that need extra help (oil patches, makeup, etc.). You only need a little bit as the suds just clean so well!!Afterwards, my skin felt so soft, exfoliated, and CLEAN. My gunky pores felt refreshed. Other gentle cleanser options were never enough for my clogged skin. Not only that, but this cleanser was able to wash off my Tarte and Too Faced máscaras with some wash.The only really NEGATIVE of this cleanser is that you MUST keep your eyes closed shut when removing mascara!!! If you open your eyes this stuff will BURN. This makes sense as it contains AHAs. So while it does an amazing job of removing mascara without rubbing your eyes to death (cause the suds really take it off) you just keep your eyes shut and rinse thoroughly or else it will BURN!) But bottom line this is worth cause it’s an all in one: remove makeup, use little product, get an AMAZING cleanse!!

The previous formula was incredible. I used it for over a year and a half with no issues. I’m fairly certain that the newer formula has caused me to break out because I have pimples in areas of my face that never break out. These bumps formed after about a week of having used this version of the formula. This is the only component of my skincare regimen that changed—I’m super dedicated to caring for my skin. I’m really disappointed. The fragrance is ridiculously strong, too.

on the plus, this cleanser made my skin so so so ridiculously soft and smooth and really helped my skin from breaking out and did an amazing job of removing all my makeup. Although when I first started using this my skin got dry and sore because I was using it with too a light moisturizer so I now alternate with a heavier one at night and that issue quickly went away. As I continued to use this I noticed that I was starting to get more bumps and blackheads than usual so that is definitely not a plus although they have diminished a little they are still consistently coming back so once I am through with the bottle I will be switching; but just as a heads up my acne problems always seem to adapt to the cleanser, it starts off promising but after a while my skin adjusts and the issues return, if this isn’t something you struggle with than this cleanser may be perfect for you.

I really loved the old formula. It was pH balanced and was able to cleanse my combination, sensitive, acne and rosacea prone skin without stripping it dry or making my skin break out. However, this new formulation is terrible. It’s much harsher than before and dried my skin out while aggravating my rosacea and leaving my forehead with bright red patches and breakouts. I’m terribly disappointed and don’t understand why they felt the need to change a perfectly wonderful formula. I suspect if you have very oily skin that is not sensitive at all this might work for you but if you’re anyone else I would stay clear.

This works as a fantastic daily cleanser and pairs great with my Foreo Luna! It doesn’t dry my skin out and also does a great job of removing oil and impurities. I wish they’d bring the tube packaging back for a travel size, but the new packaging looks better for daily use. My only drawback is I usually need to double cleanse when removing mascara.
review_title: Daily Cleanser Works Well with Luna

review_text: I just received this product, and was so excited to try it that I washed my face immediately upon receiving it. After one use, I’m ready to say it’s the best cleanser I’ve ever used. It gives my face that really clean feeling that I’m always looking for, without the drying and tightness that usually accompanies that. It’s gentle, without harsh physical exfoliants, but the chemical exfoliants (AHAs) work really well -- I don’t know how else to describe it, but my face just felt CLEAN after using this! And the hyaluronic acid provides great hydration, so my skin really doesn’t feel dry and tight after cleansing. Even before applying my serums and moisturizer, my face immediately felt soft, smooth, and hydrated after using this cleanser. Love it!

Honestly really disappointed. I have sensitive combination skin (oily nose and dry every where else) and this product claimed to be gentle and hydrating but it left me feeling too ‘squeaky’ and with dry patches galore. Really don’t think this is a gentle cleanser what so ever, it was far too harsh and did not make me ‘glow’ or feel hydrated in the slightest.

This product came highly recommended from an associate at my local Sephora. I initially tried a sample and was very pleased! A little goes a long way with great foaming action and a deep clean. I use foam cleansers as my 2nd step (I use an oil based cleanser first) and found this product did an excellent job of removing remaining debris from my skin without drying. It has a thicker, gel consistency which really allowed me to work up a good lather. It has a light scent that is not overpowering. The simplistic packaging was an added bonus and I feel this will last me awhile.

I had normally used Fresh Soy Cleanser for my face but found that it wasn’t totally removing my makeup.  I wanted to try something new, and I had read good reviews about this cleanser so I thought I’d give a go.  I normally have combo skin, but found this product was drying out my skin.  At the same time, I found that it was beginning to dry out my eyelids.  I really wanted to like this product, the smell was great and I liked the way the product went on my skin but I just wasn’t impressed with how dry and tight my skin felt right after.

I literally used this cleanser ONCE and immediately fell in love. The scent is heavenly- very subtle. You can see fine bits of blueberry in it too! The best part is that your skin is left NOTICEABLY SOFTER after you wash and dry it. No joke. Felt so soft and smooth that I was in shock, and immediately put it away to save for when my face really needs extra love. This cleanser acts like a super luxe prduct at a very decent price. DO NOT UNDERESTIMATE the importance of a GENTLE CLEANSER!!
My skin texture improved after the first use! It doesn’t dry my skin out.

I got my hands on a mini version of this product and I absolutely loved it. I went and purchased the regular size and it’s nothing like the sample I got. The sample version is everything they claiming the product to be - gentle, bouncy, cleansing without stripping. The new one I just got from Sephora is drying and harsh and feels like dish detergent. It even has a different scent. After reading some of the reviews here I learned that the Glow Recipe did change the formula of this product and it’s possible that the sample I had was actually the old formula. Too bad. I was very excited to buy a regular size cleanser.

I’ve always had pretty clear skin but I’ve always suffered with little tiny bumps on my forehead that were mixed with texture and would NEVER go away. This cleanser cleared the texture COMPLETELY! I am absolute awe of this cleanser and will definitely repurchase, I’m scared to finish the first bottle LOL it’s my baby!!
This works just like any other soap I honestly thought this was going to be amazing for my combo skin but it is a little drying  it it cleans very well just don’t think I’ll be buying it again
I’ve been using this cleanser for the past few weeks. It works great, doesn’t leave my skin feeling super dry and has cleared up my acne.

I got this at least a month ago. The first few weeks my skin was adjusting to it and felt tight.  After a month my skin is beautiful, much improved, hydrated, soft and smooth.  I now realize how much I needed this kind of cleanser. My other products work better because my skin no longer has a dead layer.  I’ve just ordered the Glow Recipe Avocado night mask and can’t wait to use it, as well.

I have really dry, sensitive, acne prone skin, especially in the winter time. I’ve been to a dermatologist and have tried every cleanser under the sun. I’ve been using this product for about a month now, morning and night, and in the past two weeks, I’ve gotten three compliments on my skin - one of my roommates literally said my skin was glowing. I’m so excited that I’ve finally found a product that works! It’s definitely pricy, but worth it.

I bought this because when I get facials with lactic acid, it always does wonders for my skin (for that week) so I figured if I use this cleanser daily, I will get those results continuously & omg I was right!! It does leave me a little dry if I leave it on too long or wash my face twice, but my skin has never looked better! No more little bumps, my scars are fading & I feel confident to walk out without putting on foundation!
The smell is. So. good! It definitely feels like it cleans my face, however - and this is probably because of the fact that it’s winter

I have had a lifelong struggle with acne and textured skin and this cleanser has been a LIFE SAVER. I notice a difference almost immediately after washing in the overall health of my skin. It cleans impurities without leaving my face tight, and leaves an overall brighter appearance. It smells great and does not irritate. So happy I tried this on a whim after using the Fresh Soy cleanser, which would constantly leave my face with small bumps. Highly recommend.
The name says gentle but I found it stung when I used it. Made my skin irritated. I ended up throwing it out half way through the bottle.
Great cleanser, the scent is great as well.

This is an amazing cleanser! The pump is so convenient and easy to use in the shower. when you pump it out you get the perfect mount of cleanser, no more no less. The texture of the cleanser is gorgeous! It is a jelly texture that feels great on the skin. When you rub it in it creates a great lather without stripping the skin. The smell is also great. It is sweet and berry like, so it reminds me of candy. If you don’t like sweet scents don’t worry because the smell is not strong at all and very light and refreshing. Overall I would highly recommend this cleanser. Ps. The packaging is adorable!

I really like both the watermelon sleep mask and the moisturizer so I had high hopes for this cleanser. this smells nice and clean but not really a blueberry scent. I feel like this cleanser isn’t anything special and is a little drying. It’s okay at removing makeup but it doesn’t leave my face feeling clean so I usually have to cleanse a second time after makeup removal. I have other cleansers I feel do better job and don’t dry my face out. Overall it’s not a bad face wash, but it’s not my favorite, especially for the price.
Extremely drying. I have oily skin. It smells lovely and I finished the entire bottle but will not repurchase. It causes dry patches and flaking that face cream cannot repair.
Really wanted to like this...but it dried out my skin AND broke me out.
Dryed me out smelled and felt like a cheap glycerin cleaner overall terrible

This product was recommended to me buy a friend so I decided to add it to my rotation of cleansers. Probably my favorite thing about this is that I can use it to clean my face AND take off my makeup. Normally, I do a dual cleansing routine to take off makeup and clean pores in separate steps, but when I’m feeling lazy I use this to do both (with minimal mascara residue).It was a wonderful, not too overpowering scent, and it really feels like it cleanses your skin. No residue is a bonus!

This did nothing as it claimed.  I didn’t feel like my skin was getting cleansed properly nor it is pore refining.  For the price, it way too below average.  Drug store cleansers do a better job.  I had to return it.Philosophy Purity cleanser does a much better job at cleansing pores and is suitable to my combination skin acne prone skin.
Smells like dish washing soap. Very drying as well. Do not recommend unless you have incredibly oily skin. It also is super irritating to the eyes if you get it near them.
I use it as second step to my double cleansing and also just this in the morning. It deep cleanses but it’s also very very gentle because it’s a jelly formula. I love it, works with my oily/dry skin
It stripped all the oils off my face and left it dry and really tight. The price point is also really high.

Perfect for morning AND nightAfter removing my makeup this fun cleanser gets all that I’ve missed! I can feel it cleaning deep into my pores bs rinses residue free and not drying at all! I love the bottle, one pump is enough and sent free! Will definitely buy again

THE OLD FORMULA WAS SO AMAZING!!! It was the only cleanser ever that i was 100% sure didn’t break me out in any way because i’m sensitive to almost everything that’s in face wash, but they completely changed the formula and added fragrance which terrible on my sensitive skin. SO upset about the change!
review_title: The old formula was so good :(

review_text: This cleanser has the cutest packaging and it’s smells really good but I’m not sure if it’s doing anything for my skin. It’s supposed to be hydrating because of the hyaluronic acid but I find that it’s drying sometimes. I’ll finish it up to see if it makes a difference in my skin.
review_title: Not sure if it's doing anything yet

review_text: I bought this all excited after reading all the reviews. After a month of using this I stopped. It stripped my skin after washing and broke me out. I really wanted to like it but couldn’t. I would not recommend for anyone who has dry skin or any skin type for a matter of fact, since like I’ve said it strips your skin. The only thing I like about it was the blueberry smell.

I love this! I use it every day! I have normal to dry skin and it doesn’t dry me out at all! It works amazing it takes away makeup almost instantly! its thick and a little goes a long way, two pumps does my entire face even when I have a full face of makeup on. Highly recommend to anyone!

I have combo sensitive skin and large pores which means more breakouts for me especially on my cheeks where I get most of my huge breakouts (my skin breaks out to hyaluronic acid) :( so I have to be careful with what I use on my face including skincare and makeup (aka dimethicone/silicone). I use this product work a microfiber cloth and it removes ALL of my makeup from my face which means less breakouts in the long run ! it has my face looking better than usual which means makeup free weekends :-)currently on my 2nd bottle, also bottle design is really nice

This is an awesome cleanser. No left over makeup after washing with this which is what I’ve dealt with from other cleansers, is have to wash my face twice to get everything off. Also this does what it says and is very moisturizing so your skin doesn’t feel stripped or anything. Love love love this cleanser. review_title: Amazing for oily to combo skin!

I actually applied it to my face dry like an oil/balm cleanser because the tube didn’t say to wet and lather hands like this page does, it just said apply to face then lather with water. Applying it dry like a 1st cleanser and then lathering with water worked fine though. I was really impressed when I finished rinsing and there was not a trace of eye-make up or mascara left. Seriously. It smelled pleasant, lightly fruity, and normally I can’t handle a lot of perfumes or scents in my face products. Its a clear, thick gel, and worked really well. My face didn’t feel stripped of its moisture barrier (aka the dreaded “squeaky clean”) I would definitely continue using this product on days I need to fall into bed without doing my double cleansing routine AND bring it on trips so I can carry less products.
review_title: impressive cleanser really removed ALL make up!

review_text: I’m super meh about this cleanser...definitely regret buying a full-sized bottle (the Sephora I was at didn’t have a trial size, and I was tragically impatient, then indecisive too long to return it). Deep cleanse yes, but it’s definitely not as ’hydrating as a toner’ - it strips my skin and makes it feel dry and tight. It does feel relatively gentle, and it does get most of my makeup off. I do like that I can use it without wetting my face (you can lather it in wet hands and then apply the lather to your face). I don’t really feel like it does anything special for my skin. So it’s not a bad cleanser, just not an awesome cleanser either.

Even on a heavy makeup day, I looked at my face up close in the mirror after using this and didn’t see a trace. But the blueberry extract is sadly overpowered by “seaweed extract“ (third ingredient) along with a list of other berries. At the end of a long day, I had a headache and the heady fruitiness of this cleanser wasn’t comforting as its “gentle“ name suggests. The other question mark is its hyaluoronic acid content as my skin felt dry after using this.
review_title: Cute Name and Concept, But Doesn't Impress

review_text: I have sensitive skin because I took Cortisone heavily and it left my skin a mess....  So I tried everything to get rid of blemishes and acne, and this is the lightest most efficient cleanser. The smell is not overwhelming, and it cleans suprisingly well!   Perfect for people ith sensitive skin who react to others such as Clinique, Vichy etc.
