Great product. Smells is light fresh and natural. Foams slightly and isn’t drying. Leaves face feeling fresh. Due to AHA it can be left on a dry face as a more protest mask!

good at taking off makeup, and my skin feels super clean after use. however, after using this regularly for about a week, my skin became dry and flaky, even after using their Watermelon moisturizer. I had to use a heavy-duty moisturizer to help, and my skin is still dry even after I stopped using it. It broke me out a little when I was using it. I don’t consider my skin to be sensitive, but I think this cleanser is too harsh on my skin.

I just love this product! I have dry skin and i was looking for a cleanser that would not dry my skin. I use it once every two days and my skin looks better than ever! My skin feels clean and fresh without feeling dry and has a nice glow. Would definetly recommand. Plus it smells AMAZING

I got the mini at checkout as anything with berries tempts me. I have combination skin, used to be dry, and it works. I mean, it’s a cleanser after all. I do feel that it’s gentle on my skin and doesn’t dry me out. It smells nice, does its job, has a really nice jelly texture. Some days it’s enough to get my mascara and eyeliner off and doesn’t sting. I think I’d buy it again.
review_title: I might like jelly cleansers because of this.

review_text: Love the scent! This actually takes off all my makeup without over drying my face.

I absolutely love this product, I have very oily skin and the cleansers I have been using just make it worse but my skin feels clean and refreshed after just one use !! Definitely should have gotten the bigger one !!
Fav cleanser ever my acne has almost 100 percent gone away. I use this every morning and it lasts a long time too.

I cleanse twice with this product to remove make-up and then to cleanse my face. I enjoy the scent, feel, and product overall. A lot goes a long way! Highly recommend for dry skin / adult acne-prone skin.
review_title: Great for dry and acne-prone skin!

review_text: I’ve been using this product since October 2018 and I will definitely continue using it, I’m on my second bottle. love how gentle it is, leaves my skin hydrated and I think it also has helped with my acne, it doesn’t dry out my skin or irritates it.
Love the consistency, its gel but lather very well. A good cleanser to get glass skin.The scent is not overpowering but doesnt smell natural either.. i dont understand why brand still use fragrance..
I love this stuff. I use it as part of my morning skin routine and it leaves my skin hydrated and smooth. It helps create an excellent start to my day.
review_title: The best face wash for my super sensitive red skin

review_text: First, some history. This is really the first cleanser I got from Sephora as I usually prefer this smaller indie brand thats not available there. I bought it because I was in a pinch, was already there, and had time to kill. So admittedly, I went in skeptical. The texture is interesting as I’d never used a jelly type cleanser before. I prefer it to creamy/milky cleansers, though. It lathers nicely and the scent isn’t overpowering. Fragrance is the last ingredient which is appreciated, but it would be great if it was eliminated completely. One thing that was an immediate turn off was the packaging. Even when my friend saw it on my shelf she said it looked like I got it at the dollar store-yikes. The packaging does look cheap compared to others I own. Also, I prefer glass for sustainability reasons. This is in plastic. For the effect on my skin, when cleansing I liked it and immediately after, my skin felt a bit stripped but I do tend to err on the dry side of normal. Granted, my skin felt clean and soft, possibly even more evened our texture.  Even after moisturizing and using my night cream, I noticed that my skin felt tight the next morning. There were even some dry patches and flaking. I’ll be giving it a few more days in case my skin was just acting up (as it does sometimes in the winter) but I have a feeling I’ll be returning to my favorite. I think this is better suited for people with less sensitive, more normal/oily skin types.

Love this cleanser! I got a free sample and decided to buy the full size! The AHAs and antioxidants truly brighten my skin just after one use (I have some hyperpigmentation and acne scars so this helps). I have combo/dry skin now that winter is on it’s way and I don’t find it too drying. You also only need a small amount to get a good lather while cleansing. Only giving it four stars because it doesn’t do an excellent job at removing my eye makeup, but it’s not a big deal if I double cleanse with an oil base product before hand to get my face squeaky clean and bright!
review_title: Cleans well and brightens even better!

review_text: Nothing special. Smells nice. Lathers well. But pretty drying. Not good for regular or dry skin.
I love this! I’ve been getting the mini one. This does not leave a squeaky streak feel after it washes off and it gets all my makeup off with a small amount of product. LUHHHHHHHH THIS

My holy grail cleanser. The only cleanser I’ll ever need for the rest of my life. It foams well, so I expect this bottle to last me a very long time. Perhaps a year.This has replaced my need for:- Peeling gels/chemical exfoliants. Bye bye REN Glow Tonic (my former holy grail)!- Anti-acne treatments (salicylic acid actually makes my blackheads WORSE!)- Popping blackheads daily because this actually cleans my pores. All of the other cleansers that say they’ll clean your pores are liars. This is the only one telling the truth!- Antioxidant “glow/radiance“ serums- Most makeup remover. I still use eye makeup remover for my eyeliner/mascara, but a pump of this massaged for a minute removes the rest of my face. I follow up with another cleanse or two after that, just to be sure.[The pump of the full-size turns sideways to lock closed for travel. The mini doesn’t, but that comes with a lid.]

Nice clean looking bottle with good pump. The gel does seem to lather better than soyface cleanser and provides a more cleaner feel. However, I have dry and eczema skin. After I come out of the shower, my face immediately starts to dry and give that tugged feeling, which I hate, prompting me to add moisturizer ASAP. I probably would not recommend to people with extra dry skin.

This cleanser is very basic. Nothing fancy. Nothing great. It’s gimmicky and hyped because of the brand. It doesn’t stink but it doesn’t smell like blueberries. It cleans your face ok I guess but I won’t repurchase.
This cleanser has done wonders for my combination skin! It leaves my face feeling hydrated, but not overly oily. It has also helped soothe some hyper-pigmentation.

This is the only cleanser I’ve found that works to clear out my huge, easily clogged pores. It’s the difference between weekly painful extractions and clear, clean skin. It stings like crazy if you get it in your eyes and can be a bit drying so make sure to to use a good moisturizer.
I love this cleanser so much! It has a great gel texture and feels good on the skin.  Its also great on sensitive or combination skin like mine

I had really high hopes for this cleanser as I do enjoy the brand and the reviews were good, but it fell short. I have combination skin and still feel like this product stripped it! It smells like blueberry vodka - alcoholic stench. I don’t believe it caused me to breakout but it didn’t prevent further breakouts or improve my skin in anyway. Failed to remove basic mascara or create a froth, I never felt fully clean after using it. My sister also bought the cleanser and feels the same way (we both gave the product two months to properly form an opinion) sadly would pass on this purchase!

I love this cleanser! I got it as a gift for Christmas. It smells so good just like real blueberries. It foams really easily without water. One pump is definitely enough for my face. My skin always feels refreshed and clean after. Would definitely recommend.

Thought I was going to love this product and I don’t. I think the bottle and color are very cute, but I don’t think it did a great job washing my face, didn’t remove make up that well. Just over all not satisfying, especially for the price! Won’t repurchase.

This stuff is incredible. The smell is so fresh and delicious, the packaging is amazing, and you only need a tiny tiny dot to wash your whole face. This lasted around 6 months of 1-2x per day use, way longer than I would have ever guessed. I wouldn’t rebuy it myself, but will be asking for it for Christmas!

This face wash is very effective at removing makeup and oil, but for my combo skin it boarders on being top stripping (next time would only use it in summer when my skin gets a bit oilier). The scent I find way too sweet and overwhelming, which is why I most likely won’t buy again.

Haven’t used this as a cleanser yet but love this as a mask. Put a thick layer on and leave for 10 mins. It makes skin glow! The AHAs leave skin looking fresh. I got it in a holiday set and the price was fantastic.

This product smells really great. Other than that, I don’t really see it doing anything amazing for my complexion. It leaves a film, which is possibly the “glow“ part?, but I don’t like the way it feels. I’m glad I bought the small size as it would be a waste of money otherwise.

Gentle yet effective cleanser. I suffer from hormonal acne and these breakouts are really inflamed red cysts that need  a gentle cleanser and this does the job. I use it at night when I do my double cleanse (I use the drunk elephant slaii cleansing balm) and it leaves my skin clean but supple and hydrated. My skin is always glowing after I use it and the glycolic acid and lactic acid help to gently exfoliate the dead skin cells off the surface of skin. I sometimes use it in the morning as well but that depends on my skin. Definitely a must try if you’re on the market for a good cleanser.

I actually use this in the morning, because I feel like it’s a gentle enough cleanse and helps wake up my skin a little bit. Has a nice cooling effect, and doesn’t lather too much. I did notice at first that it left my skin feeling dry/tight, but my skin got used to it after a bit - also could have been the colder weather or needing a different moisturizer. Also find it really hard to rinse off sometimes/like it leaves residue if I’m not careful? But really like the texture and the cooking effect, and it’s formulated really nicely. With the right toner and moisturizer, my skin feels hydrated and smooth in the mornings after using this.

I got the travel size as part of the let it glow gift set. I’ve been using it for a while now and I’ve noticed a decrease in oil production; as well as, a significant decrease in breakouts. An added bonus? It smells just as dreamy as it sounds.

Love this product! I use it everyday on my dry, sensitive skin and have had no issues (rare for me). It definitely makes my skin bouncier and glowy. I will say that those with extra sensitive skin (Like mine) may find that their skin feels a little tight after cleansing. I always follow up with moisturizer to ensure that my skin is hydrated.
Amazing product! Not only is it all natural, but it feels amazing on your face. My acne prone and sensitive skin has never felt more protected and hydrated! Highly recommended! Beautiful product.
I bought this hoping it would truly be gentle, but it’s too harsh for my sensitive skin. It completely dries out my skin and makes me look all wrinkly

Been loving this stuff! I’ve been using this cleanser for a while now and I can actually tell the difference in my skin tone and texture, due to the aha’s and bha’s. Love the texture and light foam and barely there fragrance, great for sensitive skin. The literal only downside for me about this is that it is on the drying side and I can verve toward oily, so I might not recommend to dry skin users. The reason I gave 5 stars instead of 4 for the drying is because the dryness can be combated with a good moisturizer, everything else is amazing!
It doesn’t do anything for the skin. It’s just a plain cleanser. It is really good at removing make up and that’s it.

I’ve used this cleanser for over a year. I shower in the evening using another cleanser, using this cleanser in the AM. I have no clue if it removes makeup or not. I always felt it was a little drying, however this winter, which has been incredibly mild, my face after cleansing is very tight and dry. I’ve always had an issue with my toner (also bought from and when Glow Recipe had curated products) foamed up on me. I thought it was the toner. Twice I cleansed in the AM using a different cleanser, and the toner doesn’t foam up. I did an experiment, for a week I used the product in my shower to cleanse. At no point in the week did my toner ever foam up. In my opinion, the Blueberry Bounce cleanser is not completely rinsing off my face. I’m a 61 yr old woman who has been cleansing her face for a long time, I know how to completely rinse, I know how much product to use. I wont repurchase this. If your products are foaming, look to this cleanser. The foaming agent is too much.

This leaves my skin feeling so soft afterwards! I love it. I’m leaving 4 stars because I guess I was sort of hoping it had more of a blueberry smell. Their watermelon and banana moisturizers both smell like the fruits a lot more than this cleanser does. But, I still love it for how it works and the price.
Not my favorite cleanser . Didn’t get all my makeup off . wasn’t that hydrating either . Does smell amazing but that’s really it .

i got a sample size of this product in another kit i purchased from sephora. i was hesitant to try a new face wash because my drug store Neutrogena one always seemed totally fine and the other small samples that i would get just didnt seem to be any different and yet they were 5x the price... that was until i used this one. for starters, the packaging is amazing and i love that it also comes in a travel size that you can REFILL. the scent is not over powering and smells like real blueberries. the formula foams up with thick small bubbles that seem to get into all the nooks and crannies of my face. my face feels hydrated after using it and it helped relived irritation from my face that is cause by the cold winter wind in my city. this comes with a steep price tag that i think is a bit obscene, but it does work very very well so I will buy the full size and change up my face wash for the first time in YEARS.
review_title: great smell, leaves skin hydrated, worth the money

review_text: This cleanser is amazing! I love the smell and after a month of using it I still get really excited to wash my face. It doesn’t take a lot of it to wash your face and feels very nice to wash with. I think the smell makes me very happy in general, and will literally help me if I’m not in a good mood. After washing, I definitely feel a difference on my face. It does not dry out my face and instead it leaves it feeling fresh and healthy. I haven’t run into any problems even when washing my face with this twice a day and I’ve never felt like it doesn’t clean my face well enough. Another amazing thing about this is that I haven’t had a single pimple since I’ve started using it. Before this I would get one or two pimples on my face each week and I haven’t had a single one after a few days of using this. I don’t really see myself using another cleanser in the near future and consider this cleanser my all time favorite.

I’ve had this for a while now (almost used the whole bottle) and I feel like it’s not great for dry skin which I have. I switched to a different cleanser and my skin has been feeling much better. I now use this to clear my makeup sponges, I would give it to my sister with oily skin but it’s almost empty. I do love other products from this brand, but for my skin right now (winter) it’s a pass.
The most underwhelming face wash I’ve ever tried. An absolute waste of money.

ok so i have a love hate relationship with this cleanser.In the past month i have been dealing with small skin colored bumps and whiteheads on my forehead and ever since i have started using this cleanser my skin has improved drastically which i love.What i hate about it, it tends to slightly burn around my nose and chin which turns red but the burning and redness don’t last long.Also you have to use quite a lot of product cause it disappears while cleansing.And i want to discontinue it

I love the smell! Great cleanser. It’s very gentle and you feel so clean and fresh after using it. I love this cleanser so much! It’s somewhat slippery, so make sure it doesn’t fall out of your fingers when using it.

I have been using this Cleanser and ONLY this Cleanser for a month. My main concerns are, uneven skin tone, and acne. I am in NorCal, even though I try my best to stay out of the sun by the end of summer my skin is very blotchy; along with mild acne breakouts and the scars that come with them.I bought this thinking what more harm can it do, I was wrong. I am happy to say it has evened out my skin tone, and I can see that my acne scars are fading. I will be buying this again to see what the long term effects areMy only concern is that it leaves my skin a little dry but not ashy. I really like it and I am interested in trying out more Glow Recipe products ( *when I have the money* :3c)
review_title: I bought this on a whim, but happy I did

However, I wouldn’t call it a light cleanser: I would probably use this maybe every other day because it’s EXTREMELY cleansing. Overall, I’ll continue use.**Other reviews mention how this cleanser is very drying: every cleanser is drying, you’re meant to put moisturizer on after using this product.

I think this product is really underrated. It does exactly what it claims to do. I use this as a precleanser before my acne cleanser. It cleans off all my makeup but is also so gentle to use carefully on eye makeup. I really like this product and will be repurchasing.

It got ALL of my makeup off even mascara and it didn’t burn my eyeballs off lol just a very very slight sting. But extremely tolerable I promise. I did use a toner afterward but it was barely anything on the cotton ball. It’s extremely drying but I just make sure I moisturize thoroughly and I’m going to make sure I don’t use this cleanser too often. I’ve only used it once like 25 minutes ago so idk if it’s going to give me bumps. I hope not.

Amazing cleanser! Deep cleansed a lot of oils but kept just enough to have my faces hydrated! The cleanser gently cleanse my face without the stripping feeling The packaging of this cleanser is amazing! The best about this cleanser is the smell! Smells sweet like real natural blueberries!
Completely stripped my skin and I now have dry patches on the sides of my face and nose.

I really like this cleanser. Clean beauty has become almost necessary for my skin and this cleanser was highly rated so I thought I’d try it out. My skin definitely glows after using this cleanser. I recently went on vacation and didn’t bring it with me and when I came back and started using if again, you could TELL there was a difference. I’m not sure if it’s this cleanser or a combination of products I’ve been using but my skin has never been softer. I’m giving it 4/5 stars because I wish it didn’t make my skin feel as “squeaky“ coming off. Overall I really enjoy this cleanser though, smells great, great packaging, clean beauty and makes my skin glow. Haven’t had any problems with it so far.
This felt like a really cheap cleanser to me. I have oily acne prone skin and my skin just didnt feel all that clean after using this product.

I have only used this product a handful of times but so far, so good! Seems to be a relatively basic cleanser. No harsh smell, takes my makeup off at the end of the day, and refreshes my skin. Another thing I want to mention is I only use one pump and it seems to do the trick! I’ll definitely be purchasing again!
This cleanser completely dries out my face. I’ve had my fair share of products slightly drying my face but this one just strips my face so much it’s unreal.

I have bad skin, I’m constantly breaking out and I hate it. Acne products don’t work for my skin they usually make it a lot worse. So I decided to go for this simple and gently cleanser and my skin has actually cleared up an insane amount. This face wash has definitely helped boost my confidence.

Glad I only purchased the trial size. This stuff is horrible. I have oily non sensitive skin. This stripped my skin and turned it red and flaky. You could maybe use it once a week but I would not recommend more than that. Super disappointed

I have never had that much of a problem with acne. I sometimes get it on my chin but that’s about it (NEVER on my forehead). I tried this cleanser (which I got in an Ipsy) and it broke out my forehead in cystic acne.
review_title: Broke me out in cystic acne!

review_text: I love the smell of this cleanser and how clean my skin feels after. This IS a stripping formula, so definitely not something I cleanse with daily but love to use when I need to get a full beat of makeup off from the day. Generally once I use this cleanser and tone after there is little to no leftover makeup or residue on my cotton pad.
good for summer, but a bit drying for Canadian winter. I will stop using for now and keep it for those oily sweaty days on my skin.

I’ll start by saying I was SO EXCITED to try this cleanser because I’ve become a fan of Glow Recipe & love the idea of an antioxidant-rich cleanser, but unfortunately I did not enjoy this product. I continued to use this for about a month & a half, to give it a fair chance, & we just did not jive. It felt like it wasn’t thoroughly cleansing my skin, therefore effecting my following skincare steps. I also felt like it left a residue on my skin even after rinsing it & ensuring all the product was off with a microfiber towel. I’m not sure exactly what the problem was, but it just was not my favorite, unfortunately.

This product left my skin feeling dry.  Exact opposite of what I want in a cleanser.  Smells like glycerine-the kind you would expect if you were to buy an unscented product In a discount store-no blueberry scent at all.  Suds up way too much making it difficult to wash off
review_title: Skip this dime store quality product

review_text: I recieved this in one of my Ipsy bags and omg, I am so in love. It does it’s job, works hard on your skin but leaves it so clean and moisturized plus it smells amazing - I take an extra 30 seconds to enjoy the smell! After reading some of the reviews, I’m super surprised that there were a lot of bad reviews which is making me second guess myself. I think I will buy the mini cleanser instead of the full one for now.

This stuff is great! My face is super combination and annoying. It doesn’t dry my face out but I also use it combination with the Glow Recipe pineapple serum and the Glow Recipe watermelon pink juice moisturizer.  This product definitely works better with their other products.

There is a plethora of awesome ingredients that promote anti-aging, brightening, acne-fighting, and wound healing. It’s got an enjoyable blueberry scent and turns very foamy, which makes the process of washing one’s face a very fun one. While fragrance should usually be a avoided in skincare, it’s not much of an issue with wash-off products. The only thing that is a minor issue is that this gets so bubbly that I end up getting foam in my nose and I have to be careful to not completely inhale it — slightly annoying. Other than that I can see myself buying the full-sized bottle.
I’m not a blueberry fan at all but this smells great! It’s very gentle and bubbly!
Il serait important d’écrire que ce produit est cruelty-free aussi. :)

This is now my go to cleanser for my morning routine. I discovered this gem during the holidays when my daughter gave me a kit from GLow Recipe that included this cleanser along with the watermelon glow sleeping mask and the watermelon glow pink juice moisturizer. I have dry, aging skin but on occasion have a breakout here and there. When I saw this gel cleanser I really thought for sure it was going to strip my skin and cause dryness. I tried it and was pleasantly surprised. It wasn’t drying at all. Actually it’s very hydrating and gentle. Plus, I love the added natural AHA to help with dullness. I will definitely purchase this product in the full size once the one I received in my kit runs out.
Love Glow Recipe! Love this product, it gets the job done but I find there are better products around the same price range.

Love this cleanser! Takes off a full face of makeup with only a pump or two. Smells great, and leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. It also doesn’t have any exfoliating beads in it which makes for a nice, smooth texture. The box also says it can be used as a wash off face mask if you spread a layer of it over the face and leave on for 5 minutes. I use this twice a day, morning and evening, and it has definitely been great for my skin. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

BEST CLEANSER IVE EVER USED!!! I started using this back in February 2019 and it changed my life’s. I have very acne prone skin and after using this my skin has been clear. I’ve Also gotten my friends to try it out and it has also changed their lives. Absolutely would recommend.
Obsessed of this product!! Cleaned all my pores and help them to shrink. I had a very acne skin type but now my face is super healed and clean
Not a huge fan of this. I don’t find it does much to my skin and the texture is quite thick for a cleanser.

I bought this cleanser along with another one, and figured between the two I’d like one of them. It sure wasn’t this one! Just lathering my hands up with this before I even reached my face it made the skin on my hands dry and tight, and it did the same to my face....terrible. The other cleanser I got I adore, it’s the pure skin face cleanser by first aid beauty.
loved this so much i’m thinking of buying a full size one!! it’s super soothing and isn’t harsh or drying at all and it also smells amazing, definitely recommend:)

I absolutely love this product! My new favorite cleanser! Great for sensitive skin! It always makes my skin feel and look so much cleaner! I can definitely tell a difference in my skin since using it as well!

I purchased the small bottle and after going through it without any complaints, I decided to purchase the larger bottle. After a couple washes I began forming red dots all over my cheek area. I have pretty normal skin, very rare breakouts, etc.. you have been warned!
Not a fan was very irritating on my eyes and didn’t do much.

I love this cleanser! I use it mostly as a second makeup remover. I use a makeup removing wipe before I get in the shower, use this in the shower to remove any excess dirt and grime that the wipe missed, then follow with my normal cleanser. It’s super gentle and doesn’t hurt my eyes either. Plus, it smells super fresh and clean! This is a staple in my skin care routine now!

I’m not sure what possessed me to buy this one day but my life if changed forever because of it. I have very dry skin that flakes and is often tight after using most cleansers. Enter this miracle product. I just need one pump for my entire face and it smells so good. For the first time ever my skin doesn’t feel stretched or tight after washing. I got this about 8 months ago and it’s only a little more than half gone! I will definitely buy the full size when I run out.

Love the smell of this product. My skin did feel nice and soft afterwards but that’s about it. I don’t know if it had to do with the other two Glow Recipe product’s that I was using with it (watermelon moisturizer/mask) but I did get brake out’s.

This is an absolute staple in my routine. The smell is incredible and this product leaves my face feeling and looking so clean and smooth. I’ve tried many cleansers and this one is the only one that has been a repurchase for me. I WILL DEFINITELY continue to buy this product.

I received this as a sample from Ipsy and I’ve already decided that this needs to be a part of my routine. The gel is clear and it glides on your skin. I use it as a quick mask and exfoliate when washing it off and it leaves my skin looking so healthy and almost dewy. It does a great job removing makeup as well. A very clean feeling afterwards, with a nice hint of Blueberry. I seriously love this product and can’t wait to try more from this brand!

I’m always hesitant about trying new cleansers just because my skin can be really sensitive to them. They always seem to dry it out and cause redness. I’m happy to say this one doesn’t! It smells lovely, lathers nicely, and leaves my skin feeling smooth, clean, and moisturized. It doesn’t leave behind any sort of residue, either. Definitely picking up more of this once I run out!
review_title: Clean and fresh, smells nice, and non-drying!

review_text: Firstly, I have very dry skin and NEVER get pimples! I was so excited to try this since it’s “clean” skincare. After using it a few times I had 3 huge pimples on my face along with small red bumps. My skin is normally smooth but now very textured and bumpy. I threw it in the trash and will go back to the YTTP cleanser. This was a total fail for me.
This face was is a weird gel like consistency and very drying. Im glad I got the small size because i would not buy this again.
Best face wash I have ever used! It made my pores smaller and my skin is so soft. I have dry skin and it has made a huge difference in my skin. This replaced my Clinique that I have used for years.

I really love this cleanser. I love the smell, I love the consistency, and I love how my face feels after using it. The only thing I don’t love is that one full pump is too much product. I usually try to use a quarter or half a pump.
This product made my skin look and feel clean without stripping and causing me to break out!Bonus: Light smell that smells amazing

Really love this face wash! Very gentle on the skin and leaves your face feeling soft and clean. I was worried about the scent because I have very sensitive skin, but I’ve been using it for probably 6 months now and no issues! If you have sensitive skin, get the small version first to try it and see how your skin likes it. 10/10 would recommend!

I got this in my Ipsy bag and I’m in love! I used it because it was there but I was pleasantly surprised at how well it removed my makeup. It also left my skin feeling so clean and smooth compared to my usual cleanser. I’m here to buy a full sized bottle before my mini runs out.

This is just an eh cleanser for me. It smells good, sweet but clean and that’s probably the biggest pro for me. On its own, it cleanses just fine but after rinsing my dry skin feels tight and overly cleansed. I like it best when used after a cleansing balm because the pair together don’t leave my skin feeling tight. Definitely wouldn’t go out of my way to use it again.

I really like this cleanser! I double cleanse with a balm before using this. I like that it removes the residual makeup without over drying. I got a trial size from IPSY and will be buying the full size soon.

I received this in my Boxycharm box and blown away with how well it cleaned my skin and didn’t dry it out so I had to buy more.  It has such a light weight soft feeling and the scent isn’t over powering. I can definitely see a difference since using this
smells amazing, great at removing makeup, and a little goes a long way

I really like this cleanser. I have keratosis pilaris on my cheeks and neck and this cleanser really helps! It smooths out my face and neck and leaves it soft. My face feels kind of dry after but I follow up with moisturizer and my face feels great. Highly recommend for anyone who has uneven texture or keratosis pilaris.

Love this product! Smooth consistency and gets super foamy when washing your face. It literally clears up all my make up and leaves my skin smooth and clean. It could be used as an alternate instead of make up remover. I would recommend this product for anyone!

This is an okay cleanser for a second cleanse, as it’s a gel consistency. Unfortunately, the pump on mine came broken—I push the pump out to dispense the product and it stays down. I have to pull the pump back up to dispense more product. I didn’t return it because I can still get product out and it’s too much of a hassle to return it. The ingredients of this are fine, besides the fact that this has fragrance. It’s less important because it’s a wash off treatment, BUT for being a “natural/clean” skincare brand, it’s deceiving to list fragrance as just that term. What most people don’t know is that a company is only legally required to state “perfume” or “fragrance” in the ingredients? which could then encompasses hundreds of unknown chemicals, essential oils, etc. that could be irritating to the skin. Again, it’s wash off, but Glow Recipe would be better off disclosing their fragrance ingredients if they’re going to use it at all.The smell is okay.. a little artificial. The consistency is a thick gel which is slightly odd. You rub the product between your hands and it doesn’t really spread well. Overall, an okay cleanser. There are MUCH better options, especially for this price.
This stuff is the best! I have oily skin and break out, but this stuff helps and I don’t break out with it. I was using a proactive face wash, but it was too pricey. This stuff is perfect!

I love how it leaves my skin feeling clean without feeling like it stripped all the moister from my face. Great for removing makeup. AND IT SMELLS ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!! It’s not an overpowering smell and it just smells kind of like fresh blueberry infused air and I want to just smell it all day. Would highly recommend

Absolutely love the formula. It works up to a nice foam and leaves your skin feeling clean. My husband actually took it from my shelf, he says it doesn’t over dry his sensitive skin and is gentle. Will have to purchase another one.

This is a great second cleanse! It’s a nice gel formula that lightly foams and does not dry out the skin, unlike other gel cleansers I have tried. My skin feels super clean after use. I don’t think this necessarily does much for my skin aside from cleanse. I do like it though! This product has a faint blueberry scent that is very natural and light.
I have very sensitive & dry skin so most products cause a reaction, however, this product was very gentle and did a great job at cleansing! I alternate between this and the Tatcha cleansing oil.
review_title: gentle even for sensitive skin types

review_text: My skin is not sensitive at all yet this cleanser made my skin itchy and red around my nose and cheeks. It feels smooth when you wash your face but once I removed it, it left my skin feeling dry and very tight. I would not recommend.
so goopy not a fan doesn’t do much waste of money not worth it

My skin is super sensitive so I was looking for a gentle cleanser. This definitely does that but I feel like it wasn’t enough. It’s great and I’ll finish the bottle but I don’t think I will repurchase

I had a horrible experience with this product. I have always struggled with oily skin and this wash completely stripped my face of all moisture. The corners of my nose, around my mouth, and my chin have all broken out in extreme dryness. Now that I have had this reaction, looking back at reviews, numerous people have had similar experiences. Always look through all reviews before buying a product! I have definitely learned my lesson.

This cleanser is honestly THE best cleanser I’ve ever come across and I have replaced it over and over again. My skin has shown 0 signs of irritation, redness, or itchiness -- it has only been baby soft, smooth, calm, and clean every single time. I use it every single night and use it as a wash-off mask once a week. Can’t live without it!!

My absolute favourite cleanser!! I wasn’t too keen on the strong blueberry scent as I found it always got into my mouth. Regardless I still give this 5 stars. Gentle but gets everything off! Will be repurchasing.
I received this in a gift set. This did the job and washed my face and some of my make up....but it wasn’t great to purchase a full sized product.

I have very, very dry, sensitive, reactive skin and was looking to replace my previous cleanser that was a little too drying. This cleanser is THE BOMB. Doesn’t dry me out or cause any irritation. Still keeps my annoying adult acne in check and has actually really evened my skin out. It works great as a makeup remover and really gets everything off. I am sensitive to scents and prefer my skin care to be fragrance free but since this is a wash off product it doesn’t bother me. I actually like the scent as well and don’t find it too cloying. 10/10 recommend. You could always test out the smaller size if you’re nervous.

This cleanser does not, in fact, smell like blueberries. It smells a bit like an artificial berry perfume, which was only slightly disappointing for me. However, it comes with a twist and lock cap to prevent any leaks, and the cleanser itself looks like a thick clear jelly. For skincare, I used my chilled jade roller, then applied the cleanser to my freshly dampened skin. It foamed up a bit after just one pump, then I rinsed it and patted in my jeju jelly serum. I am currently on my third day of using this product, and I am purely shocked at how clean my face feels after this. It’s like all of my pores have purged the grime it’s collected throughout the day. It’s also helped reduce my oil-prone spots and tiny pimples. I HIGHLY recommend for anybody who is trying to achieve the coveted glass skin effect.

This cleanser is so gentle & leaves my skin feeling smooth & soft. It gets rid of my dead dry skin patches but doesn’t leave the skin stripped of moisture. The scent is amazing & I love that it has a pump to dispense product easily.

I’d like to review this product but I can’t get it out of the bottle. I opened the top hoping to just dump it in my hand to use but it is so thick I can’t get it out unless I get way too much. It’s going back. Life’s too short to fight your cleanser bottle. I seem to be the only one with this trouble. Bad batch maybe.

I bought the whole line of glow recipe products because they were clean and met all of my requirements in skincare. My skin is usually combo/oily. Can get dry at times, but not too much. This cleanser dried my face out SO bad. It’s extremely tight and not enough banana soufflé in the world could replenish what this took away. Not to mention I’m breaking out terribly. I normally get 1-2 pimples a month but I have like 15 in one day! I’m always told to wait it out with new products, which I did. But it never got better.
My favourite cleanser. Leaves my skin feeling so soft and my pores tightened and cleansed. I would buy it again and again. Also, the smell of the blueberry makes it my holy grail!
review_title: Best cleanser for squeaky clean skin!!!

review_text: J’ai adoré ce nettoyant! L’odeur est incroyable et le fait qu’on peut s’en servir comme masque le rend encore plus encore intéressant!

Love this cleanser! I ran out about 2 months ago and I haven’t had a chance to buy more but I can not stop thinking about it and how great it was! I got the mini and it lasted a really long time (around four months). I loved how it was great at taking off makeup and how it was also a great cleanser.

I have dry, sensitive skin so I have been looking for the right cleanser for my skin. I love the smell as well! I usually apply it in the morning, will buy the 5.4 oz!

The only cleanser that has ever truly worked for me. I do have sensitive skin and can tell this dries my skin. So I must use an actual moisturizer after and not just a serum. Otherwise, removes my red spots, tightens my skin, smoothes my pores, cleanses, and kept acne at bay. My only struggle is that the full size bottle collected brown stuff at the bottom. I know this stuff is made out of fruit. Is it mold? Did anybody else have this issue when storing this product? A Sephora employee told me they get that complaint often? Oddly, the travel sized version never did this.
review_title: the best, but didn’t store well...

review_text: The jelly texture is indeed lovely. However, the scent smells like hand sanitizer and after using this cleanser, my forehead was flaking. This has never happened to me since I have oily to combination skin. Then I gave it to my boyfriend (lol), but this cleanser again dried out his skin as well. So it ended up being our shower gel... Do not worth the price at all. But anyway, I really liked the painting inside the packaging.
review_title: I have oily skin and this DRIED ME OUT

review_text: I unexpectedly fell in love with this cleanser. Makes your face feel cleansed without feeling tight. The slight scent is really nice and non-irritating. The texture is great and not too hydrating for oil skin. Love this stuff. Will continue to repurchase.

I bought this product a year ago. When using this product every day, my skin is so amazing. I have acne prone skin and my face is oily. So it was nice to finally find a product that works great with my skin. Plus it smells amazing. I followed with the pineapple brightening serum and watermelon pink moisturizer. My skin never look better. I recently bought the watermelon toner, Avocado retinol eye cream, and the banana soufflé moisturizer. Will do a review on those to see if those made a difference in my skin.

Makes my skin soft, smooth, and tight after use. Only thing it’s missing is hydration. Very subtle scent which is good if your don’t like overwhelming scented face products. Good size for the price and you only need one pump per use.

I wanted to try Glow Recipe products, so I got the Glow Babies set. This product came with it. This claims to get makeup off, which it does, but I don’t think it’s better than any other cleanser. It’s kinda drying. I thought about getting the full size, but I know I’d be better off trying some other cleanser.

A lot of people are followers well let me lead you to the truth! This cleanser smells AMAZING and delicious and is a great way to start and end your day! It’s a jelly consistency and a little goes a LONG way! I love it and if you’re not sure about it the mini is decently priced so you won’t kill your podcasts testing it out. It’s the perfect compliment to my 2nd step cleansing.

I bought the mini size of this for $10 which I’m glad I did because I would not have liked the full size. This smells nice, has a light blueberry scent but that’s about all I like about this. I have to make sure that I first rub it with my palms together before washing my face otherwise I literally drop the cleanser. Would not repurchase or get the full size.
review_title: Very average - kind of annoying to work with

review_text: i love this cleaner so much! i have oily skin and this is perfect for me, after using, it leaves my skin so soft and this cleanser is so gentle. plus it smells really good and can also be used as a mask. also I used this on a full face of makeup and it took off most of my makeup! so awesome

I like this cleanser. It’s not irritating and easy to use. It can be a little drying for me so I think I prefer something creamier, but I definitely have enjoyed using it. I’ve had my bottle for about a year maybe, and I noticed at the bottom of the bottle it looks like there is sand or dirt? The bottle has never been opened itself I’ve just used the pump to disperse product. Just find it odd that there’s sand or whatever in this after a certain amount of time... luckily because the product has that bouncy gel effect I can avoid it but still super weird.

i’ve already purchased this a second time - this cleanser works for me and leaves my face feeling so soft afterward (i cleanse for at least 60 seconds). i also had a lot of blemishes and recurring acne that would pop-up - i saw improvement on that after a month of use and this product continues to keep those breakouts away. only thing to watch out for is the gel slipping off your hand after you dispense it...make sure to rub it between your fingers carefully before you start cleansing.
This cleanser is exactly how the name is. A gentle cleanser. That’s a good thing! No harsh ingredients, lots of antioxidants, and a faint blueberry smell! Kept my skin hydrated, and had a glow.
I LOVE the smell. The cleanser is gentle enough for my sensitive skin which is great because I really love the blueberry smell and would definitely repurchase it.

I received this as a sample. When I get stressed, my skin becomes very sensitive (redness, itchiness, flaky along hairline and around chin. I used when I had a very sensitive skin. This cleanser contains glycolic acid, but it did not burn me at all. Even when I used this as mask (I left it on my skin for 5 min.) it did not burn. The smell was a very faint, subtle berry scent. After use, this cleanser made my skin look moist. When I touched my face after cleaning, it felt almost sticky, but in a good way. I think because it has algae as one of the ingredients?It’s a good cleanser because:1. It was gentle on sensitive, raw skin. 2. It removed my makeup completely with only one wash (I wear sweat-proof, thick&heavy foundation)3. It has good skincare ingredients. I took one star off because there are facial cleansers I like more than this one: 1)Glamglow Supercleanser 2)Kiwi Botanicals Brightening Honey Melt Facial Cleanser 3) Dr. Bronner’s Magic Soap 4) Korres Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cream CleanserAnd more.
review_title: Removed heavy, sweat-proof makeup in one wash

review_text: I bought this cleanser hoping that it would be gentle for every day use, especially using it conjunction with other treatments. The labelling is confusing, because it says gentle yet also says deep cleansing.  I found that my skin is tight immediately after cleansing and there isn’t really any moisture in it.I think it should be reccommended to be used as the second step after an oil cleanser. I don’t think I’d buy it again.
review_title: Surprisingly Drying, better for double cleanse

review_text: I like that is a gel formula, I like that it’s not too scented. It smells faintly of blueberries. It’s easy on my sensitive skin. So far it’s one of my favorite face washes.

Received a trial size in an ipsy bag. Followed instructions and it does the job. My skin felt clean, product smells nice, feels gentle on skin. review_title: Good product but my skin hated it :(

I love it it leaves my face so soft clean the makeup melts away I have been using this product about a year

Skin feels amazing, especially when paired with the Watermelon Moisturizer. I usually stick to Korean brands for face wash, but this has become my new favourite!
Doesn’t cleanse well no matter how much product you use. Do not recommend.

It smells really good only thing is if you get this in your eye you’re gonna be in a world of hurt. I have so many facial cleansers and none of them burn like this. I was in the shower washing my face I had to jump out the shower that’s how painful it was. Idk why I jumped out the shower but my survival instincts kicked in. I couldn’t open my eye or it would feel like fire. then for the next 3 days my eye was sooooooo dry. Smells good tho and cleanses well

My very favorite cleanser. A little bit goes a long way and the subtle scent is so nice. I think it’s a great price point for how much you get. I have combination skin that is prone to a little redness and it works perfectly for me. I make sure to follow with toner and moisturizer so it doesn’t dry the skin out. I also lather it into my skin gently for at least a minute. Once i wash it off you can tell a huge difference in my pores/skin. Super clean/glowy.
Love the feel of this cleanser. Feels so refreshing on the skin, leaves skin feeling refreshed and clean. Smells so good.
The bottle is REALLY Small but the packaging is so cute! I really recommend trying this one before getting the full size :)
I love this first I bought the mini size it’s help for Acne pimples it is helping a lot love it

I love a lot of Glow Recipe products, which is why I tried this.  The texture and fragrance are really nice, but the product was really drying to my skin.  I have an oily t-zone, but I’m over 40 and therefore have fine lines and wrinkles.  This just felt like it stripped all the moisture from my face.  Not purchasing again for that reason.
review_title: Not for older skin- surprisingly drying

review_text: I have struggled with blackheads/clogged pores/sebaceous filaments for most of my life.  I have been using the double cleansing method for years, but haven’t always been satisfied with the results - upon further reading online, I realized I needed a more foaming cleanser for my combo/oily skin. I am now using the Shu Uemura Porefinist2 cleansing oil with the Glow Recipe Blueberry Bounce Cleanser as my double cleanse, followed by the Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Pore Tight Toner.  Never in my life have I seen such fast and effective results with this combination!!! It is slightly more drying than I’m used to so I follow up with a facial oil and a moisturizer.  I noticed a lot more sensitivity to retinol due to the increased use of acids so I have reduced it to every 2 days instead of every other night and use the Biossance Omega Repair Cream.  I can’t get over how amazing my skin looks and feels.  I even had someone say it looks like glass! I started using all of these products at the same time, so I can’t review anything separately yet, but I will continue to purchase and recommend them considering how much they’ve changed my skin.

I keep this in the shower, so I can wash my face and body with one or two pumps--this product is that concentrated! I started using it when it can’t in the blue packaging, and have loved it since then. Like other users, I do use this as my 2nd cleansing step. it keeps my skin clean and clear.
review_title: Great all-purpose cleanser to keep in the shower

review_text: Loved the sample size- so I purchased the full size bottle. Since then, I’ve introduced a lot more acids in my skincare routine as well as some retinoid products. Since then, I feel like it dries out my skin and leaves it tight. If you are mindful with your moisture, it is a great cleanser. Clean smell with a jelly-like consistency. I use a foaming tool to make the most of the product.
review_title: gentle/use with caution with other acids

review_text: i have really reactive, hormonal teenage skin that’s susceptible to acne, and this is one of my favorite go-to’s for a second cleansing step. i honestly believe that for people with oily, congested skin that the first oil/balm cleanse is more important as oil attracts oil and pulls all the gunk out of your pores, but this eliminates all residue left behind after that step. it smells great — the fragrance doesn’t bother me seeing as this is a wash-off product. one thing i dislike about this cleanser is how difficult the texture is to work with. you really have to be careful when applying this cleanser as it slips off your fingers very easily, especially if damp. doesn’t break me out, but i’m ready to explore better options.

I’m not sure what’s in Glow Recipe ingredients that my skin hates but this is the 2nd product (watermelon mask 1st) to cause breakouts on my otherwise clear skin. I have rosacea, and sensitive/dry skin. This cleanser is definitely more for oily to combo skin. If you have sensitive skin, beware.
great smell, doesn’t dry out my skin like other cleaners & just overall very gentle

This product is really good at clearing oil residue and giving the skin a fresh feeling. I would point out that this cleanser is definitely directed more towards oily skin and after using this product you should moisturizer after.

Was using this as my daily cleanser on my very dry skin. It stripped my skin of essential oils, not great since I don’t produce enough in the first place, and sensitized my skin. Because my skin was over-cleansed and over-exfoliated I had reactive acne as a result. I repurposed it to once a week in my exfoliating regime, which seems to be working okay. I believe this might be good for oily skin but, at any rate, proceed with caution!
This is my favorite cleanser and I CANNOT love without it. It’s really gentle even though my skin isn’t sensitive and it cleans my skin but doesn’t leave it feeling stripped. 10/10 recommended!

This is kind of a hard review to write . I have gotten this for almost a year now bc I love how my face feels after using it ; fresh and clean. I love the gel consistency and how soapy it gets. Also it smells good , but I still have break outs and I wanted to find something with less fragrance .
review_title: I love you , but it’s over

review_text: Least favorite cleanser.... it smells like dollar tree soap and foams up so much. I can’t stand the amount of bubbles and the texture of this product... literally feels like washing your face with a cheap bar of soap. I’ve tried multiple times and can’t bring myself to like it - just a personal opinion.
I love the smell of it and the gel texture. It’s smooth and cleanses the skin well. I love how it lathers on the skin and foams up really nicely.

This is definitely the best smelling face wash I have ever used! Though after a couple of washes, I have noticed that this has dried out my face quite a bit. I bought the mini to test before buying the full sized one and found that it was hard to get the product out of the bottle! I don’t know if it is because of the formula but it was a bit difficult. Sad that this didn’t work out.

dude. this is one of the best cleansers i’ve used. i’m on my third bottle of this, and it’s great. i don’t get breakouts too often, but i do get little skin-colored bumps on the sides of my face. this cleanser has helped so much with that. my skin is pretty sensitive, and if you do too, i recommend not leaving it on your face for too long.

I have combination oily skin and this product completely dried out my face. It also burns like crazy if the slightest amount gets in your eyes. Also does not cleanse your face at all. I returned this product for the kiehls deep cleanse face wash and what a huge difference.

fragrance is mild, does exactly what it says. i use it as a mask by leaving the foam on after i wash my face with it using a second time (when dirt is washed off from the first wash). cute bouncy texture. i find this company always stands true to what it claims the products do.

I like to use this as a second cleanse in tandem with Farmacy’s Green Clean (as the first), and honestly, the texture of my skin has never been better.  I’ll switch between this and Korres Greek Yoghurt Foaming Cleanser as they both (with Green Clean) seem to do a good job keeping minor acne at bay, or helping speed up the recovery after a hormonal outbreak.  I’m not sure if this is my official second cleanse or not, but as my husband uses it to get the grime off of his face, neck, and arms after working around semis all day, I’ll hold on to it.  Good for people who have highly reactive skin!  Also great if you’re not sure you got all of the sunscreen off! (I’m talking physical, not chemical)

Smells good. As far as product quality it seemed to cleanse well. My skin didn’t get too dry after like some of the other reviews have said. However my damn pump would work. So I have to manually scoop the stuff out myself. Tedious but whatever.

I wanted to love this. I am a huge fan of a couple of their products. It dispenses such a tiny amount of product that you have to use like 5 pumps. No blueberry smell, just a slight chemical scent. Didn’t dry my face out but didn’t leave it feeling very clean either. Honestly for the price, it’s so overrated & overpriced. For $10, go get yourself a bottle of Alaffia’s everyday coconut face wash. 12 oz for 10 bucks. That feels way better and it’s a transparent, cruelty free, fair trade company.

Doesn’t work for my skin. I am having the absolute worst breakouts of my entire life after switching to this product! I had 8 huge painful whiteheads pop up over the course of one week of using this product. It’s a shame because it smells so nice and I like the other products in this line, but this does not work at all with my skin

I have been using this product for over a month now and have finished the bottle. I have noticed that my acne has gotten notable worse. I thought that maybe my skin was going through a detox phase, so I continued using it. My skin continued to get worse so I have finally given up after finishing this mini sized bottle. Personally, I was unimpressed and will not buy it again. I used this in conjunction with their skincare line. However, given my misfortune with this product I can say that it does do a good job at leaving the skin feeling clean and not tight. There is almost no scent as it is very light. It does go a long way, considering I have used it twice a day since I got it and over a month later I am done with the MINI. Final conclusion is, it isnt the best but it may work for someone else.

I highly recommend this cleanser, I’ve used several times it removed makeup greatly, minimizes the looks of pores, leaves the face hydrated and bright. As well as that it has 0.5% of fragrances less than one percent!

I never usually write reviews but for this I had to give it a run. This cleanser is a must cop! I was looking for a gentle exfoliant (i recommend the dermalogica one) but came across this gentle cleanser instead so I thought I would give it a try because ive had their moisturizer and mask...and I love it! I use it with a silicone face brush and my skin has never glowed as great as it does. Definitely recommend this brand for anyone
Amazing! Smells good and doesn’t dry my skin. Totally recommend
Doesn’t leave skin dry. Pump gives perfect amount. Leaves skin with a glow, acne disappears. Evens out skin tone. I believe I found a product my skin loves!
It felt like I can’t wash it off completely. wouldn’t repurchase

This cleanser is a MUST HAVE! Being a teen, your skin can get quite complicateddd. It’s especially hard to find a great vegan cleanser. This cleanser leaves your face super soft and looking really radiant! I suggest using this with the MILK matcha toner. (gel stick)
I have always had problem skin black heads white heads and acne finally I’ve found a cleanser that clears my skin and it feels and smells great
I like the smell and the way it feels but it doesn’t remove makeup or clean my skin well. I don’t wear a ton of makeup either.

I purchased the trial size because I wanted to test it out before going full speed ahead. Like many, I was blessed with what I call, Corona skin. I was furloughed in Mid March and let’s just say all my stress manifested itself on my face and since I had nothing better to do, I started doing skincare research and came across Glow Recipe and this cleanser after having tried the watermelon mask sample from and Ipsy bag. I like this cleanser because it’s gentle and my skin feels clean. I have combination skin that is extremely oily in the Tzone and I get texture. I find that I still need some type of salicylic acid in my skincare routine so I started doing double cleansing with this and Clinique’s acne solutions bar of soap. That along with the rest of the Glow recipe line has been doing wonders on this oily, acne and big pore probed skin.

It smells great but isn’t too powerful. I like the texture, it’s a bit like jelly. It isn’t too stripping either. Since I don’t wash my face with soap every day, it lasts me at least 2 to 3 months to finish. I think the price isn’t bad.
review_title: good price, good product, in my opinion

review_text: Not for oily/acne prone skin. I got this in my Ipsy and started using it in the morning as my gentle cleanser. I sometimes get hormonal acne on my chin. However, this cleanser actually caused me to breakout in places I never do. The only change I made was this cleanser, so it was definitely the cause. I can’t recommend this for oily/acne prone skin.

I tried this out for the first time in the glow babies travel set and fell in love with this. I have sensitive skin and I always feel dry after any and every cleanser I have tried until this. This cleanser is clean  and doesn’t have anything that will irritate my skin or leave it dry. I love it so much I will be repurchasing till forever  :)

I wanted to like this so bad because it’s the perfect size for traveling and I like AHAs in cleanser... but it leaves my skin feeling dry/tight after I’ve cleansed. This would probably be great for someone with oily skin. I’ll probably still keep this in my travel kit and use on my body or as a face cleanser in a pinch.
review_title: Not a bad product, just not right for me

review_text: I love this cleanser! Definitely amazing if you wear a lot of face makeup and have oily skin. You will feel so clean after this. One of the only cleansers that really takes all my makeup away.
review_title: I FEEL SO CLEAN WITH THIS CLEANSER

review_text: I have combination skin and completely dried out my face. The area around my nose started pealing and around my mouth. Smells great though

I still love the brand they just need to come out with a better cleanser.
I love that this cleanser is slightly stripping because I feel like it relieves my skin of excess oil throughout the day along with other products I use. Very gentle and clean feeling.

I’m not sure who’s definition of “gentle“ was used to name this cleanser. I have oily skin that’s been turned mostly normal (thanks to Niacinimide) but I’ve never met a cleaner that made my face feel this tight. I love EVERY Glow Recipe product that has come out!! My skin is soft, supple & oozes with radiance!!
Oh o love this cleanser ,the most gently foaming cleanser.  Glad I got 2 of them . Worth my money.
Perfetection in the world of cleansers. And lasts forever&

review_title: SHES UNIQUE AND I LOVE IT

This cleanser does the job that it’s required to do. It removes makeup and is still pretty gentle. However, it’s just not that extraordinary for the price. The ingredients and formula is somewhat basic and reminds me of many drugstore cleansers. So it’s good, but not the greatest.

This works for someone who doesn’t have super sensitive dehydrated dry skin. It actually popped my zit while I gently rub it on. It def works but a bit too strong for me. After I wash I felt my skin to be really dry and patchy.
I don’t normally review things but I really didn’t like this cleanser it was so drying and it had a weird hand soap smell to it, it basically stripped my skin and didn’t really help my acne at all

I didn’t realize I had sensitive skin until I used this for 5 days in a row. In the end, the areas around my mouth and nose were a blotchy, zit-filled, and peeling mess. My skin started to repair itself once I stopped using it. I would NOT recommend this for sensitive skin types. Maybe not even dry skin types. The only good thing I could say about it is I liked the light blueberry scent. Sadly, it just didn’t work out for me.

Smells light and pleasant. Mini size pumps worse than the regular size, but not too badly. Lathers up nicely and cleanses without irritation, but I don’t have sensitive skin, so take that with a grain of salt.

I’m a huge fan of Glow Recipe - their products have saved me many times from sudden changes in my skin texture (especially their serums and banana souffle. Highly recommend.) Sadly, this wasn’t one of them. I don’t fault the product at all, as, in the first few minutes, my skin did feel incredible and cleansed, but after that, my skin became extremely parched, covered in zits, and painfully dry. It was only after switching this cleanser out for another that I realised that this was a little too harsh for my skin. -- I would recommend this product for anyone who’s having extreme difficulty with very oily or acne-prone skin, but be warned that if your skin is sensitive, this cleanser may be a little harsh, even with an intense moisturising routine. -- The scent is very nice and I didn’t find it too overwhelming. I would describe it as “soapy“ as opposed to overly fruity, but it’s not that dollar-store-soap scent. The cleansing experience was enjoyable and I adore how easy it was to use. It just isn’t the product for me.
review_title: Sadly a bit too drying for me.

review_text: I love Glow Recipe - truly - so I was so excited when this came out. I switched out my Tatcha cleanser to try out the Blueberry Bounce. There’s nothing bouncy about my skin after using this cleanser. It has dried me out SO badly and has given me weird bumps and texture that I’ve never had before. I tried to limit the use to see if that helped, and in times I wasn’t using it, my skin improved. Every morning after I used this my skin was tight, and my under-eyes look like they have aged years. I wanted to live it, but I’ll sadly be returning. I give it two stars because the packaging/scent is nice (but could be causing the issue - I don’t know?) and it removes makeup well. Might be good for someone with ultra oily skin?

This cleanser is light, fresh, and leaves your face feeling soft and squeaky clean. Really love the light blueberry smell. Will buy again, but also going to continue looking forward the right cleanser for my combo skin with redness.
It seems like a regular cleanser but it’s awesome leaves my skin hydrated soft and I have oily skin it works for me I love it !!!
made my skin super dry every time I used it :( honestly really disappointed, usually their products go really well with my skin
Not amazing, but also not horrible. It can be super drying so you need to use a good moisturizer and did not really do much for my skin. Wouldn’t suggest for acne, but it does the job none the less.

for background- i have combo/normal acne prone skin. this cleanser has really helped. i use this morning/night alongside the krave oat so simple water cream & the purito water comfy sunblock and my skin has cleared up. this cleanser is just enough gentle exfoliation daily which is what i prefer over exfoliating products. i also have fungal acne and this product is fungal acne safe! this cleanser hasn’t dried me out & is not too stripping, but that isn’t the case for everyone. the only huge complaint i have is the amount of product for the price, i like it enough to repurchase again but if you use their recommended 1-2 pumps of product you’ll run out VERY quickly. overall i enjoy it & i can’t wait to try more glow recipe products :)!
review_title: great product, might not be for everyone.

review_text: After trying different skincare brands that would help with my complicated face problems, I finally decided to try Glow Recipe last year. I rarely have any acne problems. But due to the pandemic, face mask, & stress my cheek areas have been breaking out like crazy. I decided to give this product a try since I’m trying to introduce the brand completely into my skincare. Well after using it for a little over a month, my acne has started to slowly clear out (since I kept messing with it & scratching it). my cheeks are starting to look more & more clear. my skin feels very soft and doesn’t dry out at all! I’m definitely buying the bigger size next time! I love the blueberry smell to it as well.

I’m rarely ever loyal to a brand/product. I like to switch things up. BUT I keep coming back to this product. 1) I am obsessed with the bouncy consistency. 2) it really removes EVERYTHING. I don’t even use makeup wipes anymore because this takes off my makeup so effortlessly. One little pump goes along way. The bouncy gel turns to foam on your skin. Warning though to those with naturally dry skin, this may not be for you. But it’s perfect for someone like me with combination skin.

This stuff dried out my skin so much im surprised I dont have wrinkles already. I have a lot of respect for glow recipe products but this one was a miss. It might work for some people but id try a sample first to be sure.

I really enjoy Glow Recipe’s products so when I saw this cleanser I was really excited. Unfortunately this cleanser did not work for me at all. Sure it cleaned my skin but it also left my skin feeling dry & I started developing dry patches near my nose. So I highly recommend using a rich moisturizer if you decide to try this cleanser. Also I noticed no changes in my skin and it did nothing for my acne (I have normal acne levels). I will not be repurchasing this item and I do not recommend it. I feel like I wasted my money honestly.

I have purchased this facial wash now a few times and I will use this as long as I can. The smell is amazing. Clearly smells like blueberries but not heavily scented, its just right. review_title: Blueberry Scent + Soft Skin = Happy Customer

I don’t love to write reviews about skincare because there is so much than can affect how a product works (climate, humidity, skin type, other products, laundry detergent, etc.) Since my thoughts seem to follow some  common themes, I feel comfortable adding. I’ve been excited to try this cleanser for a while so when I saw the holiday set with a mini this year, I had to grab it. I brought it on a weekend trip with me to test out. I used it morning and night for 4 days and this morning when I woke up, I had large dry patches all over my skin. I use a thick moisturizer (YTTP Deep Moisture Cream) and oil every night and this still dried me out. I have normal to combo skin depending on the weather but I have never experienced dry patches. With that said, I have acne prone skin and my forehead started breaking out like crazy on day 2. Of course that could be related to many variables but it’s just a data point to go along with the others. I did love how clean this made my skin feel especially after wearing a mask. I may continue to use this on days where I have to be in the office and have to wear a mask for 6-8+ hours. Probably wouldn’t buy the full size though. If you have super oily skin, this would probably work great.
I found this super drying. I wanted to love it because I liked the smell and the texture, but about 5 minutes after using it my skin feels tight and dry

review_title: Leaves dry patches and straps of skin

review_title: a bit drying for dry/sensitive skin

review_text: I love this stuff. It really cleans and smells amazing. My face feels so soft after and not dry ! I would pay full price any day for this.
Love! Love! Love!Leavesy face fresh and smelling so good!!

I love this cleanser!! About 3.5 years ago I developed some fungal acne/dermatitis and I had to completely revamp my skincare regimen and products I use. This cleanser saved me. which is not a good thing. It also has a nice fragrance but dries my skin out. Would not recommend

Like I get that it’s gel but it’s almost impossible to rub into your face if it’s wet and if your hands are wet when first applying it’ll slip right into the sink so I work it into my face dry then add water for a lather.
This cleanser is gentle and smells amazing, my skin has never been clearer.
Really gentle cleanser that removes make-up and clears up skin while smelling really nice.

I love this cleanser because it doubles as a 5 minute mask. It doesn’t just clean my skin, it improves my skins appearance. Be careful when mixing in your palms because the cleanser literally bounces, hence the name, and you don’t want it to bounce right down the drain. I find the large bottle pumps more than I need for washing so I pump it about halfway. The mini size you can use two or three pumps for a wash. Once I mix the lather in my palms I massage it in for a full minute to make the most of the ingredients. If you splash it right off they won’t have time to work. It makes my face feel perfectly clean but not dry. One major reason I splurge for this cleanser is that twice a week I apply a thick layer (several pumps of the large bottle) to dry clean skin and leave on for five minutes. I like this cleanser so much as a mask I don’t need to buy my herbivore prism mask anymore, this one gives me similar results in a quarter of the time. My skin is normal, 30s, and I try to minimize my pores and redness, plus fine lines and wrinkles. I’ve tried cleansers from drunk elephant, Josie maran, korres, rodan+fields for extended periods of time before this one and I’m not planning on switching it up again. I like this cleanser for all seasons.

review_title: this is a staple in my skincare routine!

review_text: I got this as a Christmas gift from my sister, and started using it immediately because I ran out of all my other cleansers. My first impression was the blueberry smell. I tend to like products with less strong scents, and this was a bit artificial-smelling for my liking — but that’s up to one’s personal preference. I have very sensitive skin as well as acne on my forehead and chin, and haven’t noticed any burning or stinging, which is great. (Even Cerave hydrating cleanser makes my face burn!) The texture is quite strange; it’s almost like a jello and sort of holds its shape when you pump it out of the bottle. It foams a bit but not a ton and is not very sticky / doesn’t cling to your face. It’s hard to describe but anyone who’s tried this probably knows exactly what I mean! I haven’t noticed changes in my skin since using this so I would say it’s probably gentle enough not to cause a huge difference in “glow” or other qualities, but for me that’s actually a plus. Anything stronger would likely cause issues for my skin. Overall, nothing magical so maybe not worth the price, but it’s a pleasant product with no major issues!
This cleanser is not drying at all. My face feels super clean & hydrated. A little goes along away. Helped me with my Masknce
my favorite face wash, it smells so good and doesn’t dry me out too muc, plus the bottle lasts forever

This is by far the best cleanser! Better than all drug store brands. Only need one pump, a little goes a long way. I have VERY acne prone skin and it cleared right up. Definitely will be getting the full size. goes great with their plum plump serum.

Love this stuff, gentle but removes mascara!!! Use it as a mask or wash with water.
