I know the pandemic; constantly wearing face mask had a lot to do with our out breaks...at least mine. But omg!! This product made my face worse!! I guess you can say I have sensitive skin? Idk I just know that my skin is dry. The smell is alright I actually like it but no, this product did not react well and that’s because I’ve had it for over a month, thinking my skin would “break in” to the product but no the more I used it the more my skin would get irritated. I need need to for another cleanser. Definitely never purchasing from glow recipe ever again.

This is a really unique cleanser! First off it has a really nice light blueberry scent, I really enjoy it! Second it has a really cool gel bouncy texture, and it foams up very nicely! I have sensitive combo skin and whenever I cleanse my skin with this I am really impressed! It has this ability to remove makeup SO WELL yet it is still SO GENTLE! It is a little pricey but I feel like it is worth it, and if your unsure just get the mini size to see if you like it! I would Recommend!
review_title: So gentle yet removes makeup so well!

review_text: Very basic, didn’t do much for the price. Just as good as good ol’ drugstore face cleanser.
Best product on the market for gente cleaning of your face. Makes makeup melt away. Perfect product for anyone with sensitive skin.
review_title: Must buy for sensitive skin and easy makeup remove

review_text: Very nice gentle cleanser. After years of trying different things, only lightweight gel cleansers cooperate with my skin. Love this formula! However, I have come across more affordable options that work just as well.

I can see it on my nose getting stuff out of my skin!I don’t use it everyday just a few times a week, when I had used it consistently it began to sting a little more. Love this product. Smells Good. Will buy again.

Bought this for a trip and was happy with it. I have oily/combo skin and was in a hot/humid environment. Kept me from breaking out. It’s mild and smells good. Boyfriend used it as well with no complaints. It won’t replace my daily Khiel’s cleanser but I liked it.

Can’t believe I bought this in April 2020 and still have a 6th left! I’m using it EVERYDAY I swear. Great value, also the smell is really enjoyable and not too strong. This cleanser is really gentle and doesn’t strip the good stuff from your skin :)

Probably the worst cleanser I’ve ever paid for. It smells like elmers glue. It also doesn’t cleanse your skin properly, I still feel like a have a layer of grime on my face after I use this cleanser. You also aren’t getting a good value for what you pay for this cleanser. You have to use several pumps. The quality of this cleanser was surprising because I really liked this brands watermelon sleep mask!
Super gentle but you can feel your pores tightening. Works well to remove dirt light makeup.

They don’t make it clear by how they market this cleanser, but it contains active ingredients (glycolic acid), and will not play well if you’re using any other actives in your routine. It destroyed my moisture barrier which eventually caused massive breakouts. If your skin feels tight and dry after using this, stop using it!

Have used the mini version to figure out if this suits my skin. So far it has and out of all the cleansers I have used, this is the only one that has suited my skin. Great product and will buy a full size soon.

I love the smell, it’s such a refreshing cleanse! Unfortunately I agree that a lot of my product does get wasted down the sink drain because of the consistency. I wet my hands, pump one pump of product and rub my hands together and half of the time I lose almost all of it in one blob down the sink and have to start over. I find it works best when I’m in the shower for some reason. It didn’t do much to help my acne but it didn’t make it worse either. I only use once in the evening as my skin is left too dry otherwise.
New favorite cleanser. Will be buying again!! Makes my skin so soft love it.

Blueberry Bounce was my first foray into the Glow Recipe line, and it was love at first wash! I love the delicate, barely-there scent. A single pump lathers beautifully and creates the absolute softest suds. After rinsing, my skin feels soft, hydrated, and wonderfully clean (never stripped). I usually use Blueberry Bounce by itself first thing in the morning, then pair it with the Papaya Enzyme Balm for a double-cleanse in the evening. I used Philosophy’s Purity Made Simple for ten years prior to trying this, and my biggest “must“ when looking for a new cleanser was that it had to be VERY gentle, especially near the eyes. Blueberry Bounce met that expectation and more.

Since the first time using this product I was able to see a visible difference with my face. It cleanses and also softened my skin! I have sensitive skin and this product helps sooth my skin. I use it in combination with other Glow Recipe products and my skin hasn’t looked and felt better even while wearing masks constantly! I also love that it is made from fruits and is clean! I can’t stop recommending this product to friends and family.
Good but not my fav. It’s very slippery and I don’t love the consistency. It’s okay but I wouldn’t purchase again

I don’t think I could be more impressed from a cleanser! I had sensitive skin, redness around my t zone and this cleanser has changed my life. My skins so much more soft and glowing!!! 10/10 recommend.
Not too much of a fan of this product. it smells great but for my skin i feel like it was not cleansing enough and removing all my makeup off. However, the smell is nice and refreshing.

If I could give this cleanser 0 stars, I would. It has completely dried out my skin - my moisture barrier has been annihilated since incorporating this and Glow Recipe’s papaya balm cleanser into my routine! My skin is not sensitive, so I am absolutely shocked at its reaction to this product. The texture of the cleanser is too thickly goopy and is prone to flying off your hands as you try to lather it up. Overall, a hard pass. I’m going to have to really baby my skin in the next few weeks to recover from this awful cleanser. I only wish I could return this!
Not a huge fan.. dosent do “Miracles” i just feel like Strawberry Shortcake puked on my face..

Has a nice blueberry scent - artificial smelling but I like it! Foams up nicely and a little goes a long way. One pump can usually take off all my sunscreen and/or light makeup. It has not been drying or irritating for me. All in all, just a basic, pleasant cleanser.

This cleanser is the only cleanser that suits my skin. It cleans my skin without it feeling dry afterward. I. make sure not to use it around my eyes, because they felt irritated when I did wash my whole face, including the eye area.

My first review ever goes to this amazing cleanser! I love how gentle it is, how it removes my make up and does not leave my skin feeling dry at all!! A little goes a long way and the scent is very light but beautiful! 10/10

I started using this for a week before my skin started getting severely dry and the skin around my mouth turned red and peeled. I stopped using toner and just used the cleanser, tatcha dewy skin cream, and sunblock and my skin continued to get worse. It was the only cleanser I had so I had to continue using it and in my attempts to make my skin better I added hyaluronic acid along with the other products. After a month of use I stopped using it and after a week my skin went back to normal and the red, flaky skin went away. Maybe I was using the wrong products together, but I will not be repurchasing this.
Gentle, doesn’t flare up my acne or rosacea. I have oily skin and it cleans it up without being stripping.
review_title: Does what it is supposed to do

review_text: This is a great cleanser! Really gets the skin clean. However, THIS IS NOT AN EVERYDAY CLEANSER! When I used this cleanser everyday for two weeks, I noticed my skin felt dry and tight! I like to use this a few times a week or when I get hormonal acne flare ups. I love that this product can also be used as a mask
review_title: Good but not an everyday cleanser

review_text: It leaves my skin feeling nice and supple (as opposed to tight and dried out) and it also works great as a mask! However, I’m not a huge fan of fragrance in my skincare. Even though this cleanser smells delicious, it still has somewhat of a strong scent for my taste.

I have relatively sensitive skin, and it doesn’t irritate me at all. It lathers nicely and is extremely gentle. It will not remove makeup! I am also sensitive to smells, but this has a light fresh scent. I have gotten this four times now.
Not good for my normal/dry skin. Maybe if you have oily skin you’ll like it.
it’s alright, i’ve had better. feels a little too strong and made my forehead shiny. i

if you want to try this, be very careful. I got this product in a glow recipe kit that was marketed for “dry skin“ 1 day later and my skin is stiff cracking and red.. it is beyond dry and stings! this cleanser was not the right match for me, and as I read, a lot of people had this same problem. just be careful and use this once a week at most.

On paper the ingredients are all great, but I can’t help to think the cleansing agent being used is too stripping. This stings my eyes, I try to actually avoid the eye area all together with this one and just remove my makeup first with and cleansing oil. I don’t think everyone can tolerate lactic and glycolic acid daily, so maybe think of this as a treatment cleanser. Hate that it’s marketed to be suitable for all skin types, gentle, and every day use.. it’s just not the tea sis. Very stripping and patched feeling after I cleanse with this. Wanted to love it.. maybe would be better suited for extremely oily/acne prone skin.

I typically lean more towards a sudsy cleanser, so I love this! It won’t take off makeup completely, so I use this as a double cleanse. The fragrance is nice and light. I took one star off for the price, lol

I’ve been using this cleanser for about 3 weeks now, and I love it! Even from the first use I had a good feeling about it. It has an interesting jelly texture, lathers well and feels really good on the skin while you’re massaging it onto your face. 1-2 pumps is truly all you need.It washes off well, and I generally don’t wear a lot of face makeup (mascara, brow pencil, sunscreen) so this cleanser has no problem removing all of that for me. As seen in other reviews, it can be irritating if you get it in your eye so be careful there. The scent is light and pleasant, not too strong (for me anyway)All in all, this has become one of my favorite cleansers of all time. I’ve been using it every day for 3 weeks and have noticed such an improvement in skin texture and appearance! I bought the 1 oz size to start, and you better believe I’ll be upgrading when that runs out!
I love this cleanser it’s a thick consistency and it smells so good this really gets all the dirt and impurities out
I feel like this is an OK cleanser. It’s not that gentle, actually I find it very stripping :(
Love the scent and how this lathers. The consistency is “bouncy” so you risk it all sliding off down the drain as someone else mentioned. I just apply it directly to my foreo luna.

This cleanser smells wonderful and effectively cleansers your face without it feeling stripped! I’m not giving 5 stars because it doesn’t work well to remove make-up and I didn’t notice any long-term benefits from using it but it is a good cleanser.
Super gentle and efficient. I love the way it smells and it has never led to breakouts or irritation.
I have combination skin and I love this stuff! doesn’t dry me out and I was surprised at how well it removed my makeup I would try the mini size first and it lasts me a while!

I have very dry skin and this cleanser is perfect for me. I’ve been using it for 1.5 years and I’ve never had a problem. I use it with my Foreo everyday and my skin feels super clean but not stripped!!

I feel pretty indifferent about this. I have been using it for a few months and it’s just a straightforward cleanser. It didn’t feel too tight after using it, but I didn’t feel like it was nourishing either. I can definitely do without the scent, which can be a little overpowering. It was fun for a while but I probably won’t be purchasing this again.
I have combo skin so I like using this in the summer when I tend to be oilier. My pores are almost gone after washing my face with this love it

Love this product! I bought the mini one to try it out and instantly knew I was going to buy the full size. I’m very picky about skincare products but this hit the mark for sure. The ingredients are clean and the product itself smells SO NICE! Leaves my face feeling fresh especially when I use it with the watermelon toner.
This product dried the heck out of my face probably after 5 washes. I have combo skin and this was not good for my face. Also the smell is very fake.

I had bought this from the Glow Recipe website, and finished up my 3rd bottle a couple months ago.Now, first off, I have incredibly dry skin with eczema in certain spots but I also struggle with redness and large pores. I am sensitive to fragrance and they can often give me migraines. This product did not dry me out and really does not have a strong/bad smell like I’ve seen other reviews say? But I guess it’s to each their own. I made a very big move a few months ago and did not have the funds for my usual skincare routine, which consisted of this face wash along with other Glow Recipe products. So I went and bought those “dupes” I’d seen people talk about when saying that there is better products that are similar with a better price point. My skin has not been the same since, it is dry, red and my acne has just gotten awful and has stayed terrible for the past two months. Easy to say, my skin is NOT the same without this cleanser. I’m not saying that because it worked so well for me it will work just the same for you, but definitely give it a shot. I was worried upon first buying this, but now I will not use any other cleanser on my face. At first it didn’t work too well but that’s because I was not using the product correctly, put one or two pumps on your dry finger tips and rub them together then add in a bit of water and apply it to the face, this will make it nice and milky and it just smooths right onto the skin. It even helped to get rid of my chest and shoulder acne. I swear by this product and most other Glow Recipe products, it feels like it’s feeding my skin and it just eats it up!

All of Glow products have a super fake smell. They all are terrible in quality. They have a cute idea and packaging, that is all I can say about it that’s remotely positive. This one.. “Bounce” yeah literally bounces off your hands as you try to wash because it’s a gel and not a nice gel... like a Neosporin jelly.Don’t buy it. Anyone giving any one of these products good reviews are likely amateurs with skincare or maybe young girls who don’t know the difference. I do this for a living. I have it all. This brand is the worst I have.
I love this cleanser!  It’s SO gentle and doesn’t dry my skin out.  I also love that a little goes a long way.  It also smells great too!  I couldn’t be happier.

This is one of the worst cleansers I’ve ever used. It smells like cheap soap, lathers like cheap soap and leaves my skin feeling like sand paper. I was left with eczema on my chin and dry skin bumps on my forehead. This is not gentle at all, the name is very misleading... I had such high hopes
Got this for my brother as a gift. He has a very sensitive skin & other face washes gave him rashes but this one didn’t

This cleanser! “Bounce“ is the right adjective for it - the scent, the texture, all of it is light and bouncy and beyond delicious. This is a very light cleanser and 100% a great addition to a double cleanse routine, or fantastic on it’s own (which is the way I’ve been using it for the last year. I haven’t worn a drop of make-up since the pandemic began because I’m working from home all day.) This hasn’t dried my skin out or anything, and it cleanses it perfectly so that it’s a perfect blank canvas for my night toners, serums, and creams. Honestly, this makes cleansing my face FUN, which isn’t something you’d think cleansing your face would be after a long, tiring day, but this makes me look forward to my nighttime skincare routine.

I have oily skin and this cleanser makes my skin feel super fresh and clean. I like the blueberry smell and the fact that it has AHA in it it since I’m using tretinoin and heavy chemical exfoliating irritates my skin too much so this does the trick. I repurchase for the second time. Its kinda pricey fir how much you get but it’s worked well enough for me to justify repurchasing. Paired with FAB coconut water cream my skin loves it.

Love this cleanser! It’s got a pleasant texture, it’s like a fun jelly almost. I haven’t used a cleanser with AHAs before so I was anxious my skin would feel dry and angry when I introduced this face wash but it has been the opposite! My skin feels incredibly smooth, soft, and my pores are shrinking as the days go on. There was a couple of days when my skin was purging with the intro of a new acid, but that’s to be expected.

I didn’t like this at first because it made me purge pretty badly, but now my skin is really soft and clear so I’m enjoying it. Not sure if I’ll purchase again due to the high price and the little amount of product you get, but this is a pretty nice cleanser.
I have really dry and acne prone skin and this helped my skin so much!!
this is a great cleanser, but it’s not made for dry skin. i have normal/combo skin and it’s too stripping for me. i still really like it though!

great cleanser, I know a lot of people are not impressed with this but it does make my skin feel better after using it for a while I can tell the difference when I stop using it. it clears my skin from blemishes

This has been really good for my dry skin. I get hormonal acne in my chin and this has really helped prevent big painful cysts on my chin without over drying. It has a light scent, jelly consistency and turns into a light foam.
review_title: Great fo my dry and acne prone skin

review_text: Works great, great for sensitive skin. It does the job of cleanser, skin is clear! Wash face after apply your desired serums I use vitamin c serum, plump serum and cream.

I really love it! Ive used it as a mask twice a week and as a regular cleanser every day for two weeks. My skin looks so healthy and even though this does lather, it’s not drying at all! It makes my skin so soft. It also lasts a super long time if you get the mini, so 5oz for $34 isn’t a bad price at all for how long it lasts. I love it! I use a double cleanse so I can’t say if it removes makeup but it’s very fun and nice on the skin.
review_title: five stars from my dry skin!

review_text: It feels nice and is great for sensitive skin but smells like a blueberry dish soap.
Very gentle but foamy. I didn’t find it to be a good exfoliating cleanser, just refreshing. Recommend it for normal and dry skin types.
My face got oilier and broke out within two days of using this cleanser. Excellent blueberry smell, though.

This cleanser is definitely not stripping... but also doesn’t cleanse. I have combination skin and my T-zone still feels like there’s a heavy layer of oil on it after using this cleanser. Maybe this would be good for someone with dry or normal skin, but would not recommend for anyone with combination/oily skin. Luckily, I got the mini version of this as part of a Glow Recipe value set and didn’t waste money on the full size.
review_title: Not stripping... but also not cleansing...

review_text: An amazing product, perfect as a second step during a double cleanse or even as is. This bottle has lasted SO LONG m, almost 7 month now. Its good for my skin and i love to use to pamper my skin.

This is perfect for me. I have mild acne that has cleared up over the past two weeks. My skin is also sensitive and using this and the toner and moisturizer my skin looks great. The scent is great too. It’s mild which I like. I wish the line was a little less expensive but the products are great

I bought the 30ML cleanser and I’m almost regretting it. Will buy the bigger bottle. The smell is so delicious and it leaves your skin super clean and smooth.I have not used it for makeup removal, just as a facial soap for my oily skin face. I used to use the Clinique facial soap, not anymore. I Love Glow Recipe is a Cruelty-Free brand.I want to help saving Ralph.

i like it a lot! it’s so cute, smells very good, has a nice texture, cleanses well. however, it can be slightly drying. not for me personally, but i have normal to dry skin, not very dry. so be sure to patch test this product if you have more dry skin. other than that, it’s a great gentle cleanser!
This is a nice gentle cleanser that does the job. It froths up nice and is soft on the skin. Not a huge fan of glow recipe but I do like this product. Also smells great.
Wanted to love this but felt like it did nothing for my skin. Highly fragranced.

I bought this in the bigger size because I just HAD to have it and couldn’t wait for my store to get the mini size back in stock. I don’t notice the smell and I’m very sensitive to scents. It doesn’t rinse off well and leaves a sticky feeling film on my skin. I’m sure I’ll end up giving it away.
Smells amazing and I wanted to love it, but after about a weeks use, it has severely dried my face out. Now my face is red and itchy, along with dry flaky skin everywhere.

This is a good cleanser for those with oily skin as it doesn’t give excessive hydration nor does it feel like it strips your skin. It does have quite a fragrance to it, so I would avoid this if you don’t like fragrance in your products.Overall, it’s an okay cleanser but it isn’t worth the price that you’re paying. There are cheaper and better cleansers out there.

I really love this cleanser. Very soothing and gentle. The bubbles are soft and the smell is pleasant. I like to use this in between days where I’m treating for acne to give my skin a break from harsher products.

My sensitive, fungal acne prone skin really likes this! I’m surprised honestly. Tried a mini version because I was on the hunt for a FA safe cleaner and hadn’t had luck with others. I stumbled upon this one and impulse bought it. It happened to really work for me. My skin freaks out if you even look at it the wrong way lol but this did not strip it or make it break out.
definitely not worth the price for a basic cleanser. it didn’t seem to cleanse very well.

I was quite disappointed with this product to be honest. It seems that it is always so difficult to wash off after foaming, now I do not use a large amount and I find that even after using toner to remove the residue it still stays on there! The smell I like as it reminds me of a shampoo I used to use when I was little but I can see people disliking this strong scent. My last concern is that it doesn’t seem to really clean my face or cleanse it in general, and I am assuming that the strong fragrance is not helping which is why I may be having more dry spots and little breakouts.
review_title: Wish I got the mini to try out first.

review_text: I’ve used the mini size when buying the «fruits babies» and really loved it. I was scared at first because of the mixed reviews, but this is truly a great exfoliant good cleanser! Gentle and effective. It helped clearing some of my acne. I was using it twice a day, but reduce. I think it gave me some «over exfoliating» side effect at some point, but it went away fast. If you have sensitive skin and are using exfoliant during the week, maybe don’t use it everyday, but just when your skin could use some extra help to clear up :)!

Small bottle but good for travel an it lasted be months, you don’t need a lot an it makes your skin so plump and fresh with out leaving a coding on your face. I noticed a big difference in how shinny an soft an hydrated my face was after using it for a few months, will be ordering agin ! :) <3 love it!

Saw this as one of the top listed cleansers for dry skin somewhere. Just got it in today and used it for the first time. Loved the smell, loved the experience. As soon as my face dried, I could see scales. So unfortunately this didn’t work for my dry skin. It’s going back ☹️

Not the most gentle cleanser. My face felt tight when I used it twice a day. It can be hard to pump out of the bottle due to the texture. I did enjoy the texture of it and it foamed up well. The smell is light but refreshing.
I have very sensitive skin that turns red very easily. This stuff smells nice but doesn’t do my skin any favors. I received this in a Sephora collection I bought. I wouldn’t chose this for myself.

definitely not my favorite of the brand,and not worth the hype. it’s a basic cleanser with a good smell is all. I didn’t like the tacky gel feeling. it didn’t take off all my makeup and there isn’t anything special about this cleanser. the price just isn’t worth it for me

Tried the Blueberry Bounce Cleanser from a mini set that I bought online. Instantly fell in love and bought it in a bigger size. I love the soft blueberry scent! It isn’t too overpowering of a scent nor does it dry out my face. I feel like it does a good job removing my make up when I am not able to double cleanse, but to be honest the most make up I use is mascara, light eyeshadow, and foundation.
I love this product. It makes my skin glow and feel fresh.
Love it so far. Feels very gentle, my skin gets dried out easily, but this feels very nice. I use it as my 2nd cleanse, after a cleansing oil, in the evening.

The scent kinda throws me off because I prefer my skincare to have no fragrance but this was a lovely cleanser and did an amazing job removing makeup and cleansing my face. Would repurchase a small for travel and a full size for everyday use.
worked for about a month then started breaking me out!

I have combination skin and was looking for something different to use. I love Glow Recipe in general so I thought I’d give this a shot, but it makes my skin feel very tight and dry after using it. It’s not for me, but I will say if you’re someone who is on the oily side this would be a good cleanser for you.

Love this cleanser so much! I’ve been using it 9 months and in my opinion its incredible! I’ve never stuck to a cleanser as none have ever impressed me, but this has been a constant staple and repurchase. I had trouble with clogged pores in the nose area which this helped alot, as well as small little blemishes on my skin which I no longer get. At first the scent bothered me a little as I used a lot of unscented products in the past, but I’ve now grown to love it. The experience of the cleanser is like no other! If you deal with clogged pores, small blemish try this!!!!!

Ok so when I first started using this soap and the Glow Recipe products I loved them and so did my skin...it has been close to 7 months now and in the last 2 months my skin hates it. This wash has dried out my eyelids to the point where there are dry scaly patches and I have so many little bumps and acne nodules things collecting with oil and dead skins so my blackheads have increased along with bumps on my face and I am also breaking out in larger pimples in which I have never before...maybe after eating a greasy meal but this is now daily and I have not drank alcohol and have been clean eating along with taking daily vitamins for over a month thinking it was my diet but no. I stopped using it and my skin is slowly returning back to normal.
review_title: The marketing & recipe is appealing but be WARNED

review_text: I’m so glad the salesperson at Sephora recommended this to me. I have dry/combination acne prone skin. I was hesitant since my skin is more on the dry side, I also read how foam isn’t good for dry skin, but  I use a micellar water at the end of the night to wash all my makeup off first and then use a face wash to thoroughly cleanse my face off.  I previously used fab unscented facial cleanser but it wasn’t getting all my makeup off... this definitely does! My pores look smaller after using, my skin looks more youthful and radiant and my acne is disappearing. It definitely is deep cleansing and removes ALL your makeup and sweat from the day. Like a mini facial. I could see why other people would say this is a bit drying, I definitely wouldn’t use this more than once a day at the end of the day. It has a nice light scent. Overall I highly recommend

This cleanser!! It smells great and does a great job of removing any remaining traces of makeup at the end of the day. Be mindful of the AHAs and make sure your skin can take it, but slowly working this into my evening routine has done wonders for my skin tone and post-acne marks.
I have combination skin with dry cheeks. This cleanser was too stripping for me, and I had to use a very thick moisturizer to get rid of that feeling. I will not recommend for dry skin.
Holy grail makeup remover. Great for waterproof mascara too!

I have very sensitive skin & this cleanser has really improved my overall texture, pores, appearance..etc. It’s not harsh at all. Smells very light & refreshing. Glow Recipe products are top notch & definitely a favorite beauty brand of mine. This is a must have & well worth the price.
Somewhat drying for a gentle cleanser. Currently my makeup travel cleanser.

Great cleanser! Not harsh and makes my skin feels soft and clean with the stripping feeling. Associate in the store recommended this one because I was using the belif clanser wish broke me out like crazy and dried out my skin. This one doesn’t at all so far. There is fragrance but it not overpowering. It’s a very light scent of blueberries.

Got this as a gift so I figured I’d try it out for a bit. Smells super good but Hyram has taught me to be wary of good-smelling face products! Consistency is kind of weird and sticky- I don’t think I like that. Foams up pretty nicely but my face feels kind of tight after using so I wouldn’t necessarily describe this as “gentle“. I’ll use it up just bc I don’t have much in the bottle but wouldn’t buy again.

So I bought this cleanser in the Glow Bestsellers Kit and was a little disappointed that it didn’t work as well as the other Glow Recipe items in the set. It wasn’t able to melt and remove my gel eyeliner and I had to use my Tatcha cleanser to fully break down my eye makeup, as well as 2 cotton pads of Bioderma micellar water. This cleanser is ideal for people who don’t wear a lot of makeup. One positive aspect of this cleanser is the pump that comes with it. Unlike some other cleansers that have a squeeze top (like Tatcha), the pump dispensing system is handy for releasing the gel-like consistency of the cleanser and making sure you don’t dispense more product than you need to use. A little goes a long way with this cleanser and it’s very reasonably priced.Also want to add for anyone who tries to avoid fragrances in their skin care that the product has a light fragrance that smells nice, not too overpowering.
review_title: Okay Cleanser, but there are better ones out there

review_text: Works amazing as a double cleanser! works really good and makes my skin feel soft (:

I was really excited about this because it has such fantastic reviews but it wasn’t anything like what I expected. It feels good on my skin but the smell is unbearable. It’s not simply a gross perfume-y smell, it’s almost like when you leave berries in the fridge too long and they start to smell rancid, when you wash this off it lingers for a long time. If smell is no concern I could see this being great for some people, but it was a complete miss for me.
review_title: Feels good, smells terrible, unfortunate pass.

review_text: Smells nice but can be a little drying. I do not use daily.

I really like using this cleanser as my second step in my routine, after using an oil based cleanser. It’s gentle enough for every day use, does not dry out my skin, and makes my skin feel/look smooth and glowing!

This cleanser is very gentle and great as a second cleanse if I wore makeup/sunscreen or on its own in the morning or on days I haven’t worn anything after moisturizer. Leaves my skin not dry and tight like some other cleansers and I feel like my skin is clean without that overly harsh “clean” feeling. I’ve been using it just over 6 weeks and have seen a drastic improvement in my skin as far as acne and dullness goes.

I love everything from Glow Recipe I’ve tried except for this cleanser. I’ve tried over and over to make it work for me, but it severely dries out my skin to the point where I have to use multiple masks and serum to get my skin back to normal . I wish they would make a moisturizing cleanser for us dry skin folks!
Love the cleanser. Perfect for travel size, cleanse the skin very good. Not causing breakouts or redness. Works amazing for my combo skin. And for sensitive areas is good also.
Nice for oily and some sensitive skin types. This product does have a mild scent. Face felt clean without feeling drying. I’m not sure I could justify the full size price though.
I can’t really say much. It’s an okay cleanser. I can’t even pump it out of the bottle. It’s so jelly and thick the pump won’t even dispense it. I have to unscrew the cap whenever i want to use it

Love this cleanser it’s been a game changer in my skin care for the last year, when covid hit and things were closed down I could get my normal cleanser so I looked to Sephora for something with similar ingredients and tried the travel size of this. I was hooked. It changed my skin for the better!!

I love how foamy this face cleanser is and I don’t feel like my face has been stripped of all oils. Definitely works with the watermelon toner and moisturizer. Good scent that isn’t overwhelming and lingering.
It’s an okay cleanser, but the jelly consistency is so solid that you sometimes have to fight to pump it out of the bottle. So I’ll use my mini, but I won’t repurchase.

Favourite face wash yet and I’ve tried many. I love the banana soufflé lotion pairs nicely with this face wash! I have combination/oily skin, some acne. And I just love how my skin feels after. Gets really foamy, smells good (light). 5 stars

This is a solid cleanser that I typically would use as the second step after I use a cleansing balm. I like that it’s lightweight and gently foaming, and doesn’t dry my skin out. It has AHAs, but I didn’t notice much of a difference using this cleanser compared to ones that don’t have acids in them. The texture and general feeling remind me a bit of the Fresh Soy Cleanser, but I think I prefer Fresh to this. Overall, this was a nice cleanser to try out but I don’t think I’ll be purchasing a full size.

I didn’t feel like it cleaned my face at all. I have combination skin and I sweat a lot so I need something a little more cleansing. I gave it two stars because of its beautiful packaging and smell, although I’m also not a fan of fruity smells for my skincare.
Great cleanser for oily skin. Don’t know why there’s so many negative reviews. I like this product a lot and I will probably repurchase it!
I like the product a lot but when I bought it, I got it home and opened the box it came in and the pump was broken.

Love the way this smells, and honestly I love this whole brand. However, I have normal-combination skin and it dried me out a little bit, and gave me a tiny bit of texture. Also be aware that you don’t need much at all, which is awesome since its not cheap, but it doesn’t lather well so I don’t consider it good for makeup removal, but is a decent second cleanse if you are on the oilier side.

This is a great cleanser, as well as a makeup remover. So gentle on the skin and the smell of delicious blueberries. I highly recommend this product! Best cleanser I have used, so much so I bought this for my niece.

If you’re looking for a cleanser that not only smells great but makes your skin feeling luxurious afterwards, you may just need this cleanser in your skincare routine!!!So for a while I was looking for a cleanser but whenever I purchased one, there was always something about it that just did not feel right for my skin. At times, I would find a cleanser that was too harsh or one that was so gentle that it just did nothing for my skin, which led me to be on the look for a cleanser that was just perfect for my skin. After I found this cleanser, I really wanted to give it a try since the other products from “Glow recipe“ worked wonders for my skin. And after using it just once, I realized that this cleanser was just perfect. It wasn’t too harsh, did not make my skin feel sticky, and did a really good job at soothing the redness   and blemishes on my skin. Personally, whenever I use this cleanser I like to leave it on for a few minutes before washing it off, which I think makes a huge difference.

Just got this lovely cleanser in a little Sephora hull.. and wow I’m already obsessed! This left my skin SO soft, glowing and looking bright and refreshed dafter one use. I have combination skin and this didn’t over strip over over hydrate the Goldie locks of cleansers. Also the smell and texture of the lather is perfect. AND it can double as a little mask, can’t wait to continue to use this and see some nice long term results.

I really like the idea of the Glow Recipe products, love the Plum plump. I really like the scent on this and a foaming gel. However, it doesn’t foam all that well and it doesn’t remove makeup. Even as a second step after a cleansing balm, I still have traces of makeup left when I use a toner. I’m always on the hunt for better skincare, so I won’t be repurchasing.

I’m honestly shocked that this cleanser doesn’t have better reviews. I started off with the mini to see if I would like it, and unfortunately, I fell in love with it. I am loathed to spend $34 on a cleanser, but after I finished the mini I just had to. I have combination acne-prone skin with lots of congestion and hormonal acne. Using this, in combination with the papaya cleansing balm and Paula’s Choice 2% BHA a few times a week, has all but cleared up my skin. I was a die-hard Cerave fan, but even their cleanser can’t compete with this. Nothing leaves my skin as soft and moisturized as this cleanser, and I will now have to shell out an absurd amount of money every few months for this wonderful, yummy smelling cleanser. I hate you and I love you, Glow Recipe!!!
review_title: I hate that I love it

review_text: It was a little drying for me, once my skin was dry and felt very tight. Also wasn’t great at removing makeup. I really wanted to like it because I love so many of Glow Recipe’s products.

Had to take a star off because not only did it make my eyelids burn but didn’t take much of my mascara off. I do really like it as a 2nd cleanse as long as I avoid my eye areas. I don’t have sensitive skin so it was weird.
review_title: Not that gentle, but decent cleanser.

review_text: I love this stuff! Just bought two more mini size because the full size was sold out. Leaves my skin feeling clean, but not dry. Great for taking off my mascara with because it doesn’t irritate my eyes. Smells amazing. Clean ingredients. Amazing!
It made my skin super soft (I did use with other Glow Recipe products), but I didn’t foam a lot or make my skin feel super clean.

I had to jump in and say that I love this cleanser.  I have PCOS so my acne is just awful at times even though I’m 40.  I use this cleanser at a night cleanser and it helps calm my skin from flair-ups and removes all the oil and debris off my face.  I have medium sized pores but my T-zone and along my chin still break out from time to time but this really helps balance out my skin.
Love this product! Leaves my face feeling clean and fresh!!
I love this brand and have many of their products, but this is not my favorite.  It stung my eyes slightly when using it.
review_title: Stung my eyes a little bit

review_text: 5 star product but deduction for scent. It reminds me of bath&body works vintage sun ripped raspberry scent. 10/10 recommend but not those scent sensitive folks.

It smells nice. It has a nice jelly-like texture. For those with less sensitive skin, I’m sure it will be fine. It’s a shame because it cleans decently well and has a light soothing fragrance--it doesn’t smell like blueberries BTW. It’s more of a floral scent. I would recommend it only for people who are not sensitive to fragrance(artificial or essential oils) or AHAs. If you have sensitive skin, please stay away.

I have oily skin. This cleanser was gentle, but nothing special. It isn’t overly fragranced at all. I wouldn’t recommend this to anyone with dry skin, as it had a tendency to dry me out if I used it more than once daily. Use with a good moisturizer.
This gets all my makeup off without drying my already dry skin. I don’t think I’ve ever had a cleanser that makes my skin feel so clean without stripping it.
review_title: Gets All Makeup Off So Easily Without Drying

review_text: I really wanted to like this cleanser as I really like their other products, but my goodness does this strip every ounce of moisture from my combination skin. You could use this cleaner on the oily part of skin only, but that’s way too much work.
Does the job, foams nicely. It smells quite nice as well.

I wanted to love this, I only Wash my face at night. I love the scent but made the skin around my nose crack and the skin under my lips and chin peel. I used for 3 weeks and it kept getting worse. Within 4 days of stopping the use my skin cleared up, and quit peeling and cracking.
review_title: not for the sensitive skin users.

review_text: Started using this January 2020, and WOW. The difference in the texture and appearance of my skin is a night and day difference. I had bad cystic acne as a teenager, which left scars on my face. I still suffered with breakouts as an adult and hyperpigmentation is an issue for me even when the acne clears up. This cleanser essentially got rid of all hyperpigmentation I was experiencing, and reduced the size of my pores, which helped smooth the overall texture and appearance of some of the deeper scars on my face. I rarely ever have breakouts at all anymore. The most I get now is the occasional blackhead here and there, even with wearing a mask constantly. No mask acne for me! I will say that you have to be patient. Results aren’t immediate. It was drying initially, cause before I was just washing my face with a natural soap and exfoliating brush. It took about 2 weeks for my skin to balance itself out and not be so dry. By time I got through my first full-sized bottle (roughly 3-4 months later) is when I noticed the complete turn around in my skin, and haven’t looked back since! Bought my friend the small travel sized one because she was suffering from mask acne, and within two weeks, all of her acne was gone! This cleanser gently and properly cleans your face, and a little goes a long way! Light, refreshing, and has a really great lather to it.

i was so excited for this but every time i’ve used it, i’ve gotten so much acne… my skin is pretty sensitive and gets irritated easily, but i know when certain products give me more irritation than usual and this was one of them. just my experience that might be helpful to those with acne prone skin!! the plus sides are that it’s very soft and foamy and it doesn’t leave your face feeling tight, the scent is nice and it feels so soothing to use!
Its a good cleanser. I am oily/combination. Unfortunately, it’s too rough in my skin and leaves it very dry and flakey.

I love this cleanser. I’m a big Glow recipe fan in general and this product started it all. It smells fantastic; not too strong. It gets sudsy which I personally look for in a cleanser. Also it REMOVES MAKEUP which I appreciate because not all cleansers do and sometimes you have to use 2-3 washes to get makeup off. This however gets it all off first use. It also makes my skin feels soft and smooth which is nice as well
Good daily cleanser. Feels nice and scent is minimal. My skin isn’t sensitive, but probably gentle enough for everyone to use. Takes off my mineral sunscreen very well.
one of my top 3 make-up removers. very gentle but gets my eye makeup off and leaves my skin feeling really good. it has also cleared up my skin too! smell is a nice bonus

I really wanted to like it but... I purchased this a week ago and in just one week I’ve used up a quarter of the bottle. For almost $40. That’s expensive. I don’t even use a full pump. It also irritated my skin and acne. It’s a no from me.
review_title: A little does NOT go a long ways!

review_text: **Firstly, hugely concerning that I left a 2 star review on Glow Recipe site which they did not publish despite publishing 5 star reviews since. This is a trend with many sites selling their own-brand beauty products - they cherry pick the best reviews. Do not trust them**This made my combination skin very dry, especially around the mouth with flaky patches. As this is marketed as gentle and for sensitive skin I think this is just far too harsh. I also had the dreaded squeaky clean feeling which correlates with the underlying detergent smell I detected beneath the blueberry scent. Not worth the big bucks.
review_title: Drying and detergenty (plus more general warning).

review_text: Leaves my skin silky smooth , it has high quality ingredients. However a little does not go a long way

I have dry skin, but this didn’t strip my skin at all. It didn’t leave my face extremely dry and tight like most cleansers do. My skin is soft and has a clear complection. I use Innisfree Green Tea Serum after use and it leaves me with a dewy face

I bought the mini size of this cleanser before committing to the full size, as I wasn’t sure how my skin would react to it. I do like it, it cleanses well and my skin hasn’t broken out from it. The smell is pleasant but very subtle. I use it at night and follow up with The Ordinary 7% Glycolic Acid. The only thing that I’m not a huge fan of, is that I have to use more product to get a decent lather/foam when washing my face. My favourite face wash is the Vichy Purete Thermale Fresh Cleansing Gel, and it foams up like crazy with only half a pump! This cleanser is more expensive and I find myself using far more of it only to get a third of the foaminess, which is not great. While I do like it as a night time cleanser, I’m a little torn as to whether I will purchase the full size given the amount you get for the price.
Very very drying on your skin after you wash your face. I don’t know which is better dish soap or this cleanser.

1. It hurt my eyes. Even after it was all washed off, my eyes felt as if an eyelash was in them. 2. You have to use a lot for it to actually cover ur face and cleanse. One pump isn’t enough, it literally dissolved immediately when I put on damp face.3. Left my skin feeling very dry and stripped. Maybe that’s a tactic so you purchase all their moisturizers, lip masks and sleep masks.

I LOVE this cleanser, I am so happy I tried it! It leaves my skin feeling clean, but not stripped and it really helps with my acne caused by my birth control. It has also helped with my black heads more than any other cleanser I have tried. A little goes a long way, I use a small pump in the AM and PM and it lasts longer than other cleansers I’ve used. My sister, cousin, and friend use it as well! We are all combo or oily skin types so we always go for gel products to help with oil control, so it may not be the best for someone with dry or neutral skin types.
review_title: Great For Oily or Combo Skin

review_text: This cleanser reminds me of a face wash you’d buy in high school. It’s a bit jello like until it melts and smells like a cheap berry mist from the 2000’s. TBH I found it a bit fun of a face wash, that did well at foaming/lathering and cleaning, but I have acne. This cleanser did not help my skin, though I still use it occasionally as a pre cleanse for fun.
This product really helped my acne prone skin, it’s gentle and smells really good

For me Glow Recipe is a hit or a miss, and this was a definite miss.  It removes makeup OK (I only do eye makeup and pretty lightly), but it stings like crazy.  I gave this a fair shot for two weeks, but unfortunately this will be thrown away.

Absolutely hate this product! I am a huge fan of glow recipe and use many of there product but this one worked so bad on my skin. I have very dry skin and when I use this my face feels very dry and tight , I do not recommend if you have dry skin !
i wanted to love this, but it doesn’t foam well and a little does not go a long way :( my face also felt extra dry after using

Not sure what the hype of this is all about. My skin is super oily, yet it still manages to leave my oily skin super dry, and I do agree that a little does not go a long way. Will not purchase this again unless they change the formulation.

There’s nothing that special about this cleanser, however, if you’re not a picky person when it comes a face cleanser, this may be suitable for you. It has a fragrance scent to it but it does smell good however the product is very stiff and doesn’t move around in the bottle and when it is pumped onto your hands, you have to be careful because of the gel formula, it tends to fall off of your hand and the product will be wasted.

So..I tried the mini sampler in the fruit babies set-had a full face of makeup after 8 hr day, gave this an honest shot. It has the consistency of jelly & you have to use quite a bit to thoroughly clean your face, I also used a washcloth. It smelled & felt like using dishwashing liquid-completely. It literally smelled like a cheap knockoff of Dawn, & it dried out my face so badly that even after I used Quench serum, my tarte eye cream, & then my Saturday skin glacier cream my skin still felt like it was stripped. So yes, it works well to remove makeup doing a 1 step(thoroughly) but it was very drying & did NOT smell like blueberries, nor proved worth the hype for a product in the glow recipe line. I will not buy the full size.
review_title: not worth the hype or the price.

review_text: I love this cleanser by Glow Recipe. It leaves my skin feel clean and helps with those darn breakouts!
I love the Glow recipe blueberry cleanser. My skin looks and feels amazing. I use all their products and highly recommend them.

I really like this cleanser! I’ve tried about 3-4 different ones this year and this one is the best one out of them. It has a nice subtle blueberry smell which I actually enjoy while I wash. My skin feels very smooth afterwards. Some cleansers I only used once a day or when I felt like washing my face….but this one I use twice a day religiously! Only need to pump it once to get the full effect. The bottle itself is sturdy and the pump works well!

No. It barely lathers, you have to use sooo many pumps to get a good enough amount of product, and way overpriced for lacklustre cleanser. Wanted to love but just didn’t. Wasn’t the worst but did not get the job done for me

I’ve only just received it and have been using once a day (I’ve got a second cleanser I alternate with). So far in the last 10 days or so I have no complaints so far, I like the jelly consistency, it spreads really well on a wet face and foams up just right.  Skin feels clean but doesn’t feel like it’s been stripped dry after cleansing.  I love a lot of Glow Recipe’s products and this cleanser is likely one I will repurchase as it is very gentle to my skin.  I have acne prone skin, and I’m hoping this will help reduce the amount of clogged pores and breakouts with time.  I’ve noticed some complaints about the scent.   Its not a big deal for me, so if you’re like me and not too overly concerned about whether something is artificially scented or scent boosted then I’d recommend the product as a whole. Scent is very delicate, not overly perfumed and doesn’t linger whatsoever and I’ll take the positives of this product over the complaints of its “fake“ blueberry scent all day.
review_title: Really like this one so far

review_text: A very nice Cleanser that is gentle on the skin. Great for a second cleanse. Very subtly smells of Blueberry and bubbles up nicely.

This cleanser isn’t terrible but it’s not great either. The consistency is quite sticky & I felt like I had to use quite a bit of product every time. It basically just removed my makeup, my skin didn’t benefit from it. It is not hydrating.
I really dont see why people like this at all, the consistency is horrible and really did nothing. I didnt even finish my mini.

I bought this cleanser because it was recommended to me; but there were a few things not to like about it. - the smell was weird didn’t like it at all- it stripped my skin of any sort of oil; even when I used less it was like I’d used Irish Spring soap on my face - broke me out BADLY on my chin; it took me like 2 weeks to get it under control and I know it was the cleanser since it was the only new thing I’d added to my routine. Overall, it just didn’t work out for me.

I have super dry skin but this cleanser is so gentle yet it removes even my waterproof mascara. I use it twice a day, in the morning on its own and in the evening after a cleansing balm. This was a game changer for me
I love this cleanser. It’s super gentle on the skin and never burns my eyes. It’s completely cleared my acne. Make sure to use a moisturizer after though.

Wow! This melts off makeup amazingly! I would warn people to not use this around the eye area because it can burn the eyes or irritate them! But would recommend to people who are trying to get a nice clean after makeup!
Since finding this I haven’t cleaned my face with anything but this and it’s partner Papaya cleanser.Great purchase.
Great cleanser but not enough product for the price.  I have drugs store cleansers that are just a good and have twice the fl oz for less money

I’m really impressed with this! I don’t use it everyday, just the week of my period because of it’s exfoliating properties, and I find that it removes my face make up well with a moderate amount of product but no double-cleansing needed and is also helping my skin clear up without drying it. Not sure if it would be suitable for everyday use long-term for me, I would probably reserve trying that in the summer. I do plan to repurchase and continue using it during my periods, at least!
Favorite cleanser of all time! Cleans face without being too drying! I feel like it’s helped me with my acne. If you’re on the fence of trying it out I’d say go for it!

This is my current favorite cleanser.  I’ve only ever bought the mini size, and it lasts me for months (using it one to two times per day).  It IS very gentle, so nothing fancy happens when you use it…it just lathers a little and cleans your skin.  The scent is very light, which I appreciate since my skin is pretty sensitive.  If I’m wearing makeup, I use this as the second step in my double cleanse, so I can’t vouch for how well it removes makeup on its own.  But my skin never feels too dry afterward, so I’m a big fan.
Gentle non-drying cleanser. My dry skin loves this. Will continue purchasing. Half a pump is more than enough !! Don’t waste it. You really don’t need much.
Love, amazing for dry sensitive skin. Very gentle, now a staple in my skin care routine. Worth every penny!

Honestly was a bit nervous about using this cleanser since some people said it was stripping; however, this cleanser was an amazing surprise! It left my skin super soft and hydrated while really deep cleansing. I usually use the drunk elephant Beste #9 jelly cleanser, but I think this is my new go to!!
It’s so bubbly and takes so long to rinse off because of all the bubbles. I guess personal preference but I’m not a fan.Though it doesn’t leave my face tight and dry so that’s cool.

When people say this cleanser is stripping and drying as heck it 100% is. Unless your face is like butter and dripping in oil this cleanser is for you. I have a very oily t zone and normal/dry cheeks. And for the love that is holy do not use on dry skin or dry/ normal parts. I would use it on normal areas on my faces and I would have instant dry patches. Anyone with dry skin run as fast as you can from this product. I am very slowly using this product once and a while cause I don’t want to waste it but only use it on oilier parts of my skin.
review_title: If Your skin is like KY jelly this is for you!

review_text: I LOVE this cleanser. I’ve always liked to deep clean everything including my face and now at 28 years old I’m starting to take care of my skin. Before I would always use a harsh charcoal cleanser and rarely use moisturizer so my skin is really sensitive and I’m trying to repair it. This cleanser cleans really well, leaves my skin really soft and smooth, and it’s so gentle it doesn’t dry out my skin or irritate it!

My new favorite cleanser! Its gentle, smells great and leaves my skin feeling clean. I have combo skin and this doesnt dry my skin out nor make me breakout...great balance. I’m on my second bottle of the full size

I am a HUGE Glow Recipe fan. However, this product is not it. This cleanser made my skin dry and tight. It feels cheap & thin. I am not a fan. Their other products are AMAZING, but I do not like this cleanser. One plus is the scent! Very light & like blueberries.
review_title: Love Glow Recipe, but this product is not it.

review_text: I am just in love with this cleanser!! I like the texture and it’s showing changes on my combination skin!! Fragrance is good and very subtle!! Packaging is also good! I would like to buy full size once I am done with my mini!

Great gel cleanser. This product is super gentle and non-stripping. After using this product for a month, I love how it cleans my face without drying it out. My face feels soft and smoother after each use. I use this as my second cleanser at night after a balm cleanser, and I use this as my first cleanser in the morning. No double cleanse in the morning. It is supposed to be able to remove makeup, but it is not enough by itself. Definitely recommend a balm or oil cleanser first to remove makeup and sunscreen, then use this product as the second cleanser at night.Highly recommend this product!!

I love this cleanser for every day use. It has a really nice fruity scent, it foams really nicely and removes my oil well. It leaves my skin feeling soft and silky, which I love. I follow up with other Glow Recipe products! I would recommend this for combo, normal or oily skin types.

This is a nice simple cleanser, if that’s what you are looking for, but it isn’t remarkable like some other brands at this price. It says that it is gentle, but if you have rosacea, this really seems to enflame it. I’m sticking to the Fresh Soy Cleanser because it removes makeup better and doesn’t burn my face.
Smells great. Overall I like it. It’s not my most favorite, but would still recommend. Leaves my skin just a tiny bit dryer than than I would like

The blueberry bounce cleanser did not make my skin feel bouncy. Once I put it on and washed it off, my face felt so tight that I sprinted to continue my skincare routine! It also has a light blueberryish fragrance which was a little off putting for me because it missed the mark and smelled like a sweet something. Pump can also be a little irritating at times but this did last me about a month even though I used it twice a day
review_title: Doesn’t live up to its name

review_text: I was really excited to try this product but was extremely disappointed. The cleanser is like jell-O and when you try to pump some into your hand it’s very difficult to apply to your face. The first time I tried washing my face the cleanser fell right out of my hands and into the sink. It also smells similarly close to hand soap. This makes for a very unenjoyable experience when washing your face. Overall I would not suggest purchasing this cleanser, especially when considering the price.
review_title: Feels like jell-O and smells like hand soap

review_text: This is the best cleanser I’ve tried. I find it foams up much better using a face washing brush rather than just using my hands. It truly does last a very long time, I was hesitant to spend this much on just a face wash but I love it. It leaves your face feeling super clean without drying your skin out.

This is my favorite cleanser at the moment, it smells fresh and the scent is not too strong, and it makes my skin feel bouncy and hydrated. I also would recommend using slight wet hands when you rub it on your face, I found it easier to use that way.
Love this brand but this was just average. I had a bottle of St. Ives watermelon face wash that I preferred. It’s not bad, cleans face fine and smells ok but I expected more from glow recipe

For the high price and high standard of the brand, this cleanser is really disappointing. It smells like an artificial shower gel, and stings like soap if it goes in your eyes. I got some in my mouth and the taste was literally soap. It was not drying and did take my makeup off, but something just feels off with how soapy it is, especially for a cleanser. I found this to be really enflaming to my rosacea and not at all on par with the rest of Glow Recipe’s other amazing products. You can get way gentler cleansers for a lot cheaper than this.

This cleanser left my skin feeling unbelievably tight and dry. I don’t have super dry skin either, my skin is combination and every time I used this product it would bring out rough patches on my cheeks that I didn’t even know were there; keep in mind this is in a very dry winter climate. There’s really nothing special about this cleanser in my opinion and for the price you could definitely get something way better. Would not recommend.
Anything Glow Recipe, I love! One of my favorites.
review_title: Can't go wrong with glow recipe

review_text: I was really excited to try this because everything else I have from glow recipe rocks. I used this and my face was almost burning and very irritated, I thought it might have been from other products but then my husband used this and had the same thing happen to him. Unfortunate :(

I love this cleanser! I got a mini size in one of the trial-kits and totally fell in love. I ran out and bought the full size as soon as I finished my mini. This cleanser lasts forever, and you don’t need to use much product to get a nice lather and wash. It doesn’t make my face tight or dry, and pairs beautifully with the rest of my routine. For reference, I live in a humid climate and have pretty normal skin.
Nice product, headline says it all, I tried a sample of it and it was amazing, gentile cleansing with slight foaming!
review_title: Smaller than I thought, a little dust on package

review_text: this is such a good face wash definitely recommend if you want your face to glow. My face is glowing from this product. LOVE!!!

I usually use check-and-balances frothy origins cleanser but they sold out at my local Sephora. No big deal! So one of the Sephora ladies really recommended to me this face wash and totally hyped up the product. Super excited to try it out and see how it went. First time I used it I felt like it just wasn’t doing it for me. I thought that I shouldn’t judge it for using it once. So I gave my self a week and then two weeks….well, it was a total disappointment. I seriously couldn’t tell you how sad I am to have spent $34 for a face wash that just feels like I’m using a bar soap on my face when I could have spent $25 for origins and really get my face nice and clean. I will say that it doesn’t dry up your face so I’ll give it that. But if you have oily skin/normal skin or have to watch out for blackheads/pimples this ain’t it.
review_title: Meh, don’t bother with this stuff

review_text: I love using this. My face always feels so clean and refreshed after using it. I use it to clean my face and as a makeup remover and it gets everything off. I mean everything. There’s always a hard to get crevice where my nose ring is, but this works fantastic and gets it, no problem.
Love The Clean Tight Feeling It Gives This Is My Second Time Buying :)

I’ve been using the drunk elephant jelly cleanser for years, and wanted to switch it up. I really like this formula…it does a good job getting my skin clean without stripping it, and I think it’s a bit less intense than my old cleanser. This one foams up, which I also like, and just like my old one, a little goes a long way. I use this as part of a double cleanse in evenings, and on its own in the morning.
I have dry and normal combo skin, this cleanser makes my skin feel so soft and moisturized. It’s the best, it’s so silky when I wash my face!

This cleanser is great! It makes my skin feel good without the stripping feeling. However, there is a light fragrance which could potentially be a problem for those with sensitive skin. The aroma didn’t irritate my skin but if you’re sensitive to fragrances, this cleanser could irritate you. The scent doesn’t linger and it smells fresh. For the price, I think you could find a better cleanser for cheaper if you’re on a budget but I personally loved this product.
I love this so much. My skin is really sensitive so there’s really not much that works for me and most products dry out my skin by a lot but this is perfect.

This is okay, I agree with others that it kinda reminds me of hand soap, not sure if it’s the smell or what it is. I find it a little hard to get out, it’s pretty thick, it doesn’t really foam so I find myself needing 3-4 pumps to feel like I’m getting my face clean. I think this is a great cleaner for really getting your makeup off. However, it is not for me. This makes my dry skin even drier and makes my skin feels super stripped of moisture.

Was disappointed in this cleanser I wanted a cleanser that would take my makeup off but this made my face feel like I still had a full face of makeup on. The only way it would come off would be by scrubbing it off.

I really like this cleanser! I wasn’t sure at first because of the small amount dispensed at a time but if you rub it in your hands until it foams before cleansing your face it’s perfect. It’s a nice, light weight cleanser and I actually adore them smell (it hits on something nostalgic to me). After so many bonding, bland creams I like a fun smelling product- especially when it hasn’t caused me any adverse skin reactions. My skin feels clean and soft after using.
Smells great, but it dries my face out to the point of damage. I have very dry skin, so this is a big no go.

I’ve been using this product for about a year now and it’s been one of the few that have helped me tackle my ongoing acne issues that I had for years. My skin is more clear than it ever has been. I see a lot of reviews saying it has dried out others skin. I have very dry skin naturally, and I don’t find this as all. I don’t use much, a little goes a long way. I use it both at night and in the morning. My winter day routine is a bit different. At night I use the Glow Toner (if my skin is too dry from the day I skip it) with a separate overnight cream (still trying to find one I love, in the summer I just use the Glow overnight one). In the morning I use the glow drops and lighter glow moisturizer with it. In the winter during the day I’ve been using stronger moisturizers for some eczema issues on top of the other 2 Glow products, and I’ve been managing fine. I just want to reiterate, the cleanser has nothing to do with my dry skin... it’s just very dry in general.Everyone’s skin is different but it’s worth a try, even if you have dry skin, I wouldn’t let the 1 star reviews sway you. It might just depend on what else you’re using with it. I have tried so many different cleansers and can honestly say I do love the feel of this; it’s so light, smells great, my skin feels incredibly fresh after and not oily. Once again, I attribute it in being a big part of fighting my ongoing acne issues. Incredibly grateful for this product!
review_title: It's been a year and I love it!

review_title: Perfect makeup enhancer, really is like a fog.

review_text: Hands down the finest mister ever, comes out of the spray nozzle perfect every time. The smell of watermelons is to die for. I cant wait to use this in the summer :)

I have been using product for ten days. If you enjoy the watermelon moisturizer you will love this. The scent is heavenly. The mister is as fine as it can be. The product has not irritated my skin at all which can be sensitive.   My skin loves it. Well done!!!

Great Light Mist!I love a good face mist - and am guilty of owning a couple different ones! This face mist is super fine and light and compared to many other mists, doesn’t leave your face feeling wet. It definitely feels moisturizing and refreshing, but less so than some other “wetter” mists. The application of the spray feels lux and expensive and the pump doesn’t drip or leak. The smell is the perfect amount of juicy watermelon without smelling sticky or artificial. The packaging is on par with other glow recipe products ... and I love how it’s travel friendly and fits perfectly in your hand. This will surely become my go-to mist for the spring and summer months!

Great mist that really is super light but moisturizing. Dries very quick so you can move on to the next step in your skincare/makeup routine without waiting for it to dry. I also like to use this midday during the dry winter season to help refresh my skin and makeup. Highly recommended. Especially to people who don’t like other mists which are more like “sprays“. This one is pleasant and smells like a classic watermelon candy.

I love how this mist looks, feels, and smells! I have super dry acne-prone skin, and this mist is a great way to prep my skin without drying it out. It’s ultra-light and doesn’t make my face feel wet, so it creates a nice base layer for toners, serums, and creams. I’ve also used it before I apply my make-up, as a setting spray, and to hydrate throughout the day, as it provides just the right amount of moisture. Plus, it smells nice with just a light watermelon smell.

This mist is fantastic! The nozzle is really high quality, so the mist comes out super fine. It’s hydrating and refreshing. I use it as a pep up on my bare skin during no-makeup days and also as a natural highlighter over makeup, it’s versatile as both. The smell reminds me of watermelon jollyrancher, but it’s more subtle and pleasant. I’m a big fan of AUSOME’s Rehydrating Double Mist as well (which is also Glow Recipe curated). In comparison to that one, the hydrating glow effects are about the same. I apply the watermelon mist more frequently as it is lighter, but there’s also more product with 75ml for the watermelon mist vs. 50ml for the AUSOME mist. I would even go so far to say I prefer the nozzle spray with the ultra-fine mist on the watermelon one to the AUSOME one. I have super sensitive skin and I’ve been using this mist pretty liberally this week as LA is dry af, so I can attest that it shouldn’t cause any sensitivity or redness. If you’re in doubt... just try it out!

Not usually a fan of face mists since they tend to leave my face feeling wet and slick but I’ve been super impressed with this. It’s *actually* a mist/fog that distributes uniformly and leaves my makeup intact underneath. It’s also been a lifesaver in the cold/windy weather and instantly hydrates and tones down any redness or sensitivity. It’s made a huge difference in the level of hydration of my skin throughout the day!

Have used this as a quick boost in hydration mid day and as a setting spray for make up, both ways yielded awesome results. Instant hydration and a little bit of a glow that lasted all day. Also, for what it’s worth, it’s almost the end of my day and my eyeliner an concealer hasn’t budged, usually I’m touching up by now. And it has the same delicate, natural watermelon scent as the rest of the line.

I love this. The mist is so fine that it is wonderful to set your makeup with and it won’t get splotchy. The smell is wonderful, almost like a jolly rancher and fresh laundry. The only thing that you have to remember is to shake it because it separates rather quickly. I would prefer it to set makeup with because of how fine the most is. Innovative and amazing. I’ve never tried a mist so fine!

This mist is super lightweight, perfect for setting makeup or a little pick-me-up. I’ve never seen a spray that has such soft, even coverage with such a high quality nozzle. It feels downright luxurious. Because it’s not particularly oily, I feel like it’ll be perfect for summer when humidity is an issue. For a New England winter, it’s not quite hydrating enough, but still feels like an amazing treat when paired with an oil mist. It brightens makeup and skin tone with a nice glow and some plumping without adding shine. The smell is amazing and doesn’t overwhelm. I have been using it for several weeks now (I received an early sample) and my sensitive skin has had no adverse reaction and is totally thriving with it. I use it at least 2-3 times a day because it’s such a delightful treat!

I’ve had this sitting on my desk at work, and I give myself a spritz once or twice a day. It makes my skin feel so refreshed and hydrated, and it feels like a boost in the afternoon. The beautiful smell that I love about the watermelon sleeping mask is here too. And this is not important to the product effectiveness, but it is really cute and pink and I don’t feel cluttery having it out on my desk. I was given the product to review for free by Glow Recipe, but I will happily purchase again when I run out.

I received this product for free from GlowRecipe to review - it’s a beautiful fine mist that I usually only find with very high end brands. I don’t feel like my face gets “wet“ when I spray it, it just moistens my face slightly. Smell is nice, unless you are very sensitive to sweet smells. Small enough to carry anywhere and doesn’t use too much product with each spray! I have dry skin and would have liked this spray to be a bit more moisturizing. I didnt’t feel like it did a great job in the hydration department, however I absolutely love it when setting my makeup and getting that dewy glow!

I was given the product to review for free by Glow Recipe“The positives: This smells AMAZING. I LOVE the mister. Every spray should take a cue from this sort of mister, it is so wonderful and creates a nice and relaxing atmosphere around you without getting wet. I also am in love with the aesthetics of the bottle. It also is great for refreshing makeup later in the day. The bad: This wasn’t hydrating enough for my skin type (combo with a lean towards dry) so didn’t do much for me. I am keeping my hopes up for an avocado version after this. I will keep it for the wonderful cloud of summer this makes. But the Whamisa rose does so much more for my skin (if only they had this fog mister on it).

I’m generally not a fan of watermelon or scented skin products as I have watermelon allergies (the actual fruit) and sensitive skin, but I was pleasantly surprised by this spray. The spray is ultra-fine and I LOVE the scent. It smells more like candy than watermelon and it doesn’t make me breakout or give me closed comedones. If you’re looking for a juicy spray that will illuminate your skin and makeup, this is it!

This product feels so good and refreshing! Usually mists/ sprays can make my contacts feel weird when I set my makeup, but this is so ultra fine it dries quickly and helps my face feel fresh all day. Yummy scent!

First off, this smells AMAZING! It’s almost worth it for the scent alone. I don’t have overly oily skin, but this mist definitely helped keep my skin oil free when wearing makeup. It also helped keep my makeup smooth and staying in place for a full evening on the town.
Very moisturizing - nice to take with me for travel moisturizing.  The scent is very sweet watermelon - sometimes the scent does get to me but for the most part is a wonderful product
I love this stuff it gives you such a radiant glow without being oily I love the smell and It did really great setting my makeup too

I was given the product to review for free by Glow recipe. That being said, I had to purchase a second bottle because my older swiped the first from me after I used it. First of all this bottle is adorable . It’s cute and pink , how can you not like that ? The smell is amazing, like you just cut open a juicy ripe watermelon. You can use this two ways 1) as a hydrating mist or 2) as a setting spray. I used it as a hydrating mist since the weather in the San Francisco Bay Area is a little weird at times.You would think that it being watermelon it would leave your face sticky but it doesn’t . Remember to shake your bottle first to fully mix the two layers then spray 3-4 bursts from 8 inches away. The mist is very fine, not like you are shouting yourself with a water gun.Once fully absorbed you are left with soft, hydrated and glowing skin. Honestly, I love this . Sometimes I just can’t carry around a tube or tub of moisturizer . Other times I just don’t want the heaviness of a moisturizer. This is perfect for me. It gives me the perfect amount of hydration, portable and the smell brightens my mood.I will purchase this multiple times in the future.

I was given this product for free by Glow Recipe in exchange for a review. This is a very, very fine mist which is perfect for over makeup. I have very oily skin and have had a hard time finding a mist that works well over makeup, but this one does the trick! It gives the perfect glowy/dewy look without ever looking soaked or oily. However, if you are looking for a more hydrating mist, I would find something with a less fine mister/sprayer. The watermelon scent is strong, smells the same as Glow Recipe’s other products, so if those do not appeal to you, I would proceed with caution. The scent does not bother me, but I can see how others might not like it. Overall, I think this is a great mist for its value and I would definitely purchase this.

I was given the product to review for free by Glow Recipe.  To be honest, I don’t really use mists.  It was certainly nice to receive and try out, but I don’t end up reaching for it much because I don’t use this type of product frequently.  For what it is, it is a very nice product...smells amazing, hydrating, and toning.  Mist lovers will certainly want to pick up this gem!

I love it ! its great for travel and to just stick it in my purse and spray the mist before putting on my daily makeup or after! btw it doesn’t smell funny, the mist does go on lightly, it has hyaluronic acid which is a great ingredient as I live in miami and the moisture is sucked out of my skin lol! I use it daily and it has not caused me pimples or no irritation.

Fantastic product. It sprays on light and doesn’t leave your face feeling wet or sticky. I received this product from glow recipe but intend to repurchase.

“I was given the product to review for free by Glow Recipe“ I first tried the mist after I washed my face in my nightly routine. My face felt refreshed and newly hydrated. great little mist! has not given me any pimples or rashes, perfect for sensitive skin.
