This mist is my new ride or die. The mist is so fine, I wasn’t sure if I doused myself with enough product but then after 2-3 spritz my skin definitely felt hydrated! I love the Ausome Australia Double Mist, but the spray is kinda harsh and you can see actual droplets on your peach fuzz (not a fan). The Watermelon Glow mist DOES NOT, I repeat, DOES NOT, do that to your face!The scent is soooo yummy! And this bottle is TSA friendly. What more do you want?? Thank you Glow Recipe <3

I got this product for free from Glow Recipe to try out and review. Let me tell you why I gave it full stars:-Packaging is beautiful! Along with the rest of their watermelon line -Fragrance is very pleasant. Not too strong, but enough to give you a luxurious spa feeling. And you can’t go wrong with that delicious watermelon aroma. -That mist though! Ultra fine as it states, just perfection! Just the right amount of dewiness and glow. I have extremely dry and sensitive skin and in this winter, I have been loving using this mist along with the rest of my skin care. I carry it to work so I can refresh my face/makeup mid-day! I have also used it by itself on days I’m not going anywhere and feel too lazy for full skincare. And just this mist will keep my face plump and glowing and hydrated all day! Love it! Would absolutely recommend! We need more products like this!

I was given this product free to review from Glow Receipe. This is my honest review. My skin is dry, acne prone, and sensitive. As far as mists go this isn’t my favorite, but it wasn’t bad. My skin didn’t have any reactions or breakouts. A fairly moisturizing and very fine mist good for using during the day for a pick me up or right after a shower before doing my skin routine. I do not recommend trying to use it as a setting spray as it did nothing for holding my makeup. For those sensitive to fragrance, I wouldn’t recommend as it has a very sweet watermelon smell that does linger. Ultimately would recommend to give it a try, but I will be sticking with my favorite mists.

When they say “ultra fine mist”, they mean ultra fine mist!This product came out of the bottle so smooth, and yes, ultra fine!  Because of this I felt that I got super even coverage to set my makeup. Other mists I have used come out in bigger droplets and it feels like forever to let them dry. Not this one!  Quick drying, even coverage. Now let’s talk about the smell...pure heaven!  Sweet and fruity without being too sweet. I get headaches and nauseous with overpowering scents, but this one is perfect!And how does it look?  Perfect. It gave my skin the right amount of glow I am looking for. I do not like super shiny, highlighting shimmers, but I do want a healthy looking glow. This totally delivered!  My skin looks dewy and perfect.
review_title: So much more than I hoped for!

review_text: this mist smells just like watermelon and hydrates beautifully. Another good product from glow receipe.

The bottle is a great size and shape.  It fits comfortably in your hand and feels secure to hold for on-the-go misting.  My only complaint is that it isn’t as hydrating as I would like. However, I am a Glow Recipe fan and will continue to use it and see if there are any improvements!
review_title: OK hydrating mist with GREAT smell

review_text: I am a lover of all things Glow Recipe and was super excited when I found out that they were coming out with a Watermelon Glow Face Mist. I had a chance to try it before it being released and was blown away by the first spray.  It has a beautiful and continuous ultra fine mist. and smells just like the other glow recipe products. It gives my skin a subtle glow and is very light, I love using it before my skincare routine or after to lock in even more moisture. I used it the other day on my beauty blender to blend out my foundation and I was obsessed with how smooth and luminous my skin looked. Can’t wait till the weather heats up so I can store in my fridge and use on the go as a cool refreshing mist. Another winner Glow Recipe
review_title: Smells great and super gentle on my skin! LOVE IT!

The nozzle is perfect and sprays an even amount of product all over your face. It leaves your face glowy and moisturized -- perfect for makeup! It’s also very refreshing after your makeup as well. The smell is the same as the watermelon sleeping mask. It’s pleasant and doesn’t linger.The packaging is cute and portable. You can easily chuck this in your purse for whenever you need to freshen up. There’s a generous amount of product in there as well. The cap is also quite secure, which is important if you want to keep it in your bag.
Beautiful formulation. Very hydrating and perfect for a refresher throughout the day. But, I almost feel like the mist is too fine. I have to pump it about 20 times before I get the desired effect.

I was given the product to review for free by Glow RecipeI loved the scent of this - smells exactly like glowrecipes other watermelon products! The mist is super fine and feels very luxurious. However the price seems pretty high for the amount you get. But at the end of the day it’s a great product!!

I was given the product to review for free by Glow Recipe. I love this product for setting my makeup after I use translucent powder. It gives my face the dewyness the powder took away, without taking away the longevity of my makeup that using powder gives me. My face feels hydrated and not tight at all.

I was given the product to review for free by Glow Recipe.I used the mist in 2 different ways: 1) to hydrate my face at night. It is winter in NYC and my skin gets dry from the heaters. When it gets too hot/dry at night I mist this on my face and my skin is instantly rejuvenated and it feels fresh and hydrated when I wake up. 2) Also tried this setting my makeup which I was worried about b/c I have oily skin. Surprisingly it worked really well!! Didn’t make me look greasy at all. Just glowy and fresh. (I think it helped that I wore a matte foundation.) I’m excited to use this in the summer!! (Pro tip: pop it in the fridge!!)

I love this as a hydrating mist! I am an oily girl, so I don’t use it to set my face unless I am feeling particularly dry or cakey. The most is super fine, the smell is amazing and it absorbs effortlessly. I was given the product to review for free by Glow Recipe.

I am usually not a fan of mists, but this one has completely changed my mind!  It is a ultra fine mist that  gives a subtle glow, while hydrating and refreshing your skin. The watermelon scent is ah-mama-zing! I  have tried the other watermelon skin products by Glow Recipe and this one is a great addition. I like to use it for extra hydration after moisturizer, and as a skin refresher throughout the day. Highly recommend!

I need 20 more! This is such an amazing product. The sprayer creates a mist and does not soak my face like most sprays. It is multipurpose I use it before my moisturizer and after my makeup. The smell is heaven (the same as the watermelon mask and moisturizer). Makes my skin glowy and is great on makeup!!

I bought this the moment it was released on Glow Recipe’s website . Here are my thoughts after using it for some time now : A great mist for a quick hydration ( remember to press down and hold , for a true fog-mist experience ! ), can be used as a toner,  makeup setting spray,  great for traveling , doesn’t leak,  high-quality nozzle,  amazing Jolly Rancher watermelon flavored scent , etc.  It’s not going to replace your moisturizer or anything like that ( not super hydrating but sufficient for a mist ). Put it in the fridge for an even more refreshing experience .

I received this product for free from Glow Recipe in exchange for an honest review. I am from San Francisco and I know fog. And this is the most lux fog I’ve ever experienced. It is a treat for your senses and for your skin. I use it in between each step of my skincare routine as well as a makeup setting spray after I powder my face. It adds that extra bit of hydration and protection that helps each skin care product to absorb into my skin as well as provide that extra glow without making my face feel oily. I love the spray. The mist is so fine that you don’t get startled from having huge droplets “attacking” your face. Everytime I use this I feel like I’m really taking care of myself, like I’m living my best life, even though it’s a such a small thing. And when I spray it on my friends I feel as if I’m taking care of them and we feel closer as a result. I have combo skin that tends toward oily and have acne and this has not bothered me or made me break out. I feel like it’s saving me this winter, where everywhere is so dry because of the heaters being on, I spray this and my skin feels soothed. I’m also looking forward to using this on a plane, especially during a long flight. If you have drier skin I think you’ll have to definitely layer this between other richer products because this is so light, this may not be hydrating enough for you. But I still think any skin type will enjoy using this beauty because there are so many different applications.

I work in a very dry office environment and wanted something simple to help add a bit of moisture to my parched skin in the afternoons. This is truly wonderful! It works well over my minimal daytime makeup, smells terrific, and doesn’t bug out my sensitive skin. My skin looks and feels refreshed -- and that’s just what I wanted.

I received this mist a week ago thinking it would just “do it’s job“ and would be hydrating, universal, the usual. I was pleased to see that it actually travel friendly AND it’s formula and fine mist actually works sooo great with makeup. I would spray my beauty blender with this instead of dampening it to apply my foundation and then touch up with it throughout the day. My skin was too sensitive for the urban decay setting sprays while also I wasn’t liking the results of using my more “skincare focused“ mists for makeup.. I felt like i couldn’t get the perfect in-between if you know what i’m mean? Cause in a way you can get away with both for any mist but, it just led to extra shine and not really working FOR my foundation.. that was until i found this baby!!I have a trip coming up and I was worried about my dehydrated skin and having to wear full-makeup for long hours in Vegas/Cali weather however, I think the timing that this product came in my life couldn’t have been any more perfect.

Love this product, I’m a huge rose water spray & this just one ups it. Soothing on the face, doesn’t upset my eczema (I actually find it’s helped keep it at bay). Gives a nice natural glow after spraying. I haven’t used it as a makeup setting spray but enjoying it as a daily (or whenever) spray. My husband even enjoys it on his face, so this def will be a household staple!
This product is prefect for hydrating your face and helping preserve your makeup. It sprays so beautifully!!
Love the smell and it feels great on my skin!

I love using this mist as a refresher throughout the day, especially right now when it’s winter in Chicago and my skin is drier than usual. It does feel slightly tacky after spraying so I don’t use this in my skincare right after cleansing in conjunction with serums or moisturizers. I definitely feel an immediate difference and find my skin to no longer feel tight. The mist smells like watermelon jolly ranchers and though I personally don’t like watermelon scents in general, I can see a lot of people liking this. The only thing that was slightly annoying is that the bottle is inverted and can only stand up with the cap on; there have been a lot of times when I try to set it back down on my vanity after spraying and it just falls off my desk since I didn’t recap it. That’s just a minor annoyance though and I do really like the product. I did receive this complimentary for review purposes.
Omg this smells exactly like watermelon! I just wanna keep spraying! I’ve used it as a mist and it’s so refreshing.  Also my face feels soft after using it.
I’m in love with this mist. It smells amazing and leaves my skin feeling soft and fresh!

I absolutely adore Glow Recipe and when they released this product, I was beyond ecstatic. I love their watermelon sleeping mask and their moisturizer and now I can get it in a spray?? The mist on this spray is so incredibly fine and it disperses product so well!!  I have oily skin and I’ve used this as my setting spray or just throughout the day to refresh my skin. It smells lovely and it feels so hydrating and fresh!! It doesn’t feel like it’s heavy on my skin either. I recommend this 110% to anyone.
I love how hydrating this mist is, my 30 something year old skin needs all the hydration it can get to fight of those wrinkles. Keep up the glow ladies.

It’s nice and cute, but a little expensive for what it is. I don’t think the mist is that fine or the ingredients are significantly better compares to the fresh Vitamin Nectar Antioxidant Face Mist (which is also less expensive) or the caudalieBeauty Elixir.
Amazing. Fresh. Travel friendly. The mist is so fine. Great for hydration. Highly recommend!

I was given the product to review for free by Glow Recipe. First off, I LOVE the packaging. I am a total geek about packaging. It looks so pretty! The pale pink is I think what the internet seems to be calling millennial pink. A bit of sleek and a shade more pink than the baby pink of the 90’s. The floaty redness of the watermelon I thought looked cool. It made me hungry for watermelon while at the same time being concerned if I should turn down the temperature of my make up refrigerator...Second, I dig the smell. I didn’t read if it had synthetic fragrance...sorry. I just trusted the visual of the red watermelon floaty-ness in the fluid to justify the wonderfully delicious watermelon fragrance.Third, love the actual product. It isn’t too tacky but I’ve only used it at night. Have not yet tried it under make up. It’s part of my nighttime regiment. Back to packaging, it does spray a nice even FINE mist. I ought to try it under with make up or with make up...

I love Glow Recipe’s watermelon moisturizer so I wanted to give it a try. I think this mist is little pricey than other mists since it only has 75mL. But I do love their formula, which contains hyaluronic acid and few natural ingredients to detoxify and moisture.

OMG you guys!! I’m absolutely living for this setting spray! I tried it for the first time this morning (sprayed a decent amount twice), it’s been over 6 hours and my makeup is still looking so good, hasn’t separated or gotten cakey, and best of all: I’m not an oil slick like I usually would have been by now! I’m seriously blown away by this. Upon initial application I noticed that any dry patches + my makeup’s powdery-ness instantly disappeared (without making me look dewy). It gave my skin a super natural and healthy looking finish, which I’ve been obsessed with this year.If you’re debating over whether or not to give this a try I’d totally recommend to do so! It definitely lived up to my expectations and then some :)I’m gonna have to stock up on these soon as I know I’ll be using it all the time hahaha

I purchased this as soon as it launched and I LOVE it. It smells amazing (like real watermelon) and the mist is super fine. I use it as a booster before I put my serum on and to add a slight gloss to my makeup. It doesn’t “set“ makeup, but does remove any dry powdery looking areas. I can’t wait to use this during the hotter months as a refresher during the day. Winner.

This is so refreshing! The formula is lightweight and hydrating. It makes my skin look dewy and flawless. It’s a great refresher for my makeup if I need it. The best part is the smell! This smells so delicious it’s just like fresh watermelon! I enjoy that it feels like a burst of hydration/ watermelon and puts me in a feel good mood! I would highly recommend it and if you enjoy glow recipe’s other watermelon products you will definitely want to add this to your collection.
review_title: Hydrating and puts me in a good mood

review_text: First thing, the delivery system for this mist should be adopted by all skin care companies.  It is so fine and delicate and doesn’t drench the face. Now for more mature skin this is not going to give you a lot of hydration, it would be perfect for an oily skin that doesn’t want to be too glowy. Has a wonderful smell that is not overpowering or artificial smelling. Keep in mind I live in the desert and hyaluronic acid attracts water to it, so in a dry environment it does not work as well.  I think as a setting spray it excels.
Amazing!! Light mist feels super refreshing on the skin
this stuff is so lightweight and refreshing. I like misting this on after I finish my makeup and at night after my skincare routine. will def buy again!
Love, love, love this really hydrating mist.  It is not tacky at all like some mists that I have previously tried.

The ultra fine mist is great and hydration boosting was about average. The scent however was far too strong for something that’s intended to be sprayed multiple times a day. It smells like watermelon candy, like a Jolly Rancher. The scent also lingers so everyone around you will also smell your watermelon candy scent. It’s too juvenile for me, so I’ll be returning it
review_title: Watermelon scent is too strong and lingers

review_text: Let me say, I love Glow Recipe and have been really pleased with quite a few of their other products, some purchased from Sephora and many purchased directly from their site. This Watermelon glow mist however is all hype. It does however, smell delicious, it really is a light/fine mist, it’s small, cute and compact, which is great for travel and everyday carrying, but that is just where it stops for me. I’m dry skin and I didn’t get any type of hydration with this, even when applying it in between applying serums. It didn’t set my make-up or make it or me look any more dewy/glowy than any of the other products in my regular skincare routine.I really wanted to love it but I don’t. I like it for the smell and how cute and convenient the packaging is, but that’s not really worth $28+ bucks, or referring this to anyone. Now if you just want an extra face mist to add to your collection and don’t mind spending $28+ bucks on one, then yes, I say go for it. Being that I can be a product junkie and like how this looks on my skincare shelf, I won’t be returning it, I’ll just use this up and won’t repurchase it.

in love w this!!!! the cutest packaging dang the best mister i have ever felt! so fine and soothing! highly recommend and not too expensive, i’ve ya the tatch luminous dewy skin mist which is very expensive and this glow recipe one is much much better :)

I have been obsessed with the entire Glow Recipe watermelon line and this mist is no different! I can’t wait to use this in warmer months because it’s so refreshing. It smells delicious like candy and leaves my skin feeling super smooth! I’m really pleased with this so far and also happy with the price point. I received this for free from Glow Recipe but I will repurchase this along w the rest of the line as usual!

I live and die by bi-phase mists, aka mists with a separate water component and oil component. Something about that particular composition and the lack of emulsifier just comes together really well to hydrate, plump, and revive my skin. Currently, I have 4 different bi-phase mists in my stash and this mist from Glow Recipe is a new favorite. The mist is every bit as fine as promised! I spray very generously and it doesn’t disturb my makeup one bit. It also smells AMAZING! I’ve seen others describe the scent as watermelon Jolly Rancher but I dislike Jolly Ranchers but quite enjoy this scent, so YMMV! Overall, very pleased with this new release!Disclaimer: I was given this product to review for free by Glow Recipe. That said, all thoughts and opinions expressed her are honest and my own.
This product was ok not my favorite I didn’t notice a @glow” in my skin probably would not purchase again

Sent is out of this work. Enough dew to hydrate but doesn’t change the look of my matte foundation in a way that I would call it dewy. Just hydrated which is exactly what I wanted. The smell makes this a new holy grail because who doesn’t want to have a watermelon on their face all day long.

This mist works really well as a base for makeup. I usually will mist my face before putting on foundation, and I’ve noticed a big difference in how long my foundation lasts throughout the day. I’ve also found that the mist has helped keep my super oily skin a little more balanced. I usually mist my face directly after I blot, and I’ve found that doing this has decreased the number of times I blot throughout the day (the norm would be around 3-4 times, and now its around 1-2). Definitely recommend!
review_title: Works well as a base for makeup!

review_text: I cannot say enough good things about this. The mist on this baby is exactly as described: ultra-fine. It’s like a light coating of moisture for a lift-me-up. It’s amazing. I will say it smells like watermelon which I LOOOOOVE but if watermelon isn’t your thing: I’m so sorry. You’re missing out, but you might want to steer clear of this. I’m honestly thinking of carrying it in my purse (I don’t carry a large purse and have to ration what I have with me). But anyways: it’s amazing. Definitely get it if you think you’d like it. You absolutely will.

I just can’t get enough of this! It gives me a nice pick me up when I’m doing my morning and evening skincare routine. My skin looks more plump and bright. I also carry this along with me to work to spray on my face when I’m feeling like I need a boost of hydration. The smell is amazing. So good that I bought two!
review_title: I TAKE IT EVERYWHERE I GO!

review_text: This feels like heaven raining on you
The best mister I’ve ever used.  It’s super fine and smells wonderful.  Not the most hydrating and it’s definitely smaller than I anticipated.  Great for travel or throwing in your bag.

This is prehaps the best mist I’ve purchased so far!  Now the product is a bit smaller than I was expecting it to be (about the size of your whole fist clenched), but it’s really cute and simplistic.  The mister is extremely good! It produces such a fine, even mist each time I use it.  Most sprays eventually have dripping or the mist part breaks or it’s very uneven spray, but the way they made this mister is perfect! The mister is shorter and quiet wide to prevent the mister from getting messed up over time.  The cap is also very secure, I would recommend this for travelers.  It’s compact enough that you could easily take this in your purse and go.  The formulation itself is very nice and light.  It’s not too drenching and it feels very refreshing and it Definetly does set your makeup for the day.  This is a mist that all skin types could use.  The mist is also a very pleasant watermelon scent, stronger than their other watermelon products in my opinion.  It’s not at all a gimmicky or fake watermelon scent.  The formula does need to be shaken before every use because It separates in the bottle very quickly (30 seconds).  It also adds a very healthy glow to your skin when you wear no makeup (even someone who sweats a lot could get good use out of this glow look).  I also find that this mist actually absorbs significantly better than a lot of other mists which are normally either 1. Not skincare use at all or 2. Too heavy/thick from serum like ingredients to absorb into skin and interferes with makeup.  It’s the perfect balance of skincare use and beauty use.
review_title: Perfect Balance Of Skincare and Beauty Use

review_text: Obsessed!! So glowy and smells amazing

i looooove this stuff i spray it when i have a clean face i spray it when i have on makeup when im hot and sweat i just spray it all the time and i love the watermelon sent its the best spray the spray nozzle is great i just love love love and will repurchase

It looks like pink water and oil in the bottle. Smells like it’s going to be sticky. Spray is very fine and even. It is quite small in person, not as good as the Fresh Face Mist. You get 8.4oz of spray for $44, which is like 3 times the amount in this product.
review_title: Not the Best not the Worst

review_text: Was on the fence with this new product as all of the “fancy mists“ I have tried never lived up to the expectations, however, this one is definitely worth it! It makes my skin super silky and soft either with or without makeup on, the subtle watermelon scent is lovely and refreshing as well!

I love korean skin care and glow recipe is one of my faves. However for 28 dollars this is a very small bottle for a mist. Sure Tatcha and other “luxury” mists are also quite small but somehow i expected more from Glow Recipe—ESPECIALLY since one is supposed to mist throughout the day. I’ll be done with this in 2 weeks! It’s nice but not amazing. It’s hydrating but not mind blowing. I can get lots of other Korean mists for 20 dollars that will last me 6-8 months.
review_title: A lot hype, very small bottle for price

review_text: I love the smell and look this setting mist gives me, the only critique I have is that the mist is TOO fine. I know they market it as “Ultra-Fine Mist”, but my goodness that is VERY fine mist. The instructions say only to use 2-3 sprays, but I feel like I need about 15-20 to cover my entire face...and that is with it being extremely close to my face. I do love this as a refresher spray and can see myself using this during the summertime a lot.

Love the mister on this mist. Just a little disappointed it’s smaller than I expected so took off one star. It smells amazing!! Reminds me of the watermelon jolly rancher which is my favorite flavor of all of them.

Meant to add the following to my prior review: the sprayer mechanism on this is awesome...like a cloud.  This bottle is worth reusing when the product is gone.  And, I find that with repeated use the product moisturized my skin and leaves a nice moisturizer glow.

I’ve collected quite a few Korean facial mists over the last year and like to use them to set my make-up and to add a dose of moisturizer to my skin at the office which really dries out of my already dry skin due to the heating/air system. I’ve used this spray a handful of times over the last couple weeks, and it is really a very enjoyable experience. The mist comes out super fine and it smells delicious. Some mists are not fine enough for using over make-up, but I would not worry about using this to set make-up as it is extremely fine and very refreshing to use. It does feel initially moisturizing, but the moisturizing effect doesn’t last as long as I’d like. I’d say this is great mist for normal to oily skin. If you have very dry skin you’ll need to be sure to seal in the moisture with a cream or lotion on top.
Love this! Such a fine mist/fog... and refreshes my face and seals in moisture! Buying a back up soon!

Unreal. This product actually reallu surprised me. I bought it on a whim because the watermelon Glow Recipe products have always called my name, but they are a little pricey. This product has actually gotten rid of some of my accutane dryness and has made makeup application more possible. It also smells amazing and gives a beautiful glow. Also, the mist is so fine and lovely. It doesn’t make you wet at all. Although expensive, in my opinion this is worth the price.
Smells amazing and is super refreshing

it smells amazing so that’s nice. I do think it’s nicely hydrating but not more so than a lot of the others. the mister is a bit too fine for my taste - I don’t want to be aggressively sprayed in the face but I feel like I have to spray a lot to get my face damp/ But overall non irritating and plays well with other products
Smells great , doesn’t really do anything for me but make my face sticky for 5 minutes .
I’ve never used a spray that has such a fine mist, and I love it! The scent is amazing. I used this right after applying my makeup, and once during the day. Love it.
Absolutely love the refreshing mist and scent. The mist is very fine and covers the entire face. I am so happy I purchased this

This mist was sitting all by its lonesome on an aisle shelf on my way out of the store. I had originally went to the back of the store looking for it after reading great reviews. I noticed it was sold out on the back wall and I just happened to see the last one on a side aisle shelf. I love this mist! It smells good and it’s not too strong. The ultra fine mist makes it to where your face still feels dry not drenched after application. I can’t tell you how many times I’ve tried a face mist and I felt like my hair and face were watered down afterward. This mist is nice and the spray atomizer is perfect. You have to shake it to activate and mix the mist so the color of the pic is what it looks like once shaken. It will go back to being clear once it settles back down. The feel of my skin is hydrated, but not greasy. I have used this though the day and it doesn’t get greasier or build up after so many uses. I think this mist hits all the marks when it comes to the goals of a facial mist. My skin looks dewy and soft and IS dewy and soft.
review_title: This mist does what it says it will do.

review_text: Best makeup setting spray I have come across in a while! It really helps keep my makeup in place and also is very hydrating. The ingredients alone had me purchasing it before I even saw any reviews. Finding a setting spray without alcohol, silicones and mineral oil is nearly impossible, so this checked all my boxes. I left one star off only because the bottle was much smaller than I expected. Literally the only negative thing about this product. A $28 setting spray should be AT LEAST 100 mL. When I opened the box and saw how small it was I went back onto Glow Recipe’s website to make sure I didn’t accidentally order a mini or travel size. For the first time ever I was actually disappointed to learn that I ordered the right size and in fact, the product only comes in one size. Urban Decay’s famed setting spray All Nighter is $32 but you get 118 mL, and Too Faced’s Hangover Primer
Out of all the mist I’ve tried this is my 2nd favorite and I love watermelon mask also

I am overly obsessed with this face mist. It smells amazing and leaves me feeling oh-so refreshed while also keep my makeup in check. Though it is quite small (2.54oz) the mist is very fine so I know it’ll last.
this is a must in your skin prep, It smells amazing and the amount of mist that comes out when you spray it feels like heaven

Besides the bottle being smaller than the other full size setting sprays, it’s a really nice product! I have very sensitive skin and i did find it very calming for my redness and did not irritate my face! the mist is SO fine you can’t feel it hitting your skin unless you spray it closely or watch yourself in the mirror. Feels so nice and smells really good!

the mist is so fine I love it. it has a continuous spray which is nice. the scent is a beautiful light watermelon scent that lingers briefly and does not bother my migraine inclined brain. here is why I gave it 4 stars, it has a very fine shimmer. I guess that is where the “glow“ comes from. I wouldn’t mind it so much if it was mentioned in the description but it is not. it has great ingredients and is lovely for refreshing throughout the day, setting your makeup and to cool down on a hot day. I definitely recommend trying it.
This is an extremely hydrating mist.  I have combination skin that is also sensitive and this didn’t irritate at all. I look forward to using this product when I travel this summer.
Refreshing, fun to use , smells delicious ! I like to use it over the mask or moisturizer to lock in the moisture! Packaging is adorable as usual. Love glow recipe products!
Super fine mist, hydrating and leaves a nice glow.

If you haven’t bought this or tried it yet you’re truly missing out! This leaves my face feeling soft, cooled, and glowing! It comes out as a mist instead of a spray. It leaves my face smelling like a watermelon jolly rancher! It’s a must have and a never stop buying!!!

dang. really wanted to love this facial mist because all of my friends do. tried it against my better judgment even tho rice germ is its 3rd ingredient and highly comedogenic. Broke Me Out after one use! I have my esthetician’s license and am slapping myself on the wrist ): lol
Smells great and has amazing benefits too! Love how weightless this feels and how subtle the glow is as well.

the smell is great, but that’s the only good thing about this. It did not hydrate or help set my makeup. I thought about keeping it just for the delicious smell,  but the scent goes away almost immediately. There are many other brands and a lot of them have a better price point.

This helps with redness so much and is so hydrating I almost feel like I don’t need to go in with a moisturizer after. I had a break out when I first started using this and I feel like it actually helped clear it up a lot quicker. New ride or die product and it smells amazing!! The mist on it as well is 10/10.
This is my favorite spray.  The mist is so fine and won’t spit at you.  Smells great, and amazing ingredients.  I will definitely repurchase, my other sprays can go in the trash.

Look. You don’t NEED a $28 face mist. BUT if you want to treat yourself, buy it! The mist itself is light and smells nice, the watermelon isn’t overpowering. Makes my skin feel plump and glowy without feeling sticky. I’ve been using it more as a part of my nighttime routine vs a makeup setting spray. When I have sprayed it over makeup, I didn’t notice any significant changes. One of my favorite things about this is the continuous spray radius: A+ Well done!

I loveeee thissssssss!!! Is soo moisturizing and it lasts for hours. Its lightweight and when my friends ask to try they squint soo hard that it makes me laugh because is so lightt its like a fog just like they said :)
My favorite mist. Smells and feels great!
This stuff is amazing! Permanently taking its place on my shelf for all day hydration in an ultra fine mist. Must have!!!

I thought I wouldn’t like this since my tzone is oily & I usually go for a matte look, but OH MY G. After spraying this over my makeup i look like my skin is just naturally contoured & smooth! It melts all the makeup together in the most flawless way possible! Not heavy or greasy AT ALL ANDDD it’s smells so delicious that I go a little overboard spraying it sometimes, really love this product & the fact that there’s no alcohol or fragrance!!
I love the mist, it really does feel like a very light mist... i just wish it was a little cheaper

I love love the watermelon moisturizer and mask. Was so excited for this but unfortunately the most was WAY TOO FINE that I had to use SOOOO much and I still didn’t feel refreshed or any hydration. Like I felt my face and it was wet but that’s it. I wanted to love this but returned it

Maybe I’m just entranced by the scent, but I love this product! I am taking off one star because the mist is so light that I feel like I need several pumps (not just one or two) to feel like I’m getting results, but after that it does feel really nice. I use this more for skincare than to set makeup.
This smells so good! The sprayer is very fine, so it’s like walking into a tiny cloud of happy watermelon jolly ranchers. Definitely expensive for what it is, but that’s the only drawback.
I guess I don’t get it. The mister is superfine and amazing. I adore the scent but I see absolutely no difference on my skin. I’ve used it before and after make up.

Is this doing anything for my skin? Honestly, I don’t know. Is this a magical setting spray? Not really. Does it come out in a super fine foggy mist that feels super luxurious? You better believe it! Honestly, it smells so delicious and feels so refreshing and luxurious that it puts me in a great mood in the mornings and for that alone, I’ll totally keep buying this.
Works great alone love how it makes my skin glow however it doesn’t work as a setting spray for me...made me look oily after a few hours
Over priced mist! And they don’t include water or a preservative on the ingredient list. I work in cosmetic manufacturing, how do you make a mist without water???

I really underestimated how much I would like this product! I have dry skin and this spray does make me look more dewy. But more than that I feel like it just completes and refines my makeup look. It makes my makeup melt into my skin so it doesn’t just sit on top of it and gives me that glow from within. Love it!
I haven’t used this mist long so you can take that into consideration in this review. The delicious scent alone makes this product worth it!! It is perfect. I am sensitive so scents

I was not going to buy this because it is a lot of money for a small bottle. Plus, I have other mists. I tried it in the store and fell in love. It is a refreshing and very fine mist that smells delicious. I am hooked.

This spray is amazing and refreshing, a definite must for the summer! I find it is a tad sticky for a couple seconds while it dries but the glow it leaves makes up for it! I love the fine misty spray it gives out and the watermelon smell to me smells like freshly cut watermelons. I would definitely recommend!

I’m super into this! Bought based on a YouTuber I follow just to try and I’m kind of obsessed. The mist is so amazingly fine that it never feels really “wet.“ The scent smells just like a fresh watermelon. Between the ultra-fine mist and the fruity scent this mist is just so refreshing; I cannot wait to use this in the summertime! I will say that it doesn’t provide amazing hydration, but I have placed it over makeup without the makeup running or looking oily on my (already oily) skin. It definitely provides a subtle bounce and glow to the skin that I really enjoy.
I don’t know why but I expected a much bigger bottle. I am curious, how long it would last me. Not sure how much it is actually doing for the skin? I does feel nice though.

its like any other spray—- and it leaves me feeling a little sticky. the scent is amazing, but otherwise i feel like this product is just average, especially with how little the product has. I got this a month ago and im more than halfway done. Overall, its a fine mist, but I would invest my money in a cheaper spray that does the same thing this one does.
Yes Its ultra fine! But didn’t see any difference after spraying.. didn’t see any glow. Not of any use. Doesn’t even hydrate.
Smells amazing! Lightweight and a great was to feel refreshed

Fail. I would say it doesn’t deserve any stars but it does smell good. Unfortunately that’s all it seems to do. It caused me to break out, not horribly but definitely some pimples when I normally have none. It also doesn’t seem to visibly do anything to my skin. I switched to this from Saturday Skin’s face mist thinking it would be the same product but have a watermelon scent. I will definitely be going back to Saturday Skin!
I love this spray it smells yummy amd gives me a good.. GLOW! I use it after skin care routine morning and night but wish it was cheaper because I just want to spray all day!
Great mister, great smell and great hydration! Everyhing about this spray gets me excited.

I was really impressed with this product. This is the first time I was inspired to write a review on any product. I didn’t expect that much because while I liked it, I wasn’t that blown away by the sleeping mask they make. However, this product is so light and misty and refreshing. The scent alone helps the mood. But what really got to me to write a review was that it made my face soooo incredibly soft the next day.
Beautiful product ! Love the smell & the mist is very fine so I feel like I use more of the product ! But other then it’s a beauty !
I was excited when this came out and had to buy it. The mist smells very good but I don’t think it helps set my makeup at all.
Such a refreshing mist. Watermelon juice gives you a bright and dewy look, while apple cider vinegar keeps you from getting too oily throughout the day. This stuff is incredible.

I was a little worried about the size of this when I received it, considering the price, but I realize now that this will last me quite a while!  The ultra fine mist helps to control the amount of spray used and also helps to make a more accurate spritz!  I will definitely be purchasing again!
Lovely scent, but left my skin feeling very sticky. Unfortunately a return item for me.

It wasn’t all that to me, I fell for the hype lol. Other than that the smell is amazingly fresh - like fresh watermelon. For me it wasn’t hydrating enough with the soft mist, I found myself constantly spraying more than I should to feel  something, idk it just wasn’t for me
It’s good but small? smells amazing just like the watermelon line smells..mist is very very light so u need like 10 sprays so is say 4 stars because of the size
review_title: good but smaller than I expected

review_text: Loving this product so far! I love the smell of it and the way it makes your face feel it doesn’t leave a sticky residue behind. I also love that you can reapply it over make up throughout the day and that it works as a face prep or a finishing spray. I really like having my face smell like a watermelon ha ha. I would really like to get the moisturizer now.
I don’t get all the hoopla with this! Yes, it smells great but no, my skin does not look more hydrated after using it.
Meh. It smells great but I’m not seeing the skin benefits and I feel like I have to use alot to get any product on my face. And yes I know, it’s an “ultra-fine mist“ but that does not mean invisible.
Love! Extremely hydrating and super fine mist. Feels great when I wake up and before doing my makeup.Did I mention is hydrating? Dry patches have disappeared for the meanwhile :-)

I don’t understand the good reviews for this product. The fragrance is so overpowering that I just wanted to gag and sneeze whenever I use this. I love watermelons, but this is just way too strong. Yuck.

Not useful. I bought this because it looked so cute and pretty like the picture. However, it has been 1 month that I bought it. The mist inside feels unclear like dirty water and the top pink part-watermelon part changes to light pink or more white feeling. Is it expired already? Not feel safe to spray on my face again.
Really fine mist and it helps make my powder melt into my skin I like it

This product has an amazing smell. My issue with it was that it broke me out pretty terribly, and I do not typically have sensitive skin. The other con is you need to use a LOT of product to get an ’even’ layer of it on your face.

I love watermelon moisturizing gel so I definitely had to try this going in to Summer. I really wanted to love this but this is a miss for me. The smell is delicious and the nozzle discourses this light mist which for some reason makes this feel more expensive but I noticed no difference in my skin. For the price I don’t think it is worth just do have as an indulgence. There are better face sprays out there that actually do something.
Love this smell! I have purchased the watermelon glow moisturizer too, which I loved! I’ve been looking for a nice, hydrating facial spray for the summertime,
I love the smell but don’t really feel the point of it . Great packaging , Great smell , not enough benefit . Wouldn’t keep me from trying their other products though .
Do not waste your money! This broke me out and dried my face out.  While the most feels nice and smells nice, it’s not worth it at all.
review_title: Dry face and instant break out!

review_text: I’m not convinced this is helping my skin too much but it sure does smell good! The Spray is GLORIOUS but extremely fine so you do have to hold it close to your face. I use this as soon as I get out of the shower to give my face a little extra moisture before I out my moisturizer on. o have extremely dry skin and this does help a bit but not even to write home about. I’ve also tried this over makeup and didnt notice any different from my normal wear. I would buy this again just for the smell
Only good things about this product is how appealing it looks and how good it smells (for about 5 mins, that is) ... definitely fell for the hype. not worth the price

This smells amazing going on but thankfully doesnt last long. (if your sensitive to smell maybe think twice before purchasing) The mist is so fine and refreshing, my skin is on the oily side with dry areas. It hydrated my dry patches but also helped with keeping the oil at bay. Didnt do much for the redness in my skin though (the reason I bought it in the first place) but i dont regret it. I well definitely be using this and replacing my morphie spray.

I do really like this product. It’s nice and refreshing and I use it every morning. It feel like you use a lot every time you go to use it and with the size not being that big I wonder how long it’ll last. I realize it has the amount of liquid listed but I guess I just didn’t realize how little it is. I feel there are other facial sprays that have a better price point than this. Probably won’t rebuy it because of the price.

When I saw this one was coming out I actually drove to Sephora and bought one.. not even waiting for reviews OR ordering online with my flash shipping and waiting 2 more days. I wanted it ASAP. That’s unlike me, I’m impatient but not that bad lol. I tested it in store and decided I needed it. It smells really good, refreshing like watermelon spiked with cucumber.. and the ultra fine mist feels as refreshing as it smells so that’s a plus. I wish it was a 5* but I don’t think it will replace my usual settings sprays.. I dont get the same results as UD all-nighter, MAC fix+ etc BUT it’s a lovely spray for the warmer days and feels good to prep the skin so still not a bad product just not replacing anything in my collection like I really hoped it would!
review_title: Good for refreshing and prepping, not setting.

review_text: ive been using as an essence before serums but it smells amazing and the fine mist is super refreshing! not sure if its really doing anything but love it as a mid day pick me up as well.

I feel like I have to use a TON of this (the bottle says 2-3 sprays, I find myself using 3-4 times that much per use) to get to “hydrated“. It is definitely ultra fine, and smells great, but I have other, less expensive facial sprays that I prefer.
Hands down best facial spray. The smell is divine, and it literally leaves a glowy dewy finish to my clean skin or after makeup.
review_title: Best facial spray I've ever used

review_text: The spray smells really nice and feels comforting on the skin. The mister itself is very fine, one of the best sprays I’ve tried (even better than the famous Fix Plus). My skin feels soft after using it but it’s not a revolutionizing product for me. Personally, I think this is pretty pricey for the amount that you get (about 2.5 oz). I would repurchase only if it I got a discount on it. I do recommend trying it out for the mister alone.
I love this mist, it makes my skin feel soft and hydrated.
Love it! Light and hydrating and I LOVE the scent!

I’m going to be honest and say that I’m not sure it actually moisturizes my skin, but it it definitely doesn’t dry it out, which is usually what mists do to me. The smell is delightful (reminds me of old school Body Shop watermelon after sun spray) and the mist is very fine and refreshing. I usually give myself a blast at nighttime, but I have a feeling I’ll being using it more frequently this coming summer.
This is the only spray I actually see results with. Improves my dryness significantly and leaves my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. Mist is very soft and doesn’t squirt out like other sprays
The scent is of a sweet watermelon. You have to shake it up before use but it is very refreshing on the skin.

Lovely! Cute, well designed packaging delivers the perfect amount of mist with the lovely watermelon-y smell. I apply it before my skin care routine and after makeup. My skin has been looked brighter and more even each day. I think I will buy an extra just to keep in my bag.

so I tried the other watermelon product from this brand and I hated it so I was on the fence about trying this product but i’m glad i did. it has brightened my face tremendously and it helps to add a little moisture too. i think if you have dry skin like me you should try it out. i’ll definitely buy another bottle when this one runs out
Smells great, not sure that it actually does anything though....
Product smells good and feels okay on the skin but it’s not a necessity to have. Didn’t do much for me. 2 stars for the smell.
Simply delicious!  The most refreshing facial mist I have ever tried!
I love the smell and the way it makes my skin feel but I never thought I’d say that I wish the mister was a little stronger you have to get it so close to your face to even feel it

I bought this with my own COINS! By far, this is the best most ever. I have used affordable, and high end brands and there is NO comparison.  It smells amazing and it does what it says it do for your skin. It’s very hydrating and sets your makeup, doesn’t leave blotchy patches on your skin.  I use it approx 5-6x per day constantly, my coworkers use it everytime they seeing sitting at my computer! Everyone loves it. I will continue to buy this.. Hello Glow Recipe!
Love love love! Will purchase again

This literally smells so freaking good! I love just spraying it for a little refresher throughout the day. It definitely gives you a glow, so watch if you have oily skin because it can make it worse if you’re wearing makeup

When I first started using this product I thought I would fly through it for sure, given how much product you get compared to other setting sprays. But this hasn’t been the case. It sets my makeup beautifully and helps melt my powders into my skin. I gave this four stars for two reasons: 1. if you don’t like strong  smells, this might not be for you. although, i find the watermelon smell doesn’t linger for long 2. now that it’s getting warmer outside i’m finding that this might not be great for oily-combo skin. but that’s okay! i’ll just switch sprays for the summer. no biggie.

My favorite part of my routine in the morning AND at bedtime. I bought this for my daughter and once I borrowed it, I was hooked and have bought it as a gift for friends twice. I LOVE THE SMELL, i love how it makes my skin refreshed and quenched and clean. Watermelon Jolly Rancher smell in the best way. The spray is fine and steady and my boyfriend even asks me if i could “give him a spray“ when I’m using it. I will buy this until the day I die. LOVE LOVE LOVE.
review_title: BEST PART OF MY DAILY BEAUTY ROUTINE!

review_text: Love it! Another perfect product from Glow Recipe. Never leave home without it.
Awesome hydrating micro mist with the amazing smell of watermelon. The drops land on your face so finely, allowing for quick absorption.

As an esthetician I approve this product. I’m so for ingredients that are healthy for the skin, and for reading labels and actually being aware of what you are putting on. Plant based is the way to go. I love that the mist application is “ultra fine”! It dispersed so much more evenly onto my face, and I don’t feel like I’m wasting so much product-it feels amazing! Best mist application I’ve tried! My face feel refreshed & hydrated. Watermelon scent is on point! No sensitivity with this product- my skin tends to be reactive. Only reason I don’t give it a 5 is because I don’t use it everyday due to the AHA from hibiscus (exfoliation properties). I’ve tried the watermelon moisturizer and mask as well, this is my fav out of the 3!
Not only does this smell amazing it feela amazing too. Sprayer nozzle is great

This is a nice, cool, refreshing face spray that will give Yu that clean fresh face fill. I place it in my mini fridge and use after a fresh clean face. The cool sensation mist is a delight. It will not hurt to add to your collection

I love the smell first of all!!! I wear it everyday before and after makeup. I spray it on even when I don’t apply makeup. It’s light and makes my skin silky soft. It also looks like a lava lamp when it separates and that’s super cute. The shape is perfect for any makeup bag btw.
Absolutely love this product! It is so refreshing and it doesn’t make my skin feel weighted down or oily. And it smells wonderfully!
I barely get any sleep since I have a baby so my skin looks dull. I use this throughout the day to hydrate and my skin feels soft and refreshed.
Smells amazing, and makes makeup melt beautifully into the skin for a more natural looking full coverage!

TL;DR: While I enjoy this product, there is no one who NEEDS it. It is a luxury product. Aesthetically, this mist is gorgeous! Pretty color, easy to hold, very easy to apply, smells amazing, and the mist is very fine- truly a mist and not a spritz (like a regular spray bottle). With that being said, I don’t know that it does much of anything. It is lightly hydrating at best. It didn’t help or hurt my makeup application when I wore it underneath. It definitely doesn’t work as a setting spray. It didn’t make me break out but it certainly hasn’t had any effect on my skin. This makes it pretty pricey for a product with no real use.But you know why I still gave it 4 stars? Because it makes me feel fancy AF! I enjoy using it, the smell makes me happy, and it’s a small, extra step in my routine that makes me feel pampered. With 3-6 sprays a day, it should last a while. $28 is worth it, for me, for a little happiness and self care. So... get it if you want! It won’t change your life but girl it might make you feel cute.

Is this worth the price? YES. The mist on this thing is so fine, it makes me wish it was refillable. I would love to put all my setting sprays in this container because it is divine. The product itself smells like a jolly rancher in the best way possible. It leaves my skin looking hydrated and it melts my powders in but it doesn’t make me super dewy in the way the tatcha dewy skin mist does. I love this for the summer time when my skin is more on the normal side and it’s so much cheaper than tatcha. I will definitely be repurchasing when I run out

I don’t normally write product reviews, but this item is out of this world! If you’re like me and sweat a lot, you will love this product. I find it helps cool me off faster and the smell is great! Buying one for my mom for Mother’s Day.
review_title: I’d give 10 stars if I could!

review_text: I have normal/dry combo skin but lean more to the dry side. This product smelled FANTASTIC but that’s it. Absolutely no hydration ..not even a little. I wouldn’t recommend for anyone that has anywhere near dry skin

I love this watermelon mist, it actually absorbs into my skin instead of just sitting on top of my skin like a sticky barrier! But it’s not a miracle worker, if you don’t drink enough water, nothing else will hydrate your skin properly! It makes me feel refreshed and the smell is an added bonus

Honestly this has been a life saver for my postpartum skin. Since having my second baby I’ve had super dry uneven skin and I never found anything that helped when this happened to me with my first. I tried this after giving birth and it has been working great. I spray it on 3 times a day and I love it!

I used it today for the first time. The foundation I used normally is so matte but using this spray kept my face nice and dewy. Not dry at all. When I used it at first I didn’t hear the usual spritz you normally hear but you feel it on your face. It’s so nice. Plus the bottle is so cute and looks nice on my vanity.

This is a good mist. It’s hydrating and works really well for setting makeup. It also has great ingredients. It smells really, really strongly of artificial watermelon, so minus a star for that. This product will also separate, so you have to shake it before use. Overall a decent product, but similar results can be achieved with the drugstore Pixi milky mist.

This product is fantastic. It smells wonderful, the mist is the finest I’ve tried yet, and it leaves the face so soft and hydrated. Not sure it extends the wear of makeup, but for the price and experience it’s so worth it!

If you suffer from eczema DO NOT USE THIS! I been having the worst eczema breakouts on my face this year due to the extreme cold this pass winter. It just finally cleared up until yesterday when I used this! The eczema on my eyelid and above my lips showed back up this morning! I’m annoyed! Anyone with eczema would understand how annoying it is and how hard and long it takes to fully go away!
Love it! Adds the perfect level of luminous texture to my skin with or without makeup. It’s extremely refreshing too, and smells very nice :)

Bought this because of mel Thompson on youtube, truly an amazing mist and the smell is divine! Its a pleasure to use, smaller that expected but I haven’t made a huge dent so far and have used this often since purchase- my bf likes this too! Was using tatcha dewy skin mist which I love the smell of as well but the sprayer on this is just so much better.
I wanted to love this but it itched and stung my face. My skin is pretty sensitive so if yours is too, be warned.

I’m a huge fan of Glow’s overnight masks, including the watermelon one. If you’ve tried it, you know what it smells like. The mist has the same smell, but it’s pretty appalling if you have to wear it all day. It didn’t have any noticeable effect on my face. There’s also glitter in it, and it doesn’t look like the picture. The pink part settles at the top. Anyway, I returned it so no hard feelings.

I don’t know if it is doing anything for my skin other than slight hydration, but the mist is so fine it’s almost unbelievable. This is excellent to use after powder to make sure nothing on your face looks dry or caky. The fine mist does not create any large droplets and evaporates quickly. Also it smells like jolly rancher.

I love mists, and this is so far the best I’ve ever tried. I love the watermelon scent and the super fine fog mist. It contains hyaluronic acid and other great ingredients for the skin. The reason I can’t bring myself to give it 5 stars is the price — yes, I love it, but it almost pains me to use it because I don’t want to have to spend $28 on another bottle. If they could lower the price to $20, I would give it a perfect rating. I will repurchase it at some point in the future, but because of the price, my go-to hydrating mist will continue to be the Pixi Milky Mist.

i love using mists throughout the day. my skin gets very very oily during summer so this mist is perfect for me. keeps my skin hydrated, smells amazing, feels so fresh and i can use it as much as i want. during winter i do need more hydration, but with combinations of my other skin care products, this works for me.
Got it today. I am obsessed. I wish it was bigger.... I have used it 3 times today. Smells delicious, hydrates so so good.

I noticed that people with oily skin rated this higher than people with dry skin. I have combination skin. I decided to still give it a try.I applied it right after taking a shower when my skin feels kind of dry before applying moisturizer. 2 pumps didn’t do anything, l didn’t even feel the mist. Then l applied about 5 more pumps closer to my face until l felt my face a little wet, then l let it dry. My skin didn’t feel dry again, which tells me it provided some hydration, a little more than what l expected based on the bad reviews, but nothing super Wow!   I like the formulation, and if it wasn’t because it is too pricey for the amount of product it comes with, l would buy it again and again.
review_title: Hydrating formula, but requires many pumps.

review_text: So refreshing!! Smells amazing!! No joke when they say ultra-fine mist. Nothing else compares

I’m in love with this stuff! I got this from Sephora almost as soon as it came out because I heard good things about the actual mister/sprayer on it, and I was not disappointed! It gives the most perfect, fine mist that never leaves spots on your skin after you use it, and has a nice light watermelon scent. The only con would be the fact that it separates in the bottle *very* quickly, so you have to shake it up before EVERY use, even during the same makeup application. Also, if you really don’t like the smell of watermelon, you probably won’t love spraying this on your face. But, to compare it to something else, I also have used the   and the   , and this mister/sprayer is SOOOO much better than the ones on those. I don’t know if I prefer the actual formula of this spray over the formulas of those other two, but since the mister on this is so good, it’s the only one I want to use to set my face powder so that I’m never left with water spots on my face! ALSO, it comes with a LOT of product - more than it looks like when you see the bottle! For example, the Tatcha Luminous Dewy Skin Mist (full size) is 40mL, while this Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Mist is 75mL for almost half the cost... another reason why I’d definitely be more quick to repurchase this one versus other sprays/mists I’ve tried before. Highly recommend!!!!UPDATE: Although I really loved this stuff, I found that my face started getting red and irritated after using and unfortunately I think this product was the culprit :/ I ended up returning, but would still recommend this product if it doesn’t irritate your skin!
review_title: Ended up returning, but would still recommend

review_text: Will I repurchase? Probably not. It didn’t wow me. It also didn’t disappoint me either. I find that it added a touch of luminosity to my combination skin, but a lot of other mists can do that with a lot more benefits... as this item didn’t help set my makeup. I still think it’s a fun splurge item to keep yourself cool during the warmer weather (especially if you put this in the fridge before using).
review_title: Fun item, not a must have

review_text: Looooooove!!!! This product is amazing. I live in CO and with it being super dry, this works perfectly on my skin. The watermelon smell at first was like, “woah“. But then the smell dissipates and you’re left with dewy moisturized skin. Plus It’s not sticky or tacky.

this mist is the best I’ve ever used. EVER! It’s got the finest spray which is great for even application and it really hydrates without making you look or feel oily. It just looks healthy and dewy. I love it in between and after skincare steps, and to set my makeup. The ONLY negative thing I have to say is the amount of product for the price.. it’s kind of expensive for the small amount, especially considering how often I use it. I’ve had it since the VIB spring sale and I’m already halfway through the bottle approximately.. I’d love for the brand to come out with a bigger size!!

I actually bought this spray because I’ve heard so many people talk about how good it is. Believe them. It really is good and worth the hype! I love the smell and the way the bottle mists your face. It also gives your face a beautiful glow without being over the top and breaking down the makeup underneath. (It’s worth mentioning that I typically wear makeup that provides a sheer coverage and natural skin-like finish) I would definitely repurchase.
review_title: I bought this because of the hype. No regrets.

review_text: Oh this smells good! I bought it with no intentions of it really doing anything for my skin other than refreshing it, so on that note, I am happy with it. I keep it in my fridge - the ingredients do separate but a couple of shakes mixes it back up. A few cool spritzes of this on a hot day is a delightful pick-me-up.

I received this product gratis from Sephora and the Beauty Insider Community. As a beauty product, I love it. The smell is absolutely divine, good enough to eat. The nozzle and mist themselves are the best I’ve ever tried, perfectly even and light. I love using this as a setting spray of sorts, especially when I’ve used a powder foundation and want to avoid cakiness. Be warned: if you spray too much or too close to your face, you will disrupt your powder. It’s not a cute look! As a skincare product, I’m not noticing any benefits, which is why I knocked off a star. In a Chicago winter, it doesn’t provide anywhere near the hydration that my combo skin needs. Hopefully it will be better in the summer when I lean more oily.

I was actually surprised with how much I liked this! I tried it out for the first time after DE’s sukari babyfacial and I was very impressed. It’s such a fine mist that smells pretty good. I sprayed it after my facial and my skin felt so incredibly soft and still does. I like the packaging too, and I think this was definitely worth the price of it. I haven’t tried it over makeup or anything, but I might just to see.

It needs 5-6 sprays to cover the entire face and I do not notice any difference in moisture level afterwards. Would not recommend it. I am only keeping it because I do not want to return and have Sephora toss away the barely used product which is a big waste...

I love having this with me, so refreshing and gives a glow. There might be more moisturizing mists out there? I’ve actually heard good things about Olay facial mists. But I don’t think you’d regret buying this one. I have the watermelon moisturizer as well and it’s great. I recommend that you sample these. I don’t think they’re the most powerful thing, to be your primary moisturizer, but they are great tools to add to the skincare regimen.

I am obsessed!! It gives me a Korean-glass skin look without feeling dewy! I love the fine the mist are and let’s not forget the smell, I just want to stick out my tongue and taste it hahaha I will definitely repurchase it!
I love the scent, I love the way it feels.  It does leave kind of a stickiness until it dries completely, but I love the other results so much that I just let it dry before I put on makeup.
I like, it smells nice, and for once, it doesn’t irritate my skin. But I also feel like it doesn’t really do much? I don’t really notice a big difference besides very slight moisture.
I like this product a lot and I love the smell of it keeps my face moist. My skin is real sensitive and it doesn’t even break it out
Love the gentle smell of watermelon, absorbs right into my skin. Love that the product has apple cider vinegar.
First of all it is very moisturizing and helps make up last. But real kicker is that I am addicted to the smell.  It also has a very fine spray which I also appreciate.
It ok spray not the best I just want to try the hype

This is nice. But... For one, I feel the most is TOO fine. Never thought I’d say that, but I don’t feel like it gets enough on my skin. It evaporates too quickly and I feel I have to use twice as much as my regular spray, and with the price, I’m not sure if it’s worth it. Another thing is it has a cooling effect, and sometimes it makes my eyes water because it sticks around even after the spray has dried. That being said, these aren’t really huge issues and this smells divine. So I’m just taking off the star for the small size/large price. Since I have to use more, just wish it was bigger.
review_title: Nice, but I have to use so much!

review_text: Glow Recipe has the cutest products and packaging! I already love their Watermelon and Avocado Masks and knew that I needed this when I first saw it in store. Not only does this mist smell like watermelon summery goodness, it also comes in the most perfect ultra-fine mist. I love using mists before makeup and in between skincare steps and this mist is no exception. It plumps up and prepares the skin for makeup and helps keeping everything looking fresh.
I feel neutral about this hydrating mist.  I am keeping it but I seriously doubt I would buy it again.  It just didn’t blow me away.

This is your #1 product for the summer from a quality company. Even spray, not too heavy/not too light so just perfect moisturizer, and the watermelon smell is so fresh and divine!!! A must have. Fits easily into your purse as well for on the go travel!!

I loved the hydrating moisturizer from this line, and I thought this mist would also give the same results, but it falls flat. The ultra fine mist is almost too fine. I had to spray it several times to even feel like it was on my skin and the only effect I could see after using it was my skin smelled like watermelon. Save yourself the cost of this mist and just get the moisturizer or another product.

I’m obsessed with this! I’m obsessed to the point that I spray it on my face even when I’m not wearing makeup. The mister is extra fine, you have to hold the bottle close to your face to feel it. And it smells AMAZING! I took it with me to Disneyland and 12 hours later my makeup was still perfection. Highly recommend!
My absolute favorite spray.  It feels amazing under makeup and does a great job over makeup.  I cannot be without it.  I already went through one bottle!

Yeah it’s cute and compact. Yeah it smells delicious. And that’s it. I feel like I need to spray this for 5 minutes straight (exaggeration here) on my face to feel it doing something, so that means if you’re like me and like facial mists you’ll go through it fast. I haven’t noticed any insane difference in the way this sets/ makes my makeup last longer than other drugstore mists I own. I kept it because it’s cute and smells good, just told myself I just won’t repurchase it.  Now I regret even keeping it. The more I use it the more I’m like this is so useless! lol* I wish I would’ve returned it.
love this stuff!  The mist is so fine and it smells so yummy.

Loving this!!  I was looking for a face mist, not a setting spray, that would refresh my skin and/or makeup throughout the day and give a bit of a glow, but not make me look greasy, and this is exactly what I wanted.  The spray is the lightest, most ultra fine mist I’ve ever tried, and at first, I could barely feel it on my face.  It’s beautiful over powders when used to melt them into the skin and is perfect after midday touch ups.  I was worried that the fragrance or watermelon ingredients would irritate my extremely sensitive and reactive skin but I haven’t had any issues.  Just a few quick sprays is all it takes to get a lit from within glow and I can’t recommend it enough!

I really enjoy using this product. First off, the sprayer on this thing is amazing. I don’t like it when I set my makeup and my face feels damp and takes forever to dry. My face doesn’t even get wet with this...just hydrated and refreshed. Also, it smells absolutely lovely. I’ve been using it to set my foundation, and it keeps it looking hydrated throughout the day and seems to help diminish cakiness and creasing. I received this product gratis from the Beauty Insider Community.
How that Ariana Grande song goes?  I see it, I like it, I want it, I got it. I also smelled it and that was the reason. Sucker for a cute packaging and they nailed it this time

I was highly anticipating this spray because of all the hype surrounding it. I was waiting for the release and bought a few bottles because I thought I’d love it. Pros: Scent does smell yummy Cool, packaging unique bottle Sprays out a full spray which most facial sprays do not Cons: Face feels fresh at first, but doesn’t last Not as moisturizing Must be shaken so formula is mixed To summarize the product, I think it’s good but to keep up the consistency of the other products in their line, I think I would not repurchase.
love this especially after my daily skin care routine it’s so moisturizing and smells like jolly rancher!
OMG OMG OMG!!!! Such a fine mist it feels like angel tears (or like the Morphe continuous setting mist lol!!), feels so good on the skin, and is GOOD for the skin as well!!

I adore this! I have normal to dry skin and this has the most perfect fog like mist. It leaves a beautiful glowy finish but not greasy or balmy. I was kind of surprised how little the bottle was though. I had seen people on YouTube using it and it didn’t seem that small. now I will say that I dont think you would use alot because it doesn’t have a thick mist, it’s a very sheer foggy mist but does cover really well but doesn’t take alot of product to see results. For this Florida girl, this mist is heaven sent! Sets my makeup perfectly and I use it before makeup on a bare face. it is so good!
I love this mist so much! I use it before and after make up and it make me look glowy and glossy in a perfect way. And I love the smell. Only bad part is I feel like it finishes so quickly.

I love the fine mist this has and it’s amazing that the nozzle doesn’t leak like other fine mist nozzles I have tried out. The smell is perfect for me, super light and fresh, but sweet! I love the way my skin has a slight tingle after spraying it on and I’m so happy this exists! Already bought my second one!
This broke me out with cystic acne. I haven’t had acne in years but this was the only thing new in my routine. It also broke out my teenager with a lot of white heads.
I love the smell. However mine changed color after a while(~2 month), like a dirty orange pink color:( not sure can still use it.

So I know that Mists,timers and sprays can be a hit or miss but this stuff is wonderful!It gives me skin a nice hydrating feel,a little natural glow  and hasn’t broken me out.I use this before and after I apply makeup.This mist is also apart of my skincare routine.The smell is a little powerful at first but it’s nothing too heavy.I recommend it a lot.
review_title: A mist that is just right

review_text: I’m absolutely in love with this mist! It really sprays ultra fine, smells like watermelon and melts all my powders beautifully into my skin. I love the ingredients in this as well. Will be repurchasing.

Definitely a no-go!!! It’s way too scented and the scent is incredibly overbearing. I’m perplexed how it is sold out at most places: presumably, it is way overhyped. I’m so glad I just returned it (and I barely return things)!
The mist is wayyyyy too fine! The smell is not worth the price and i do not like the after smell at all. Was so excited for this but disappointed.

I ordered this during the VIB sale, and let me tell you I’m so glad I did!! I can honestly bathe in this stuff! The mist is so perfect and the smell is just like fresh watermelons!!! So I use it before I put on my skin care and then after to lock it all in (and because it smells and feels so good) I just can’t get enough of it! So happy with this purchase and it’s verified clean which is amazing! I’m really interested in trying the watermelon sleep mask now!!!!
Love this! It adds a natural radiance to my skin.

I have a thing for face mists and sprays, I LOVE them. I purchased this in store simply for the smell and fluffy embrace it gave. It is ultra fine and delicious on skin. I have used this facial mist as a setting spray to give my skin an extra glow and it has done a great job. My makeup tends to crease and with this mist, it does not!
One of the best mists I’ve ever tried. Always feels refreshing after I spray this on my face. Watermelon smell feels like its summer!

I don’t use this as a setting spray but it is an amazing refresher and the smell is beyond good. The mist the sprayer creates is as good as my Flower Beauty Setting Spray and very moisturizing. Highly recommend.

I’ve got pretty standard combo skin and my t- zone area as well as around my mouth always feels the most most oily almost instantly. However my matte setting sprays just make me look dry and flaky but don’t necessarily help with that oily feeling. This stuff sets my makeup so beautifully! It isn’t greasy or cakey at all and it makes my face feel matte while giving me a satin/ dewy glow. I just bought my first bottle and I’m already buying a backup.
review_title: Dewy skin mist for combo skin!

review_text: The size of this spray was smaller than expected.  The mist is very fine and it smells AMAZING.  I’ve been using it with the matching moisturizer.  Used it to set my makeup and I did not get oily at all throughout the day (I live in the south with 100  degree weather).  The spray is kind of long enough for you to do one line on the X across your face.  I would suggest moving the spray quickly or else it will dew up on your face.  I noticed that it does dry quickly and doesn’t disrupt your makeup.
review_title: A bit small, but worth it.

review_text: This stuff is awesome. I just finished my first bottle that I bought the week it came out. I have eczema and I found that spraying this after using my moisturizer did WONDERS. I normally would spray it on and then massage it into my skin. I found that if I just let it sit on my skin it made me look greasy. I don’t recommend this for oily skin, but if you do have oily skin, I would use maybe one spray (I normally do three).

The directions on this product say you need to spray yourself every two hours. I took it to work and didn’t want to sit at my desk spraying myself so I went to the bathroom. The probably is that it looks like you’re carrying spray to the bathroom... Awkward. Also I don’t see the value in the cost vs. benefit. There is a soft watermelon smell which is beautifully fragrant but other than that this product makes you look too oily or “dewy.“ If you only use one pump of spray a day then you definitely don’t see a benefit-it’s too light to be a finishing spray.

I’ve previously used (and loved) their overnight watermelon mask, so I wanted to give this a try. First, it does have a very strong watermelon smell. I love it, but, some people who aren’t into strong smells of anything may not enjoy this. Second, the product itself is fantastic! This is great to wear as a setting spray OR for a more natural look to add a fresh faced glow. I’ve used it both ways and it works either way! I prefer it mostly for a bare faced glow. The product does separate, so you need to gently shake it before use. The misting aspect is nice. And I feel you get more than you would using something similar... such as the tatcha dewy mist spray. If you’re on the fence about sprays and want a reliable one without a super expensive price tag, I would definitely try this!
I loved this especially since it’s a clean product and smells SO good. However, when used as directed it only lasted me a month. For $28 that’s not really sustainable.

This is incredibly expensive for what it is. It does nothing in my opinion. If you only are looking for a nice refreshing smell this one is it. Other than that, put your money into something else that does something. Returned it.
Makes your skin feel refreshed. The smell of watermelon is wonderful and refreshing as well.
Love the product! But the price is too much for such little product. I just wish there was more juice!!

Product smells amazing... I seen it on Instagram and was so curious to try so I purchased without even looking at the size... it came in and I was highly disappointed ... smells wonderful but the price for the size is not worth it.
Great finish and smells like summer!

This spray is lovely, looks pretty on my vanity, and has a very fine mist. The reason I will not be repurchasing is the durability of the nozzle. Mine broke after only using a small amount. No problem right?  Just refill my empty fix plus bottle so there would be no waste. Well... after 30 minutes of trying to open the bottle, I finally broke the top off but not without having to destroy the whole thing.  It is definitely not reusable.
