I did manage to salvage most of it and am using it with my Mac bottle. I’ll stick to fix plus from now.
review_title: lovely but bottle was a let down

review_text: Even though this isn’t suited for my face (made it a lil itchy) i spray it on my neck and my hair and it smells amazing. I love it, and my bf loves it too.
review_title: itchy on my face but smells amazing on hair

review_text: I absolutely love this product! It has such a nice,fine mist and makes my skin feel so good! It’s also amazing to spray on after applying a powder highlighter and gives it a nice glow.
smells so sweet, makes my makeup stay locked while also adding dewiness, and the sprayer creates the finest mist. It’s my new go-to facial spray.
If you want a glow without shimmers, look no further.  Worth every penny!  I restocked during VIB.

I bought this as a fun beach bag addition and didn’t expect much so I’m not disappointed. I don’t find this mist does anything for my skin at all, other than I love the smell and it does feel refreshing spraying it throughout the day. For the price, will try another mist next time to see if the deliver in other ways, but for now definitely enjoying “the experience.”

I just love this mist ! It’s perfect for summer and smells great! Even though it contains ACV, you can’t even smell it. The mist is very fine and even. Just don’t forget to shake it first because it has 2 phases. It keeps my skin well hydrated because it contains hyaluronic acid and keeps my skin glowing. I just wish that it came in a bigger size but it’s still deserves a 5 star rating!

I’m unconvinced this does anything, maybe it does maybe it doesn’t, but it doesn’t do anything BAD either (unlike another mist I’ve tried from a high end brand), and it smells exactly like watermelon jolly rancher candies to me and I love that! I keep getting a random whiff of watermelon! Sometimes you just need to splurge on something for no other reason than because it makes you happy, and this is it.

I got this for free from a friend and am so glad I didnt pay for it. It smells amazing (if you are into a slightly less sweet watermelon jolly rancher) but otherwise is no better than the 4 dollar evian spray you can get at CVS. Its a bit sticky and gives no dew or shimmer thats noticeable, nor does it set your makeup or feel above average hydrating. On top of that, it slipped out of my hands after a few uses onto a carpeted floor and now the pump spray only shoots in an aggressive straight line, rendering it totally useless. Would be 4 stars if it was 5 dollars, but I would never spend 30 on it.

I recently had a couple four hour flights and this most was perfect for keeping me fresh and hydrated both in the airport and on the plane. The most is so fine that I was able to spray it on my face during the flight and it didn’t affect the people sitting next to me. Same thing in the airport. Plus, it smells amazing!  It was exactly what my face needed to not feed completely parched when traveling (especially on the way home after I had gotten a bit too much sun). I use it at home sometimes if I’m just doing a quickie skincare regimen at night.

I am so in love with this product! When I tested it in store I was blown away by how good it smelled. Aside from the smell, I really enjoy that it is a mist versus a spray. It’s not too much or an overwhelming amount of product that comes out. It’s super refreshing! I was a little shocked by how small the bottle was once I saw it in person but with how finely it comes out, the bottle will last a long time. If you are a watermelon lover, you will adore this product.
I love this, after my other sprays are finished, I will never buy another. Smells so divine too!
I find this product to be simply average. There isn’t anything this does for my skin that any other similar product I have does.
review_title: Not all it's hyped to be

review_text: Love the smell of watermelon!! The mist is refreshing and doesn’t drench your face like some mists do. So far this mist hasn’t dried me out or caused any skin irritations. I’m not sure how well it moisturizes my face (I do a lot of moisturizes day and night). If you want a nice watermelon scented fritz pick me up during the day, I highly recommend. If you are more conservative with your money and don’t care about scents then I’d say pass it up.

So I bought this with my Rouge Reward after seeing my favorite beauty Youtuber (Jena Froese) recommend it. This legit may as well just be water. Yes it smells nice, and the packaging is luxe and cute. But this literally did nothing for my skin. Misting my face with a spray bottle filled with tap water would be more moisturizing. You can’t use this as a setting spray either like some other face mists. Definitely don’t waste your money.
I love how it smells like it feels and how it ends my makeup

It’s suggested that this can be used as a make up setting spray but it shouldn’t...it’s great for refreshing the skin, or as a base before applying make up, but it has no real properties that would make it a setting spray...it’s still great and I love it.  Would definitely purchase again!!!
It’s ok.  Hydrating and smells good but nothing special.  I prefer my regular old rose water.

It was okay, to be honest. I had been following the glow recipe and was excited to see how the spray would work as a setting spray, or just as a hydrating spray. it didn’t really work that well as a setting spray, but it does smell really nice. The product is made of really clean ingredients, so you can feel good while you’re spraying it, but that’s it. the bottle is pretty small, so I usually keep it in my purse, and spray it whenever I need to freshen up my make up

BEST EVER!This feels amazing! ultra fine mist is correct and I love the smell.  It feels very refreshing on my skin, I use it all the time, with and without makeup on.  I use before makeup with my primer, after makeup, after removing makeup when I start my night time skin routine.  It is just an awesome mist.  Will definitely be purchasing again!
review_title: If you haven't tried this your not living

review_text: It is so refreshing. I use it everyday as a primer. The smell is to die for. I did not like it as a setting spray because it does not fix my make up. But I like it as a primer more than Smashbox primer water.
I absolutely love this product! I have very dry skin! And this watermelon glow ultra-fine mist makes my skin look healthy and glow!

I tried resisting this purchase because of the price point. I failed miserably - lol. I love this little bottle of heaven. Glow Recipe has fine-misting down to an art. It smells so yummy and it’s so refreshing. If you live for a hydrating moment like I do, this is worth every penny. I would buy again.

Not sure if this is actually working because it feels like glorified water, BUT DANG it smells amazing. I can’t stop using it because I just want to smell it! I wouldn’t recommend this to set makeup, but more to hydrate and refresh throughout the day.
So moisturizing, especially when sprayed over hyaluronic acid serum. The smell is light and heavenly, will absolutely buy again ♥️

Smells fantastic however is a gimmicky trend that will fade away, I don’t find this to be a staple piece as it doesn’t exactly do much, it smells very good and feels nice in the skin when first sprayed but that’s it...
review_title: A gimmick with a nice smell

review_text: It’s fine. It smells amazing and it’s hydrating but I wouldn’t say it’s very glowy or luminous. Didn’t give me any breakouts which is a plus. I will say the price feels a bit high for the overall size and amount of product you get though.
I love this so much. I love the smell, the feel. I love how fine the mist is too.. I use it all the time. I plan on buying it again and again..
review_title: so good you want to eat it lol..

review_text: Love this product! Smells delicious and makes me feel refreshed!!
This was horrible.  Smelled like artificial jolly rancher and 2 days after I got it it started turning brown.   Yuck!!!!’

Nothing special which is kind of disappointing. It smells great and gives me glowy skin for like 20 seconds besides that the spray is too light weight for someone with dry skin such as myself. Honestly the Mario badescu spray does better
Love this mist! My skin is refreshed, and hydrated, and it doesn’t take off your makeup when you spray on top :) The bottle might look small, but its 75 ml which is great! Perfect for my bag.

I really like this mist. I spray it on my face as soon as I get out of the shower. it makes me face feel soft and plump and smells sooo good. It has not caused me any skin irritation or breakouts which is a huge plus.

This is the best smelling product I have ever put on my face. I absolutely love how refreshing it feels during my skincare routine and I use it to set my makeup for a flawless look. I can see how it helps my skin look plump and radiant. I have combo/oily/acne prone skin and I would definitely recommend this to anyone.

This is my new favorite mist! I have been a long time user of misting rose water... I was even making my own at one point (and its my fav flower) -- but this watermelon mist is the most HEAVENLY AMAZING spray. It smells amazing, and I love how light the mist is. If you have oily or acne prone skin I recommend spraying it further away from your face. One bottle has lasted me a couple months, and I spray it constantly and share the mist with everyone around me!

This has replaced all of my setting sprays and mists! This makes my skin feel amazing, not sticky, super fine mist. It feels like you’re walking through a fog! I’ve made 2 repurchases so far I need this to be around forever I can never run out of this!!!
I received this as a free sample first, but I love it so much that I’ve rebought a couple. It smells like watermelon jolly ranchers. The very fine mist is extra refreshing.
Finest and even mist. Gives a beautiful glow and instant hydration. Perfect for summer.
this is so hydrating for a mist! I’ve used it in place of moisturizer on humid oily days. it gives me instant glass skin that lasts all day!
I love the smell and it’s a good product for drier skin.   Too oily for combo skin

I never leave home without it, it’s always in my purse. I love the smell, of course, but I feel so refreshed after applying it. I use it after our day at the pool and for anytime I need a pick me up. I have a glow for a while after using it and feel great!
review_title: Another amazing product from Glow Recipe!

review_text: More watermelon scented products for me. Watermelon is my go to scent this summer! This product was recommended to me when I came in to try some facial masks. The artist sprayed some on my face after we applied moisturizer and I feel in love instantly. I bought this mist on the spot. My only complaint is that it truly is an ultra fine mist. I end up spraying for a while bc I love the smell and it feels so refreshing on my face.

Cute packaging, but very strong scent. If you don’t like candy watermelon scents, or are sensitive to scents at all this isn’t the mist for you. The nozzle sprays nicely and product soaks into the skin well

I was never one for facial mists, but I received one of these as a gift...and finished it in two months and then repurchased itI use this spray just to rejuvenate my skin and give it a boost in moistureAlso smells lovely :)
I love this product, it gives my face a moment of joy with that real ultra fine mist fog,it refrehes, hydrates and plumps my skin, and it refresh my makeup, it is a must have.

I love this!It smells yummy, button presses very nicely, sprays a nice, even, thin layer of product.I use it when I need an extra boost of hydration. I avoid putting it on or under makeup because it is a little oily.

yeah....this facial mist is incredibly overpriced and over-hyped for what it does. The mist itself - which so many YTers and reviewers raved about - is actually sort of terrible. Even though the particles feel delicate and fine, the mist itself shoots out rather than creating a fine cloud of gorgeous hydration, like all my favorite mists usually do. The scent of watermelon jolly rancher might be nice for a body lotion or candle, but on my face it feels far too sweet and not at all refreshing. I feel like I have to use so much product to cover my face, and since you don’t get much in the bottle itself, it’s not a good value whatsoever. The sad thing is I usually adore Glow Recipe, and it’s rare i find a hydrating mist I don’t like, but I don’t like this. It’s perfectly ok, but I have found much better from similar Korean and Asian skincare brands for half the cost, without half the hype. This is not a product I will be repurchasing.

Every time I walk into a Sephora, I use this tester spray on my face. I can’t say it does anything too noticeable for my skin but it makes me feel super luxurious and smells amazing. It’s incredibly refreshing and perfect for summer. I think if I’m looking particularly dull it does freshen things up. I got it as a gift, and love it. But not sure if I would spent money on something that doesn’t make a difference in my skin
This is very refreshing, smells great (if you love watermelon), the spray is very fine so its not like it hits your face when you spray it.
I need a bigger bottle! This is one of the best moisturizing sprays out there! It’s so authentic and feels so good ❤️❤️❤️❤️
I love this product, the mist is amazing, and smells so good. I carry everywhere with me and use it with or without makeup. For me is the best mist ever
This mist is just lovely. Keeps my skin hydrated, dewy and most of all, I love how fine the mist is. Highly recommend!!
review_title: never will I be without this

review_text: I loved the Glow Recipe Watermelon moisturizer but it didn’t totally agree with my skin, so I was very excited for a mist to come out. The mist itself is so fine and heavenly. The packaging is fun and simple. The smell is divine. The only reason I didn’t give it five stars is because I did notice that on days I used this, my makeup would sometimes start to melt off a little bit quicker than usual...so now I keep it for skincare time at night or when I’m not going out.

Ok, so I’m a bit of a skincare junky but I can’t get enough of this mist. YouTuber Mel Thompson turned me on to this. The mist is ultra fine and the scent and hydration makes it so worth the spluge, tho this is not the most expensive one out there.

I love using this spray before makeup or to use throughout the day for an extra glow. The smell is amazing and the bottle is compact for easy travel. This was my first time using this and now I’m hooked!

I really enjoy using this, and making my friends and family use it too! It smells amazing, is very hydrating and I feel it does everything it claims. Makes the skin glow, hydrates, looks great over makeup. Did I mention it smells AMAZING? A perfect face spray to keep in your bag. Love it.
Smells super good like watermelon jolly rancher and has an EXTREMELY fine mist. Adding too much will make you hella dewy so i do just a few squirts at a time. I like it a lot.
It adds a glow, just use it close to your face or else you’ll use too much too fast.

This spritz pretty much says it all!Not only is it so refreshing you feel like your eating ice cold watermelon on a 100 degree day but the way it mists your face is what sold me!So delicate and sensual.  I have purchased a ton of spray toners/ setting sprays etc for my face, and they can be aggressive and not enjoyable.  This one is my favorite hands down!I feel like I’m on a tropical vacation when I spray myself:). Very happy with this product.

Please be observant of the bottle. I kept this at my office. In fairness there would have been fluctuations when the office would have run very warm to cold. Today after spritzing myself in the face I realized that there was mold growing heavily inside the bottle.
Love! After and before makeup it’s amazing for dry/normal skin!

First of all, I was dying to try this product, and if I could give it 4.5 stars, I would. I love how it smells, and the mist is so fine and gentle against my face. It also does a good job setting the small amount of makeup that I use.  However, I don’t feel as if the moisturizing effect lasts that long, so you really do have to use it every two hours as recommended to notice it. And, well, unfortunately, that’s a bit more than I’m willing to spend on this product, as it is rather pricey. I will definitely continue to buy it, but it won’t be for everyday use.

I have so much love for this spray, although I wish it came in a larger size. So help me, I’d bathe in this if I could. Ok, I bought this as I wanted to get into facial mists. This is in my top two (The other being Mario Badescu’s aloe/lavender). I put this on after I wash my face, and then after I’ve applied my serums and lotions. My skin seems to feel more supple, hydrated, my god the smell is fantastic! Never stop making this, Glow Recipe!
I love this mist but the bottle is definitely a lot smaller than I expect. But it’s sooo refreshing! I do love it! The smell isn’t overpowering to me! It’s just..... fresh watermelon!
review_title: Would be five but has to be four....

review_text: Amazing mist that sets and adds a subtle natural glow!!!
Aside from the scent taking me to a sweet summer island excursion, this mist makes my skin feel like a baby’s perfect bottom. No joke, this is better than carbs. Everyone needs this in their life!!!

first of all, the smell is AMAZING. if you love watermelon you’ll LOVE THIS. it hydrates, it leaves a very nice glow. i use it for everything such as toner, prep for make up and to set my make up. sometimes i just spray for a touch up too. LOVEEEE!

Yes.. But I don’t want to. It is not a must in my skincare steps but definitely love caring it around in my purse and spraying it through out the day. It smells delicious and feels so refreshing. The mist is so fine that it is easy to go over board and end up looking like a grease ball, so be careful.

This spray is so wonderful! Makes my skin so hydrated and dewy with out soaking my skin. The mist is ultra fine and the watermelon glow is such a divine scent. I love this stuff and can’t stop using it!!

I am in LOVE with this mist. It really is ultra-fine, and makes skin glow as advertised. When you use it in conjunction with the other two Watermelon products, the moisturizer and sleeping mask, it leaves skin feeling soft and smooth with a glowing, radiant look. I wouldn’t consider this a setting spray, its more of a skincare routine product. The smell is heavenly. Its smells like REAL watermelon, not the artificial watermelon smell.
I use this before putting on moisturizer and it makes my skin look beautiful and feel super hydrated! I love that it’s not sticky feeling at all + it doesn’t break me out which awesome.

LOVE! I wish this came in a bigger size, im a sophomore, and this is perfect to go into my backpack for the occasional spritz every now and then! It’s fun, and the packaging is super cute, (and seems sturdy!). It also smells amazing, if you have a little extra cash to spend, I do recommend this!
Dude. Buy this. I’m a setting spray fanatic, I could write sonnets about the sprayer on this glorious spray.
It really hydrates your face and gives a dewy look that makes your skin look ALIVE. I use it before and after makeup or even alone. 10/10 recommend <3

I was really into K- beauty about 3/ 4 years ago and then it just exploded and was everywhere. I began transitioning to all natural products, but I held on to Glow Recipe because their products are great for my combo, sensitive, finicky skin. I’m especially in love with the watermelon products, which I leave in my skincare fridge so they feel extremely soothing when I apply. I ordered the mist from their site on day it launched and used it about 3 times and hadn’t touched it again. I really liked it, I just have too many products. Flash forward to this miserable humidity. I pulled mist out a couple of weeks ago because i wanted something “refreshing” and it was perfect! Irritated at myself for not using this whole time. As others have said, it’s a very fine mist, which is extremely rare and I love being able to control spray to targeted areas if I want. Awesome on fresh face or over makeup. It’s hydrating enough for my combo (oil slick right now) skin, but I can see this not being enough for drier skin. I think the whole watermelon line is best suited for oily- normal skin and in the harsh winter even I need to layer the sleeping mask with the pink juice and mist. I can moisturize by just spraying this on and not worry about my cream moisturizer smearing everything together.
It works fine but there or other things that works just as good. I realize it’s CLEAN but it’s to expensive!

I won a years worth of Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Glow line and this was one of the products included. And I have to say I love this mist! I am a mist addict and have quite a few different ones from different brands and this is in my top three. It’s hydrating, refreshing, it smells amazing and it works very well as a makeup setting spray. I like the dewy finish it gives my matte foundations. I have a few bottles to last me a while BUT when I run out I will definitely repurchase!
Great smell, feels refreshing. I like the way it feels and I think my face gets an extra sheen? No idea. Five stars.

This is the best mist that I have ever used. It adds so much moisture to the skin and makes it look and feel plump and hydrated. The mist itself is very fine which I love, and it smells amazing. Such a fine mist, great sent, melts makeup right into the skin for a more natural looks.
Makes your skin look dewy and feels super hydrating
I love this more than anything. I use this after foundation /concealer/light baking on my nose (thanks Mel Thompson!).
Love this. I spray my face at least twice a day, particularly on days I tan.

Amazing smell!!!  like the rest of the glow watermelon range it is light and moisturizing. Bottle is small unfortunately but it is a good Korean product so all in all happy with the purchase.

If you love Glow Recipe’s Watermelon sleeping mask, you will love this mist. It has the same iconic scent as the mask: fresh, dewey watermelon. You can think of it as a lovely facial perfume with wonderful skin benefits. I’m in love with this mist. It’s very rare that I get addicted to a product so much so that I use it every day, more than once a day.Before purchasing this mist, I spent a long time coveting it in my local Sephora. Every time I visited the mall, I made a special stop at Sephora to spray this on my face. It’s perfect for everything: setting your make up, restoring hydration to your face, using as skin prep, using as a perfume—anything I can think of to use it for, I will. I have extremely dry, sensitive skin. I am the kind of dry where even on hot days when I’m sweaty or more prone to seeing just a *tad* bit of oil, my dry skin will be peeling off in those same oily spots. I have to take care of my skin well, otherwise there’s no escaping the dryness. This spray keeps me dewey on even my dry days and pulls back the shine when I need it to on warm days. The perfect balance.

I’ve only used this one day, and I’m already in love.  I have extremely dry/sensitive/flaky skin as a result of my use of prescription tretinoin.  I used this spray in the hopes of refreshing my skin and makeup appearance after a long day at my office and right before a social gathering.  Not only did it instantly refresh my makeup appearance, it dramatically reduced the appearance of the dry flaky skin on my forehead, below my nose and on my cheeks.   I used it again this morning after I cleansed my face and once again after I applied my makeup.  When I came to office, my coworkers commented on how much better my skin looks.  I am hooked!  My only complaint is the amount of product received.  It would be great if they could offer a larger size option in the future.

I bought this spray because I wanted to see what all the hype was about. I have yet to find a face mist or setting spray that I love.Well I think I found it! I love the ultra fine mist it covers the face with just a few pumps and give my make up a perfect finish. I have combo skin so I was afraid I would look oily after I sprayed it. I will definitely buy this again.

This is the. BEST. I repeat, the BEST face mist I have ever bought in my life. It is so luxurious, it smells great, doesn’t leave you sticky or “too hydrated,” and yes it really does make you glow. I don’t think I can try any other facial mists now after owning this. This is THE ONE.
review_title: I Can Never Buy Any Others Ever Again

review_title: A joy to use each morning

review_text: Love this spray. It smells delightful and feels so refreshing. I use it almost everyday.
Love the smell and feel of the watermelon mist, I cant help but use it multiple times a day when my face needs a little moisture and pick-me-up.
review_title: Amazing! I want to mist all day!

review_text: Glow Recipe has out done themselves with this product. The formula of the most is absolutely wonderful, I can feel the hydration on my skin( and I have very dehydrated skin).  Also, the spray nozzle/ fog like mist is well designed and functions and performs like no other. This is a multi- talker as well. Not only does it perform skin care benefits but it can set and spruce your makeup as well. The nozzle sprays uniformly, it doesn’t produce and big droplets, that can ruin your makeup like other setting sprays.

At first i thought this product would be gimmicky, but since I have all of the other glow recipe items i decided to purchase this one as well. It’s now one of my favorite products! Its extremely versatile; I use it to wet my brushes, hydrate my skin, or give my face a nice glow after my makeup routine. It’s also super long lasting! I use this spray multiple times throughout my makeup and skincare routine and I haven’t had to buy another one since buying this one 3 months ago! The spray nozzle is well designed and distributes the product great. I will definitely be repurchasing this once I run out!

Smells amazing like pretty much every other GR product. It’s a tad on the oily side but it’s still refreshing. I’d give it 5 stars if it had less oil in it but I still really enjoy it and purchase it when I can afford it. It lasts a long time too which is nice. I try to grab it when it’s available in a Kit.
Love the packaging and the color of the product, it’s ecstatically pleasing. However it dried out my face and caused breakouts, had to return!

I have dry sensitive skin, and this has helped my skin look dewy throughout the day even without a moisturizer. I usually spray this throughout the day when I’m lounging at home and not wearing any makeup. It keeps your face looking hydrated, will definitely keep buying this product.
review_title: Gives you a nice, hydrated glow

review_text: Love this spray! Now this to me is not an everyday spray. I’ve used it a couple of time over makeup (and I’m a combo skin) and it was way too hydrating. Great for winters or just use it in between skincare for extra hydration. I prefer to use this for skincare than a makeup setting spray. It smells like fresh waterMelon and the mister is super super fine.

I noticed alot of makeup/skin tutorials were using this stuff and I can see why. Smells amazing is so refreshing and hydrating and it’s a nice fine mist. Use this everyday in the am and it may even replace my mario basescu facial spray. Like most sephora products it is pricey.

One star for the containers, negative ZERO for their contents.  I bought this product as part of a kit direct from the company.  Unfortunately, it was a mistake buying directly from them because they don’t accept returns from international sales.  I had a bad allergy using their products in the weekend.  My face turned red, itchy, rashes Onedeveloped and thickening of the skin.  I had suffered this weekend and contacted them to return the products.  But I was told they don’t accept returns.  Very disappointing.  No I won’t recommend buying their products.

I love this mist! It has the perfect spray nozzle with an ultra-fine mist. I love the way that this product feels and smells! It does a nice job at hydrating my skin. I keep it in my skincare fridge for a nice, cold application.
Love the smell and spray nozzle. It does not leave water drops on my face. It is very hydrating.

This product is great.  it will provide with hydrating effect, so when youre wearing make up you dont feel your skin dry up.  I have used it as a primer and as a setting spray.  I can honestly say it works well as both but it wont provide the holding effect that some other setting/primer sprays  because its a clean product without that many chemicals and also because other setting sprays dry your face to conserve make up longer and this one will hydrate.  I recommend for daily wear but not for any special occasions where you need all night strength.

i absolutely adore this product! it has a wonderful and refreshing watermelon scent and i was very impressed with the ingredient list. if you do not like fragrance i would not suggest this, but the percentage is super low in this product so i did not mind! it is extremely hydrating (i have normal skin so im not sure how it would be with dry skin) and i sometimes use this instead of the HA serum from the ordinary. i overall highly recommend if you want to splurge a bit!

I 100% bought this for the watermelon scent that  I love from all GLOW Recipe products, and was pleasantly surprised that it is also refreshing and moisturizing. I use this after applying makeup, without makeup, whenever I feel dry... this stuff is great and my bottle is running close to low, so new purchase coming up!
I did not see any changes what they have claimed. Its just a hype. Not worth for price.

I love this product! It smells amazing and the mist is super fine. I always have a super dewy glow to the skin after using this, which I love because I have very dry skin. However, I took away a star because when the product is sitting out, it settles and separates and it looks less than pleasant (until you shake it back up). I started keeping it in the fridge to ensure the ingredients were fresh because of this. But overall, amazing product and will be repurchasing!!
Hydrates my skin and smells so good! I use it before makeup and keeps my skin glowing.
A nice hydrating toner. Didn’t make me break out, left my skin feeling fresh and hydrated, also smells amazing.

It’s quiet refreshing and hydrating. I use it after the watermelon toner and before moisturiser. Sometimes I skip the moisturiser part (during the day) and it still works for me.Totally loving the scent, the spraying pump and the texture. Does not leave water droplets on my face, absorbs perfectly.

I really liked this product when it came In the mail... even though it wasn’t as pink as shown in the picture. Now, after a couple of months it turned completely white and it doesn’t smell like watermelon anymore, it smells like plastic. Seems like it expires quickly and it doesn’t even have an expiration date on the packaging. Not worth the price I paid.

I love this! I’m not sensitive to scents and the watermelon scent of this is sooo relaxing.I spray this on my face any time of the day! So obsessed with this I bought 2 more bottles. I want it all over my house. I also recently started spraying this on my scalp because I heard the owners of glow recipe that you can spray it on your scalp

Okay, at first I didn’t know if I loved this, I kept using it and now I’m obsessed! First u need to hold the spray down for the full mist which I didn’t even realize for about two weeks!! It makes the biggest difference with the application and how it actually works. It makes ur skin glow! I don’t like this over my makeup, I like this as a skin prep and to use in between all of my moisturizers and for a refreshing added moisturize during the day. It smells like pure watermelon and works wonders! This is a must for everyone!
I love this mist! It smells amazing, gives you a fresh dewy glow and it sprays out the Perfect amount so you don’t feel soaked! Great on no makeup or after a full face!
Great pick me up for your skin! Great smell. Very refreshing
Love how this product smells! Almost finished my first bottle and just purchased another refill! And it doesn’t make my eczema flare up ... great!!

I would definitely recommend this product! I use it after P.E or any physical activity, and when I need to set my makeup. It is super hydrating and plumps and nourishes my skin. If you need a facial mist this is the one!!
review_title: Refreshing, Smells great, Aesthetics on point!1

review_text: Wow....this spray feels so good. I have extreemly dry & sensitive skin & this spray does not irritate it in the slightest. Feels cooling, refreshing, soothing & smells so wonderful, like a real watermelon (not fake). I love this over makeup as a setting spray, a refresher throughout the day, on bare skin after skincare & 1st thing in the morning to refresh & wake me up!The mist is perfection. I also have the Tacha glowy skin mist (purple bottle) & I dislike the spray on that one.... it’s almost to mild & oily of a spray.... moves my makeup around. The glow recipe spray & formula is truly perfection. Moisturizing, glowy but not an oil slick, soothing & refreshing. Beautiful when sprayed onto a damp sponge & bounced all over ur base makeup! Highly recommend!!!
I enjoyed the feeling of the mist. But just don’t understand the hype. Did not see any benefits at all.

i love the moisturizer so i had rly high hopes. i had how fine the mist is. unless you spray very close to face like 2 inches away you can barely feel anything. it smells delicous but not as refreshing as using rosewater that costs under 10 dollars in comparison. wont repurchase

I don’t find that it does anything it claims to do. The fragrance is quite strong and the mist is so fine that you can barely feel anything on your face. I’ve also had it for about a week and its half empty???? It’s way too small.
Great refreshing smell. Beautiful mist like a party.Unfortunately, it dries out sensitive skin pretty bad, and have to return.

Does everything it says it will- hydrate, refresh, and make your skin glow. I got this since I live in Las Vegas where the heat wreaks havoc on my skin. Was originally going to use it as a nice pick me up during the day or after gym refreshing mist. I’ve now incorporated it into my morning and nighttime routine. It’s sooo hydrating! my skin looks luminous and just soaks it up. I’ve tried a bunch of their other products before and this is the only one I’ve really loved and repurchased.
This mist is amazing! I have dry and sensitive skin so, this keeps me hydrated throughout the day.

I found this product to be extremely overrated. I ran out of my Caudalie Beauty Elixir and was looking for a new facial mist to try. After reading all of the raving reviews I gave this a go. I now wish I hadn’t. Unless I spray an inch away from my face, this spray does absolutely nothing. The only upside I can think of is that it smells fruity and even so, if you are a more mature skin care enthusiast you wouldn’t appreciate it as the scent it very intensely fruity and artificial smelling. For this hefty price tag, go on and find something better. Highly recommend the Caudalie Beauty Elixir.

While I do love glow recipe, I feel like I have a hard time getting this on my face. The mist is so fine it’s like I’m spraying 10 times the products I normally would. It’s not my first choice sadly.. it’s also very small & just too difficult for $28
I love this mist, and it keep my skin hydrated. Always have to mix it though, because it looks like it separates in the bottle.

Love the fine mist when using this product. It smells wonderful and feels great on the skin. Definitely recommend this product. This is my new favorite setting spray. Great for touch ups during the day.
A little pricey but the mist is so fine and refreshing. It smells amazing and makes your skin look hydrated and fresh. Would repurchase
I love this product so much. The smell isn’t too overwhelming and the spray is fine and dainty. I would repurchase this a million times.

Smells great and has a wonderful mist amount that sprays beautifully. Sadly, this made me break out terribly around my nose and chin, and I usually never have acne breakouts. Maybe it’s the fragrance, maybe something else, but totally didn’t make my skin smooth and glowy.

I have about 5 setting mists/sprays along with Evian water mist in my apartment at the moment. I love Glow Recipe and it may work perfect for you but for me it was to light of a mist, the bottle is extremely tiny and I’ve gone through half already in 3 weeks. The discontinued Korres Rose Spray is my 1st love but I’m a extremely loyal fan of Mario Badescu and he has the most lovely facial sprays in a fantastic price point. And MAC prep + prime is just that go to in every way. In my opinion I would personally invest among the mass majority of sprays out there today!
I absolutely love this product. It smells amazing and gives me the right amount of moisture.

I love this mist!!! It smells incredible and leaves my skin feeling so hydrated but not sticky or tacky in any way. I use this on my skin without makeup and reapply this on top of makeup to refresh it. Love it.

it’s super fine so it’s not as harsh as other brands like Mario Badescu Facial Sprays (i love mario badescu sprays they just feel like they shoot at the face) but this Glow Recipe Mist is perfect lovely fragrance smells just like their sleeping mask, toner and glow juice moisturizer!
This product is amazing. It smells really fresh and the “ultra fine mist“ is no joke! I use it as much as I can and yet it is still full!

I love that it can hold my makeup literally all day and its not a spritzer! but the smell is way to much for me, it sometimes overwhelms my own perfume unfortunately. if that make this fragrance free I’d totally buy more of this.

Works okay, nothing great nothing awful. Best part about this mist is the smell for sure. As far as a setting spray, you can find better for the same price. There’s no wow factor. The most is ultra fine, which I personally don’t like because it sometimes is hard to tell if I’ve sprayed enough, so I end up over spraying to compensate and end up using more than needed (if that makes sense). I personally wouldn’t recommend it for the price and the quality, but if you wanna feel trendy and cute by all means try it out for yourself. You might love it. But I’d rather buy something that legitimately works.

Love this stuff, great as a quick moisturizing base or finishing spray. I like dewy skin and this certainly gives just that when used at the very end of my makeup routine. The smell is definitely pretty strong and sweet, more like candy than actual watermelon but I love it. The spritz is amazing, so fine with an even distribution and goes so so far! I will say this product is far from a setting spray, if you have oilier skin and are looking for longevity this is probably not for you. But for my combo skin it’s awesome and feels luxurious, and has never irritated me!

LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE!!this product is so hydrating and refreshing! the mist is so fine it’s like a fog and goes on so evenly. this product really helped with restoring my moisture barrier when my skin was freaking out with the weather change. its a bit expensive but well worth the money!
Love this mist! I love the scent and I love the look it gives me. It’s like glass skin in a bottle! I LOVE the mister too! it is SO fine

Absolutely love this product! The glow recipe line is one of my favorite skincare products to use on my combination skin. The formula is not oily so it doesn’t leave my face looking like I was sweating all day.

This bottle has lasted me while and the scent is heavenly. I love that there is hyaluronic acid in it, I use it after my retinol and before my moisturizer. I love keeping it in my purse if I want my skin to look dewy in the middle of the day. I even sometimes wake up, spray this, put on some sunscreen, and that’s my skincare for the day. I sometimes don’t feel the need for moisturizer during the day when I have this! Will repurchase even though the price is a bit steep.

This doesn’t do enough for me to plan on purchasing again. I bought this to use immediately after cleansing as a first step to bring moisture back into my skin... but it’s honestly just sticky, and not hydrating. It smells nice, and I’ll continue to use it until it runs out, but I think there are better facial mists out there.

It smelled nice and was super cute but it went bad after 9 ish months. Smelled rancid. Contacted Sephora regarding an exchange bc it should be good for at least a year , but they refused. They told me to use my points to use towards their rewards... which we can all agree is crap. Even their employees tell you their reward system is crap. So don’t buy this. It’s rancid and Sephora isn’t fair nor do they care

This smells just lovely and is quite refreshing! The bottle looks so pretty pretty on my desk. That said, it is really expensive for so little product. I agree with other reviews that the product doesn’t do much. It has a top layer of oil you shake before use. The product is not drying on my face after evaporation, unlike some other mists. The spray is finer than the other similar spray, but not as fine as aerosol sprayers.  All in all, buy it for the lovely fragrance and packaging. Don’t buy it if you are expecting value or results. It is only a face mist after all.

Ingredients make me happy and make my skin happy. I love the watermelon smell and how this makes my skin feel. The mist is ultra fine and I love that. This product does settle so make sure you give it a nice shake before you use it. I keep this on my desk next to me so I can refresh every once in a while. Honestly, I don’t know and can’t 100% say that this is making a difference with my skin as I’ve added several new products recently, but it’s definitely not doing any harm. Perfect little slice of refreshment to glow up my skin during the day.
review_title: Hey mist, how you so fiiiiiiine???

review_text: Another hyped up, overpriced product.  The scent is nice but I was not impressed with the quality or effectiveness of the product.  Will not be purchasing again.

I can’t get over the scent of this face mist I’m in love!!!! The watermelon scent is so addicting I wanna spray this on my face all day. It also leaves my skin with a nice natural healthy glow. My only con with this is how fine the mist is. I know a lot of people rave about how nice and fine the sprayer is but I just find it too fine if you know what I mean. I have to hold it very close to my face just to feel the mist. I’m also going through this bottle very quickly because you need to spray so much just because how fine the mist is. Maybe that’s just me because I’m obsessed with looking super dewy and need something with a heavier spray to really coat my face lol. If you’re not into that super dewy look then you’ll probably really love this mist although I prefer a more heavier face mist. However I do love this and will continue to repurchase just because how amazing the watermelon scent is. Perfect for summer!

I love it!! The smell is great and the cool mist hitting your skin is wonderful. I bought two bottles during the VIB sale and I hope they will last until the next sale. I could spritz this all over my body. It is wonderful after washing your face for the night or after putting on your makeup or just anytime. The mister on this product is super fine and never clogs. I just love the smell. If you are having hot flashes keep it in the refrigerator and mist yourself....cools you right down!

The glow I got from this is hype worthy I love this especially if I’m in a rush in the morning amd wanna look fresh on my way to work.. I keep it in my lunch bag for work so I never forget ..love it so much

It’s honestly not hydrating. I know it’s a hyped up product but i decided to try it even though I avoid fragrance because i’ve heard it’s super moisturizing. it’s not! Honestly I couldn’t even tell the difference after using it several times. another over hyped mist with fragrance and no real benefit. I also don’t like mists because i don’t like the mist to get onto my eye area which is hard to avoid when spraying it onto your face. Have to spray it onto your hands first

I love a quality facial spray during the summer months for an instant refresher.  Because I’ve become so very impressed with Glow Recipe watermelon products, I had to add this to my routine.  This mist is now among my favorites, delivering a thin moist essence of fresh watermelon which I find to be not only moisturizing, but cooling and calming.  At one time in my life, I was all about lavender.  However, these great watermelon products have earned an A+ in my beauty regimen!  I keep one in my car for an instant pick-me-up whenever I’m out and about!  Love love love!
Works great as a setting spray or a refresher during the day.  Great smell. totally recommend.
The Smell is great but waiting on stores to open to return. Have to always shake and kinda sticky. The size is cool small and portable fits in a small purse or a fanny pack
I have very oily skin , so this is so perfect ! I find it hydrating plus my skin gets a very glow effect from it . The bottle will last me a long time . I use it twice a day . I will repurchase ❤️
This is awesome! I keep it on my desk at work and spritz it throughout the day to refresh my skin. Smell is awesome, very light.
It’s great for setting your make up, or just adding a little bit of hydration to your face.

This face mist is perfectly a true micro mist, looks gorgeous, and smells like a fresh squeezed watermelon... But it is by no means a moisturizing spray. This mist is more for uplifting your mood and getting a mild amount of humidity increased. Does not look or feel moisturizing. Would I buy again? Probably not.

I don’t ever expect visible differences in my skin from a face mist, so I bought this having zero expectations there. PROS: smells lovely, beautiful and functional packaging. The mist is super fine and sprays very evenly, the best of any mist I’ve tried in that respect. CONS: The amazing scent is literally only while you are spraying it, dissipates instantly. No tingly, refreshing feeling on the face (as with Claudalie face mist and many others). And seriously the price! Definitely expected more out of this baby for $28 TLDR: Great product if price is not a factor whatsoever. Personally will be returning and rebuying Claudalie beauty water

I’ve been wanting to try this product for a few months and finally caved. The mist is sooo ultra  fine that it takes way too many pumps to feel like it’s doing anything. I’ve only had it a few days/used it a few times, and a noticeable amount is already gone. Smells great but for me it did absolutely nothing :(((

love the way this evens out my skin tone. i have very sensitive skin that tends to get red no matter what i try to do to stop it. keeping this in my bag and spraying my face when ever i need it EVEN WHEN I HAVE MAKEUP ON helps sooooo much !!!
SO FRESH! this mist is fine textured with an amazing scent. Great to add a dewy finish to your morning and night skincare routine, or to refresh throughout the day. Love this product!

Truly luxurious!!! This is ultra hydrating and I love spraying some on my face before I put my hyaluronic acid to ensure my face is extra damp & improve the effectiveness of my HA. If you’re looking for a mist this is a must!!

I’ve been curious about this brand forever and finally decided to purchase something I’ve had my eye on. So let’s get into the specifics: Smell - 5/5. Delicious. I love spraying it on my face for the smell. I usually hate overly sweet scents but this one is nice. Mist - 3/5. It’s SO fine I barely feel like I’m putting anything on my face. I like to feel a little gratification for a hydrating mist but I feel like this one doesn’t have much. Moisturizing - 2/5. It doesn’t do much, tbh. I sometimes wear it over makeup but even then I don’t feel like it adds much. Overall, I probably wouldn’t purchase this again. I do want to branch out in this brand though since I like the scent.
Smells amazing but is not irritating like some scented skin care products can be. I’m obsessed with this product and use it throughout the day. Will repurchase.
I’m so obsessed with this stuff! This mister is insanely smooth and it makes my skin look glowy all day long. Also sits on top of makeup just fine, been using it as a setting spray!

The smell of this mist is very refreshing and the spray is very fine and covers a big area of the face with one squirt. However, I noticed it changed color after some time and I had to throw it out. I probably would not repurchase.
I love this! Im not sure exactly what its suppose to do but once I spray it on, it leaves my skin glowing and super fresh. It also smells delicious!!
My fav mist! It smells absolutely heavenly, like watermelon jolly ranchers and feels so fine on the skin.
Fun packaging, and smells amazing. I don’t really know if it does anything but i enjoyed it as a luxury item
I am obsessed with watermelon so I love this spray! Hydrates my skin and feels and smells heavenly.

It is not a bad product, but I’m failing to see its purpose. I use it in between skincare layers to promote better absorption for the next product, but I feel like spritzing plain water on my face would give the same results. It does smell very good, exactly like juicy watermelon, but the scent doesn’t last for more than a few seconds. It does feel refreshing and the packaging is cute. Won’t buy again though.
review_title: Too little product for the price

review_text: If you want glowing skin and something that smells great then this is for you. The first ingredient is Watermelon extract.

I am a product junkie, I literally tried over 50+ products just in the last year. I find a lot of sprays to be sticky/tacky, that they sit on top of my sling vs penetrating it, or that they make my skin too shiny (I look like I’m sweating). I keep coming back to this one because the moisture sinks in, makes me look refreshed, is light weight, & makes my skin glow and have a slightly dewy finish wo looking like my whole face is covered in highlighter
review_title: my go to mist, & I’ve tried them all!

review_text: Not impressed. This was not hydrating and didn’t feel or see any difference. The same results with just spraying with water.

This is such a good product??? I put this before makeup and after too and my skin became so good??? Like tf I’m oily usually but it giving me such a cute healthy cute glow and I don’t look super oily I am in love ngl
review_title: sent by gods and smell so good

review_text: This is one of my favorite products to use, in the spring and summer its super enjoyable bc of the watermelon scent. One of the best things about it is it’s very refreshing and it cools you down and keeps you moisturized throughout the day. The bottle is small enough to put in your purse and carry with you to refresh your makeup. If your makeup separates or creates dry spot it’s easy to use this to fix it. I have a travel-size brush I carry with me, I just spray this on at my desk using a compact mirror. I brush it out then tada... brand new again. You’re going to love this product. Quick tip, on days where you are exhausted and you know you’re not going to complete all of your skincare steps, you can use this spray in replacement of several steps. I don’t recommend doing that on a regular basis, I just mean when you’re completely tired. I like the Korean skin care routine, however on rare days I don’t feel like doing toner then essence then moisturizer. I cut out all three of those steps and just spray this on after washing my face and I  finish with a hydrating and moisturizing sleep mask. This product is extremely multi-functional.

Too sweet, feels sticky on face and after having it for about 6 months, it developed some sort of nasty brown layer on the top when it would sit like it was molding on the inside. Would not recommend.

I was so excited to try this mist, but was immediately disappointed when I finally received it! I had carefully read all of the reviews, and knew the risk of this product having a short shelf-life. However, I was not expecting it to already be expired when it arrived in the mail! The product is murky and white/yellow in color (it looks so much more gross irl than it does in the photo I’ve attached), and I haven’t even opened it yet. Do NOT buy this product!
I use this as a toner in the morning. It does add a nice glow to the skin, but I honestly enjoy the experience more than the product. It smells amazing and the mist is heavenly.

I bought this spray a couple weeks ago and i’m obsessed with it. I watch a skincare specialist on youtube by the name of Hyram, on his channel he recommends different types of products that have amazing ingredients and that he personally has tried and enjoyed. On his channel he frequently says that facial sprays are not an essential step or product in a skin care routine. On the other hand, I love facial sprays and think that they are very hydrating and fun. He talked about this spray on his channel and said that it wasn’t the worst ever and that if he would ever use a spray he would maybe try out this one. Since I was looking for a facial spray to purchase, I went ahead and purchased this watermelon glow ultra-fine mist and it is amazing. It smells amazing and it leaves your skin feeling hydrated and dewy. The packaging is super cute and it is a wonderful addition to your skincare routine. I DEFINITELY recommend it.

Let me start off by saying I do use this product, just not as often as my other mists. The main reason I gave 3 stars is because I took 1 star off for the mister, as it’s so sheer that I feel the need to hold the product very close to face before using it, or else my skin will not feel damp in the slightest. I took 1 more star off because the smell is very strong. It’s not bad or irritating, but I could see how it could be for more sensitive skin. Overall, it’s still a good product, just not for everyday use, in my opinion.
This smells SO bad. I actually like the smell of the mask but the spray bottle has a bad smell, sickly sweet like throw-up.

I use this product as a setting spray for my makeup and it truly melts into my face and makes everything look so nice and natural. I use a lot of heavy makeup products too, so the fact that my face looks so smooth and glowing with this product has made it my go to setting spray. 10/10 would recommend. and it smells so good.

The mist--heavenly. So light and diffused. The smell--delightful. Light and fresh watermelon scent like their overnight mask. Spraying this on your face is a lovely experience. However, I find this is better used under my makeup than over it. Maybe because I have normal-oily skin I found it ever so slightly broke down my makeup when used as a setting spray, though it did give an amazing glow. I switched to using BEFORE makeup (as the last step after skincare/sunscreen) and I don’t have that problem anymore. It still helps give a glow, but much more controlled.
review_title: more skin care than setting spray

review_text: Like it.Smell amazingIm using it every day and enjoy it
love everything about it, the smell and the way it makes my skin feel
Looks totally different from the pic, definitely would not recommend
I dont really feel like it did anything for me especially for the price
I love Glow Recipe. But this is my by far my favorite. I keep it in my bag and on my counter. I spray a little when my face starts to feel dry and after after I moisture my face. It feels so good.
It feels so nice and hydrating and refreshing and smells amazing. It’s just a nice thing to have for a quick mid day spritz

This mist was beautiful the first 2 months. Smelled great and had a true refreshing feel to the face when applied. I used this product almost daily at my work desk. The smell and texture noticeably changed and soured within 2 months. Very disappointed.
i think this is a great product at a decent price. at first its very refreshing but then it wears off a little, i still love it though!

I really like this.. The mist is very light and soothing.I was a bit concerned the fragrance would be too strong because i typically don’t like face mists/sprays with strong scents but it was perfect. Most importantly I love how it makes my skin look.
Love the smell, love how hydrating it is and love that the spray is super fine.
Mediocre. Did nothing for my dry skin, scent got old after a while. YTTP spray is better. I got this in between purchases to try something new, and it was a no go.
I love the smell of this and like any face mist it’s really refreshing but I don’t find it does much in terms of hydration. I loved it but I wouldn’t repurchase, it was fun to try.

First, only bc I’m so genuinely, wholly in love with this, I suspect my honest review may read something like an ad, let me just say that this is a totally honest review. I’m addicted to collecting mists (& lip balms; their watermelon lip pop balm is also delicious) and though I’ve tried hundreds and always have a rotation of at least 20 going, this is one of the best I’ve ever used, if not THE best. If I had to recommend only one facial mist generally, without knowing the characteristics/preferences of the person to whom I’m recommending, this would be it. Granted, I’m quite partial to watermelon, but then, who isn’t? Plus, it actually has some great qualities and universal uses, beyond its piquant and delectable scent. It seems like it would be universally well tolerated, even by those with sensitive skin, and beneficial to any skin type. I honestly can’t even imagine what anyone could complain about with this product. The spray mechanism is high quality and delivers the finest mist I’ve ever seen so that you can spray it on top of makeup without displacing it. In fact, it improves makeup by slightly diffusing any powder or buildup, letting it melt into your skin to look more natural and settled. Furthermore, you can also overuse the f*** out of it like I do, simply bc you’re an addict in need of a hit, and it will still last quite a while. Even with several pumps, the measured, delicate cloud is never overwhelming. It produces a beautiful and natural glow w/or w/out makeup. It really does feel hydrating and moisturizing, without leaving any kind of unpleasant residue. It also acts as the perfect afternoon de-stress mist; the silky yet sheer dew refreshes and calms the nerves, the sumptuous smell inspires deep, calming breaths. Overall, it’s a luxurious, almost epicurean sensuous experience that will at once improve the appearance/feel of your skin, make you feel indulgent and happy, and remind you, even amidst midday tension, to stop and smell the watermelons.

review_text: I received a full-size version of this product with Glow Recipe’s Glow Together Set (which I totally recommend - the set is the price of just the Watermelon Glow Mist alone, but comes with a mini-size of Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Glow Sleeping Mask - it’s a great value with great products!). The mist is great! I have dry skin, especially during the winter, and a couple of spritzes at the end of my skincare routine (following moisturizer, or, if I’m going outside, skincare) just adds a nice hit of moisture. It also smells really nice, like a watermelon Jolly Rancher (for watermelon purists, this scent is a bit artificial). I generally spray the bottle about 4-5 times per use, and the nozzle is amazing - it produces a true mist that’s so fine that it’s almost like fog. I use this three times a day: after my morning skincare routine, after my post-workout shower, and after my nighttime skincare routine. I estimate that the bottle will last me around two months, which is perfect because my friends have told me that the mist starts to lose its scent and color after about 2 months anyway (the color doesn’t matter as much to me, since this mist bottle is in special packaging and isn’t clear like the original mist bottle).Also, I’m a sucker for cute, aesthetic packaging, and this product (and Glow Recipe’s entire product line in general) really fits that description! It really matches the Glossier products on my skincare shelf, which is just the icing on the cake! In conclusion, I would recommend this product to anyone that wants a soothing, hydrating mist that smells amazing (so, literally everyone!).

This is my favorite product ever. I use it under makeup, throughout the day as a refresher. I forgot moisturizer in my travel bag and used this in place of it. It’s an amazing product and smells incredible

Absolutely in love with this product, such an amazing scent and mister! I would repurchase this again and again! The only reason I’m not giving it a 5-star is because of the size. I really love using facial mists as a last step to lock in the rest of my skincare, as an extra boost of hydration, or to wake myself up a little. I’ve found most of the mists I have tried to be super underwhelming, watery, and seem to disappear into thin air after a few seconds of being on my skin. I really fell for this one after trying it at a store because it feels more substantial than other mists I’ve tried. I like that it’s a bit “milky“ and feels slightly moisturizing without being sticky, and actually seems to linger on my face for a bit. I wouldn’t say face mists are absolutely necessary as part of anyone’s skincare routine, but if you want to try incorporating them - this is a great one to try out.

I then reapply at mid-shift break and sometimes before the end of my shift. one bottle, with this much consistent use, has lasted me a good, solid three months. the bottle sweats internally and eventually pretty much fully emulsifies so that I barely have to shake it before use anymore. maybe that’s how I store it, but I literally just keep it in my bag. THIS IS NOT A SETTING SPRAY! it is a refreshing spray. it keeps my make up from breaking up over my oily skin, and also keeps it from getting cakey on my drier skin, with regular use throughout the day, but it does not increase the longevity of products. the benefits of this do not come from the make-up aspect of this spray, but more from the skincare benefits. This being said, I myself have bought many products from this brand like all their serums, dew drops and moisturizer and I do not regret those purchases. The last thing I personally was missing from this brand was their mist so naturally I bought it.      When I tell you the pictures are lying to your face. The actual size of the bottle is very small. I understand mists are very limited and compact in the skincare industry and its hard to find a good one you enjoy with actual product size. If you are thinking about this product I suggest finding it in store, smelling it and looking at its size if that’s something you want to spend $30 on. The box it comes in is also a little misleading because when you open it up, their is a major size difference.     Another reason I rated this product 2 stars is that it smelled lovely however, going off off appearance and aesthetics it looks NOTHING like the picture. The picture is very bubbly/cute/pink. In real life, the product is DIRT BROWN. Literally brown juice. Never in my life have I been more disappointed and cat-fished from a product. review_text: This eye sleeping mask from glow recipe is incredible! I use Glow Recipe’s entire line (minus the avocado products because I have combo skin) and I love it. When I heard they were releasing an eye sleeping mask I couldn’t be more excited to try it. I have a very sensitive eye area. I’ve tried numerous eye products on the market and they all seem to cause me to break out as well as form milia around my eye area. As you would assume I was a little cautious to try this. I opened the box and couldn’t get over how cute the packaging was (no surprise there though really). I opened the jar and the smell is amazing. Using the little spoon I placed a pea sized amount on the back of my hand. It was so soothing and creamy, but not too rich. When I started patting it onto my eye area I couldn’t get over how little effort it took to sink into my skin. It was so soothing, especially on the acne and milia I already had around my eye area. Now time for sleeps. I wake up in the morning and can not believe my eyes! They were definitely visibly brighter and less puffy after just one use! The acne and milia were also less red and sensitive as well as decreased in appearance which I couldn’t be more happy about because it’s absolutely painful. I am so happy with this product and look forward to seeing even better results after continued use. Thank you, Glow Recipe!
product_name: Avocado Fine Line Eye Cream with Retinol

review_text: I have some mild wrinkling around the outer corners of my eyes, chronic stubborn dark circles, and I frequently wake up with puffy eyes due to lack of sleep, stress, drinking the night before, whatever.  I got a sample of this and it’s been exactly one week that I’ve used it every night. First of all, I was really nervous about putting retinol by my eyes due to a bad experience with getting Drunk Elephant’s retinol too close to my undereye and experiencing crazy burning and redness for days.  But this stuff is seriously gentle! I haven’t experienced any irritation whatsoever. It applies easily, and really does melt into your skin, getting creamier as you apply.  I, to my surprise, notice a difference in my dark circles, which have been untouched by numerous other eye creams. The wrinkles by my eyes don’t look as prominent and the puffiness is non-existent in the morning.  My eyes feel hydrated and “awake.“ I seriously wasn’t expecting these results (or any results tbh, so many eye creams do absolutely nothing) but I’m so glad I stopped in the store and got a sample because this is definitely something I want to continue using.  10/10!

Another one of the claims put forth by the creators of Glow Recipe is that the encapsulated retinol is supposedly great for dealing/preventing milia, as well. I’m super prone to milia, so that was another reason I purchased this. Unfortunately, I’ve yet to see positive results for existing milia, and I’ve since had 2 new milia pop up since I started using this, so I can’t confirm that as a benefit whatsoever.All else aside, it’s very similar in consistency, texture, and scent to the Sleeping Mask, just in a tinier bottle.If you’re looking for a hydrating eye mask with the POTENTIAL for dealing with wrinkles/milia, I’d say give it a try. I’ve turned 2 friends onto this product and they absolutely love it, so, I’d say if you’ve got mild concerns, this is worth a shot. If, like me, you’ve got more problematic eye concerns (deeper wrinkles, milia, and eyebags), this is by no means a miracle eye cream that’s going to do any more than what’s already out there. Onto the next one!

review_text: I have been using the Glow Recipe Avocado Melt retinol eye cream for four months (I’m about halfway through the jar) and I really like it. You need a tiny amount, like a grain of rice on each eye (maybe even less), to do the trick, and they give you a tiny spoon. I use it only at night and I wake up to really hydrated undereyes, much more so than other creams/gels I’ve tried (Laneige, Farmacy, Volition, drugstore brands). It isn’t sticky and it sinks in really nicely and quickly. The retinol has firmed and thickened my skin - it’s not strong retinol and I’m only 35, so it reasonably does what it can, I think. And I know “thickened” sounds weird and somewhat gross, but my undereye skin was so thin and dry (like tissue paper!) and it is definitely not anymore, in a really good way. I have but one complaint: there’s no place to keep the spoon with the jar. I keep it off to the side but wish it were magnetic or something. I am overly picky about skincare in general. Not only do I not buy anything without researching all the possibilities and ingredients first, I am ALWAYS tempted by what else is out there - but I would definitely repurchase this one. It has treated my skin very well.

review_text: I have never reviewed a product from Sephora, but I had to review this one. I have hooded eyes and thin skin around the eyes, but up until about a year or so ago they were relatively symmetrical and just had one smooth fold. Then, the right started getting more hooded and crepey, and I felt really self-conscious about the uneven effect. I also started to notice darker circles even while well-rested, and a vein that was becoming particularly visible. Plus, I was prone to milia and I stupidly attacked one and gave myself a small pink scar earlier this year. Ok. Enough gory detail this stuff. The first 2-3 weeks, I didn’t see any difference, and then for 1 week or so my eyelids felt a little dry—not peely or uncomfortable, but the dryness made undereye wrinkles look deeper temporarily.  I used a bit extra of my usual eye cream during the day to help. Then after about a month or so of use, I’ve started to see slow, steady improvement. The scar is completely faded. The fine wrinkles are much finer. And the best of the best is that the crepey quality and the very thin, dark undereye skin is retreating. Circles are lighter, veins less visible, firmer skin all around. I feel like someone dialed back my eyes a year or two.  I use nightly, and a little goes a long way. I don’t have particularly sensitive skin, so I feel fortunate I didn’t have any reactions. I use very hydrating cream during the day to avoid dryness, and I’ve never had persistent dryness since that one week.  (I use the Tatcha Renewal eye cream on no-makeup days, and the lighter Silk Peony which doesn’t budge under makeup on other days). Honestly, the effect was better than I was allowing myself to hope for. I haven’t developed milia, and the one stubborn one I had seems like it may be smaller (but could be passage of time).  Give it a try for at least 2 months—you might be surprised. Check out the before & after (both no makeup, sorry for the silly face but you can clearly see the extra folds on one side).

review_text: I give it 4.5 stars.  I deduct half a star for the somewhat awkward packaging (the opening is super tiny and you have to carefully dip the tip of a finger in) and the fragrance.  However, the fragrance is not overpowering at all and hardly noticeable.I really like the texture of this eye mask.  I appreciate that the brand isn’t lying when they call this an eye mask- most eye “masks“/creams are simply normal formulated moisturizers and just called a mask.  This actually feels like a hydrating leave-on mask.  It feels like it actually forms a thick shield on your eye skin that is still there the next morning.  The product is very thick and moisturizing and easy to apply- not too thin that it’s watery and slips around too easy and not to thick that it tugs on your eyes.  It is perfect right in the middle.  I like the addition of niacinamide too for additional anti aging benefits.  This feels very occlusive which I love for the eye area.  This product didn’t irritate my eyes at all and I can see myself being able to use this nightly in the future without irritation.This is a wonderful product and an amazing foray into this brand (my first GR product).  If you’re wanting to get into this brand I think this is a good product to start with. This is one of my favorite skincare products I’ve acquired lately.

review_text: Will be the moisturizer I will use FOREVER! In recent years I have found myself thoroughly frustrated with the skincare industry & the US’s regulation of it. Companies are allowed to place just about anything in our products. As a medical esthetician, who took the time to really study ingredients, where they are derived, what they do & how, I have found myself reading thousands (not kidding) of product ing. lists thinking, “This is not touching my skin!I am severly acne-prone & sensitive (hormones, ugh) I can’t use even the most noncomedogenic oils on my skin, they will all eventually clog my pores. I need an oil-free moisturer that does not contain ingredients that will irritated my sensituve skin or break me out. It is almost an impossible task! Even products claiming to be “clean“ & free of nasties like parabens, pthlates, petroleum based ingredients, etc etc, usually still contain fractionated oils (like capric/caprylic triglyceride, which is altered palm or coconut oil), silicones (which while not comedogenic in & of themselves, do seal things that are against the skin, like your own dead skin cells & sebum), alcohols (drying, except for a few, like cetyl, stearyl, cetearyl, which are fatty alcohols, but they are comedogenic). Stumbling across this product was great. I find it moisturizes my combo skin well, no irritation, helps barrier function, has anti-inflammatories for soothing breakout & light acids for exfoliating. If some of those ingredients look scary, they aren’t, promise. My only issue is with “fragrance“ at the bottom. It contains lots of plant & fruit extracts (just be careful if you have allergies, read all of them), plus: Gluconolactone is a PHA, polyhydroxy acid, that exfoliates gentler than AHAs;Sodium Polyglutamate is similar to HA in that it draws moisture, but also help your acid mantle & is anti-inflammatory; &Betaine Salicylate is a gentle acid, milder than salicylic acid, another beta-hydroxy acid. All reasons I love it!
product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: As a Southern woman, I know good watermelon when I smell it and this toner kind of freaked me out the first time I used it. The large pores between my cheek and nose area do not suck up as much foundation as it used to (and doesn’t need as much product there)HOWEVER2. Something in the toner irritates my already irritated skin on my chin and right above where my unibrow would be if I allowed it to grow in (these areas are covered by my foundation and a color correcting concealer. So what IS this? PHA, or Poly Hydroxy Acids are a group of acids that work their magic slowly, which is great for sensitive skin that is prone to irritation and redness (which befuddles me as to why it does NOT help me). And BHA stands for beta hydroxy acid. BHAs are water-soluble acids made from sugary fruits. They help peel away the surface of your skin so that new, more evenly pigmented skin cells may generate and take their place.You would *THINK* that this toner would help my irritated skin, but alas, it doesn’t. My irritated areas peel, and true to the BHA, the peeling gets WORSE. With that said, I am enjoying the benefits from the scent and the pore cleaning/tightening on my nose and between said nose and cheeks.

I have been using this product for a few months at the time of this review and the results from this product have been incredible! The two most dramatic improvements I have noticed are my pores are definitely smaller and my skin is “tighter” and much smoother. My husband has even commented on how soft my face feels and noticed the improvement of skin texture. The scent of this product is very much like natural watermelon rind. Even thought it doesn’t affect the quality of the product, aesthetically, the packaging and color of the product are also very pleasing and beautiful. Safe to say, this product works for 22 year olds and 56 year olds, and for both dry and oily skin types! Money well spent.

review_text: Sure, the fragrance of this toner isn’t the most pleasant, but that doesn’t take away from its efficacy. Aside from that, when they say ‘pore tight’ they mean it. It has really helped dissolve the blackheads on my nose. And instead of drying the skin out like other blackhead removal products, it’s hydrated it. I’ve also noticed a visible difference in all the pores on my face. To combat the stickiness, use less product, spread it around your face and then tap until it’s absorbed. It takes a while, but it’s worth it.
product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: This is my first time purchasing Glow Recipe and I wasn’t impressed.  I really just found this to be an awkward formulation because, while the premise of combining exfoliating PHA+BHA with hydrating cactus water, etc., seems to make sense (so that the astringent acids are supposedly balanced out by the watermelon and hyaluronic acid), in actuality what this gives you is a strong dose of exfoliation/astringency that does strip your skin of some of its usual hydration and oils which the watermelon, cucumber, and hyaluronic acid can’t make up for because those molecules aren’t small enough to deeply penetrate your skin but will block the passage of subsequent skincare products.  So, using this product as your first-step toner in the long run, you’re putting something quite aggressive on your skin and then not able to sufficiently nourish your skin afterward which makes for stressed, malnourished, and prone to wrinkling skin.  The first couple weeks using this product yields good results because, yes, the PHA+BHA are doing their work, but then I started noticing progressive dryness and peeling.  It just seems like this product wasn’t thought through very well.I also disliked the candy-like scent of the product and its packaging which is simply cheap and unattractive.  For a product of this price and size, a bumpy glass bottle and plastic cap just seem inadequate.  And, given its overall value due to the formulation, I wouldn’t buy this again and do not recommend.
product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: Great product. Honestly the best toner I have used. Unlike most toners, which tend to be acidic or have a strong scent, this tone is very light, has no harsh smells, is a gooey serum-like consistency, absorbs quickly and does not cause oiliness. The description of this product also suggests it can reduce blackheads. I’ve been using it for 5+ weeks now, as my morning and afternoon toner. During the first two weeks, it did not visibly reduce my blackheads and I was very frustrated. However, I started using other products in conjunction with this toner (ie. Aztec Clay mask 1x week can find on Amazon Ca for $10… and using a blackhead extractor 1x week), I then noticed no new blackheads. So it does not reduce existing blackheads, you’ll have to do that on your own, but this is great for keeping new blackheads out! Also, great for sensitive skin and the scent is not harsh; in fact it’s very pleasant and goes away within 20mins of application. The photo I’ve attached is my bottle after 5+ weeks of 2x daily use, so it will last me a while (6+ months). I recommend using the K-beauty method of applying the toner with your hands, like a serum. This way you save toner and save the environment from single-use cotton pads! Absolutely love this product. 5/5 for soft, young, healthy and blackhead-free skin!
