review_text: This is a really nice exfoliating toner for sensitive skin. I bought this thinking that the BHA referred to in the title was salicylic acid, which is probably the most powerful and most well-known BHA around. In reality, the BHA in here is betaine salicylate, which is believed to be twice as as gentle as salicylic acid. Gluconolactone is a PHA that helps gently remove dead skin cells while also providing anti-oxidant and moisturizing benefits. These two exfoliants are gentle enough that most people can probably use this daily without suffering the intense side-effects that might come with traditional salicylic acid or glycolic acid toners. I’ve been enjoying this toner for the past few weeks. It has a really interesting bouncy, watery jelly texture that I’ve never come across in another toner before. Obviously it’s been too little time to notice anti-aging benefits, but so far I’ve been enjoying its hydrating effects. It sinks in pretty quickly so that’s nice. I can definitely see myself repurchasing this in the future.

review_text: Usually I don’t buy into the hype or overhype of products, but something told me to jump on the Glow [Recipe] Train, and I’m glad I did. This ’toner’ (more like an essence) is absolutely wonderful to use and is like a tall refreshment for my combo-dry skin. It’s fast absorbing and dries down to a smooth, refined, non-tacky texture without the dryness -- perfect for a makeup base! I figured when I read conflicting accounts of a watermelon-scented product vs “this doesn’t smell at all like watermelon“ that it likely smelled like *real* fresh watermelon and not the synthetic (candy) watermelon scent with which we’re all familiar... And I was right. If you’ve ever drank a fresh-squeezed watermelon juice, that’s just what it smells like. I prefer to apply this using just my fingers (it’s so soft) as a little goes a LONG way -- much further than if using cotton pads/rounds -- and I’ve not noticed any “stringy clouds“ or “floaters“ in the product, though I attribute such comments to the cactus water (neat addition.)  As for the plunger, I initially thought this was a silly complaint as the little ring-handle makes it easy-peazy to remove, but with time mine broke (even though I anticipated such and thus was gentle removing everytime). This is kind of a bummer as I must store my cosmetics away when not in use due to curious children, and thus, can’t rely on just keeping the packaging upright. It will require using my nails to remove going forward, which I’m not thrilled about.  While I’ve not noticed an improvement in my enlarged clogged pores, longterm, it provides a slight immediate refined and smooth appearance, and I will continue to use and purchase just because it’s such a treat for my skin..Now that my go-to nourishing toner has been discontinued, it’ll serve as replacement. It’s super gentle, it’s hydrating, nourishing, makes a perfect base for makeup application, and is a great addition to my AM routine when I give my skin a break from extensive PM routines.
product_name: Watermelon Glow PHA + BHA Pore-Tight Toner

review_text: meh... I bought this product on the glow recipe website and I thought I should provide some insight on the Sephora app.1. This cleansing balm contains polyethylene. Polyethylene contains plastic and is very harmful for marine life. If you want a polyethylene free cleaning balm, you may want to use Banila Co’s Clean it Zero cleansing balm. This cleaning balm does not contain polyethylene, so you will not be harming the fish and other marine life. Keep in mind that if people continue to use polyethylene, it will pollute our waters and will get into the food chain. There have already been instances where there was signs of micro plastic and polyethylene in fish. If we consume these fish, we will get plastic and polyethylene in our digestive system. This is why I personally do not use cleansing balms containing these ingredients. They are so harmful and do not do much. Plus, polyethylene is so high on the ingredient list meaning that there is a high concentration of it. 2. It’s not worth it’s price.For 32 dollars, you should be getting something that is unique. This is a cleaning balm, so similar to other cleaning balms. There are so many cheaper, higher quality, polyethylene free cleaning balms. I don’t get why this is priced so high for what it is. If you wish to buy it, go ahead, it’s just not the best. 3. It’s claims are not as amazing as it sounds.Glow recipe claims to have vitamins in it, however since this is a wash off treatment, your skin will not be getting as much of those benefits as you think it will. Essentially what is happening is that the vitamins from the papaya are going down the drain as you wash it off of your face. Sure, it might seem relaxing or nourishing, but it’s not really doing what you think. Overall, I think this cleaning balm is definitely not the greatest out there. With that amount of money you could get a better quality, polyethylene free, cleaning balm with better value. Also where did all of the bad reviews go?

review_text: So this review will be based on my first impression on how I found using this cleansing balm for the first time.A little bit about me:- I have VERY sensitive skin; the littlest things can irritate me.- I have rosacea; I can get very flushed, red checks on products that I can’t tell irritate me. Sometimes, the ingredients can sting my eyes, cause flushing around my T-zone, or a few hours later I can see new tiny bumps form. Now, I have read some of these reviews which played a huge part in me purchasing this. First off, the ingredients list was impressive, very minimal, and a bonus that this is certified Clean from Sephora! Also, I have never used anything from Glow Recipe as I find their products heavily fragranced (terrible for acne prone, rosacea and even my sensitive skin).However, I read the instructions and it was super easy to apply. I don’t know why some of these reviews say that it leaves residue; cause it really doesn’t. They must be using it on drenched skin... When I use the spoon to scoop up the balm, I first rub it in my hands then gently apply to where I have makeup/SPF. I gently use circular motions so that I know the balm has melted. When you can tell the balm is a warm-liquid against your face, that’s when you know it’s ready to wash off. I used luke-warm water to wash any trace off and followed up with my Cetaphil Gentle Cleanser (which is a must have for anyone who suffers from sensitivity) and I must say, my face felt clean, nourished, and plumped with no visible redness.I will continue to use this balm but only after a long day of work as I have to wear a mask for 8 hours. This is ideal to use once a day, preferable in the evening as a good way to ensure your skin has been thoroughly cleansed from all traces of makeup/SPF/build up oil.

review_text: Unlike many reviews here I actually bought this with my own money. On the pros side I believe that this is a nice and innovative cleansing balm. I was skeptical about the addition of papain because I thought that it wouldn’t actually exfoliating the skin.  You can rest assured that i found it made my skin smooth after 1 minutes of messaging the cleansing balm into my skin. I also like that it has a light fragrant smell from all the fruit extracts that isn’t overpowering. I like this because the cult favorite Then I Met You cleansing balm smelt to medicinal to me which is one of the reasons why I didn’t like that particular balm. Overall these benefits are winners in my eyes On the cons side this balm is extremely hard to get of the face because it does not emulsify well with water. I’ve have never had a cleansing balm or oil that required me to rub my face for a few minutes just to feel like I got most of the balm after. Although they rave about not using PEGs they are a known scientific based class of emulsifiers which is why they’re found in almost cleansing balms because they make it easier to rinse of the face. Since they replaced the PEGs with sorbitan oleate it do not have the same chemical properties of PEGs it makes it harder to remove it from the face. However, I recognize that PEGs can cause issues for some individuals which is why I only removed one star. But you have to double cleanse with this balm. So if you don’t like double cleansing I would pass on this because you will have a hard time trying to remove it from the face. Beside this con I think this is a wonderful cleansing balm and I will probably purchase it again in the future

review_text: I wear very little makeup, so a little of this balm goes a long way. It has a lovely texture and a mild fragrance. It’s gentle on the eyes too and takes everything off. It does leave a little bit of residue, though, and absolutely has to be followed by a second cleanser. It works fine as the first step in a double cleanse but I doubt it could ever be used as a standalone cleanser. That said, I loved this and will probably repurchase.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: isn’t very good for removing mascara. if you don’t wear makeup and use a double cleanse system this would be good, it smells nice and is really smooth. if you wear makeup i would recommend micellar water over this.

review_text: I wasn’t sure how I would react to this initially because I have pretty sensitive skin and a dry eye disorder, but I was pleasantly surprised! This took off my face and eye makeup with ease and without causing any irritation to my skin or eyes. Once I rinsed it all off with a wet towel and warm water, my skin was left more hydrated and glowy before I even used my serums and moisturizer!

review_text: Really a great balm cleanser. It dissolves dirt, oil, makeup and spf nicely but does feel thick and takes quite a bit of water to remove it all. Afterwards, I don’t notice a film and my skin doesn’t feel tight, so only taking off a star for the thick texture.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: Smells so good! This makes washing my face so fun and enjoyable. I look forward to this every night. My face feels clean, soft, and refreshed afterward. It’s the closest I’ll come to a tropical vacation in a while :)
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: This smells delicious, and I like the texture is very soft and creamy so it glides on your face. It removes makeup effortlessly, as I use this first in double cleanse. product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: I received this for testing purposes. This product is amazing! I used to use the one from Clinique but this one is my new favorite. It isn’t greasy at all and it gets all my makeup (including eye makeup) off quickly. It also smells amazing and the pastel orange color is so cute. After learning how bad makeup wipes were for you I knew I needed one of these balms and this one is perfect! No complaints, this will be a staple product I use from now on

review_text: Overall I like this product! It is on par with the other beauty cleansing balms, non irritating, feels good on my skin and has an amazing smell. Comes with a ton of product! I received this product free for testing purposes

review_text: LOVE best cleansing bomb i have ever purchased!! melts everything off so gentle on the skin

review_text: At first I used way too much and couldn’t get it to rinse off. A little goes a long way. It actually does remove waterproof makeup (eyeliner, mascara) and I didn’t need to double cleanse. I received a sample and am planning on getting the full size.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: Removes makeup like a dream. Only con to this is that it’s hard to wash the actual balm off.

review_text: I was not sure about trying this product, because it is not fragrance free. However, the fragrance has not irritated my skin or my eyes. A lot of negative reviews say that it leaves a film on the skin, but this has not been the case for me. I use this to double cleanse, followed with my CeraVe hydrating bar soap. I love the texture and the very faint smell. It does as good of a job as my neutrogena cleansing oil when it comes to removing makeup and sunscreen. The only thing I don’t like about this is the high price point.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: Finally a cleansing balm for my sensitive acne prone skin! I’ve been wanting to get away from makeup wipes because they feel harsh. I tried a drugstore and the Clinique cleansing balms and they both made me break out and irritated my skin, especially my eyes. I had almost given up on cleansing balms until I saw someone use this in their irritated/sensitive skin routine so I took a leap of faith and it works like a dream. A little goes a long way and it easily removed my makeup include mascara without me have to rub hard. Tip: after you’ve rubbed in all over wet your hands with warm water and rub it in again before rinsing off. It helps it rinse off easier
review_title: the holy grail of cleansing balms
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: Just alright to me. It removes makeup but doesn’t emulsify as well as other cleansing balms I’ve used. I’m happy I got a sample and not a full size. I still prefer the Farmacy Green Clean.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: Astounding product! The texture of this is so smooth and buttery compared to other cleansing balms I have tried that are more thick. This can feel a little thick when you first add water after working it into the skin but as you thoroughly wash it off, it leaves the skin soft, smooth, clean, and overall nourished. I find myself enjoying removing my make-up a lot more when using this balm. It’s Polyethylene free, free of synthetic fragrance, rich in fatty acids, vitamins, and antioxidants. Also, a huge bonus is that it smells delicious. I think the name is super fitting with the texture and scent of the product as well.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: Wasn’t sure what to expect, but LOvED this. Not only was the packaging beautiful but the smell is to die for. It was so easy to use and a little goes a long way! Left my skin feeling so soft amd hydrated.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: If you are still using makeup wipes, finish using those and then purchase a cleansing balm & never go back to wipes. This product melts the makeup off so easily. review_text: I love it. The smell of this product is amazing, also I stopped using my cleansing water to remove make up because this does all the work. review_text: I have tried a few cleansing balms before (K-Beauty and US brands) and they were either gritty, drying, or triggered my rosacea. This cleansing balm has been great so far in comparison. It melts quickly and it’s super soft and gentle on the skin. The scent is very light and smells a bit like strawberries. I’ve recently found out that it removes my waterproof mascara that no other cleansing balm has! I typically use it to remove SPF and makeup at night, but it’s nice as a morning cleanse as well. Absolutely recommend giving it a try, I’m hooked.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: Love this cleansing balm! It’s a great first cleanse to get off all of your makeup & sun screen. It also smells really good & doesn’t leave as much of a residue I have noticed with other cleansing balms. My skin feels so soft after using this.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: Holy moly! Okay, so I typically don’t use products like this, BUT I gave it an honest trial after receiving it in my influenster box. It legit melted my makeup off. Like, you could see it happening. It went on smooth and came off smooth - but with ALL of my make up. As a simple girl who primarily uses the make up eraser and a cleanser, this was mega impressive. Plus my skin felt soft afterwards! Only downside is that it didn’t quite rinse off as well as I had hoped. Maybe this was a user error and I applied too much? Either way, I had to use a cloth to get all of it off properly. End result: I’m still thrilled!
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: This balm dissolves makeup and SPF better than Farmacy’s Green Clean (in my opinion), but will not give you the cleanse rinse (without oily residue) that Green Clean gives you. And let me tell you, I LIVE for Green Clean and typically always go back to it after trying other cleansing balms or oils. But this... is a game changer... I’ve always had trouble getting all of my waterproof eyeliner and mascara off with just a cleansing balm or oil and often have to use an oil based makeup remover to get whatever it didn’t dissolve, but I don’t have to do that with this one. I use One Size Beauty’s liquid liner and Marc Jacobs Highliner in my waterline and this dissolves EVERYTHING. Smells great, but isn’t over powering. Leaves your skin feeling hydrated and SUPER soft!But again, it will not give you a clean rinse. You will have an oily residue on your face so if you don’t like that, you will need to do a double cleanse with this balm.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: I LOVE this product. First off, the packaging is beautiful and the spatula is great. The smell WOW, mouth watering but NOT overwhelming. This feels like a treat for your skin. product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: I was really excited to try this as it smells really good and I’ve been a loyal fan of the clinique balm remover. Went on easy enough, but trying to take it off was another story. review_text: I received this product as a free sample from Sephora, it’s the only cleansing balm that has not made me break out. My skin looked really good the morning after using it and I was very happy with it. I’ll more than likely be buying the full size
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: This product is a great oil based cleanser. It has a nice consistency, unlike opposed to some other oil cleansers that’s can feel too think, this one felt nice and thin. This balm is fine to use on its own as a cleansing step. My skin felt clean and surprisingly soft after use. It did tingle and cause some redness on my cheeks, presumably from the enzymes in the papaya, but it wasn’t irritating. Plus the packaging is beautiful and it looks pretty on your sink.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: My new fav! product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: I really love this cleansing balm!It goes on so smooth and makes my skin silky soft. I’ve used it every night before bed for the past 3 weeks. This is mostly because i don’t like to fully rinse the product , as the directions suggest, i just do a quick rinse with warm water. I have been consistently using this for 2 weeks and have noticed a significant glow to my skin!
review_title: Pamper your face after a day of full cake.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: I got this balm as a reward sample from Sephora and was extremely excited to try it. Reviews were great and this brand was respectable so I had high expectations. Hands down one of the worst cleansing balms I’ve ever used. I hesitate to believe the reviews are real or honest at this point. Yes, it melted the makeup off from its oily nature. But holy crap, this stuff does not properly emulsify. Once you start rinsing with water to try to work it off, it literally feels like a layer of oil is sitting on your face still. It feels plastic-like and thick. I had to spend a long time rinsing with water but it wouldn’t budge. I double cleanse so I proceeded to use my face wash to help it come off, but it still felt glued to my face. Even after I managed to get most of it off, my eyes were still smudged with mascara residue. I didn’t feel clean whatsoever so I used a toning cotton pad with micellar water. To my horror, the cotton pad was still stained with leftover face makeup. Even the scent is horrible. Smells like cheap lip smackers lip balm. I never leave reviews and I avoid talking badly about products because I understand things work differently for different people. But this is straight up an awful product. What the heck....If you’re looking for a decent cleansing balm, I recommend the one from Pharmacy or another k-beauty brand called Then I Met You. Those set the standard. Do not waste your money or time on this product.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: I use this to take off my makeup before using a cleanser. Melted away everything, even waterproof mascara. Smells wonderful and the next day I noticed an improvement in the texture of my skin.

review_text: My boyfriend walked in yesterday and the first thing he said to me was “WOW your skin is glowing!“I received this product for Christmas and have been using it every night as my first step cleanser. After having multiple dermatologists mistake my dehydrated skin as oily skin, and giving me the wrong products to use I now have a lot of blackheads as well as acne scarring and hyperpigmentation. I have been using exfoliating products for the last year in an effort to get rid of my blackheads and clogged pores. After hearing about this enzyme cleansing balm and reading reviews I decided I wanted to try it and add it to my routine.First off I love the fruity refreshing smell. It does dissipate so if you’re concerned about a strong fragrance I wouldn’t let that deter you. It’s a very creamy balm consistency. I haven’t had any issues with it being runny or needing to be mixed like some other reviews have said so maybe that is a storing issue. It spreads on the skin really nicely and does a good job of removing makeup as my step one cleanser. To be fair I do not use foundation and only do eye makeup and lipstick. It rinses off better than other balm cleansers that I have used and leaves my skin really smooth. My skin feels so nice after I almost don’t want to do my step two cleanser.Being as I have only been using it a couple weeks, it’s hard to tell if it’s impacting my blackheads since they are so old and deep. But it is worth noting that the last pore strip I used seemed to pull out a lot more debris from my skin so maybe that is because of this cleanser.It only takes a small amount of product to cleanse my face so this jar is going to last me quite a while.It’s a bit more expensive than the last balm that I used but smells better, works better and takes less product to cleanse so in the long run I think it will actually be cheaper. I highly recommend this product if you are looking for a step one cleanser.
product_name: Papaya Sorbet Smoothing Enzyme Cleansing Balm & Makeup Remover

review_text: I bought this balm to use as a first cleanse to remove makeup and was attracted by the smoothing claim. It has a nice texture and glide over skin when first applied, but I can confirm that it does not emulsify, which is essential for a cleansing balm. It instantly becomes slimy when water is added and the mixture of makeup and balm that I would otherwise expect to easily wash off is instead transferred to my hands (it doesn’t wash off my hands either). I tested the balm on the back of my hand after the first time I used it because I thought maybe I used too much on my face; it didn’t get slimy and washed off well enough, though I don’t think it fully emulsified. When I tried it again the next night and used less it still became slimy, which makes me think that it only washed off my hand because my hand was already clean. Some reviewers say they’re removing the balm with a cloth, which is fine if you’re ok with that extra step and your skin can handle that type of exfoliation, but keep in mind that you don’t have to do that with a good cleansing balm. Other reviewers are saying to not worry about it not emulsifying because you can just wash it off with your second cleanser, but if you have to use your second cleanser to remove your first cleanser, then your second cleanser isn’t able to do its full job, and that makes this balm basically useless as a first cleanse.

I used to really like the IT cosmetics cleansing balm, but it would always fail at taking off my eye make up? even though it wasn’t water proof, I felt like I really had to scrub my eyes to get it off. so I decided to give this one a try. and I was blown away at how easy it takes all my make up off. no hard scrubbing, or “leaving it” to penetrate the make up. for me about a dime sized amount of product worked best. then I followed up with a gentle aveeno cleanser. my skin feels clean, and not tight and dry after washing ( even in the winter) this is not a paid review and im genuinely happy that I can cake on as little or as much make up as I want, and this balm will always get the job done!

review_text: It is indeed very rich, and can be a bit tough to get off with just water, but I always use a cloth to gently remove the first layer of any cleanser I use. The glass container gives the serum a luxurious feel, and I love that all the parts of the container are recyclable. I would definitely say that all skin types could use this serum, as it wasn’t oily nor drying to the skin. I will continue to use this serum.

I received this complimentary from Influenster. I have to start off by saying that I’m a huge fan of hyaluronic acid products,so I was super excited to try this one.  Looking at reviews by other users, it looks like I’m in the minority, as I did not care for this product.  I really wanted to love it.  It comes in a super cute pink bottle and has a really nice, slightly sweet smell, but after using on my combo skin for the past few weeks, while I feel like it absorbs OK, I feel like it leaves a sticky feeling on my skin no matter how much I rub it in.  With other hyaluronic acid products I’ve used, they normally absorb right in and my skin feels soft and plump.  The first time I tried it was the morning after I received it. I cleansed my face like normal and applied it lightly and wore it, without makeup for the day. Even after a full-day of wear, I felt like there was a slightly sticky film on my face.  My skin had a slightly dewy look, but upon touching my skin, it felt slightly tacky.  The next few times I used it, I applied it at night, after my shower, just before bed.  While my skin looked slightly more hydrated and MAYBE plumper in the morning, I still had the slightly sticky film feel in the morning.   So, while I really wanted to love this product, I would have to say that I don’t recommend it for everyone.  If possible, I would suggest buying a sample to see how it works for you because, even though it appears to be popular among others, I just didn’t get the same experience :(

review_text: A pleasant surprise from Glow Recipe for me, most notably in the fragrance (or lack thereof), and the beautiful way in which this serum goes on. The ingredients are fabulous, particularly for dry or dehydrated skin. I am combo, and tend toward dehydrated with an oily T-zone, so once a day usage (generally morning) on toner damp skin gave me the best results. My absolute favorite part of this serum is how beautifully it goes on - I imagine it is the silk proteins that give it the slip as it is silicone free (hallelujah!), but I got no pilling or stickiness like I get from most HA serums even when used on damp skin. This serum did sit wonderfully under makeup, but my honest favorite usage was for a bare face. The ingredients list is solid, but the 5 weights of HA seems a bit gimmicky to me. I did not see or feel a difference in hydration performance compared to other HA serums I have used. The antioxidants are a nice bonus, as is the collagen, but their effects are primarily seen long term. Having used the heavily fragranced watermelon and pineapple glow products in the past I was VERY surprised by the barely detectable hint of plum scent in this. If you are like me, and sensitive to fragrances skincare, this serum is absolutely worth a shot. Ultimately, if you are looking for a simple HA serum, there are plenty of other plainer, cheaper multi-molecular weight formulas to try. What sets this product apart is the addition of the antioxidants and the fabulous application that leaves you with the dewy, but not greasy look that is so desirable and well nourished skin.

Amazing love how it feels I noticed a difference right away super smooth great product

I bought this product 2 weeks ago and saw a significant difference in my skin. My skin was severely dry (my cheeks were red from being chapped and dry). I was in dire need of a boost of hydration. I am a drunk elephant junkie...but I was told to give this a try. I’m SO happy I did! I use this morning and night. A MUST is your skin HAS to be a little damp for it to work. If not, it feels like it doesn’t absorb at all. I use this product with the tea tree toner from lush. I fully dry my face, spray the toner and pat 2 pumps all over my face. I’ve had zero problems with this method, however I fully understand everyone is different and this might not work for them. I noticed my skin was so much more hydrated after a few days! The redness on my cheeks went away as well (which I usually have slight redness, but that’s gone too). I also paired this at night with Sephora’s firming night cream (this did such wonders for my extremely dry skin) During the day I paired this with the toner from lush, this product and followed up with an eye cream & sephoras firming day cream.

I have been using this for about 2 months with a bunch of other glow recipe products but after adding this I notice a big difference. Overall my skin looks a lot healthier and this was a great addition to my routine!

this was a total game changer for me. I’ve never had acne before in my life until I had to start wearing a mask everyday. my face was completely broken out. it hurt and I was so embarrassed. I have dry skin and the past few months I have not been very good with my skin care, leaving on my makeup when I sleep, not doing my night time moisturizer and so on. I implemented this mostly because I have been so bad at the rest of my skincare and thought even if I did this once a day every other day when I do makeup it might help hydrate my skin and omg did it. While it isn’t a really deep wrinkle or anything, it was still visible to me at least, now it’s only noticeable when I make facial expressions! Again, after just days! I absolutely 1000% recommend this. You need this in your life. Trust me.

I used to be a ride or die kinda fan of Glow Recipe, having owned every single product they’ve come out with (aside from the Niacinamide serum which I do plan to try once my TA one runs out). I’ve tried both the Ordinary and Inkey’s HA serums, really enjoying the results from Ordinary’s but being a sucker for Glow’s packaging and the added “benefits” this one promised....yeah, I should’ve known....I’ve been using this daily for over a month, I literally don’t see a single difference between what the cheaper Ordinary one accomplished over this one. It did cause me to have 2-3 very painful cystic bumps on my chin (that I thought was from something else and wasn’t), I haven’t had a single cystic bump in forever so it was definitely from this. And before anyone says it’s because of purging or new actives, I know how that works and I don’t get cystic outbreaks in purging/new active introductions. As for the results, it’s hydrating. It adds a nice healthy glow to my skin. As far as additional plumpness or line reduction? Nope. I get the same results from the $6-7 Ordinary HA serum. As for application, I agree with others about the problems with the bottle and pump. It is really sticky to me, but most HA serums are so that’s not an issue for me. It’s a good HA serum, but save your money and get the same results from a cheaper option. This one is nothing “special”......

review_text: Honestly thought this would rock but it just didn’t make my skin feel good. Felt very sticky and tacky on my skin.

This is the least moisturizing product I’ve ever put on my face. I have dry skin and live in a dry winter climate, so hyaluronic acid does nothing for me and I knew that going to into it, but the reviews are so good and it also advertises  deep hydration and glow. I was kindly sent this complimentary from Glow Recipe, but the thoughts below are entirely my own.First off, I’m already a Glow Recipe fan. I tend to like most of their products, and especially love the products targeting dry skin. I would overall say this is more of a product for dry skin, but I do think it could work for all skin types.Plum plump is such a beautiful product in both texture and experience. You’ve all seen the bottle, and yet somehow - I actually think it’s cuter in person! It’s oddly pleasing to hold in your hand, and I appreciate the solid glass packaging. The product itself does contain hyaluronic acid (obviously), but it doesn’t stop there. The plum ingredients (3 types) are rich in antioxidants and help to boost hydration.  I’m personally a fan of the addition of spirulina, which has anti-inflammatory properties, as well as the vitamin B5, which can be helpful for healing the skin. So yes, it’s much more than just another hyaluronic acid serum!As for a few more notes: while Glow Recipe doesn’t disclose the percentage of hyaluronic acid, based on the viscosity of the serum, i’d say it’s a higher percentage. And as for application, if you’re struggling at all, i’d recommend using a mist before or after applying the serum. If you’re in a drier climate, this can help boost the moisture content for the HA. The consistency is thicker, but still cosmetically elegant (and up to par with other Glow Recipe products).Overall, I’m very pleased!

I hate the feeling on anything sticky so I am soo picky about the feeling of products on my face-let me tell you that this is NOT sticky whatsoever. It is very thin once it goes on and dries so quickly, you will not regret it!
I use this product after I tone, I spray my face with rose water and then use it. Love!
I love this product. By far the best hyaluronic serum. They’ve spent some time with this formula. My skin looks incredible.

Skin was so dry from winter, a pregnancy and breastfeeding. This added a nice freshness to my skin and complemented my routine to recover my skin. I can see a difference if I don’t use it but I’m not sure if it’s crazy better than other HA serums for the price. But if it’s on your list or searching for a sure thing, get it.

I really love this product. I previously used The Ordinary HA serum but didn’t appreciate the sticky texture it left on my skin. I’ve experimented with other HA serums and have come to love this one and the Glossier one. But something about this one leave my skin looking so plump and glowy and hydrated. I have already used up a bottle and will definitely stick with this product as my go-to HA serum. I used it for 4 months every day, morning and night. I spray some rose water to create a damp environment for the serum to absorb the moisture from. It makes a huge difference! There isn’t a scent to the product as well, which is a plus. I also enjoy that it is in a pump form rather than the dropper form. My only complaint is that the packaging is bulky and the bottom of the bottle is thick, so I thought I had more until I realized I didn’t.
Works great on my skin! Glow recipe has the cutest packaging
This is really good, I use it IN the shower after I clean my face with cerave. but I won’t purchase again, there’s cheaper options.

Bought this because of a youtuber’s high recommendation and have been listening to all these dermatologists bash natural products. Usually I purchase all my skin care from a company called living libations which I adore but thought I would try going a less natural route, regretfully this product smells like the glitter roll on sticks I used as a kid in the early 2000’s. I am not speaking to its efficacy because I have not used the product long enough to say and from other reviews it sounds like a great product, I just cant stand the cheep smell. I wouldn’t recommend because of the price and synthetic smell.

I’m in my 30s and I’ve tried probably about 50 serums. I bought this because I love how gimmicky and cute it was, but I am extremely pleased about how hydrating and non-greasy this stuff is. I switched to a different serum by Fresh after I ran out and could tell a difference. My skin literally glows. I’m on my second bottle & just ordered a third.

I was so excited to give this a try because I have loved many of Glow Recipe products and I am in need of finding a serum to add to my routine. I am going to use this completely but so far I don’t see enough from the product to repurchase. It soaks into the skin and goes well with my other skin care products but I just haven’t seen any difference to the appearance of my skin after adding this to the routine.
review_title: Still looking for a serum unfortunately

review_text: Absolutly love this HA a little on the pricy side but so in love it’s worth splurging
Best hyaluronic acid serum I have ever used. It’s not sticky at all like a lot of other brands! & a bonus is the packaging! It’s so cute!
This HA is so worth the price. It feels incredible on the skin, and doesn’t leave a sweaty, sticky feel after application. I use it as a primer, and my makeup always looks incredible!
I loved this product! I have very dry and sensitive skin (especially in the winter) and only after one use my face was hydrated and I no longer had any dry patches. I highly recommend this!
The pump doesn’t work. I have to unscrew the top to get product out. Unfortunately I don’t think this is any better than my other hydrating serums which is disappointing for the price.

I fell in love with the watermelon Niacinamine  glow that I assumed this one would be bomb too. It was just OKAY, not worth the money for sure. So many other hyalaronic serums out there and for a better deal! I got the inkey list serum instead and I can feel like one sink into my skin for hydration!
This is the best HA serum I have EVER USED. Absolutely glowing after I use it after my morning cleanse.

This is a definition of a shoulder shrug emoji for me. It doesn’t make me break out or make me oily or make my makeup pill, but it doesn’t do much of anything else for me either. There is also a deceptively small amount of product. After a month or so of not every day usage, it started sputtering and I realized it was almost out of product. If you want an Instagram-worthy bottle, it’s very pretty. Otherwise, I think there are much better products out there for your money, or at least ones that are of similar quality but will last a bit longer.

I usually love all of the glow recipe products that I purchase, but I am disappointed in this one. After using this product for one day, my skin became dry, textured, and I began to breakout. I’m not sure why my skin reacted to this serum because my skin usually lives hylauronic acid, but I will be returning this.

I couldn’t wait to try this and immediately upon opening I was afraid I broke the applicator cap! I’ve seen other people mention that their cap/pump broke and I thought that happened with me. I realized I screwed the entire thing off and the pump came out completely still inside the cap. I was able to fix it by screwing the whole thing back until it was tight and then carefully popping off just the cap. I’m glad I was able to make it work but that experience alone was kind of frustrating. Now for the PRODUCT. I’ve only tried this once so far but I like it! The texture is fun and very goopy (kind of like the GR watermelon toner but a bit thicker) and it sunk into my skin so fast and without stickiness! This was pretty expensive for the amount you get so I’m not sure I’d repurchase or recommend unless it turned out to be AMAZING but I’m looking forward to using it more!
review_title: Annoying Packaging and But Nice Product So Far

review_text: I bought this stuff after doing some research. I’ve dealt with pretty bad acne, dullness, and redness. I’ve been using this with glossier super pure and after only a week of use i was getting daily compliments saying that my skin wasnt just clearing up but was looking beautiful & glowy. I had high hopes for this product but it went even beyond my expectations! the plum scent is subtle but absolutely delicious and i cannot recommend this enough. (first photo is my skin a few weeks before, second is after 2 weeks using it every day)
Very sticky....I ended up returning it unfortunately

My skin didn’t like the fragrance in this product. From a hydration point I could’ve bought the Inkey List’s Serum and have the same results. The consistency is great - but the results didn’t justify the price for me.
Definitely keeps the moisture in. Doesn’t plump the skin. Makes skin a bit sticky but once the next layer of skincare is applied on top it is not sticky. Lasted me two months.

Definitely hydrates my face and makes my face feel firm! I was hoping for a flattering scent but there isn’t much of a scent to it. It lasts fairly well on my face but it all depends on your skin type. It makes me feel like I’m glowing!
Love how it feels on my skin! Makes my moisturizer feel like it’s absorbing so much better!

I love this serum, it makes my skin look so hydrated and plump. Almost like a dewy look but not quite. I honestly think it makes my skin look younger and healthier just with this serum. Not a huge fan of the pumper but that is the only bad thing I can say about it.
Love this product!! Smells nice and fruity but not overpowering. It has a nice texture and really helps my skin feel hydrated and plump! Definitely plan on repurchasing it!
I love glow recipe but this product didn’t work for me. Made me break out on my chin. Loved the consistency and light fragrance though. Wish I could have used it!
In love with this serum!!! I have oily skin- so I only use this as a nighttime routine, but this makes my skin look more radiant than it ever has. Really a fantastic serum.

I was lucky enough to get this in my last Boxycharm box. I’m a big fan of Glow Recipe, so I was super excited. The packaging is lovely, just like the rest of their products. I like how they go with glass bottles, instead of completely plastic. The claim? Deep hydration and plumping. The result? For me, hydration definitely occurred. I didn’t notice much “plumping”, but I absolutely felt more hydrated. Is it worth $42? Probably not. At least not with the minimal results I am seeing. However, it’s a good product by a brand that is focused on clean beauty and providing some of the best ingredients. I’d absolutely recommend.

Only used it for a week and already redness on my cheek are fading and almost gone. My skin feels hydrated throughout the day and it glows. Never ever felt the need to write a review for a product but this one deserved it. Highly recommend 100%!!!

I didn’t really notice a big difference using this on my skin. I tried a lot of different combinations as well as using it on damp skin and just wasn’t really that impressed. It’s a bit sticky and doesn’t layer under makeup or primer well
This is the first winter where my skin wasn’t flaky. Every winter no matter the amount of water or lotions/creams I use my skin will flake it is so dry. This worked wonders.
review_title: first winter I didn’t have flaky skin

review_text: AMAZINGGGG serum!!! Makes my skin SO hydrated without feeling greasy/oily & has overall improved the look & feel.LOVE LOVE LOVE will be purchasing again & again
It goes on well, after rubbing it in. It doesn’t feel sticky or too thick. My face cream sits well on top.
I promise you do not need fragrance in your skincare routine. Seriously. Hydraulic acid from the inkey list is AMAZING - w/no fragrance and it’s 1/4 of the price.
This has become my favorite hyaluronic acid serum EVER. I always tone before I apply. Super hydrating and absorbs well into skin.

I received a small sample of this with a previous purchase and I was hooked and had to splurge on the full size. Honestly, I haven’t been a fan of fragrance lately, but this serum smells so good, yet isn’t too heavily scented. I used to use the Ordinary HA serum but I feel like Glow’s absorbs a lot better into my skin rather than have that sit-on-top feel Ordinary has.

I have combination skin and I prefer lightweight products that won’t feel heavy on my skin. This is seriously Perfection ! I’m glad I purchased this, the consistency is not sticky nor thick or runny it’s a great in between. I like to add 1-2 drops of my vitaminC from the abnormal company. I use this night and day!
My skin never felt this plum and hydrated, works perfectly in my oily skin. If you don’t like this glass affect, or super shiny you would like to use just at night... I mean, I love this product!!

AMAZING I LOVE THIS PRODUCT. It is a super silky product and did not make me break out. Does not have a sent to it which I like and unlike any other hyaluronic serum it’s super light and silky. The only down side is the bottle is small. For reference I have sensitive acne prone skin and I have dehydrated oily skin and I love this product.

I’m in love. One week of continuous use and my skin looks great. It definitely feels plump. This is a much thinner product that most HA and that’s one of the reasons I love it. It sits well under other products. It feels refreshing when applying. I’m not understanding ppl complaining about scent ... it’s literally so light you can barley smell anything at all. I’m pleased with this purchase. Yes it’s priced higher then some but worth it in my eyes. Glow recipe all the way baby!!!!

I really wanted to love this product unfortunately for me after the second use, my face began to feel get dry! It started to feel like after a chemical peel. I could tell the more I kept applying the product throughout the week the more peeling my skin would shed. My sister on the other hand had no allergic reaction to it. Unfortunately I have to pass. For some reason I’ve noticed on my super dry skin hyaluronic acids flare up my dry skin even more.
I liked the way this made my skin feel and how makeup wore on top of it but it broke me out :( if you don’t have sensitive skin and want a nice hydrating serum to use under makeup I’d recommend!
I use this with the fruit babies minis set. got super comments with only 2 uses all together.
This serum is soooo nice and helped me with my dehydrated skin. It’s silky smooth and light weight. I wake up with soft plump skin. I would definitely repurchase again.

Ugh. I wanted to like this product so much but it fell so far below my expectations. Some background: I’ve recently begun getting facials that include products that have plum ingredients and I thought this would be able to offer something similar of an effect. The advertisement of plum was my main appeal to this product and I was intrigued to see that the ingredients listed three different types of plums and one of them happens to appear in a product I know is used on me when I do go get facials. Unfortunately, this ended up being nothing more than an overpriced Hyaluronic Acid (HA). So to be brutally honest, if you’re just purchasing this product to get the benefits of an HA then I would recommend a different brand because to pay this much I would expect this to be the most hydrating of formulas and to actually deliver on the “glow” that plum ingredients provide in other formulations, and it sadly does not. I have personally had better, longer lasting hydration from other HAs, as well as other products that include low percentages of HAs. But what’s most disappointing is that I  saw no noticeable glow, despite using this regularly for about ten days (I’ve since switched back to my 2% HA from The Ordinary). The packaging is very cute and the scent is all natural but this is so not worth $42.00.

I’ve only been using this for a week, and I have to say... this works. This was the only thing I changed in my skincare routine, and my skin is noticeably more hydrated and glowy. It’s also helped reduce redness and has made my skin much softer. This is my new go-to serum and I will be purchasing again.

As I get older, my skin gets more sensitive, drier and  prone to break-outs. I use this everyday and love it!  No flaming red skin just nice hydrated smoothness. I also use it on my décolletage where I have some wrinkles due to sun damage and I have noticed such an improvement. Definitely recommend

This serum is so lightweight and it dissolves into the skin unlike other serums that sit on top the skin and feels heavy. It smells amazing and I already see a difference since I started using it. My face feels more hydrated. 10 out of 10
Love this! I have sensitive, dry skin that breaks out with almost every serum - except this one. Love!

I really can’t say anything bad about this. I don’t hate it. It does seem hydrating. I didn’t have any skin reactions. It’s just a bit boring especially for the price. If you have the extra money, it’s fine but nothing that exciting
Great product... does exactly what it says it will do...my favorite hyaluronic acid by far. Great start for the rest of my skincare

Love this serum! I have combination skin, so I try to exfoliate with AHA/BHA around every other day, which can dry my skin out. This serum really helps to return the moisture and keep my skin balanced. I haven’t experienced any pilling like I did with the Ordinary one. Definitely recommend for those who have dry skin or who often exfoliate.

I tried the mini from rewards. It felt so nice when I applied it and I love the texture (so liquid and light). But after few minutes, my face felt so sticky and I didn’t like it. I want a serum that makes my face all soft, not sticky all day.

I got the product a month ago or so, so far so good. Great moisturizer serum but i have one issue... that is its foaming up when i apply on a clean faceIm at a point where i rinse my face for 5 solid minutes so this dumb serum wont foam up...  is anyone else having this issue?

I’ve always incorporated a hyaluronic serum in my routine for hydration, the fact that this has HA and the added plum extracts & peptides is the reason I chose to try it. It is very hydrating and does take a little time to absorb, it has a light scent that goes away quickly. I use this with the pineapple brightening serum and my skin has been looking great! I will be repurchasing this serum.

I have very dry, sensitive, early signs of ageing skin and I love everything I have tried from glow recipe so I thought I would give this a try. I have been using this for 3 months with no positive results. My skin is dryer, uneven skin tone, chicken skin texture, and acne I never had before. It has turned my into something horrible. My skin might just be too sensitive for this product.

I’m 36 years old and new to the anti-aging skincare scene, but have fallen in love with this product. I’ve been using it for about a month and saw a noticeable difference immediately upon using, as well as over time seen improvements in my skin. I use it in the morning and at night as part of my skincare routine. When you’re first applying it, it feels slightly slippery and is easy to spread all over your face. It is not sticky at all and dries without any residue, leaving my skin simply feeling soft. I actually look forward to putting it on everyday. I was truthfully skeptical that any of this stuff would work, but even my husband, who doesn’t notice subtle change, has commented on how great my skin looks. It’s a little pricey, but worth it. I will definitely be buying this again.

I personally love this hyaluronic acid serum, it doesn’t leave a sticky feeling on my face like some of the reviews I’ve read, but I also use other glow recipe products in my skincare routine so that might make a difference, it has a light fragrance to it but I would definitely recommend to someone who has pretty dry skin definitely not oily.
Super glowy and hydrating, however I found cheaper options from the Ordinary and the Inkey list do the same thing for way less.

One of my new favorite serums! I use this at night right after getting out of the shower. My skin has been looking more plump and feels softer after daily use of this product. My only complaint is the pump has started having problems and it’s hard to get the product out...other than that love it!
My ultimate favorite hyaluronic serum! This stuff does wonders! It’s super expensive and a bit sticky so I use it at night and use marine algae during the day.

I cannot believe the transformation my skin has undergone with this serum! I’m 30, a few ance scars under my chin but normal skin on the rest of my face. 4 weeks of continuous use and wow! No more texture, I’m super hydrated, my laugh lines are gone, and my fave looks great without any make up. I too this serum with Fresh: Lotus Youth & the Ordinary’s 100% Rose Hip Seed oil. Sunscreen on top and wow - perfect combo!!!
This has been a game changer for me! I use it under my moisturizer and SPF during the day and it has definitely improved my skin texture and fullness! Also a little goes a long way!

Gave me small whiteheads all over my face and neck. My skin felt itchy right after I applied it. This was the only thing I changed in my skincare and routine and as soon as I stopped, my skin went back to normal a week after.

Just finished the entire bottle. Lasted several months and I used it almost everyday 2x/day most days. I am going to try something else and I probably will not be repurchasing. It wasn’t bad but it was not great. Didn’t do much for wrinkles/lines. It’s sticky. The absolute worst thing about this product is the dispenser/pump. It’s super cute yes, but a pain! Sometimes you get a squirt of product but most of the time you get dribbles down the bottle and you have to pump a ton to get what you need. I was dying for it to be done so I can get something w a dropper. For $40+ it’s just not worth it.
Didn’t like this one mainly because it made me break out. My skin WAS soft but not the worth the breakouts.

I broke out. Everywhere. It’s sticky to the touch and the stickiness barely goes away. I woke up with a lot of red dots I guess I had a reaction to it. Its hydrating but underwhelming because it only lasted a few hours… I have dry and sensitive skin.
review_title: broke out and it’s so sticky

review_text: I didn’t want to like this because of the price but I can’t go without it. I can’t use anything with l ascorbic acid because it turns my nails orange, so I have to get my Vit c from things like kakadu plum. This has helped to brighten (not as well as LAA, but that’s to be expected), and plumps. For those saying it’s sticky, you have to apply Hyaluronic Acid on DAMP skin. I spritz my Indie Lee toner then pat this on top. No issues with stickiness or pilling, but applying a HA serum on dry skin will cause stickiness and potentially pulling.
review_title: HG!! Apply on DAMP skin to avoid stickiness.

review_text: works well on sensitive reactive skin! however sometimes it leave a sticky feeling... other then that its a great product!

This is my new go to serum. It has a nice feel on the skin and no gross smell. It makes my face dewy and plump. And it doesnt feel greasy or pill on the skin. I’ve been using for a few months now just bought my second bottle and will continue to purchase. I use all the glow recipe products and have had no irritation or breakouts.  Super happy with this product.

It’s ok. I’ve tried other product with higher concentrations of hyaluronic acid and they worked better for me. My face doesn’t look as plump and healthy with this one. I would use this one if others isn’t available.
I havent seen that much of a change in my skin. I dont find it helps my skin or adds any *visible changes, I will continue to use it and see if if proves me wrong.

This stuff is great! I have dry skin not prone to acne. I’ve been looking for something to hydrate my skin. I definitely have noticed a change since using this every day. My skin is way less dry and that’s saying a lot since I live in the desert. Honest review.

I always get kind of annoyed when people rate stuff based off of their skin sensitivity; but truly I think it probably has to do with the fragrance. Hyaluronic acid improves penetration of your other products, so thats also a possibility, but I have not had this issue before, ever, and my skin is the least sensitive. I’ve even just cut out all actives and used this alone with a simple moisturizer and it still caused a massive break out and irritation.The fragrance in this honestly isn’t crazy or over powering and it actually smells very nice, just wish that it or whatever in this product that doesn’t play well with my skin wasnt in there!
review_title: Broke me out, I do not have sensitive skin :(

review_text: Love it! This is my 3rd bottles ! AMAZING SKIN ! Felt great every morning!!!!

I was looking for a super hydrating serum that helped with fine lines, that was also more affordable than my $90 retinol products. It also had to be vegan friendly, cruelty free and under $60 and this is it! My skin feels super hydrated and has a youthful glow. I have pretty sensitive skin and zero issues with this serum.

The price is not for everyone, that’s why I don’t give it 5 stars. I use this HA at night and my face remains hydrated, healthy and plump until the next morning. Doesn’t have a smell, has a thin texture that dries quick, and didn’t burn my skin.

I haven’t gotten a deep-pore pimple in a long long time. In the five nights I’ve been using this (with zero other changes to my routine), I’ve now gotten 2. I’m in my mid-30s with no history of acne (adult or teen), and I’m sitting here with hot compresses trying to bring the clog to the surface. Yes, I attribute these craters to this Serum. HA is a staple in my routine, so no this isn’t a new ingredient my face is adjusting to or anything. Idk I love Glow Recipe in theory, but their products just deeply underwhelm me. Not the most popular opinion i know… but especially for K-beauty, their products are so expensive and gimmicky.
love glow receipe but didn’t love this :( i am combo skin nothing special about this product would much rather pay less for the ordinary or inky list for a product similar
review_title: great brand just not my fav item

review_text: Ok so I was a little hesitant. I’m 38 full time mom to 7 kids & honestly skin care has never been on my mind. I was lucky enough to make it through a day without my shirt getting stained & then collapsing in bed at nighttime. However I started getting fine lines on my forehead & a friend the same age looked flawless. Her trick is Botox. I can’t do that so I decided to start taking care of my skin. Now I won’t lie I am not an expert. I’m learning as I go. But because my family is so large I needed to find products that were good but also affordable. My husband splurged and got me the ester lauded renutriv for Mother’s Day but honestly for a $500 price tag for the kit I was not impressed at all. On to this beauty. Ok so I signed up for boxycharm. The first couple months were iffy but since then the boxes have been incredible. And the Add Ons make it worth it. I paid $12 to try this full size plum serum and I am hooked!!! Boxycharm has so many amazing high end face products that even if you don’t get them in your box always the add ons make the subscription alone worth it. I am in love with this serum. I noticed a huge difference in my skin just after one use. The second night I saw a difference in my neck as well. I use this serum with the Murad overnight mask I got from boxy charm as well and it’s the perfect combo. Eventually I will work in toner etc. but for now all of the glow recipe prodocts I have gotten in my boxes have been amazing. If you want to try something that works this is it. Now I will say I have combo skin so my face does look oily after I use this so I only use this at nighttime but I am totally fine with that. I highly recommend as it really does plump and help with lines. I know everyone’s skin is different and what works for them is different but this truly is working for me and I give it ten stars! I also highly recommend boxy charm. Yes there boxes never ship out at the beginning of the month and usually ship mid month but the wait is worth it.

I love Glow Recipe’s Hyaluronic Acid Serum. I have finicky skin that can break out one day and become bone dry the next day. I have tried extremely high-end hyaluronic acid serums, and affordable ones from The Inkey List and The Ordinary. For me, Glow Recipe blows them all out of the water. It is refreshing, NOT STICKY, DOES NOT ROLL-OFF OR CLUMP UP ON THE SKIN, and plumps up my fine lines. I use it as the first serum in my skincare routine.

This was a pretty disappointing serum, i expected my dry skin to love it but it just sits on top in a sticky, tacky layer.  The texture kind of ruined it for me so I never use it.  Didnt break me out though, and most things do.

I love the serum the scent, texture, ingredients BUT the 1/3 of the container is glass and it gives you the illusion that there’s still some serum left in the bottle. At the first, I thought the tube of the pump is a bit short so I can’t get to the product on the bottom. I didn’t realize till I took the pump out and shake it upside down and still nothing comes out of the bottle. It’s just supper thick glass bottom looks like there is more product in there. That was definitely not the amount of product worth $42.
review_title: I would give 5 stars if only….

review_text: This is such a nice, non-sticky product that just sinks into my skin. My skin has definitely become noticeably more plump and I have a really thin face :( so I’ll take all the plump I can get. I will say the bottle irritates me with the thick glass at the end, I always think there’s way more in it than actuality.

I love this serum, it makes my skin feel so refreshed and hydrated! I used this while on accutane to help keep my skin hydrated, and it was great! I loved it so much I’ve kept it in my routine after stopping accutane. My skin feels bouncy and plump without being tight, and seems like it would be great for any skin type

Received a sample of this using my Sephora points (but I really just wanted the Avocado eye mask that it came with). Hyaluronic is in a lot of things, so I just don’t think I need a dedicated serum for that extra moisture. But with that said, I don’t enjoy the feel of this as it dries. It’s rather sticky and tacky, even when you make sure to apply it to damp skin. However, if I was looking for a product for extra moisture in the form of hyaluronic, in the mid-priced range, I do enjoy First Aid Beauty’s ultra repair serum, or in the affordable range, The Inkey List’s collagen serum -- and both of those also include peptides. This is just too expensive for what it is and offers. Maybe it’s good for some people, but it’s not for me.
review_title: I don't really get the hype

review_text: This is one of my favorite hyaluronic serums!  I switch between this and the La Roche-Posay Hylau B5 and like them both equally. I’m on my second bottle of this. In the morning when I’m getting ready I spray my face with a hydrating mist or Tower 28’s SOS spray, then I’ll put this on. It feels hydrating and just- nice. I just like using it and I feel like it does bring a bit of plump back into my skin. I definitely recommend as a hyaluronic serum!

Like they said A drink of water for your thirsty skin. Gets rid of dry and flaky areas on my face instantly. Sinks deep in your skin and hydrates it from the inside. One pump is enough for your whole face
smells heavenly. I loooove using this serum. My skin is very happy and hydrated.

After trying this product through a sample I redeemed with my points, I fell in love. From the first use I could feel the product working on my skin and I love that a little goes a long way with this serum. It has a light, pleasant plum scent that doesn’t smell fake/artificial. I also love that it did not break out my sensitive skin. I tried this serum along with Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Dew Drops and couldn’t decide between the two so I ended up purchasing both. The watermelon serum is supposed to help brighten skin and make your skin glow whereas the plum serum helps with anti-aging, elasticity, and fine lines. I justified buying both serums Glow because they contain two different active ingredients (the plum containing hyaluronic acid whereas the watermelon contained niacinamide) that do two different things. Highly recommend this serum for anyone looking for a new serum that doesn’t break out sensitive skin!
I do not like this serum. I tried a sample and it was soapy on application, and then my skin felt sticky and coarse once it dried.

I have been using this serum for about half a year and it definitely helped with skin texture and makes my skin feel so plump. Some people might say it’s a bit sticky when applied but if you pat it on to your skin as it dries, it absorbs nicely. Finish off with a moisturizer and it’ll be fine. I prefer products that actually work instead of judging how the consistency is lol
Absorbs fast and feels great. Got as a sample but might need to actually get it.

Best hylaronic serum I have tried. I am in love with the texture and adorable packaging. I know its on the pricer side but I find the long lasting hydration it provides is unlike any other serum. If you are looking to purchase a product from glow recipie this is it.

I bought this, finished it. Then went ahead and bought The Ordinary’s version. I originally wanted to think I was spending a lot of money for the same quality but... it’s not the case. I wanted to believe that I’ll save quite a bit of cash going for The Ordinary but I have to say, the texture, consistency and the overall feeling after applying The Glow’s is so much better.Glow’s texture: It’s a lot more liquidy, and smoother, almost lighter too. When applied it glides on my face effortlessly and leaves an amazing freaking glow. I look so freaking healthy and just... hydrated. It doesn’t leave a feeling of having any thick serum on top. It really feels as if I was blessed with a thin layer of light, a refreshing, sheet of hydration.The Ordinary’s: Now I’m not saying I dislike this one in any way, they’re both great products and they do the same. I just felt when I was applying 3 drops and spreading them onto my face, the consistency was a little bit thicker and harder to spread across my skin without a light pull. It did leave my skin with a glow but I wouldn’t say it felt like a nice glow. I felt as though it was a little bit on the tacky side and I just overall didn’t have the same excitement and joy I got when using the Glow’s. It felt like it was a little bit heavier & thicker, not as refreshing. The reason why I will continue to use Glow’s after I finish the ordinary’s: there are more properties in the Glow’s product that allow it to feel a lot smoother, lighter, giving an overall more enjoyable application. Whereas when you take The Ordinary’s it’s really just ONE ingredient which is said on Mixed Makeup’s Youtube, these products tend not to feel the best because there’s solely one indigent. She explains better on her channel! Now they really do still do the same, and if this doesn’t bother you, go ahead! Save a couple of bucks and get the Ordinary. They’re both still great products but it’s really how you feel with it on your skin and if you don’t mind

review_text: I love this product! No irritation, as I tend to get with other acids, and I could tell a difference after just one use. Just like any acid, don’t overuse it!
The only serum I have ever liked and hasn’t broken me out! It absorbs quickly and is hydrating. Seems to have oil control benefits as well.

This product works! I love the way it feels. More importantly the way my skin feels from using it. I say it is a must have serum for plump hydrated skin! Got my first bottle through Boxy Charm. Just purchased another cause I cannot be without! I love the texture and how it drys down.

This serum is pretty good. I normally use the Lancome Advanced Genefique serum, which I love, but I wanted to try something more affordable. My problem areas are some fine lines on my forehead and around my smile. I have to say this helped plump up the fine lines so much better than the Lancome product. It didn’t fully get rid of my fine lines but I can notice them slowly disappearing. I have dry, olive toned skin, and dark hair and this product has helped moderately with fine lines and helped brighten my skin tone. I was hoping it would help with my uneven skin tone (ie. dark circles, sun spots) but it doesn’t do anything with that. If you’re looking for a solid serum for daily maintenance, this is it. I would buy this again.

I would like to start this review off by saying if I was stranded on an island and was only able to bring three items with me this would be one of them. I have been using this serum for almost a year once to twice daily and what I love the most about it is not how it gives my skin that glass look but how it can be used two different ways. I use this right out of a shower or bath while my skin is still damp to really lock in that moisture and it is insane how firm yet smooth my skin is once it has dried. Another way I use this serum is as a primer before applying my foundation the tackiness really helps the foundation from separating and I notice I use less which saves me money in the long run from having to buy more foundation sooner than later. I’ve spent more money on a cold meal at a nice restaurant than I did on this serum. A little bit goes a long way! As I mentioned above I use this once to twice a day and still have not ran out. I have hundreds of skin care products anywhere from cheap to very expensive and this is by far one of my top favorite products. I get compliments on my skin when I’m not wearing any make up and all I usually have done is apply some of my plum plump. I am about to purchase the avocado serum for my redness but as far as firmness and brightness goes, I can only thank this product for it.
review_title: Dullness dryness and saggy? We don’t know her.

I even put this on my lips sometimes since I have Hyaluronic acid filler on them and I swear this makes them plumper. Over all this product not only looks so cute on my vanity but it gives me that glass skin look that I love. WARNING: if you live somewhere that is very dry this might not work for you. Hyaluronic acid absorbs moisture from the air so if you live in dry climate, it will do the opposite because it will end up absorbing the moisture from your skin instead and make it feel dryer. So keep that in mind!

While the packaging is very cute, actual amount of serum in the container seems a little deceiving. If you really look at it, there’s a line where the pump stops which is about a centimeter above the base. And once there is very little serum left, you have to dump it out onto your hand or face because the pump doesn’t completely reach the bottom.

It does what it says it will do: my skin looked hydrated and glowy. However, I prefer not to have dedicated products that have only HA as its active and instead go for ones that combine other active ingredients with HA, reaping multiple benefits.

The niacinamide helps control over production of oiliness which is awesome!As a primer, I knew I’d love it from just feeling the consistency, but I was very hesitant to apply it over top of makeup. When worn as a primer under makeup, it helped adhere base products to the skin and prolonged makeup wear time, but again, it didn’t help me in the pore department. It did, however, help smooth over fine lines! Glycerin is high up on the ingredient list, so the skincare benefits of hydration translate to keeping makeup looking fresh and skin feeling supple! My skin is more on the normal to combination side, so I found that my t-zone becomes emphasized more when applied all over. This issue can easily be solved via selective application/avoiding the t-zone. I personally apply this above my brow bone + on the top of my check bones, and find that it actually accentuates my bone structure in a flattering no-makeup-look way. It also wears well under translucent powder without pilling, etc. The added fragrance is fairly subtle and smells like juicy watermelon. If you have ultra sensitive skin however, I would keep in mind that added fragrance is present in this formulation (my skin is fairly reactive, however I have not experienced any negative side effects/breakouts/inflammation since a week of daily use). All in all, I would recommend this product - the ingredient formulation almost completely checks out for me (I prefer fragrance-free products, however am not opposed to them - especially if the fragrance is not overpowering + smells nice like this one).

review_text: I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe. I loved this Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops. It smells amazing, very hydrating and brightening. I use it almost everyday. It gives me ultra glowy look even with no make-up.

I was gifted this product by Glow Recipe via Octoly. The texture feels very similar to their Plum Plump serum — thin and slightly tacky, but quickly absorbed into the skin for a plump feeling and visible glow. My skin felt softer after a few days of use, and I definitely feel as if it’s helping to keep my skin hydrated in combination with my skincare routine. As for the makeup benefits, I don’t find that this helps significantly with longevity of makeup, but it does make my base look much more radiant and helps keep my foundation from sinking into my fine lines and other dry areas. I haven’t used it tapped on as a highlighter like they recommend, but I love it mixed with foundation or as a base before foundation.

Glow Recipe gifted me one of their newest product launches, and let me tell you. I thought I’ve met dew before, but after trying this serum, I realized that that wasn’t the real dew. Now, this is the real dewy dew. Let’s get dew-ing.  I absolutely love everything about this serum. First of all, it smells deliciously fresh, it is very lightweight, it has a hydrating gel texture, absorbs quickly, and gives the most amazing glow.   I’ve tried it alone, and also under my makeup and it does a great job as a primer. I usually get a few dry patches whenever I put my face makeup base, and this one really helped conceal and hydrate those spots pretty well.   It makes my skin feels dewy, healthy, and very very hydrated. It also makes it feel soft and plumped. I LOVE a good dewy look and this serum gives me that and more.  Very happy with it, and in love with the cute packaging!    Gifted, but all opinions are my own.

This product was kindly gifted to me by Glow Recipe This has been my new favorite under makeup skincare product! I’ve always loved light hydrating serums and this one is just completely incredible. I love how dewy and plump it makes my skin look, and the bottle of course is gorgeous!

I love how deny and suple this serum leaves my skin. I usually have oily skin but in the winter it gets really dry and that this contains niacinamide to help with my pigmentation as well. The scent isn’t too overpowering which I love. I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe but my opinion is entirely my own.

this product was gifted by Glow Recipe for my honest review. this is such an interesting product! i’ve used it as a primer/base underneath my makeup, on my cheekbones for a highlight, and on my eyelids for a glassy no-eyeshadow look. it’s a bit tacky upon application, but i think it helps my makeup stay in place longer. i can’t say i’ve seen any dramatic differences in dark spots/acne marks, so i won’t be relying on this for all my skin brightening needs - but i appreciate the instant dewiness it provides! as for the ~aesthetics~ of the product, i looove the bottle it’s packaged in! such a unique shape & it has a pearlescent sheen to it (which i wasn’t able to fully capture on camera). the scent is very sweet/fruity & reminds me of those watermelon slice sour patch kids! i usually don’t love fragrance in leave-on products, but this one is cute so i’ll let it slide.. lol. overall, really loving this product!

review_text: Glow Recipe gifted me their Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops in exchange for my honest and unbiased review.I am so glad that I got the opportunity to test out this product. This product is moisturizing and gives my skin a subtle, natural glow. It’s a light gel texture, so it doesn’t feel heavy on the more oily spots.
