I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe. It is very light weight and smells nice. It leaves a nice glow with or without makeup over it. Its perfect for a natural look or a dewy eye shadow look!

This is an amazing product, it does actually add glow to the face. I mixed it with my foundation and applied it on my face; it just didn’t turn out well, my face was super oily. So my advice to people with oily and combination skin type shouldn’t mix this product with their foundation. So now I only use it with my other nighttime skincare products at bed time.

I absolutely cannot stress this enough, but 100% absolutely, you should definitely invest your money on this product. Having dry skin and an affinity for glass skin, I was desperately seeking a product like this. At first, you’re somewhat thrown off by the name of the product. It’s a niacinamide serum. Watermelon too, but that ingredient is synonymous with the brand. Given that niacinamide is in a lot of skincare these days, you’re not really intrigued to buy a product that’s main focus is this particular ingredient. Or so you say now. However, this gives you a dewy complexion for literal hours. If you want that glass-skin look, this product does a brilliant job at incorporating Korean aesthetics and formulations in the western market. Notably, its serum texture makes it easy to apply and set into your skin. Very unlike other products with similar claims, like the Glossier’s Future Dew for reference. Personally, this product is quite effective for its intended purpose. I would absolutely recommend this product.

Perfect addition to my routine! I am a heavy khiels girl but have recently fallen in LOVE with Glow Recipe! This product feels moisturizing and not sticky at all. I haven’t tried it on top of make up just yet, but will do very soon. I’ve used it as a last step in my daily skin care routine and my skin is dewy, supple and soft! I’m sooo in love with this product and their Papaya cleansing balm! Highly recommend.

I’ve been skeptical of makeup prep products for a while now, I always feel like it leaves my makeup application worse off, this is absolutely NOT the case here.  This goes on the skin super smooth and absorbs leaving for face looking fresh and dewy. I love wearing this on light coverage days as well as full coverage. As always the packaging is GORGEOUS and a little goes a far way. If you like a natural dewy highlighted look without the glitter, this is definitely the way to go. I was gifted by Glow Recipe this product,  for my review, but my thoughts and opinions are my own.

One of my favorite new additions to my skincare routine - 1-2 pumps is all it takes for stunning, smooth, dewy but not sticky/greasy skin! I can FEEL my skin soaking this up and loving it. I love that i can be used morning or night as well.

I was offered this for free, for a reason I will not share, and I love it! it gave my skin a great glow but I wouldn’t consider it a highlighter but it could be. I would recommend as a serum but not as a makeup product. fair warning this serum can be thick but it doesn’t leave a white residue like The Ordinary’s niacinamide serum does.

Gifted by Glow Recipe, but all opinions are my own. Niacinamide is one of those ingredients that has changed my skin for the better. It’s really toned down my redness, and now, I use it as maintenance. Texture: It’s a thicker serum texture. Almost has a slight jelly-like consistency, not watery at all. Once blended in, it feels like you’re applying water to the skin. Can be used as a serum in your skincare routine, as a makeup primer, or as a glowy highlighter. I’ve used it as all three. As a makeup primer, it does help my makeup grip down and last longer. I did enjoy this under my makeup as an extra hydrating step. As a highlighter, it’s a very natural glow from within. I find that you don’t really need a highlighter if you use it as a primer. Quickly absorbs into the skin, but gives you enough time to apply other products while your skin is still damp. Made my skin glowy without the sticky feeling. I love it as a skincare or makeup product. Kept my skin very hydrated, which it needs. My main preference is to use it in my skincare routine because I feel like I’m getting the most out of it. This would be great for travel since it is multi-purpose. Lastly, it is part of their watermelon line, hence the delicious scent!
I put this serum on my bare skin after I wash my face in the morning. The glow this provides makes me  look like my skin is healthy and moisturized. I’m very impressed.

I’ve been using the new Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops for about 2 weeks (I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe)! Here are my first impressions: it’s got a subtle watermelon fragrance, which I love. It feels very hydrating on the skin. I’ve applied it as the serum step in my skincare routine, as well as using it as a primer. IMO it grips makeup very well! My makeup lasted all day with this. I have a feeling that this will replace my original primer!

I love that you can use this as a serum under your moisturizer as well as a glow boost under makeup and after moisturizer/sunscreen. It smells soooo good and makes my skin look glowy all day. This is my new favorite skin product.

I received this product as gift complimentary from Glow Recipe and I am more than thrilled. It is my go to each day with or without makeup. I absolutely love the glow with any sticky feel, it feels like I don’t even have anything on. It holds my makeup in place with no cracking whatsoever, i don’t even use primer most times. Definitely a new favorite for me!!!!

This product was gifted by Glow Recipe and what a beautiful serum it is! I love the lightweight texture and scent. This serum leaves my skin looking so dewy. I’ve been applying this as the last step to my AM skincare routine and it works well with spf and make up. Would highly recommend this!

Hello glowy skin! I Niacinamide is my latest favorite skincare ingredient and this product is totally why! If you have dry skin or skin that can’t hold moisture, this is the product for you! My skin feels refreshed and hydrated without being greasy.  Gifted by Glow Recipe
So far so good! I have been using it for a week now and I like the natural glow and it keeps my face moist!

Glow Recipe gifted me their Niacinamide Dew Drops and I’ve loved using them under my makeup! It’s a great product that gives me a super nice glow without making my skin feel heavy and really helps my makeup shine!

I received this product from glow recipe for my free review. The product smells great (much like their watermelon overnight mask) which is great if you like fragrance but terrible if you don’t. The product felt great going on the skin and had a light gel like texture. I have oily skin, so it doesn’t take much to give me that glowy effect. It worked great as a primer under make up but I wouldn’t use it to give a glow over make up because it got messy. Honestly, this product works best as a primer.
Keeps my skin moisturized and has a subtle glow. Would buy again .
Worst Product ever!!! it has darkened my skin. changed my skin color and now I see dark patches that were not there before

I received this product complimentary from Glow Recipe. I enjoyed the light refreshing texture of this product and how it wasn’t sticky or oily. I didn’t find this to help my makeup last longer, but it didn’t have a negative impact either. After testing it as a hydrating serum (average performance), primer, and highlighter, I preferred it the most as a highlighter when I want a glass skin glow. The only downside is that the glow only lasts 1, 2 hours max before the product is absorbed into the skin and the glow disappears.
review_title: Refreshing glass skin glow but doesn't last

review_text: Umm, thank you Glow Recipe for making skincare of watermelon & Niacinamide. I forget when i received this, but whatever, i’ve used it a few times so far, and just did not long ago after my shower with my skincare routine. I can’t say i’m seeing results just yet (you gotta stay consistent, duh! :p) but this stuff smells amazing, feels so good on the skin, hydrating & has niacinamide which has many benefits to it. I’ve loved Glow Recipe since i bought their watermelon moisturizer a long time ago, i love their watermelon line & they keep amazing me with those products. Note, i don’t have all the watermelon products in that line but regardless, amazing. So, if you have dry skin, and need lots of hydration, this is it! This product is much better than The Ordinary Niacinamide, although i like that one too.. but this one doesn’t give you that tacky sticky after layer like The Ordinary does, this absorbs so well. I highly recommend!
This is a must have if you’ve got dry skin. It’s fantastic and not too heavy or greasy. I’ve got combination skin and this does the trick.

I’ve been using this for about a week now and love wearing this product everyday. I don’t wear any makeup and the glow lasts about 8 hours. It gives me that dewy skin look,  which is awesome for someone who wants to go more natural.

I have dry combination skin (oily in my T-Zone, dry as a desert on my cheeks). I decided to try this as I saw it could be used safely around the eyes and as a serum. I used it for a week AM and PM and I found my skin felt so soft, firm, and hydrated; especially around my eyes. I love this! I also tried it as a dewy highlighter and it was very flattering.

Gifted by Glow Recipe - The Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops did not disappoint me at all, I love how versatile it is! You can use it as a serum, as a makeup primer or as a dewy highlighter on top of your makeup at the high points of your face! How amazing is that?! I personally love using this a serum every so often and/or as a dewy highlighter look, butttt since this has a slight tacky feel to it, I love putting this on the high points of my face & adding my favorite highlighter powder on top, it gives you double the glow and my makes my makeup look so dewy and flawless and I love it !!!!! I recommend it to others 10/10 !

Unfortunately this product made me breakout and I won’t be repurchasing. I’ve used every day consistently for 3 weeks- I wish this was more like a serum but the consistency is more like a moisturizer because of its thickness. My skin didn’t react well to the fragrance either- there are other Niacinamide’s I prefer over this one (such as the Ordinary)
review_title: not worth the hype - skin broke out

review_text: Unlike a large portion of the positive reviews for this product, I purchased this product from Sephora when it was released. I own several glow recipe products and have thoroughly enjoyed them all. I would describe the consistency of this product as a thick gel and isn’t runny. Pink in color. This product IS FRAGRANCED. So, if you’re sensitive to smells or don’t like scented skincare, I would pass this product up. I actually like the scent, as it reminds me of Watermelon Jolly Ranchers. This product glides on and soaks into the skin nicely while still leaving a subtle glow (photo below in natural light taken at 9am). For reference, I have combination skin (oily t-zone, dry outer perimeter/chin) and use these niacin-amide drops in conjunction with Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Toner. My skin LOVES this product.

I received the Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops complimentary from Glow Recipe about 4 weeks ago and I’ve been applying it once a day as part of my AM skincare routine. The texture is a lightweight gel that has a mild and refreshing watermelon scent, and can be used on its own as a last step to a skincare routine, blended into a foundation or used over makeup to add a glossy, natural finish. Right off the bat, I absolutely loved the scent! It is subtle but so lovely and refreshing and definitely adds to the experience. The product itself feels soothing and cooling when applied, does not irritate or flare up my rosacea, helps boost my skin’s luminosity and I love combining it into my foundation to help me achieve that healthy, natural glow from within. I also really enjoy using it on its own as a last step to my routine on no make up days as it helps my skin look revived and plumped on mornings when I’m extra tired. When used underneath makeup, it helps me look fresh all day without making my makeup budge. It never makes me look greasy and it feels really light on the skin no matter how I use it. I love the versatility of the product and definitely see myself purchasing it again in the future!
review_title: A Gorgeous, Natural, All Day Glow!

review_text: Love this stuff! First off, the smell is amazing. Light watermelon scent that doesn’t linger. My face felt so nice and moisturized hours later and my skin had a subtle glow. Perfect for those no makeup days. Will definitely repurchase.

Leaves my skin feeling tacky so I took off one star for that. Other than that, it gives me a dewy look and it does soften my skin. Have been using it for a few days so I can’t speak on the long term benefits of this product.

Complimentary from Glow Recipe, This oeey goey serum is everything and more! Super light-weight, hydrating, rich and smells SO GOOD! I’m using this serum all winter long, my skin fees so hydrated (My skin type is more on the dry side). I barely wear makeup and this makes me not want to wear at all.I love using this serum as a primer to before my concealer or as the last step to my skincare routine if I’m not wearing makeup. Such a wearable product, I am obsessed!!
I love the glow this gives me! I dont wear makeup often, so I put this on after my moisturizer and it looks so nice!

Glow Recipe kindly sent me over their new Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops. I loved the watermelon line, and it smells fantastic, so I knew I would love this.My skin is not a super fan of pure Niacinamide (i.e., The Ordinary one). I never use it frequently enough to get the benefits. I have used this every day for three weeks, but I wanted to make sure I really used it. It is slightly tacky when first put on, and if I use over SPF (please, I am most definitely not wearing makeup). When used as a serum and under moisturizer, I do not notice any tackiness. I also like to mix it with my SPF or moisturizer and that also helps with the texture. I love the subtle glow/glittery look that it gives my skin. This is going to continue to be a staple in my lineup.
In Love with this stuff!! Goes great with the toner
Literally made my makeup last all day and it made my complexion have a subtle glow without looking oily. I’d give it 10/10 stars if I could
This is my new favorite product i’ve ever used. it makes me look so glowy and bright and hydrated with no gross feeling. this brand changed my skin in a great way

Incredibly soft and soothing. I’ve noticed a difference with redness after 1.5 weeks. Light, but nice watermelon fragrance. Not overpowering nor long lasting for scent. A little of the serum goes a long way. Zero irritation, zero clogging of pores. I plan on buying this product in full size (I received sample).
I like it - but you have to use a ton to get the glowing face they speak of.

I really have been loving these drops. I use it like a serum right before I apply makeup and it helps keep my skin not only clear and radiant, but helps my makeup look really dewy as well. I like to use it on no makeup quarantine days too and it makes me feel like like a sloppy flop. The scent is also really nice!
I saw the difference in my skin tone and skin texture. My skin has a healthier glow and softer feel. Im really kiking this product the more i use it.

This serum is amazing! It’s super light on my face and it gives my skin the perfect amount of “dew”. A little goes a long way so I only use a pump and then apply moisturizer! It keeps my skin soft and moisturized throughout the whole day. I have super dry skin, especially during the winter, so this has been a lifesaver. It smells like watermelon jolly ranchers so it’s a treat every time I use it!

Loved the texture and the color . I tried it on different occasions and my makeup was flawless all of the time.I prefer using it as a primer, because it gently prepares my skin and creates an ideal canvas to hold onto makeup. I loved how fast it was absorbed on my skin, but it left it looking very shiny. That’s why I’d rather use it with no makeup on, I feel it gives natural skin a perfect glow. #giftedbyglowrecipe

I love using the Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Glow Drops, complimentary from Glow Recipe as both a face serum and a highlighter. It glides on my skin so nicely and leaves it with a natural glow without adding excess oil to my face. It applies well both under and over makeup and absorbs into my skin super quickly. I like to mix this in with foundation for a dewy coverage. It also wears super nicely under makeup. It has a thick moisturizing texture that isn’t heavy and has the classic watermelon scent. It’s not overbearing but something to keep in mind if you’re sensitive to fragrances.
would honestly recommend this for any skin type. i have very dehydrated skin in the winter but using this as a serum makes it look moisturized and bright without feeling oily.
Love this stuff ! I got it in a smaller size kit with their watermelon sleeping mask and they’re both really great. My skin feels super soft and dewy when I use it. I highly recommend.
Thank you for letting me be a part of this campaign I completely enjoyed it it made my face feels so nice and shiny.

My boyfriend bought this for me as a gift. I knew I would love the smell because I already owned the Watermelon Sleeping Mask. I was skeptical because I have very oily skin, and I wanted the benefits of Dew Drops-but I didn’t want to look greasy. These are great. I do not look greasy when I wear this. It plumps my skin and gives a radiant appearance to the skin-no sparkle or shine. I’m seeing a difference in my pore size and the overall brightness of my skin.

This is part of my morning skincare routine. I use this product underneath my makeup and wow does it ever leave a hydrated/dewy texture to the skin. My makeup sits really nicely on top of it and helps created a dewy complexion. The product has a really sweet watermelon scent that is amazing! The scent only lasts on the skin during application which is very luxurious, but then disappears after a few seconds which I appreciate.
review_title: Great addition to my skincare routine!

review_text: My skin is extremely oily and I always have to be extremely careful when buying any moistures or serums, so I have to be honest I was scared this will cause my skin to be more oily especially since it’s on the expensive side, I found the more ideal way for me which is to use half a pump and not 1-2 like the instructions recommend. It certainly does it job and gives my skin a lovely natural glow without giving it the oily effect. I also have to say I love the packing and scent of the watermelon.

Gifted by Glow Recipe. First the packaging is really cute. I like the light consistency of the product. It sat really well underneath my makeup. But wasn’t really dewy once I applied the makeup but before it had a nice shine to it. Overall I like it but wouldn’t purchase since I haven’t seen any changes and wasn’t mind blowing product.

I haven’t tried it over makeup yet, but without it leaves a beautiful plump shine. Please read the instructions. When not wearing makeup apply it last over the rest of your skincare. When wearing with makeup apply it over your makeup. Oh, the scent is so delicious. It’s a very sweet watermelon scent. Overall, a great clean product

I absolutely love this makeup primer gifted to me by Glow Recipe. The packaging is so beautiful and I especially love that it’s recyclable. I like the way it sits under my makeup and the dewy look it gave my skin. I definitely could see myself repurchasing this. I especially like that you only need a little bit of product to get the job done!

This product was gifted by Glow Recipe. This is a nice product to wear on days when you aren’t wearing makeup and want a little glow.  I have oily skin so this works well for my skin type but I’ve heard the glow isn’t very long lasting if you have dry skin. I wouldn’t recommend trying to wear it under makeup as my makeup doesn’t seem to sit well on top of it. Love that it has niacinimide too so it has skin benefits.

I’ve tried a majority of Glow Recipe’s line. My skin seems to respond really well to their formulations -- I’m a return customer now of about 15 months. This is probably the most versatile offering in their collection. Can use it alone after cleansing in the day. It’s the p e r f e c t consistency -- not too watery, not greasy, no stickiness. Absorbs super quickly, and leaves a really nice subtle glow.I bought the Plum Plump serum recently, and I really dislike the consistency of that product. So I’ve been mixing the Dew Drops in with that to offset the stickiness. I’m definitely repurchasing this when I’m out.

I recently got to try the Glow Recipe Dew Drops which I recieved #complimentaryfromglowrecipe for my honest review. This feels really nice on the skin, is moisturizing and adds a subtle glow. I like using this on the tops of my cheekbones for a natural dewy look without the use of an actual highlighter. If you like that no makeup, makeup look or a “glass skin“ look, I think that you would really enjoy this product! I gave the product 4 stars because I’m not sure about some of the ingredients and how safe they are. For example, I wish I knew what they used for fragrance.

This adds such a wonderful glow. it can be a little tacky so give it time to absorb, especially if using as a primer. I personally love it as a primer, it adds great light and control under my foundation.
review_title: Truly Dewy Glow (Works Great as a Primer too!)

review_text: I didn’t get this free like half the reviews, but I wish I had lol. I love this stuff. I have really angry skin and my 2021 goal was to just heal and care for my skin. The first time I put it on I hoped it would be a keeper but I had make sure I didn’t get any breakouts or weird stuff happening. Everyone, this stuff is like...diamond skin in a bottle, please buy it. If you skin is hateful and doesn’t like anything- it’s probably going to like this.

This product was gifted by Glow Recipe. I have combination skin that leans on the dry side and my skin absolutely loves this serum! The texture is fantastic. I really like to wear this under makeup to give a more dewy look and another plus is my makeup lasted all day. If you want your skin to feel soft and have a beautiful (not greasy) glow, this product is for you!

This product was gifted by Glow Recipe for my honest review. I really love this highlighting serum! It has a light texture and leaves my skin soft, hydrated, with a beautiful glow and it’s not oily. It has a nice and light watermelon scent.

I’m not a fan. I didn’t find the product to add any more of glow or dew than my regular neutrogena moisturizer. It’s very tacky and also broke me out the next day. Over all I felt it to be more gimmicky than anything.

I bought this as soon as it released and it’s genuinely so good. I have dry patches around my nose, and this does so well to prep my face before makeup and get rid of the dryness. My skin also looks great at the end of the day after I take all the makeup off, too.

Got sample and didn’t notice anything good or bad, but after a week I got a rather larger zit. I can count on one hand how many breakouts I’ve had in 5 years. That was the clincher and in the trash it went. I don’t understand the reviews on this.

this is magic in a bottle! I got this as a free sample and within like 2 days my skin looked SO different in the best way possible! I had big pores and this reduced my poor size and I look like i’m wearing an instagram filter when I look in the mirror! it reduced my pore size, gave me a beautiful glow, helped with my uneven texture and dull/dryness it’s truly magic in a bottle. use this with their hyaluronic acid serum and it’s perfect!
I love this product so much. It makes my skin look amazing and the smell is so nice! I will be repurchasing.

This is fantastic! I haven’t used it as makeup but it is a pretty serum! I love to use it in the morning and it glows in the perfect way from under moisturizer. It has really softened my skin and helped with my moisture barrier. The niacinamide is also helpful
review_title: more than just a sometimes highlight

review_text: This product didn’t do at all what it said it was going to do. There was no “glow“ and it made my makeup oxidize. I tried it a different way on day 2 and it’s still made my makeup oxidize. I will be returning it.
I love this product. It makes my skin so smooth and glowy. It also smells AMAZING. Totally recommend!!!

This stuff is wonderful. I have tried the watermelon toner and was underwhelmed, but I love this serum. I put it on in the morning after rinsing my face and it gives my dull skin a brightening glow I’ve never seen before from a product. Tonight I used it as a highlighter for the first time and it gives a more luminous, natural looking highlight than the usual powers or liquids. I will definitely, definitely be repurchasing this in the future.

This is cute, smells good but would never replace my Paula’s choice niacinamide. I guess if you want to use it as a subtle highlighter go for it, but it doesn’t offer enough niacinamide to make my pores smaller or skin soft like Paula’s Choice or the First Aid Beauty Niacinamide does.
review_title: doesn’t replace real skin care products/overhyped

review_text: This serum is super nice. I love all the glowy everything I can get my hands on. It wears so well under makeup and leaves my skin so hydrated and dewy. It absorbs well into the skin and does a beautiful job giving a reflective glow that isn’t overdone. Totally love and thankful I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe to try.

I first received a deluxe sample with an order and decided to try it since I use some of glow recipe’s products. I use it at the end of my skin care routine before makeup and I love how nourished/plump it makes my skin look. Sometimes even if I don’t wear makeup I wear as my last step and brows and I’m good to go. It’s glowy  but not greasy looking. You just look hydrated! It helps with the dryness around my cheeks. And you don’t need to use too much.

After glancing at the spectacular reviews I purchased this product immediately. I struggle with dry/combination skin, and this serum helps tremendously.After washing my face with an acne cleanser (which tends to be drying), I apply this product on my face and it gives me a nice clean dewy look! The hydration lasts a good bit, and the scent is amazing.

This is my first time ever writing a review and I just had to rave about this product. I purchased this literally a week ago and I can already see the changes it makes in my skin. The minute I put on this product, I automatically feel my skin being super soft and smooth. I only use two pumps to cover my face, I could probably use less but I just love it so much. I’m the type to notice (most of the time) any changes that a product has done to my face and this was the one that dramatically made a difference. Whenever I smother it onto my face at night, I wake up with clear, moisturized skin and I love it! The smell is so light and reminds me of watermelon jolly ranchers which eventually goes away as I continue on with my skincare routine. It also gives a subtle glow which is pretty under makeup as well, but I mostly use this at night. I would definitely recommend this product to everyone and anyone! Go get you one sis!!

Im a huge fan of glow recipe in general. I got practically the entire collection but this one is not a must. The bottle is pretty, the product smells good but I didn’t do anything to my skin. It’s only a shiny finish. The plum plum one is WAAAAAAY better. Don’t spend your coins.
I got this as a sample and my face was dry and peeling due to cold weather. I have sensitive skin and this has worked wonders on my skin. It’s the one thing that upped my skincare routine
I love the texture of this product so much. I use it twice a day and my skin is more hydrated and smooth. I like the smell as well, it’s not too overwhelming.
I love this stuff. I’m not sure if it makes a huuuuge difference but I do enjoy it. And the smell!

Full nights sleep in a bottle! My dull maskne ridden skin had new life breathed into it after using this just once. Leaves skin soft, supple, with a noticeable all over glow. Multiple ways to use it too!

While I liked this product, I didn’t think it was any better than the Maelove Niacinamide I use. It calmed my skin, and I liked the subtle scent (like jolly ranchers!), but it didn’t give me any glow or dewiness. I would consider switching once I finish my Maelove though.

These are so refreshing, smell amazing, and help my redness prone skin. I’m very fair, normal skin type with redness in the cheeks. I got these for the niacinamide. It says you can use this as a highlighter over makeup, but in my opinion that is gimmicky. I just use it as a skincare serum. It feels cool to the touch when applying, has a glossy finish to it, and smells like a watermelon jolly rancher. This product DOES have added fragrance, but it smells pleasant and not overbearing. I would give it 5 stars if it weren’t for the added fragrance. It already has watermelon extract in it, which would scent it plenty. The packaging is a beautiful glass container that looks so cute on a bathroom counter. One pump is plenty for the entire face. I like rubbing this on my décolletage during the day as well, for a pretty glow.

Sticky / Left a film Pretty disappointed with the product because my expectations were high. I tried it out in all the recommended ways and it leaves a sticky or tacky residue on my face. I noticed when I wear it without foundation the film is actually noticeable. I love that packaging and the consistency but although the smell isn’t overpowering, it smells synthetic like a lip smackers watermelon lip balm from when you were 6. Looks like a lot of the 5 star reviews are from people who were gifted the product so I wish I noticed that before I bought!

I’ve been using a deluxe sample size for a few weeks now and I really like how it makes my skin look glowy, I think it’s help heal my post acne marks heal a bit faster. It could also be because of the exfoliating I’ve been doing with a AHA/BHA scrub, not sure which product is helping more. My only complaint is that it isn’t very hydrating despite the fact it makes my skin look glowing. I have dry skin in the winter though.

Absolutely LOVE this product! I have used it for about a month and have definitely seen a noticeable difference in the redness on my cheeks, chin, and forehead as well as a visible reduction in my hyperpigmentation on my cheeks (brought on by my pregnancies). My skin looks so much better after a month of use and my skin feels so lovely when I put this product on in the morning and evening. Even my husband has noticed a difference and even asked if I was wearing makeup ( I wasn’t!) My skin is looking much more even and glowy. A little goes a long way...only need 1 pump. Smells light and fresh too. I will continue to buy this product! LOVE, LOVE, LOVE!
Whether you want a highlight balm without glitter, or want to soothe your skin and give it a nice glow, this is a fantastic product. I love how it looks and feels.
I really want to like this product, but it doesn’t seem to work for me.  I don’t find my skin looks any more glowing.  That said, the texture of the product is very silky and the scent is pleasant.

I really wanted to like this product! The packaging is super-cute and the product itself has great reviews and a yummy, yet not overpowering scent. Unfortunately, it feels extremely sticky and tacky on. I applied to a bare face, and it was just this side of rubbing syrup on your face. After a couple of hours, I could not wait to wash it off. I returned it.

Disclaimer: I received a gift card to select a product of my choice to review. We love a multi-use product! According to the description, Dew Drops could be used as a serum, primer, or dewy highlight, and I’ve tried using it as all three and here are my thoughts: As a serum, Dew Drops provides light hydration and the benefits of niacinamide in a gentle, gel formula. It spreads gorgeously on my skin, and I use about 2 and a half pumps to cover my entire face. However, upon dry down, it has a very slight tacky finish. It still plays well with the rest of my skincare routine, but because of that tacky finish, I prefer using this as a primer. As a primer, I find that this helps prevent products from moving too much or breaking apart on my face, since the tackiness helps grip my makeup in place. The hydrating gel texture ensures that I have smooth, hydrated, and glowy base to work with. I prefer this over other glowy primers because it provides glow from moisture, whereas others just use metallic pigments. As a highlighter, this is alright. Since this does dry down over time, the highlighting effect fades. I prefer other dewy highlighters over this. Overall, I love this and highly recommend.

I’ve never had this happen and I’m pretty annoyed that I now have a few dark spots after the break out I got, because I didn’t realize right away that these products were causing it! since like I said it’s never happened before, but as soon as I stopped using all of the watermelon line my break out stopped, but I was left with dark spots that aren’t going anywhere. I’ve tried all kinds of stuff to get rid of the dark spots but nothing has worked. A big disappointment since I love this brand and wanted to be able to use all of their products but since most of their products are in this watermelon line I guess I’ll have to stick to other brands instead.

I use this serum twice a day, and in the nearly six months of using it, I have noticed a noticeable improvement in my redness, pore size, and overall health of my skin. This serum is packed with ingredients that enrich the skin; watermelon has vitamin A and C, moringa has vitamin E, and Niacinimide is what your body naturally turns vitamin B3 into. So you get anti-aging, brightening, soothing, and smaller pores all in one step, which is definitely what I can see with my skin. I’m a skincare junkie, so I’m always trying out new products, but now that I’ve started using the Dew Drops, I’m not about to replace this now!There is no smell that I notice, and the serum’s texture isn’t sticky, just glowy. review_text: Apparently, you can’t have profanity in reviews- believe me I tried and that should tell you how holy grail this is for me. I held off purchasing this but tested it when I picked it up as a birthday gift in store. For context, winters for me mean the area around my mouth and on my chin is dry, flakey and literally peeling most days. When I say I have tried everything- I have. Cicaplast b5 baume from LRP, danessa myricks dewy primer, even primers by smashbox and guerlain... Even priming oils but found they tend to break up makeuip on top sometimes.  I’ve come to accept I simply cannot wear makeup in winter anywhere below my nose- so I don’t. I tested this as a skincare product and I’ll say, I can use it as such on high points of my face but to use it on the areas I need (around mouth), it is MUCH too sticky as last step for me. I’m talking gripping primer level of tacky. So, without expecting much. I tried it as a base layer for makeup and holy. My foundation did not cling to any dry or rough patches in my problem areas- none. For reference I use the UD tinted hydrator, IT CC or MAC face and body. SOMEHOW, this allows me to wear complexion products over eczema-type areas; something no other product has achieved. Not only that, but with hours of wear, my makeup continued to look flawless. Typically, after a few hours even with the dewiest primer, my skin is dry again and everything’s visible. Moral of the story- I will be purchasing, recommending, and probably telling my dermatologist about it. What this gives me, has been unachievable for me for a long time. I’d pay double for it I had to. I pray this does not get discontinued like the banana moisturizer from GR- my other HG

review_text: Glow Recipe kindly gifted their new serum to me to try--which was very exciting--and I immediately started using it when I received it.  I don’t struggle with a lot of redness but I AM always interested in trying products to help strengthen my skin barrier and improve my overall skin health.   For the most part, the ingredients in this formula seem solid which made it more appealing.  I’ve used it both morning and evening and have found that using it at night before bed provides a light amount of overnight hydration that’s still noticeable by morning although I wouldn’t recommend this solely for hydration.  It also works great for me in the morning and doesn’t interfere with makeup application over it if I don’t use a primer and meshes problem-free with any primer that I’ve paired with it as well.  Unlike some serums that I’ve used, this one absorbs very quickly and doesn’t leave a tacky residue but rather my skin is left with just a soft, hydrated sensation.  The packaging is very on-trend with the brand--very cute and appealing--and I appreciate that it’s dispensed easily with a pump.  In terms of formula, the majority of the ingredients are beneficial with a couple of exceptions; I wouldn’t recommend this for those who particularly struggle with acne as it can potentially exacerbate especially fungal acne.  It does have a light scent which is derived from natural ingredients rather than added fragrance but this may also be problematic for some.  Overall, however, the serum contains a blend of ceramides, lipids, glycerin, niacinamide, and some other reputable elements that have proven to be beneficial.  I’m overall happy with the product so far and have had no negative reactions after having used it consistently; I would recommend at least trying it if the product claims are of interest and will continue to use it myself.

review_text: Oh Glow Recipe - they’re so good at making appealing products! Once again, the packaging is beyond adorable, the texture is lightweight and absorbs rapidly into the skin, and the naturally occurring scent light and pleasant. But is it worth it?Let me preface this review by saying I don’t personally deal with redness, but I do deal with dryness and occasional sensitivity. I was excited by this product because avocado oil is one of my personal favorite ingredients for tackling dryness. I love the concept of pairing that with ceramides (for skin barrier support) and niacinamide (for evening the skin tone).  Additionally, this contains quite the list of plant extracts - many of which have soothing or anti-inflammatory properties.While using this, my skin has felt much more hydrated and free of sensitivity. It’s interesting that they write on the box: “this serum targets irritation and redness from dehydration.“ That makes perfect sense to me from my experience. Meaning: redness can be caused by a wide variety of root issues. If you are thinking of purchasing this for redness, i’d make sure you have isolated the potential cause. For example, if it’s related to acne, this may only do some basic soothing. If you have dry skin with redness, you may see MUCH more relief from this serum.TLDR: I believe this is a wonderful product FOR dry skin types, especially those who deal with minor sensitivity and redness specifically from that dryness.Hope that helps!

review_text: I received the new Glow Recipe Avocado Ceramide Redness Relief serum complimentary from the brand for review purposes (#AD). I’ve been using this daily for a bit over a week and wanted to share my thoughts.Glow Recipe describes this as a lightweight serum that helps to reduce redness and irritation caused by skin dehydration or disruption of the skin’s moisture barrier. It’s formulated with glycerin, jojoba, avocado oil, niacinamide, various ceramides, rice protein, allantoin, peptides, and various other lipids and botanical extracts. The texture is a very light cream, somewhere between a creamy serum and a gel moisturizer. It spreads very evenly on the skin and sinks in quickly. It has a bit of a light floral smell that fades quickly, which I assume to be due to the various floral extracts. The formulation certainly includes lots of great emollients and humectants to help with skin barrier repair and maintenance.Regarding the redness-relief claims, I think this is kind of nonsense. Skin can experience redness and irritation for a wide variety of reasons, so suggesting that this will address any and all of them is a bit silly. I suppose if you had redness from dehydrated or chapped skin, this could help with that - though I would recommend something more occlusive with less botanical extracts/potential skin irritants for that purpose, to be honest. The niacinamide can help with hyperpigmentation, but the percentage is not disclosed so I would personally recommend a different product for that purpose as well. What I can say with confidence is that this is a wonderfully moisturizing serum, and I would definitely recommend it to people with dry or dehydrated skin looking for something light to layer in with a more occlusive moisturizer to improve their skin’s hydration. Those with sensitive skin would probably do best to avoid this one (though I’m sure you guys already aren’t messing with glow recipe given the fragrance and botanical extracts in general!).

review_text: If this product came in a bigger bottle, I’d give it 5 stars, because while I think it’s good quality, it is also overpriced. I bought this mainly as a serum to support my moisture barrier’s health. Since it contains 5 kinds of ceramides, cholesterol, and fatty acids, this is a great product for that purpose. The texture of this is pretty lightweight, though you can definitely tell that there are oils in the formula. I used it in the daytime and it sunk in reasonably fast without leaving me greasy.I don’t know how well this helps with relieving redness, since I don’t suffer from that issue. If you’re like me and you bought this as a skin barrier protectant, I don’t think you’ll be disappointed. I still have to point out that there are more affordable options out there. The Paula’s Choice Omega+ Complex serum also contains 5 ceramides, cholesterol, and fatty acids and it’s a little more affordable than this. Stratia’s Liquid Gold is a cult classic in the moisture barrier product category, and not only do you get twice the amount of product, it also costs much less at $27. If Glow Recipe lowered the price for this 1oz bottle or if they made the bottle bigger without raising the price, I’d give it a perfect score. I can see myself repurchasing this but only during a sale or with a discount code.

review_text: I’m surprised at how much I like this! I have dry and sensitive skin but large pores (yes, all skin types can have large pores and/or acne, not just oily) that get easily clogged, but I hesitate to use even gentle chemical exfoliants these days because I spent years overexfoliating my already parched and exhausted skin. Additionally whenever I use a clay mask my skin ALWAYS ends up feeling super dry/tight and uncomfortable after, and my skin never feels better off for using it. So the idea of a hydrating clay mask was super enticing to me, and I decided to give it a try despite the AHA/BHAs. And I’m so glad I did! My skin felt so smooth and hydrated after rinsing it off, and I only felt a slight tingle due to the chemical exfoliants but they did not exacerbate my redness or sensitivity like usual. Side note, the tiny amount of physical exfoliant in here is seriously not a problem at all - since this is a rinse-off mask not a moisturizer or overnight mask, you shouldn’t be rubbing it into your skin at all, only applying gently to the surface, so you won’t get microtears or damage your skin barrier. Don’t let people scare you over it. Seriously the amount of blueberry shells or whatever is so small it really doesn’t matter, this isn’t St. Ives scrub level lol. Docking a star because I really don’t like the smell, and because I have a feeling I’m going to run out quickly because it’s a smaller size. But when I do run out, I’ll definitely repurchase!

review_text: Let me start off by saying that I’ve had horrible experiences with vitamin C serums in the past. It doesn’t use L Ascorbic acid, but five other forms of vitamin C. The texture of this serum isn’t sticky and it absorbs super easy into the skin. It’s hydrating and leaves my skin feeling plump, smooth and soft. Most importantly, it helps fade my post inflammatory hyperpigmentation more quickly than if it were to heal on its own. This is one of few products I can say that my skin actually craves. I use 2 pumps of this serum before moisturizer and SPF in my morning routine. This serum is so gentle that I even use it on my “rest“ nights when I am not using a retinol or chemical exfoliator. This is honestly my most repurchased skincare product of all time. If you are looking for a pleasant and non-irritating vitamin C, I highly recommend giving this product an honest try.

I was excited to try this plump plump HA cream. I have been using several products from glow recipe and they have really helped hydrate my skin. I was happy to I incorporate this cream into my skincare routine. I have been applying it after my toner and sometimes mix the glow recipe dew drops for an extra added glow. A big plus that it is a refillable moisturizer. So you save the jar and sure insert the new cartridge.

Gifted by glow recipe I am so excited because I and love Glow recipe  I love all of the products so when this came out I was thrilled! I just started using it so it’s too soon to tell but excited to use! Especially the help with dry skin

I love this cream so much!! It instantly brightens and plumps my skin and I love the scent of it. This is definitely my favorite product from this brand to date. It’s so lightweight but helps hydrate my dry skin!

I like this moisturizer. It has a small scent. It’s also very thin and light which I like. I also enjoy the refillable pods that can be replaced when the pod is empty. The packaging is very nice! Overall I enjoy the product!

I was really impressed with the Plum Plump  Hyaluronic Cream by Glow Recipe it has a lightweight creamy gel texture that glides on skin easily and absorbs well without leaving any tackiness. Gives a dewy finish, that kept my skin staying  soft, smooth, well hydrated and grease-free all day.  I also enjoyed that it comes with a refill pod  so all I have to do is buy the refill when needed.
review_title: Keeps my skin hydrated and soft

review_text: I’m so excited that Glow Recipe came out with this moisturizer because I love their HA! The texture of this reminds me of yogurt, which isn’t bad but usually something I wouldn’t go for. It applies nicely and feels slightly tacky, but is perfectly in between being super hydrating and lightweight. I absolutely love that the pod is refillable!

I tried the Plum Plum serum in the past and I loved it, so I was excited to try this moisturizer with hyaluronic acid. I want to start my review with the packaging of this cream. It is made of glass and is very beautiful, I appreciate the reusable pouch concept. The texture is creamy, a little bit like gelee. I didn’t notice any fragrance. It is absorbed quickly and easily by the skin and leaves a beautiful natural glow. I have combination/dry skin and I think it hydrated well throughout the day. It also layers well with other skincare products that I use. Its components such as vegan collagen and vegan silk protein are meant to deeply hydrate the dry skin and diminish the appearance of fine lines for healthy, bouncy, youthful skin. I am looking forward to seeing the more visible results.

I’m always excited to try a new product from Glow Recipe!  Their new Plum Plump Hyaluronic cream did not disappoint!  My dry skin absorbed the fluffy whipped gel cream quickly, resulting in soft beautiful skin! Love the plumpness and hydration!  Definitely glowing for the holidays after using this cream!  Also really impressed with their refill, reuse glass jar packaging!  Brilliant way to reduce waste and so easy to replace with a PCR pod!

Glow Recipe Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Cream / Moisturizer is very hydrating and nourishing. It glides on smoothly, my skin absorbs the product leaving a dewy finish and slight glow. It is a gel cream texture like bouncy pudding with a slight scent. I feel that it leaves my skin hydrate all day. Love the eco friendly packaging, which can be refilled. Complimentary from Glow Recipe.

I love the light hydrating feel with the gel cream texture. The packaging is really cute as well. Love the blend of hyaluronic acid and plum extracts which leave my skin feeling fresh and soft after every use.Best suitable for combination skin type

Love this product by Glow Recipe! I’m a big fan of their Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Serum, so I had to try this out! I generally have pretty decent skin, but in my mid 30’s, it just looks tired, despite a full night’s sleep. This applies like a dream (makeup goes on smooth after), and gets absorbed quickly. Love the velvety texture and the hydrated and more plump look I get all day. Happy customer :)

OKAY.... I AM IN LOVE WITH THIS PRODUCT. The texture is light weight,  creamy water,  fresh. It glides sooooo well onto the skin. Feels hydrating and plumping. Light scent that doesn’t over power . Give the face a nice natural glow *Gifted for free by glow recipe but opinions are my own

I’ve been loving this cream lately. It’s lightweight but still hydrating. I have more “normal”ish skin but it gets a little bit drier with weather changes, but it’s been doing a great job at keeping my face nice and moisturized. I can’t really pick up any scent to it, maybe it’s super light lol. Also, it reminded me of yogurt when i first opened it haha! I love the texture of it, and how fast it feels like it sinks into the skin. Also, I actually really like the refillable packaging idea, and I get it, the package is supposed to look like a plum, but it does feel a little bulky for how much product you get. I still think it’s super cute though lol!

I am obsessed with this new product! It came in a nice small glass jar but the product was in a “refill pod” so if you run out, you can just save money and more sustainable by just buying a refill pod and not the whole product itself! As for the product, it’s not too heavy and left my skin GLOWY! The ingredients are great- hylauronic acid and lots of vitamins incorporated which help brighten, smooth, and heal the skin. Overall, very pleased!

The new Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer is just as amazing as it’s serum counterpart! This a beautiful moisturizer that is not heavy or greasy and it provides long lasting moisture to the skin!

Glow recipe is a favorite brand of mine. This new release was much different than I expected. I had nearly no scent, and an unusual text. It’s almost greasy feeling which is strange for a gel cream. It also left my skin feeling a bit sticky.

Gifted by glow recipe. Glow Recipe always brings the plump, supple skin I crave. I love how quickly this product works to make me look more awake and even younger! My face looks renewed and alive, plus feels so soft! The scent is signature Glow Recipe, too - fruity and fresh!

How aesthetic is this packaging from glowrecipe ? I’m so excited for the launch of their Plum Plump Hyaluronic Cream. This gel like formula leaves my combo skin feeling glowy and hydrated thanks to Hyaluronic acid. Its easy to absorb consistency leaves the skin feeling refreshed and balanced all day. I didn’t feel it grease up throughout the day and there was an instant glow. Also, noteworthy is the package allows refillable pods, so the glass container can easily be repurposed or reused. I love plants and feel this would be a great repurposed jar. I’d highly recommend it

Cute packaging & eco friendly with the refillable pod! It smells great and is so hydrating. I have dry skin so i like to layer gel moisturizers under a thicker one and this one is perfect for that! Might might be my new favorite gel moisturize.

My skin has been feeling dry lately so I was excited to try this moisturizer. The jelly texture feels so great on the skin, I love his lightweight the jelly texture is, it leaves a nice dewy finish. Within a few days, I’ve noticed improvement, my skin feels more hydrated and plump.

I own plum plump serum and this cream was a must as i was in live with a serum. it gives similar effect - firm and moisturize skin deeply, boosting skin radiance and glow!  another great product from my fav Glow recipe

Another iconic product from the Glow Recipe family. The plump plump Hyaluronic Cream deeply nourishes and plumps my skin in an instant. The cream is a thick consistency that is light on the skin it never felt heavy on my skin. As the name says “plumpplump“ it truly did plump my skin almost like a freshplum. Applying this cream morning and night was asent with stew Relybeutine and it’s always a great scent with Glow Recipe.

This is a very nice moisturizer. The texture is lightweight and reminds me of yogurt. It has a scent that’s barely there. The cream is hydrating and leaves skin soft and plump. The skin looks healthy and glowy, and the hydration lasts all day.  This moisturizer applies smoothly and sinks into the skin well, but there’s a tiny bit of stickiness left afterwards, so I prefer it for nighttime routine (the stickiness disappears later). This cream comes in a refillable jar and I love when brands do that.

Glow Recipe has never failed me with their incredible products. This cream is hydrating and feels refreshing on my skin. The plumping effect works wonders and creates a beautiful glow. The texture is creamy and luxurious. My skin never looked more youthful and healthy.

Upon initial application, I really like how this feels on the skin! It’s like a creamy gel that sinks into the skin quickly. It’s lightweight and doesn’t feel sticky. It leaves the skin feeling moisturized and looking glowy! The scent isn’t super strong which I appreciate. You can definitely smell a fruity scent. I don’t totally love the scent but it’s not bad. Overall, I really like how it feels on the skin! It does have a pretty long list of ingredients so if you like more minimal ingredients in your products, this list of ingredients might be more than what you want. I do think that is has some nice ingredients though. It has lots of oils and fruit/leaf extracts. It also has hyaluronic acid and niacinamide!

Hear me out !!! If there is one product that I would recommend from glow recipe, it is this plum hyaluronic cream. lightweight pudding-like consistency that literally my skin drinks away without leaving any sticky residue. No heaviness at all. Normal, combination, and oily skin folks will love it instantly. Dry skin will need another thick moisturizer on top. I can’t wait to try it with makeup on top.

I’ve tried a few products from Glow Recipe and they were all amazing, but this one really takes the cake. First of all, it smells amazing. I love how smooth it applies and it makes my skin feel amazing! It’s so hydrating. It’s not super thick but it’s not too thin, it’s literally perfect. I also love that it is refillable! I’m obsessed.

If you’re a fan of the Glow Recipe - Plum Plump collection then you are going to love this new addition, the Hyaluronic Cream! It’s the first time I’ve seen a GR product come in a refillable packaging! It’s so lightweight and feels like a creamy gel moisturizer! I 100% recommend picking this baby up!

Beautiful container but even more beautiful consistency. Though this is a scented moisturizer it’s a very faint fragrance so it’s not at all overpowering. I love how fluffy the gel is and how quickly it absorbs into my skin. It leaves behind a dewy glow that really makes my face look so refreshed. My skin says hydrated and soft for hours. I am keeping this in rotation because I really do enjoy it. Oh and I also LOVE that this is a refillable jar because it’s super pretty.

I really liked their banana soufflé cream, but I think I like this even better! Perfect for my combination skin. It’s light yet provides enough hydration. The refillable pod feature is a great idea as well.

Great !! It’s good for sensitive skin. Not too overpowering on the skin, has a pleasant smell and color, and soaks into skin well. Less rich than their other products but perhaps it’s better that way.

I love this moisturizer. Especially it’s the first refillable moisturizer I have ever seen. I do appreciate the environmental sustainability sense of this brand. I have oily skin. And this cream feel hydrated at just the right amount. It quickly absorb into my skin and I feel hydrated all day. Like it, and will keep it in my routine!

This moisturizer is incredible. It smells so delicious. like real plum. At first, it feels like a luxurious cream texture but then it dries down to more of a water consistency. My skin stays hydrated throughout the day and gives me an extra glow.  I have dry skin and it definitely kept my skin hydrated. My skin is also sensitive and I had no issues. This moisturizer helps with redness.

I love that Glow Recipe made this moisturizer to be refillable, and as always their packaging is super cute. This product is lightweight and perfect for my oily skin. Also..the texture is dreamy. I apply it on damp skin to give the hyaluronic acid a full affect. Love it!!!

This is such a gorgeous cream. I feel like it was especially made combination skin! It has that perfect balance of hydration and moisture that my skin loves, especially during the day. It feels rich but lightweight at the same time and leaves my skin plump (!) and glowing.

Love this product! The packaging is beyond adorable - plus it is reusable, which I’m so excited about. The moisturizer itself is so lightweight and smooth on my skin. It looks great and really makes me feel hydrated.

This is an amazingly hydrating cream from Glow Recipe! The product absorbs onto the skin quickly and leaves a gorgeous glowing finish.  My face is smooth and hydrated when using this cream filled with hyaluronic and polyglutamic acids. This is definitely going to be a staple in my routine.

I’m loving this moisturizer so much! Everything from the green packaging to the color and scent of the cream, they nailed it again. Its creamy yet lightweight and applies smoothly. It absorbs quickly without any greasiness or stickiness, which I love. It contains two of my favorite ingredients - PHA and hyaluronic acid to provide deep and long-lasting hydration. My skin looks and feels healthy, hydrated and dewy. I prefer this in the morning.

I am super super excited about this new launch. I love everything from glow recipe and I have used the plum serum in the past and now I’m very excited for this plum moisturizer. It is deeply hydrating and it really helps with dry winter skin.

New favorite face cream! With the winter weather coming into full effect, my skin has been so dry. Thanks to this hyaluronic face cream has been a lifesaver! My skin feels so moisturized and plump which I love. I look super glowy and it keeps my face moisturized throughout the day. Although it gives me a dewy look, it seeps into my skin so nicely!
review_title: Love this for my dry skin!

review_text: i was gifted this product by glow recipe and i am so thankful for it. this product is great, and beautiful, and thin, but hydrating, and smells fantastic, but not too heavy. truly a dream cream. the best ever.

This is my new favorite moisturizer, hands down. The packaging felt extra when I first took it out of the box, but when I discovered the refillable pod system I was all in. The formula is a firm, creamy gel that glides on easily. It doesn’t feel greasy but does have a super dewy finish and I need to take a couple minutes to let it soak in before putting on sunscreen. My skin had been unhappy and dry due to the changing seasons, and this moisturizer noticeably put it back on track within a day. Will definitely be purchasing a refill!

Love this moisturizer!!!Smell of the plum is amazing! Gel texture is so creamy. It is lightweight but absorb quick and it definitely hydrate my skin. Even the few hours after putting them, my skin stays so soft. Will definitely repeat this product.

I was beyond excited to try this moisturizer from Glow Recipe. I’m such a huge fan of their products and have loved everything I’ve tried. I recently added this moisturizer to my daytime routine, using it with my plum plump serum. The texture is a beautiful purple hue and is so creamy and lightweight. As soon as I apply this moisturizer it instantly melts into my skin. I absolutely love the gorgeous glow and dewiness it gives my skin, making it look healthy and refreshed. I definitely noticed my face had more of a bounce and was plumper and firmer. It’s also super hydrating to my skin and lasts all day long. It didn’t take long to see these results, which is why I love Glow Recipe products so much.  Using this with the serum has made my skin look better than ever. And the packaging of course is amazing, I love the way it looks on my vanity. The refill pods is so cool and a nice touch.

I was so excited to try this product because I have always heard great things about Glow Recipe. After one week of using it, I noticed so many changes in my skin. It was all around more even and felt so hydrated. The texture of the cream is thick and dewy and makes your skin look instantly glowy. Although it is thick, it absorbs super quickly and is not oily whatsoever. My skin stays hydrated throughout the day and night and overall this product leaves my skin looking flawless!

Glow Recipe’s Plum Plump Hyaluronic Cream is my new favorite moisturizer! My skin is normal to dry and this has my skin felling so dewy and plump! The products absorbs into my skin and keeps is looking hydrated and plump all day. I also love that it smells so good.

The smell is so nice! I always love the scent and packaging Glow Recipe has. As well I found this non-irritating and comfortable for my skin. Sometimes products like this can be an irritant or making me drier but this wasn’t the case. I wish the refill pod was a little larger as it only filled the container maybe 50-65% full? Good for combination skin though! Doesn’t leave the skin particularly tacky (maybe slightly but a lot less than others) and isn’t super oil-inducing.

I’m so happy they’re expanding on the plum line because I love it! The moisturizer isn’t too heavy for my combo oily skin but perfect for the winter weather. Doesn’t leave me dry at all! Instead it’s hydrating & plumping.

This gel cream has such a nice INCI list and is really interesting focusing on plum. I really like the texture and feel that it not only deeply hydrated my skin, but it also has some oil content to lock it in. This works both for my daytime moisturizer and my evening moisturizer because of the unique texture. This is perfect for those with combo skin and makes my skin feel so balanced when using it. I just love it!
review_title: Great we’ll rounded Combo skin fave!

review_text: This is my new favorite moisturizer! This cream makes my skin look/feel so hydrated, and gives me the dewiest glow. It quickly absorbs into my skin, and feels like a drink of water for my dry/dehydrated skin. If you like Glow Recipe’s Plum Plump serum, there is no doubt that you won’t like this. I can’t recommend this beauty enough!

When open my package for this I literally gasped!!! It comes with a refillable container inside of the glass one I love this so much my skin feels so moisturized and the product absorbs into my skin fairly quickly.
This product is so incredibly hydrating! I love the way my skin glows right after application! The consistency is rich and the way it glides onto my skin to do its job is impeccable!

Refillable jar is genius. The initial texture in the jar is like a mousse pudding but when you apply it, it feels like a light gel cream. I think even oily skin ppl will like this because it is refreshing and light.

Love the lightweight hydrating feel of this moisturizer. It has a subtle fresh plum scent that smells delicious. Even though I have dry skin, this gel cream stills works great for me and moisturizes my skin well. However, it’s quite pricey considering it’s basically just a hydrating gel cream. Unless you specifically want the plum scent, there are more affordable alternatives I would rather get.
review_title: Love but not a must have

review_text: This is a really pleasant texture and has a subtle scent. I haven’t used the hyaluronic acid serum in this same line so I can’t compare it to that, but it definitely seems to add extra moisture to my skin. And I love the refillable package!

The jar is super cute and I love that it has a pod inside so going forward you can buy a refill. The creamy gel feels very lightweight on my skin and absorbs well. It has Hyaluronic and Polyglutamic acids so it does a great job of hydrating skin and it plumps out fine dehydration lines leaving my skin looking smoother throughout the day. It’s a really nice feeling moisturizer for my combination skin and I think that all skin types would enjoy it.

Glow Recipe has quickly turned into one of my favorite brands. Their formulas just seem to work on my skin, and this moisturizer is no exception. Skin feels plum(p) and hydrated after each use, and my complexion looks healthier overall. Love the refillable packaging.

I’m a huge fan of their Plum plump serum so I was so excited to try out this moisturizer. The texture leans more like a gel which I love! Fast absorbing my skin drank it up and Instantly felt moisturized and I could see how gooey and plump my skin looked. I have dry skin and I can already tell my skin is loving this moisturizer!

This cream makes my skin feel so hydrated and soft! My skin is naturally dry and looks so much better and more hydrated after I apply! It gives my skin a glow and lasts all day, and my skin feels much more balanced and absorbs really quickly! The texture is very jelly-like and creamy! I definitely recommend!

Glow recipe launched its newest moisturizer and it is quite lovely! I love how plump it makes my skin feel and how hydrating it is! Such a great addition to the line. I also love that it is a refillable jar!

The packaging is so cute! More importantly, I love how light weight & fast absorbing it is. It’s moist and plumping at the same time. I also like how soothing and soft it feels on my skin.  I do wish there was more product for the price.

I have the serum from this product line to and I absolutely love it not to mention the adorable pink packaging these are just so cute I hope they come out with some other products like maybe an eye cream also
It has a very light texture! Does not feel heavy on the skin. My skin absorbs it ver quickly. It’s hydrating and leaves the most beautiful glow! I have dehydrated skin and this was lovely on my skin!

I’m not a fan of moisturizer. I’ve yet to find one that won’t clog my pores, weigh down my skin (even though it is dry), and visibly plumps at the same time. I had really given up. I was gifted this moisturizer from Glow Recipe, but honestly, I plan to purchase it once I’m finished. Not only does it come in a refill pod, but it does everything I need my moisturizer to do! I noticed a difference in my skin instantly, and I’m sure these changes will sustain themselves with frequent use. The worry lines on my forehead looked smoother, I have no new breakouts, and I don’t feel like there is a thick layer of goop on my skin. Not usually a scent person, but this one is subtle and fruity; I like it. 10/10 for me!

love the glass and refillable packaging and the texture if the cream is so soothing to my skin, my skin was so soft and plump after , keeps moisturized for long time, I love using both in my morning skincare routine and night time too, best during fall season and winters .
Tbh, this was ok. I have dry skin and hyaluronic acid is a lifesaver during the winter season. I enjoyed the nice hydration it gave after applying, but in terms of changing my skin, didn’t do much.

I really enjoyed the nice thick texture of this cream! It absorbs nicely with no sticky feeling. I immediately noticed my skin felt very soft and looked hydrated and plump. It layers well with my other products with no pilling. It’s quite lovely!

This moisturizer is so good! It feels very hydrating and moisturizing and leaves my skin glowing. The texture isn’t too heavy nor too light and feels silky/smooth when applying. I love that it’s refillable packaging - nice work, glow recipe!

This moisturizer is amazing! The texture is like bouncy pudding and it easily soaks into the skin. My skin feels immediately hydrated and smooth. After application there is also a nice glow! I love the serum so I knew I would love this moisturizer. This moisturizer really absorbs quickly into the skin, I was amazed! I usually have textured and dry skin, but this one took it all away. My makeup goes perfectly on top with no issues. I also see how balanced my skin is and how it gives a nice amount of hydration without being too greasy. You can even refill the moisturizer with an insert. Love that! I would definitely recommend trying this one out!

This is amazing! My skin has been hating me since introducing it to a stronger retinol. This has helped recover my skin. Not only does it look much more hydrated, my skin isn’t feeling as much sensitivity as it was before. It is so nourishing and my skin feels much smoother.

Glow Recipe has been on my wishlist and I was very excited to try this new hyaluronic cream. Even though I have oily skin, my skin needs extra hydration during winter time. I like the texture because it is pretty lightweight, it goes well with my combination skin. It absorbs very well into my skin. My skin feels very hydrated and soft afterward and it gives me a healthy glow. Definitely a good addition in my routine.

Let’s start with the eco friendly jar design. I love how it has refill pods & this beautiful jar can be reused . Well done glow recipe. It’s super hydrating formula. My face looks hydrated & smooth. It absorbs really quick. Little goes a long way. What I really like about is that it has no added fragrance which I really dislike. It has a neutral smell.

I love this cream so much already after using it for a week! It’s a light & fluffy cream that isn’t too heavy yet moisturizes my combination skin very nicely and leaves me with plump & smooth skin. It has a light fragrance which smells so refreshing too! Would highly recommend this product.

I’ve been loving this new Glow Recipe Plum Plump Hylaronic Cream and it’s a must-have! This has a very light scent not fragrance like but smells like their Plum Serum too. It sinks into my skin immediately and keeps me hydrated all day! The beautiful glow on the skin is spectacular too! My skin looks plump too and I love how my skin looks all day. It never gets dry and the gel texture is perfect all year long. I am usually dry in winter but with the added Hylaronic Acid, it keeps my skin hydrated enough during the drier months too. Definitely recommend!

Loving this new product from them! I use their other products and was really excited to try out this one! It gives me great moistures and my skin feel great after applying. I love how it absorbs into the skin so quickly and make my skin feel so smooth!

Omg I was so excited to try this product! It feels sooo nice on the skin and smells amazing. It is super hydrating and made my skin super plump and bright. Highly recommend for someone looking for a new moisturizer.

I’m so impressed with all the products from glow recipe and this one is same or even better love the packaging so much specially the little refill that’s amazing, love the texture super light weight and my skin absorbed really well, my skin feel so smooth and hydrated.

Obsessed !!! I love Glow recipe.  Some of my favorite products so I was super excited to try this one out. Lightly scented. Made my skin feel hydrated, smooth and glowy. I noticed an immediate different. Huge plus to more eco friendly package where you can just buy the pod to replace when finished.

I was gifted this product from Glow Recipe. I have normal skin, so this product leaves my skin sufficiently hydrated. I enjoy the texture of this product and it is a TRUE water cream. I think that is would be the perfect moisturizer in the warmer months. But I’m order to make sure my skin stays moisturized all day in the drier months, I have been layering on top a thicker cream. The fragrance is not irritating to my skin. I would overall recommend this if you’re looking to treat yourself or to switch up some products in your skincare routine.

This launch was so perfect for Glow Recipe! Their products are incredible and this was no exception! The texture is lightweight and absorbs so easily into my skin, and it has the lightest fresh scent. The packaging is so pretty and it makes my skin feel so hydrated and plump - and that hydration lasts!

After using this product, my skin feels dewy and bouncy. It gives just the right amount of shine without being overly excessive. I really like how it smells -- it has a lightly sweet fragrance. I don’t think it is too much fragrance that would make someone break out from it though. I use this as a daytime moisturizer (for combo skin) and it keeps my skin looking hydrated all day. I don’t notice any tightness or any dryness, so it is perfect for combo skin because it doesn’t give too much oil but it still keeps the dry parts happy. The texture is really lightweight, has a great cushion to it, and glides smoothly. The product also absorbs really quickly, which is why I think it is great for combo skin. Bonus points because it layers well without pilling. I use this over various serums and also layer SPF on top with zero issues.
review_title: Great for combo skin and it's reusable!

review_text: Oh My gosh! Did not disappoint! As a glow recipe fan this product literally screams LOVE ME! It’s so so good! I use this at night and then the watermelon moisturizer in the mornings and my skin feels so healthy and glowy! This literally makes my skin feel so soft and glow instantly! Highly highly recommend!

Every Glow Recipe product I’ve tried thus far has always impressed me, and this Plum Plump Hyaluronic Cream is no exception! My skin feels so plump and hydrated after applying this, and the texture of the product is lightweight and silky so it absorbs into the skin fairly quickly. My skin feels hydrated throughout the day even though it’s winter, and this cream definitely helps it stay that way.

This product is amazing. Love that it’s not too thick. Hydrates my skin really well. Makes my skin super soft. Just need to ensure to use the right amount. If you use too much it does tend to get a bit sticky on my skin.

This is a great product, especially for summer! It is lightweight, easy to apply, absorbs nicely into the skin and doesn’t leave it greasy. I have really enjoyed this cream and how much softer my skin is.

This is the first time I’ve used this product and I absolutely love it! My skin feels so soft and plump. It smells amazing too. I look so glowy after using this. I highly recommend this product if you’ve never tried it before!

This cream works so well with my dry sensitive skin. It helps to hydrate my skin and make it look healthy. I love how it feels on my skin and I love how my skin looks afterwards. I highly recommend this product.

What a dream this moisturizer is! This gel-cream is so lightweight and melts in the skin. It keeps my skin hydrated and dewy all day without feeling greasy. I love that it’s refillable. I will be buying a refill pod as soon as it’s finished!

My skin felt great and GLOWY after putting on the Glow Recipe Plum Plump Hyaluronic Cream. I always love Glow Recipe products because my dry skin absorbs the lightweight product so quickly and stays on throughout the day. Yes, my skin feels more balanced.

When I tell you the Plum Plump Hyaluronic moisturizer has made my skin incredibly soft and feel amazing I MEAN IT! Not only did it give immediate results, my face looked and felt plumper and a lot of the redness I have actually went away throughout the day. The texture is incredibly smooth and melts right I to the skin. 10/10 recommend. GLOW RECIPE NEVER DISAPPOINTS! I was sent this product for free
review_title: If you want supple plump glowing skin, GET IT

review_text: The moisturiser is really nice. I am loving how plump and nourished my skin looks after I use this cream. It is perfect for winter season and also it helps to moisturise the skin really well. It’s a great product to try

I love the new refillable pots design. The packaging is as cute as usual. I love the lightweight texture of this for my combination skin type.  I was so excited about this launch and it didn’t disappoint. My skin feels soft and moisturized after.

Absorbs so fast and is hydrating to the skin. A little scented, so I would be careful if you have sensitivities. Definitely a small glow to the skin and would be a great addition under makeup application. I love Glow recipe so much!
