review_title: A hydrating and plumping gel like cream!

review_text: I have incorporated this gel-cream into my facial care routine and I have loved it.It moisturizes my skin very well without leaving it greasy or sticky. My skin looks glowy, moisturized and pretty. I like to use it at night to seal in the toner and serum.  Very happy!

I’m super obsessed with this off the bat. It comes in refillable packaging which is so unique! I like the fact I’ll be able to purchase refills in the future. It has a jiggly water gel texture that gives such a huge burst of hydration to the skin. I have combo skin so I like gel in the morning and this has worked perfect under my make up. It absorbs really well and doesn’t feel heavy. Plus it smells great like the rest of their products. Overall it’s a win.

I absolutely love the texture of this so much! It’s so hydrating on the skin, and isn’t sticky on my skin at all. I also love that this is refillable, it’s a great feature that I wish more skincare products had!

I am beyond excited for this launch and it did not disappoint! Smells lovely, leaves skin feeling nourished and soft with continued use and I LOVE the reusable packaging (see my pic). I’ve enjoyed using this when my skin is in need of a hydration boost and it’s been perfect for these cooler temps while my skin is adjusting.If you’re super sensitive to fragrance maybe skip this one, but otherwise I think most would be pleased.

I really love this packaging! it is refillable and cute plum shaped. Texture is gel like which I really liked because I love moisturizers like gel typed and hydrating. I have a dry skin and it feels very gentle and moisturizing on the skin leaves dewy finish. It has a fruity scent like other Glow Recipe products.

There’s a few things I want to touch base on in this review. First off, the packaging is great. I really like the new concept of a “refillable” outer packing where you just repurchase the product in a small cartridge instead of buying a whole new product that some brands are starting to do. Second of all, the texture of the moisturizer is absolutely incredible. It looks like it would be a thick cream but it’s not as thick as it looks and it melts right into the skin. It even looks good on the skin - it doesn’t look too oily or shiny like some moisturizers can make you look. Next, I feel like it pairs really well with other products. I used it alone and also with a vitamin C serum. It works great with both. Lately, I started using this product when I had super dry skin. I used it at night and woke up to beautifully moisturized skin that looked healthy all throughout the day.

I honestly really enjoy Glow Recipe products and was really excited when the Plum line was getting another addition. I have really dry skin so as much as I love the watermelon one, I wanted something with extra oomph! This product really hydrated my skin. The texture is whipped and creamy and feels really silky-like. I like using this both day and night and it definitely gives off a healthy glow. It sinks into the skin and my skin and face just look a lot healthier. I’m honestly loving this a lot:)

I’m seriously so in love with this product! The packaging is so pretty (just like all of Glow Recipe’s other products of course!) and aesthetically pleasing! My skin seriouslu feels SO nice, and I would 100% recommend this product!

This is the perfect gel moisturizer ! I love how it makes my skin feel. I’m very picky when it comes to things making my skin feel sticky and this doesn’t! Absorbed well, I also have sensitive skin and it made it nice.  I’m have to also mention the packaging is so pretty just like all of those other products.

Absolutely love this product it has helped my skin feel so plump and hydrated. It gives me such a glow after just one use and I can say I’m truly obsessed. The ingredients originally sold me and then the application is what is going to keep me buying this. It’s so smooth and not super heavy or oily. Totally recommend.

I received this product from Glow recipe complimentary for reviewing purposes.This is the moisturizer that will lock all the hydrating and moisture that you applied on your face prior. I found it as a decent daytime moisturizer as well. It does not feel oily or greasy alone so it could be used in the morning before spf application. I prefer to prep my skin with a hydrating toner or a hydration essence. Otherwise this cream felt less nourishing without other skincare products. It could be a good option for oily and combo skin (it states on the packaging it suits combo skin). The texture feels between cream and gel-cream. It slips off my spatula. The finish appears very dewy right after application. However, the cream absorbs very quickly without an oily film or residue. The finish appears to be natural as well which I love for daytime.
review_title: Great day cream for combo skin

review_text: My new favorite moisturizer. I’m in love with this hyaluronic acid moisturizer because it feels so gentle on my skin while also plumping it. It’s incredibly moisturizing and ideal for my combination complexion. It’s refillable and environmentally friendly!!

I was super excited to get to try this moisturizer! My skin is a combination of oily in the t zone and dry near my mouth. I felt that this did a good job of evening it out. I would have ranked it higher but I didn’t really love the scent. That being said, it’s definitely minor and not over powering. I did think it left my face a little sticky for a few minutes after applying but it seemed to absorb nicely. Finally, I’m all about the sustainability portion. I love that you get the nice packaging and can actually just refill it. Overall, I would recommend and plan on buying a refill.
review_title: Loving that glow, not so much the scent

I have been enjoying this product so much. I am a huge fan of the Glow Recipe Plum products. It leaves my skin looking soft and hydrated with a healthy glow. The texture is very fine and doesn’t leave my skin feeling tacky.

I think this is perfect as a morning moisturizer under my sunscreen, or as a spring / summer moisturizer

I have always been a huge fan of Glow Recipe products and this cream is no exception. My skin gets extremely dry in the winter here in Michigan and this has saved it. Love to lather it over my serums at night & wake up to glowing skin!

First off all, the packaging is the cutest!! Love the bottle. Anyways, i love this hyaluronic cream! It gives my skin the hydration it so badly need and at the same time gives a me beautiful glow! A must have!

This product is amazing! My face feels just as smooth as the product itself. After applying my face instantly glows! I was a bit worried to use since my skin is very sensitive but happy to report that I had no irritation!

This new product from glow recipe is so good my skin was beyond dry and this product brought my skin back to life just over night but over all time and time after using it it’s just making my skin better and better definitely recommend this one

It comes in a re-fillable pod which is an interesting concept, so you replace the pod in the same glass jar. Super fun gift for a friend.

My new favorite moisturizer. It brings out the glow from with while ensuring moisture to the skin. It’s not oily neither does it leave a residue. I love it so much. And the fact that it’s a refill is even better . Saving the earth

I love Glow Recipe products & this is no exception! This moisturizer is very hydrating & leaves my skin feeling super soft. I love that there’s no sticky residue like the moisturizer I’ve been using until now. And I especially love that they made it refillable! Such a great idea!

Absolutely gorgeous moisturizer! It left my skin looking glowy and plump. It absorbed quickly into the skin and still left my dry skin feeling hydrated. Would definitely recommend this for daytime use if you want something refreshing and lightweight. I also think the refillable packaging is a huge plus.

This product is great for dry skin! My skin gets so dry in the winter time and this product helped my skin out so much. It’s a nice glow without being sticky. You don’t need much product with each application. Packaging is cute and modern.

Beautiful skin that looks glowy and youthful! One of my favorite moisturizers ever, this totally changes your skin appearance making it look radiant and super hydrated. I have oily skin and this has worked wonders for me

This cream is lightweight and absorbs quickly. A little goes a long way so it will last months. It does plump up the face a bit which I love.  If you’re looking for a thicker cream then this is not for you. My skin feels moisturized and light and I really like it.

This has been such a pleasant surprise of a product! The texture is bouncy and light, but packs in a shocking amount of hydration. My one key complaint is that this doesn’t mix well with some physical SPF’s and can cause pilling. I haven’t had issues with a ton of other products, but even when giving it an hour+ before applying SPF these products just don’t mesh well.

Glow recipe products make nice gifts for teens and young adults. The packaging is cute and their products smell great. This is a decent gel like moisturizer. It’s not enough for my dry skin in the winter and is a little too expensive for me

I love the innovation of this product and how they are trying to make refillable products. I wish each pod came with more product. I love the light texture of this product and how fast it absorbs in the skin. Makes me skin look amazing but since I have super dry skin it doesn’t last all day.

I received this free from Glow Recipe. All thoughts and opinions are my own. I absolutely adore everything from Glow Recipe and this is no exception. Use it on damp skin and you will get the most wonderful glowy and hydrated skin ever!

I have been using Glow Recipe skincare for the longest time and this Hyaluronic Acid cream is the best!! I love how it’s refillable so it reduces waste and it keeps my skin so soft and moisturized for winter skin ready.

I absolutely love the packaging. It looks luxurious. The texture is super light. This is magic in a bottle deeply moisturizing and smoothing skin while absorbing quickly for a non-heavy feel. It is lightly scented, barely noticeable.

I love the concept of it being a refillable moisturizer. I did find it a bit difficult to open at first but besides that the packaging is nice. I found the cream to be light weight and moisturizing and didn’t leave my skin feeling oily. It absorbed quite quickly into the skin and left my skin feeling smooth and hydrated. I applied it over top a skin mist and didn’t have any difficulty with it pilling. The smell is also nice but might not be for everyone. Overall a pretty decent product!

I always love Glow Recipe, and this moisturizer is already another favorite of mine. My skin doesn’t feel sticky after applying, and it absorbs quickly and makes my skin feel refreshed and hydrated. Plus, the packaging is so cute!

So good!! This cream is everything my dry skin needs. Perfect for winter time. It’s hydrating and makes my skin feel plump and happy. It’s not too thick but is very moisturizing. Glow recipe does it again

This has easily become one of my favorite moisturizers! I love that this has a lightweight, almost whipped texture but is still very hydrating. It gives my skin such a nice glow. I also appreciate that this does not have a strong scent. I definitely see myself buying a refill of this.

This left my skin bouncy and supple!  It absorbs well and leaves your skin looking and feeling hydrated.  It’s deeply moisturizing for me (combo skin/ dry in the winter) but without being ‘oily’ feeling.You can replace the moisture pods that fit in the jar. Awesome for those looking to be more sustainable.

First of all I love the packaging, the color, the glass jar and that it comes with a removable refill pod. The texture is so soft and smells amazing. It feels so good and refreshing on the skin, leaving it smooth and bouncy.

First of all I really love the packing and how my skin feels after applying. This glow recipe plump moisturizer  formula is really hydrating. It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin  glowy and hydrated throughout the day. I love the fact that you can replace the pods. I highly recommend it

I’m not into gel creams. But this one is perfect for me. So hydrating, the perfect hydration for winter. It’s not oily either. I used it under my make up and my make looked so flawless. I hope they make more plum products.

My skin feels so rejuvinated! My skin looks bomb after applying the product. Plus, my skin stays hydrated throughout the day. The best part is that it gives me a glow and makes my skin feel more balanced. The texture of this product is so creamy, its such a treat. It absorbs quickly.. my skin drinks it up.

I love glow recipe products so much! It is so cool that they are doing refillable products now as well. I love this moisturizer so much. It is very lightweight and absorbs very quickly into my skin. I love the glow that it gives as well!

My skin felt amazing!! Absorbs so quickly into my skin and has a very light fragrance that smells heavenly. Very moisturizing and way better then any other serum or Creme you have ever tried. Has me glowing after using each time.

THIS SERUM IS FREAKING AMAZING!!!! It smells absolutely amazing and my skin feels so supple and elastic the morning after using it! I would definitely keep using it!!! The packaging is so adorable and feel luxurious!!!

I am 20 years old and have combo skin and like to have a nice glow, and am focusing on minimizing my breakouts and skin texture.  A little bit of this product goes a long way! But my skin feels so nice after I put it on and it gives me all night hydration. After using it for the past week my skin has become more smooth and hydrated, I can also tell that my skin has more of a bounce.  It has also helped with my breakouts (it was the only change in my routine for the week). Needless to say I am a huge fan of this product and will continue to be using it in my PM routine!

This lightweight moisturizer feels great when I apply it. It soaks in easily and leaves me feeling hydrated. I love the ingredients - especially the hyaluronic acid and the squalane. It doesn’t pill and works well under makeup. It is almost scent free and has a nice, soft texture. My skin is extremely dry in the winter and so I need to use this along with another hydrating serum. I think it would work best for me during the warmer summer months. This would probably be best for someone with combination skin. One of the things I love most about this product is the fact that the jar is reusable and you can purchase pod refills for it! Overall, a wonderful product!

Used this product for my nightly skincare routine. The packaging is well put together. The jar is made of glass & has refillable pods which is nice. The consistency of the cream feels thick but not too heavy & moisturizing enough for my dry skin. It also has a little bit of a fruity fragrance, but definitely not a strong scent which I like.

This is a great moisturizer if you want a quick and easy skincare routine. I like to use it in the morning - a splash of water to cleanse face, then apply this product all over. It’s very hydrating and the jelly-like texture sinks in nicely.  I also appreciate the refillable pack and the overall plastic design. Glow Recipe’s other products are in glass containers, and get nervous in fear of dropping them!

I’ve only been using this for about 5 days and WOW. The hydration from this is amazing. I was worried that this wouldn’t be suitable for winter but I have been proven wrong. It has a very smooth consistency and it sinks into my skin so beautifully. I have oily combination skin but I think this would work well for most skin types.

This Plum Plump Hyluronic Acid Cream is my new go to moisturizer for this upcoming winter. It’s lightweight, but it hydrates the skin very well. My skin is usually very sensitive to fragrance but this cream worked perfectly fine even though it had a fragrance which I’m so happy about. When applied at night it helps my skin look plump in the morning:) I highly recommend it!

I really like Glow Recipe and have been happy with all the products I have tried especially those that have hyaluronic acid in them. This product gives me a beautiful glow and keeps my skin plump and hydrated all day long with or without makeup. I have nothing negative to say and am so glad they have a cream now I love this even more than the serum.

Ohhh wow. This may be my new favorite product from Glow Recipe and I have a bunch of favorites already! This product is cushiony and is a gel cream and feels so lovely on my skin. It works to deeply hydrate my skin when it is dry, but also isnt heavy or greasy when my skin feels more combo oily when its warmer out. I love how my skin feels smoother and plumper and stays hydrated! Bonus points for it having refillable containers!!
review_title: My new fave Glow Recipe Product!

review_text: This is a really good moisturizer. It’s super thick and has a jelly like texture but in a good way! A little bit goes a long way! It absorbs into your skin quickly and really hydrated your skin. I used it on my face and neck!

Great night time moisturizer. I have very dry skin and in northeast winters I need a good moisturizer that is heavy duty, but does not break me out, this fits the bill! put it on every night and love it.

This is one of my new favorite moisturizers! This is a lightweight gel moisturizer and just sinks into my skin. My skin feels ultra hydrated without feeling greasy. I love the packaging and refill pod options.

I want to start out by saying that I’m obsessed with the packaging on this Glow Recipe moisturizer. It’s not only adorable, but they have made the compact to be refillable which is an incredible step in helping reduce our consumption of waste. I also really enjoyed the product. It gave me a nice plump and hydrated feel without being too heavy.

Very excited to give this product a try. It is thick and has a slight fruity scent, not overpowering. It is a little tacky after application and would recommend to those with dryer skin as at feel a little heavy once it’s on the skin.

i was so excited to try out glow recipes new product! i’ve never been disappointed with a launch and this one was no exception. a little goes a long way! i used the product that was left on the seal when i opened it and i had to use it all over my body because it was way too much for just my face. it did however make my skin sooo glowy and smooth

Loved it! I’m going to start by the fact that you can re use the packaging, packaging is 10/10 very nice color. It smells amazing! It leaves my skin looking good and feeling good. This might be my new product before wearing my make up.

Did someone say, juicy? This is a hyaluronic acid moisturizer and that’s one of my favorite skincare ingredients. I have combo skin but it’s one of the big moisturizing agents that doesn’t leave me feeling greasy or overly hydrated if you get what I mean. Along with something that’s my favorite in skincare, this is REFILLABLE! This is a beautiful glass bottle that you just buy replacement pods for! Yay for less waste! The first night I used this, I was surprised to wake up the next day and find my face still felt plump and like it had a nice little barrier. Lastly, I’m a smelly girl…I love heavy scents, but not in skincare or makeup. This is SO incredibly lightly scented it hardly has one at all! Can’t wait to see how it continues to do for me! It’s also vegan, cruelty free!

This moisturizer has a nice gel-cream texture which would be great for oilier skin types but maybe not enough for drier skin types especially during the winter. It leaves a slightly tacky feeling on the skin immediately after application, but does absorb eventually and is pretty hydrating! I’m personally not a fan of the scent which is just like their plum plump serum. Also kind of pricey for the product you get. An ok moisturizer overall and I like the refillable concept!

Love love love this hyaluronic moisture cream. This is by far the best moisturizer I found for the dry winter months for my dry sensitive skin. The texture is everything and more. You need to have this in your collection a pair so nicely with the hyaluronic acid serum!

Loving this moisturizer for morning and night, works great at hydrating and plumping the skin, but doesn’t make me greasy at all! I love the plum serum already and this is a great addition, another hit from Glow Recipe!

This is LOVELY. It has a whipped gel cream texture so I was apprehensive about using it this time of year. I live in New York so the winters are brutal with the cold air and dry heaters. I applied this cream in the morning and the moisture really lasts all day until I do my PM routine. It’s has a flattering highly dewy bouncy finish on the skin, and absorbs just enough to where it’s lightweight, but doesn’t sink it to the point of feeling parched.

I was so excited for this moisturizer and it didn’t disappoint. The watermelon was my previous favorite but I like how the hyaluronic acid is included in this moisturizer making it easier and more hydrating. It adds plumpness as well which I always love about hyaluronic acid.

So impressed with this hyaluronic acid cream! Love using it especially in the dry cold winter months as it leaves my skin looking and feeling plump healthy and hydrated! Smells so good and absorbs right into the skin!

Okay by far from many moisturizers I’ve tried, this hyaluronic cream really rejuvenates my skin and there’s a noticeable “plumpness” after the first application. I have combo-dry skin and this hydrates so well, also brightens my complexion!

Super plump, super glowy skin. Love the texture, it is light yet moisturizing.  I used it as it is and under makeup, it makes my skin look way better and I have a combination skin that gets too dry in some spots and too oily in other spots. Also, love the idea of the reusable bottle.Anyway, I highly recommend it.

Love this cream, it’s not too sticky and keeps my face so hydrated. One of the better gel creams for keeping in moisture without feeling too heavy. Love the scent as well and environmentally friendly since it’s refillable

I have been using the Glow Recipe Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer for over a week to see how hydrating it is. I have dry skin on my cheeks and forehead and the cold weather makes it even drier. The texture is lovely and absorbs so quickly into my skin. It does give skin a bit of a natural glow. On days where my skin is at its baseline and it’s not too cold outside, this moisturizer is good. It keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day. On colder weather days when my skin is particularly dry, I would need a moisturizer a little heavier. I adore Hyaluronic Acid and this is a lovely product overall.

Glow recipe kindly gifted me the plum plump hyaluronic cream . The moisturizer comes in pretty glass purple jar with a matching lid in a similar tone. Not only do I love this product for its results but I also love the fact that this face cream comes in a refillable pod within the glass jar. The moisturizer comes in a whipped gel cream which is a new experience for me but it feels amazing on the skin. After application your face feels and looks notably more moisturized.The plastic and the foil to the pod are both recyclable once you finish your product and the best part is that you can replace it with a new pod so you don’t have to create more waste.

Love the texture and packaging of this cream. It’s super hydrating and keeps my skin soft and smooth for a long time. It works great on my skin and keeps it moisturized during these winter days. It’s sensitive skin-friendly too.

Beautiful skin that looks glowy and youthful! This product is great for dry skin! My skin gets so dry in the winter time and this product helped my skin out so much. And I love the concept of it being a refillable moisturizer.

First, the packaging is so cute and I love that it’s refillable! The product itself is so lovely. It has a nice, subtle scent. The consistency is perfect and applies beautifully on the skin. It sinks in very well and my skin loves it

Probably the best moisturizer I’ve ever tried! This product makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated. My skin gets dry in the winter and I have not had that issue since I started using this. It’s definitely plumping as it says! I haven’t been wearing makeup because I love how it leaves my skin looking so glowy and plumped! I would definitely recommend this product if you struggle with dry and dull skin.

I absolutely love this new product. It smells so good and I am so grateful that it has a reusable glass container. It’s important for more cosmetic companies to make positive steps in the right direction for protecting the earth.

What an amazing treat! Glow recipe has knocked it out of the park again. Especially with this reusable packaging I love when a brand works to be more sustainable nowadays! Good job! It’s glorious by the way!

I’m liking this so far. It feels very light and refreshing on the skin. It feels like a gel almost texture wise. It absorbs well and leaves my skin with a glow. My skin also looks more plump and hydrated. I’d say it does what it claims. I also love that this has refillable packaging, clean ingredients and is cruelty free. Go Glow Recipe!

I am always impressed by Glow Recipe and love their fun packaging! This product is super hydrating and perfect for my dry winter skin. I live in a very cold mountain climate so I need skincare products that get the job done, and this does just that. It really makes my skin glow and look/feel really healthy and nourished. It’s not at all greasy and my skin absorbs it nicely, so it’s easy to wear under makeup. I apply this at night and wake up with my skin still looking so fresh and dewy. Another great product from Glow Recipe!

I’ve been impressed with products from this brand in the past and I definitely wasn’t let down this time around either. I received this complimentary and I’m happy with it. The consistency is so smooth and silky. My skin looks so glowy and hydrated. It smells lovely and the packaging is gorgeous. I definitely recommend.

I am obsessed with how creamy and rich this cream is! I was pleasently surprised as I have very dry skin and sometimes products aren’t hydrating enough especially during winter months. This definitely gets the job done and pairs beautifully with the plum plump serum for an extra glow from within moment!

Okay I’m obsessed with the packaging of this moisturizer! It’s so amazing that you can purchase refills for this. More importantly I love that this gives me a glow and keeps me hydrated throughout the day. This did not disappoint :).

I haven’t tried one product from glow recipe that I didn’t love, and this is no exception! I cannot believe the glow this gives your skin! It is so hydrating and honestly gives you an instant glow! I love using this on no makeup days! It’s perfect for the dry, winter months!

First, the packaging is soooo cute. I love how it resembles a plum like how unique. I love that the packing is reusable and all you need to do is purchase the refillable pods. The cream itself is very light without being heavy.

This is my first product that I’m trying from @glowrecipe. First of all, I really like the packaging. It’s so cute. It comes with a refillable pod. I love the way it feels and smells. It feels great on the skin, leaving it smooth and bouncy. This is a gel-type formula. The moisture it provides is immediate. There is no greasy feeling. During the winter, I prefer something thicker, but this is perfect for summer and oily skin. My husband will definitely enjoy using this.

I love all things glow recipe, and with every new launch that love grows. This cream is incredible! I have dull, dry skin especially now that the weather has gotten colder. This cream has done wonders for my skin! The consistency is rich without being overly heavy, absorbs easily, and the component is refillable. I love the healthy glow it gives my skin, too!

Glow Recipe’s NEW Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer is a hydrating, skin-balancing, whipped gel cream that comes in a refillable jar (!!!). That’s right - the product is actually in a pod with a peel-off lid that you can pop into and out of the glass jar! The cream has a very light scent (this is free of synthetic fragrance) and the lightweight texture is kind of like a cross between jelly and yogurt. It absorbs quickly and  leaves you with a beautiful dewy finish. This is definitely something I would reach for often during the summer months!

WHAT A COOL CONCEPT! I love Glow Recipe products so I knew that I would fall in love with this cream as well. It feels so hydrating but still lightweight on my skin and leaves a little glow. I love how in the future I would just need to buy a refill pod to keep enjoying this product.

This product works great for my oily/combo skin! It literally melts into my skin and works great alone or under makeup. It has a very pleasant, subtle scent and is super refreshing! A great addition to my AM routine.

The first thing that caught my eye about this product is the fact that the inner container is a refillable pod, so you can refill when you run out and not have to purchase extra outer packaging! Nice touch and I like how it uses less material. The moisturizer itself is nice and a cooling gel that would be most suitable for non-oily skin, since it does apply a little tacky, so it would be too heavier for oily skin. I find it great for my skin type and leaves me feeling so hydrated, my skin feels soft and supple, and I look so glowy!

First, a refill pod I think this is awesome (hands up). This cream feels very hydrating and the skin looks like a silk, it has a very pleasant light fragrance, in the morning my skin looks glowy and I love the texture.

This moisturizer has a whipped gel creamy texture perfect for any skin type ! Love how hydrating it is and my face feels soft and plump everytime I use ! It has Hyaluronic acid, polyglutamic acid, plump and ice willowherb as main ingredients!

Another amazing skincare product from Glow Recipe! I am all for products from Glow Recipe because they actually create a glow like the name implies. This Plum Plump Cream is no exception. First off, the best thing about this packaging is that it comes with refillable pods - great way to keep using the same jar and reduce waste. The texture of the cream is between a gel and a cream so it’s light yet moisturizing. It feels very bouncy and leaves your skin feeling supple and hydrated! I absolutely love it for my dry skin especially during these dry winter days.

Love glow recipe and this was no exception, it has no scent, very moisturizing and sinks into the skin. It’s a hybrid texture not too thick and more of thicker watery consistency.Love the idea of the pods so their is less waste.

I truly love everything about this product. The way it felt on my skin. The hydration it gave me. The texture of the product was a thick lotion type gel consistency. I really felt so much better after using it.

Glow recipe is one of my favorite brands, and this new product has changed everything! My skin is left moisturized without getting oily & glowing. It also works well with my tanning drops and goes on smoothly.

OMG, if you want to be a veritable dew drop, you’ve found it. The cream has a light fruity scent like all glow recipe products, and glides on smooth. It leaves a dewy glow that’s not sticky. It doesn’t pill on top of other products. Goes great with the plum plump serum as well. I also LOVE that you can buy replacement pods!! Keep up the good sustainability work!!

Gifted by glow recipe . Very nice product!It is absorbed quickly without leaving a dry feeling. It has a light, nice scent. The texture is very thin in a good way. Afterall, it is a water product. It goes on smoothly and if you use too much just tin your finger over the edge to put it back in.My face finally feels clean and “balanced“. It doesn’t get too oily or too dry. I haven’t had flakey skin around my eyes .

This cream is a beauty. I fint that just a little goes a long way. I love how it glides on the skin and it absolutely feels beautiful. It keeps my skin hydrated, especially this winter time. And the refillable pods? *applause*

I am so very excited to try this new launch by glow recipe. The first thing i wanna mention is that it comes with a refilling pod which is just so nice and is budget friendly. It’s a hyaluronic acid moisturizer which helps retain moisture into the skin which will be very beneficial for the upcoming winter weather. It claims to plum the skin and give it a healthy glow. I wish the size were a little bit more. The moisturizer is beautiful just like their other products are. I would definitely recommend to all.
A refill pod, yessss for it. I love glow recipe and most of their products works so well on my skin. I love this moisturizer as well, it works so well to make my skin glowy and plump.

I am so obsessed with this new Glow Recipe Moisturizer! It makes my skin feel so soft and super hydrated! My skin looks very glowy after I apply this moisturizer and it looks awake. I also love the texture!

I wasn’t sure what to expect with this but can 100% say this is one of my favorite skin creams ever. My skin feels so moisturized and soft after use. This is also great to use for gua sha, my skin literally feels like it’s drinking water when I apply. Love love love!!

I want to say that I love this line. Glow recipe has become one of my favorite brands when it comes to skincare. And this product is not the exception. My skin feels son perfect, and soft and glowy! I completely recommend this

This is my new go-to morning moisturizer! It’s really thin and spreads nicely so a little bit goes a long way. It’s super hydrating without making my skin get greasy throughout the day. It’s worked surprisingly well as a moisturizer/ makeup primer in one for days where I am in a hurry. I love the plum plump serum and it’s safe to say that this has also become a favorite from Glow Recipe for me!

LOVE this moisturizer so much. My skin drinks it up and stays hydrated all day. It feels more supple and balanced too. I love the luxurious texture and the glow that it gives post application. If you’re looking for something hydrating and balancing I highly recommend this product.

Love this hydrater by glow recipe and I am obsessed! I’ve tried many moisturizers before but I woke up with my skin still feeling hydrated and was actually surprised and had forgotten I had used this the night before. :) love.

This moisturizer is sooo dreamy for all skin types. It’s light and airy and makes your skin feel like a cloud. I felt my skin feel quenched after just one use but the benefits just got better after each time I used it! Seriously such a beautiful cream and it pairs perfectly with the GR Plum Plump serum! Love love it!!

Was very excited to try this brand and this product! I can already see an improvement in the texture of my skin in only a few weeks of using it. I love that it doesn’t have a strong scent to it and leaves my skin feeling hydrated all day!

I really like this moisturizer more than i thought i would! Its definitely heavier than I was anticipating, and oilier. However its great for my dry skin. I see an immediate glow and plumpness to my skin after using it. I have not experienced any irritation. The scent is strong but goes away.

This lightweight texture Hyaluronic cream provides abundance of hydration to my face. It gets absorbed nicely into skin. Its become part of my morning Skincare routine. Literally plump and give nice glowing face. All the healthy ingredients in this cream doing great job. Totally obsessed with this.

Absolutely loved this product! Everything from the packaging, to the scent and formula.. it was absolutely amazing! Tried it a few times now, and it feels so nice and smooth on my face and it doesn’t break me out!

Thanks for gifting this to me Glow recipe! I have never loved Glow recipe products as much as i loved this one, plum plum is a real game changer for combination dry or oily skin! It leaves a nice dewy, hydrated and a healthy plump look on the skin. A must buy for sure

This is a great moisturizer! I was gifted the Plum Plump Hyaluronic Cream to try and I absolutely love it! It feels amazing on my skin and makes it so soft. I also love that it’s refillable for sustainability!

Holy yes!! This new plump hyaluronic acid moisturizer makes my dehydrated skin feel and look AMAZING! The product absorbs quickly but gives my skin an all day hydration! I love the whipped texture for this fall/winter season on my oily/combination skin.

Love everything from glow recipe and this is no different! Super hydrating and brightening and not too heavy feeling on my skin. I’ve been using it morning and night, doesn’t irritate my skin or make it feel oily.

I’m a huge fan of Glow Recipe’s Plum Hyaluronic Serum and was SO hyped to try this. The texture is sort of in-between a cream and a gel and it turns into a watery consistency when worked into the skin. Super plumping, has not broken me out, fragrance is pleasant and not overpowering - absolutely a winner for me!

This has become my new obsession! It’s so incredibly hydrating and plumping. Perfect for the winter months. My skin has felt less dry and parched and you only need a tiny bit! I love that it’s refillable and the packaging is super sturdy and beautiful to look at as well I received this complimentary from Glow Recipe for testing purposes

I am definitely a fan of Glow Recipe and this new plumping cream is joining my list of faves. Packaging? So cute and also love that they have refills! Product? Really creamy and fluffy and makes my skin look and feel soft and hydrated. It soaks in well and doesn’t leave me greasy. I feel like the price is extremely affordable and honestly better than some others for similar products. I am impressed. I will definitely look at repurchasing this one.
review_title: My new fave moisturizer for dry skin!

review_text: What can i say, this is a great product by glow recipe. They just do skincare so well. The product left my skin looking very hydrated (not dry at all). Helped moisturize my skin because my skin has felt horrible recently (due to the cold weather). I am absolutely loving it and I have combo skin so if didn’t make my skin too dewy.

THIS IS MY NEW HOLY GRAIL PRODUCT FROM GLOW RECIPE!!!The packaging is so cute. The texture is so nice, so lightweight. It absorbs into your skin leaving it moisturised and smooth. Absolutely in love with this!

I love this face cream. A little goes a long way with this, you don’t need a lot to get great results from it. It has a bouncy texture and melts into the skin effortlessly. It layers under makeup beautifully because it leaves a slight tacky finish on the skin which I think is perfect before and face products. I mainly use this in the morning. I have very dry skin and I was nervous that it being light weight would not hydrate my skin well enough but I was pleasantly surprised that it kept my skin plump throughout the day. I’m using it now in winter but I really think this cream will be perfect for summertime with how my skin acts during that time of year. I think if you liked the matching serum to this like you’ll love this moisturizer! I also really appreciate that once you finish it you can buy a new pod to put in and save the original container. It saves you a little bit of money and is better for the environment which is always a plus

My skin has been extra dry in the winter, so I’ve been relying on all the products that can help me with hydration. So happy that I found this moisturizer because my skin has never felt softer and smoother! If you struggle with dry skin, you should definitely try this out. It’s a must-have during the colder months.

I have been absolutely loving this moisturizer. Each time I apply it my skin looks smooth and has a beautiful healthy glow. It keeps my skin feeling hydrated all day long. I have never purchased from Glow Recipe before but I now want to try all of their products because this moisturizer is just that good! The smell is nice and faint. It sinks into the skin very quickly and gives a great glow while not looking oily. I also appreciate that this product will last me a long time as you only need a small amount! The only thing that would make this product better would be if it had SPF in it. I am now tempted to buy everything from Glow Recipe because I am so impressed!

This has quickly become one of my new favorite moisturizers! It leaves the skin so dewy and plump creating the perfect base for makeup! I love that it hydrates but doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy - I also live in an area with extreme winters and need an intense moisturizer and this does the trick!

I love the lineup from Glow Recipe so I was excited to find out I was being gifted this new gem. First off, I love that it’s refillable so you can just replace the cartridge. This moisturizer has a smooth whipped texture that sinks into the skin evenly. This keeps my skin moisturized without turning me into a grease ball. I also appreciate that the scent on this is barely there. Overall a great addition to the Glow Recipe lineup!

This product went viral for a reason! I am absolutely loving the Plum Plump for my dry sensitive skin. It gives me all day hydration and the perfect canvas for applying makeup. I love the light fruity scent and the texture is so silky smooth. This applies like a dream and works all day. I am in love!

I live anything glow recipe! Some days I have dry or normal skin. In NYC, it’s been getting so cold and my face has been dry. Using this before work or even bringing it with me for that extra layer of moisture really has helped me skin feel and look more hydrated!

This is one of the few products I’ve ever tried that made an immediate difference in my skin. My skin is glowing and sooo plump and hydrated. Glow Recipe never disappoints. I highly recommend this product. I like using it both in the morning and at night!

This is a great moisturizer. Probably not for dry skin people during the colder weather but definitely for those with oily/combination skin. It has a slight faint fragrance but other than that there’s nothing really to note about this product.

I’m absolutely in LOVE with this moisturizer! The glow is absolutely STUNNING!! I’m actually going to save it for summer when my skin is less dry and more normal because it’s so perfectly lightweight.

I’m been using this cream as my daily moisturizer. It smells good but isn’t over powering. It has a gel like consistency but still feels very hydrating and nourishing on my skin. It reminds me a lot of the Fresh arose moisturizer. I also love that you can refill the jar with a refill pod! What a genius way to help the environment!

Okay, highly recommend!!! I have been using this product regularly in my skincare routine because of the way it makes my face look and feel. It’s hydrating and adds a beautiful glow, as soon as applied!

This Plump Plum Hyaluronic Cream is lightweight but packs a punch at hydrating the skin. My very dry skin felt very nice and plump throughout the work day. The scent is light and faint. Also love the new initiative with the sustainable packaging.

My skin gets really dry during this time of the year since I started using this glow recipe product my face doesn’t feel dry at all it gives a glow and plump effect every time I use it  I love it. Also can we talk about the packaging it’s just gorgeous presentation.

I LOVE this cream! It makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated when I use it. The texture is thick yet easily absorbs into skin. It gave my skin a nice radiant glow for most of the day. I think it has a mild yet yummy scent that is pleasant. This really does keep your skin plump and moisturized especially now that we’ve hit those drying winter months.

Love this product! You don’t need a lot of product which great, and it moisturizes my dry skin! It gives a beautiful glow to my skin. I have used this every morning and night and my skin loves it. One of my new favorite products!

This is a nice everyday moisturizer with a lightweight texture. It absorbs into the skin very well and has a light scent. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and soft. I will continue to use to see if it makes my skin look and feel more plump.

This is such a good pre-makeup skincare! My base looks really good because of the moisturized and plump skin! Love the packaging as well! Texture feels so nice on my skin and really helps hydrate my dry skin.

I was gifted this from Glow Recipe. This moisturizer hydrates, balances skin and delivers a glowy skin. It contains polyglutamic acid, hyaluronic acid, and plum to deliver visibly plump, glowing skin. It really like the smooth texture, fruity scent and packaging. I used this moisturizer daily and love it. This moisturizer works well on my skin and does not irritate my skin. It absorbs well into the skin. It keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day and makes my skin feel so soft.

Wow! I am in love with this moisturizer. My skin feels so soft and plumped when using it. It keeps my skin hydrated all day without oiliness. The texture is also just right, light and absorbs well. I love that it’s not heavy yet still moisturizes my skin well. And best of all it leaves my skin with a nice glow! Highly recommend! This was gifted from  Glow Recipe.

I really love Glow Recipe, so happy that I could try this new moisturizer made of plum. The scent is amazing and really hydrating. Love how cute their packaging is and such a perfect size. I use it during the day time, and works wonderful pairing it with the face mist from Glow Recipe as well

Glow recipe kindly sent this to me for free and I’m obsessed with this product! Glow recipient blows me away every time! This product feels so high quality and makes me skin feel amazing! I highly recommend to everyone!!

I really really love this moisturizer! My skin gets so dry during the inter and it has been loving this! It absorbs really quickly, which I appreciate. It has a nice scent but it doesn’t linger long for me. My skin feels so hydrated and it seems to even give it a nice glow! I love the packaging and that you can purchase refills to help reduce waste!

This is such a beautiful product that really makes my skin feel and look so amazing. I love to use this cream during the day so my skin can look hydrated and radiant through out the day. I feel this has been really helping my skin look its best.

This is described as a whipped gel and it is indeed that beautifully silky whipped texture. It’s super hydrating and absorbs fully and quickly while leaving your skin nourished. It’s certainly refreshing and left me with a gentle glow! Wears well under makeup.

Lightweight and quick absorbing this moisturizer has quickly become a favorite. Leaves my skin nourished and well hydrated plus has a nice scent. Wears well under makeup and makes my skin look plump and fresh. Gifted.
First glow recipe product and makes me want to try more from them. Doesn’t break me out, not greasy, but also hydrating (way more lux than hydroboost) Amazing scent that isn’t too strong

Glow recipe was one of the first skincare brands I fell in love with. All of their formulations are of great quality and the results are evident. I absolutely love their plum plum hyaluronic acid and the cream performs just as well!!

Absolutely LOVE this moisturizer. It really does make my skin plump and hydrated. It’s lightweight but also thick if that makes sense. It absorbs well and works well under sunscreen. I will definitely be purchasing a refill.

Another gem from Glow Recipe! I haven’t tried the Plum Plump serum but I need to now. This is such a gorgeous moisturizer, it’s lightweight but still leaves my skin feeling ultra hydrated throughout the day. It plays well with the rest of my routine and I haven’t experienced any pilling or products bunching up. I also love that this gives such a beautiful glow to the skin. And this is REFILLABLE which is amazing.

I don’t know it does it, but it actually balances out perfectly! My oily t-zone no longer needs to be dabbed with paper and my ultra dry cheeks are soft and supple throughout the day! Love the texture, it’s light, spreads easy, little goes a long way. I pair it with avocado eye sleeping mask cream and avocado ceramide serum to reduce redness. We have really dry and cold winter in Alberta and this cream gives enough hydration without being heavy and clogging pores. Works great as a night cream and the face isn’t dry in morning.

Love this moisturizer! Has a more gel like consistency so it’s not too heavy. Hyaluronic acid makes it very hydrating! Also has a nice scent which is light and not over-powering. Extra points for this being a reusable jar so it’s not a constant waste of packaging!

This is my first time trying out a moisturizer from Glow Recipe. I tried this moisturizer a few times, and while I do like the texture of the cream, it’s not great for the colder weather. It felt too lightweight on my normal to dry skin. If anything, I would save it for the hotter weather. Overall, it’s ok.
review_title: It’s best for warmer weather or oily skin

review_text: I love this product! It’s a beautiful gel cream that smells subtly like plum. It makes my skin feel so smooth. It also layers well over other skincare without pilling. I’ll continue to use this moisturizer when my combo/oily skin needs some extra moisture.

I love how moisturized and plump this cream leaves my skin. It smells amazing and gives my face a lovely glow. The jar is beautiful and can be recycled which is a plus as well! Overall I would highly recommend. This was gifted to my by the brand.

I LOVE THIS!! The texture is sooo nice and smooth, it makes my skin look so radiant and plush! I live in Minnesota where it’s very cold right now and this has been a lifesaver for my skin! I layer a thicker moisturizer over it or a oil to lock everything in. My makeup wears so well under this too!

I love that this product is refillable to cut down on waste! This leaves my face feeling moisturized and plump. It absorbs nicely and doesn’t have a super strong scent. The texture is not too thick or thin and you don’t need to use a lot of product! So far I am loving it!

Ahhh I’ve hear good things about this brand and I’m so excited that I’m able to try it! My skin has been feeling really dry due to the cold weather but this cream has helped my skin feel softer and look healthier.

I really love this product. It is super hydrating and definitely plumps my skin. I would say this is great for normal skin, and I will probably need an oil or something a tad heavier for the winter dryness! Overall an 8/10 for me!

I’ve been a huge fan of the Plum Plump serum since it was released, so I had high expectations for this moisturizer. I’m happy to say that it totally lived up to them! This gives my skin plenty of hydration for the day, and leaves me with a glowy, dewy look that I love! It pairs well under foundation and also works well as a night cream.

I’m so in love with this product! First of all, it’s quickly absorbed, so you can do your skincare fast and easy. Second, my skin feels so hydrated! It’s incredible how smooth and glow it looks. I recommend it.

The texture is beautiful and I love the amount of hydration it provides! For me and my combination skin it would be better at night in colder weather or during the day in warmer weather. I think the plum line is their best yet!

okay, this product is absolutely amazing! This doesn’t irritate my sensitive acne prone skin and it smells really nice. This brand has really great stuff especially for sensitive skin. Just left my skin feeling super glowy and super hydrated!

This is a great option for anyone with dry/normal skin, and anyone who already loves the plum plump serum! It also has a great pod option where you can just buy a refill and not have to purchase a whole new jar!

If you’re someone who suffers from dry or dehydrated skin during winter like me, then I can’t recommend this cream enough! It has hyaluronic acid which will help keep your skin soft and hydrated for the colder weather. Definitely super amazing for the skin and it applies on effortlessly and absorbs into the skin easily.

I LOVE this moisturizer! Just like the plum plump serum, it’s super hydrating, absorbs right away, and immediately makes my skin feel softer/more plump. Granted, the plumping effect is something you should get from any hydrating product since all it means is to increase moisture (giving it that taut, plump look) but obviously not all products are created equal. I’m a big Glow Recipe fan, but until now, I’d never found either of their moisturizers to be anything special/right for my normal/dry skin - the watermelon one was WAY too light (I ended up using it as a serum) and the banana one’s texture was oddly thin. This is also fairly light (I’d definitely group this with other water gel creams) but somehow it’s very effective in providing both immediate and lasting hydration without leaving behind any residue (the watermelon one often felt sticky afterwards). It’s not quite enough for my semi-dry skin right now (during the winter) but I can see it working well during any other season. It says it’s best for combination skin, which I would agree with, though I’d say it’s suitable for “normal“ (not dry or oily) skin in the summer. Also I LOVE that it’s packaged in a refillable jar since it’ll actually make a difference in cutting down the amount of waste that goes into product packaging!!!

What an aesthetically pleasing product.. it’s so cute!! The container is refillable which is so cool so you can actually resuse the glass container when you’re done. The product itself is fun! It’s like a gel? Idk I like it, it’s cooling & hydrating on my sensitive red skin. It takes a moment to dry entirely on the skin but once it does, it doesn’t feel heavy or sticky or anything. A little goes a long way as well so it’ll last you for a while!

I am in love with the packaging of their products, it makes me want to use it every time! This cream makes my face feel so soft and hydrated, I really like to use this day and night. It even works amazing under makeup!

Love this moisturizer! It’s lightweight, blends beautifully. Leaves my skin glowing and hydrated bad looks great under makeup. I loved the plum plump HA serum and this also does not disappoint! Another fave from them.

I received the Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer as a gift from Glow recipe . This is great for anyone with dry or normal skin, This moisturizer gives my skin plenty of hydration and also leaves me with a dewy look that I really love. It also has a nice pod option where you can buy a refill.

This may be one of my favorite Glow Recipe products! A lightweight, truly plumping moisturizer, it left my skin feeling supple and soft.  A great way to prepare skin for makeup application as well!  The refillable pods are super cute and I love the direction the brand is moving in.

I recently received the Plum Plump Hylauronic Acid Cream and am in LOVE! Granted there isnt many things from Glow Recipe that I dont love. All of their products are so well created. This is lightweight yet incredibly moisturizing, perfect for the winter months.

I’ve never tried skincare with a plum before. It’s definitely a very interesting ingredient. I love this cream, it makes my skin super soft and very hydrated all day long. It doesn’t clog my pores which is a huge plus.

I AM OBSESSED!!! This moisturizer is so so so good! It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and with a glow! It is super lightweight and absorbs quickly! I love that this has refill pods too. I would definitely recommend this moisturizer!

Glow Recipe’s Plum Plump Hyaluronic Cream is amazing. The texture is smooth and feels extremely moisturizing. A wonderful cream that deeply moisturizes dry, dehydrated skin and reduces visible fine lines, leaving skin healthy, firm and youthful.

This moisturizer is absolutely lovely. It’s lightweight but still hydrating- it’s the perfect middle moisturizer between pink juice and banana soufflé. It’s a great morning moisturizer for my skin and my dry skin just drinks it up. I love the gorgeous packaging, too.

Leaves my skin glowing and hydrated all day long! I apply this after washing my face every morning and it smells so good! It makes my face look and feel super moisturized and that feeling lasts all day! I love it!

Refreshing, smells amazing and plumps my dry skin! In the winter my skin is beyond stubborn, and this stuff has been helping a lot. Right away my skin looks more plump and hydrated! I have been loving Glow recipe products!

I am so impressed!!! This has an incredibly lightweight hybrid gel cream texture that left my skin feeling hydrated and bouncy without any sticky or greasy residue left behind. I love the fact that the jar is reusable with eco friendly refill pods, and the fact that it’s fragrance free and esthetically pleasing. All around another win for glow recipe!

I LOVE this product! It’s a combo of a serum and moisturizer so it isn’t too thick and glides nicely on the skin. It makes my skin feel so healthy and hydrated! I’ve been using it every day and have noticed a beautiful healthy glow it adds to my skin.

The scent is a very light smell but nice. I honestly can’t remember a plum smell but it does smell fruity. The cream is a gel cream hybrid - you can see it. I even put it into the fridge for extra cooling. I’m using this in the morning but you can use it at night too. You know sometimes when after you wash up, your face can still a feel a bit bumpy? Well this INSTANTLY smooths out my face! You can literally feel it immediately. Throughout the day I didn’t feel the need to reapply, whether I’m inside or outside. Feeling plump and dewy at the same time.

After applying this moisturizer to my skin it immediately feels plumper and hydrated. It gives me an instant glow too. I love the lightweight gel texture. It sinks into my skin right away and doesn’t feel tacky once it dries down. I highly recommend it to people with dry or combo skin.

Let me begin by saying I absolutely love Glow Recipe’s Plum Plump Hydrating serum! I was really intrigued to see what’s different about this moisturizer.. While it is a great moisturizer in its own merit, I feel it’s a good option to layer in winters with other products or serve as a standalone moisturizer in warmer seasons!I love that it’s not too heavy and gives a nice glow without making the skin feel oily, it probably isn’t enough for combo-dry (my skin type), dry skin types in this season.

I truly love this product. First thing i notice is the nice glow after I apply all my skincare. Really does make a difference for my complexion appearance. I love how easy it is to apply and definitely part of my travel essential (smells so good too!!)

This was one of the first products I tried from this brand and it encouraged to buy an entire bundle! I’ve been using it in my morning routine for about two weeks now and can already see the difference it’s making. I really have a “glow from within” now and I absolutely love it! Also love that the brand encourages sustainability by having an option to buy a new pod to insert into the packaging instead of buying a whole new container. 10/10!

This moisturizer is a beautiful purple color in the jar and has a light sweet scent. It’s definitely hydrating but I find it sometimes not quite rich enough for my combination skin in the winter. I think this will be a great product for the warmer seasons.

This moisturizer leaves my skin feeling so soft and smooth! I love how hydrating it is, and the packaging is really adorable. The scent is super nice as well. Overall, I highly recommend this product!

I absolutely love this new moisturizer from Glow Recipe! I have used the serum in the this collection in the past and it really helped to soothe and hydrated my skin and this cream is the perfect addition. It has a really nice texture that glides on to the skin and leaves it feeling super hydrated. This cream has been perfect for the dry winter months helping my skin gain a bit of moisture and glow back!
review_title: Amazing for the dry winter months!

review_text: So moisturizing without be greasy! Nice scent that isn’t too overwhelming. I’m always nervous to try new moisturizers but this one was great. It absorbs well, but leaves a soft dewy finish and plumped, very hydrated skin.

Glow recipe did it again! I’ve been using this for about 2 weeks and just love it. It’s a nice, lightweight moisturizer that doesn’t clog my pores and doesn’t weigh me down. Smells yummy, of course, and for the price I think you get a great amount of product!

I have combo skin and this product was perfect! I could use it as a day or night cream although it’s definitely more of a day cream since it’s thinner in consistency. The smell is just the smell of normal some fruity scent. This cream made my skin look SO dewy so I really enjoyed that. Because of the hyaluronic acid in the product, it left my skin feeling soft and plump.

Love the formula, it’s hydrating & perfect for winter dryness of the skin. Since I’ve dry skin/peeling issues, this felt thick & greasy & not too watered down. My skin soaked it all up & I didn’t need to go over it with a mist or oil. So I like it.!

This was such a fun product to try! The packing is adorable and you can buy refillable pods for this, which I absolutely adore. The formula is a nice, plush gel cream that’s best for combo skin. It sinks in nicely and leaves skin with a nice “plump” that makes applying makeup easy. It’s not heavy enough to be my winter moisturizer but it’s great for everyday when you want a little added moisture boost. It gives me a nice glow that makes me look healthy without being greasy.
review_title: Glow Recipe Plum Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturize

review_text: I am OBSESSED with the Plump Plump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer.  I have super dry skin so at first, given the gel like texture, I wasent sure it was going to be moisturizing enough but I did not feel the lead to reapply face lotion throughout the day! Makes me skin supple, hydrated and plump! Great for all skin types!

I’ve been using this hyaluronic cream for a few days now and I love it so far!  It leaves my skin so hydrated and bright.  I prefer to use it in my nighttime routine but it does leave my skin hydrated all day when I use it in the mornings as well.  I really like the jar it comes in and the fact that is refillable too!  It makes my counter look so cute!
First off, I LOVE how the packaging is sustainable. The product has a lovely light scent, and went on like a DREAM! It wasn’t sticky or thick at all, and sunk right in. Highly recommend for dry skin

Pleasantly surprised by this product it’s so light and the texture is almost like a jelly. My skin feels instantly hydrated like it’s drinking water. I love using this after a hot shower/before bed, very happy!

Just to talk about the texture for a second, I haven’t found a moisturizer that makes my face feel the same at the Tatcha Water Cream. This is, by far, my favorite Glow Recipe product. I love the refillable jar, I think the texture and scent of this are fantastic, and this is the perfect formulation for my skin right now. I have normal skin that tends to get a little bit more dry in the winter months. If you have super dry skin though, I don’t know if this would give you enough moisture on its own. However, for me, this is a versatile daytime and nighttime moisturizer. It also layers well under makeup without pilling up, which is very important in a day time cream for me.

I have been using it for more than two weeks and just love it. It leaves my skin hydrated, plump and brought. Great for all skin types. The packing is very cute. It has a fruity smell. So refreshing. Highly recommended.

I FINALLY found skincare that doesn’t breakout my face (thank you Mikayla Nogueira!!). My whole life I had okay enough skin, but it definitely needed *something* to enhance it and help make it not look so drab.  I could never tell what it needed (I’d probably have more oily skin if I didn’t live Upstate NY with such cold/dry weather — but in the meantime I’ll say I have oily/dry skin, with an emphasis on the dry). Any combinations of products (really big expensive brands too) would eventually leave me with breakouts after 2-3 days, especially with it being mask season. Anyway, it’s been a month now and I haven’t seen any blemishes. I use this with the hyaluronic serum first and my skin is finally what I always hoped it would be! Only took 31.5 years :) Bonus: love the smell
review_title: Finally skincare that doesn’t breakout my face!

review_text: I love the banana moisturizer and thought I would try this. I am so disappointed that the jar is so deceivingly small. The jar houses a smaller container with the lotion. It has the illusion that there is significantly more of the product. I hate when companies do this.
This product is super good. I really enjoy the texture of it and how it leaves my skin after use. The texture is unique and it really does plump and hydrate my skin

I think I’ve found my new favorite moisturizer! This product keeps my skin hydrated all day, gives me the perfect glass skin glow, and helps to plump and bring my skin back to life. The lightweight whipped cream consistency spreads far and applies so smoothly without pilling, and it works great under makeup. This product is amazing for my dry skin but I feel it would work great for any skin type! I highly recommend this product and will definitely repurchase!

Stunning!!! Stunning, stunning, stunning. I cannot believe it is so adorable for the feel and ingredients. I am a die hard of tatcha dewy skin moisturizer but feel ridiculous every time I purchase it because of the price. This is my new replacement and is EVEN BETTER! It is a odd consistency but blended out on the skin, it’s a dream. Love that they sell refills for even cheaper. New staple in my PM skincare routine!!!

I absolutely love this moisturizer! I especially love it for day time use since it’s so light weight and it gives the face an overall radiance. I think this would work for all skin types. Looks great under makeup.

This product is the smooth, lightweight moisturizer my skin wants to drink up all winter long. I love how light but high impact the formula is and that is doesn’t leave a greasy film on my skin afterwards. It’s great for makeup prep because it leaves my skin feeling smooth and moisturized but not slick to where my makeup slides off my face. It absorbs quickly and leaves a healthy glow. I also appreciate that the packaging is sustainable because the component is glass and there is an option for a refill. I was gifted this product by Glow Recipe for my honest review.

This is a really beautiful formula, with good ingredients. The texture is super lightweight, and I would describe it as a rich, almost whipped, gel consistency. When applied this transforms from a gel consistency to a liquid texture that feels very hydrating. However, this formula is still very lightweight. As someone with dry skin, I prefer a richer cream formula. I can use this during the day under spf, but this is not moisturizing enough for my night routine.  At night I use this as more of a “hydrating serum“ and apply a richer moisturizer on top.
review_title: Beautiful Formula for Normal / Oily Skin

review_text: This is the only glow recipe product I have tried that I feel stuck in between about. It is very gel like and hydrating but the problem I find is it absorbs unevenly on my skin (could be my skin not saying it is the products fault), but my main issue is on my skin this cream pills up in combo with the overnight sleeping mask. And it pills BAD. It doesn’t work in combination with the niacinamide drops for me either, although not as bad as the mask. I follow the directions for all products but they just aren’t working in combination with each other for me. this cream on its own is good, I can see it lasting me way longer than the pink juice does, but I honestly don’t think I will end up repurchasing since I am having problems combining it with my other favourite glow recipe products, but I don’t dislike it enough to return it either. I would definitely say I prefer the pink juice moisturizer

I hate gel products but this moisturizer has completely changed my opinion. I have combination oily/dry skin. This is a creamy gel that actually leaves your skin soft, supple and moisturized for hours. Very spreadable and a little goes a long way. Other gel moisturizers have melted into my skin and dried matte. This gel leaves my skin feeling bouncy and springy after each use. It is not heavy on my face or heavily scented. The packaging is a little confusing at first because you get this big jar that holds a small pod of product. However it’s made this way so that you can buy refill pods to refill your jar. I recommend this if you like plump, moisturized skin!!

After I used this moisturizer I felt my skin so hydrated and left with a beautiful glow. A little bit of product is enough for my whole face, it’s a light texture and smells  so amazing. I’m just a little time my skin has improved a lot

This is a thick and hydrating gel moisturizer.  On my dry skin, this moisturizer feels great and is very light weight. It looks good under makeup and doesn’t peel off my foundation. I love how it is refillable and the packaging feels luxurious.
Ok this moisturizer is amazing!  My skin loves it!  No break outs or greasy feeling!  Makes my skin look and feel so smooth.   Picture posted is after using plum plump for 3 weeks!
i’ve been using this moisturizer for the past few days along with the plum plump serum. this gel-like moisturizer soaks right into my skin & leaves my skin feeling so soft and glowy and hydrated.

This moisturizer is soo good for my dry skin. It’s been extra dry due to winter and this seriously hydrates! Absolutely would recommend this if you have drier skin and need something a little extra dewy.

I’m obsessed with most products from Glow Recipe. This one is truly amazing. I love the texture of it, and my skin immediately soaks it up. It gives your skin a glowing look, and is super hydrating. I also love the smell, and the way they created a refillable component. I love the sustainability of this!

The product seems great so far I’ve been using it since the past three weeks. I’ve noticed that my skin has broken out a little less and I have noticed a glue on my skin. This product has very slight perfume and easily spreads on the skin. It gets absorbed very well and disappears after a few minutes. I will continue using and hopefully see more positive results of this product.

I absolutely love this moisturizer, I have really dry skin and found this to be my new favorite nighttime moisturizer. Especially as it’s more dry outside I feel like my skin feels more smooth and way less flakey. This moisturizer also paired really well with my other night time serums. A little of this goes a really long way too, so I truly feel this moisturizer is worth every penny and already know I’m going to buy a refill when I run out!

Super hydrating, perfect for night! It is a bit tacky for me to use during the day as I use Dr Jart’s Cicapair Tiger Grass drops in lieu of foundation. I’ve really struggled with finding a night cream that didn’t clog my pores and this does the trick.

I have EXTREMELY dry skin to the point that my nostrils flake every morning in the winter. I have to basically use a balm daily as a moisturizer. I received this as a Christmas gift and was skeptical…I have never. And I mean ever. Tried a gel-like consistency moisturizer that would work for me. This is stunnnnning. It’s like your skin is drinking a glass of water, it leaves it so plump and dewey. I was amazed that I didn’t have to add another moisturizer overtop. I love Glow Recipe, especially their watermelon clay mask, but this is easily my favourite product from them. I have about 3 other moisturizers in my rotation right now and I find it hard to not use this one every single time. Great launch.

Obsessed with glow recipe - I’m 30 with combo skin and love their plum products - my skin gets drier in the winter but this really seals on moisture post serum ❤️ I recommend this because it’s not oily or drying

I have dry, sensitive skin. This moisturizer has worked so well for me! It makes my face feel so soft. I love that it is rich and hydrating but absorbs into my skin quickly. It gives my skin is such a healthy looking glow! This moisturizer is perfect for wearing under make up to. I have definitely noticed a difference in the hydration and texture of my skin. I would recommend trying this no matter what type of scan you have if you are looking for some thing hydrating this winter! It has a nice, light scent. I don’t like to not have a scent but at the same time don’t want anything to irritate my skin. I’m so glad I try this moisturizer because I absolutely love it!

I have tried many moisturizers but this is by far the best one I ever used! It’s so so hydrating but once you apply it turns into this silky texture that just leaves you with glass looking skin! I am honestly mind blown and I will forever be obsessed with this! My skin is goals when I use this! I’m so happy with my skin
