I can really feel my face being super hydrated and glowing at the same time. I really also love how convenient the pop out and refill idea has come to life !

I really like the packaging of the cream, its color.  in addition, you can buy the cartridge itself and use the packaging again, which I consider a good idea.  the face cream is pleasant, it moisturizes the skin nicely, does not leave a greasy film on the skin
Thought it would be more of a true cream consistency. It definitely feels like a gel. Not moisturizing enough for my dry skin type, but would be nice for normal/combination skin in my opinion!

This cream will literally make you look like a plump glossy peach in the best way. This light bouncy gel-like cream moisturizes and wakes up my skin. And it pairs great with the plum hyaluronic serum! I think the best part of all though is the refillable packaging, which I think is very future-forward thinking.

This moisturizer really blew my socks off! I love how hydrating it is and it didn’t irritate my sensitive skin at all! The packaging is also super cute and I love how much product you get in the jar! I would definitely recommend this!

I really love how light this moisturizer is, it works perfectly under makeup and I’ve really been enjoying it during the winter time. This stuff really keeps my skin plump and hydrated longer than most!

The moisturizer isn’t too heavy for my sensitive skin. It’s perfect for this  winter weather. I always love the scents and packaging from Glow Recipe. I love that it has a pod inside so going forward you can buy refills. This moisturizer is so good. It feels very hydrating and moisturizing and leaves my skin glowing.

I received this product for free from Glow Recipe . I really liked this cream ! moisturizes my dry skin very well. pleasant texture and well absorbed. Adore about scent ! I love it. I highly recommend this product!

I love the texture and packaging of this cream. It’s so hydrating, and it gives my skin a healthy plumped glow. I have combination skin and it feels very lightweight yet nourishing. I love pairing this cream with glow recipe serums.

My skin felt very glowy and hydrated after using this moisturizer. With my combo oily skin I was surprised it stayed that way throughout the day. My skin was more balanced and the products melted into my skin.

I love this! The packages is so cute and I love how it reduces waste. The pods are such a good idea and I love refillable things because throwing away pretty bottles is the worst! The product is super creamy and hydrating! Glow recipe never disappoints!

I love this product. The only reason I knocked it down a star is because the jar inside the outer shell is much smaller. I don’t care for deceptive packaging. There is way less product inside the jar than you think.
review_title: Great product - less product in jar

review_text: Finally - a face cream that doesn’t make react to my sensitive eyes and feels wonderful. For years I’ve struggled to find a face cream that doesn’t make my eyes burn all day - they are so sensitive it’s ridiculous. I’m clearly very sensitive to something commonly used in skin care products that are not clean and green.  My skin feels hydrated, happy and I have a healthy glow! At first I was putting too much on and it was pilling, so I lightened up on the amount and it’s perfect now. I’m in love with this company!
review_title: Perfect for sensitive skin and eyes.

review_text: Made me have a terrible acne breakout.  And for an expensive, monetary price, too.  I regretfully overlooked how this product ambiguously hides some of its ingredients behind the listing of “natural fragrance,“ an inconspicuous tell that the product is hiding unfavorable ingredients from its buyers.    It really is just a cheap product that was able to hype up its price because of Glow Recipe’s reputation and trendy advertising.

I haven’t been blown away by any of the Glow Recipe products that I’ve tried in the past yet, but I really like this one! Normally I find the scent of Glow Recipe products to be a bit strong, but this one seems a bit more subtle to me. It smells like gummy candy!I really like that it comes with a “pod” that you can replace when you you’re finished with it. The pod is a lot smaller than the actual jar though, so don’t be deceived. Anyway, the consistency of this cream is like that of a water cream. It applies incredibly dewy at first but then it dries down quite quickly. I would say this is great for all skin types. I look forward to using this one during the winter!

I’ve been loving this product so much! It’s the extra hydration boost that I need this time of the month and absolutely love how it makes my skin look and feel throughout the day. I’ve been using it on a no makeup day, and underneath my makeup and have been loving both!

This moisturizer is my new holy grail! It keeps my skin super hydrated and happy by absorbing quickly and staying on pretty much all day, I’ve noticed a significant difference in texture and glow after using this product for a few weeks now. The packaging is also super cute and recycling-friendly since you can just buy and discard the pods when you’re done instead of the whole glass container.

I’m in love this moisturizer it’s become my go to! It’s super hydrating which I need especially during these cold winter months! It leaves my skin feeling super soft and supple and looking dewy without leaving it feeling greasy and oily. I love that it also meshes well with my foundation and keeps my skin glowing and hydrated all day!

The Plump Plump Hyaluronic serum is true to its name. After regular use I felt my skin was hydrated, full and noticeably smoother. I love the smell, texture and packaging too. Definitely a new staple in my routine.

The refillable packaging is genius and I appreciate the eco-conscious approach that Glow Recipe is taking. More brands need to take a page from their book. The consistency of this luxurious gel-cream is dreamy and my combination skin loves this moisturizer.

One of my all time favorite moisturizers! This plus the Hyaluronic acid serum is everything! I love how it immediately helps to hydrate your skin and give your skin a beautiful glow! I also love how the packaging is refillable!

This is such a unique product! I’ve never come across a texture like this before. It’s a like a bouncy jello-like cream. It’s a little thicker than your regular gel-like textures, but not as thick as a cream. Excellent moisturizer! It instantly gives my skin this plum and healthy look. It might not be enough for those with dry skin, but I have combination skin, and I absolutely love it. Great product underneath makeup, and it helps in creating a very dewy glass-skin kind of look.

I was super excited to try this moisturizer out as I’ve seen so many great things about the company. My skin gets pretty dry in the winter months so I treated myself to this cream for Christmas. I used it for about 3 weeks and my skin broke outterribly. I really wanted to love it so trialed it longer than I probably should have as my face got completely spotted (I quit using it about 3 days ago and it has started to clear so I know it was the culprit). Other than that, it does give a glow but I found that I either didn’t use enough product or if I used too much, it would sit on the skin. Love the packaging though!

Great moisturizer! Hydrates skin and gives you a really gorgeous glow. Super lightweight and sinks into skin and keeps skin moisturized all day! Also has a light scent that smells amazing. Highly recommend!

I have dry skin and after using Glow recipes Hyaluronic Cream it left my skin feeling refreshed, super hydrated and my skin had a hydrated glow look to it. My skin stayed hydrated throughout the day! It absorbs into the skin quickly. The cream feels like it melts into your skin. I definitely recommend to everyone! This is my favorite moisturizer to keep my skin hydrated and looking great! I love that it’s refillable for less waste!

I’m so shook! This cream was amazing. It smells like candy and when you open up the container, the cream is like a jelly consistency.  It keeps my skin moisturized and it is very lightweight. Although the refill option sounds environmentally friendly, I think it makes more waste to be honest? Although I do enjoy using this, I’m unsure if I’ll repurchase.
I really like this moisturizer! I typically use it at night before bed- my skin feels smooth and hydrated after use, as well as when I wake up the next morning. Another good one from GR!

This moisturizer has the cutest packaging! It’s also a really nice consistency, almost a gel. It melts into my face and gives me an instant glow! I have been loving this for morning and night use. Super excited to see how it helps my dry skin in the winter.

I loved this lotion, it was so hydrating and felt very luxurious on my skin. The smell is all that you would expect of a Glow Recipe product, fruity and clean. I loved this skin lotion and highly recommend it!

This has easily become my favorite go-to moisturizer. Keeps my skin hydrated and glowing throughout the day without feeling greasy. My skin tends to be dry at this time of the year but I haven’t experienced that since I started using this and I’m so obsessed! I highly recommend this to anyone who suffers from dry/tight skin. Definitely repurchasing since this was gifted.

Super hydrating without being heavy. Perfect for what my combination dry/oily sensitive skin needed for the winter. It feels more like a gel but hydrates like a cream. And it smells subtle and lovely.

I have sensitive skin so I was pleasantly surprised to find out that this product did my skin some good! It is moisturizing and comfortable on the skin. Did not leave me with any breakouts and left my skin feeling refreshed.  It also smells lovely!
Great product leaves my skin super dewy and preforms great under make up as well!

It’s an okay moisturizer honestly really nothing mind blowing. I just don’t like it makes me feel greasy after half an hour. Not going to repurchase I was disappointed seeing all the reviews that raves about it but yeah no for me

If you want a moisturizer that is nourishing to the core yet lightweight and breathable, look no further than this one, folks. This cream envelops your skin in a blanket of hydration and plumps up your skin, while not feeling heavy or suffocating. It spreads and absorbs effortlessly and the texture is a dream, leaving the skin with a healthy dew and a soft touch. The hydration this moisturizer gives also lasts all day. The scent of this product kind of smells like you walked into a candle aisle at the store but very, very mild. It doesn’t linger. And finally, that packaging? Come on now. Highly, highly recommend this one!

After using at least 100 different “plumping“ products, this one does the best job of making any difference in plumping out fine lines and creases. Easy to spread, not sticky and no noticeable scent. Love that it is refillable.

WOW...an it would be an understatement, I have always had combination skin where my t zone was oily but the rest is dry an flakes sometimes. Especially during winter times. BUT OMG when this phenomenal plum cream came out it was an amazing moment.  My skin has never felt so hydrated so light weight, with just one product. When I’m used to useing everything from glow, this light weight whipped greatness left my skin plumped an hydrated even toned, supple an just gorgeous. I absolutely 100% recommend this Especially for combo skin.. love love love

This moisturizer is the best thing I’ve purchased at Sephora so far. It I can put it on at night and trust that the next morning my skin will be smooth and soft. A bit pricy but I’m telling you it’s 100% worth it. The packaging is ADORABLE, the smell of plums is very nice but not too strong. I have combination skin and this product works wonders! Always leaves a nice glow too ;)

So i just received this moisturizer today and was a bit  disappointed to see it comes with the refill pod inside, which is much smaller than the jar, itself so you’re getting much less product. i guess it shows it this way in the photo but i didn’t realize, so just fyi y’all.

OMG THIS IS SO GOOD, I used this for about 4 days now and my skin has never been so smooth.I used to have little bumps under my eye and fine lines and this product just cleared them up so quick!! Best moisturizer EVER

So I will admit that I am a Glow Recipe fangirl, and will try every new product that comes out because I usually love them. However, the plum serum was a miss for me because it was like putting water on my skin that evaporated in 5 minutes. THIS product, on the other hand, is absolutely amazing. It’s very light and almost like a jelly, but sinks in easily and leaves my skin soft, smooth, and bouncy in the best way. Also, it doesn’t take much and it spreads like a dream, so I feel you get your money’s worth. Finally the best moisturizer I can find. It’s perfect.

I absolutely love this moisturizer! It makes my skin feels so soft, clean, and healthy. I would give it 5 stars, my only reason for not is because the amount of product you receive is not what you think based on the packaging. The container is much larger than the actual amount of product inside. It’s almost deceiving which was really disappointing to see how little product you get for the price. But overall, I love the way my skin feels after using :) definitely recommend this product, but just letting you know it’s not as much inside as you’d think.

First off: this is the best smelling face cream.  It’s what I imagine the sugar plum fairy uses at night.  This consistency is almost jelly-like and feels cooling and don’t in your skin.  I noticed it left my skin nice and dewy.  It works well enough on my winter skin, but because of the cooling effect I think this one will be a summer must have too!

Best cream I’ve ever used! I’m honestly just waiting for it to blow up. Thanks to Tik Tok I learned my skin personally was dehydrated and not dry. Now that I switched up my products to reflect that I’m left with more hydration than I have ever seen in my life with none of the acne. I want to address some reviews that complain that the refill is smaller than the jar, these products go by WEIGHT, not volumetric measurements. The main container will give you 50ml and the refill pod will also give you 50ml.

When I tell you I’ve tried EVERYTHING for my dry, acne prone skin I mean it. I was an ulta employee for a long time and I feel as though I tried everything there was on the market. It’s a gel consistency and melts into the skin without being sticky but it still leaves you with a beautiful glow and a hydration literally unlike anything I’ve ever used before. I use this with the watermelon dew drops and plum plumping drops mixed together before I apply and my skin has never looked or felt better. Thank you glow recipe bc I will never be able to live without this moisturizer!!
I love this as a daytime moisturizer. It is light, refreshing, and does the job and keeps my skin moisturized. I have had no irritation or issues from it. 10/10 recommend.
left me greasy after an hour. I’m in late 40s w normal skin and it was just too much shine for me.

I bought this because Mikayla from TikTok recommended it and I am not disappointed. It is so good! It doesn’t leave my skin feeling oily (I have oily combo skin). Very light weight an glowy. My skin has never looked so good. I’ve only been using it for about a week so I can’t wait to see the long lasting effects it has on my skin. I recommend this to everyone.

Surprisingly impressed by this moisturizer. It checks off all the boxes for my dehydrated acne prone skin this winter: super hydrating without being greasy/heavy, makes my skin glow, and hasn’t broken me out. This moisturizer + the Watermelon Glow PHA Toner are quickly becoming my holy grails, and I will gladly repurchase them over and over again!

I do like that they went with a refillable format for the jar. I’d recommend this for people who are looking for fun and cuteness in their skincare.

Love this brand so much! Great for my skin and always the cutest packaging! I would recommend giving them a try you won’t be disappointed! They are awesome and one of my fave brands forsure!! Love love love!

Lovely moisturizer. My skin has been extra dry and dull lately with my tretinoin combined with the cold winter months. Love the texture, very light gel-creme consistency. Soaks right in. Excuse while I go buy 5 more.
review_title: I need to stockpile this one!

review_text: I quite like this product. It reminds me of Tatcha’s Water Cream at a lower price. The texture/consistency is quite heavenly and it really leaves the skin hydrated. However I am taking off one star because of the product’s use of fragrance which can be irritating to the skin.

This new moisturizer has yoghurt-like texture for a glowy, healthy-looking skin.It’s quick-absorbing and non-greasy. Love how it comes in refillable pods now. It’s safe to say that I found my go-to moisturizer for winters.
I absolutely love this cream for aging skin. It smells yummy and feels so good on my skin. I used it with the serum and I can tell a huge difference in my skin after 3 days
I loved how lightweight it was and fast absorbing! Would have preferred a light fragrance but if you love fragrance-free, then you will love this!!
I have dry skin and had such high hopes for this product but it just sat on my skin and made my face feel really sticky instead of hydrated :/

i have dry skin and use a thick moisturizing cream overnight, and was looking for a lighter but very moisturizing option during the day. i’ve tried many moisturizers and this is my favorite! it’s lightweight but so hydrating and after a few weeks of use i feel like my skin is dewy and glowing. 10/10 recommend

review_title: Love this company, love this product

review_text: I love it, it gives a perfect glow to the skin and of course hydration.

I got a free sample of this in one of my sephora orders and now im coming back to purchase the full thing. The directions say to pat it in so after showering I did, and maybe I just used too much, but it just would not really get in there and kept pilling up on my fingers and face. I had to really pat it for quite a while and I still don’t think I got everything in.. Left strange texture.

I received a sample of this, and ohhh my goodness, I’m on here buying the full size right now. I’m GLOWING. It’s lightweight, absorbs quickly, and is so nourishing yet non-greasy. I didn’t even know my current moisturizer wasn’t doing a good job until I tried this and saw real results.

I love all of the other glow recipe products so I was excited to try this and bought it the first day it dropped. Unfortunately it gave me deep painful zits each time. If you’re not breakout prone like me, then you will enjoy as it gives a nice glow. I also liked that it was not scented.
my favourite day time moisturizer at the moment, it’s super lightweight but incredibly hydrating! makes dull skin look glowy and plump upon first use!!
Very lightweight and easy to apply. Perfect for under makeup for that dewy complexion.

AMAZING!!! I am in my late teens and I have struggled with acne for about 4 years so far, over quarantine id say that my acne was at its worse so just recently I decided to try this cream. I recommend trying it if you’re on the fence.
Did not like. Made my skin feel tacky. Felt like it never absorbed into my skin.
Love it. I have dry, dry skin and I haven’t had any issues with dry patches this winter.

I love this stuff. It’s super moisturizing without being oily. You immediately will have a glow to your skin. I got this as a free sample and immediately purchased my own. I got the refill because it didn’t make much sense to me to purchase it just for the packaging. I have containers that match my vanity aesthetic so I saved a few bucks by getting the refill. Highly recommend, I use it on its own as a moisturizer at night or under my makeup before my primer. It works great with both wears.

I’m dehydrated combo with oily t-zone and dry cheeks and mouth. This stuff works amazing. It keeps me hydrated through the day and at night, I use this with the Dr. Jart ceramidin cream to give a little oomph to it. The texture is luxurious, not tacky, and perfect for me!

I was scared to use this because it’s heavily fragranced and I’m having a breakout right now but I ended up liking it. It made my skin glow! Although, I did notice I formed a new pimple after using it but I’m not sure if this is what caused it.
This cream was very hydrating and moisturizing! I enjoyed how it applied smoothly and it really gave my skin a dewy finish. It isn’t a holy grail for me- but it is good and I will continue to use it!
review_title: If you want dewy skin then this is for you!

review_text: Feels like silicone sitting on top of ur skin and the more u put or rub the product in it ends up pills terribly!
Love this alone or under makeup! Really refreshed and plumped my skin! I put it in my beauty fridge to chill before applying! Makes a huge difference! My skin has never looked this good! Buy this!

This gel cream goes on my skin smoothly and absorbs well. I feel instantly refreshed and my face stays moisturized all day. I use it day and night after serum. My skin definitely feels plump and glowy.

This is an awesome product I didn’t know this but if you’re going to order for the first you should get the no refill moisturizer so you get the container to start using the refill. I hope some learn from my mistakes.
Best moisturizer I’ve ever used and my first glow recipe product. My skin was flakey and dry from the cold and this stuff changed the game for me. Highly recommend!!

I got this in a sample, and I’ll be buying the full size after my usual daytime moisturizer runs out.  This stuff feels so nice!!  I have fairly oily skin and this stuff made my skin beautifully dewy without looking and feeling like a greasy clogged mess, like so so many others I’ve tried.  True to its name!!

All these great reviews I had to try— I have been using claudile moisture cream for years now and thought to try new brand … well this one made my skin feel tight at night even after my serums and eye cream. I wish I could take it back but threw  away the  box since all these great reviews were posted … I sometimes wonder if all their  reviews pay for their own

I was so content and I love that you can refill that pod which I will be doing. I will be using this product every single day as part of my skincare routine.
review_title: Glow Recipe Plum Pump Hyaluronic Acid Moisturizer

review_text: I have incredibly sensitive dry skin and was looking for an affordable dupe to Tatcha’s dewy skin moisturizer. After reviewing the Watermelon Toner from GLOW, I was really on the fence but listened to my friend. A little goes a long way with this product, and I even apply it to my neck and chest (if low cut shirt.) I see an instant difference in my skin and have been thoroughly pleased. My skin has had 0 bad reactions and it sits weightless. I am not a skin care fanatic, and really trust in personal testimonies. This was the first product I bought blindly and can see why it has such great reviews. For extra plumpness, I put it on my lips before adding my Carmex lip balm. I love it and my skin’s texture has drastically changed.

I have extremely dry skin, after speaking with a Sephora employee about this product I decided to give it a go. This product pills so bad. It literally just sits on top of my skin. I will not be purchasing again.
Obsessed with this moisturizer!! Will definitely buy again
Love the way this makes my skin feel. Very plump! Love that it is a gel moisturizer. Does not feel too heavy.

A decent daytime moisturizer. I use in the AM after cleansing and serums. I like to pair it with drunken elephants vitamin d bronzer so I don’t have to wear foundation. It gives the skin a nice dewy glow. I don’t like to pair with make up because it doesn’t really sink in to my skin well.

This product not only keeps your skin hydrated throughout the day, but it leaves it feeling smooth and refreshed. It absorbs super quickly and helps with hyper pigmentation! Overall I’d say that this is the perfect product to balance out the skin and make you feel hydrated.

This is more like a gel/water like based moisturizer. I have really dry skin and this does moisturize my face but it does dry off after a few hours of wear. I would rather recommend this during the summer, not for winter.
I really wanted to like it but it’s just something watery which pills after some time. I also felt that it made my face much dryer that it already it.

NOT GOOD AT ALL SAVE YOUR MONEY! I bought this due to hearing so many good things as I have dry skin. this does NOT hydrate at all. within the 1st 10 minutes of having it on, my skin got dry.  after only using it for 3 days my skin around my mouth got flakey. please save your money

I received this product as a sample and was instantly obsessed. I don’t usually like scented products, but the scent is lovely! I have extremely dry skin, and woke up with dewey skin after applying this at night. It’s lightweight yet deeply moisturizing. It doesn’t feel greasy, and it doesn’t pill on top on my Vitamin C serums or hyaluronic acid, or under my SPF and squalane oil. Probably the best moisturizer I have discovered yet.
Very light but glows moisturizer! Gives a nice shine if you do after a serum like myself! I have dry skin especially during the colder season and this stuff makes me so glowy i love

What a beautiful moisturizer! Love the idea it’s refillable. This is a great moisturizer for my dry skin and makeup applies wonderfully on top. A little goes a long way and it has a light weight gel like consistency. Super moisturizing without feeling heavy. Recommend!

This is the best moisturizer I’ve ever used for my super dry, dehydrated skin!! I get really flakey in the winter, so I wanted a daytime moisturizer that would address that - this works amazing for both day and nighttime, and will leave your skin feeling SO SOFT and SO HYDRATED. Scents usually irritate my skin, but this has a lovely and subtle scent which hasn’t caused irritation yet. I’m so scared it’ll become one of those products that’s always out of stock because I want to keep buying it forever!!! Also love the refillable packaging, and I think this stuff is definitely worth the money!

It’s a gel cream formula so I was expecting more lightweight hydration and that’s what I got. I see this being better for the summer when I reach for more lightweight moisturizers, personally for winter a prefer something more hydrating. It’s a bummer that it pills if you use to much, so you do have to be mindful of how much you apply to prevent that. The scent is nice and not super strong although something to keep in mind if you are sensitive to fragrance. I do like the idea of the refill pods, it’s neat that they incorporated that with this product’s packaging.

This product does everything it says it will and then some. You only need to apply a very small amount on the back of your opposite hand and then gently pat on your face with the other with a light touch. It really blends into your skin effortlessly and smooths out evenly across your face bringing you an immense amount of hydration. I’m impressed. I will def re-purchase this item once done. I love all of glow recipe’s products but this one might just be my fave after their sleeping mask.

This is one of the best moisturizers I have ever tried! Absolutely amazing! The whipped, bouncy gel cream texture is gorgeous and sinks right into the skin, and as is typical of Glow Recipe it gives a gorgeous, yet natural, glow to the skin. I was at first hesitant upon hearing “gel-cream”, as that is often a key word for oily skin and supremely lightweight formulas, but this is a true gel cream, not a barely there gel. It is perfect for my combination skin. It does have fragrance, so if you have a fragrance sensitivity/allergy, I would avoid, but if you are someone who is just not a big fan of fragrance in beauty products, I would totally recommend. I personally don’t like fragrance, but this one is barely there. It’s hard to describe, but I would say it smells subtly light and sweet, with the barest hint of plum, plus it fades quickly. Not as strong as that of the watermelon glow toner (although I actually love that fragrance as well). Only problem is it DOES NOT FILL UP THE PACKAGING! It’s great that Glow Recipe does refills for their products, but I honestly think it’s just a tactic to trick consumers into thinking they’re getting more product for the price, because the refill pod is significantly smaller than the glass jar. I would still fully recommend though, it’s worth all the hype!

review_title: Just want we needed from this brand

review_text: It has a really nice, lightweight consistency & I love the smell! Smells only a little bit like sunscreen, the watermelon scent is present but not overpowering. There’s such a clear difference in my skin since I started using this product, I mean need I say GLOW? Only small complaint is I wonder how quickly I’ll burn through the product applying at an amount that truly gives me full sun protection, but that could just be me being used to over-applying sunscreen. Highly recommend!

The reviews on the product are highly incentivized and seem like a first impression. I spent my own money on this.. so this is an authentic reviewPROS: It does everything it claims IF you use a very sparing amount. It’s very glowy, with a little bit of stickiness great for under makeup. It has a watermelon (jolly rancher) and sunscreen fragrance. Depending on your senses it may smell strongly of watermelon jolly rancher or more on the sunscreen side. For the most part, I don’t smell it on my skin after application. CONS: If you are SERIOUS about your sunscreen application, and you apply the recommended amount or a generous amount… this does the exact opposite of all their claims. It will feel goopy, sticky, heavy on the skin and take forever to settle in. PLUS if you apply this amount, it WILL pill. And if you have oily skin, you’ll end up a grease ball by the 2-3 hour..A little goes a long way. You’ll like it or hate it depending on how much you believe should be applied.

This is so amazing! I love every glow recipe product I have tried! I tried it the next morning after I got it and have been wearing it everyday since! I go to school and come back after and my face is still glowing! It distracts the shine from my combo - oily skin by making the rest of my face glowy and shiny! I love it so much!!! I am wearing it right now, as I am writing this review. For people who don’t like the glow look, this might not be for you! Occasionally I have to reapply when I see that the glow is fading, so that might be why the glow lasted all day.
review_title: Where has this beauty been all of my life!

review_text: I love this sunscreen!!! It feels so nice on my sensitive skin (even with the added niacinamide) and my makeup sits really nicely on top of it. I love that it’s not just a sunscreen but works on improving your skin at the same time!! Plus it makes me super glowy (not greasy) which is always the goal :)

This product is great to keep healthy and glowing skin appearance. Really good to use those days when you dont wear makeup but it also feels great with makeup on. It smells amazing and it will be great to wear all summer because it contains SPF 50.
I’m so sad! I wanted to love this product so badly. It pills so much on me. It smells great and if the pilling didn’t happen I would love it.

I was so excited to try this because I love most of everything I buy from Glow Recipe ! The finish was great and didn’t pill under my makeup . The one thing that I could not get past was the scent , and I am not talking about the watermelon scent because I did not smell that . It was the strong SPF scent so much that i felt like i could taste it in my mouth . I thought i would try this since it is part mineral and had no avobenzone in it . I think i am going to have to stick to mineral . However if you can handle that than this is a beautiful sunscreen .

I LOVE this sunscreen. First, it is sheer but almost leaves a dewy sparkle on the skin. It’s so flattering especially on my skin that’s super dry. It also smells amazing!! I usually hate wearing daily sunscreen because it’s oily and leaves a white cast but that was not the case with the sunscreen. A must try!!

I’ve been waiting for a spf from glow recipe for as long as I can remember. I love that this one is hydrating, gives an instant (and long term bc of niacinamide) healthy glow, lightweight, smells good, is cooling, noncomedogenic, safe to use around the eyes. I could go on and on! The ONLY con for me, is the pilling. I’ve tried all the tips, different product routine, full GR product routine, bare faced, etc. i still deal with pilling. At this point I think my skin just doesn’t like it. It’s been different for everyone, but I would say to give it a shot, because if it doesn’t pill for you I guarantee you will love it!
I love Glow Recipe and I wanted to love this. The smell and consistency is wonderful, but when I put it on it pills SO BAD. The worst pilling I have ever experienced from a product.

I am in love with this sunscreen! It’s very lightweight and has a light watermelon scent(best scent out of all I have tried), the best part is it has SPF50! It absorbs very fast just like lotion, is very easy to blend, and not greasy. It hydrates my skin the whole day and doesn’t form a white cast and makeup stays very well on top. When I reapply again it doesn’t feel thick and still absorbs very fast and doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin at all. My skin looks very glowy and bouncy, I love it! I am excited to find out if this sunscreen can also even out my skin tone.

Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Glow is probably the prettiest sunscreen I own! I like that the sunscreen is like a light weight cream. It has a faint scent of water melon and blends clear. I really like that there is niacinamide in it which is wonderful for brighter, glowing skin! It’s comfortable and wears well. On it’s own, the sunscreen sinks beautifully into the skin and doesn’t feel greasy or tacky. However, it can feel tacky or pill depending on the other products in your routine.  For example, it doesn’t seem to work too well with facial oils or certain hydro based serums. I also prefer using it with a simpler, pared down skincare routine as it’s quite a moisturizing sunscreen.
review_title: Decent but can feel tacky based on your routine!

review_text: This completes my glow recipe skincare line. Doesn’t feel sticky at all. Super love the scent and the after glow is the best.

So incredibly disappointed. I absolutely love Glow Recipe and have all of their products. I was so excited to try the new sunscreen, but was super sad that no matter what I tried it kept pilling upon application. I applied with skincare products under, allowed more time for products to dry and also tried with nothing underneath and every time I was left with little strings or balls all over my face. I unfortunately returned today.

On the plus side, lovely smell and it’s a lovely texture to apply and you’re left with a radiant glow. However, my biggest issue with sunscreen is while you get the best of both worlds when it comes to broad spectrum protection considering there are mineral and chemical filters, you also get the worst of both worlds too. It left the sorta gross sticky feeling a mineral sunscreen does with a slight white cast, but also stung my eyes like a chemical sunscreen sometimes can. Not to mention its expensive compared to other sunscreens. I won’t be repurchasing.

This sunscreen is extremely gorgeous!!!! 100000000% recommended! I’m so in love i have never tried a sunscreen like this! It’s so hydrating, no white cast, no streaks on the skin, no bad spf smell, extremely glowy and fresh, makes your skin like butter and makeup applies beautifully on top! This is everything you would wish of a sunscreen! It’s like a moisturizer that blends to ur skin like magic! I’m not going to buy anything else anymore
It’s just like the cerave one, i have light skin tone and it still leaves a white cast and it’s too thick. Irritating and just not worth it.
review_title: don’t buy it for the cute packaging lol

review_text: This is a huge no for me and I will be returning this soon. I wanted to like it very badly because of the high SPF and dewy finish but the formula pills horrendously. I found that it wasn’t moisturizing either and I suspect the pilling has a drying effect as well. The finish is quite tacky for awhile. I’ll be sticking to my innisfree sunscreen, half the cost and 10x the quality.

AHH this product is amazing and feels so great on my skin! I have loved Glow Recipe products and was so excited to get my hands on this new launch! I was out in the sun all day this past weekend and this held up very well!!

I was gifted this product and I am obsessed! My skin feels very hydrated, glowy, and not greasy at all! I love the scent of this sunscreen and it is easily blendable. It doesn’t leave a white cast and really just blends into the skin so nicely. Using this product has become my favorite part of my skincare routine!
review_title: My favorite part of my skincare routine!

review_text: This feels very light weight compared to many other sunscreens I have tried. I love the formula and the consistency. I tried it over one of my favorite moisturizers and also on bare skin. I noticed some slight pilling over the side where I used moisturizer first. It has a very slight iridescent purple tint to it, which I imagine is part of the “glow” the product is supposed to give. That being said, it feels very nice and light on the skin, which I appreciate as someone who lives in a hot and humid climate. I will continue to use this!

I purchased this shortly after the launch. I was super excited to try it and needed a sunscreen. I have super fair and combination skin. I used their plum plump moisturizer (which I love) before applying this making sure to let it set, I brushed my teeth I got some coffee, then I started applying this and it pilled horribly, I swiped and then patted it in. I washed everything off, completely started over, and applied this sunscreen with nothing underneath. IT STILL PILLED!! I don’t know if I got a bad batch, or if they need to reformulate. But I returned it to Sephora, and the woman that helped me with the return said that niacinamide and sunscreen always pills, she didn’t know the science behind that, but just knew from experience of using them together, so it’s kinda silly that they created a product that includes both of these ingredients. I’m super disappointed, but I have faith they will figure this one out.

This sunscreen is super lightweight and easy to apply. There’s no white cast unless you really massage it into your face. It’s also non-sticky, not chalky, or irritating. And the scent is super light!

I love this cream so much!! Glow Recipe always has some of the best sunscreens and skincare so I definitely trust the brand. Definitely would recommend since it goes on lightweight and does not show a white film.

I actually really loved this product. First of all the packaging is so cute and perfect for traveling. I loved the thickness of the formula as well. It blended in nicely with no white cast. The only con is the scent. It’s not too strong for me, but it might be for others.

A light weight creamy consistency that blends in very easily will little residue. Very subtle watermelon scent that isn’t overpowering at all. Will be great for the upcoming summer just to throw in your everyday bag.

I love the smell, i love the packaging, but the pilling.. God the PILLING!! I honestly wanted to give it 2 stars but I’m waiting to see if the benefits really make up for the pilling. I have to really work it in my skin to get rid of it, but i look at my hands and all the pilling ends up there. Kind of makes me think like I’m removing product and not really benefiting from the ingredients. Thankfully it doesn’t pill through my makeup, another reason why i gave it a third star. I’m going to finish the bottle, but i won’t repurchase. The Paula’s choice spf is WAY better. You just slap it on and no cast, no pilling, doesn’t feel greasy, you won’t ever have to worry about it if you’re a girl in the go. Hope this helps.

As someone who is a huge fan of Glow Recipe and also uses sunscreen everyday, I was immediately interested in Glow Recipe’s Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50. I love that this sunscreen has a high SPF, applies easily, and doesn’t leave a white cast.

I love the smell and that it doesn’t leave a white cast on the skin. The glow recipe is very hydrating, more like a lotion. It does give my skin a bouncy/hydrated look which I like. I did have experience with the pilling but when I used this on top of a moisturizer I didn’t experience it.

I like this a lot however the only way I can use it is bare face with no other products. If I use with ANYTHING else it pills up very badly. When used alone it’s the PERFECT face sunscreen. Light scent that doesn’t linger, rubs in beautiful without leaving any white cast and most importantly protects amazingly from sun (and artificial sun). I use tanning bed regularly but never ever tan my face and always slather it in sunscreen and this is the first facial sunscreen that I have used that has completely protected my face in the tanning bed… not even a little redness when I get out.

First of all, this packaging is the cutest! This doesn’t have the typical sunscreen smell and it goes on super nice! I think it blends well with makeup. It isn’t greasy or thick and my skin is glowing! I didn’t notice that it pilled like some people said.

I love this glow recipe sunscreen it peels on my face dont know why  but other than that its super refreshing feels great, keeps my skin super hydrated and the sunscreen adds that layer of protection we need. It goes on great under makeup once its fully dried. Just need to blend it in quickly to your face so it doesnt dry as it dries a bit quickly. Sunscreen is so essential for wveryday and this is a perfect product. You glow while wearing it and thats a big deal! And you can constantly blend it in until the peeling is gone and it goes beautifully under makeup.

This product gave my skin an instant glow and applied so easily! Unlike a ton of products that i’ve tried, it’s lightweight on the skin and doesn’t feel greasy on my already oily skin. I’m excited to continue using it to see if it evens out my skin tone.

I really love this, it really sets into my skin nicely I’ve been using it everyday since I got it!! It also smells really good, just a hint of watermelon! It doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy and it’s not too heavy feeling.  I will for sure be buying this one again!

What a great sunscreen! I love the lightweight feel and texture.  Smells great and blended well. I have seen that a ton of planning and care went into this product from their Instagram posts.  Happy to have it in my regimen.

Este protector solar me parece muy lindo para una piel normal a seca. Si tienes piel grasa, quizás no te vaya a gustar. Me encanta que tenga niacinamide, mas que un bloqueador solar es un tratamiento para la piel, me encanta

it had a light scent of water melon which i love, it’s not over powering at all. at first it goes on white which helps show me where i already rubbed it in but after like 30 seconds it faded away and just gives a nice healthy glow. i love!

Glow recipe never disappoints! I have been loving this sunscreen!! I have extremely fair and combination skin. This is super light and barely feels like you have anything on. I love the slight glow that it gave my skin. The wear time was great and it worked well underneath my makeup. Highly highly recommend!

I was so excited to receive a watermelon scented moisturizer with spf. It is perfect for not only beach or pool days, but even days when you will simply be outside running errands. It doesn’t leave my face like, smells great and absorbs evenly. I received this product free to give my honest opinion and review about it.

I’m not really a fan of sunscreen because they usually feel heavy on the skin but I don’t feel this way about this one! This sunscreen is easy to blend on the skin, and does not feel greasy on the skin!

This sunscreen makes my skin look SO nice and it feels so lightweight on! I know some are having piling issues but I read a tip from someone else to apply when your face is damp and that’s the only way I’ve been applying it since purchased. I go through my normal skincare routine, let it set for a few minutes, then spray rosewater and pat on the sunscreen :) I know it can seem like too much effort for a high end product but no white cast, no breakouts and the way my complexion feels and looks is so worth it!
My new favorite skincare product! Lightweight and glowy. The fragrance is subtle and it feels amazing :)

I know everyone was SO excited to try this new sunscreen! And so was I. I love glow recipe skincare and had no doubt their SPF would be equally as amazing. I have oily skin but this winter it’s been quite dry, more than usual. This SPF is very hydrating. And VERY glowy. Oh it adds such a beautiful glow to your skin. It has a light natural scent to it that hasn’t seemed to irritate my skin. I have tried this with different skincare combos and have not experienced any sort of pilling. I think this is an amazing SPF and if this checks off the boxes you’re looking for, then I say give it a try!

So ive been testing this for about 4 days and Unfortunately i wanted to love this but i do not at all . I have very sensitive eyes and this sunscreen started to burn my eyes each time i used it and it also never sank into my skin only sat on top and felt greasy in a few hours . .

I loved this! Left me with a really nice glow. I felt hydrated all day long. I really appreciated how non greasy and lightweight it was on application. I was able to wear under make up too which I liked.

Prior to the release of the Watermelon Glow SPF, I was using Glow Recipe for all my skincare routine except my sunscreen. I was always holding out hope they may create one so I could start using a full Glow Recipe skincare routine and they finally did!!! :D I have really sensitive skin so finding products that don’t cause irritation and actually work for my skin is super tough. I love this SPF because it feels lightweight, looks glowy on the skin, and leaves me skin feeling hydrated. Glow Recipe’s watermelon products are my favorite so I love how the SPF contains watermelon. I definitely would recommend adding the Watermelon Glow SPF to your skincare routine!

I bought this sunscreen the day it was released. There was already so much hype around it, I couldn’t wait to try it. I have now been using this for about a week and when I first got it yes, I thought it was nice but it was only because I used a very small amount. If you use a the correct amount it sunscreen needed for good protection—this sucks. IT SUCKS. its thick, goopy and leaves you very greasy looking. it feels heavy on the skin and theres a very slight white cast. and this pills. it pills on first application, it pills when you go to reapply. this doesn’t dry down fully for me either. it stays sticky and feels heavy on my face throughout the day. the sunscreen smell is slight, but you can def smell it. so much for being a sunscreen you’ll actually want to wear.

Wasn’t sure what to expect out of this product since I’m VERY picky about sunscreens. But I was blown away - I will continue to buy this product. It goes on so smooth and doesn’t leave me feeling oily at all! I have tried it alone and under makeup (if wearing under your makeup I would suggest allowing plenty of time to dry). Love this and it smells fabulous!!

Pros- light watermelon scent, very little white cast. Cons- pilling. This sunscreen did not play well with certain moisturizers. Basically ruined my entire makeup application. Also feels slightly greasy/thick.

Absolutely love this product! My skin is glowing and bright and it look so much better in a matter of two weeks! 100% recommended this product to anyone and everyone who is thinking of purchasing it!!!

I have been using this product for a week and loving it. I have not had any issues with pilling, was actually surprised to see some comments about that. I love that it leave a really nice glow to the skin and a bit of a tacky feeling to it. I almost feel I can use this as a primer under my makeup.

First and foremost, I love the texture of this sunscreen! I have oily and acne-prone skin so was worried it would be thick and greasy like other sunscreens I’ve tried but it is not. It is very lightweight and absorbs nicely into the skin. After application, your skin is left with a beautiful glow! Not too greasy or heavy-feeling on the skin either, just looks really dewy and makes my skin feel moisturized. I’ve used this sunscreen under makeup and I have not experienced any pilling or other adverse affects. Also, it has not seemed to clog my pores which is incredible but I make sure to thoroughly remove it at the end of the day. A great daily sunscreen that is perfect to protect your skin in the summer and all year round!

I have over 10+ sunscreens opened right now but I couldn’t resist trying Glow Recipe’s first sunscreenThings I enjoyed: scent, glow, milkiness, effectivenessThings I didn’t enjoy: blend, a little stickyWith this said, it’s important to note that mineral sunscreens are never as comfortable as chemical sunscreens. I like that this has SPF 50, gives a radiant glow, and a healthy appearance. However, it is not compatible with all skincare as it has pilled in several occasions.
review_title: Fantastic SPF if it works with your skincare

review_text: i wasn’t expecting too much from this product but it is my new favorite sunscreen! it smells good, not too beach sunscreeny, and makes my skin look super dewy and fresh, it surprised me it is very moisturizing!

I had such high hopes for this because I love the brand but I’m so disappointed! It pills really badly no matter what I’ve tried. I even tried just putting on bare skin with no product underneath and it still pilled. It’s especially disappointing because the finish is really nice before it starts pilling.
Love this! Wouldn’t recommend for makeup days but perfect for clean skin, no makeup days! Haven’t had any pilling like some people on here have mentioned.

I was a bit skeptical about using this product since a SPF product and I am of melanin complexion. It is, however, my first Glow Recipe product and I was excited about that. This product did have my skin feeling moisturized and soft the entire day. I didn’t have any issues with feeling greasy and it didn’t leave a white cast like most sunscreens do on my skintone. However, it did get caught in my eyebrows and would show up there. The texture was nice and smooth and I didn’t have problem with blending it into my skin. But it does have a watermelon scent if you are too keen on that. It didn’t bother me, but it did throw me off at first. I have not seen any real changes in my skin or the texture. But I have been using it everyday since receiving it. I can say that I like it. Hopefully, they’ll come out with an unscented one though.

My new go to sunscreen- I’m obsessed with the watermelon scent!! It wasn’t sticky at all and felt very hydrating throughout the day. It’s also SPF 50 which is great. Would highly recommend trying this out!

This sunscreen that was free from Glow Recipe is my new holy grail!! It leaves zero whitecast, smells so lovely, and feels wonderful. I also love that it’s a higher SPF. Also reapplies really well over makeup. Great product!

The tube is a great size with the amount of product you get! There is a slight watermelon smell to the product, but has an underlying watermelon smell. It felt light in my skin, and held up well under makeup! It was not sticky at all!

I love this face SPF lotion. It doesn’t have your typical sunscreen white cast or greasy feel to it, and it applies really smoothly under my makeup. It did not feel greasy at all and smells super good. It kept my skin protected when I went to the beach and it did not break me out which is a win because my skin is sensitive and breaks out easy.

I have to admit I am a sucker for packaging. This packaging caught my eye immediately. I received this complimentary to try and I was so excited. I actually really liked this! It’s hard to find a good SPF that smells nice and goes on nicely. I would definitely recommend this product to try.

So sad. I love all their products I’ve tried so I was so excited for this and it pilled so bad. I tried to make it work using their tips, patting it in, letting all my products absorb first, even using it without any other products and it just wouldn’t absorb! Opt for supergoop instead, this spf is so hard to work with.

I am so in love with this SPF!  I am obsessed with the glow that my skin has whenever I wear it.  It’s so hydrating and natural looking on my skin and it wears beautifully alone and underneath makeup as well

After having tried this amazing sunscreen by Glow Recipe, I recommend it for daily use.  It makes my skin feel smooth and refreshed for most of the day. It has a creamy light texture and rubs into my skin nicely without leaving a sticky or flakey residue. I enjoy the light smell and love that it provides an ample amount of sun protection (SPF 50). I will be using this product regularly.

I love this product how ever it did leave a light white case after applying. I’m on the darker complication so it’s more noticeable on my type of skin tone. Otherwise great product. It feels and smells amazing

Okay I seriously love this sunscreen. I think the best part about this sunscreen is that it’s more like translucent rather than white. Sometimes sunscreen will leave my face looking white (which who wants that lol) and this one doesn’t do it at ALL. It is so beautiful and gives your skin a nice glow. I will definitely be mixing this in with my moisturizer. It also smells amazing - like watermelon of course! So happy!!!!!!!!

I’m really enjoying this sunscreen. It has such a light and lovely scent. It’s thicker than a moisturizer but not nearly as thick as your everyday sunscreen. I find myself reaching for this as if it were a moisturizer. This is going to be a staple in my summertime routine if not year round.

Does peel and have a slight white cast. I don’t recommend using this with other serums. I applied my Hyaluronic plum serum and it made the sunscreen peel over my makeup. I wanted to love it but made my skin feel dry.
review_title: not for me-peels with other products

review_text: I honestly really love this product on my dry sensitive skin. I’ve been using it for about a week and a half now and have noticed a difference in my scarring. I haven’t been a frequent user of sunscreen in the past because I can’t get over the smell but I love this one. It’s really light weight and sits perfectly under my makeup. It’s really dewy and makes my skin look so glowy under my makeup. It’s honestly my favorite sunscreen I’ve ever tried and I think I’ll finally consistently be using sunscreen in my every day routine. Glow recipe NEVER misses!

This product is absolutely amazing! The event was so light it wasn’t too much. It also felt so soft on my skin with zero tacky residue like other spf I have tried in the past. Definitely a new favorite of mine.

So I have used 2 other products from glow recipe and love them and I have repurchase them. Over all I love their products.  I have been using this SPF now for 2 weeks. It gives you amazing glow and your skin is so hydrated. Doesn’t leave a white cast. And it’s not oily if you have oily skin. My skin feels and looks so soft I love it. I like the consistency, its light weight and watery like so it absorbes into the skin good. The only CON is that it peels with a lot of other products. I have layered this on 3 other products and it peels. I have layered on 2 and it peels. I have waited about 5-6 mins after applying other products to put it on, and it peels. So it’s either I wear it alone. Or just put on my vitamin C serum and that’s it.  And I have to pat it onto my skin, not rubbing because it start to peel. Other then the peeling I really love the glow and the hydration. Has a light watermelon scent that I absolutely love.
review_title: Amazing glow, but peels with other products

review_text: Such a refreshing sunscreen! I love the smell as with all there other products! Perfect for everyday wear! Great base for makeup and provides a good amount of protection as well! The niacinimide helps with a dewy look!

I am so disappointed. I wanted to love this. Scented products don’t bother me and I love Glow Recipe’s entire watermelon line, so I was so excited to get this and sure I’d love it (I even tossed the box right away). It does have that watermelon scent but it also smells like drugstore sunscreen. Not necessarily a bad thing but just an observation. The real problem here is the pilling. I cannot get this stuff to lay down smooth on me if my life depended on it. I’ve tried everything. I will be returning it unfortunately.

The glow recipe sunscreen is my new go to. It smells absolutely amazing and I LOVE that it is reef safe! This sunscreen is so lightweight and doesn’t leave my skin feeling greasy. I can easily put make up over it without feeling like it changes my application.  Even when I wear it alone it leaves my skin feeling hydrated and gives it a beautiful healthy summery glow without the fear of clogged pores. Looking forward to wearing this one all summer long!

The texture of this is perfect, and goes on so easily! Also great that you don’t have to use a lot of it to get full coverage so the bottle will last a while. Did not have issues when sweating that it ran into my eyes which is a definite plus! Smells like classic sunscreen, was hoping for a more watermelon scent but I still love it!

This makes your skin feel amazing, it’s very moisturizing & very hydrating. My skin looks alil dewy after I apply it but it would make a great base for under your makeup. I love how it doesn’t dry out and leave a white cast on your face like most spf do. This product is a must!

So tired of these fake reviews. It’s nothing like all these five star reviews from incentivized “influencers”. Sephora needs to stop. I have no problem returning every single product with exaggerated reviews. There are about 25 drugstore spfs that perform better than this.

This product was sent to me from Glow Recipe to review. I have tried tons of sunscreens in my life and have never had one work so horribly on me. I did my skincare as I normally would and as soon as I applied the sunscreen, it pilled. I did try it with a heavy moisturizer underneath and that helped a lot. However, I don’t always want to wear a heavy moisturizer during the day. This sunscreen has a light watermelon scent that goes away after a few minutes. However, if you are sensitive to scent, you might want to skip this one.

Love the way it leaves my skin. Some SPFs are too heavy but this one is lightweight and my skin feels hydrated. I can’t wait to use it daily in the spring. I haven’t tested it under makeup yet but alone it feels really nice!
review_title: Love the way it leaves my skin.

review_text: I was super excited for this product at first, but it pills really badly, and I unfortunately had an allergic reaction to it, so I had to return it and exchange for another mineral sunscreen. Aside from the allergic reaction, my main beef was the pilling and the price for what you actually get. It was a lot smaller than I had expected, which is a bit of a letdown considering the price.  Overall, wanted to like the product, was excited for the product, but very disappointed.  Packaging was cute though.

I love everything about this product from the packaging, the texture, to the result. The packaging is simple and cute. The smooth texture makes a good base for makeup and I really like how glowy it makes my skin look. The scent is not too overwhelming and I have no problem using this on sensitive skin. I would totally recommend to anyone!

This smells so good! I was a little worried my face would smell like a Jolly Rancher all day lol but the scent is light and does not last. This product is easily blendable and does not leave a white cast on your face. It’s hydrating and lightweight, and it definitely gives you a glow!! If you prefer a matte, airbrushed look, this product may not be for you. My skin looks dewy and refreshed after using this spf.

My skin has never felt softer or more enhanced. After applying the product I immediately had a rejuvenated feeling that lasted for hours. All day long my skin felt soft, hydrated, & illuminated a glow look. This is a natural look that I haven’t seen in a long time. The product is soft, creamy & lightweight. The product is incredibly blendable and easy to apply to the skin either with my skincare brush or my fingers. I was even more excited about the formula being non-greasy. Rather than leaving my skin feeling heavy and weighed down with an oily or greasy feel, I was left with soft touchable skin that was hydrated all day long. I cannot wait to continue using this product to see what my skin is like in weeks to come.

I loved the new Glow Recipe sunscreen. This product is so lightweight and extremely easy to use! I have very dry skin and this was the perfect texture without making me feel greasy or causing breakouts. I use this with my moisturizer and my skin has never felt so good! I highly recommend this product for the upcoming spring/summer!

I love the uniqueness of the watermelon scent when applying. It’s a very light scent. It applied easily and it’s actually lighter than most SPF creams. I wear it whenever I go hiking. Fortunately for an every day spf I haven’t used it as much because it makes my combination oily skin greasy through the day. I would love this in a non greasy formula. That would be so awesome! Still great option for the outdoors :)

I have sensitive skin, so finding a sunscreen that doesn’t break me out has been hard but I think I finally found it!
