review_title: smells great but a pass for me

review_text: This makes me look so glowy! I tried it with my regular face cream (clinique gel & also with ceramidin) and no pills. I also tried it alone and it was nice. It smells good and I love how my skin looks!!! I have olive skin and it leaves no white cast and doesnt get weird around edges of face. Did not try with makeup.

I have always loved the Glow recipe products I’ve tried. Sadly, This was a miss for me. I have extremely dry skin and this pills a lot for me. While the packaging, dispenser and feel of the product is great, it does not stay on for long.

I really enjoyed using glowrecipe broad spectrum spf 50 lotion.  It is so good.  Yo get glowy, hydrated and protected skin, It blends so easily into the skin  and no white cast.  Works well on mature skin and it gives it that hydration boost.it can be worn alone or under makeup.  Has great ingredients too!  Ive been using this product daily & you can see it on my bare skin on instagram. Love it !

I normally react to and break out from chemical sunscreens on my face. I have to be diligent about taking this one off (if I just use micellar water, it’s not enough, for instance) but as long as I do, it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin. In that regard it’s the best chemical sunscreen for the face that I’ve ever used.I do think this could possibly give a white cast, but I’m so pale that tinted sunscreens are often visibly dark on me, so you can’t really tell on my skin. It gives a beautiful glow but doesn’t slide around like crazy either. I do find that it sometimes pills when combined with some of my other products, but it’s a small price to pay for a sunscreen with a formula that wears so elegantly. It has replaced all my other facial sunscreens.

Lightweight! Doesn’t leave a white cast and very moisturizing! I use it in the mornings and before my makeup routine and it has been wonderful. The packaging is so cute and it doesn’t have a sunscreen type smell. Love it!

I am loving this sunscreen! It is light and not very oily/greasy. It is blendable and doesn’t flake off when I put my make up over it. The packaging is cute too which is always a plus. For reference I have combination skin with semi sensitive skin. PS I LOVE THAT IT HAS Niacinamide in it!!!

Pros: Absorbs well, light scent, glow is a sheen.Cons: Pills, pills, and pills so more! I can’t wear this during the summer because it pulled on freshly washed skin, with and without moisturizer. Only time it didn’t pill was over oil, which makes it less wearable (for me) during the summer months and probably decreases the effectiveness of the chemical sunscreen. I also have brown skin and found that it had a mild white cast that improved with time. I’ve only seen a few reviews mention these issues. I’ve tried MANY different sunscreens and this one feels good on, looks OK on, has pretty packaging, but takes too much work to get right. Not sure how there are so many raving reviews. I returned it.

I love GR products so I thought I’d give this one a shot. The product texture is nice and creamy but I have a hard time blending it in. Since it’s a zinc oxide product it does leave a slight white cast on my face. I only wear this product if I’m not leaving the house or not taking a client call (I work from home). It’s lightweight and not greasy but just not my favorite sunscreen. I AM excited to see if it helps even out my skin tone in a few weeks. I’m using it in combination with the GR vitamin C cream too!

Product was free, good and it provided a shine and a glow to my skin. Not a bad sunscreen, I have others that are better but not sure if I would purchase again. Still a good average sunscreen though just reapply throughout the day.

So far I really like this sunscreen, it’s very creamy and lightweight. It does take awhile for me to rub it in to blend nicely. It has a very light watermelon smell when you first apply it but the smell does not linger, nor is it overpowering. Overall, great product for me.

I wanted to love this so bad! I love the glow recipe products but unfortunately this peeled for me just like everyone else. I will admit it does leave a great glow but I can’t wear this under makeup because of the peeling. Don’t know if I would repurchase but I will definitely use it up for the days I don’t wear makeup.

So far I really love this product! I usually do not like scented products at all, but for some reason I really don’t mind Glow Recipe’s scents and they don’t irritate my skin. I love Niacinimide in my skincare, it has literally saved my skin in the past so I always look for it in new products. I’ve been seeing a lot of Tik Tok reviews that the product pills, but I haven’t had that problem as I use a small amount at a time to build up. I think it also just depends on what products you use underneath! The brand really did a great job with this product, as usual. Also, the packaging is so cute! Killed it again!

This is such a luxurious, lightweight sunscreen! It comes out of the tube more liquid that most sunscreens, but I don’t mind. Upon application, it feels like a serum and absorbs into my skin really quickly. My skin felt slightly tacky, but not sticky. I had no white cast and I liked that my skin didn’t have that shiny look that most sunscreens leave. My face just looked and felt hydrated! It also sat beautifully under my makeup. My only drawback was that this sunscreen smelled slightly “chemically”, but the smell dissipated after awhile. I’m definitely going to recommend this to my sister.

If you love a glowy look, you’ll love this sunscreen! It has a lightweight texture that initially sits on top of the skin but it sinks in after a few minutes and feels weightless. I really like the light watermelon scent and found it gentle on my skin. I didn’t have issues with pilling unless I used a very thick moisturizer underneath (and didn’t give it time to sink in). A little pricey but the glow is so pretty!

I loved the scent and the lightweight formula. However, it pills up really badly, even on bare skin. I immediately had little white flakes pill up on my face and made it look like my skin was peeling off. It also stings my face a little, although it’s fairly mild and goes away after a few minutes. I will definitely be returning as this is not worth the money.

I usually love anything Glow Recipe comes out with, but this is not it. It pills incredibly underneath the makeup and it also pills when reapplying this sunscreen during the day on clean skin. I tried switching up my skincare products, but nothing works. I really, really wanted to like it.

Product was great. Smelled nice and texture was perfect. I love the packaging as well. Would definitely recommend to any of my family and friends in the future and look forward to trying the brands other products.

I usually love Glow Recipe products and have several on my shelf, but this is not it for me. Pills terribly and is way less blendable and more streaky than many other hybrid sunscreens I’ve used. It also has some sort of menthol ingredient that gives that cooling sensation which I absolutely despise on my face.  It had a nice light watermelon scent, which is about the onlyRedeeming quality for me.

What I liked about this SPF is it has niacinamide in the main ingredients.But it leaves this glowy and oily finish on my skin that I don’t like,  besides I have oily skin.If you don t have the tolerance to niacinamide it is not for you, because it can cause dry patches in your skin

I love this brand but the product was terrible. I tested it for a week trying different moisturizers and foundations with it, different setting times, etc. It always pilled on me and left my face looking dry and blah. NOT glowy. Also pricey for little amount of product, but would pay it if the wear was nice. Disappointed.

I really wanted to love this product like I usually do when it comes to Glow Recipe products, but this product was incredibly underwhelming. It leaves an oily residue and pills when used with make up. The smell is nice, but for the price, I am not a fan and would most likely not purchase this.

Disclaimer: I paid for this product. Scent: Scents tend to make me itchy but this scent was very mild- I just would like to know what ingredients entail “fragrance.”  It dissipates quickly. Pilling: I found that it pills mildly with products underneath that do not moisturize enough, could make flakes worse.Texture/Spread/Finish: It’s harder to spread if you have dryer skin or use products with cetyl alcohol (a wax alcohol). The dew barely lasted and my skin looked dry as the day went. Additionally the dew is best for smooth and young skin as it highlights wrinkles and texture. I wish that w/ dewy products, formulators took fine lines and skin texture into consideration. 30+ adults can be profitable clients too. Also, please consider men use skincare too.  Eyes: Unfortunately yes, it irritated my eyes often! I was surprised.  I found this product worked best with hydrated skin using humectant, Squalane (helps spreadability), moisturizer (lock it all in), and some sort of texture smoothing ingredient that wont pill. For the texturizer I use a cheap Cetaphil oil-free moisturizer with SPF 30. I find this makes me look smoother, glowy, and the effects last sooooo much longer!! It also spreads more effectively.  GR please take notice if this mix. Cost: OVER PRICED. Niacinamide is a cheap ingredient!! The dew is short and must re-apply. No sweat / water resistance claims so limited use. To make it work it requires more products so more costs. 1.7 Oz is too little SPF usage and price point. GR, .3 Oz would have still left you with a high profit margin! This should be at least 2.5 ounces.  What makes me want to wear sunscreen everyday? Not breaking my wallet every time I reapply. Ever consider that? I still recommend others give it a try though.

This sunscreen could’ve been so great. Like others have said, it pills really badly. It took off every bit of skin care I had on. I even waited 15 minutes between applying skincare and the sunscreen. It also isn’t as hydrating as I expected. Don’t waste your money.

This is a great sunscreen! Super lightweight. Love the glow recipe watermelon scent. You can’t go wrong with adding this to your routine. No white cast - perfect to put on underneath your makeup! Everything glow recipe does is just amazing.

Unfortunately I had to return this. I was so excited when I saw GR was coming out with a sunscreen and truly thought it would be great but, it did pill on me a bit and I let every layer of my skincare routine absorb. Also I really didn’t like the finish, it’s very float which is great but it also looks too oily for my preference. I do hope GR will take in to account the reviews and come out with a different sunscreen in the future though. A mineral avocado one perhaps?!?

I’m so sad that this product did not perform well as I love so many Glow Recipe products! This spf pilled so badly every time I wore it. I wore it 5 different times and changed up the application process each time and found that the only time it didn’t pill was when I applied it to bare skin without other skincare products. Realistically, I have a solid skincare routine so I shouldn’t have to change it up in order to make a product work. I listened to their tips and tricks to apply it and still couldn’t make it work :/ Definitely going to be returning

I love this product for daily SPF! It has a creamy, smooth texture, and glides on easily, without being tacky or sticky at all. It is lightweight, and not greasy like so many sun protectants can be. It wears well under makeup and gives a subtle glow without being heavy! I’ve attached a photo of it on my bare skin before applying makeup. Love it!
Pilled like crazy with only a serum and moisturizer.

I love everything about this product except I find that the only thing that sits well on top of it is the dew drops. I’m a regular makeup wearer with dry skin (due to tretinoin applied at night), and would love GR to release a product that works as a dedicated makeup primer or possibly even a glowy cc cream for us makeup users. I know this would delve into the makeup arena, but come on, we’re all secretly hoping for some naturally derived, glowy, color corrected skin with sun protection (am I right y’all?)!

I was gifted this product from Glow Recipe! Although I was a little skeptical because I had already seen some reviews of the formula, I was pleasantly surprised that it worked great for my skin! I know some people experienced a little bit of pilling--but that was not the case for me! The sunscreen wore beautifully under my makeup all day.
review_title: Hydrating sunscreen with no white cast!

review_text: i wanted to like it, but it’s… just fine. i think if you use just a little bit (ie < two fingers!!), it settles in nicely, and it definitely doesn’t leave a white cast. however, it’s important to use the right amount; when i do, it pills like CRAZY. also has a weird cooking effect on the skin, and i’m personally not a fan of the watermelon scent here. it’s definitely hydrating and i do see a bit of a blurring effect, and it’s not greasy which is really nice — when it’s not pilling up, the skin feel isn’t bad. i think it’s okay, and i’ll be finishing the product, but i will not be repurchasing.

I struggle with this sunscreen. I wanted to love it, but I don’t think it’s for my dry skin. It has a tendency to pill especially with any dry spots. I love the packaging. It has an initial watermelon smell & then smells like typical sunscreen. I’d give it a 3.5/5.

I was so excited to try this, because I love niacinamide. I love their line of watermelon glow products, and this is the perfect addition. It gives your skin a gorgeous glow, and makeup layers flawlessly on top. I also love how lightweight and easy to blend it is. It doesn’t feel greasy or heavy, like sunscreens sometimes do.Throughout the day I noticed that it kept my skin feeling hydrated, which is so cool that a sunscreen has that type of benefit. It doesn’t have a white cast which is very important.I also stopped using my regular niacinamide to see if this product evened my skin or lightened any scarring, and it did! It definitely has the skincare benefits that niacinamide usually does.It’s my new favorite product right now, highly recommended!

So I love Glow Recipe products so I was very excited when they launched this, and I want to love it so badly, but it’s a really difficult product to work with. it’s difficult just to apply this product without having it pill, and it’s been basically impossible to wear this under makeup because it just pills and makes my dry skin more dry. Also, I’m Italian so I’m white but I have olive skin, and ive had an issue with this leaving a white cast over my skin when it’s pilling bad. I love how glowy it makes my skin, but it’s just really hard to work with, and I honestly wouldn’t recommend it.
review_title: I love Glow Recipe, but this is a pass.

review_text: This sunscreen is literal perfection and the fact that it doesn’t leave a white cast is just cherry on top fora WOC like myself. It’s very light weight and absorbs within couple of minutes and leave a very natural dewy finish. I’ve been trying it out for 2weeks now and no breakouts which is huge for my sensitive skin. I’m sold and highly recommend this sunscreen!
review_title: Approved by a WOC with acne-prone skin

review_text: I got a sample of this with my recent Sephora order. I tried it this morning and it immediately pilled upon application. I’m glad I didn’t splurge and buy the big size as was thinking I would. I want to love glow recipe but everything I’ve tried from them has been a miss.

Bought this due to all the hype. Like other reviewers, this pills very badly even without make up over it.  Tried it three days in a row, with sufficient dry time with my skincare and it always pilled. Was not hydrating enough for me and also left a white cast.  Will be returning.

I love this sunscreen! I am so picky about sunscreen. This one doesn’t leave any strange textures or white casts, and it actually improves the look of my skin. I’ve worn it alone and under makeup, and it worked great either way!
This did not pill on me! I was kind of skeptical but it was wonderful on my skin, left me smooth and glowy. Smells just like their watermelon line, its amazing.

I’ve only every written “glow“ing reviews for all of GR’s products, but not all products within a line will be perfect and this one falls short.  I received a sample of the new sunscreen for an incentivized review with much excitement, but only to find this product “pilled“ upon every application attempt.  I tried different skincare products, GR specific products, waiting for each layer to completely dry, and even on clean bare skin with no success.  I’ve been very puzzled by the conflicting reviews and wonder if there are issues between production batches.  I also noticed in video promotions and with other influencers’ videos, they do not spend much time rubbing in the product which makes me question effective application and true honest reviews (are people hiding the pilling issue?).  I also saw the GR video promotion of reapplying sunscreen by lighting tapping a beauty blender...this is concerning to see since this will add very little protection.  Even the regular promo videos use very little product.  This is misleading to consumers about proper sunscreen use and protection to prevent skin cancer....just overall disappointed.  I will continue to buy my favorite products (Blueberry cleanser, Papaya balm, Pink Juice and Plum moisturizer, mist, and toner) and try new ones in the future.  I’ve been a long time fan of the company back to the K-beauty curation days, but I feel like they are missing the mark big-time on this one.  I hope they can take this feedback and help improve their product and information around sunscreen application.

NEW STAPLE PRODUCT! After using this product my skin is super glowy and moisturized (it also leaves a beautiful sheen!).  I’ve noticed my  skin looking more supple and glowy throughout the day.  Blends easily with it’s cc cream like consistency. I have oily skin and this product doesn’t make me look oily at all. You need to try this!
review_title: ALTHOUGH IT’S A NEW PRODUCT IT’S A STAPLE!

review_text: I’ve been using it for a while and on the first try I squeezed a lot so it started to peel but on next use I used a pea size for cheeks, chin and forehead and it blended better. No peopling. Reapplied after 2hrs since I was in the sun a lot if not I’m good for the day. Overall, it’s been good.

Omggg I love how this feels like a moisturizer but has spf in it!! Definitely recommend especially now with the sun all out. Was aftraid it would smell too strong but NOPE smells yummy and fresh not overwhelming

I thoroughly enjoyed this product and feel like it really helped my skin. I would definitely purchase this again and recommend it to everyone else as well. I have yet to see a product that compares to this.

A gorgeous sunscreen! It has a lightweight texture and it absorbs well leaving a healthy finish that’s not greasy or overly matte. Makeup goes well over this product. It has a light fruity scent that masks typical sunscreen smell. It does leave a little bit of whitish residue that might be problematic for darker complexions. All in all, a good product

As an acne prone/ combination skin person, I am always hesitant to try new sunscreens as almost all of them have always broken me out. However, I have been quite diliigent with this one and I like the results of it. This sunscreen has a very light and milky (not too runny) of a texture. On the skin, it feels very lightweight and it is non- greasy and blended pretty well into my skin. I used it with my CeraVe PM moisturizer and Azelaic acid. Personally, I have had no issues with the sunscreen piling when used alone but I did see some piling under my makeup. After using the sunscreen, my skin has felt hydrated for most of the day although you do have to reapply it a couple of times. As the name claims, this sunscreen is glowy and will give you the glow! In addition to that, the spf has a very faint fragrance but it is definitely not as strong of a smell. Overall, I really liked the sunscreen but I think for others, it can be a hit or miss depending on their skin and it’s needs.

Absolutely love this sunscreen!! I’m super super picky when it comes to sunscreen and this one is basically perfect! It’s thin, blends so easily, leaves no color/cast on the skin, doesn’t peel up with other makeup, and it gives me a little bit of a glow. Also, it doesn’t make me oily which I find to be so crazy because I’ve only found 2-3 sunscreens that do the same! If you have thought about trying and are on the fence, I would say go for it because there is a good possibility that this will be your new fav! I do wish a little bit more product came in the tube though!

It’s everything I’ve been looking for in a sunscreen…It’s so lightweight, it absorbs quickly, non greasy. Plus I love that has subtle watermelon scented. I’m sold on  niacinamide formula, and it doesn’t leave a white cast. Plus It’s non-sticky. I’ve combination skin, It’s hard for me to find a sunscreen that doesn’t breakout my skin.It leaves my face with a natural glow. It works amazingly on my combination skin!
review_title: It leaves my face with a natural glow!

review_text: I had so much hope for this sunscreen, I love the texture, how light weight, and how the product feels because it reminds me a bit of an over favorite sunscreen which was discontinued years ago. But as a person who has facial hair I find it very hard to find sunscreens that work with my beard/ facial hair. On days and weeks where I’m not clean shaven, pilling happens, which I absolutely hate when I look for in a sunscreen. But on the couple days my face is cleanly shaven the product applies and sinks in well to the skin without pilling. I gave it 3 stars cause it’s great without facial hair, but not so great when I have it.

This is such a great lightweight product that sinks into the skin. It doesn’t leave a white cast. I am thrilled with its performance. It’s becoming one of my favorite sunscreens that I own, truly impressed.

This product has beautiful packaging but that is about it. The sunscreen does not mix well with other skincare products and balls up even if I wait over an hour between applying my moisturizer and this sunscreen. I also have very fair skin and this sunscreen needs to be rubbed in really well or it will leave a white cast. I will be returning it.

I had high hopes on this sunscreen but just what happened to other people happened to me as well, the pilling. I let my skincare dry correctly before applying the spf but still didn’t work. Maybe it works for other people but it didn’t for me.

Hands down this is the best sunscreen I have ever used. I also love the fact that I don’t have a white cast after you use it. Leaves my skin feeling silky without feeling greasy. It’s also great on my sensitive skin.This product has my face looking radiant, fresh and youthful. Not sure what I was doing with my life prior to these to products. This instantly improves my complexion- skin looks firmer and smoother. I have bought it 2x in a row. It is moisturizing without feeling heavy. I love it!

Gifted by Glow Recipe. This SPF is, in my opinion really nice. The hybrid chemical/mineral filters make the formula blend a lot more easily than exclusively mineral formulas and I personally found application to be easy and fuss-free. I have only worn this without makeup over it so far, and so far, no pilling for me. I like it. I don’t love the fragrance and that’s why I’m deducting a star.

So I recieved a free deluxe sample and I have used it and even cut it open to get it all out. I struggle with a spf some I don’t like the feel. My fav is the 111 skin but that stuff is so pricey. This will be first purchase from a sample I’ve tried. I love this spf, it feels good on skin, makes you a bit glowy and obsorbs well! A must try

This product has changed the sunscreen game for me. I’m so glad I found it. It doesn’t feel thick or oily like most sunscreens, so it doesn’t make my skin feel cakey. It’s def a more liquid formula which I love. Also it smells aaaamazing!

Omg wow I can definitely keep checking that this is one of my favorite skin care brands ,I have been using this product for a few days and I promise you that the changes are very noticeable and my skin is very healthy, I highly recommend it

I really wanted to like this because I love everything else I have from this brand. So it didn’t pill for real, just a little bit of flaking off my nose + around my mouth. I had to keep trying to apply it to these areas :( I also felt that it never sunk into my skin, but was just hanging out on top. I can handle a little bit of a tacky feeling, but this was straight up sticky. It was sticky on my hands and my face felt sticky while - and after - applying it. It does kinda smell like sunscreen but that goes away super quick. It didn’t leave a white cast, gave me a cute glow, and made my pores less noticeable. So that’s why it gets three stars, but I will be returning/exchanging it bc I can’t deal with the stickiness.

Okay! I loved this products. I have seen other reviews about it peeling and I did not experience that. I loved the packaging, that it is a higher SPF and that it makes you glow! Will 100 percent repurchase! I low their products and I’m excited to have this in my daily routine!

I absolutely love this watermelon glow Niacinamide sunscreen. It has a very lightweight consistency that leaves the skin looking hydrated and glowy as well. This is not only spf 50 but it’s also jam packed with all types of good ingredients for the skin.

This is really nice with no white cast. It has a slight smell of watermelon and a stronger smell of sunscreen. It pills a tiny bit probably because of the niacinimide but after the initial peel, it still nicely on the skin and under make up.

This product has greatly improved the appearance of my face. It is very soft to the touch, fresh, light, spreads like butter and absorbs wonderfully. I use it every day and it is part of my beauty routine

Absolutely loving this sunscreen! I’m a big fan of the Watermelon Glow Drops so I had high hopes for this sunscreen! It did not disappoint. Smells amazing and feels so good on the skin. Highly recommend!

I have found one of the best clean sunscreens! This gives a gorgeous GLOW! I used on a beach day and it was so lightweight and felt hydrating. Ive also used it under makeup and my makeup layed well on top of it. Its a cute bottle thats perfect for everyday to carry with you so you can reapply throughout the day!

Absolutely fell in love with this sunscreen! It’s thin and glides on so well. Leaves zero white cast and feels light on my combo skin! It also has 50 SPF which is so great!! I love how it looks on my skin :)

This Product is so nice!!! It makes my skin feel so soft while also being protected! The only thing that I don’t like is it leaves a slight white cast , not a lot tho!! Easily blend-able. I wore this under makeup and it made my makeup go on so much smoother. It does a great job with keeping me hydrated! I love how it makes my skin glow, I got so many compliments when I didn’t wear makeup . The texture is very smooth and not bumpy like others I have tried. I would say it is lightweight, but it’s also greasy as well.

This glow recipe sunscreen is very good. Spf 50 is great for my everyday application and it leaves my face absolutely glowing. It feels like it has protected my skin well and the added niacinamide is a bonus.

This sunscreen is fantastic! In my opinion, it only smells a little bit like watermelon with a very strong sunscreen smell to it, but I don’t mind much. It is very lightweight & makes my skin super glowy and gorgeous after application! I also LOVE that it’s a high SPF and gives my skin amazing protection plus hydration.

If only all moisturizers came with SPF 50! I adore this product and all its ingredients… niacinamide evens out my skin tone while HA hydrates and plumps. Not heavy or greasy. This is similar to Dermalogica Dynamic skin recovery but almost half the price. I have not tried under makeup yet so I’m not sure how well it would fit into your full makeup routine but this is a must for summer days out by the pool.

Unfortunately, after a few uses, I have decided to return this. I feel this formulation was likely rushed and is a miss for Glow Recipe.The smell is unpleasant. There’s a light watermelon scent mixed with a strong chemical sunscreen odor, and something about the two just don’t go together and it smells sour and just off. Thankfully, the scent fades quickly. Each time I used this, I used it over my standard skincare routine of Vitamin C, Glow Recipe Avocado serum, and Glow Recipe Plum Plump moisturizer.My biggest gripe with this sunscreen is that it looks GODAWFUL under makeup. It causes pilling sometimes, and also sometimes causes my pores to look full of white gunk. The last time I used it, it was sitting on top of my skin in weird white patches, and when I tried to apply makeup over it, it was streaky and just awful. So awful that I had to wash it all off my face and start new, which I have never had to do.There are so many other sunscreens on the market that are not as expensive, not fragranced, and won’t cause issues under makeup. Glow Recipe missed the bar with this one.

This is probably one of the best sunscreens I have used. It was sooo moisturizing and it smelled amazing! The best part of this sunscreen is that it does not leave a white cast on melanin skin. Another pro about this product is that it sits very well underneath my foundation without being too cakey or greasy like some other sunscreens. I would definitely recommend!
review_title: Not greasy and doesn’t leave a white cast

review_text: So silky and smooth! Not sticky or greasy after it’s set up, and layers over other products fairly well. It’s a little tingly and feels cooling on the face and I love it. I don’t feel like I look greasy, even over my acne/ oily areas, it doesn’t even burn my acne spots! The glow this gives just looks like healthy happy skin, and I think this’ll be my favourite sunscreen for years to come!!It does ball up when you try rub it in, but I usually blend in my SPF with my fingertips, I just thought I’d test it to see if that’s why people were having issues.

Overall, I think the sunscreen is light-to-medium in terms of thickness on my face and it does have a bit of a sunscreen smell to it. I don’t smell any watermelon, but the sunscreen smell isn’t too overpowering. Heads up, make sure to pat it into your skin AFTER your skin care routine is done! That will help it not look so white on your skin and reduce it from mixing with your skin care
This pills. I usually love this brand, so I had high hopes. On top of the pulling, it makes my skin feel dry. The texture itself felt like it would be drying.
I have combo skin but I found that this doesn’t make me look greasy like many other sunscreens. The watermelon scent is very light, it gives my skin a healthy glow. I will definitely buy this again!

I like the consistency of the sunscreen, I have combination/dry skin and it had a glowy finish. I liked the shine it left on my skin, but bare in mind, it does take a few mins to sink in. It leaves a slight white cast initially but it disappears after 15 mins. It does have that weird watermelon sunscreen smell but it wasn’t too overpowering imo and it does fade after a while. It doesn’t peel at all for me so yay! Lastly, this DOES NOT pass the eye sting test so beware of your eyes when applying. Overall, I think it’s a good sunscreen. It’s not exceptional, but it’s good enough for me to keep using it and finish it up. I guess I’m slightly disappointed because I was excited to try it and had high hopes, but it’s just okay.

I have been using this product for about two weeks and I’m loving it now, but I’ve learned that there are some tricks to making it work well!The first time I used this sunscreen, I tried to use it like I would any other sunscreen: I grabbed a huge gob of it and tried to rub it in on top of my moisturizer until it looked clear. That turned out to be a bad idea, the product pilled everywhere and I think most of it ended up off of my face rather than on my face. I was convinced I hated it despite my love of the other products in the glow recipe watermelon line.On day two, I tried to allow my moisturizer (a thin lotion) a little time to sink in and dry before applying the sunscreen. That helped, but I still got some pilling.After a couple of weeks of troubleshooting, I’ve learned to follow these steps:1. Use a thick moisturizer that evens the skin surface. I’ve been using the Rich B**** moisturizer from Freck for this, but I’m sure the gel formula of the pink juice from glow recipe would also work!2. Apply the full amount of sunscreen you need and spread it across your face, then stop touching it. Don’t rub until it looks clear. It will look clear as it soaks in. This step helps to get an even coat and eliminate pulling!3. Leave the sunscreen undisturbed on your face for at least 30 minutes before applying any makeup over it to avoid pilling.I know that these steps sound tedious, but they are so worth it! My skin was having a really dry seasonal transition this year, and it has been looking so glowy and fresh since using this product!

It’s pretty good - leaves minimal white cast for me. I find that it dries very past so I have to be quick or there might be slight pilling. I use it on no make up days to get a little bit of a glow.

I use so many of the Glow Recipe products and was hoping this would come thru like the Dew Drops, Toner and Hyaluronic Moisturizer. This is absolute garbage though. I’m always buying new facial SPFs thru here or snag them when they’re offered in the promos or reward bazaar. This one pills so badly and also leaves a terrible white cast. I have a daily morning and nighttime skincare routine as well to maintain the best hydration for my face as well so I doubt it’s anything I did that would have caused this product to flake off my skin the way it did. Do not bother with this.

Unfortunately, she’s not doing what she was supposed to have done. I love Glow Recipe but unfortunately this is jus not it. The scent is overwhelming & it burns. I get some pilling as well which is annoying in general, but makes it even worse under makeup. The price point is also crazy when considering everything I already listed in addition to the size of the bottle.. skip. exit stage left

Y’all. I have no idea what these other reviews are talking about. This smells exactly like watermelon and is unlike any other sunscreen texture. It glides on like your fave moisturizer. It’s amazing! I have a fair skin tone! And I apply it right after I wash my face. No need to double up on your am skincare plus this.
review_title: GLIDES ON AND SMELLS LIKE WATERMELON

review_text: Glow Recipe is my favorite skincare brand, but unfortunately this is the first time I’ve been disappointed by them. Aside from pilling like crazy, the sunscreen sometimes burned a bit when I put it on, and I don’t even have sensitive skin! On top of that, it stings my eyes like crazy. I bought this for spring break and spent the whole time with red burning eyes. Really bummed out by this one as I was so excited for it to come out.

Honestly I was really disappointed. I purchased because of the hype and on the first week it definitely lived up to the expectations. Fast forward 4 weeks later and not a day goes by that there isnt a slight white cast when applying and the immense pilling that occurs is ludicrous! Yes, I wait enough time before applying the sunscreen in between my other face products, as directed! Now I always check myself in the mirror before going to work because I know there will be piling and white cast. I do like that it is lightweight though.
Made my skin peel but it did go on nicely and no white cast but wouldn’t purchase again
I have never ever ever had an issue with sunscreen pilling until now, it’s insane how bad it is. And yes I do wait a good amount of time b/w products.

This is AMAZING. Most sunscreen that isn’t Zinc burns my skin and turns me red. No reaction at all. No white cast, no pilling or my other skincare products, definitely have to let everything else sit in first before applying. And it looks and feels amazing

I really wanted to like this but it’s SO pilly. I made sure everyone to exfoliate; let my moisturizer dry completely; then pat it in by sections… just as directions say. It pilled SO much. Even trying different moisturizers. Really bummed. I would not recommend.

I love the glow. Hate the pilling. I don’t wear foundation or makeup for that matter. The pilling is not good for the size and price of this product. It is lovely on me until the pilling makes it seem like my skin is coming off.

No white cast and makes your skin feel really soft!! Also made my skin look really glowy! It occasionally has pilled but it I apply in sections at a time I’ve found it pills less. Also love that this product is reef safe.
Pills like crazy, and leaves a sticky film on your face. Also got sunburned after being in the sun for 30 minutes, after reapplying it twice.

This sunscreen pills. But! I have a solution - work in small ‘batches’. Don’t apply dots all over your face and then rub it in; apply bit by bit and you should be fine, let it sit for a moment before applying your makeup. For me personally this is one of the best American sunscreens - but I prefer Asian ones better.  It works, but with some effort.

Is this making anyone else break out? I feel like since I’ve purchased it, all I’ve gotten are small pimples. It’s sucks because I really wanted it to work. It smells nice and the benefits are great but the white cast is visible. People say there’s pilling . I didn’t really get that too much if I’ve set my makeup right. thank u, next!

I read the reviews and still decided to give this product a go. I really wanted to like this product but it pills so much no matter how apply it and the amount that’s applied. It also definitely leaves a white cast. It smells great but I definitely will not repurchase.

This has a nice scent to it mixed with a bit of sunscreen smell. It definitely gave my skin a nice glow and absorbed easily. I work in small sections instead of rubbing it all over at once. Feels nice on the skin and makes my skin feel soft!

This sunscreen has the best scent out of all the sunscreens that I’ve tried. I was so excited to see that Glow Recipe made a watermelon sunscreen. It absorbs into the skin quickly and does not leave a sticky feeling.

People were so right about the peeling!! It’s better if you have no other skin care after washing your face and if you only use a little product. I tried patting in/rubbing in/no skin care/with skincare..

I really like this sunscreen! Sometimes sunscreen with skincare additives can make it feel heavy and greasy but this isn’t the case. It smells great and can be easily rubbed into my face without leaving a white cast.

This sunscreen is a game changer! I have very sensitive skin and most sunscreens break me out. This one feels super light on my skin and has a really nice smooth texture. I have been layering this under my daily makeup and so far I haven’t experienced any breakouts. I would definitely recommend giving this sunscreen a try!
Pilled everywhere, even without any skincare or makeup on.  Pilled even on bear skin. Makes me look really greasy. I liked the smell and cute packaging, that’s all. Will be returning.

SO happy about this. This sunscreen is PERFECT for under makeup, but overall so good too. It has the signature glow recipe glow, doesn’t pill and leaves no white cast. Great on it’s own too, but ideal under makeup!

I bought this bc of ig and it’s praise of it. I have oily skin & acne prone(very rare). This was just sooo greasy and not light weight. It also made me pill a little and gave me dry patches. I went right back to my Elta md spf… if you have hyperpigmentation Elta md will literally take away your red cheeks in 1 minute of application!

The product packaging is beautiful, I’m not a huge sunscreen girl but this is great, it has no white cast and leaves the skin dewey! Great for summer only complaint is it does have the traditional sunscreen smell

I absolutely love how glowy my skin looks after using Glow Recipe’s serum. I couldn’t wait to try their sunscreen! It left my skin dewey without any white-cast. It feels really good on my skin, I highly recommend!

Very disappointed in this sunscreen. I wanted to love it so bad. The texture is actually very nice and lightweight, not too greasy or heavy on the skin. I did like the watermelon scent as it’s not too strong. However it’s a pilling mess. The first time I tried it I saw instant pilling by rubbing it in. I thought maybe I needed to let me skincare soak in first before applying so I tried that and it still gave me the same pilling results. I tried a third time and the pilling became unbearable where it was pilling all over my face that I had to wash it off with water and reapply with another sunscreen. Unfortunately I had to return it as I didn’t want to risk not having enough sun protection due to the pilling. Very disappointing.

This is probably the first sunscreen that didn’t make my eyes water but I didn’t love this. It was super thick when I applied it after my other skincare. It also peeled some when applying it and putting on makeup. I also felt like it took a while to rub in, the purplish tint took some work to get rid of. I returned it.

Obsessed with this sunscreen, doesn’t leave a white cast, doesn’t pill and leaves my skin moisturized with an amazing glow, hope the brand keeps this in their line forever cause it’s my new holy grail!

My skin has never felt so soft and glowy and protected. I felt the nice sheer glow and didn’t require makeup. The smell is absolutely amazing too and it does not leave my skin feeling greasy either which is something I love.

Smells amazing, feels lightweight, slightly moisturizing (I have super dry skin), my main complaint is that for me it’s been pilling on me… idk if it’s the products I’m layering but I wear it to work with no face makeup just moisturizer and it pills … into white lil pieces .

My favorite sunscreen of all time. Its the perfect end to my skincare routine every day and makes for the perfect primer. I love the way it feels on my skin and has the perfect matte finish. This will always be an everyday staple.

obsessed with this sunscreen! unfortunately i’ve almost never used sunscreen as a brown girl but I bought this because all of the hype around it & I’m so happy that I did. It plays well with all of my other glow recipe products but also goes beautifully under my other serums. never had pilling issues or anything!

I wanted this to be my new favorite sunscreen but I hated it so much. I can’t put anything under it and even with nothing under it THERES SO MUCH PILLING. Please save your money and buy a Japanese or korean sunscreen. Not worth how much it is with how finicky the product is. For this amount and price it should just work.
Finally an spf that doesn’t break me out!! i absolutely love using this and it wears well under makeup. super moisturizing and doesn’t leave a cast on my face. left my skin dupery gooey.
Really wanted to love this product because I love all of the glow recipe products I’ve tried, but no matter how I apply it pills like crazy.

Glow Recipe did it again and I’m not surprised. I’ve been using the SPF for a month and I’m still thrilled with it. It’s a treat for my face each morning. I love the consistence and delicate fragrance. I already have my next bottle. I need this is a body SPF!

This is the first glow recipe product that I did not like.  The formula is exactly like the typical American spf.  It stings eyes, is greasy looking and has the spf odor.  Non of these are features of an original Korean spf.
I wanted to love this so bad. No matter what combo of skincare I use beforehand or how I apply it, it pills so bad!

I am absolutely in love with this new product from Glow Recipe. First of all, I love their watermelon product line. Second, I love a good SPF product. This creme feels lightweight on my skin and doesn’t feel greasy. Also, there is a light watermelon scent without an overpowering sunscreen scent. I will be adding this product to my daily skincare routine for sun protection. Beautiful product!

Applied nicely on skin. It makes your skin glowy and very little white cast. I feel a cool sensational on my skin. Everything looks great until 2 hours later I check the mirror and shockingly find it pilling. I have to rub the pilling off my skin. I can’t imagine how much it will pill during the winter month when my skin tends to get drier.

I am enjoying this very much.  This blend of sunscreens is not breaking me out the way most single formulas do.  I find it absorbs well with a little bit of patience.  I have only had a pilling issue once, and then it was only bc I had applied too much.  I applied this after my serums and in place of my moisturizer and it does a good job at both protecting me from sun and dryness.  I would definitely buy this again.

I love the Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen! This goes perfectly in my skincare routine and provides the prettiest glow! I love how lightweight it feels on the product and how it seamlessly blends into the skin. My favorite new product for the summer!

I have only used this a handful of times, so please take this review with a grain of salt. This is overall a good SPF. I love that it’s SPF 50. The texture is what you would expect of typical sunscreen (i.e not gel) but not sticky or greasy at all. I have combo skin but dehydrated and my skin is not dry nor is it oily with this. I don’t know why a lot of reviews are having pilling issues. I have worn this with different variations of skin care underneath and no pilling. I don’t wait for my skin care to set before putting this on either. Today I wore it with three serums and a moisturizer and it worked perfectly fine. I would also argue that it’s almost un scented, which I like. Certainly  nowhere near the other watermelon products that glow recipe has. Overall a good product!

I have dry skin so I like my spf has some moisturizer in it, I don’t mind it’s oily. However, this product is not just oily! It’s super sticky, like oily sticky, but sticky in bad way, it can’t let foundation sticks on your skin, instead it let your foundation set on the sunscreen badly’ I tried so many foundation but none can work with this sunscreen! Also it’s peeling soooooo bad!

This sunscreen worked really well for my oily/extremely sensitive acne prone skin. I’m am shocked I haven’t broken out. It keeps my skin hydrated and the “oily”( it’s not that oily) feel goes away after it drys down. I genuinely have not experienced pilling and I use a lot (2 fingers methods with no products underneath)   It’s a really good sunscreen + no cast(I am white but warm tone) + calming feel going on
review_title: No cast and my acne prone skin loves it

review_text: The packaging on this product is so cute! This was a thicker formula than I imagined and left my skin looking very dewy and glowy. It did appear to give me a slight white cast even under makeup. It also felt like it didn’t dry down very well. It also very much was burning my eyes.

I always use moisturizers and spf because I can never find a moisturizers that has spf that doesn’t leave me greasy or with a white cast. This moisturizer completely changed the game by being moisturizing but not greasy AND provides spf without the white cast. If you’re on the market for a 2 in 1 product to make your morning routine a little shorter, I highly recommend.
review_title: 2 in 1, with the both products being amazing!

review_text: wanted to love this product bc I love glow recipe. I tried it 3 different times in diff ways to fix the peeling. nothing really worked. It smells amazing, but their are far better options you don’t have to try to work with to keep from peeling.

I wanted to love this as I love glow recipe and the other watermelon products they have! This how ever is awful. It sits on top of your skin and gets all mealy and stuffs off before you even have time to put makeup on! I use an spf daily and this isn’t going to be it!

I’ve just recently hoped on the sunscreen bandwagon (I know, I’m super late to the game!) and so happy that I found this product. It’s super lightweight and non-greasy which is perfect for my combination skin. I also love the glow that it adds which makes me feel super comfortable going out with just this sunscreen and no makeup.
Pilled like crazy for me. I even went onto the Glow Recipe’s TikTok and watched their tips on applying but still pilled. It was also really greasy feeling, and I have dry skin.
It pills. The glow is amazing if you’re not wearing anything else but most of the other products I use will make this sunscreen pill.
this is such a glowy sunscreen.  i love this when i have acne/bare face days because of the niacinamide in it.
Pretty nice texture and it’s sensitive skin friendly but  I’m still trying out it has only been a week

So so disappointed in this product!! I love Glow Recipe and really wanted to love this. It was way too expensive for the size, especially since it pills! I have never experienced this before… the product pills and you end up with pilling after maybe 20-30 minutes of application. I wouldn’t mind spending this much on a product from a company I like if it is truly luxurious and doesn’t pill. It doesn’t feel nice when dried.. it almost made me feel a little dry. I will revisit if they reformulate this product in the future. But right now it is a major meh!

I’m in love!! I’ve been looking for a sunscreen for my face and I think I’ve found the one! First off, I love the scent. Second, it definitely has a glow after you apply but it’s not the sunscreen white glow you get with other sunscreens. Third, it works great under makeup and doubles as a primer. My skin doesn’t feel dry and is not irritated after use.

This product goes on good. If you have oily or combination skin I’m thoughts are you will not like this! Unless you actually wait the entire 20mins for it to set. I have dry skin and this was what it says GLOWING. I expected it to be that but dang, not that much. It typically dries down but the first few mins after application are shiny shiny shiny!! It has a fant smell right at first of maybe watermelon really just something sweet but as soon as you rub your hands together it rub it in your face it goes away. I also noticed peeling with this. I tried a different skincare routine and it didn’t do it as bad but still peeled and my neck a little. It truly differs from person to person like every other skincare product. But I hate I spent this much money on it and I will not be putting this back on my face. I will use it up on my body like legs and arms. I haven’t tried any other products from this brand but this will not stop me from trying it. I think I just go excited and had high hopes. After the dry down and if it doesn’t peel it could be a good sunscreen under makeup maybe for an extra glow.
Did not experience any pilling. I have super oily skin so it stayed a bit greasy but no bad smell, marking down only because it makes my eyes sting and there are so many that don’t do that.
Worst sunscreen ever… i have dry skin and it gave me patches all over my face. I am very pale but this has a white cast and it gives a pilling effect if you mix it with anything.

I tried this sunscreen for about a month and I had to return it. It has a lot of fragrance, feels heavy and greasy on the skin not to mention it takes forever to sink into the skin. I really wanted to love it but it did not work out for me.

There is definitely a learning curve with this sunscreen because otherwise it WILL pill. I’ve learned that for me, I can only use toner, essence and maybe a very light serum before applying this sunscreen. I can’t use a moisturizer because I find that it always pills. Also, you have to work fast with this product! That is KEY. If you’re used to working in your sunscreen until the cast disappears, you CANNOT do that with this one. I try working it in evenly really quickly, when it’s still liquid on my face and then I stop. You will have a very light white cast, but just give it a few minutes and the sunscreen will set in. Now for formula, it’s definitely on the thicker side. I have oily to combo skin and I can say that I feel it being sticky and it gives me more of a dewier look that I would want. I’m currently using this only for my first application of the day and use another sunscreen to reapply throughout the day. If I reapply this  more than once, I look like a grease ball. I would not recommend this sunscreen for people with oily skin, there are definitely better options and some less expensive. I’m sorry Glow Recipe I love your products, but this one is just not for me!!! :(
review_title: I wanted to like this, I really did…

review_text: Really wanted to like this but after a couple hours noticed that all of it was pilled in little white clumps around my face . Will be returning unfortunately as a result

I have been on the hunt for a daily sunscreen for forever and I think that this is it. I’ve been using it for about a month now, and while I do find it has VERY minimal pilling sometimes, but overall I am enjoying it! I find that it absorbs quickly, is not greasy, does not break me out, and leaves no white cast. It also plays very well with makeup. For reference, here is my routine:- wash face with fresh soy face wash & foreo luna - juice beauty vitamin c serum - saturday skin eye cream (this makes the sunscreen pill so i don’t use the sunscreen around my eyes)- laneige cream skin toner / moisturizer 2-in-1- dr jart ceramidin cream - and finally, the glow recipe sunscreen

I really wanted to love this product but I could not get it to stop pilling when I had any sort of product under it. It was great just on its own with no moisturizer underneath, but most days I need more hydration than just a sunscreen. I tried everything recommended on their TikTok and I just couldn’t get it to work. Such a shame.. very pretty when it did work!
I’ve found my sunscreen, and I’m so glad it’s Glow Recipe! It blends in well with an appropriately glowy finish and doesn’t smell as strong as most sunscreens do.

It leaves a glowy and slightly tacky finish. So makeup wears great over this sunscreen. It feels lightweight which is great for summer time. It has a light watermelon scent. I think people who doesn’t like sunscreen scent would really like this! It has a milky consistency, so I could apply this all over my face easily. One big miss for me, it peels bad, especially on hairline and eyebrows. I think it’ll peel bad for people who have lots of peach fuzz all over their face. My eyebrow becomes a mess whenever I put this one. I’m excited to see this sunscreen’s skincare benefits after consistent use.

I actually paid for this and I live it. Living in the tropic where all year long is sunny and over 90 degrees I’ve tired almost all Sunscreen on the market. From drugstore to the highest end and this is by far the best Sunscreen ever. Leaves my face plump, protected and no white cast or greasy feeling at all. My skin is combination in wintertime a bit dry and summer super oily and this works wonders. I’ll keep buying this forever.

I love most of the glow recipe products, but this one did not work out for me. I was disappointed that it made me break out pretty badly! The smell is also odd- smells like regular sunscreen that they tried to cover with watermelon… I prefer my Tula sunscreen!

This sunscreen is okay. I definitely believe it helps to protect my skin from sun damage but the application could be smoother. As I was rubbing the product into my skin, it started to pill a little bit which is very inconvenient.

I have been on the hunt for sunscreen that would not make my face oily and is easy to apply. I think I found it.Since I use retinol at night, wearing sunscreen during the day is super important on my fair skin. I love Glow recipe products and this new sunscreen is everything! I love the fact that it is SPF50 and combines niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. I feel protected all day!

I really enjoyed this sunscreen. It didn’t leave any weird cast on my skin and it made me glow. I have dark skin so it’s hard to find a sunscreen that doesn’t make me grey. I definitely recommend this product.

I’m giving this suncream a 4/5 because if you apply enough it begins to pill up on the skin which I don’t love. Excluding that it’s a lovely product: the watermelon scent isn’t overpowering, my skin looks glowy after using and it doesn’t irritate my sensitive skin at all.
Great product either under makeup or by itself. Gives sun protection and skin smoothing in a lightweight formula. This is my new go to product.
I love the light watermelon scent, the hydrating effect, and the healthy glow this sunscreen leaves! I did not have issues with pilling — applies very smoothly on me.

This made my skin very hydrated and supple. The product does feel very lightweight. I love the glow that it gives the skin. It blends out really well. the texture is really smooth and kinda silky. Due to the niacinamide and hyaluronic acid, I feel my face looks brighter and looks more hydrated. Definitely going to be a staple this summer!

I wanted to love this product SO bad but it just didn’t sit well with my oily skin. I started to look more greasy than glowy after being out for just a few hours, especially under makeup. It also didn’t mix very well with my other skin care products because it started to peel off my face when I would apply it - even after giving everything time to absorb into my skin.If you have oily skin but sunscreen is the only step in your morning skin care routine, I’d say go for it! I do like this if I just need a sunscreen for being outside in the sun all day (Like at the beach or something); this just wasn’t the best for my every-day use. I didn’t notice any white cast, it didn’t burn around my eyes, and it was moisturizing enough to skip my moisturizer in the morning.
review_title: Not the Best for Oily Skin

review_text: I am not sure i like it. It does not behave well with other products. It tends to peel off. also it does have a bit of a white cast on me. I did wear it on the beach all over my body and it worked better that way but for the price I would purchase something else

Great for the body most days, doesn’t work on my face now matter how I use it. It pills over every skincare product I use. It even pulls on my freshly washed face. Such a bummer, as I love Glow Recipe and swear by their serums and moisturisers.

I really enjoy this product. At first the smell of the sunscreen was overwhelming and took my by surprise. I expected watermelon, after a few times of using it, I became used to the smell. I saw comments about pilling but I never experienced that. I don’t find that this makes me oilier throughout the day.

I really wanted to absolutely love this product but I do have to give it three stars. Things I do love it does have a beautiful glow and the scent is really nice it does apply and leaves no white cast however you cannot wear this with make up on top and it does peel when you have loads of other products on so this is something that I will keep in my bag for when I have like no make up on and I just need SPF alone

At first, I thought I might have found my perfect sunscreen.  But, alas, no.  I initially liked the smell, slight glow, texture, and high zinc oxide content.    However, the more I used the product, I noticed several downsides.  Even though I don’t use foundation, as others have noted, the product pills quite a bit.   In addition, even though there isn’t a noticeable white cast, because I have a slightly darker skin tone, there is still a tiny bit of one.  The biggest problem with the product, though, is the lack of information regarding its short shelf life.  I bought it in March of 2022, but the expiration date was January, 2023, less than a year.  I talked to three people at Sephora but could not get a satisfactory response as to why the expiration date was so short.  Something about the natural ingredients?  Then I emailed the Glow company three times, and no one responded to my question.  I like to order products online, so I don’t want to risk buying this product with such a short shelf-life.   I don’t think I will repurchase.
I have dry skin. Within 2 days of using this my skin started flaking.
Pills like crazy. Looks terrible under makeup. Levels white cast on my dark skin… idk super disappointing product

Immediately pilled on my skin unfortunately. Researched the problem and sought advice. I omitted my Peach & Lily vitamin c serum in my morning routine but it still polled and fluffed off. Gave it multiple shots but ultimately returned it.
review_title: Tried it multiple times before returning

review_text: I am a die hard glow recipe fan, is i was a bit hesitant to try this sunscreen after looking at the ingredients and seeing the combo of zinc and chemical filters. I tried this sunscreen on in multiple ways, with my serums, with just my vit-c serum, just a toner, or just a moisturizer. Every single time it would pill. I tried waiting 10-20 minutes after applying product to put on the sunscreen and no luck, still a slight white cast and pilling. Truly disappointing as every other product is a hit and run, I really hope they reformulate this.

I still want so badly to like this, it sounds like the perfect sunscreen. I’ve only used it a few times, but it pills no matter how I try to apply it, whether whole face at once or in sections, and whether rubbing it in or lightly tapping. This morning it looked so bad that I washed my face and started over, using a different sunscreen as my last step. My morning routine: cleanser, vitamin C serum, moisturizer, SPF. Maybe if sunscreen is all you apply in the morning, it’ll go on smoothly, but that isn’t me. I threw out the box already, otherwise I’d return it.
I have acne prone and combination skin, this sunscreen works perfectly for me

My new favorite sunscreen ! I’ve been using this for a week now & I absolutely love it. My skin has been so moisturized. Not to mention the beautiful glow this gives my face! I love this for when I’m not wearing makeup. Please be cautious that under makeup it will pill.
Pills terribly, on bare skin, over moisturizer, and not good under makeup.

As a retinol user, with combo/ acne prone skin, sunscreen (that doesn’t break me out is crucial for me) is crucial for me.Initial thoughts: I hate thick sunscreen. This one blended out so nicely and gives a nice glow without the oily feeling. I do recommend moisturizing beforehand, as it works well with a moisturizer. you can tell that the sunscreen is a mix of chemical and physical but the blend is so lightweight, it doesn’t create a problem for me.after a week: It hasn’t irritated my skin, or broken me out. I like how the sunscreen wears and preps my skin for make up. I feel the effects of the hyaluronic acid. Niiaciamide tends to irritate my skin but this formula has not given me any problems. Not sure how high the percentage of niacinamide is, so maybe that’s why. my only bone to pick it that you need to use a moisturizer before this product, and give it enough to time to absorb into the skin or else it will pill. Overall, I do think this will be my go to summer sunscreen.

Really lovely scent, and gives a nice little boost of hydration, but I dont think it should be mixed with a lot of other products (pills if you do this), better off if used before a moisturizer, with a light spritz around the face and then pat it in, helps with absorbancy.
review_title: Nice and refreshing, dont use too much!

review_text: I wanted to love this product so badly, but after using it three times I wasn’t able to handle the feeling of the weird film it left on my face, and the pilling. Keep in mind this is completely on it’s own without anything overtop, I didn’t dare layer it with makeup. It does make the skin look glowy without being greasy upon application, but it doesn’t feel nice at all throughout the day. I returned it and said the cashier had two people before me return the product with the same complaints within the hour.
review_title: It’s gonna be a no from me

review_text: I was having high hope for this :( But I was disappointed because it kept pilling. I’d tried for a week with different techniques, with/without moisturizer, but it didn’t work. Nice smell and glow tho!
Leaves a white cast. Tried on different days. Same result

review_text: Pros:- price tag because I’ve been using my Dr. Brandt LIQUID SUNSHIELD and it costs $65 whopping dollars! Cons:- it is NOT sensitive skin approved since it broke me out- it has the typical sunscreen smell which I don’t mind on my body but on the face is a dealbreaker.- it pills like no other. I was hesitant about buying this because of some of the reviews I’ve seen about the sunscreen pilling or flaking. So far, I have been using this sunscreen for about a week and a half and I have NOT experienced any pilling or flaking. I feel that it all depends on the products underneath and the way you finesse it into the skin. I usually massage it with medium pressure and in a circular motion around the face and it applies just fine. It does give me a bit of a high glow/shine at first, but it simmers down after 30 min or so. I can handle that just fine. It has a bit of sunscreen smell but it’s also mixed with a bit of that watermelon smell, but both dissipate after a while. I don’t experience a white cast after I finesse it into the skin for about 30 seconds. I have olive, tan skin. I also have sensitive skin so I can be acne-prone. This doesn’t make me break out so I am VERY thankful for that because I WANT to use sunscreen, and this makes me want to use it which is great. It leaves a nice glow to the skin and I enjoy all the great ingredients in it. Niacinamide is a great ingredient for skin balancing, tone, and dark spots so as a leave on product, it is great. I also love that it has hyaluronic acid, aloe, and watermelon in it to help plump and soothe my skin. Overall, I think it’s a good sunscreen. Happy it’s also a high SPF (as oppose to the usual 30 SPF protection I find). I do see myself re-buying.

This product can be tricky, but you can have good coverage without pilling. The trick is time. Simple, I know. I do all my usual morning skincare, then walk away for at least five minutes before you come back to apply the sunscreen. The more hydrating my moisturizer the longer it needs time to absorb. After waiting 5-7 minutes, I apply the two fingers of sunscreen and walk away. I need to wait between 10 and 15 minutes before applying makeup. If I still see the cast, I know it’s not ready for makeup. I can say  it always makes my skin look great, but I’m not sure it’s worth the time it takes.

I apply three fingers length and work it in quickly, I let it sit for 15 minutes before applying makeup on top. It gives a really nice glow. It leaves a white cast until it sets, that’s how I know it has set and it’s ready for makeup on top. It’s easily in my top 5 fave sunscreens :)

review_text: i have had an interesting experience with this spf. i figured i’d share my story and advice, in case you’re considering buying, or struggling with this product. i have extremely dry skin during winter. my skin drinks up moisture and creams like crazy, and can still always take more. i got this product at launch, and i had zero issues applying this spf over a full face of creams, and even another moisturizing spf. i was surprised when i heard that people had issues with pilling, and i figured that people were just rubbing this product in too much, instead of applying a layer and letting it dry. and then spring came. my skin returned to more normal hydration levels. the first day i applied this over my normal skincare, i saw exactly what other reviewers meant. it pilled like crazy! it’s a shame, because this spf is beautiful and glowy. i have since reworked what i do before i apply it, and thought i’d offer some advice: use this spf over minimal moisturizing skincare. it is a very hydrating product on its own, so you can get away with using it either over a lighter moisturizer that’s absorbed into the skin, or the spf on its own, depending on your skin’s hydration level. apply your two fingers-worth in an even layer, and don’t rub it in, just apply and let dry. it wears well under makeup, surprisingly, and i like how the product shows up as a beautiful glow on the skin. i only wish that the product was water resistant, and not so finicky. i hope this helps :)
