Great to be used by itself, if you pack too many products before it might flake.leave a nice glowy skin snd is not sticky.if you don’t like the dewy skin, this is not for you.
review_title: Great alone for the lazy days.

review_text: This is the best purchase I did for far for my face. I picked it up on recommendations and after I read reviews. It does provide radiating skin, and also works on blemishes or acne scars. I really have acne prone skin, but this product do wonders. But the price is certainly on higher end.
This sunscreen is freaking awesome! The only sunscreen that doesn’t get flaky on my skin and is a great base for makeup!

I wanted to love this so much as I’m a big fan of Glow products but this just didn’t do it for me. Leaves a hint of a white cast, doesn’t dry down and smells heavily of sunscreen which I hate. Was really expecting it to be less “sunscreen” and more “skincare” but I feel like I may as well just wear something way cheaper to not love it. I didn’t love the texture of it either unfortunately. I don’t wear makeup daily so I can’t comment on how it wears under foundation but I feel like it would be far too greasy for my skin to do that
Pilling like crazy even when I don’t have anything underneath (didn’t even apply a moisturizer). Leaves white cast.

Nice for a day around the house with no other makeup on but doesn’t play well with my other beauty products or skincare regimen. Gives you a nice glowy finish and smells really good! However, it’s Shockingly priced (as most sunscreens in North America are, unfortunately..) and there is just better products out there for half the price. I would not repurchase.
I really like this sunscreen. The watermelon scent smells so good. Spreads easily. Dries down to a nice glow. I would definitely recommend this product.

i’m only giving this 2 stars because it smells good. this sunscreen pills like crazy!! wether it’s over bare face or layered on other products, it pills. i mean once you rub off all the pilling, it looks glowy, but that’s just not enough to consider ever buying this again. avoid if you can!
I had to remove this immediately after I put it on because it started pilling.
Wore this outside for a 45 minute walk and got a slight sunburn. Glad I wasn’t out longer.

Wanted to love this product however for the insane amount of pilling, this is a waste of money 1000%! Does NOT play well w/any of my skincare on no-makeup days no matter how much I test various products to prevent pillling. Same goes for my make up (foundation, tinted moisturizer, or cushions) I used a variety of make-up techniques (brush, sponge, fingers) to apply but this sunscreen is terrible. Much prefer SuperGoop or Shiseido SPF.

This product does not work well over other skincare. If you’re using this, you need to use it after you tone and you have to use it section by section, otherwise there will be pilling. Such a disappointment because I’m such a fan of glow recipe and this is their worst product yet.

Great product! Blends decently into my skin but could rub in a bit better (I also have darker skin). Love this brand partly because all of their products just smell so good! Would definitely recommend.

I use the watermelon toner and the plum hyaluronic serum, I let those sit for about a minute or two then apply and I have yet to experience any piling with this product! Also love the glow it gives and the fact it doesn’t leave a white cast on me!

If you don’t use other products with this, it peels. I really wanted to love it. It was between this and the super goop. One day I was in a hurry and didn’t apply a serum or anything else, and it definitely peeled I was pretty disappointed.

Love the scent and the texture of this product, however I find that sometimes the product can peel off my skin sometimes. What I mean by that is as I rub my face small white specks of products come off so thats an annoyance.

I had really high hopes for this sunscreen but it’s not for me. I have oily skin and it just makes my skin feel heavy. It stings and it transfers to my eyes. I wear contacts so for most of the day I’ll have a film over my contacts or if I’m not wearing contacts then my eyes will sting all day long. Also it burns for a good 15 minutes after putting it on. I won’t be repurchasing this.
review_title: Not for oily skin and stings my eyes.

review_text: I bought this along with a couple other sunscreens as I’ve never had much luck finding decent facial SPF, and this one is no better than any drug store brand. It doesn’t have a white cast, but it pills to no end. Very disappointing. I’m also curious about how the reviews on the Sephora site are so good, but as soon as I looked on other sites, everyone was mentioning the pilling. Not a good product for the price. Very overhyped.

I wanted to love this SPF because I love so many of Glow Recipe’s other products, but ugh this just pills too much on my skin, it’s crazy! I even wait for my moisturizer (I use the Banana cream one from Glow Recipe which I LOVE) to set in, but still so much pilling! Won’t be purchasing again.

Got this sunscreen because I enjoyed using the glow drops serum, but I would have to apply them with an spf everyday which interfered with it’s scent and the silkiness. Unfortunately, this product does not have the same smoothing/illuminating effects. The solution tends to leave me feeling dull and uneven in texture, it is pretty grainy if the bottle is not thoroughly shaken. This gets 3 stars because it works for sun protection and still improved skins appearance, it just didn’t work as well at hydrating and softening.
It’s ok. Too shiny for me, and this sunscreen travels. An hour into wearing it, my eyes sting and I taste sunscreen in my mouth.

I love glow recipe but this is a huge miss. This sunscreen pills up on itself dramatically. I’ve used a variety of base skincare products, including only Glow Recipe, and it pills the same every time. It does eventually blend out once you wipe away all the pilling but I don’t think you should have to work that hard for a sunscreen. These are my results using the recommended amount of sunscreen (two fingers length for the face, one finger length for the neck). It does leave a really natural glow to the skin, but there’s plenty of sunscreens that will work as well for a cheaper price. I recommend trying out some other Korean and Japanese sunscreens! It’s usually a better bang for your buck too.

I have been on the hunt for a good sunscreen to apply over makeup and i remember when this launched there were so many influencers saying you can apply it over top of your makeup with a sponge… well i tried that and it was a mistake. thankfully it was the end of my day and i was sitting in the sun with my room mates with nowhere left to go for the day. it was oily and pilled more than any other sunscreen i’ve used. it also pills so much when you layer it with your other skincare. i like that it doesn’t have a very strong scent to it, and if you skip all other skincare steps in the morning and you have zero intention of putting makeup on and if you’re pale like me then it’s good but if you have darker skin than a white girl who doesn’t go outside, it’s going to leave a white cast. i stan glow recipe but this is not it.

I have tried absolutely everything to try to make this work. As many have said it pills and that’s what annoys me.The reason I gave it a two was that I was too lazy to go return it so now I just mix it with my body moisturizer and use it like that on my arms and legs. (Yes, I’ve also tried applying it with my face moisturizer mixed together and still pills, not sure why it doesn’t with the rest of my body).
This sunscreen could’ve been good but it pills on your face and ruins any make up you put on top. I would not recommend this sunscreen from glow recipe.
I’ve used this as a daily sunscreen on its own without makeup. For me, this works if I add moisture before applying but for acne prone skin that may not be a great option for you.

I really wanted to love this sunscreen, but it pills so badly. Once it started to pill on my face, I decided to just use it on my chest and arms, it pulled there too creating a chunky mess on my skin :-(
this sunscreen is probably the BEST one i’ve ever used! i’ve had it for 3 months now and it makes you SOOOO glowy and protects you from the sun. i would 10/10 recommend this to everyone.

Seeing all the good reviews so decided to give it a try. I did not expect to be sticky. It’s a bit on the thick side which I do not like especially in summer when it gets hot and feeling sticky on your face is just not very pleasant.  I like it’s SPF 50. I will not purchase it again though.

I was a bit hesitant to try this product out given that everyone was saying it was pretty hit or miss and it pilled like crazy, however I didnt experience any of that! The sunscreen went on like a dream: super smooth, no pilling, and no white cast!! It gave me such a beautiful glow and I am just so in love.

Okay so hear me out… I also experienced the piling at first BUT after some trial and error I love this. It’s really nice and cooling and I like that it’s SPF 50. What made the biggest difference for me was squeezing the sunscreen out on my hands and then applying it to my face. I have only experienced the piling when I applied it directly to my face

I wanted to love this because I love Glow Recipe, but contrary to its description, it does have a greasy feel to it. I noticed when I added this to my routine, I had an increase in comedones & cystic acne. I never experienced any pilling that others have claimed, however. It sat on top of my toner & serum nicely, and I was able to apply makeup on top of the sunscreen without any issues. Sadly I’ll be switching this out for another once I finish the bottle.

Very oily and I have a darker skin complexion and it leaves a white casts, in order to remove said cast I have to use a spray and vigorously rub it in. Not worth it in my opinion, I will move on the supergoop unseen gel sunscreen.
This pills super bad if you use it over moisturizer or other skin products, you need to wait a while before applying sunscreen but otherwise, it’s an amazing product!
Pills like crazy over moisturizer.  So annoying.  I don’t have time in the AM to wait
I ended up retuning this product, but it just wasn’t for my skin sadly!

Used it over glow recipe moisturizer and still pilled like crazy. Takes forever to rub in and BURNS my eyes to the point that I’m surprised i have retinas. I love everything else glow recipe BUT this.
I wear this under my makeup. I haven’t had any problems with pilling or anything else. Love the scent and the glow it gives

I use it on bare skin and at the end of the day- my face feel so soft and smooth. I have been using it for a few weeks now and I really like how healthy my skin feels. The bottle is small but I think it’s worth it.

Honestly like I was so hype for this, but it really is  nothing special. You could easily find Korean sunscreens with a more elegant formulation than this for half the price. It also a lot thicker than I expected it to be, like it feels like it just sits on my face.

I like the glowy cast it provides but it’s useless if you try to use any toners or serums underneath because it pills like crazy! Also it leaves a bit of a white cast which is not great if you have medium-dark skin. There are better sunscreens on the market like Shiseido or SuperGoop tbh. I will be returning this
I wanted to like this product so much. I’m a huge fan of Glow Recipe but the sunscreen pills on my face. It is such a disappointment

I use a plethora of glow recipe products, from their cleanser to their serums, toner and even creams. I have never felt so let down by a product. No matter what moisturizer I use under this (a gel or lotion) this sunscreen pills. My entire face is covered in white pilling spots. The sunscreen smells nice and feels fine but it is completely unusable.

I think I’ve found my holy grail SPF for my face! I am extremely fair skinned. If I’m in the Sun for 5 minutes I literally turn pink. I wore this on my face the past two days at the pool for 5 hours each day and my face didn’t burn….at all.  I don’t think I would wear this under makeup just because of the consistency, but for outside days with no makeup this will for sure be on my face.
I would not recommend this product since it does not get into the skin at all. After an hour or so the cream starts separating on the skin

Don’t do it. This sunscreen pills so badly. I’ve tried EVERYTHING to get it to not pill, but no matter what you do or how long you wait...it will pill. I’m now using it as an expensive body sunscreen just to use it up. Don’t put yourself through this.
Perfect for pool days out in the sun. Love that it has zinc. Also sits nicely under makeup.

I’m not used to buying such expensive sunscreens.  I don’t wear sunscreen daily (I don’t wear makeup either).  This sunscreen is nice, in my opinion.  I have worn it a few times on days I know I will be out in the sun for any extended period.  It is not totally matte, but it’s not super greasy either.  I have oily skin, so this being oil-free and non-comedogenic is what drew me to this product (and because it smells like watermelon!).  I mix this with the Glow Recipe oil-free watermelon moisturizer to dilute it a bit.  The only time I’ve tried putting this on my face full-strength is when I am going indoor tanning, which is why I bought it.Overall, this is a great sunscreen for my needs and I may purchase it again, but for what most other people are using it for (under makeup, reapplying, hoping it won’t leave a white cast, etc.) I can’t be the judge of that because I don’t care about / use it in that way.
review_title: I only bought because it’s a watermelon sunscreen

review_text: I love this sunscreen. Got a mini size in another set I bought and then bought full size after using. It smells great and makes my skin feel great too. Doesn’t make me break out like other sunscreens either. It is not greasy and doesn’t leave my skin greasy either. This is a must have for outdoors! Love this product!!

I’m not one to spend to much money on skincare and believe drugstore brands or the inkey list and the ordinary can do better than more expensive brands but… this is literally the best facial sunscreen I’ve ever had- doesn’t irritate my sensitive eyes- has a cooling effect for a very long time somehow- not a fan of fragrance in general but this one has just enough where it covers the sunscreen smell without being obnoxious and love the high spf- also no white cast at all and not heavy on skin

I really wanted to like this product.  But with all the hype I dont feel its anything special. I USE  a department store face SPF that I prefer. I dont see this one becoming my go to at all. It always leaves my face feeling tacky. I  personally don’t always wear a full dace of makeup so Its NOT for me.  I do think it has a nice smell. I do not foresee myself purchasing it again.
I really wanted to love this product. I use a couple serums from this brand. However, I was disappointed by the poor quality of the product. The sunscreen pills…

In one sentence the worst sunscreen I’ve ever had! It pills so badly, feels sticky and heavy on the skin, and it never absorbs. Specially if you try to add make up on top of it, your skin will look awful. Not recommended at all!

I love this sunscreen!! In the morning I apply a vitamin C and a light weight moisturizer then after that all drys down I add this sunscreen on top it goes on my skin so nicely doesn’t irritate my eye. It leave my skin with a nice glow without any oiliness. I think this sunscreen is best for dry skin like mine.

No. Just no. If you put anything on your skin before this, it will pill. And I like to use at least a vitamin C serum before sunscreen. The way to avoid pilling is to apply in very small little sections slowly and rub lightly and pat in, and ain’t nobody got time for that. I can’t decide if I will donate this or keep as an early AM gym sunscreen when I have nothing else on my face.

This is my first time using this brand and I am really impressed. I didn’t know what to expect from this sunscreen, at such great price tag, but the quality is there. For reference, y have normal to dry aging skin.PROS:- Lightweight texture: it was easy to spread but it took a while to get absorbed by the skin.- It doesn’t leave a greasy feeling (even applying the recommended amount), although it can feel heavier on oily skin.- It worked well under my makeup but I needed to apply a matte sunscreen to compensate the glowy finish from the sunscreen.- No white cast: it has a combination of chemical and physical sunscreen, and it doesn’t leave you with any white cast.- It has niacinamide, hyaluronic acid and aloe as ingredients. - It has a slight watermelon scent, very pleasant in my opinion, but that can be irritating for those with perfume sensitivities- Clean+Planet Positive at SephoraCONS:- I don’t think this is good for oily skin, unless you apply a very thin layer that will not provide the advertised SPF protection.- It is a little pricey.I am sharing my honest and authentic opinion as a Sephora Beauty Insider Community Ambassador

It does some pilling even with all Glow Recipe products underneath. So I use it on my arms and legs and it is better there. I use it on my face when I barely have anything on and don’t use a lot. Won’t be buying it again but glad I tried it.

I’ve been a Sephora customer for 10 years and never written a review, but I was so happy with this product that I just had to post it. I was in the process of returning “Supergoop“ glow, since it turned my skin yellow (I have insanely pale, neutral skin), when I saw this and immediately grabbed it because I love most Glow recipe products. I love how this feels, and as someone with dry skin I just need to put this on in the morning, no other moisturizer. This reminds me of the feeling of asian sunscreens with it’s milky texture but even higher quality- just feels kind of luxurious. I’ve tried almost every suncreen that exists and spent a fortune, and I’m so grateful my search is over.
review_title: This is the Sunscreen I've been Waiting For

review_text: I finally found my perfect sunscreen - something that works and doesn’t cause any reactions to my super sensitive skin. I have oily/combo skin and this doesn’t make me that oily. I’ve been using it for at least a month now and I will keep repurchasing this. It gives a very slight white cast but nothing too much. It’s great under makeup and does not pill. Not sure why it pills for most of the reviews here but I’ve never had it pill on me even when I put makeup on. It glides on smoothly and gives me a beautiful glow. I have nothing bad to say here.

I could not figure out how to apply this product and have it not pill/ball up for most of the summer.  I read the reviews warning of this problem but thought maybe it was exaggerated because there were so many other good reviews I thought I would give it a try.  After trying it over and over again I think I figured out how to apply but there are too many caveats for me to buy again.Pros--Great for my dry and sensitive skin. -White cast does go away after rubbing (but I do have pale skin)-Skin looks dewy and pearlescent, no tint but to me gives a great “no makeup“ makeup look.-No scent.-Didn’t burn my eyes.Cons-- I can ONLY WEAR IT BY ITSELF.  No essence; no serum; no toner; no makeup (I tried under eye concealer and blush) under or on top of; no water on my face, hands, or hair line, OR IT WILL PILL UP/FLAKE OFF IMMEDIATELY.-When applying I can only apply about a finger tip dab amount at a time to one area of my face, rub it until the white cast is gone (maybe two or three seconds) and then stop rubbing and apply in next area of face.  If I apply about a quarter/ generous dollop amount and massage into face or, God forbid,  keep massaging after white cast has gone it will PILL UP AND FLAKE OFF IMMEDIATELY.-And when I say flake off I mean it looks like the whole product crumbles like parmesan cheese all over the place and you have to keep brushing it off your neck, lip gloss, eye lashes and clothes for the rest of the day. - Am not great at reapplying sun screen like you should but imagine that would be impossible for me and have it not flake off.
Horrible. Pills instantly and flakes. Even if used alone. Does make your face look glowy and doesnt leave a white cast, but pills horribly, especially on the neck and hairline. Will be returning.

I’ve been using this a few days now and really like it - it rubs in nicely, and I’m not finding pilling issues at all like I’ve seen others mention. however it’s VERY ’dewy’ feeling and doesn’t really absorb at all - even hours after applying , I can still feel it kind of sitting on top of my skin. gives a very glowy look as described, but I can’t imagine this working well at all for people who already have oily skin. I tried it both with moisturizer underneath and straight onto dry skin, and I didn’t find much difference. on the plus side, I feel like it’d be great for people with dry skin or those who want that dewy glow!
I wanted to love this sunscreen, but it peels horribly. Using it after other skin products or no products at all it still peels.

I really wanted to love this product. I like other products from Glow Recipe, but this sunscreen pills!! I read reviews before I bought it, and hoped using it with other Glow Recipe products would help with the pilling- it did not. I tried using it alone, applying it on a freshly washed face with no other products and it still pilled. This was the first “expensive,” sunscreen I have purchased and I was not very impressed. I returned it today. It smells nice though!
review_title: Not worth it. This product pills!

review_text: There’s nothing special about it. You do have to wait a while for it to set into your face. I didn’t see any white cast. It does settle into your face smoothly. It’s okay.
review_title: Okay for daily but nothing special

review_text: Sunscreen has become one of my favorite parts of skincare, and I was really excited when I heard Glow Recipe was coming out with this! Sadly I was quite disappointed...I have combo skin and found this was a bit too oily for me. By the end of the day my skin was SO shiny... It also pills so that and the shininess makes it hard to reapply as you’re supposed to. I would not recommend this product, as you can probably find something better for a better price. I’ll go back to my trusty Missha sun milk until there’s something else new to try!

I have dry skin and I like a product that gives me some glow. This is quite a glowy sunscreen, so I would avoid it if you aren’t into that. The consistency is not too thick and it is easy to spread out. It has a slight oily feel but it absorbs after about 30 minutes or so. I appreciate the high value of SPF. Although I like it, I can see how it wouldn’t be for everyone, so for that reason, I wouldn’t recommend it. Oh and the reviews about pilling - if I use it on top of a light moisturizer its fine but it pills up over hyaluronic acid serum.
I love this SPF. I use it everyday as my moisturizer and it does the trick. I like that it has niacinamide. The smell is great and a little goes a long way.

Love this sunscreen. It has not made me breakout, does not feel greasy or oily. Really comfortable wear! It did pill the first time I used it but I did use a mattifying moisturizer before so I would recommend you use a normal one. It did not pill again. Make sure your skin is moisturized!

I hated this sunscreen after wanting to love it. I got a sample and took it to golf with me for my arms and legs. After less than 10 minutes of wear, it was pilling and rubbing off. And felt so sticky. I could not wait to wash this stuff off my body!

Amazing SPF50! GR has not let me down! Got this yesterday but I spent weeks researching this as I’ve seen so many reviews about “pilling”. After you cleanse, don’t apply any more products just go right in with this to avoid the pilling issue! I love the glow it gives me, and the amount of protection just blows me away! Thank you GR for making another beautiful product! SPF IS IMPORTANT! Minimum SPF30! But SPF50 way better!!

I have used this everyday for around 3 weeks now and I love it! It has played nicely with all my products and I haven’t had the issue at all of things pilling up? I use the snail line from peach slices and niacinamide/acids from inky list and no problems. I will say if you lean more oily skip your moisturizer when using this. Overall gives a nice glow, sun protection and works well with other products. P.s. maybe the pilling is from not letting each product like fully sink in?
i like this that because this does not smell like the usual sunblock/sunscreen.

for my scent sensitive ladies, i personally got this product because i hate the smell of typical sunscreens and i thought this would smell like watermelons (like their niacinamide dew drops). but it smells like an ordinary generic sunscreen. i also felt it was heavy and sticky on the skin even when i applied a very small amount. i don’t think it’s worth the price personally so i will be returning :/
Great product I don’t need to buy separate niacinamide.I loved the results.

I really like this product. I had been looking for a face sunscreen for awhile and I had a LOT of criteria--had to be cruelty-free, not contain any silicone (my skin just CAN’T with silicone), can’t be tinted, couldn’t be too thick. This one ticked off all the boxes so I gave it a try and I love it--it’s light and sinks into the skin really well.I haven’t had any of the pilling or sticky issues some of the other reviewers have had--quite the opposite, really. This blended into my skin beautifully. I had read the reviews and considering I have a pretty intense skin care regime in the morning with a few layers of products (toner, serum, booster, moisturizer) I didn’t have high hopes because almost everything pills on me--but this didn’t. It also wasn’t sticky at all on me.I rubbed it on my hands first and then patted it onto my face so maybe that made a difference, but overall, I like it.
review_title: light,cruelty-free, and I had no issues with pills

review_text: Its a really great sunscreen I will say, just a little greasy and not the greatest under makeup. For the price there’s definitely better sunscreens out there- but I like that this has some skincare benefits in it too.

This is my current favorite sunscreen. The bottle is small enough to fit in my very small purse but the product has lasted me through the summer. It doesn’t take a lot to cover my face and it leaves a nice glow on my skin. It has a faint watermelon scent, which I love but others may be sensitive to, so be aware of that. It also is quite dewy, so it isn’t ideal for under makeup or if you want matte skin. But if you want a dewy glow and some nice long term benefits, I would recommend this sunscreen.

I was excited to try this because of the reviews of the product and reviews of glow recipe but I am not a fan of this sunscreen. I have dry skin and this makes my skin feel sticky and it looks greasy. I don’t like the dewy look and I hate how I can tell that it’s on my face. It’s especially bad on the neck. My neck feels sticky all day after applying this. I have to use powder over top and it doesn’t reduce any redness it actually makes it slightly worse. I only gave it 2 stars because it smells yummy.
review_title: Not a fan, there are better sunscreens out there

review_text: This works fine as a sunscreen but my makeup disintegrated within an hour. Not worth the price.

This has been the best SPF I’ve owned I wear it daily with or no makeup in the hot humid sunny weather I’m from the south. Once I apply this product it smells like a hint of watermelon and ofc that SPF smell however it goes away within seconds. I am olive toned so I will have a white/gray cast but it doesn’t last too long either once it sets in within minutes my face is clear as day. I have no issues with this at all. It does not rub off or peel off . I’m very athletic so I run outdoors a lot in and I can a-test it is sweat proof and will not burn if it gets into your eyes. It has helped from preventing dark spots and I have not experienced any breakouts either. It gets the job done on my training days and blends perfectly with my makeup on my full glam nights
review_title: Glad I didn’t let the negative reviews scare me

review_text: Not my fave to wear. Love the smell and feel but flakes and it’s not easy to blend

Beautiful to wear on its own. Doesn’t play well with all makeup, and when I tried to use it after the plum plump moisturizer, it pilled. Do be careful around your eyes, it stings. Whenever I wear this I get compliments on my skin.
love the smell but makeup does get flaky, texture is pretty good and not too sticky

LOVE this sunscreen! First off, the smell is amazing. The texture is light and smooth. This is my go to sunscreen for day to day use. I work out out a lot and was very excited that it’s not at all runny or greasy when my body starts to sweat. I highly recommend Glow Recipe and the products that they put on the skincare market, so it’s no surprise this was another home run from this brand!

I am a Glow Recipe lover but I just can’t love this product. After a short while of this being on, it leaves my skin with a really weird texture. Also, I’m a contact wearer, and it always makes them cloud up. I even completely avoid my eye area and it still manages to coat my contacts. Luckily no burning with that. I want to love this product so bad but I just can’t.

I hate this sunscreen so much it makes me actually angry whenever I use it. I don’t know how this got past testing phase without anyone pulling the plug. The way to make it work without pilling and flaking is to do one small section at a time, rub in only until it’s spread around and then never ever touch it again. You can make it work but there’s such better options.

As much as I wanted to like this product, it’s just not good. I love Glow Recipe and i’ve tried this product many other ways but each time it was the same outcome- bad. No matter how you apply it or what base you use under it, this product has a lot of white cast and it piles up all over the face. You can see small white buildup all over your face throughout the whole day.
It’s a 10 from me! I love the dew it gives my skin and my makeup sits beautifully on top :) looks great on its own too
white cast over face when working out and not good under make up

Leaves my skin glowy without looking oily or sweaty. Spreads easily on the skin without leaving white marks. Blends fast too so I don’t have to rub it long, feels like putting on cream or lotion. Highly recommend.
I feel like people hate on the sunscreen just because they want to fit in but this sunscreens actually really good and it wears good under my make up I’m almost done with it might repurchase
I’ve bought this 3-4 times and I love that it leaves my skin very glowy but it pills. Maybe I’m rubbing it in too hard?

I have very sensitive, reactive skin and it is nearly impossible to find sunscreen that will not break me out. What makes it worse it that I am combination- oily in the t-zone and dry around the mouth, so most sunscreens tend to make me an oil slick rather quickly. I was nervous to try this, especially since it is supposed to be glowy and fragrances but let me tell you… this is a game changer for me. I use this as my daytime moisturizer (I add moisturizer on my dry areas after applying this) and it is an amazing base for my makeup, doesn’t break me out and gives me a beautiful glow without making me oily.

Now I understand why the reviews are so split for this spf. If I put this on a completely bare face (no skincare beyond cleanser), it goes on beautifully, no white cast, and gives a glow without looking greasy at all. One might even say it is mattifying, but with a glow. But as soon as I try to put it on with any skincare underneath, it pills like crazy. The problem for me is that while I can go without serums and all that stuff, I at least need a moisturizer underneath since the zinc oxide in the spf dries out my skin. But even a very light moisturizer under this causes it to pill. I could see this working for a humid day spent outdoors in the middle of the summer, where I wouldn’t worry about other skincare and probably wouldn’t need the moisturizer either. But, I’m not going to spend the $$$ for that niche type of situation, I’d sooner just get a cheaper and more versatile waterproof spf. Rating this was hard, I landed on 3 but it could be 4 or even 5 stars if all you do is wash your face and apply sunscreen after with nothing else. It’s just won’t work for me for most days during the year and isn’t worth the price for the few times I could use it. It’s too bad though, as I said, when it does work, the finish is beautiful.

Initially, I found myself questioning whether this meant a downgrade in terms of efficacy; however, according to Glow Recipe’s instagram, it’s actually more powerful? They claim this new version has 2.5% pH-balanced AHA, which is supposedly as strong as 10% glycolic acid (whaaaat)I doubted this - because I’m a skeptic at heart - but lo and behold, I found myself purging within days. Heads up that this formula increases turnover, so know that could happen (the ol’ “skin getting worse before it gets better”). Frankly, while this may seem frustrating, it really is a sign of a strong formula. Within a few more days, my skin cleared and is looking clear and bright - all without the product stinging!!I’m not sure how GR did it, but wow - I’m pleasantly surprised!

I like to pat it in until it absorbs fully and it helps to keep my evening skin care routine simple but also effective. In the morning after waking up, I found that my skin already looked visibly plump, hydrated, and so much softer. Not only does it smell amazing but it does amazing things for my skin too!

Absolutely love this product. My face feels so hydrated and feels so smooth. I apply it at night as my last step in my skincare routine. I use this about 2-3 times a week. My skin feels amazing. I would definitely recommend this product to family and friends.

Love this product! The product texture is very silky and hydrating feeling which definitely has helped my skin feel more hydrated.  I love how my skin feels after application. It’s the perfect product to top off your nightly routine. I didn’t experience any issues with layering this on my other products. I will be using this weekly!

When I wake up in the morning, my face feels very plump and smooth. I notice my skin is more even and glowing after using this at night as the last step of my routine. The texture is watery gel base and has less watermelon scent compared to their original sleeping mask and it’s easier to spoon out of the container without dropping. My skin wasn’t too compatible with their original sleeping mask but this one works so well on me! I am gonna continue to use it until

Tried it last night & I’m very happy with this new formula! Loved the OG watermelon sleeping mask, so I was a little worried at first. I did use a moisturizer on top of this, almost treated it like a treatment serum, to keep my skin hydrated as I am a dry skin type. The texture is light but fluffy, so I think if you’re skin is oily you might be able to get away without a moisturizer. My skin immediately looked glowy & bright, not sticky & no pilling issues! Played well with my other skincare so that’s a plus. I woke up with soft,even & happy skin. I think I’ll be using this 1-2 nights a week as a treatment in my bright skin journey!

This overnight treatment mask is so so amazing, I’m absolutely obsessed! It goes on your skin so smoothly and instantly made my skin feel hydrated! After I use this the next morning my skin is always so bright and glowing!

Super thin texture which is perfect for the hot summer weather. I would say it is better than the original sleeping mask because skin look glowly in the morning- hence the watermelon glow title. I think the travel/mini size is good enough to last for a while.

Love this product! It’s a pretty lightweight wet yet cream texture. It feels good on top of my regular routine. Some days it can feel like a lot personally on my skin bc I do have a bunch of products I put on my face, but I will say I have definitely noticed a difference in my skin. I feel like my skin is hydrated and it’s definitely helped out with some bumps on my skin.

I am obsessed with this night mask! I’ve used it for years because it really works. It leaves my skin feeling brighter, tighter, and more hydrated. I layer it over other products as the last step in my nighttime skincare routine. If you want a glow, use this product!

I have used this overnight mask for couple of nights. I find it gentle on my combo skin as it didnot cause any breakouts. My skin feels soft any I don’t feel any dryness or dry flakes on my skin. Over all I feel even sensitive skin would love this. I loved the gel texture which gets absorbed onto the skin quickly and makes skin very moisturized.

As a huge fan of glow recipe, I was so excited they launched this new formula of the sleeping mask! The first night I tried it my skin was a little red and more oily than it usually is in the morning. The second morning however I could tell my skin was a bit smoother and hydrated/plump. (there wasn’t any redness as well!) I can’t wait to continue using this and see more improvement in my skin :)

It has a jelly texture, and absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling sticky. Also, I haven’t experienced any irritation, so far. The only downside is that it contains fragrance. Other than that it’s a good product.

My skin felt smooth when I woke up. Using Hard water can mess up my skin but this revived it. The product texture is watery and light. My skin is definitely more hydrated and brighter and my pores aren’t as big. I usually break out from other products and this one made my skin look better/not breakout. I’ll use this a couple times a week before bed after I’m done with my skin care routine. It doesn’t feel bad over my other products. My skin feels a lot smoother. I like that it doesn’t feel sticky after applying.

This is so soothing and refreshing. It’s very gentle and effective. It makes my skin feel hydrated and refreshed. My skin looks more even radiant and dewy. It also appears more smooth and soft. I really like this.

I am obsessed with Glow recipe watermelon line. I love to apply it as the last step to my skincare routine. It feels refreshing to use. I totally can see it helps to make my ski appear softer and smoother. Highly recommend it.

This is one of the best Glow Recipe products that I have tried so far. On top of the amazing watermelon scent that I like, this product actually works. My skin type is sensitive, so it’s tricky to find a product that won’t irritate - it has to be strong (when my skin is rough), yet gentle at the same time. I applied it as the last step in my PM routine and the next day my skin literally glows and my skin tone appears brighter and smoother! Highly recommend for those with sensitive skin and occasionally have rough skin texture like me!!
review_title: Finally an AHA treatment for sensitive rough skin

review_text: I have been using this mask for a week and I am totally in love! The texture is a watery gel that is easy to spread and once it dries on the face it doesn’t clump. No strong scent either. This mask leaves my skin feeling supple when applied, and when I rinse it off the next morning, my skin feels smooth, hydrated and glowing. The mask will also last a long time with this size of the jar so I think it is worth the price.

First off, I’m obsessed with glow recipe. I have dry, acne prone skin and their products have been life changing for my skin. When they reformulated their sleeping mask I had to test it. I’m SO glad I was able to because it’s AMAZING. It applied effortlessly onto my skin and felt slightly cooling. It wasn’t sticky by any means and was very easy to apply. I left it on overnight and when I woke my skin was literally glowing. After only a few uses my skin has brightened and looks so much more healthy. It’s smoother, softer and just overall amazing. If you suffer from sensitive skin and have been hesitant to try glow recipe, just do it. The fragrance hasn’t ever aggravated my skin and it’s one of the only skincare that has actually helped my hormonal acne.

I’m not gonna lie, my first impression of this new formula was not good. The consistency is watery and it doesn’t have that watermelon smell I love… so I wasn’t impressed…. Until the next morning… I notice a much brighter glowing skin the first thing in the mirror and I think to myself huh glow recipe does not disappoint… but I really wish they’d keep making the old formula as well but I bought two bottle, one for myself and one for my sister before it ran out….
I tried this as a mask and it felt really good on my skin. Felt cool and I felt a slight tingle. It looked so healthy and bright. My skin felt extremely soft.
Absolutely love! After one night I could tell a difference in the brightness and evenness of my skin. I’m excited to have this as part of my routine.

Want to upgrade your night time skin care? Then add this to it and you will be glowing. This just melts into your skin and you wake up the next morning glowing. Plus it smells amazing and does not make your skin tingle!

I am obsessed with the Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow AHA Night Treatment and am amazed with how well it works! Ive Been using this treatment at night before bed, I absolutely love how my skin is in the morning when I wake up its so smooth, soft and hydrated and has a  natural glow. I have also noticed my skin to be more even toned and firmer.

a little goes a longggg way with this product. I applied it and it gave sort of a cooling sensation. It felt very lightweight and you can feel it working it’s magic on your skin. When i woke up the next morning, my skin was GLOWING. it was giving glass skin. I love the cute packaging and think it’s worth its price

Glow Recipe really never disappoints. Everything from the packaging to the formula is absolutely perfect! The texture is very unique and unlike any other night treatments I’ve ever tried. It’s a lightweight, gel like consistency. It absorbs very nicely and doesn’t leave any sticky residue on my skin. It literally sinks into my face and feels softer, smoother and it’s very comfortable on my skin.

Magic in a pink bottle, the morning after using this product I noticed that my face looked so refreshed and moisture! The texture is like slimy, my skin felt so hydrated, it makes me look brighter. My face feels so fresh right after applying it. My skin feels smoother!

Received a sample. The texture is like a cool gel that goes on clear. soaks in immediately. Not greasy or tacky. Woke up with a glow. I would recommend this for anyone who wants a simple easy night routine.

I was a bit nervous to try this because I wasn’t really a fan of the original watermelon might mask (because of stickiness and pilling). They have definitely improved the formula. Although this new mask feels a little sticky when you’re first putting it on, it soon absorbs into the skin really well,  and I didn’t feel like it was going to rub off on my pillow.  The morning after I used it, my skin did look brighter and more supple and glowing. I will continue to use this a few nights a week for moisture and exfoliation.
review_title: Much better than the OG watermelon night mask

review_text: I love this brand. It’s one of the few brands that doesn’t leave me feeling oily or warm. Instead, it leaves me feeling both cool and hydrated. A perfect combo. It smells amazing and has the smoothest silkiest texture.

Oh my god! Im obsessed with this gentle exfoliating night treatment! My skin is so smooth, hydrated & glowing after only one use! What in the world is this! It feels incredibly lightweight & gentle on my skin & I can see it smooths my texture gently. My skin is so bright and even toned! Worth the money!

This is a great lightweight hydrating sleeping mask, especially for hot weather or if you want a gentle way to exfoliate your skin. This sleeping mask has a delicious watermelon candy scent and a really fun texture. This is one of my go to products to use in my nighttime skin care routine.

Wow wow wow this is amazing! I’ve been using it for a few days and it’s already healing so much. My pores have shrunken and it’s helped tame my acne as well. My skin is more even and smoother. Literally obsessed

I’m a sucker for products with AHA since my skin tends to get textured spots on the days I work. The product itself is a light gel that absorbs nicely into the skin. For me I like to mist my face with plain rose water then apply the mask (dime size only). If I do more than it becomes a little sticky. Took about 15 min to fully absorb into the skin and I was ready for bed. In the morning my skin had a lovely glow, almost as if I had highlighter on ! You have to try this !!

Wow! Skin is super smooth! It can be a little drying so plan to double up on moisturizer the next morning. My only issue- the mini size is so small!!! And for that price? Ugh! More expensive than the OG watermelon mask. Not sure if it’s 100% worth the price.
review_title: really great treatment BUT super small size ugh

review_text: I love this night serum! I have been wanting to try something from this company for forever and am so happy that it lived up to my expectations! It is an amazing consistency and applies on the face amazing. I use it every night and love how it leaves my skin feeling the next morning! So amazing!

It’s OK goes on your face very smooth is more water-based I really really like it and it’s unscented which is a plus because sometimes scent things can irritate your skin but it’s  very soft I only used it once but I would recommend it it doesn’t smell like watermelon tho

I looove this product so much..every morning after applying it my skin feels so supple & hydrated! I use this a couple nights a week as the final step of my night routine. I love how this smells & feels when I first apply it. It absorbs nicely into the skin & I feel like it has improved the glow of my skin!

Since this product is a replacement of the old Glow Recipe Watemelon Sleeping Mask, I can’t help but compare the two. The old mask honestly didn’t do anything for my skin so I was excited to try this. The first (and biggest difference imo) is the lack of the watermelon scent. I get why they toned it down for people with skin sensitivities, however I do miss the smell! It feels the exact same in texture and sat nicely on the skin overnight. Overall, I didn’t notice my skin looking or feeling noticeably better the next day. I’m giving it 3 stars because I haven’t had long enough to try it, but we’ll see!

So, in all honesty I was not necessarily the biggest fan of the original version of this sleeping mask! To me it was just like a basic gel like moisturizer… But I feel like this version is way more exciting! I have sensitive skin so at first I was kind of freaked out when I saw that this product includes acids in it, but I’m not gonna lie the actual formula is extremely gentle even if he use it every night! Honestly, if you have dry skin this is probably the most perfect and amazing moisturizer for you!

Glow Recipe is famous for their watermelon glow line, and they have had lots of success on previous launches. This one intrigued me, as none of the other products from the line have worked for me. Unfortunately, this one was a miss too. The scent is just too much for me.

I was such an OG fan of the original that I was nervous about the reformulation. I didn’t need to worry because this is IT!! The addition of AHAs but still super gentle and hydrating is a serious upgrade. I love the jelly texture and I use it as my last step of the night. When I wake up in the morning my skin feels smooth, hydrated and bright. Plus the watermelon scent is so yummy, all the Glow Recipe products are!
From the first day the product arrived, I use it every night and it has an incredible texture on the skin and also leaves it very hydrated, soft and bright. I love it and the brand is also very good.
I LOVE THIS PRODUCT.  it is a jelly texture and after a few uses this product has left my skin feeling so glowy and hydrated the next morning. it doesn’t leave a sticky residue and absorbs overnight.

First off, this product smells wonderful! Think watermelon jolly rancher, YUM! I was a bit worried about using this mask because the original one I tried pilled all over my face and pillowcase! Luckily, this one didn’t do anything like that. It makes my skin supple and glowy the next day without any irritation. There is a slight tackiness right after applying this but it goes away within a few minutes.

I didn’t try the original one so I don’t know the difference. However, this has a gel texture that sits on the skin, which I’m fine with it. The next day my skin feels really soft and smooth but my skin isn’t irritated.

I was looking for a new product to add extra moisture to my dull and complicated skin. I have been breaking out like crazy. This gentle product has left my skin feeling brighter, smooth and hydrated. It truly was a blessing in addition to my skincare routine. It did not leave my skin feeling sticky and I feel so fresh when I wake up.
review_title: Add this to your skincare routine now!

review_text: Love the glow I get from this in the morning. It brightens and hydrates well. I usually don’t go for overnight treatments but I really enjoyed this one. I use it as a last step on my skincare routine and when I’m lazy enough sometimes the only step. Makes my skin feel smoother and plumper.

After just one use with this product, my skin already felt smoother and softer. I love that this was lightly scented and not too overly scented. This is going to become a regular product in my nightly skincare routine.

I have been testing this product out for a week or 2, and I have already noticed a huge difference in my skin. I use this as my last step in my nighttime skincare routine and in the morning I wake up with glowy and smooth skin. I’ve noticed a lot of my texture has improved a lot. Glow recipe has not let me down thus far and is becoming one of my favorite skincare brands.

First of all, I love Glow Recipe packaging, all of the products are so adorable and I always save my empty jars! The product was phenomenal, too, it makes my skin feel so soft in the morning! It did sting a little bit upon initial application but the formula also has a cooling sensation that helps soothe the redness. The texture is gel-like and a little sticky, it leaves the skin feeling very hydrated and moisturized, and doesn’t sink in fully, so you wake up with some product still on your face. I usually wash my skin with plain water in the morning and that seems to be enough.

I liked the consistency of the mask and the fact that it contains only 2.5% AHA. I’m trying to avoid strong chemical exfoliation so this is great to have! It also feels super moisturizing so I skip my moisturizers the nights I use it. The watermelon scent is subtle (almost not there?) so that’s nice too. My skin feels slightly smoother the next day. I wish there was more product though because it might take a lot of uses for this to give some incredible results.

I wanted a new night treatment because I’ve recently felt like my skin is full and dehydrated so I got this one and so far I love it! It’s a nice consistency and when I wake up in the morning I can see a nice glow.

AMAZING!! I love the subtle scent of this, and it glides so smoothly over my skin. My skin feels so smooth from the AHA and more plump overall. It’s gentle on the skin so I’m able to use it every night, and I’m a huge fan of it.

I’m a huge fan of Glow Recipe! I love the overnight watermelon AHA night treatment. Anytime I have a blemish and I use this treatment I wake up the next day and it has either vanish or is super minimal! This is seriously magic in a jar!

I love glow recipe products but this one is just okay. I have the original with the watermelon scent but this one does not have the scent. The texture is liquidy, careful when open because I spilled a quarter of the jar all over my vanity. I like the ingredients so I’ll keep using it. When I wake up in the morning my skin feels soft which is good. This won’t work for me for winter because I have dry skin.

I have pretty dry skin and so I thought this product would give me hydration and a nice glow. It does not give me the hydration i need for my face. It’s a little too thin and goes away within 3 minutes. However, it did make my skin more glowy and smooth. I use it maybe like once or twice a week and after applying this I’ll go ahead and apply my nightly moisturizer because it is thicker.

I have been a longtime user of the Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Night mask regime.  Loved it until I met the new “kid on the block“.  The smell is a little more subtle.  The texture is a bit heavier.  The game changer for me was the hydration factor.  This new version added a wonderful level of moisture.  I have dry skin and this product has helped balance mine.  In the morning my skin looks refreshed, soft and cheery.  Will be purchasing this new version as soon as my current supply is gone.

Absolutely love this product! It has left my skin so nice and smooth. Whenever I feel like my skin felt congested or needed a refresh I used this and it helped 100%! I love the smell so that doesn’t bother me but do take note of that. It layered with my skincare routine really well. In love!

Glow recipe never fails. I live in the hot and wonderful state of California, so my face has been a little dry. I’ve been applying this to my face at night and wake up so hydrated and glowy! It sits on my face nicely and feels extremely light! I love!!

I complimentary received watermelon night treatment from Glow recipe and im obsessed with it . I apply it for a night and in the morning my skin was glowing! The gel texture makes it easy to apply, leaving my skin super hydrated, bouncy, smoother and glowy! It doesn’t have strong scent which I LOVE! I definitely recommend to try it!

I used this at night after a full day of makeup and it was an amazing feeling when I woke up. My skin was so smooth and bright as compared from the night before. I do have oily skin and it definitely didn’t make my skin feel oily in the morning but moisturized.

I am obsessed with the Glow Recipe AHA night treatment! I used it at night as an overnight treatment and I loved how tighter my face felt the following day after the first use! Because it contains 2.5% AHA, I like to use this at night right before moisturizing. I appreciate that my pores appear smaller, and my skin is so much brighter and glowing. It’s very hydrating, it’s cooling and very light and it doesn’t dry me out at all. It’s such a great overnight treatment; it’s a gentle exfoliant that supports cell turnover so I love that they came out with this product! So far after using for the last couple of days I have seen dependable results!

This product has almost exact color and texture to their discontinued watermelon glow drops. I am disappointed that it had no watermelon scent. I love scented facial products. The next morning my face looks brighter. I almost look more awake, I should say. My skin looks plump and hydrated which is always a plus. I have dry skin and this product makes me look and feel hydrated in the morning. Over all this is a nice product to have.

I am in love with this watermelon night treatment! My skin feels so soft and smooth when I wake up in the morning. The texture is very light and not sticky at all. As someone with dry skin, this mask is very hydrating and leaves my skin looking and feeling so hydrated.

love the new formula! Im always worried when a product i love gets reformulated, but fear not, this new formula is amazing! scent is lighter, no alcohol smell, no mixing required, no pilling and is a stronger than the previous mask! It helped clear up blemishes and scarring overnight and my skin felt hydrated and baby soft. i highly recommend, especially if you enjoyed the original!

My skin feels SO hydrated and glowy when I wake up after using this treatment! I’ve been using this at night for my last step in my skincare routine and it has made my skin feel so smooth and radiant. This is the best overnight mask I have ever tried! Others make my skin purge with harsh ingredients but this one doesn’t irritate my skin at all.

I have been using this product for over a week and I’m super happy with the results,  I had a big break out because I used another product and this cream helped me with this horrible break out I had, it’s almost gone, it leaves my skin glowing and youthful, I really loved it

My skin loves this product! I apply it at night and when I wake up in the morning my skin feels baby smooth. The mask has a light watermelon scent but it’s very light, the texture is also super light and kind of on the watery side. Overall I would recommend if you’re looking for more hydrated skin.

This was actually my first Glow Recipe product and I must say, I’m impressed. I can’t go based off the previous formula, just what I know now. This product has a watery but thick consistency, which is bizarre. When I first used it, it felt soothing and it irritate my skin, despite having AHAs. I felt hydrated after putting it on and it sinks right into the skin. In the morning, I looked glowy and I felt hydrated. I used it alone and with skincare products and it worked extremely well both ways. I feel that my skin feel more hydrated and brighter as well!

Absolutely loved this mask! It gives the same glow and plumpness as the Watermelon Sleeping Mask but adds a boost of chemical exfoliation as you sleep!! I wake up with my skin in absolute “post facial” glow and hydration!!! Love love LOVE!!

I have so many glow recipe favorites with the watermelon glow as my holy grail for overnight skin treatment. The new version has increased my skin’s hydration and the scent is more subtle than the original. The additional AHAs did not irritate. It plumps my skin instantly and I wake up to refreshed bouncy smooth skin.

This is the first product I have ever tried from Glow Recipe, I’m impressed! I apply this before going to bed at night and I wake up with hydrated, glowing skin. The texture is smooth and jelly like which I love- it’s fun to apply! My skin overall feels so much smoother, I recommend this!

This AHA treatment is amazing! Not only did it make my skin feel very smooth but it is extremely hydrating. I use this at night and when I wake up in the morning my skin feels so refreshed, I love this new formula! It also smells amazing. I love this treatment for my oily skin!
review_title: I love this treatment for my oily skin!

review_text: LOVE this new product. It has a unique thin gel texture that hydrated my skin beautifully while the aha got to work. I woke up the next morning and could see an immediate difference and over the past week of using it my skin texture has improved.

I am soooo happy with this reformulation! I loved the initial mask a lot but this one is just so much better. My skin is so soft and bouncy and plump. Looks like I just got a facial. I am so happy with this and highly recommend

What an epic new launch by Glow Recipe. From first use, I fell in love instantly. The gel texture melts into the skin and by morning my skin looks radiant. I’ve only been using for 2 weeks (4x total) but I am very optimistic the results will be fantastic. I’m such a sucker for anything with exfoliants. Cannot wait to try more of their products.

This is an amazing product If you want fresh and glowing skin the next morning. love this mask firstly because of texture, it’s gel-like and extremely lightweight. It’s gentle, has never broken me out. I use it once a week as an overnight treatment and wash it off the next morning and my skin is soft and glowing. It smells amazing. I think it should have an applicator spoon or dropper or something to apply.

So impressed with this new product. Smells AMAZING, and the texture is amazing. It’s also good for sensitive skin like mine. I love how my skin feels after application - so soft and dewy! Packaging is nice too

This product is officially a holy grail mask! With consistent use, it’s brightened up my skin completely, evened out the dullness/patchyness and my skin feels supple and hydrated. The resurfacing aspect is so gentle on the skin and doesn’t cause irritation- I highly recommend!

I love an overnight product - especially one you wake up and notice a difference. My skin looked nice and even and smooth the next day and it only got better after continued use! My only “issue” is I have very dry skin and this is supposed to be used in place of a moisturizer before bed so it took me some time to adjust to the texture as I’m used to the feeling of a thick, hydrating moisturizer but it’s not sticky and after a little bit I didn’t even notice!

I really enjoyed this product I love glow recipe and definitely love their watermelon collection so I was very excited for the night mask leaves skin so smooth and incredible really loved it and smells amazing

This is a very good exfoliating mask for dry sensitive skin, if used properly. I cannot really handle most chemical exfoliants but I have had no issues with this product so far. I wouldn’t use it more than 2x a week though, and I do apply a thicker moisturizer on top once the mask sinks in. My skin looks brighter overall and more even. I’m looking forward to seeing some improvement with my pores and blackheads.

Let me start - I am huge fan for past few years of Glow recipe!! Few years back I tried their watermelon mask. Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow AHA night treatment - even outs my skin Dullness and my skin feels super hydrated and just relaxed. It smells and feels amazing!!

This jar is smaller than the OG sleep mask but it works even better than the original sleep mask! I love that a little goes a long way and my skin is always plump and glowing the next morning! I love it!

Glow Recipe hits the ball out of the park yet again with another brand new formula. This overnight resurfacing mask makes my skin feel so plump and bright the following day. It’s works like a peel off mask. I use a warm soft towel to remove all the dead skin away in the AM.

This new Glow Recipe product is amazing! My skin feels so soft and hydrated when I wake up! It looks noticeably more even and I like it more than other overnight treatments that I have tried. The texture is really nice too!

I really liked this product. It made my skin feel very soft and I woke up with a glow! It soaks right into the skin so when you wake up you don’t need to wash it off and it doesn’t get all over your pillow like some overnight treatments. I did break out when I started using it but my skin is very sensitive so I now only use it a few times a week. Overall I like this product!

I love love love this product!!! feels so great and refreshing on my skin. I wake up and notice a glow right away. Def good with layering skin care no pilling. a little goes a long way so just a dab will do. 10/10 !!

I received this Watermelon Glow AHA Night Treatment from Glow Recipe in exchange for my honest review. I really like using this night treatment! It smells so good and my skin looks a lot brighter the next day after I’ve used this!

As a Watermelon Night Treatment OG lover, I was excited to try this new product!I was happy to see my skin was plump, hydrated, and blemishes were less red and almost gone by the time I woke up in the morning!

The first night I used this, I felt a very slight tingle/burn, which honestly just tells me it’s working. I continued to use it and didn’t feel that feeling again, but my skin has improved. I can see smoother, more hydrated skin. It also feels plumper, which I’m surprised because the product itself is so thin. I was gifted this product.

I FREAKING LOVE THIS PRODUCT. Grateful I received this as a gift as I don’t think I would’ve purchased it at first. I was scared the watermelon scent might be too harsh for my skin but to my surprise there’s barely a scent. Legit next day of application, my skin felt so so so soft. I was SHOOK. this product is truly amazing. I use it as last step after moisturizer.

I received from Glow Recipe: Watermelon Glow AHA Night Treatment.I love this night treatment, every morning my skin looks much brighter, and smooth with healthier looking skin, I love that it is not greasy at all, I love the products of this brand and now this one joins my list of favourites..

I am a huge fan of the watermelon toner so I was super excited to try the overnight mask - and it didn’t disappoint! The texture is like a lightweight jelly. It goes on smooth and I wake up with glowing, dewy skin.

I don’t usually like nighttime masks because they leave my face feeling sticky. While this mask goes on a little sticky it dries down pretty quickly for a more comfortable sleep. I’d had a random textured spot on my cheek for about a week that this mask mostly cleared up after one use, and by the second use my face was back to normal.

This night treatment has been so good to my skin! I put it on overnight and by the morning, my skin feels amazingly smooth and hydrated. I love the gentle exfoliation it provides! Such an amazing new reformulation.
review_title: Love how this makes my skin feel!

review_text: i’m happy that this new mask works well for my sensitive skin! it makes my skin feel so smooth the next morning. The scent is really light so its perfect for those that don’t like heavily scented skincare products

I love the watermelon glow treatment so I was so excited to see they launched an overnight version. I love to put this on before bed and then wake up with brightened and refreshed skin. My face always feels so smooth after using this product.

I didn’t want to leave a review until I used this product at least a few weeks, but honestly I was impressed after the first use. I have an autoimmune disease that causes my skin to always be dry and textured so I didn’t think that after my first use that my skin would feel so soft! I like that the mask isn’t sticky and has a nice, subtle scent. This product will definitely become a permanent part of my routine!

this product made my skin feel so hydrated and plump. I’ve used it twice already and have noticed how much softer my skin feels. My skin feels refreshed in the morning. I love the texture and how it’s lightweight yet so moisturizing. This product is definitely going to be a staple in my routine.

The watermelon line from Glow Recipe has always been my fave of theirs. With a subtle yet pleasing watermelon smell, this resurfacing mask gently hydrated and brightened my skin after just a week of using it. Woke up to hydrated and plump skin! The watermelon glow line from Glow Recipe never disappoints. I’ve used this twice so far and right off the bat from feeling the texture I knew it was going to add hydration without irritating my skin. My skin felt renewed and plump without breaking out.

Overall, I will be using this in the future. My full review is on glow recipe because sephora has character limits. Trying this was a bit of a rollercoaster. The first time I used it I was not very impressed. I did not really notice anything as far as smoother and hydrated skin. In fact the morning after first use my skin felt tight and dry to me. I did not (and still don’t) like the way it feels on my skin; it feels filmy and sticky, which is unpleasant to me. I still have some of the OG watermelon night mask and I always felt like my skin looked great the morning after using it, more hydrated and smooth than when I used this new night treatment, so I decided to do a literal side by side comparison. I did half my face with the OG and half with the new treatment. The smell of the OG is better, the new treatment smells kind of alcohol-y and not nice and watermelon-y, to me at least. What I discovered in the morning was what got me though. The half of my face with the new product was definitely more lifted and toned looking. Having it on only half of my face made me realize the difference. And that difference stayed for the whole day as far as I checked (because yes I kept looking to see if I could see a difference, duh, I wanna if the effect lasts more than just when I first woke up). The side with the OG of course had the gel piling but it did leave my skin more hydrated and bouncy. The firming and toning effect alone though is enough for me to want to keep using this product. If I am honest I kind of wish the OG was still around and that this was just released as its own, new serum and not as the successor, so to speak, for the watermelon glow sleeping mask. I do really like the firming and toning effect though, so I plan on using this in the future.

I think this could work for sensitive skin types but make sure to patch test. Really loving this and might repurchase if I don’t have any future skin issues.
