I am so impressed! My skin looks brighter and more hydrated as soon as I wake up. The product is so smooth and lightweight. It layers with my other skincare perfectly and I will continue to use it as my final step. My skin is so smooth now!
review_title: Great for my acne prone skin

review_text: This mask is a lightweight, gel texture that glides on the skin and dries down nearly invisible. My skin felt smooth and soft. I woke up to treated breakouts and smoothed texture. It’s gentle as far as AHA treatments go, particularly overnight treatments and was hydrating for my combo skin. However I don’t think it would be the best option for super dry skin! Overall I enjoyed this mask and will use again!

I loved the original but am equally happy with this re imagining of the watermelon mask! I didn’t notice a substantial difference in feeling or texture but am enjoying the product so far and love the whole watermelon line!

I have been using this for a few weeks now and have noticed my skin feel bright and glowy! I use it in the morning and evening as my last step in my skincare routine. My skin looks so healthy with a natural glow without it looking greasy. The only thing I would have liked to have seen is a small spatula to come with it so I wouldn’t have to dip my fingers into it.

absolutely LOVE it! Skin looks so glowy the morning after, feels super smooth and even too! doesn’t have much of a smell like other GR products but it’s still super nice. Really watery consistency so a little goes a long way!
This is one of my new favorite products! I had never really been into the overnight skincare products, but I absolutely love this one.  Also the packaging is absolutely adorable and I love the smell.

I absolutely love this new product from Glow Recipe! My skin feels so amazing when I wake up it feels like I put a fresh new face on for the day. The cream is so silky smooth and hydrating especially for someone with dry skin like me. My face feels so smooth and glowing especially when left on over night.

This night mask by Glow Recipe is magical! After Applying it for the first time woke up to a beautiful soft skin. My face felt super hydrated and soft as if I had no pores !! The texture is gorgeous! Gel like lightweight and applies beautifully. Unlike other overnight masks I’ve tried before this one doesn’t feel heavy on my skin or cloggs my pores but dissolves into my skin giving me a beautiful glow. I plan on using it as much as I can!

I received this as a gift. I has been using this overnight and I have seen amazing results. I was struggling with skin that looked too dull and this has helped bring my skin back to life. It’s for overnight but to be honest I use it in the daytime under my makeup.

I was sent a sample of this to try out by glow recipe in exchange for reviews and a coupon.  It’s not game changing for me at least. I feel like my skin was smoother with the plum moisturizer so I wouldn’t buy this product. It doesn’t have that typical watermelon scent, and the texture is runny leaving your skin tacky for a couple minutes. It definitely feels moisturizing after you put it on and the tackiness wears off. In the morning my face felt like usual so no change there. Granted they wanted a review after a week so I really didn’t notice any difference, maybe after longer use. If you have dry skin then I think it’s worth a try.

I love the updated version! The added hydration benefits are amazing. My skin just soaks this up. The consistency is the same as the original mask but I like this one so much better and the scent isn’t as strong. If you’re not a fan of heavy night time sleeping masks, this AHA Glow Treatment is for you!

This is my first time trying product with AHA. I was little concerned that it could be little harsh on my skin but it’s not. I apply it twice a week as my pm skincare moisturizer. It is not tacky and the texture is smooth. It is very hydrating and I notice my skin feeling smoother and clearer when I wake up.

This product was gifted however all opinions are my own! I love glow recipe and this product is no different:) it feels so nice on the skin and smells so good, like all other glow recipe products. Highly recommend

I adore their watermelon line. To add this AHA overnight Mask to their line up is amazing. I prefer this over a Niacinamide mask. Although this still has that ingredient but further down the list. I love the watermelon scent as well. My skin is smooth in a matter of days. Had no skin irritation either.

This is a really great AHA night product. I have oily sensitive skin that is acne prone. The packaging is gorgeous glass minus the cap which is like a nice pink plastic. My skin feels hydrated and smooth after use of this. I use it a few times a week for pores. I would recommend it for sure.

So I’ve been using the glow recipe serum with AHA in the mornings and decided to add this to my night routine! The combination has cleared up my skin significantly! I had some dark spots from the sun and they’re gone! Definitely did some work!

This feels so good on my skin! It’s perfect for layering with moisturizer too. I love the packaging, the pink is sooooo cute. It’s a good texture that leave my skin feeling refreshed and clean. Absolutely love!

This product is so nice! I’m really enjoying it for my skin type (sensitive and dry) and am seeing improvements over night!  The texture is nice and smooth and not too sticky! Overall a very nice product!

I love this treatment! I’ve seen results from the first time I used it.  After using it 2-3 times a week I’ve seen my skin getting more even, brighter, and softer than ever! My makeup applies easily and I no longer struggle with dry spots on my face. I recommend this treatment if you’re the type that wants a mask that works while you sleep!

This is such an upgrade from the original watermelon mask. It keeps that same great watermelon scent, but with a much better formula in my opinion. This exfoliating mask is gentle on my skin and applies without pilling over my moisturizer. The next morning my skin looks brighter and I’m excited to see long term results!

This formula feels very silky and lightweight, but is still deeply moisturizing. I use this during my nighttime skin care routine so that it works overnight, and the next morning my skin feels moisturized and looks radiant. It works well in combination with The other products in my skin care routine and absorbs easily without pilling. After weeks of regular use, my skin has a visible improvement in overall texture and appearance.

I have been using this nightly to try and help improve my skins texture and I’ve definitely notified a difference! And it smells so good! I love the way Glow Recipe’s products smell anyways and the fact that they actually work is even better

Oh my! The packaging, baby pink color and consistency of the AHA night treatment is wonderful! It is surprisingly runny and lightweight and unlike any other treatment I’ve tried in the past.It does feel slightly tacky at first which I personally don’t mind since it’s an overnight treatment. A lot of exfoliants are too strong for my dry skin but this one is very gently and does not irritate my skin at all. I love waking up with smooth, soft, and hydrated skin!

Honestly I’m not really into sleeping masks, actives, or fruit-themed products, but I love this! It makes my skin look radiant and hydrated. As far as the actives go, it’s really gentle (I use 2 x’s a week). I love the texture, it’s not too thick or too thin and is slightly sticky at first until it dries down. It doesn’t smell like watermelon (plus for me). Overall I really enjoy this product.

The products I use is Tatcha and got the Glow as a sample. I must say….. in just 1 day I can definitely feel and see the difference. I washed my face with my face washer and afterwards used the Glow at night before bed. It has no smell, does not feel sticky or as if you have something on once it’s penetrated onto your skin. My face the next day had a beautiful glow and less blemishes. This is wonderful and I will be purchasing. Even 2 days later my face is still clear and looks much healthier prior to this. I definitely recommend this product. Especially if your the type that don’t like anything heavy, sticky or weighing on your face. LOVE THIS.
review_title: LOVE THIS PRODUCT IN JUST 1 USE

review_text: This is the first glow recipe product I’ve tried and I really like it! I was a little worried about the scent because I tend to get only products without fragrance, but the scent is not overpowering and doesn’t irritate my skin. This is super easy to use and layer on top of other serums and under your moisturizer. A little bit goes a long way, and it sinks into the skin so well. When I wake up in the morning, my skin looks clearer, brighter and softer, and any breakouts are diminished. l would definitely recommend this product, and will continue to use it 1-2x a week.

I use this treatment a few times a week and have definitely noticed results! Make sure to wear a lot of sunscreen during the day, as it’s easier to burn when using this. I like how it feels on my skin and it has made my texture better

I love this brand it has made such a huge difference in my skin care routine. This new formula is very lovely it melts into the skin and leaves my face feeling refreshed and plumed when I wake up in the morning

After trying the Watermelon Glow AHA Night Treatment, I am very impressed. I love how my skin felt the next morning. Very hydrated, glowy, and looked like I had already done a full skincare routine. I would 100% use this again in the future!

I’ve never tried an overnight mask before so I was really excited about this one. My skin has felt so dull and dry lately too. I put this on before bed over my nighttime skin routine and washed my face when I woke up. My skin felt and looked so moisturized  and glows!

Love all the glow recipe products and was excited that the watermelon now has an AHA ingredient! I’ve used a full jar of the watermelon overnight mask before and love how hydrating it was. With the added AHA it leaves my skin feeling not only hydrated, but tight and with a clearer complexion. I have this on rotation with my evening skincare products!

Glow recipe has the BEST skincare products! I love this mask they have made. I put it on at night and wake up with aglow on my face. I love it and highly recommend it to everyone who wants to have glowy skin
This has helped brighten and smooth my skin like none other! I was so impressed with how easy this layers with other skin care products, and also how amazing my skin feels after I wake up with it on.

This overnight mask is so nice. I have had incredibly dry skin lately and this was a game changer for. After using it for the first time, my skin felt so hydrated, smooth, and radiant. I have been using it twice a week since and have noticed a big difference in my skin. If you are in the market for a new overnight mask, this is a great one!

An absolute hit for Glow Recipe! There aren’t many products out there that have made a noticeable difference in my skin after just one use. But this product did exactly that. The first time I used it my skin was dull and feeling rough as I had a super stressful week and had neglected my skin. I put this one and went to bed. When I tell you the next morning I was so surprised to feel my skin feeling so soft and smooth when washing my face. It truly works, and you only need a light layer. I’ll be repurchasing till the end of time.

This is Glow Recipe’s newest product that’s a reformulation of their watermelon sleeping mask. This one adds some acids in it to promise you clearer and brighter skin after waking up. The texture is a soothing gel feel and I was sad that the watermelon scent wasn’t really detectable! After applying on the face, there’s a tingling sensation right away but goes it away quickly. It feels slightly sticky but too bothersome. The next day I didn’t really notice a huge difference in brightness and my skin wasn’t too dry after. Since it has acids in it, I wouldn’t use this more than 2x a week so any improvement in brightness would take a while to notice. I did enjoy using this though because of the texture and how my skin looked glowier in the morning.

I’ve only used this a couple of times, but I love Glow Recipe and couldn’t wait to test it out. So far so good! It feels nice on my skin. I have dry skin, so I was a little worried about the AHA being too strong for it. But it’s gentle enough to use for me. I like it a lot and can’t wait to see results over time!

I am madly in love with this one!!! Is a very lightweight product and very hydrating! It gives you the most beautiful glow and your skin feels pretty healthy! I use it 3 times a week since is an exfoliant and I have to be careful not to damage my skin barrier since I am a little sensitive these days. In the morning my skin is feeling still hydrated and brighter! Love it!

Wake up to brighter, smoother skin with this night treatment! I use this alone and over other skincare; I find it works better without moisturizer, but that’s just personal preference. For my oily skin, this is more than enough to seal in my skin’s moisturizer. Teensy but sticky upon application but dries down quickly. Effective but very gentle; I use this in-between retinol nights and experienced no irritation.

Can you believe this is my first ever product from them? I never got to try the original but I love anything watermelon scented even though the faint scent disappears right after you apply it. This is a runny gel texture, not sticky and gives a little hydration to the skin, but it’s so gentle that it doesn’t seem to do that much- the texture that I had was only faintly smoothed out by morning. Still testing to see how it goes but I’m unsure about the results so far. I feel like if I used it several times a week I would have less texture, but I’ll have to see. For sensitive skin, this would be perfect for you or for anyone who wants to use a gentle product on a daily basis to keep pores clear.
review_title: Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow AHA Night Treatment

review_text: I love glow recipe products so I was really excited to see this night moisturizer release! The product is very hydrating and super lightweight. I love that this leave a glow to my skin without feeling heavy like a lot of night creams do. Would reccommend!

No watermelon scent :(. But this mask does sink in quick, it’s not sticky, and it definitely smooths my skin when used overnight a couple times a week! I personally haven’t experienced any pilling when layered with various serums and cream products.

I have been searching for a great PM mask and I have found it! I absolutely adored the texture! It is creamy and smooth, it soaks into the skin with a barely-there finish. It felt kind of whimsical on the skin and also intensely moisturizing. I actually found that the AHA was gentle and effective. I attempted to try to not layer too many products with it and used at the end of my skincare routine at night. Also, it has the most beautiful fragrance, that doesn’t overpower the cream or the product. My skin is in absolute bliss with this cream.

I am a big fan of Glow Recipe’s products, I have not had a product that doesn’t work well for my dry sensitive skin. I have been using their Strawberry Smooth BHA+AHA Salicylic Serum for about a month now; it does so well keeping my hormonal pimples at bay. When I saw they have am AHA Night Treatment from the Watermelon Glow line, I was beyond excited. When I first tried it, I had a under the skin pimple on my chin. After just two usages (at night time, one night apart), the pimple was gone. Now I use this treatment once a week (twice during period). With the combination with the Salicylic Serum, my skin has been clear and looking hydrated. Recommend for all skin type.

I’m obsessed with this product! I’ve always loved glow recipe skincare and this did not disappoint. My skin felt so hydrated and nice aftwerwards. It gives a really nice subtle glow which layered perfectly with the rest of my skincare and makeup. Would highly recommend!

This makes my skin feels so soft, hydrated, fresh in the mornings. I used over other two serums - It layers great with these other two products.  I apply this 2-3 times a week. The smell is great, not strong at all. The consistency is very unique… like a gel but lighter. I definitely recommend it.

I was happy to have the opportunity the newest addition to the glow recipe collection. The revamped watermelon sleeping mask actually works really well, I enjoy that it is lightweight, it absorbs into the skin so well!
It had a nice texture and made my skin softer but it broke me out.

I love the packaging and the pinkish watery, serum like mask in the square glass jar.. It spread easily and nicely without sticky feeling.. It is very lightweight and absorbs quickly.. It makes my dry skin hydrated, moisturized and nourished.. It also makes my skin soft and plumper..
review_title: Makes my skin plumper and glowing!

review_text: This product is great! I’m always weary of trying new skincare with my sensitive skin, but this didn’t cause me any breakouts and left my skin feeling smooth and moisturized! It doesn’t have any harsh scents, which i like also. Overall it’s a great product!

When I heard that glow recipe was coming out with a new product I was so excited. I’ve been using glow recipe for quite a while now. I started using this product & I love that it feels so lightweight. I love that when I wake up in the morning my skin looks super glowy & hydrated. I’ve used my overnight products before & this one of my favorites. This one is definitely going on my favorites list.

I’m a fan of Glow Recipe and was super excited to try this product. I use this mask every other day when I’m not using retinol. I use this at night as the last step of my pm routine and wake up to hydrated and brighter skin. After a few days of use i feel like some acne scars are fading.  I haven’t tried the previous version of this mask but I would recommend this one.
review_title: New addition to my pm routine

review_text: I was a bit hesitant to try this mask out because I have sensitive skin so I don’t tend to try out products with  AHA since I find them stripping and drying. However, this mask was not drying or irritating and I love the way it makes my skin have a nice, healthy and natural glow. It is very hydrating and easy to apply. I use it before bed and wake up feeling very refreshed. I recommend this to everyone who wants to achieve a glowy skin and smooth skin texture without the hassle. Just apply, sleep, and wake up to a glowy you!

This overnight mask is something I have been looking for! I tend to get acne on my cheeks and this helped clear some of the dark marks I had on the surface. I live the feeling of the mask, but it’s not as hydrating as I like. I use the plum plump moisturizer on top of this to get the intense hydration that I want

It smells great as always is the case with glow recipe products. My skin was nicely hydrated afterwards and I have no complaints. My skin looks radiant and youthful and plump. Would recommend.  The packaging is nice.

I was a fan of the original GR watermelon sleep mask, so I was excited to try the new improved watermelon sleep mask. It smells lovely. It applies nicely. My skin looks much more refreshed the day after using. I like that it’s thicker than the old mask!  I use every 3 days. I’m really loving the new improved mask.

I was sent a few samples to try. I really enjoy the product so far. Love the scent, as always. I was also a fan of the previous product. I think this one has a lighter texture and it dries down better. I wake up with a nice plump soft face. I think the only thing I’d change is the packaging. I did receive a small sample size so maybe the larger jar is better, but with the consistency of this product, I think it would be great in a pump bottle like the watermelon moisturizer. When my samples run out. I will probably order a full size jar.

This new Watermelon Glow AHA Night Treatment is so good on my skin! I’ve been such a fan of Glow Recipe since their first launch so this product takes me back. The consistency of this product is quite runny and I’m not sure if it’s supposed to be like that. However, it feels so good on my skin. It makes my skin feel very hydrated and in the morning, my skin feels really smooth! I, of course, need to continue using this product to see longer lasting results. But for using it for about a week now, my skin has been loving it!

I absolutely love this concealer. I have used it everyday since I have received the product. It is creamy, allows for easy application, and most importantly it is not cakey. Personally, it is a little more matte than I would prefer, but with a little more moisturizer applied before application, it is perfect. It also is great for sensitive skin!

I am a bit fan of Glow Recipe so normally I got really excited for this new product. The Watermelon Glow AHA Night Treatment comes is an aesthetically pleasing glass jar and it smells absolutely delicious. The texture is very lightweight, almost runny. I usually apply it as the last step on my nightly skincare routine and it feels really good, like a comfy blanket over my face. I like waking up with a hydrated, smoother and brighter skin. It’s a win for me!

After using this a few times a week for a few weeks, I’ve noticed that my skin definitely looks brighter.  It’s not too harsh.  My skin isn’t drier or stinging after using, which sometimes happens for me when I use exfoliants. It also doesn’t have any smell unlike the other watermelon products from glow recipe. I think this is better because I like my skincare unscented.
review_title: Not too harsh and brighter skin

review_text: Smells so yummy! I love the smell of glow recipe products and packaging is luxurious. Applying the product feels so soothing and nice on the skin and it makes my face feel very fresh and hydrated. It doesn’t feel to heavy either!

I’ve used several times as the last layer in my night routine, making skin smooth & bright.  This satisfies my dry skin with hydration & feeling moisturized, in the morning my skin is nice & smooth & still feels hydrated! I love the glass pot, even the side indentations fit your grip making it easy to hold.  The runny,  gel texture is cooling & feels good on my skin.  Of course, it smells fantastic without being over the top watermelon!

LOVE THIS NIGHT MASK! The texture of it is great and it feels so luxurious when applying at night. I wake up to my face feeling refreshed and very well hydrated. I’ve noticed an improvement in skin texture and brightness. The smell is nice and light and overall the mask doesn’t feel too heavy on my skin, which is a huge plus!

Love the texture, it’s like a jelly and felt cooling on the skin. My skin absorbed it quickly but just did notice it left it slightly tacky feeling. When I woke up the next morning my skin felt smooth but didn’t notice it being brighter. Will keep testing it.

It smells SO delicious and fruity! I use it as the last layer of my night time skin routine and it makes my skin feel super moisturized and looks glowy. It makes my skin feel very fresh! The packaging is also very adorable and luxurious.

Love this product thank you Glow Recipe!! Leaves my skin so smooth and hydrated in the morning, and goes on super light and refreshing. I use it every night after my nighttime skincare routine (cleanse, tone, retinol, moisturize). My only complaint is that I have other glow recipe watermelon glow products (the dew drops and lotion) and the watermelon scent for this product isn’t as strong as the others.

My skin feels noticeably softer when I wake up, and the product has a smooth, almost tacky feeling. My skin feels very hydrated and more bright, and right away I feel more plump. This has hydrated my skin more than other overnight treatments, and I use it a few nights every week. It layers great with other products and my skin feels so smooth!

I absolutely adore anything from Glow Recipe and this mask is no exception! I love the watermelon scent in all of their products and this mask is super gentle yet gets the job done. Will be adding this into my routine.

I absolutely love this face mask at night it feels super soft in my skin. For the next day my face looks and feel really hydrated. Love the smell of it and how it makes my skin look I would totally recommend to others.

I love this!!! I’ve always liked glow recipe and have tried their watermelon glow moisturizer before. This is along the same line and I love how my face feels cleaner and smoother when I wake up in the morning. <3

Glow recipe never ceases to amaze me! I already loved their original product and the new version is amazing.  It smells so good like watermelons. It made my skin feel fresh and clean and super soft. Definitely try this!

Completely obsessed about it! Besides the fact that it smells amazing, I love how my skin looks and feel after using it. I usually use as my last step of my night skincare routine and I wake up looking flawless!!

glowrecipe sent me this product complimentary to try out! I had never tried out the old formula but had always been interested in it. I have loved it so far. It feels a little sticky at first but dries down and doesn’t feel uncomfortable on the skin. Every time I’ve used it I’ve woken up to softer and visibly smoother and glowier skin without any irritation!

I use this in my night time routine and my skin feels soft and hydrated in the morning. The product has a smooth jelly-like consistency with a delicious watermelon fragrance. The packaging is also very practical and adorable!

I have been using the new Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow AHA Night Treatment every night and I have been getting so many compliments on how radiant and clear my skin looks! I apply the night treatment as the last step to my skincare routine and I have been waking up with plump, clear, healthy skin every day! I love using gentle exfoliant treatments overnight because I can see the difference in my skin in the morning and I have very sensitive skin so finding an exfoliant that doesn’t irritate my skin has been a struggle but I am so happy I have finally found a product that works for me! My skin is more hydrated, former and smoother since I’ve started using this night treatment!

This is my first time trying a product from Glow Recipe. The treatment has a lightweight texture and absorbs easily into skin. It has a very pretty pink jar. I use it as an overnight treatment and my skin looks soft, smooth and hydrated the next morning. I am very happy with this product.

This is such a beautiful and wonderful product! It has a glass container that remind me of rose quartz. I have incorporated this over-night moisturizer to my daily night-time routine. I have been using it every night for about 2 weeks now! Works well layered with any of my other night time products! It feels really nice when I’m applying it on before bed. It makes my skin feel much smoother and glowy! The formula has a very dewy and pink appearance. It has a very light delicious watermelon scent that is almost not noticeable, which is great for sensitive skin. It leaves my skin super hydrated and bouncy the next morning. With consistency, I have been noticing positive differences with the appearance of my skin.

This feels like the previous Watermelon glow mask, but less tacky and I think it absorbs better. The fragrance is also not as strong as it was in the previous version. It does a great job of hydrating my skin and leaving it glows, and in the  morning my skin feels nice and supple. I definitely will be using this in my nighttime routine 3x a week to get the full exfoliating effect.

Very happy with this product, my skin looked hydrated, soft and smooth after using it overnight. I love to use these kinds of products overnight for best results. I love how thin the product feels yet absorbs beautifully

My skin feels so hydrated and plump after using this night treatment. I love the thinner silky texture of this product and how nicely it absorbs without being either drying or too heavy on my skin all night, plus it layers well with the rest of my skincare routine! I love how gentle this product is while still feeling effective. I will continue to use it a few nights a week and leave on over night! I can’t wait to see long term results. And just like with all glow recipe products, the packaging is adorable!!

I haven’t tried anything from Glow Recipe yet, but I think the brand is very innovative so I was excited to try this AHA night treatment. I like the ease of using this since you apply it as the final step in your nighttime routine and wake up with results. This is very lightweight and absorbs easily into the skin, with a very mild watermelon scent.  Similarly to SF Good Genes, I wake up with smoother and softer skin. Big fan of this!

Talk about glow! I’m always looking for a good treatment or exfoliating product. I’ve been using this 1-2x weekly and am really enjoying the results. It sinks into the skin well and doesn’t feel sticky like some other overnight treatments. When I waste up I notice a soft glow and even look to my skin. I don’t enjoy heavily fragrances products before bed so I really enjoy that this is unscented! I can’t wait to see the results over time.

I received this complimentary in exchange for a review; these are my honest opinions. Another note - I never tried the original version of this product, so I can’t offer a comparison between the two formulas.PROS:- I recall the original version having a strong watermelon Jolly Rancher scent, which I didn’t notice in this formula; it has a very faint watermelon scent that I really only notice if I sniff the open jar directly - great news if you have a sensitive nose like I do- the formula spreads so easily across the skin & absorbs quickly without leaving any tackiness behind - a little goes a long way!CONS:- sadly, this broke me out, so I can’t attest to its exfoliating/smoothing claims since I have had to stop using it
review_title: no strong fragrance anymore, but broke me out

review_text: Never disappoints by Glow Recipe! This new product is great leaves my skin feeling so refreshed. I have sensitive skin and haven’t had any issues with it yet. Another plus is that this smells so good too!

Obsessed with this night treatment. My skin looks brighter and more firm. It’s very moisturizing & smells so good! I use during the day and haven’t experienced any drying. I love this product & would highly recommend!

I love this brand’s products, it never disappoints me!  the product smells nice, leaves a feeling of clean and fresh skin on the face.  I always wake up with a beautiful face after using this product !!

This is such a lovely night treatment, it smells really nice and the texture is so good, jelly like. I like that it doesn’t pill and it’s pillow proof. The next morning my skin feels softer smoother and has a lovely glow.

This product from glow recipe is so good i fell in love immediately. It has a nice soft texture and applies so smoothly. It is lightweight, you can barely feel it. The next morning my skin felt like baby skin.

Finding ways to improve my skin without extra effort is always a bonus, which is why I love overnight masks! This one is different than others I’ve tried in the past. It has a very runny texture,  is not too heavy, and sinks into the skin. I don’t wake up feeling greasy or anything like that. It leaves my skin feeling radiant and gives a healthy glow

This night mask has a light texture, easy to apply and absorb.  I use it as recommended, a few times a week, I like how it works overnight and what it does to my skin, it is helping to improve the appearance in general, it looks more hydrated and healthy. It has reduced the dryness, which I highly appreciate.

Very excited to use the reformulated version of this! I think it’s still super gentle while providing some skin renewing overnight. It’s definitely less irritating to me than the old version, but the hydration levels are about the same. I always use a really good moisturizer when I use this so I don’t dry my skin out!

I really love this product! Has a light scent which I really like because it’s not overpowering and I don’t even smell it once I apply the product. Has a gel type texture which is my favorite. And I love that I wake up with my skin feeling more hydrated and already looking smoother, brighter, and just better. This is my favorite treatment I have ever tried because it’s easy to incorporate into my routine since you only use it 2-3 times a week and it absorbs into my skin quickly and doesn’t make it feel sticky or anything as I apply it right before bed. I’d definitely recommend checking this out and I’m excited to see my long term results with this product and might be the first skincare item I have ever repurchased after finishing because I usually like always trying new things but that’s how much I really love this overnight treatment !
review_title: My favorite skincare product I’ve ever tried!

review_text: I love Glow Recipe and I love AHA treatments, so this is a match made in heaven products! Super cute packaging as always. The products itself felt great applying to the skin, smelled delicious but not over powering, sunk in quickly and easily into the skin. It played well over my other skincare too! Or perhaps the gel lotion formula wasn’t hydrating enough for my dry mature skin?  I think for someone younger, or new to chemical exfoliants, or with combo to oily skin this might be a wonderful product and I would recommend that they try it.  There were no negative effects, no irritation or redness, but there also wasn’t the exfoliation or smoothing that I have gotten with other products.

This formula is really nice. It’s thin and sinks into the skin quickly, leaving a nice, healthy glow behind - but the packaging… I am at a loss at why they decided this needed to come in a jar. It is way to thin - think a little thicker than the Dew Drops. This would have been so much better in a pump bottle - a serum dropper even! It truly makes no sense to have in a jar because you could literally turn the jar upside down and it would pour out. You have to dip your fingers in multiple times just to get any product, which means it’s getting way more contaminated than it needs to be. This is an occasion where the packaging really ruins the product. My husband, who loves Glow Recipe, won’t even use this because he can’t get any of the product out of the jar because again, it’s so thin, than it cannot be scooped out. This is truly such a bummer because this is one of the first Glow Recipe products that isn’t overly scented so I am actually able to use it (I have sensitive, acne prone skin, so while I enjoy their formulas I cannot use most of them because the fragrance breaks me out). I really hope they decide to change the packaging, because this packaging honestly makes it pretty in-useable. I don’t see anyone else complain about this, which is blowing my mind. It makes me wonder if I got a bad one or something. Im so confused.
review_title: Why would they put this formula in a jar?

review_text: I love the fact that you can literally put this on the entire eye area, as well as how thorough the instruction are for this (it even says to apply between the brows in that 11s zone). I have been looking for a product that could be applied like this! It’s surprising that there really aren’t eye cream out there meant for the entire eye area. I also really like the texture and it does absorb quickly and my skin feels nice and silky after (it not sticky=yay). Now unfortunately for me, when I tried this the first night things went fine, the second time I put it on and my skin reacted and was bumpy (it was not an allergic reaction, just like irritation).  I don’t have reactions to using vitamin C on my face, so I wasn’t sure if the vitamin C was just stronger than the skin of my eyes (which is a more sensitive area) could do, if it just wasn’t used to it, or if this isn’t going to be for me. After looking into it, the vitamin C could just be more than my eye skin area can handle as far a ph change goes. It took about 2 weeks for my skin to come back to completely normal. And then I (crazy thing) decided to try diluting the eye cream in the niacinamide dew drops since that’s safe around the eyes (reducing the vitamin c concentration) and to try only using every other day to see if I my skin will adjust and then maybe I will be able to use the product normally. It has been going well so far... However, I am not an expert by any means and I don’t know yet if my skin will actually adjust and if I will be able to use the product normally. This is just my experience and what I am trying because I did like the product and I want to be able to use it in the future.
review_title: I like it, hopefully it will like me

review_text: I received a sample of the Guava Eye Cream from Glow Recipe for review purposes. I am 45 with drying, aging skin that still breaks out occasionally. My primary treatment concerns are hyper-pigmentation (from pimples) and crows feet. I used the GR eye cream twice a day for two weeks, stopped for two weeks, then used the rest for another two weeks. And I have to say, the difference was eye-opening! The days I used the eye cream, my eye area was lifted and bright. The effects were cumulative and when I stopped for the two weeks, I still looked more refreshed and awake than I did prior to starting the eye cream! I also noticed my acne breakouts healing more quickly, and the hard sebum (clogged pores around eyebrows) softening and dissolving. A very small amount (half a pea size) sufficiently covered my entire orbital area. Think “Zorro’s Mask” zone, which includes the lower forehead and between the eyes. I love this product and immediately ordered a full size. On days my skin needed more moisture, I used the Glow Recipe Banana Moisturizer all over. Just perfect.

However i think that is more of personal preference i personally like a sudsy lather but this may not bother you. Dispite the later i think this may have to replace my cleanser soley because the benefits are amazing and outweigh any cons this has even convinced me i may need the avocado serum haha
review_title: A must have for combo, dry or winter cracked skin!

review_text: I was sent some delux samples to try. I really like this cleanser. It is perfect for the dry cold winter climate I live in. It’s not irritating or drying but I do feel like it’s getting my skin clean. I’m a big fan of glow recipe products, but I don’t regularly use their other cleansers, but I actually think this one will be in regular rotation for me. At least in winter! My one complaint (but bonus for some people) is the scent. I would call this unscented. I don’t really smell the fresh aloe scent. I miss the fruity scents. But if you generally shy away of some GR products due to scent, I say go for this one! I think if it was a nice scent, I’d give 5 stars.

At first, I was concerned I would break out because this cleanser has oil in it. To my surprise, I did not break out. Instead, I found this to be more hydrating than my other cleansers. It lathers easily and seems to be “creamy“ as opposed to thick. The scent is not strong--neither pleasant nor unpleasant. The skin on my nose tends to be flaky on a daily basis during cold weather, no matter how much I moisturize. I was surprised to notice a dramatic difference after using this cleanser. I would recommend this to anyone who has dry skin.

The formula is amazing and the products does a fantastic job with removing the makeup and grime from the day without stripping my skin which is amazing as I have dry sensitive skin. I wasn’t a huge fan of the smell at first but adjusted after a couple of uses. Would definitely recommend!
review_title: Great cleanser - removes makeup without an issue!

review_text: The Avocado Ceramide Moisture Barrier Cleanser is a creamy cleansers lathers easily and makes my skin feel clean, calm, and smooth without that tight dry feeling. Using the new Avocado Ceramide Moisture Barrier Cleanser with the Avocado Ceramide Recovery Serum (which I already love) has help calm my redness in my skin and some hyperpigmentation.
review_title: Calming cleanser that won’t dry you out!!

review_text: Absolutely love this brand! Love the feeling of this cleanser! It is so lightweight and smooth. During the winter the apples of my cheeks and the tip of my nose can be tender from the cold weather and mask wearing, this cleanser is so gentle and actually feels soothing.

Like that it was low scent. Felt that it was minimal lather, but that is not a big deal to me. It did sting my eyes, which is disappointing - because it is marketed as makeup removing, I like something that is gentle around my eye area. I felt like the first few days using it followed by my normal skincare routine, my skin would get overly oily, which I usually do not experience. After a week of using it tho, I think my skin adapted. All in all, I would recommend this as a morning cleanser, or after a day wearing minimal makeup! Certainly did not have a negative experience.

Love this new cleanser! Rich creamy lather and leaves skin soft, refreshed, and with a healthy glow!  Subtle clean scent, definitely not strongly scented. Perfect cleanser for everyday use as it doesn’t irritate the skin. Thanks glow recipe for another amazing product!!!

The scent is very mild, neutral and almost unnoticeable. Once I added water, it worked well. I feel like it cut through my makeup better than the blueberry bounce cleanser. I always double cleanse with papaya balm and then blueberry bounce, but I felt like this product worked well alone. I did not feel dry following it’s use and we are experiencing cold weather right now!
I have used faithfully for 2 weeks. I can say this will be my new cleanser love the results, skin feels so soft and more youthful, love it.😍

i’ve used this for the past two weeks and i have seen the difference with my face’s dry winter skin! especially around my nose and cheek area, it is less ashy and more glowy! thank you glow recipe! 10/10 recommend!
review_title: I’m switching to this face wash/moisturizer!

review_text: Cleansers are not a part of my skin care routine because of how harsh and stripping they are. I was fortunate enough to be on the tester panel for Glow Recipe’s Avocado Ceramide Moisture Barrier Cleanser and I’m so happy that I was selected! This is the cleanser we all needed but didn’t know could exist. It’s silky, not super lathery, provides good coverage with just a little bit of product, and seriously leaves my skin feeling softer and more moisturized after I rinse. I was shocked given my previous experience with cleansers in the past. The Avocado Cleanser didn’t leave my skin feeling tight or dry at all, quite the opposite. My opinion has completely changed. Not surprised that Glow Recipe achieved this feat… their line in incredible!

This cleanser is exactly what the glow recipe family was missing. I find their blueberry cleanser a bit harsh for my skin so I was happy to see this is much gentler. The texture is velvety and doesn’t strip my skin. It also removes makeup effectively, including my mascara. After a week of use, the only complaint I have is that I have to use quite a bit since it doesn’t foam up.

This is a much needed addition to the GR family. The blueberry cleanser is too drying for winter and I don’t always feel like double cleansing so skip the papaya. This one is great. Gentle enough for my sensitive acne prone skin while still effectively cleansing. No offensive scent. Would definitely recommend!

I was ECSTATIC when I saw this cleanser. An avocado cleanser with ceramides!!!! I started dreaming of moisturized, supple and glowing skin. I quickly found that when I applied it to my skin my face immediately started feeling tight and dry. I’ve had this happen after I have fully cleansed my face, but not when I began washing my face. I love Glow Recipe, and my entire skincare routine, except my cleansing step, are products of Glow Recipe. I’ve tried every product, and I’m always looking forward to GR’s next launch. So sorry Glow Recipe, but the Avocado Cleanser is a hard pass for me. Still hoping for that perfect cleanser for ultimate nourishment specifically for aging skin.

I have oily skin that is prone to sensitivity, redness, and dry patches in the winter, and this cleanser definitely gave me a nice boost of nourishment. It has a richer and creamier texture than the blueberry gel cleanser, however it’s a thinner cream consistency, which made it easy to work with and spread, not feeling heavy but still providing a norishing boost. The richness came from the formula, not a heavy texture.After washing my face, my skin didnt get the dry ‘hurry up and put the next product on me’ feeling before I could get to my toner. This cleanser definitely gives an extra moisture retention/soothing boost, and I would definitely reccommend it for anyone with dry skin or anyone who wants that extra boost of nourishment through the cold dry winter months!
review_title: A boost of nourishment for any skin type

review_text: This product gets your skin smooth and soft. I feel as if my skin is more hydrated and nourished. A creamy cleanser that gets your skin amazing cleaning but balanced.
review_title: They have done it again! Just Wow!

review_text: My sensitive skin is prone to dryness especially during the winter. This cleanser provided deep nourishment while removing my makeup.
This cleanser helped me a lot and as well helped my skin barrier it was non irritating and as well as very nourishing. I have oily skin that is prone to sensitivity and redness.

I have dry, flaky skin from the use of tretinoin. The cleanser is creamy and silky. I didn’t find it to have a scent. It lathers well and feels luxurious on the skin. It’s gentle but really works well at removing makeup and leaves the skin feeling healthy and hydrated.
review_title: A must have for dry skin!

review_text: The cleanser works great for dry and sensitive skin. It’s very gentle and the skin feels smooth and nourished.
review_title: Great product for dry and sensitive skin!

review_text: I have oily skin and am prone to redness. After a few days of using this cleanser, I noticed a huge reduction in both. My skin looks even and has a nice glow to it. Not shine, glow! I didn’t expect this product to have the results it did but it is now my go-to morning cleanser!
I love this, it has been a gamechanger during the winter months on my dry skin. It lathers and cleans great. I use this as sole cleanser on no-make up days.

This new cleanser felt wonderful on my skin, especially since the weather has been so cold. It makes the perfect amount of foam, washes away easily and leaves my skin feeling clean but not tight. Like the other avocado products, it has a mild and gentle scent. It paired great with my papaya cleansing balm and removed all of my makeup. This is a luxurious feeling cleanser and I highly recommend it. Another winner from Glow Recipe!

I’ve been using this for about a week and have found the lotion-to-foam cleanser left my skin feeling hydrated and thoroughly cleansed. I am not a fan of the scent as I was spoiled by the blueberry one. My skin didn’t feel tight which is always a plus and it removed all the day’s dirt & oil without feeling I needed to wash my face a second time. I would recommend this to everyone but especially for those who double cleanse.
review_title: Double cleanse No More with this Treasure!!

review_text: This cleanser has perfectly met my needs for a milky cleanser in my glow recipe lineup. It breaks down makeup and is the perfect cleanser for the dry winter season, leaving my skin clean, moisture intact, and ready for the next step in my routine. Couldn’t be happier!
review_title: This is exactly what I’ve been waiting for.

review_text: My first thoughts were ohhh an avocado cleanser! I was very excited to try, I feel that it didn’t really have an avocado smell, but it did feel nice to wear all around the face, not drying at all and very rich with moisturizer, will say it’s definitely better than the blueberry cleanser only because that one can tend to dry my face up. This cleanser works so well that I could literally replace all my cleansers for this one. But I don’t waste lol so when I’m done this avocado cleanser I’ll definitely stick too. ;)

I received a sample from Glow Recipe in exchange for an honest review about their product.  I find the Avocado Ceramide Moisture Barrier Cleanser to be hydrating, soothing, and it left my skin glowing.  I use many Glow Recipe products and this one will be added to my routine, as well.  I enjoyed the lotion-to-foamy lather effect this product had and the fact that it didn’t strip my face dry made this product a good one for me.  I prefer the blueberry bounces’ scent much better but it would not be the deciding factor for my purchasing this product.
review_title: Another Hit made by Glow Recipe!!

review_text: My acne during my pregnancy has been so bad, so when I tried this cleanser, the redness disappeared and the acne has died down. I have used it twice a day and my skin looks nourished, clear, and glowy.

Used this cleanser for two weeks. I loved the way my skin felt after. That tight and dry feeling when you wash your face doesn’t happen with this product. Perfect for winter. Also used along with the papaya sorbet cleansing balm. Amazing.
I love this gentle cleanser for daily use. It feels soothing and my skin feels very healthy after using it!

FINALLY an non exfoliating cleanser from GR!! Absolutely LOVE this cleanser! It’s creamy/foamy, doesn’t strip my skin & makes it feels nourish. It’s gentle, yet effective at removing the last of my makeup when I double cleanse with it. It’s worth it for everyone with sensitive skin, but all skin types in general.

I enjoyed using this moisturizer over the past 2 weeks. It left my skin feeling soft and smooth. My husband noticed I had less irritation and fewer breakouts, even around my cycle. The only thing I did not like was the cleanser did not lather well for me, but it worked wonders for my skin. The texture is creamy like a light lotion. I did not notice a scent at all.

Great for double cleansing at night in the winter months.  Normally I double cleanse with the papaya balm followed by blueberry bounce.  This extreme weather mixed with indoor heaters leaves my skin a mess & sometimes a little tight after using the blueberry cleanser in these months.  This helps me keep my nightly double cleansing routine going without feeling dry.

I thoroughly liked this cleanser so much. It lathered very well and I didn’t need to use much product to get a good clean. The texture is very nice and creamy, so it feels gentle on the skin. It didn’t strip my skin of hydration as other cleansers have. I also enjoyed it at night as well as when I woke up in the morning. This cleanser is gentle but its work is mighty.
This is the BEST in the winter when your skin is dry, red and chapped. It felt so calming on my face, and the redness was gone in an instant.

Great cleanser that makes your face feel clean without stripping. It easily took off the spf I use everyday, and it lathers well with and without a foreo. My only issue was the horrible smell, but that’s personal preference.

I received two small free samples of this as part of the rollout campaign. I used this cleanser in place of my normal GR Blueberry Bounce Gel Cleanser for about a week and a half and like this one a lot, but would only recommend this as a second cleanser. It does not remove makeup very easily and it doesn’t lather with just water and hands easily either—I needed to use a facial buff sponge to get it to lather richly. It’s quite gentle and hydrating, plus it doesn’t leave my skin feeling tight or dry or dehydrated after air drying, unlike the Blueberry Bounce Gel Cleanser. I have sensitive dry skin and get irritation rather easily, however this cleanser did not leave my face feeling flushed or looking pink like other cleansers typically do. It’s a very solid product, but should really only be used as the 2nd step in a double cleansing routine (if you wear makeup). I’d recommend an oil-based makeup remover for the 1st step if you’re using this as part of a double cleanse skincare routine. Overall, this cleanser is hydrating, gentle, nourishing, and does not leave my skin feeling dehydrated or irritated. It’s not an all-in-one cleanser, but it does minimize discomfort for dry and sensitive  skin types after face washing and I would purchase the full size of this once it’s released.

I received a sample of the Avocado Ceramide Moisture Barrier Cleanser from Glow Recipe for review purposes. I am 45 with dry, dehydrated skin that still breaks out occasionally and is prone to hard, oil-clogged pores at my temples and cheeks. My primary treatment concerns are hyper-pigmentation (from acne) and crows feet. I used the GR avocado cleanser twice a day for two weeks. The cleanser was creamy yet rinsed away cleanly. (It’s reminiscent of the Herbivore Cloud Jelly Cleanser, for comparison purposes, but is a touch more moisturizing.) The GR cleanser is a really nice “final cleanser” as I do use an oil/balm first step, second step foam cleanser, then a “treatment” third cleanser such as one that contains glycolic acids, AHA, PHA, salicylic acid, or a moisturizing cleanser, depending on what my skin needs.  I really appreciated the GR avocado cleanser on days after I’d used a chemical exfoliant. It was very soothing and did not cause any stinging. I highly recommend this for all skin types, even oily or acne-prone. As I mentioned earlier, it does rinse away cleanly and did not leave behind any filmy residue. I also love that it has ceramides and pre/postbiotics, so I’m treating my skin as well as gently cleansing. Overall 5 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️!

Worked well with my combo/oily skin. Lotion to light foamy texture when water added. Did not remove waterproof mascara as well as their BB cleanser but still is a wonderful cleanser. Will definitely continue to use it!

I currently use the Avocado Serum as a part of my normal skin care routine. I was excited to know that there was going to be an Avocado Cleanser. It applies so nice on my skin and it has helped reduce my redness in the morning. I can’t wait to include this in my normal skin care routine.

I have been using this for about 2 weeks now. I have mature skin (42 yo) and maintaining moisture has been a struggle! My skin feels clean after using this cleaner without feeling stripped or dry.   Will be buying for myself and my daughter!

After using this cleanser for two weeks I’ve seen my skin improve so much! Redness has minimized and texture is smoother. Overall my skin looks less irritated. It’s very creamy and the scent is very light(oatmeal).

Only had to use such a small amount and lathered up very well and covered the whole face. Texture was smooth and creamy. Absolutely left my skin feeling smooth and looking refreshed. Skin felt so hydrated after washing. Smell was nice and not too much, just a natural scent which I love for the face. It took makeup off so easily. After a little over a week of use, I feel like my skin looks radiant and healthy. I am in love with the whole line of Glow Recipe and knew this product would be awesome!
review_title: Hydrating and great for winter skin!

review_text: I received a free sample of this product to try for 14 days in exchange for my honest review. I am 24 with combination skin, prone to dry flaky skin on my forehead and nose. Overall, I liked this cleanser. I thought it was very gentle and soothing with a mild scent, but it was not effective in removing all of my makeup. For reference, I use Tarte SEA Power Flex concealer and Tarte Maneater mascara. I still had mascara on and around my eyes after using the cleanser. I would use this cleanser either as the second step of a double cleanse, on days that I don’t wear makeup, or in the mornings. It was soothing and did seem to help with my flakiness which had worsened with the winter weather. The texture was pleasing and almost mousse-like, but it didn’t lather as much as I would have liked. It left my skin feeling clean, but not stripped, and supple. I would recommend this cleanser, and will continue to use it (especially during cold months) but I don’t think it should be marketed as a makeup remover.
Used this for several weeks and have noticed a great change in my skin, less red, even skin tone, brightness. Will definitely repurchase this item.
My new go to! Left my skin moisturized and feeling great! I would recommend a double cleanse if you wear a lot of makeup. Helped with my redness. My new fav!!!

I have really dry and sensitive skin, especially in the wintertime. Sometimes I have to stop cleansing altogether to avoid painful rashes, but this product was super soothing and easy on my skin. I could use it every day and not feel sensitivity. However, I’m not a fan of the scent and it could be a bit better at taking off makeup.
I love this cleanser! It’s gentle, still foamy, smells pleasant, and leaves my skin feeling clean without feeling dry! If you like the Clinique All About Clean Cleanser- this is similar.

I’ve been double cleansing and I don’t have leftover makeup after using this Avocado Ceramide Moisture Barrier Cleanser:) It doesn’t lather very much. It leaves my skin feeling very moisturized. Will be purchasing in the future.
After using this cleanser, skin feels soft and smooth. Clean and hydrated at the same time. Skin feels hydrated all day.
review_title: Clean & hydrated at the same time.

review_text: This was very gentle on my skin and I was able to wash off eye makeup surprisingly well without any burning sensations. I loved the silky textured lather and light scent as well. I definitely noticed an improvement with skin texture and dryness!

I’m 33 with combination skin that gets flaky & textured in the dry winter months. I received a small sample to try for 10 days in exchange for an honest review. So far, I’m really enjoying this product. It cleanses gently with a mild scent. After, my skin does not feel stripped, dry, or stiff. It has noticeably helped with flaking. It’s comparable to the Cerave Hydrating cleanser. My only word of caution is that this is a water-based cleanser. So, while it will remove light makeup, it will not remove heavier makeup. For context, I generally use GR’s Papaya balm or Farmacy Green clean for makeup removal. For this reason, I don’t think it should be listed as a makeup remover. That being said, I love using the cleanser as the 2nd cleanser in my nightly double-cleanse routine or in the morning after a heavy workout/to wash of any overnight masks. I’ll definitely make this a part of my regular routine.

When I first tried the cleanser, I was a little surprised by the sent. The products are usually a bit more fruity, but it wasn’t unpleasant, just different. It lathered quite nicely and when I put it on my face, it felt rich and almost oily.  It was very smooth, but also kept its lather through the whole minute of washing. When I written it off, I expected it to leave an oily residue, but it washed off clean and clear and left my face soft. Altogether,  I loved it and it was a very effective makeup remover and cleanser.
It’s smooth and lathers easily and it removes makeup very well. It doesn’t have a strong scent.
I have been using for a couple of weeks. My skin is smooth, brighter & moisturized after using & not dry. It removed my makeup very easy & I feel I don’t need to double cleanse. Love this product!
review_title: A must have for dry skin!

review_text: I love the way this cleanser felt, it starts as a luxurious cream that slowly transitions to a light foam. Scent was barely there and not at all noticable, not that i would have minded. I love how my face did not feel tight and raw after using it. My skin feels so much smoother, this is the perfect cleanser for the cold winter months.

After using this creamy lotion-like cleanser for 2 weeks I noticed that the dry  and rough areas are smoother , softer, and  more moisturized , while my entire face is impeccably clean.  Initially I missed the sudsy, bubbly feeling that I generally look for in a cleanser, however it still did the job.
review_title: Great Cleanser for Winter Combo Skin

review_text: This is fantastic at removing makeup and a daily face wash. Definitely a product I look forward to purchasing more of. This washes my face beautifully and thoroughly. I have slightly sensitive skin and dryness. I had no issues at all.
review_title: I love this cleanser and makeup remover

review_text: Creamy and luxurious! I’m a huge fan of their blueberry cleanser and could never have dreamed Glow Recipe would make another cleanser but omg so lusciously moisturizing. Thank you, Glow Recipe!

After using this product for the last two weeks, I’ve noticed my redness was gone. I have very sensitive skin and I will use this cleanser from now on. Also noticed how easily it removed my makeup. My skin feels so much more hydrated now too

im really enjoying this cleanser! it is very soothing for angry skin.for reference, Im 40 with menopausal sensitive finicky adult acne prone combo skin. this cleanser has no scent and I’ve had zero bad reactions while using it! I personally prefer to double cleanse since I use a heavy moisturizer in the winter but this is a perfect second cleanse without stripping my skin! dare I say, I prefer this over blueberry bounce... I think i do!

I loved this cleanser!! It’s amazing for people with sensitive/dry skin. Most cleaners that later into bubbles strip my skin too much, but most gel cleansers don’t make my skin feel clean enough. This cleanser was the perfect mixture! It was hydrating and soothing and I noticed a huge difference in my skin almost immediately. I highly recommend this product and will be buying again!
I absolutely love this cleanser. It makes my face feel soft and smooth. It is easy to apply, and takes your makeup off well. The scent is not too strong.
review_title: A Much Have In Your Skincare Routine

review_text: Initailly I didn’t know it was a cleanser cause it looked like lotion but I decided to give it a try and it gets activated with water. It is definitely a winter cleanser for everyone like me that needs that extra moisture locked in your skin. It does not strip your natural oils from your skin but cleanses your skin and gets rid of dirt, and makeup. This will be my go to winter cleanser, while the blueberry cleanser will be my summer cleanser.

I’ve tried so many other brands, but what I love about this cleanser is the fact that it’s so creamy and I’ve tried so many other brands, but what I love about this cleanser is the fact that it’s so creamy and nourishing. The best part is it really helped with my redness using this with the avocado serum amazing.The best part is it really helped with my redness using this with the avocado serum was just amazing

After using this product, I could already see the difference after the first wash. I love how this cleanser hydrates my face, you could really feel the difference after you rinse your face. I recommend it for people with sensitive skin like me. It’s so calming and soothing as well, it takes my make up off gently. I am now torn between using this and the blueberry face wash.

I received a sample of this cleanser and used it twice daily for two weeks. Previously I was using the Blueberry Bounce Cleanser (same routine). I have combo skin (very oily everywhere but dry, flaky, and red around my mouth) and breakout easily. The smell is not as good as the Blueberry Bounce - it has a clay-scented undertone. It feels very smooth when applied and lathers up, but it doesn’t get quite as foamy as the Blueberry Bounce. I think my complexion has improved over the past two weeks. My skin is not as oily, the dry area around my mouth is still dry but not flaking, and I have fewer breakouts. I plan on switching to this cleanser and would recommend it! I will miss the pump bottle of the Blueberry Bounce and wish this cleanser also came in a pump bottle so I could better measure how much I need to make it lather up.

I received this product from Glow Recipe as a trial and I have really enjoyed how it’s been treating my skin. It’s gentle for my sensitive skin and I’ve noticed my barrier looks healthier since using. Will totally buy this once my current cleanser runs out.

After using this cleanser for a couple weeks, I noticed how my skin was a lot softer and smoother. It’s not drying and feels like my face is moisturized. I see myself using this cleanser during winter time in place .

Using this cleanser has improved my dry skin significantly.  I was a bit hesitant at first because my skin is sensitive, I have to be careful with the products I use, but glow recipe has never let me down. I immediately felt the difference. The creamy texture, basically no scent and how clean my skin felt when I rinsed, it was amazing! After 1 week of using this cleanser, my skin has stopped flaking. I even got asked by someone if i got a facial because my skin was glowing. So if you’re looking for a cleanser that will leave your skin squeaky clean but not at all dry, this is the cleanser for you.  Your skin will thank you!
Amazingly soft lather, without over stripping. Great for a second cleanse.

This cleanser was everything I needed for my skin this winter. It’s very creamy and nice on the skin. It definitely helps reduce redness and any irritation after just one wash. I’m in love and will be using this cleanser everyday from now on. Thank you Glow Recipe!

I like the texture of this cleanser and felt it does a great job of removing light amounts of makeup and textured skin, it ended up irritating my rosacea. If you don’t have rosacea or sensitive skin then this cleanser should be fine for you.
review_title: Good Cleanser for Average Skin Types

review_text: I really like this cleanser it’s creamy and foams easy while it cleanses my skin. This cleanser really helped my skin this winter this cold weather left my face dry and flaky but with this cleanser my face feels soft and hydrated and I don’t have any dry flakes. Definitely recommend.
review_title: Good cleanser for dry winter skin

review_text: Has a nice creamy texture!  Feels like it removes makeup well/leaves skin feeling very clean without feeling too dry.

This cleanser is gentle and very easy to use.  I did not experience a big foaming action but I did enjoy messaging this cleanser onto my face.  My skin felt hydrated and soft after each use. It worked well to take off makeup, which I seldom wear, and sunscreen at the end of the day.   The formula is gentle and non-stripping.  I would recommend this cleanser to those who are new to skincare and do not wish to have a multiple-step routine.
review_title: Great product for the skincare novice

review_text: I saw an immediate improvement in my skin with   this  new face wash.You definitely need to try this. My skin is glowing. Glow recipe has the best products.
review_title: New face wash for glow Recipe.

review_text: This cleanser is creamy, sudsy, and leaves my skin feeling so clean and hydrated. I have very dry skin and using this for a week has helped bring moisture back to my face.
review_title: Must-have for us dry skin girlies.

review_text: The product made my skin more red than when I was using blueberry bounce, so I will likely stick with that one. It did smell great and lather well and was enjoyable and easy to apply. Removed makeup well too. It also hydrated my skin without flakiness. Not sure why I was slightly more red after use. Decent product, but doesn’t beat blueberry bounce for me!

I was really hoping to get on well with the Glow Recipe Avocado Ceramide Cleanser. I’m a big fan of every Glow Recipe product I’ve tried in the past, and I’ve tried most of them. However, I do have dry skin, which is quite sensitive. So I have to be careful about using and/or overusing active ingredients like exfoliants, vitamin C, retinol, etc. I’m also allergic to Niacinamide, so that’s a no-go. Sadly, I can’t use most Glow Recipe products very often. Other than the Banana Souffle Cream, which has been heartbreakingly 💔 discountinued. I still use that one daily.So when I saw this cleanser, I thought it was going to be perfect for me, as it seems to have no notable harsh ingredients, and was designed for more dry and sensitive skin types. Plus, I love a creamy, gentle cleanser with ceramides. Unfortunately, one or more of the ingredients in this formulation just didn’t agree with my skin, and caused sensitivity and irritation. I don’t really know which ingredients caused the issue. I gave the cleanser 4 stars, because my skin is quite sensitive, & most people probably wouldn’t have a sensitivity to the ingredients. I really like the cleanser overall, and I wish I could continue using it.This cleanser is a green creamy liquid, which produces a very light froth. I like this type of cleanser, because they are generally the most gentle, non-stripping types of cleansers. It does cleanse the face and neck thoroughly. I don’t really wear makeup often anymore, so I cannot report on the cleanser’s ability to remove makeup. The cleanser appears to have no added fragrances, and there really is no detectable scent. I love the fact that it contains ceramides, because my skin usually flourishes when ceramides are in a truly gentle formulation. I’m really disappointed that I cannot continue to use this cleanser, but I’m sure many people would do well with it & love it. If you know that you aren’t sensitive to any of the ingredients, I would highly recommend this cleanser.

I had a chance to use this product over the last few weeks. I wasn’t sure what I would think of it because I have been using the blueberry cleanser for so long and been happy with it. This really exceeded my expectations. It is a very creamy consistency and lathers nicely. One thing that I should note is that the product itself is a little thinner than I expected and it’s really easy to squeeze too much out of the bottle at a time and end up with more than needed and it would therefore be better if either the formula itself was thicker OR if the opening in the tube wasn’t as large. The only reason why I did not give this product a full 5 star rating is because of the packaging. The formula is a bit runny and since it is in a tube with the opening at the bottom, you would need to hold the tube with the hole facing up before opening as to not have the product just pour out, which is such a waste if you dont catch it in time. It would be much better if they change the packaging into a bottle with a pump.

review_text: I bought this cleanser a few weeks ago and have been using only it since, but it hasn’t lived up to its claims, and I don’t understand the hype. Compared to the cleanser I’ve been using for the last few months (Tatcha Rice Wash), this leaves my skin feeling dry and dull. It does remove makeup well, I’ll give it that, but given its claims, I was expecting it to leave my skin feeling hydrated, healthy, and somewhat glowing, which it did not. Like other reviewers have mentioned, the packaging is a serious issue - I didn’t think it would really matter, but this really needs a pump as the consistency is so thin, otherwise you end up wasting as much product as you use. Unfortunately I’m returning this and going back to my other cleanser as it was more hydrating.

I have a hard time not feeling like my oily tzone causes my pores to be more pronounced so this helped make it look not as noticeable. It definitely has no crazy heavy scent to it and it’s small packaging helps with on the go! I like it and I’ll continue to use this!

Gifted by glow recipe! These are the blurring drops. First off, I love the smell as we stick to their strawberry line. It’s subtle. It has a good effect as it gentle sweeps across skin allowing foundation to grip to it. I notice it does blur my pores, especially around my nose.

this feels so nice on the skin! amazing for the oily skin girls like me who are looking for a primer-serum! it blurs my skin amazingly and works well with all the foundations i use it with! truly a great product!

I’ve been using these drops as a night serum and I really love the way they make my skin feel. They really smooth out my skin and help my pore to appear smaller. I typically don’t love exempted products on my face because I have sensitive skin, but the scent in this serum is so subtle that it doesn’t bother me. I’m looking forward to using this long term to see if it makes a difference in shrinking my pores!

Love pairing this serum with their strawberry bha serum for the best acne fighting combo. I tried it as a primer and I enjoyed the subtle blur and tackiness it had, but I think I prefer using it better as a serum

I’m used to thicker primers and was surprised by the runny consistency of this one. It is by no means a miracle product, so don’t expect your pores to be invisible. However, the blur drops somehow manage to make my pores, which are most prominent on nose, less noticeable. At the same time, the drops create a velvety smooth canvas that helps my foundation glide on effortlessly and stay in place all day. My Make-up still looks great at the end of a long day. I think I’ve found my new favorite primer!

This serum truly leaves your skin glowy!!!!! I am obsessed with the consistency of this serum. It leaves me face hydrated and moisturized for the whole entire day. It has a great consistency. I recommend.

The blur drops did make my skin look more hydrated and did help a bit with the excess oil. I have very oily skin specifically in my t-zone and this did help slightly reduce the oily look on my face. I didn’t really find it to have a pore blurring effect though.

At first I was under the impression that this was more of a primer than a serum, so my first application of this was a bit too much as I was not expecting a serum consistency. I do enjoy that this is a treatment as well. When first applied it goes on smoothly, a bit mattifying, I find a second smaller application in target areas allowed for a better blurring or softening effect. It feels great on the skin. Really enjoyed getting to try this out.

I got these complimentary from Glow Recipe in exchange for a review.I loved these Strawberry Blur Drops! I like this so much more than the other blurring primers I’ve used because it doesn’t have a thick gel texture and it’s nongreasy. The liquid texture of these drops is not runny, making for an easy application without losing product. My foundation looks amazing when I use these drops as a primer: it really stays in place all day and my pores looked less defined. I also love these drops as a last step for my nighttime skincare routine, for locking my hydrating products in. Also, the packaging is so cute! Overall, 10/10 for me!

I love this serum by glow recipe . It has become a staole in my makeup routine. My skin feels so hydrated but smooth after using this. Doesn’t let my makeup get oily as I love matte skin. I highly recommend this

I am loving how this works for my skin. I am using it as a middle step as suggested. It has a great blurring effect. As someone who usually doesn’t wear makeup it looks completely natural just a little softer. Definitely a great addition to my routine.

I have large pores and get very oily in my t-zone, and this product instantly blurred my skin. It’s a light, creamy serum texture that feels like nothing on the skin once it’s absorbed. I wore this under my makeup and noticed that I was significantly less oily but still dewy rather than matte/cake-y. I love using this as a primer for a natural skin-like finish with my foundation! I definitely recommend this product as a primer under makeup or as a step in your skincare routine to help shrink your pores ✨
review_title: This product is a game changer for oily skin!

review_text: I loveee the BHA serum so I was super excited to see a primer was coming out! It’s a more lightweight version of the serum, minus the AHA so I can wear in during the day. Can’t wait to wear this everyday!

My pores are pretty visible and I love a good product that has a blurring effect.  My skin looks and feels smooth.  My foundation sits on top flawlessly and does not dry out or feel crackly by the end of the day.  Complimentary from Glow Recipe.

I didn’t know if I would see much difference as I have use the glow recipe dewdrops. However, I know that niacinamide is very good for the skin and put it in a primer would probably do wonders for my skin. The consistency of the product is water-based so it does go on a bit watery but you’re able to really massage into your skin and it dries rather quickly. You will feel a bit of tightening on the skin and it will be a little bit dry. This is the effect of it shrinking the pores and blurring them. That actually works for me because my skin is naturally oily and so when I apply additional products or makeup, that is a bonus. It helped to keep down my oil production and made sure that my makeup doesn’t move. I was hoping for more of the watermelon scent but it’s actually very faint. I also thought it would be somewhat hydrating as well. So I will give it three out of five stars.

Gifted by Glow Recipe. I am always seeking out a product that will minimize my pores to give me that ’flawless airbrushed look’ and this did the trick. It was easy to apply, glided on the skin, and gave me what I wanted. My pores looked smaller while also giving my makeup a good base.

This is definitely a holy grail serum & primer! My face looks super smooth! I have been using this as my primer everyday and love love love how my skin looks! It looks like I’m using a pretty skin filter on Snapchat. Although the packaging is super cute I wish it came with a pump bc a lot does come out and it’s very wasteful!);

I really enjoyed this product! It is very thin and light which I liked a lot. It glided onto my skin smoothly and blurred my pores! I’ve been using it after I wash my face then before I put on my makeup!

I was expecting an intense strawberry smell, but it’s really doesn’t smell like anything. Which is better, for me at least. It blurs pores very lovely, especially great under the make up. Texture is very thin, makes it very light that you don’t even feel it’s there.

Gifted by glow recipe I am a huge GR fan as it is and when i saw this I was so excited !! First of all my skin looks beyond smooth and when I use it with make up wwhoaaaa absolutely flawless love !! So pretty

I love that this is a skincare hybrid so it’s like an2 in 1 and in this economy that’s a win. I love the experience this product gives too, from the packaging to the light but yummy smell. 10/10 for me!

This was gifted to me by glow recipe but I do highly recommend giving these a try!
